items.desc: Sede di lavoro: Roma Sud – Casal Palocco / Axa Tipologia: Full-time – 40 ore settimanali Modalità: In presenza Esperienza: Junior, preferibilmente 1–3 anni Chi siamo Siamo una realtà imprenditoriale impegnata nella progettazione, nello sviluppo e nella commercializzazione di piattaforme software innovative destinate ad aziende e professionisti. L'intelligenza artificiale rappresenta una componente centrale del nostro metodo di lavoro: utilizziamo strumenti AI avanzati per accelerare lo sviluppo, migliorare la qualità del software e realizzare soluzioni tecnologiche evolute. Per ampliare la nostra struttura cerchiamo uno Sviluppatore Software Full Stack Junior, appassionato di programmazione, nuove tecnologie e intelligenza artificiale. Di cosa ti occuperai Entrerai a far parte di un ambiente dinamico, lavorando direttamente con la Direzione alla realizzazione di piattaforme digitali già progettate a livello di struttura, logica funzionale e interfaccia. Il tuo compito sarà trasformare i progetti esistenti in applicazioni software complete, funzionanti e affidabili. In particolare, ti occuperai di: Sviluppare applicazioni web e piattaforme gestionali. Utilizzare strumenti di programmazione assistita dall'intelligenza artificiale, come Google Antigravity, Claude Code, ChatGPT o soluzioni equivalenti. Trasformare mockup HTML e specifiche funzionali in applicazioni operative. Sviluppare e integrare frontend, backend e database. Realizzare collegamenti con API e servizi esterni. Implementare nuove funzionalità su piattaforme esistenti. Analizzare, verificare e correggere il codice generato anche attraverso strumenti AI. Individuare e risolvere anomalie tecniche. Eseguire test funzionali e controlli di qualità. Collaborare all'ottimizzazione, alla sicurezza e alla stabilità delle applicazioni. La progettazione grafica, la struttura delle piattaforme e i mockup sono già gestiti internamente. Competenze richieste Conoscenza di JavaScript e/o TypeScript. Familiarità con React, Next.js o framework equivalenti. Conoscenze di sviluppo backend e database SQL. Capacità di utilizzare Git e strumenti di sviluppo software. Esperienza o familiarità concreta con strumenti AI applicati alla programmazione. Capacità di comprendere, modificare e verificare codice sorgente. Conoscenza della lingua inglese almeno a livello B2, scritto e parlato. Attitudine al problem solving, precisione e autonomia operativa. Competenze preferenziali Saranno considerate positivamente conoscenze di: Node.js e PostgreSQL. Python. Docker e ambienti cloud. API e integrazioni con modelli di intelligenza artificiale. Playwright, Vitest e strumenti di testing automatizzato. Automazione dei processi di sviluppo software. Utilizzo di agenti AI per lo sviluppo e la manutenzione delle applicazioni. Non è indispensabile una laurea. Valutiamo anche diplomati informatici, diplomati ITS Academy e candidati che abbiano sviluppato competenze attraverso esperienze pratiche o progetti personali. Cosa offriamo Opportunità di lavorare su progetti software innovativi e concreti. Utilizzo quotidiano di strumenti avanzati di intelligenza artificiale. Collaborazione diretta con la Direzione aziendale. Possibilità di contribuire allo sviluppo di più piattaforme digitali. Ambiente tecnologico orientato all'innovazione e alla crescita professionale. Opportunità di apprendimento e specializzazione nelle tecnologie AI applicate allo sviluppo software. Chi cerchiamo Una persona curiosa, motivata e appassionata di tecnologia, che non si limiti a utilizzare l'intelligenza artificiale per generare codice, ma voglia comprenderlo, migliorarlo e utilizzarlo per sviluppare software di qualità. Cerchiamo soprattutto capacità pratiche, affidabilità, voglia di imparare e attitudine a risolvere problemi. Come candidarsi Invia il tuo curriculum vitae specificando: Linguaggi di programmazione e tecnologie conosciute. Strumenti di intelligenza artificiale utilizzati nello sviluppo software. Eventuali progetti realizzati, anche personali, con link GitHub o dimostrazioni. Livello di conoscenza della lingua inglese. Disponibilità a lavorare in presenza nella zona di Roma Casal Palocco. La selezione comprenderà un colloquio conoscitivo e una breve prova tecnica pratica, finalizzata a valutare le competenze effettive. Se ti appassiona sviluppare software utilizzando le nuove potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, inviaci la tua candidatura. Retribuzione: €18.000,00 - €18.200,00 all'anno Benefit: Bevande gratis Parcheggio libero Snack gratis Sede di lavoro: In presenza

items.desc: Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling At a glance We are looking for new medior colleagues to join our Non-Retail Credit Risk Modelling team within ABN AMRO's Risk Modelling department. Effectively managing risks is essential in banking. The importance of modelling in core banking processes, such as risk management, is growing rapidly. New technologies, data sources, and data-driven solutions bring countless opportunities. These opportunities drive competition and increasing regulatory demands on data and models. ABN AMRO is taking a proactive step by leveraging these opportunities to strengthen its competitive position. The Risk Modelling department aims to create risk models that enable risk-based decision-making and sustainable growth. Our models comply with regulations, accurately predict risks, and allow us to offer clients a sustainable price that aligns with their risk profile. Our team is committed to being at the forefront and cutting edge of these developments. Your job As a data scientist in the Non-Retail Credit Risk Modelling department, you play a key role in redeveloping credit risk models for various lending portfolios. You and your team are central to reshaping ABN AMRO’s credit risk model landscape, one of the major challenges in the bank’s risk management. In this role, you contribute to every phase of the model redevelopment cycle, from model initiation to internal validation and onsite inspections by DNB/ECB. You have advanced knowledge of statistics, coding, modelling decisions, and applicable regulations. You can clearly articulate your views and foster strong collaboration with stakeholders across the bank. Working environment ABN AMRO’s Risk Modelling department is a young and international team consisting of over 150 professionals from diverse backgrounds. As the bank’s centre of excellence for quantitative risk models, we play a crucial role in daily decision-making processes. Our models support activities like pricing deals, granting credits, and determining capital requirements. Our team thrives on intellectual challenges and has a hands-on mindset to deliver results. Collaboration is key to ensuring our work has maximum usability and a positive impact across the bank. Your profile You have a master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field; You have >2 years’ experience working in a credit risk modelling team e.g. IRB, IFRS9, Stress testing or related model development. You speak and write English fluently; You are an effective communicator, connecting easily with stakeholders on different levels of seniority; You are familiar with relevant coding languages, such as Spark, Python and SQL. Experience with Azure DevOps / git is a pre. You have thorough knowledge of banking and credit risk; You have thorough knowledge of rules and regulations and regulatory trends relevant for credit risk modelling (Basel, CRR, etc); Experience in working with DNB/ECB through communication and on-site inspections is a pre. Do you have what it takes to meet this challenge? Do you have experience with large projects with a strong quantitative character, and an eye for detail? Or are you a top talent in the field of quantitative risk management, and ready for the next step in your career? Look no further and apply to this role, we look forward to get to know you! Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing. In addition, we offer: An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowanceand a flexible benefit budget. An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future. Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you. Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually. Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work. Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000. An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use. You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy. Interested? Interested in this position? items.desc: Vill du utvecklas inom B2B-försäljning och sälja en tjänst som hjälper företag i vardagen? Aliado hjälper företag att ta hand om kundförfrågningar även när de själva är upptagna. Om rollen Du kontaktar nya företag, framför allt via telefon, och presenterar Aliado. Vi börjar med hantverkare och serviceföretag, exempelvis elektriker, rörmokare, byggföretag och målare. När ett företag vill veta mer bokar du en demonstration och visar tjänsten digitalt. Om företaget har tid kan du demonstrera den direkt; annars bokar ni en tid som passar bättre. Du följer upp dialogen och arbetar vidare med affären fram till avslut. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: Kontakta och bearbeta nya företagskunder. Ta reda på hur företagen hanterar kundförfrågningar och vilka behov de har. Presentera och demonstrera Aliado. Ta fram lösningsförslag som passar kundens verksamhet. Besvara frågor, hantera invändningar och förhandla. Följa upp kunddialoger och driva affärer till avslut. Vem söker vi? Du tycker om att skapa kontakt med nya människor och känner dig trygg med att presentera och sälja. Du är kommunikativ, förtroendeingivande och motiveras av att nå resultat. Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet av AI. Du får lära dig produkten och hur du presenterar den. Erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning, mötesbokning, kundmöten eller försäljning av tekniska tjänster är meriterande. Vi tror att du: Tar egna initiativ och arbetar målmedvetet. Är bekväm med telefonkontakt och digitala presentationer. Kan förklara en teknisk tjänst på ett enkelt sätt. Är strukturerad och bra på att följa upp kunddialoger. Är nyfiken på AI och digitalisering. Uttrycker dig väl på svenska i tal och skrift. Vad erbjuder vi? Du får introduktion och stöd för att komma in i rollen, och möjlighet att utvecklas inom försäljning och AI. Du får också vara med och påverka hur Aliado bygger upp sin försäljning framåt. Låter det som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan och berätta varför du vill bli en del av Aliado. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Lön: 10 000,00kr - 100 000,00kr per månad Arbetsort: På plats

Då är du intressant för oss. Vi söker en ekonomikonsult med särskilt intresse för system, digitalisering och AI. Du behöver inte vara programmerare. Men du tycker att det är roligt att förstå hur tekniken kan göra ekonomiarbetet bättre. Från ekonom till problemlösare AI förändrar ekonomifunktionen, men tekniken gör inte jobbet åt oss. Någon måste förstå problemet, ställa rätt frågor och avgöra vad som faktiskt är en bra lösning. Det är där en riktigt bra ekonom gör skillnad. Du behöver inte kunna allt. Vi söker en trygg ekonom som är analytisk, nyfiken och prestigelös, och som börjar leta efter lösningar så fort någon säger att det där går inte. Och så var det det där med Mpya För på Mpya är du aldrig bara konsult. Vi tror på laget före jaget. På att den bästa lösningen sällan finns i huvudet på en enda person och på att kunskap blir bättre när den delas. Du får därför inte bara möjlighet att utvecklas ute hos våra kunder. Du blir också en del av vårt eget kunskapsbygge. Vi vill att du ska komma med idéer, testa saker, ifrågasätta och vara med och forma hur vi själva arbetar framåt. Känner du igen dig? Då ska vi ses. Inte för att bocka av en kravprofil, utan för att prata om vad du kan och vart du vill ta nästa steg. Oavsett om du redan har kommit långt inom system och AI eller precis tittar över kanten. Intervjuer sker löpande så ansök gärna så snart som möjligt. Vid eventuella frågor är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Emelie Palmqvist på emelie.palmqvist@mpya.se eller Lina Rehnholm på lina.rehnholm@mpya.se Vi hörs snart, visst?

items.desc: Pet Pawr Group AB är ett snabbväxande entreprenörsdrivet bolag med en omsättning på ca. 1 Mdkr. Vi är ett av Nordens mest moderna zoofackhandelsbolag – både online och i fysisk butik - och står bakom flera välkända varumärken: ZOO.se, Tinybuddy, Pritax och norska PetXL. Vill du bygga AI-agenter som används på riktigt, i butik, lager och på kontor? Pet Pawr Group söker en specialist som tar egna AI-tjänster hela vägen från affärscase till drift och mätbar effekt. Om rollen Du äger de tjänster och agentbaserade flöden vi utvecklar inhouse och du bygger dem själv. Målet är mindre manuellt arbete, kortare ledtider och bättre beslutsunderlag i alla avdelningar. Du ansvarar för utveckling, drift och första support, och rapporterar till vår CTO. Rollen passar dig som i dag arbetar som AI Engineer, AI-utvecklare eller fullstackutvecklare med fokus på automation. Det här gör du Bygger och driftsätter agentbaserade flöden med tydliga gränser för vad agenten gör själv och när en människa godkänner Kartlägger manuella moment tillsammans med avdelningarna och prioriterar efter störst effekt Äger roadmap, backlog och acceptans för dina produkter Sätter vårt arbetssätt för AI-driven utveckling: specifikation, kod, granskning, test och produktion Mäter effekt i sparade timmar och följer kostnaden för modeller mot nyttan Utbildar kollegor och tar fram riktlinjer för ansvarsfull AI, informationssäkerhet och GDPR Du har Minst 3 års erfarenhet som fullstackutvecklare Byggt och driftsatt agentbaserade flöden själv Erfarenhet av automation i handel till exempel supply chain, prissättning, innehåll eller masterdata Vana att värdera initiativ i kronor och timmar och att föra dialog på ledningsnivå Gott omdöme kring säkerhet och personuppgifter Meriterande är erfarenhet från detaljhandel med både butik och e-handel. Så arbetar vi AI är ett medel, inte ett mål. Den enklaste lösningen som ger effekten vinner. En lösning som inte används räknas inte som levererad. Vi erbjuder Mandat över prioriteringar, verktyg och modeller inom givna ramar Avsatt tid varje kvartal för att utforska nya verktyg och modeller Hybridarbete från vårt kontor på Linnégatan i Stockholm Bra att veta Våra butiker har öppet kvällar och helger. Ibland kan ett akut fel i dina tjänster behöva åtgärdas utanför kontorstid, men det ska vara undantag och inte regel. items.desc: Ansök senast: 15 november 2026 Stockholm Hybrid Arbetsuppgifter Bank och försäkringsbranschen genomgår stora förändringar. Nya kundförväntningar, ny teknik och möjligheterna med AI och automation påverkar både våra erbjudanden och hur vi arbetar. För oss på Länsförsäkringar Stockholm innebär det en möjlighet att utveckla verksamheten, förenkla våra processer och skapa mer värde för både kunder och medarbetare. Vi söker nu en Affärsutvecklare som vill vara med och driva vår fortsatta utveckling och strategiska förflyttning. Om jobbet Som Affärsutvecklare blir du en del av vårt Affärsutvecklingsteam inom enheten Ekonomi, Affärsutveckling och Hållbarhet. Vi arbetar brett inom organisationen, nära företagsledningen och projektleder några av företagets mest prioriterade satsningar och förändringsinitiativ. I rollen kommer du arbeta med allt från strategiska frågeställningar och större förändringsprojekt, till processutveckling och nya arbetssätt. Framåt kommer vi att lägga ett allt större fokus på att utveckla och effektivisera våra processer och realisera potentialen med AI, automation, smartare dataanvändning och nya verktyg. Vi söker därför dig som både har en stark generell förmåga att lösa komplexa problem och en särskild förmåga att utveckla verksamheter, processer och arbetssätt med stöd av ny teknik och tillämpning av AI. Du kommer bland annat att: Leda några av företagets mest prioriterade projekt och förändringsinitiativ Strukturera och analysera komplexa affärsproblem och ta fram tydliga rekommendationer och beslutsunderlag Analysera befintliga processer och arbetssätt, identifiera förbättringspotential och utveckla enklare och effektivare lösningar Identifiera hur AI, automation, data och nya verktyg kan tillämpas och tillsammans med verksamheten, IT, Analys och andra specialister omsätta möjligheterna i praktiken Analysera och kvantifiera potential samt utveckla välgrundade business case som stöd för prioriteringar och beslut Driva förändring så att nya processer, verktyg och arbetssätt fungerar och används i verksamheten Rollen innebär stort ansvar och stor frihet. Du behöver kunna ta dig an frågor där svaret inte är givet från början, snabbt sätta dig in i nya områden och självständigt driva ditt arbete framåt. Samtidigt arbetar vi nära varandra i teamet och hjälps åt för att tillsammans nå bästa möjliga resultat. Om dig Som person är du en mycket stark problemlösare som trivs med komplexa frågor. Du är analytisk och affärsmässig, arbetar datadrivet och kan omsätta analys i tydliga slutsatser och rekommendationer. Du är nyfiken, lär dig snabbt och vill förstå hur saker fungerar på djupet. Vi tror också att du har ett särskilt intresse för, och erfarenhet av, att tillämpa AI för att optimera processer och arbetssätt. Du behöver inte vara teknisk specialist, men du förstår hur tekniken kan användas för att lösa verkliga problem och kan tillsammans med specialister bidra till att få lösningarna att fungera i praktiken. Du har ett högt självledarskap, tar ansvar för dina uppdrag och driver arbetet framåt utan detaljerade instruktioner. Samtidigt är du prestigelös och lyhörd, bygger förtroende och kan utmana på ett konstruktivt sätt. Vi lägger stor vikt vid vem du är, hur du tänker och din förmåga att fortsätta utvecklas. För oss är det viktigt att kombinera hög ambitionsnivå och stark leveransförmåga med ödmjukhet, samarbete och ett genuint intresse för människor. Vi ser även att du har följande erfarenheter och färdigheter: Akademisk examen på avancerad nivå inom ekonomi, industriell ekonomi, datateknik eller annat relevant område Några års kvalificerad arbetslivserfarenhet från exempelvis management consulting, IT-consulting, processutveckling, transformation eller liknande Mycket stark problemlösningsförmåga samt god analytisk och affärsmässig förmåga Erfarenhet av att leda större projekt, delprojekt eller andra komplexa uppdrag med många intressenter Erfarenhet av att utveckla processer, arbetssätt eller verksamheter, gärna med tillämpning av ny teknik/AI eller digitala lösningar Vana att arbeta med analyser, data och business case som underlag för beslut Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera och presentera komplexa frågor på ett enkelt och tydligt sätt Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift Varför Länsförsäkringar Stockholm? Vi tror att de bästa resultaten skapas när människor får både ansvar och möjlighet att utvecklas. Hos oss blir du en del av en organisation där människan står i centrum och där vi kombinerar lokal närvaro med styrkan i Länsförsäkringsgruppen. Du får chansen att påverka din egen utveckling, vara en viktig del av vår tydliga tillväxtresa och arbeta nära både kunder och engagerade, kompetenta kollegor. Här finns utrymme att växa, ta ansvar och vara med och forma både rollen och vår fortsatta framgång. Framför allt söker vi dig som vill framåt - som drivs av möjligheter, utveckling och att göra skillnad. Känner du igen dig? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig! …

items.card: About the Role As Signal Processing Engineer within RF Processing & Analytics, you own the algorithms that turn raw electromagnetic intercepts into an actionable picture of the RF environment — detecting, characterizing, and identifying the emitters around our platforms in contested environments. You work across the signals captured by our Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare modules, building the classification and
items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As Signal Processing Engineer within RF Processing & Analytics, you own the algorithms that turn raw electromagnetic intercepts into an actionable picture of the RF environment — detecting, characterizing, and identifying the emitters around our platforms in contested environments. You work across the signals captured by our Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare modules, building the classification and analytics layer that turns isolated detections into a real-time electronic order of battle for operators and downstream autonomy. Responsibilities Signal Detection & Characterization: Build algorithms to detect, deinterleave, and extract parameters (PRI, pulse width, frequency, modulation) from intercepted RF emissions. Emitter Classification & Identification: Develop classification pipelines — combining feature-based methods and machine learning — to identify emitter types and match them against threat libraries. Electronic Order of Battle: Design the analytics that turn individual detections into a coherent, real-time picture of emitters, tracks, and threat posture. AI-Assisted Analytics: Apply machine learning to modulation recognition, anomaly detection, and emitter fingerprinting where it improves classification confidence in dense, contested spectrum. Cross-Module Data Fusion: Work with signals captured by Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare to build a unified processing pipeline rather than siloed, single-sensor analysis. Real-Time Pipeline Engineering: Take algorithms from offline prototyping (MATLAB/Python) to real-time or near-real-time implementation, alongside software and embedded/FPGA engineers. Field Validation: Validate detection and classification performance against simulated and real-world RF datasets, in lab and field-test conditions. Candidate Requirements Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. 3-6 years of experience in RF/radar signal processing, ideally with exposure to ELINT, ESM, or SIGINT applications. Strong fundamentals in DSP: spectral analysis, filtering, multi-rate processing, statistical/adaptive signal processing. Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for algorithm prototyping; working knowledge of C/C++ for production-oriented implementation. Comfortable applying machine learning to signal classification problems. Clear communicator, able to work across RF hardware, software, and data science disciplines. Fluency in English required; French is a plus. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.desc: Start date: 1st April 2027. A clinical research associate position is available working on a collaborative project to develop diagnostic and prognostic tools for coronary artery disease, as part of a multi-disciplinary team led by Professor Martin Bennett at the Department of Medicine, University of Cambridge, where the position will be based. Cardiovascular disease is the largest cause of death worldwide, and new diagnostics and treatments are needed, particularly in those at highest risk. In collaboration with the Department of Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics, Centre for Mathematics Sciences, Cambridge, we have developed an AI-based machine learning algorithm to analyse intracoronary images and identify high-risk patients and assess the efficacy of drugs to prevent or treat disease. The clinical research associate will work within a growing team of clinical and non-clinical scientists to further develop this and other tools for clinical use, focusing on image co-registration, segmentation, and post-processing to generate outputs suitable for clinical decision making. We are particularly looking for candidates with experience in invasive coronary image processing for real-world problems, and experience with relevant image analysis software would be very advantageous. Further information on the project from Professor Martin Bennett (mrb24@ cam.ac.uk). Duties include collaborative research objectives and defining individual project work streams. Working with the PI, the role holder will be expected to plan and manage their own research and administration, with guidance if required, and to assist in the preparation of proposals and applications to external bodies. You must be able to communicate material of a technical nature and be able to build internal and external contacts. Fixed-term: This post has funding for up to 2 years in the first instance, which may be extendable to 3 years. There may be the opportunity for the successful candidate to pursue a PhD during their employment, subject to approval. This appointment requires an Honorary Clinical Contract. This is an integrated appointment between the University and Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust ("NHS Trust"). You will therefore also be issued with an Honorary Clinical Contract by the NHS Trust. You should be aware that if your contract with the NHS Trust is terminated your employment with the University will be terminated, and vice versa. Please ensure that you upload a covering letter, CV and a completed Additional Information for Clinical Researchers form in the Upload section of the online application. If you upload any additional documents which have not been requested, we will not be able to consider these as part of your application. Please include details of your referees, including email address and phone number, one of which must be your most recent line manager. Please quote reference RC51491 on your application and in any correspondence about this vacancy. The University actively supports equality, diversity and inclusion and encourages applications from all sections of society. The University has a responsibility to ensure that all employees are eligible to live and work in the UK. Apply online

items.desc: Apply until 17/11/2026 (DD/MM/YYYY) 23:59 (Brussels time) Faculty of Engineering and Architecture Department EA05 - Information technology AAP temporary appointment - 100% Number of openings: 1 Reference number: 202610/EA05/AS/015 ABOUT GHENT UNIVERSITY Ghent University is a world of its own. Employing more than 15.000 people, it is actively involved in education and research, management and administration, and technical and social services on a daily basis. It is one of the largest, most exciting employers in the area and offers great career opportunities. With each of its 11 faculties and more than 100 departments offering state-of-the-art study programmes that are grounded in research in a wide range of academic fields, Ghent University is a logical choice for its employees as well as its students. YOUR TASKS At least 50% of your assignment will be spent on academic research in preparation of a doctoral dissertation in the discipline Machine Learning, more specifically, you will focus on energy efficient foundation models. You will assist in the teaching activities at the department in courses at bachelor level, in the Engineering Technology programme, in the field of computer science. You will assist in the internal and external services of the department. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR You hold a master’s degree in one of the following fields of study: Applied Sciences (Engineering), Industrial Sciences and Technology (Engineering Technology), or Sciences, specifically in the field of computer science (informatics), or you hold an equivalent degree or a master’s degree in a field considered relevant or equivalent by the committee. The degree requirement needs to be fulfilled at the start of your appointment. For diplomas awarded outside the European Union, a certificate of equivalence (NARIC) must be submitted. You are interested in academic and/or project-based research and services. Any teaching experience or participation in extra training, conferences, etc. is recommended. You have excellent teaching and communication skills. Sufficient knowledge of the Dutch language is required. You have to be able to provide academic education in Dutch at Bachelor level. Knowledge of programming languages C ++, C #, Java and Python, of computer networks, of the operating systems UNIX and Windows Server are plus points. Scientific research skills (for example international publications) is a plus. WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU We offer you a two-year appointment, which may be renewed twice for two years, on condition that the previous term was given a positive evaluation. Attention: If you have been previously appointed as a junior assistant or doctoral fellow at a university within the Flemish Community, this appointment will be deducted from the maximum term of appointment, which is six years at the most according to the Codex of Higher Education. Your appointment will start on 1 January 2027 at the earliest. Your remuneration will be determined according to salary scale AAP3. More information about our salary scales. All Ghent University staff members enjoy a number of benefits, such as a wide range of training and education opportunities, 36 days of paid leave, bicycle commuting reimbursement, ecocheques, etc. A complete overview of all our fringe benefits. INTERESTED? Apply online through the e-recruitment system before the application deadline (see above). We do not accept late applications or applications that are not sent through the online system. Your application must include the following documents: In the field ‘Cv’ : your cv and an overview of your study results (merged into one pdf file). In the field ‘Cover letter’ : your application letter in pdf format. In the field ‘Diploma’ : a transcript of the required degree (if already in your possession). If you have a foreign diploma in a language other than our national languages (Dutch, French or German) or English, please add a translation in one of the mentioned languages. In the field ‘Certificate of equivalence’ : only for diplomas awarded outside the European Union a certificate of equivalence (NARIC) must be submitted (if already in your possession, if not, you need to be able to provide proof that you have applied for a certificate of equivalence at the start of your appointment). The certificate can be requested via www.naricvlaanderen.be/en. For diplomas awarded in the UK before January 31st of 2020, a certificate of equivalence is not required. Note that the maximum file size for each field is 10 MB. As Ghent University maintains an equal opportunities and diversity policy, everyone is encouraged to apply for this position. MORE INFORMATION For more information about this vacancy, please contact Prof. Sam Leroux (sam.leroux@ugent.be). We foster excellence in both fundamental and applied research, spanning fields such as neuroscience and cognition, humanoid technologies and robotics, artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, and material sciences, offering a truly interdisciplinary scientific experience. items.desc: Het bedrijf Onze klant is een opkomende tech-startup in de data sector, gedreven door de missie om ongekende waarde uit ruwe informatie te halen. Zij bouwen slimme, schaalbare algoritmes die bedrijven helpen om razendsnel betere beslissingen te nemen. Zonder logge structuren of bureaucratie, maar met een platte organisatie waar jouw ideeën direct worden getest en uitgerold. De focus ligt hier volop op experimenteren, pionieren en het bouwen van innovatieve producten die de markt echt veranderen. Wat zij doen heeft directe impact op hoe organisaties hun toekomst vormgeven, omdat betrouwbare data de fundering van elke goede strategie vormt. Je komt terecht in een hecht en briljant team van tech-enthousiastelingen die graag kennis delen en wekelijks successen samen vieren. Jouw rol als AI Specialist in dit verhaal? De vertaalslag maken tussen complexe modellen en werkbare realiteit, waardoor je vanaf dag één je stempel drukt. Getriggerd? Lees dan snel verder! Takenpakket In deze rol neem jij als AI Specialist het voortouw bij het ontwikkelen van revolutionaire oplossingen vanaf de eerste brainstorm tot de livegang. Je analyseert enorme hoeveelheden informatie om patronen te ontdekken en vertaalt deze naar bruikbare inzichten die de kern van nieuwe producten vormen. Complexe bedrijfsvraagstukken zet jij om in werkbare datamodellen, waardoor klanten direct tijd besparen en hun foutmarges verkleinen. Door het trainen en finetunen van algoritmes verhoog je continu de nauwkeurigheid van de bestaande systemen. Interne teams neem je op sleeptouw tijdens interactieve sessies, zodat iedereen de nieuwste technologieën begrijpt en optimaal kan benutten. Strakke kaders rond dataveiligheid en privacy borg jij moeiteloos, waardoor alle innovaties niet alleen slim maar ook betrouwbaar blijven. Profiel Voor deze functie van AI Specialist kijken we vooral naar jouw innovatieve denkkracht en de drang om dingen te bouwen. Je beschikt over een masterdiploma in een relevante richting, gekoppeld aan aantoonbare bagage in machine learning of geavanceerde data-analyse. Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van modellen vanaf scratch stelt jou in staat om razendsnel waarde te leveren binnen een snelgroeiende omgeving. Vlotte communicatie behoort tot je natuurlijke sterktes; je kan ingewikkelde materie heel behapbaar overbrengen naar non-technische stakeholders. Collega’s omschrijven jou als een pragmatische bouwer die veel liever in concrete oplossingen denkt dan blijft hangen in eindeloze theorieën. Aanbod Jouw inzet als AI Specialist belonen we met een pakket dat net zo modern en flexibel is als de startup zelf. Een stevig brutosalaris, eerlijk en direct afgestemd op de kennis en absolute meerwaarde die jij binnenbrengt. Direct een gloednieuwe elektrische bedrijfswagen inclusief laadkaart, zodat je zorgeloos, comfortabel en groen de baan op kan. Optimale gemoedsrust via een uitgebreide groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, perfect geregeld voor jou én je gezin. Dagelijks een fijn extraatje dankzij royale maaltijdcheques en een mooie, structurele netto onkostenvergoeding. Volledige vrijheid over jouw planning door de glijdende uren, waarmee je werk en privéleven naadloos in elkaar laat overvloeien. Meerdere dagen per week de optie om in alle rust via thuiswerk te knallen, met ergonomisch materiaal voor je thuiskantoor voorzien. Een riant opleidingsbudget dat je helemaal vrij mag inzetten voor conferenties, cursussen of boeken om je brein scherp te houden. Echte, tastbare inspraak in een platte structuur zonder hiërarchie, waar jouw technische beslissingen de richting van het bedrijf bepalen. Wekelijkse teamlunches, toffe hackathons en legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels die de fantastische sfeer er extra goed in houden. Klaar voor deze nieuwe stap? Stuur vandaag nog je cv in en we bekijken samen de mogelijkheden.

items.desc: To strengthen and/or further develop its research competencies in educational technologies in distance learning settings, the research center for Learning and Instruction with Future Technologies (LIFT) is looking for a: Research Software Engineer in Educational Technologies (100 %) Place of work: Brig, partial remote working possible (within Switzerland) Start date: 1January 2027, or upon agreement Contract duration: 2 years (renewable) The research center for Learning and Instruction with Future Technologies (LIFT) is an interdisciplinary research center dedicated to research on learning and instruction in education. It bundles expertise on how students learn, how interest develops, how learners regulate their study behavior, and how digital and distance teaching can be designed based on evidence. The center investigates current and future challenges in high-quality education through theory-driven research that is applicable in everyday distance teaching. Its ambition is to advance rigorous, useful, and innovative research that helps evidence-based teaching practices become normal practice. To support researchers and implementation partners in prototyping or building educational technologies (including learning-management systems, Generative AI, AR/VR/XR and more), the LIFT is looking for a versatile software engineer. If you love trying out new technologies and building prototypes and tools at the forefront of what is possible, this opportunity is a good match! The position is based within the IT team and reports to the Head of IT for personnel and organizational matters. You will primarily support research at LIFT, working closely with its researchers and following the university’s IT standards. Your responsibilities Implement prototypes in alignment with project partners’ specifications and inputs Further develop prototypes into scalable products Take ownership of project development Scout and benchmark technology, including specification comparison Conduct user evaluation of prototypes Upon agreement, co-author research publications. Note: This position is strongly focused on the development of said prototypes and products. It does not, however, include system maintenance or helpdesk tasks. Your profile Master’s degree in Computer Science Experience in building websites including both front end and back end Experience in working with GenAI APIs, as well as recent trends such as Agentic AI Experience in working with continuous integration (CI) and testing methodologies Experience with at least one game engine, e.g. Unreal, Unity, or Godot, including AR or VR development Experience reviewing and improving code written by others Interest in human learning and interaction design Collaborative personality and ability to interact comfortably with others and working in a diverse team Enjoy learning new things and figuring things out Excellent command of English, knowledge of French and/or German is a plus We offer Academic visibility: You will be named as a co-author on work you contribute to, and you are encouraged to publish the tools and methods you develop as contributions in their own right. A research-intensive academic environment: You will be part of a dynamic university setting characterised by strong scientific expertise and a culture of interdisciplinary collaboration. Attractive employment conditions: modern working conditions, generous social benefits and a wide range of continuing education opportunities. A committed team: you will join a highly skilled and engaged team that embodies innovation, excellence, and a strong culture of collaboration. An inspiring working environment: our campus in Brig is located in immediate proximity to the historic old town, the Swiss Federal Railways (SBB) station and attractive natural and mountain regions. It offers a high quality of life and a vibrant academic exchange. Your Application Motivation letter describing why you have the necessary skills for this position (2 pages maximum). Resume (2 pages maximum). Portfolio of previous work (either as a PDF or a link). We look forward to receiving your full application in PDF format by e-mail no later than 15 November 2026 CET, to the Human Resources Department at the following address: jobs@unidistance.ch . For further information, please contact Prof. Dr Julia Chatain: julia.chatain@unidistance.ch .

We're supporting an established global healthcare consultancy looking to appoint a Data Scientist within its growing Market Access and Health Economics team. This could suit someone with experience in healthcare analytics, applied machine learning, AI development or scientific research who is looking to take greater ownership of technical projects. The role will focus on developing innovative Data Science and AI solutions, improving existing research processes and building new tools and services that support pharmaceutical clients and healthcare decision-making. The role involves working with large and complex healthcare datasets, scientific literature and other structured and unstructured data sources to develop practical solutions using machine learning, AI and statistical analysis. Projects may include developing AI-powered research tools, automating data extraction and analysis, building predictive models and creating interactive applications to support internal teams and pharmaceutical clients. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of individual projects, from initial concept and development through to implementation, working collaboratively with other Data Scientists, researchers and commercial teams. Your responsibilities will include: Developing and applying machine learning and AI solutions to healthcare and research-related challenges Working with large structured and unstructured datasets, including healthcare data and scientific literature Using Python, R and other relevant technologies for data preparation, analysis and model development Exploring opportunities to automate research processes, data extraction and analytical workflows Developing practical tools, applications and visualisations to support internal teams and clients Taking ownership of technical projects, from initial development through to testing and implementation Collaborating with healthcare researchers, technical colleagues and commercial teams to identify opportunities for innovation Communicating technical findings and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Supporting the development of new technology-enabled services and improvements to existing processes Requirements The key requirement is a strong foundation in Data Science, Python and machine learning, alongside the ability to independently approach technical problems and develop practical solutions. A background in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, real-world data, health economics or scientific research would also be beneficial. A Master's degree or PhD involving Data Science, machine learning or quantitative research would be welcomed, particularly where candidates can demonstrate independent technical project delivery. What's in it for you? This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional data analysis into a position focused on developing new AI/ML applications and practical technology solutions within healthcare . You'll be joining a growing team where Data Science and AI are becoming increasingly important to the consultancy's services, with opportunities to influence how new tools and technologies are developed and implemented. The role offers a good level of autonomy and project ownership, allowing you to take ideas through the development process while collaborating with experienced colleagues across Data Science, healthcare research and commercial functions. It could be particularly interesting for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, learning new technologies and seeing their work translated into practical applications rather than purely producing analytical reports. Wir arbeiten für die öffentliche Hand, Verbände und Unternehmen und betreiben eigene Datenprodukte. Unsere Projekte basieren zunehmend auf grossen Mikrodatensätzen. Dazu zählen beispielsweise Steuerdaten natürlicher und juristischer Personen, auf deren Grundlage wir Prognosemodelle entwickeln, ebenso wie Erfolgsrechnungen und Bilanzen von Unternehmen sowie Patentdaten, die wir mit Unternehmen und Regionen verknüpfen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der nicht nur gerne mit Daten arbeitet, sondern auch methodisch etwas draufhat. Kennst du den Unterschied zwischen einer Pooled Regression und einer Fixed-Effects-Regression? Weisst du, was echtes Clustering von einer blossen Kategorisierung unterscheidet? Und siehst du in Datensätzen voller Tippfehler, unterschiedlicher Schreibweisen und Sonderfälle eine Herausforderung statt ein Ärgernis? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Deine Aufgabe Du verantwortest Modelle auf grossen Mikrodaten, von der Rohdatenlieferung bis zur ausgelieferten Zahl. Dabei bringst du Ordnung in komplexe Daten, verknüpfst unterschiedliche Quellen und erkennst Methodenwechsel und Brüche in Zeitreihen. Dabei willst du verstehen, wie Daten entstehen: welche Prozesse und Regeln hinter einer Steuerveranlagung oder einer Bilanz stehen und wie sie sich in den Daten niederschlagen. Wenn etwas nicht aufgeht, bleibst du dran, bis du die Ursache kennst. Auf dieser Grundlage entwickelst du statistische und ökonometrische Modelle, erstellst Prognosen und Simulationen und untersuchst beispielsweise, wie sich eine Steuerreform auf die Einnahmen eines Kantons auswirkt. Neben der Modellierung überlegst du dir, wie sich die Korrektheit von Daten und Resultaten überprüfen lässt, etwa mit Plausibilitätschecks, Abgleichen mit unabhängigen Quellen und Tests, die bei jeder neuen Datenlieferung laufen. Du hinterfragst Methoden, erkennst unplausible Zahlen und präsentierst unseren Auftraggebern die Ergebnisse verständlich und nachvollziehbar – inklusive ihrer Grundlagen und Grenzen. Viele unserer Modelle sind langfristig im Einsatz – etwa in unserer Patentanalyse, unseren Branchenprognosen, unserem Steuerrechner sowie unseren Benchmarking- und Regionen-Tools. Deshalb legen wir grossen Wert darauf, dass deine Arbeit nachhaltig nutzbar bleibt: sauber dokumentiert, versioniert und für andere nachvollziehbar und reproduzierbar. Dein Profil Du hast einen Master oder ein Doktorat in Volkswirtschaftslehre, Statistik, Data Science, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach und 3-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit grossen, unordentlichen Datensätzen. Python beherrschst du sicher und arbeitest routiniert mit pandas, NumPy, statsmodels und scikit-learn. KI-Tools nutzt Du wo möglich und sinnvoll, behältst aber das Verständnis und die Verantwortung. Du kennst Panelökonometrie, weisst wie mit fehlenden Werten umzugehen ist und validierst Modellergebnisse of sample. Machine Learning setzt du dort ein, wo es etwas bringt. Du arbeitest selbständig und sorgfältig, auch mit vertraulichen Daten und zugleich gern im Team: Man kann sich auf dich verlassen, du fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist, statt Annahmen zu treffen, und du gibst und nimmst Feedback an. Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch. Gute Französischkenntnisse ist ein klares Plus. Besonders willkommen ist Erfahrung mit Steuer- oder Registerdaten, Mikrosimulationen, Verknüpfungen von Datensätzen (Record Linkage) und/oder Bilanzdaten von Unternehmen. Was dich erwartet Deine Modelle werden von Kantonen und Unternehmen genutzt, und du prägst mit, welche Methoden bei uns zum Standard werden. Datensätze, an die man ausserhalb von Verwaltung und Forschung selten herankommt. Ein interdisziplinäres Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen: Du siehst, was mit deinen Zahlen passiert. Freiraum bei Methoden, Werkzeugen und eigenen Ideen. Ein Arbeitsplatz mitten in Basel und gelegentliche Einsätze bei Kunden in der ganzen Schweiz. Rund drei Tage pro Woche arbeitest du bei uns im Büro oder beim Kunden, die übrigen Tage im Homeoffice. Dazu kommen flexible Arbeitszeiten. Bewerbung Du kannst dich über Linkedin bewerben oder schick uns deinen CV an jobs@bak-economics.com und zeig uns, wie du arbeitest: mit einem Code-Beispiel, einem GitHub-Projekt (gerne auch aus einem privaten oder Studienprojekt) oder einer halben Seite über ein Datenprojekt, bei dem etwas nicht stimmte. Was war falsch, wie hast du es erkannt und wie hast du das Problem gelöst? Neugierig geworden? Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

items.desc: Wil jij onderzoeken hoe AI en data de zorg slimmer en veiliger maken? Als Junior Onderzoeker Toegepaste AI en Data test je modellen en prototypes in de praktijk, samen met ziekenhuizen en zorgorganisaties. Je werkt onder begeleiding van ervaren onderzoekers. Sluit je aan bij het lectoraat ICT-innovaties in de Zorg. Jouw nieuwe baan begint bij hogeschool Windesheim in Zwolle. Aan deze baan geef jij invulling Zinvol werk begint met onderzoek dat er echt toe doet. Als Junior Onderzoeker werk je aan projecten van het lectoraat ICT-innovaties in de Zorg. Je analyseert data, bouwt en test prototypes en vertaalt technische resultaten naar bruikbare inzichten voor zorgprofessionals. Binnen een project krijg je een afgebakende taak. Je pakt onderdelen zelf op en begeleidt studenten. Ervaren onderzoekers staan naast je. Voorbeelden van projecten waar je aan meewerkt: het testen en monitoren van AI-modellen in ziekenhuizen het ontwikkelen en beoordelen van synthetische data AI-ondersteuning bij digitale triage en zorg op afstand veilige verwerking van data uit zorgsensoren Meer in detail ben jij als Junior Onderzoeker bezig met het: verzamelen, opschonen en analyseren van data ontwikkelen en testen van modellen, prototypes en demonstrators uitvoeren van literatuuronderzoek en technische verkenningen opzetten en uitvoeren van experimenten, en vastleggen van de resultaten bespreken van bevindingen met onderzoekers, ontwikkelaars en zorgprofessionals bijdragen aan rapportages, presentaties en andere vormen van kennisdeling begeleiden van studenten bij technische projectopdrachten Welkom bij Windesheim Een hogeschool waar iedereen zich gewaardeerd én thuis mag voelen. Gelijke kansen staan centraal en onze kracht ligt in samenwerking. We dragen bij aan een inclusieve en duurzame samenleving door relevant onderzoek en het opleiden van nieuwe professionals. Met persoonlijke leerroutes en actuele opleidingen bouwen we samen aan de toekomst. Onze campus in Zwolle is een energieke gemeenschap met alle voorzieningen: van een campuswinkel en restaurants tot sportschool en zwembad. Dit alles op een steenworp van het bruisende stadscentrum. Jij sluit je aan bij 15 collega’s van het lectoraat ICT-innovaties in de Zorg . Kenmerkend aan jouw team zijn de korte lijn met de zorgpraktijk en de mix van technische kennis en zorgkennis. Het team doet onderzoek dat direct raakt aan de praktijk, van ziekenhuizen tot zorgorganisaties in de regio. Een indruk krijgen? Bekijk de projecten AI-supported digital triage en remote patient monitoring en LokAI . Jouw bijdrage Wij geloven dat diversiteit onze resultaten versterkt. Voor de rol van Junior Onderzoeker zoeken we een nieuwsgierige professional die zorgvuldig werkt aan onderzoek naar AI en data in de zorg. Je hoeft nog niet op alle onderwerpen ervaring te hebben. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwe technologie wilt onderzoeken en uitproberen, en dat zorg en publieke gezondheid je aanspreken. Daarnaast heb je: een afgeronde bachelor of master, bijvoorbeeld in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, ICT, Technische Informatica, Bio-informatica of Medische Informatiekunde kennis van programmeren, data-analyse en AI of machine learning ervaring met een onderzoeks- of ontwikkelopdracht, bijvoorbeeld via je afstudeerproject, stage of eerste baan het vermogen om gestructureerd te werken en technische keuzes goed vast te leggen een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) je werkt graag samen met collega’s, studenten en zorgprofessionals met uiteenlopende achtergronden Het is een pré als je ervaring hebt met: gezondheids-, sensor- of andere praktijkdata synthetische data, privacy of cybersecurity het begeleiden van studenten Herken je jezelf in deze rol, maar voldoe je niet aan alle punten? Reageer dan gerust. Een informeel (telefoon)gesprek is ook een mooie eerste stap. Ontwikkeling binnen de functie Je krijgt begeleiding bij het verder ontwikkelen van je onderzoeksvaardigheden en technische kennis. items.desc: The University of Surrey is a global community of ideas and people, dedicated to life-changing education and research. We are ambitious and have a bold vision of what we want to achieve - shaping ourselves into one of the best universities in the world, which we are achieving through the talents and endeavour of every employee. Our culture empowers people to achieve this aim and to collectively, and individually, make a real difference. The role The University of Surrey has recently been awarded a three-year project by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council. The title of the project is Spectrally Efficient Low Cost Energy Efficient Communication for Transport using 3D Angular Modes (SELECT-3DAM). We are seeking a Research Fellow to join us for the remainder of the project (expected until March 2029) on a full-time basis. This work builds on recent seminal work carried out by the project investigators on Linear Angular Momentum Multiplexing (LAMM). The project is an exciting opportunity to undertake work on antenna synthesis and physical layer radio to underpin the science to enable practical implementation of an evolution of this concept, 3D Angular Momentum Multiplexing (3DAMM), for advanced infrastructure to train communications. Its application is to provide a low cost, energy efficient solution to deliver reliable gigabit connectivity to train carriages in tunnels. 3DAMM is a highly innovative wireless transmission architecture that has promise of revolutionising spectral efficiency in some wireless links. We are looking to attract the brightest and best to form an effective team to develop and investigate the concept further. Together with another researcher appointed to the role focused on RF and antennas, this will include designing and constructing a concept demonstrator. The postholder will undertake a range of research activities within a specified research area in infrastructure to train communications by means of 3D Angular Momentum Multiplexing, assuming responsibility for specific areas of projects and making use of new research techniques and methods, in consultation with the research award holder or supervisor. This will include computer-based simulations, library research, critical evaluation and interpretation as well as assisting other researchers with practical measurements. About You The post holder must hold a PhD degree (or equivalent) or close to completing a PhD degree in Electronic Engineering, Mathematics or other areas related to synthesis of antenna arrays and/or modulation and coding. Postdoctoral research or industrial experience would be an advantage. The post holder will have authority over some aspects of project work and must be capable of providing academic judgement, offering original and creative thoughts and be able to interpret and analyse results. How to apply To apply, please submit your application with a CV and cover letter online via the University of Surrey jobs portal.

items.desc: About the Company (https://www.aicamrobotics.ai/) We are a forward-thinking company that is developing autonomous robotic solutions for last mile delivery and intelligent devices for smart mobility. About the Role We are looking for a Navigation & Perception Engineer (f-m-d) to make our robots move safely and reliably through indoor environments shared with people. You will work on autonomous service robots that deliver objects and guide people, and on semi-humanoid and humanoid robots that navigate and perform loco-manipulation tasks. The work covers how the robots understand their surroundings and move through them: localization and mapping, semantic scene understanding, motion planning, and execution on real hardware. Responsibilities Own and harden our multi-modal navigation stack (localization, mapping, planning, obstacle avoidance) for dynamic, unstructured indoor spaces with people. Build semantic maps (object-level, open-vocabulary 3D scene representations) that ground natural-language goals into navigation targets. Fuse 2D/3D lidar, RGB-D cameras, IMU, and wheel odometry into the perception pipeline that feeds navigation. Extend the behavior layer above navigation: task-level goals, docking and approach maneuvers, recovery behaviors, and human-aware navigation policies. Build simulation environments for rapid testing of navigation and perception, validate on real hardware, and iterate. Handle multi-floor operation and building infrastructure: elevators, automatic doors, charging stations. Deploy and test navigation in realistic use-case scenarios. Required Skills Strong background in mobile robot navigation and 3D perception, with hands-on experience on real hardware. Deep understanding of SLAM, path planning, obstacle avoidance, and motion control of mobile robots. Solid experience with perception for navigation: point cloud processing, object detection and segmentation. Hands-on experience with ROS2 and the Nav2 framework. Proficiency in C++ and Python. Proven ability to debug and tune robots in the field, where sensor noise, latency and messy environments are the norm. Nice to have Experience in any of the following is a plus. We do not expect one person to cover all of them: Open-vocabulary perception (CLIP, SAM, vision-language models) and 3D scene graphs for language-grounded navigation. Visual place recognition for relocalization, especially learned pipelines (NetVLAD, CosPlace, EigenPlaces, AnyLoc). Learning-based navigation (reinforcement or imitation learning). Deployment on embedded platforms (NVIDIA Jetson). Whole-body control or loco-manipulation for mobile manipulators. Fleet or multi-robot coordination. What we are looking for Engineers who bridge theory and real-world execution and are comfortable both reading research papers and diagnosing hardware issues on the bench. Strong debugging skills: able to isolate why a robot misbehaves, whether the cause is a sensor, the software or the mechanics. Comfort with the full navigation stack, from integrating new sensors to high-level behavior logic. Genuine interest in making robots that reliably understand and navigate spaces shared with people, rather than in delivering demos. Pay range and compensation package Bargaining Agreement: Italian National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria). Classification Target: Expected job level B2, corresponding to a statutory base minimum of € 33058,74 gross per year. Total Rewards Package: Final financial offers will exceed collective bargaining minimums to reflect individual expertise and prior achievement. The complete rewards proposal will include an individual merit allowance on top of the base minimum, a fixed production allowance, welfare benefits, performance bonuses, healthcare coverage (Metasalute), and pension options (Cometa). Applications are welcome from all individuals regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, background, or disability status.

items.desc: TL;DR We help large enterprises cut energy costs and valorize flexibility in the age of AI. We're hiring a Applied AI Engineer to own the foundation under our agentic features: the architecture, the harnesses, the evals, the tool surface, the model choices and the guardrails that let AI workflows run reliably for large enterprise customers. About Companion.energy Companion.energy connects the financial side of energy management (contracts, markets, risk) with the operational side (assets, processes, sites). We model complex energy contracts and flexible assets, forecast demand and production, and translate predictions into automated, second-by-second control decisions that move megawatts and money. Our software is used by large B2B enterprises and energy players to lower OPEX, maximize revenue, increase renewable usage, and manage risk. Why Companion.energy ? Where this is going. Energy management today runs on spreadsheets, manual checks and consultants who bill by the hour. Reading a contract, checking a year of invoices line by line, comparing one site against another, writing the monthly report. Almost none of that work needs a person, and all of it has to be right. We believe agents do that work, inside the platform, on the customer's own data, and that this is what rebuilds the category rather than making it look nicer. Insight on demand instead of by project. When the platform can benchmark a portfolio of sites or explain a cost deviation itself, analysis stops being an annual consulting engagement and becomes something a customer asks for on a Tuesday afternoon. That changes what our customers are able to do, not just how quickly they click. It ends in the physical world. The same platform steers batteries, shifts industrial loads and bids into balancing markets. Insight here does not end in a report that gets filed. It ends in megawatts moving at a different moment, which is what makes an energy asset pay for itself and what makes a renewable grid workable. The repetitive work is a bottleneck we feel ourselves. A lot of the configuration and analysis behind our features is still done by hand on our side, and that is precisely what stops us rolling them out to more customers. Automating it is not an internal efficiency project. It is how the company scales. Real stakes. Large enterprises act on what our system tells them. A reconciliation that gets a number wrong becomes a claim against a supplier, not a bad chat reply. That constraint is what makes this interesting engineering rather than a demo problem. Room to decide. The agentic part of the product is early, already live with customers, and the place on our roadmap with the most room in it. You will be setting the direction rather than inheriting someone else's framework. What you'll work on The agentic architecture. How an agent is defined, how tools are exposed to it, how context gets assembled, how a run is traced, and how state and long-running work are handled. Today each of our AI workflows answers those questions its own way. You decide how we answer them once, so that building the next agentic feature is routine rather than a new invention. Evaluation. Deciding what "good" means for a feature whose output differs on every run, then building the harnesses and datasets that hold it to that standard and catch a regression before a customer does. This is the part most teams skip and the part that separates a demo from a product. The tool surface. We serve the platform to agents over MCP today, through an internal management server and a customer-facing analytics server. Designing tools to be used by models rather than people is real design work, and so is deciding which steps of a workflow should stay deterministic code instead. Multi-model. Which model runs which step, how we stay able to swap them as they change, and how that decision gets made on evaluation evidence rather than on release notes. Cost, latency and reliability as product constraints. A budget per feature, caching, retries and fallbacks, and the monitoring that tells us when a workflow has become slower or more expensive than the value it delivers. Guardrails our customers can accept. Permission-aware, tenant-isolated and auditable, with human-in-the-loop wherever a wrong number turns into a claim against a supplier. Our customers are large enterprises, and their data cannot leak across tenants or into the wrong hands. The workflows on top. You will build features as well as foundations, and the foundation gets judged by how fast the next feature ships. Contract and hedge position ingestion is next in line, following the pattern reconciliation established: take the document, parse it, propose the mapping, let a human confirm.; What we are looking for You've built agentic systems that survived contact with paying customers: tool design, context engineering, multi-step and long-running flows, structured output, retrieval where it earns its keep, and the judgement to keep a …

Je experimenteert met de nieuwste modellen van Google, Anthropic en OpenAI en combineert taalmodellen, spraakherkenning, stemmen en tools tot iets dat echt werkt. Komt er een nieuw model uit? Dan wil je het proberen en horen of je agent er beter van wordt. Je verandert hoe Zonneplan werkt. Je ziet waar voice-agents meer kunnen betekenen voor sales, service en operations en neemt zelf het initiatief om dat te bouwen. Je kiest de technische aanpak, koppelt systemen en brengt nieuwe toepassingen na zorgvuldig testen live. Van het eerste idee tot de gesprekken waarin je hoort dat het werkt: jij pakt door. Hier wacht niemand af. Heb je een beter idee? Zeg het, en bouw het. We zijn gedreven optimisten die liever testen en soms falen dan blijven hangen in hoe het altijd ging. Je werkt samen met slimme mensen én slimme systemen, in een team vol verschillende achtergronden waar iedereen meepraat, meebouwt en meetelt. Jouw impact bij Zonneplan Jij bouwt nieuwe voice-agents en brengt ze live. Je ziet waar een agent werk kan overnemen en neemt zelf het initiatief. Je bepaalt de aanpak, koppelt de benodigde systemen en test totdat de agent in echte gesprekken zijn werk doet. Jij geeft agents meer mogelijkheden. Met API-koppelingen en toolcalling laat je agents orders afronden, afspraken maken en operationele taken uitvoeren. Je zorgt dat ze weten wanneer ze kunnen handelen en wanneer een collega moet overnemen. Jij bepaalt de technische koers. Je kiest de architectuur en tooling van de voice-stack en beslist welke verbeteringen je doorvoert. Daarbij weeg je gesprekskwaliteit, snelheid, betrouwbaarheid en kosten af. Jij maakt ieder gesprek beter. Je duikt in gesprekken en traces om te ontdekken waar timing, begrip of toolgebruik misgaat. Je bouwt evaluaties waarmee je verbeteringen toetst en fouten eerder vindt. Dit krijg je van ons Een salaris tussen €3.250 en €5.000 bruto per maand. 25 vakantiedagen (met de mogelijkheid om er meer bij te kopen) en reiskostenvergoeding. Een persoonlijk keuzebudget voor sport, boodschappen of iets anders dat bij je past. Een toegewijd team met veel ervaring in generatieve AI, dat elkaar elke dag uitdaagt om bestaande werkwijzen anders aan te pakken. Vrijheid in tooling, providers en modellen, inclusief een Claude Max-abonnement. Dit neem jij mee Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding. Je hebt zelfstandig AI-toepassingen gebouwd en verbeterd, in eigen projecten of in je werk. Je hebt technisch inzicht en begrijpt hoe taalmodellen, spraakherkenning en koppelingen samenwerken. Ervaring met voice AI is een pré. Je doorgrondt processen, zoekt technische problemen uit en kunt beoordelen of een oplossing goed werkt. Je werkt zelf AI-first en hebt een sterke bouwdrang: je neemt initiatief, maakt zelfstandig keuzes en krijgt je ideeën werkend. Zo ziet het proces eruit 1. Solliciteer op deze vacature en vertel of laat zien wat je hebt gebouwd. 2. Kennismakingsgesprek met Samer (recruiter). 3. Eerste gesprek met Glenn (direct leidinggevende van de functie) en iemand van het team. 4. Persoonlijkheids- en capaciteitentest en een praktische casus waarin je een AI-toepassing bouwt of verbetert. 5. Is er een match? Dan doen we je snel een aanbod. Wat bouw jij voor Plan Zero? Bij Zonneplan werken we aan Plan Zero: een volledig duurzaam, kostenneutraal, frictieloos en betrouwbaar energiesysteem. Jij bouwt voice-agents die klanten helpen met hun vragen, bestellingen en afspraken. Solliciteer en laat zien wat je al hebt gemaakt. Wat is jouw plan? Heb je vragen? Bel of mail met Samer: 088 020 3012, samer.elmokdad@zonneplan.nl Please note: Proficiency in the Dutch language is required

items.desc: Du willst ein KI-Produkt nicht nur mitbauen, sondern verantworten? replient.ai beantwortet und moderiert Kommentare auf Instagram, Facebook, TikTok und YouTube mit KI, auch unter laufenden Ads. Die KI lernt die Tonalität jeder Marke aus bisherigen Antworten und der Website. Über 900 Marken, Creator und Agenturen nutzen replient.ai, darunter SNOCKS, HOLY, OCEANSAPART, Liebscher & Bracht, fonio.ai und mobile.de. Jetzt suchen wir die Person, die bei uns die komplette Technik in Oberösterreich übernimmt. Deine ersten 90 Tage Codebase übernehmen: Du übernimmst die bestehende Codebase und machst sie zu deiner. Du entscheidest, was bleibt, was umgebaut wird und was weg kann. Antwortqualität messbar machen: Du baust Evals für unsere LLM-Pipeline und machst die KI-Antworten nachweisbar besser: Tonalität der Marke, richtige Fakten, saubere Moderation. Integrationen skalieren: Meta, TikTok und YouTube liefern die Kommentare, auf denen alles aufbaut. Du machst die Anbindungen stabil, schnell und bereit für mehr Volumen. F&E-Projekt mit der FH OÖ: Ein gefördertes Forschungsprojekt (FFG / Land OÖ). Du verantwortest es technisch und bringst die Ergebnisse ins Produkt. Tech-Roadmap und später das Team: Du baust mit uns die Roadmap, legst fest, wen wir als Nächstes brauchen, und baust später das Tech-Team auf. Was du mitbringst Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung mit Software, die echte Nutzer verwenden. Die Rolle ist für erfahrene Engineers, nicht für den Berufseinstieg. Du hast LLMs schon in Produktion gebracht, nicht nur in Demos. Du bist in TypeScript, React, Next.js, Supabase/Postgres und Python schnell produktiv. Du willst die komplette Technik verantworten: Codebase, Infrastruktur, Roadmap. Du hast Lust auf Meta-, TikTok- und YouTube-APIs und verstehst Social Media. Du kannst ca. 2 Tage pro Woche zu uns ins Büro nach Lichtenberg bei Linz kommen. Was du bekommst 90.000 € brutto fix (14 × 6.429 €) plus 1 % vom ARR-Zuwachs: Wächst replient.ai, wächst dein Einkommen mit. Klare CTO-Perspektive: Du triffst die technischen Entscheidungen und sitzt bei Produkt und Roadmap mit am Tisch. AI-first Tool-Stack: Claude Pro, ChatGPT Pro, Cursor und was du sonst brauchst. Hybrid: ca. 2 Tage pro Woche im Büro in Lichtenberg mit Pöstlingberg-Blick und Outdoorspace, an den anderen Tagen remote. Ein kleines High-Performance-Team statt Konzern, geführt von Markus & Thomas Danninger. So läuft die Bewerbung Kein Anschreiben nötig: Bewirb dich direkt hier über LinkedIn. Wenn du richtig auffallen willst, schick uns zusätzlich kurze Antworten auf diese 4 Fragen an office@replient.ai (Betreff „Founding AI Engineer“). Ein paar Sätze pro Frage reichen. Zeig uns etwas, das du gebaut hast (GitHub, Live-Produkt, App oder Side Project), und sag kurz, was dein Anteil war. Was ist dein bestes KI- oder LLM-Projekt, und wie hast du gemessen, ob die Ergebnisse gut sind? Was reizt dich daran, bei uns die komplette Technik zu verantworten, und womit würdest du anfangen? Welches replient.ai-Feature würdest du als Erstes bauen oder verbessern, und warum? Tipp: replient.ai vorher 14 Tage gratis testen, ohne Kreditkarte. Danach folgen ein Kennenlerngespräch mit Markus & Thomas, eine kleine Testaufgabe und ein bezahltes Probearbeiten.

items.desc: Avrai completo controllo dei numeri con cui Jet HR prende ogni decisione, e ci costruirai sopra modelli predittivi e agenti AI per scalare. Cosa farai Il tuo obiettivo è possedere le metriche di Jet HR e trasformarle in modelli predittivi , dal dato grezzo alle decisioni di Sales, Growth e Ops. Nel concreto: Sei owner dei modelli dbt che sono la source of truth delle metriche di Jet per Ops, Growth, Sales, Finance e Product. Costruisci il semantic layer delle north star metrics: la base della self-service analytics e degli agenti AI che interrogano i dati. Costruisci MCP e agenti AI per l’analisi dati e per automatizzare i processi GTM (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success), misurandone l’impatto. Crei analisi che orientano le decisioni concrete di Growth e Ops. Porti la self-service su Metabase a tutta l’azienda, a partire dai domini ancora scoperti. Test, documentazione e monitoring inclusi. Sviluppi modelli predittivi end-to-end - lead scoring, attribution multi-touch, forecasting - dalla definizione del problema al deploy e al monitoraggio. Come lavoriamo Il team Data di Jet HR non è un semplice team di supporto. È la funzione che costruisce l’intera piattaforma dati su cui gira il prodotto e i prodotti AI che lo estendono. Data platform. Lavoriamo su una piattaforma scalabile e robusta: architettura, automazione, data products. Niente one-off, niente workaround. Self-service. Ogni team di Jet deve poter lavorare sui dati in autonomia. Dobbiamo essere un moltiplicatore, non un collo di bottiglia. Tech-first. Il team è composto da data engineers, analytics engineers, data scientists e AI engineers. Collaboriamo strettamente con prodotto, sales e operations per trasformare i dati in asset strategici. Niente task banali. Non esistono report manuali da tenere in vita. Automatizziamo, ottimizziamo, costruiamo soluzioni che durano. Tech stack DBT · Snowflake · Python · Metabase · DltHub · Apache Airflow · Docker · AWS Chi cerchiamo 3+ anni di esperienza in analytics engineering, data science o data engineering. Parli italiano. Per combattere la burocrazia bisogna prima capirla profondamente. Statistica applicata. Hai usato modellazione statistica e causal inference (A/B test, metodi quasi-sperimentali) su problemi di business reali. Data modelling. Hai lavorato con modelli dimensionali (star/snowflake schema) e/o Data Vault. Python solido. Lo usi ogni giorno per analisi, modelli e pipeline, con codice pulito e testabile. Cosa offriamo €45.000 – €60.000 di RAL. Full remote. Per davvero. Puoi lavorare da dove vuoi, basta che sia in una timezone compatibile con l’Italia. Se vuoi, il nostro ufficio a Milano è pronto ad accoglierti. Due volte l’anno abbiamo un meetup di 3 giorni, tutto pagato da Jet. Ownership di quello che fai. Non hai spec iper-dettagliate, non sei un mero esecutore. Sei tu responsabile dell’output finale. Impatto concreto. Siamo una start-up, ognuno dà un contributo essenziale allo sviluppo dei prodotti e alla crescita di Jet. Il tuo lavoro fa la differenza per migliaia di clienti. Start-up environment. Non è una startup qualsiasi, ma una ben finanziata e zeppa di talenti. In 6 mesi vedrai ed imparerai cose che altrove forse vedresti in anni, con un altissimo livello di responsabilità e coinvolgimento. Processo di selezione Prima interview con Talent Tech interview con Head of Data & AI Final interview con il team

Perseguiamo l’aggiornamento continuo rispetto all’ evoluzione tecnologica , collaborando con aziende Leader in diversi settori di mercato e realizzando soluzioni “chiavi in mano” presso i nostri laboratori. 👤 Lavoriamo mantenendo al centro le persone e la sostenibilità ambientale. Crediamo nella valorizzazione della diversità e nell'inclusione di persone di ogni provenienza, genere, età, orientamento sessuale e abilità. items.title: Data Scientist, Featurespace
items.card: Job Description What it's it all about: At Featurespace, part of Visa, we build technology that helps financial institutions protect their customers from fraud and financial crime. We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our team, developing and managing the analytical capabilities at the heart of our fraud and risk prevention products. The opportunity This isn’t a role where you build a model and hand it over.
items.desc: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description What it's it all about: At Featurespace, part of Visa, we build technology that helps financial institutions protect their customers from fraud and financial crime. We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our team, developing and managing the analytical capabilities at the heart of our fraud and risk prevention products. The opportunity This isn’t a role where you build a model and hand it over. You’ll work across the full lifecycle of analytical products, from understanding customer problems and exploring data through to developing, deploying, monitoring and improving models in production. You’ll combine strong data science with product thinking and operational ownership. You’ll see how your models perform with real customer data, understand the value they deliver, and help ensure they remain effective and well-managed as data, customer needs and fraud patterns change. You won’t be developing your expertise in isolation. You’ll join a group of other Data Scientists in Cambridge focused on fraud and risk, working alongside colleagues with significant experience in the field. It’s a close-knit and collaborative team, with lots of opportunities for informal learning, mentoring and exchanging ideas with people tackling similar problems. What You'll Do Develop ML models using rich and complex transactional datasets. Work with customers, product managers, engineers and delivery teams to turn real-world problems into effective fraud and risk prevention products. Take models from discovery and experimentation through to production. Monitor deployed models, investigate changes in performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Retrain, enhance and safely release models as data, customer needs and fraud patterns evolve. Measure and communicate the impact of our fraud and risk prevention products. Contribute to model governance, documentation and robust production processes. Share knowledge, mentor colleagues and help improve how the team works. This is a hybrid position. Hybrid employees can alternate time between both remote and office. Employees in hybrid roles are expected to work from the office 3 set days a week (Tuesday - Thursday), with a general guidepost of being in the office 50% or more of the time based on business needs. Qualifications What we'd like from you: Experience implementing machine-learning models or analytical algorithms in software. Experience using Python, Java or another major programming language for data analysis or machine learning. Experience using SQL to analyse data. Practical experience working with large, diverse datasets. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly for data-centric problems. The ability to pick up new technologies and concepts quickly. Experience collaborating with multiple stakeholders on technical projects. Clear and concise written and verbal communication. The ability to manage and prioritise your own work. A degree in a scientific or numerate discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
