items.desc: Discover ING Hubs Romania ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from our office in Bucharest. Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business , with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products. We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you? The Mission Within ING, there is ING Analytics (INGA) - a major driving force in its digital transformation of the bank. By creating measurable value for ING and its customers through world-class analytics products and services, INGA helps ING to become a data-driven leader. Among others, INGA delivers call & speech analytics, generative AI in risk summarization, insights into portfolio performance, advanced ESG data insights (commercial purposes), data analytics platforms (cloud and on-premises), and many more. We are looking for a Data Scientist to join us in Bucharest. In this role, you will be responsible for scoping, developing, validating, and documenting machine-learning-based solutions which will form the core of the products that INGA develops. You will collaborate closely with other scientists and analysts in evaluating model performance to ensure the best possible performance. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals who are committed to developing themselves and learning new skills. We hire people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time in Bucharest. Come join us! Your day-to-day A typical day for a data scientist starts with coffee, catching up with colleagues, and drafting a plan for the coming day. After the standup, you will start developing machine learning solutions, adopting best practices and quality standards for fit-for-purpose model pipelines. As an effective team member of the model development & implementation team, you will challenge the status quo while addressing the requirements of the ING model governance. After lunch, you will prepare fraud advance models to be deployed to production. Finally, to wrap up the day, you will actively explore INGA’s domain and engage in creating a journey that makes our bank and our society safer. What You’ll Bring To The Team Bachelor's degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, or econometrics. 3-5 years of work experience in the data science field. Good understanding of supervised and unsupervised machine learning methods. Strong Python programming skills, Apache Spark, SQL, Git. Excellent communication skills, capable of working collaboratively in a semi-remote, globally distributed team. Nice to have Broad experience with end-to-end machine learning projects; involvement in all modeling steps (from data extraction to production). Background in writing production-ready code and a solid understanding of object-oriented programming is a strong plus. Proactive and can-do attitude (self-steering). Curious mindset; you are collaborative and passionate about helping others to grow and improve. Able to embrace challenges in a fast-changing and complex environment. If you want to deep dive into the processing of personal data conducted by ING Hubs Romania during the recruitment process and your rights related to it, read the privacy notices on our website (make sure to scroll until you reach the Data Protection section/ Candidates tab).

items.desc: Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling At a glance We are looking for new medior colleagues to join our Non-Retail Credit Risk Modelling team within ABN AMRO's Risk Modelling department. Effectively managing risks is essential in banking. The importance of modelling in core banking processes, such as risk management, is growing rapidly. New technologies, data sources, and data-driven solutions bring countless opportunities. These opportunities drive competition and increasing regulatory demands on data and models. ABN AMRO is taking a proactive step by leveraging these opportunities to strengthen its competitive position. The Risk Modelling department aims to create risk models that enable risk-based decision-making and sustainable growth. Our models comply with regulations, accurately predict risks, and allow us to offer clients a sustainable price that aligns with their risk profile. Our team is committed to being at the forefront and cutting edge of these developments. Your job As a data scientist in the Non-Retail Credit Risk Modelling department, you play a key role in redeveloping credit risk models for various lending portfolios. You and your team are central to reshaping ABN AMRO’s credit risk model landscape, one of the major challenges in the bank’s risk management. In this role, you contribute to every phase of the model redevelopment cycle, from model initiation to internal validation and onsite inspections by DNB/ECB. You have advanced knowledge of statistics, coding, modelling decisions, and applicable regulations. You can clearly articulate your views and foster strong collaboration with stakeholders across the bank. Working environment ABN AMRO’s Risk Modelling department is a young and international team consisting of over 150 professionals from diverse backgrounds. As the bank’s centre of excellence for quantitative risk models, we play a crucial role in daily decision-making processes. Our models support activities like pricing deals, granting credits, and determining capital requirements. Our team thrives on intellectual challenges and has a hands-on mindset to deliver results. Collaboration is key to ensuring our work has maximum usability and a positive impact across the bank. Your profile You have a master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field; You have >2 years’ experience working in a credit risk modelling team e.g. IRB, IFRS9, Stress testing or related model development. You speak and write English fluently; You are an effective communicator, connecting easily with stakeholders on different levels of seniority; You are familiar with relevant coding languages, such as Spark, Python and SQL. Experience with Azure DevOps / git is a pre. You have thorough knowledge of banking and credit risk; You have thorough knowledge of rules and regulations and regulatory trends relevant for credit risk modelling (Basel, CRR, etc); Experience in working with DNB/ECB through communication and on-site inspections is a pre. Do you have what it takes to meet this challenge? Do you have experience with large projects with a strong quantitative character, and an eye for detail? Or are you a top talent in the field of quantitative risk management, and ready for the next step in your career? Look no further and apply to this role, we look forward to get to know you! We are offering We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing. In addition, we offer: An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowanceand a flexible benefit budget. An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future. Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you. Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually. Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work. Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000. An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use. You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy. Interested? Interested in this position? Please send us your application! Your Future: Inclusive, Innovative, Sustainable At ABN AMRO, we believe in " Banking for better, for generations to come. " Equal opportunities for everyone are a crucial foundation, as we strive for an inclusive culture where all employees feel seen, heard, and valued. Our vision of being …

items.desc: Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our new Machine Learning Engineer Machine learning is becoming an increasingly important part of how we understand energy markets, improve forecasts, and make trading decisions. We are therefore looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to move our models from research to production, building robust, scalable pipelines that continuously improve our strategies. At Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET), we combine deep market expertise with machine learning, quantitative research, data, and engineering to automate and optimise how we trade power. We’re a small, highly ambitious team based in central Copenhagen, specialising in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is at the core of how we operate, supported by one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets. The Opportunity Energy markets produce vast amounts of data and are continuously shaped by weather, power production, transmission constraints, and market behaviour. Using that data meaningfully requires accurate models and reliable software and infrastructure that allow those models to run in production. As our Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll work across machine learning and software development. Alongside quantitative researchers, software engineers and traders, you’ll build the production systems behind our ML pipelines, making our trading more performant, more reliable and more automated. You’ll own the full lifecycle around the model: from data management to the pipelines and frameworks that deploy and monitor our models, keeping them reliable and adaptive as markets evolve. The opportunity for impact is large, and so is what it asks of you: dedication, real talent and the willingness to grind through hard problems. This is a hands-on engineering role at the centre of how CET uses machine learning to trade. What You Will Do Strengthen our ML framework: Build and improve the framework our researchers use to build models and quantitative strategies. Build production-ready software: Design and develop reliable, scalable, and well-tested Python software that integrates machine learning into our internal trading platforms. Develop data infrastructure: Build and maintain data pipelines and storage solutions for ingesting, transforming, and serving diverse market and fundamental data. Ship and operate models: Take models from experiment to production, including deployment, serving, monitoring and experiment tracking Improve our ML and engineering practices: Help strengthen our approach to MLOps, testing, CI/CD, code reviews, and the wider model development lifecycle. Shape our technical solutions: Evaluate and introduce tools and technologies that improve how we develop, deploy, and operate machine learning solutions. Collaborate across disciplines: Work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and software engineers to turn business and market needs into practical technical solutions. Build energy-market expertise: Develop a deep understanding of power markets and how machine learning, data, and software can improve trading decisions. What We're Looking For We value strong technical ability, sound judgement, curiosity, and motivation to learn. While we don't expect a perfect match, many of the following qualifications will help you succeed in the role: Strong software engineering skills: Experience building clean, scalable, tested, and production-ready software. Strong Python skills are essential, as Python is our primary development language. MLOps and development practices: Proficiency in Git, code reviews, CI/CD, experiment tracking, model deployment, and monitoring. Cloud computing: Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, ideally including relevant data and machine learning services. Problem-solving and communication: The ability to structure complex problems, communicate clearly, and collaborate with colleagues across technical and commercial disciplines. Full professional proficiency in English is required. Ownership : The ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment. Interest in energy markets: Curiosity about power markets, trading, and energy systems. Previous experience in energy or trading is an advantage, but not a requirement. Education: A degree with a strong technical focus, e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, or other relevant fields. We welcome different educational backgrounds and levels of qualification. What We Offer Growth environment: Become part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow. Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders. Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive salary package and attractive benefits that reflect your skills and contributions. Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, …

items.desc: Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam Ben je benieuwd naar onze cultuur, opdrachten en ontwikkelmogelijkheden? Bezoek op 11 november 2026 ons event Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam. Spar met onze consultants over actuele ontwikkelingen in IT, kom meer te weten over onze uitdagende opdrachten en krijg advies over jouw carrièremogelijkheden en de vaardigheden die de komende jaren het verschil maken. Meld je aan (hyperlink naar https://www.cimsolutions.nl/aanmelden-open-huis-next-step-in-ict-amsterdam/) Als Data Analytics Specialist / Data Analist / Data Scientist ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verzamelen, analyseren en interpreteren van data om inzichten te verkrijgen en te gebruiken voor datagedreven besluitvorming bij of voor onze gerenommerde klanten waaronder Belastingdienst, Gemeente Den Haag, diverse ministeries, Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau of VGZ. Afhankelijk van het ervaringsniveau ligt de focus op verschillende aspecten van data-analyse en data science. Waarom past deze vacature bij jou? Je bent analytisch, nieuwsgierig en gedreven om maatschappelijke impact te maken met data. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen techniek en beleid en weet abstracte analyses te vertalen naar concrete inzichten. Je draagt graag bij aan kennisdeling, continu verbeteren en datagedreven werken binnen onze klanten. Je vindt het leuk om kennis te delen met collega’s, klanten en vakgenoten. Je voelt je thuis in een informele, collegiale en professionele omgeving, waar de aandacht voor de klant en voor de medewerker centraal staan. Wat ga je doen? Verzamelen, opschonen, transformeren en valideren van data uit verschillende bronnen. Toepassen van statistische methoden en data-analyse technieken om patronen, trends en inzichten uit data te halen. Ontwikkelen van geavanceerde machine learning modellen. Resultaten van analyses visualiseren en presenteren in heldere dashboards, rapporten en presentaties. Adviseren over datagedreven besluitvorming aan management en stakeholders. Coachen en (bege)leiden van medior en junior Data Specialisten. Effectief samenwerken met Data Engineers, Data Stewards, business analisten en andere stakeholders. Wat kun jij van ons verwachten? Een vast dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 8.000,- bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding; Opdrachtkeuzevrijheid: Jij bepaalt in overleg waar je aan werkt, met de begeleiding van een personal coach; Per jaar € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast ook nog eens 5-10 dagen studietijd; Kennissessies met vakgenoten en inhoudelijke events; Minimaal 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen op te bouwen of te verkopen; Sociale events zoals sportdagen, weekend weg en gezellige borrels; Een vestiging bij jou in de buurt. items.desc: Job Description Do you thrive in designing and developing software solutions for modular robotics platforms? Are you motivated by taking responsibility for the entire software development process and ensuring compliance with quality and architectural standards? If so, we might have the right job for you! As a Software Engineer within vision and robotics, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining software solutions while ensuring compliance with quality and architectural standards. Moreover, you will contribute to the successful implementation of solutions by conducting training sessions for internal stakeholders and end users. You will support projects, collaborate closely with the Technical Product Owner (TPO), and ensure valuable feedback from projects and site integration is used for adjustments and further development. Responsibility for Vision and Robotics Responsibilities We are a global organization, but you will be working from our office in Aarhus and be part of a small team of highly skilled colleagues in logistics. You will join the Robot Product Team, which covers multiple disciplines – Electrical, Mechanical, Automation – with you as the software responsible. You will work in close collaboration with the TPO, who acts as Product Owner, and you will have sparring opportunities with software colleagues across the organization to support knowledge sharing and development. Here, your responsibilities will be: Improving new software products related to vision and robotic applications and supporting their use in projects. Maintaining and developing software applications according to our operating model and applicable standards. Ensuring code quality through reviews, documentation, and adherence to coding and architectural guidelines. Offering input to automation strategy and technical requirements and setting product requirements in collaboration with the business. Testing and validating functionalities on our local test loop or on sites. Collaborating with interdisciplinary teams on a common system and evaluating and selecting appropriate technologies for automation and system integration. Experienced Software Developer You are familiar with commonly used tools, frameworks, and libraries relevant to 3D vision, point cloud processing, and AI development, and can evaluate and apply them effectively based on product needs. Additionally, we imagine that: You hold a bachelor's or master's degree, or an equivalent qualification in computer science, engineering, or a related field. You have solid proficiency developing real-time applications in C# and Python. You possess solid expertise in classical computer vision and 3D geometry, with a strong focus on point cloud processing and object recognition. Experience or interest in machine learning and signal processing is highly relevant, as these fields play an increasing role in advancing vision and robotics applications. You have experience in developing and maintaining various software architectures such as Docker and Kubernetes. You possess strong knowledge of software design principles, design patterns, and effort estimation for development tasks, and have hands-on experience with version control systems (e.g., Git), as well as software prototyping and conceptualization. You bring a solid understanding of high-level integration with robotic systems and can design and implement interfaces that enable effective communication between software components and robotic controls. You can combine input from multiple sensors into valuable insights. This could be cameras, LiDAR's, encoders, safety sensors etc. Moreover, you demonstrate innovative thinking, analytical skills, and a strong problem-solving mindset. You bring excellent communication skills, team spirit, and a high willingness to learn. You enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines in a diverse and inclusive environment. Interested? If you find the description interesting, please do not hesitate to contact Henning Horn Lauritsen +45 8741 4674 with any question you might have or apply via the link. We look very much forward to hearing from you! BEUMER Group Conveying, loading, palletizing, packing, sortation, and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

items.desc: HQ Air Command, RAF High Wycombe, HP14 4UE Job Summary This role sits within the Deputy Director People pillar, placing the team at the heart of the Air People Directorate, supporting and influencing data and analysis across the different People areas. The role is part of the Digital and Analytics team, which is set up to: Provide the 2* directorate and wider RAF with the best digital solutions, people data, analytics and insights available. Support data driven decision making. Ensure quality data is maintained and reflected in our data and dashboard products. The People Analytics and Insight Data Scientist position is a new role which will play a critical part in driving the analytical outputs of the People Analytics and Insight team. The products and processes developed within this role will directly link to the quality and timeliness of decision making at senior levels. This is an exciting position with opportunities to develop advanced analytics outputs and structures which will be crucial to progressing the scope of and impact of the team. While the role does not require direct line management of others, part of its purpose will be to develop tools that can be utilised and maintained by existing members of the team, building greater resilience and contributing to their future development. The team has ambitions to deliver a 10-year analytics roadmap as part of the People Analytics Transformation (PATx). This is aimed at transitioning into the employment of more advanced analytics. This role will be pivotal in refining and facilitating delivery of this strategy. This position is advertised at 37 hours per week. Job Description The People Analytics and Insight Data Scientist will develop advanced analytical products that improve the quality and timeliness of senior decision-making. The post holder will develop and maintain data models, machine learning pipelines, forecasts, dashboards and supporting data processes. The post holder will work with stakeholders across Air to turn complex workforce questions into clear, evidence-based insights, while ensuring products are robust, assured and maintainable by the wider team. The post holder will work autonomously within agreed priorities, applying professional judgement when selecting analytical methods and escalating matters with wider policy or strategic implications. The post holder must have the ability to work in a fast-paced and evolving environment, where attention to detail is critical. The projects (military & civilian data) have considerable interest at all levels of the leadership and as a result the post has significant exposure to senior civilian and military staff. This is a positive, fast-moving team, at the forefront of the RAF in terms of modernising the way the Department captures and utilises data. The job holder is responsible to SO1 People Analytics and Insight for: Creating data models, machine learning pipelines, forecasts and other advanced analytical processes to support team outputs. Identifying and clearly explaining data-led solutions to business problems, including recommendations for non-technical and senior stakeholders. Developing data cleansing, transformation, validation and assurance processes that support accurate, timely and reliable analysis. Engaging stakeholders across Air to identify opportunities for advanced analytics, facilitating data discovery and applying RICE analysis where appropriate. Leading small teams of data analysts when required, setting the analytical approach and ensuring delivery to agreed quality standards and timescales. Refactoring existing products and processes where specialist expertise is not available within the analyst team, ensuring technical quality, resilience and maintainability. Working with SO1 People Analytics and Insight to identify skills gaps and recommend and prioritise technical upskilling for the wider team. Providing training and designing product maintenance arrangements that reflect the capability of the analysts who will sustain them. Deputising for SO1 People Analytics and Insight when required, including coordinating tasks, presenting technical matters and representing People Analytics at executive meetings within delegated authority. Managing and delivering higher-complexity Management Information requests received through the People Analytics Front Door, including integrating multiple data sources, resolving data-quality issues and providing evidence-based recommendations. Completing all required project documentation and complying with relevant security, assurance, diversity and inclusion, health and safety, and mandatory training requirements. items.desc: Notre entreprise Infotel Conseil accompagne les directions Informatiques et Métiers des grandes entreprises depuis plus de 40 ans (Airbus, BNP Paribas, Banque de France, BPCE, Air France, Arkéa, Stellantis, etc.). C’est aujourd’hui plus de 3 100 Infotéliens qui ont rejoint le groupe en France (Paris, Toulouse, Lyon, Bordeaux, Lille, Rennes, Nantes, etc.) et à l’étranger (UK, Monaco, Allemagne, US, Canada, Inde, Maroc). Nous avons ainsi réalisé en 2025 un chiffre d’affaires de 294,5 M€. Infotel Conseil, spécialiste des projets IT, intervient pour ses clients sur la gestion et l’évolution de leur patrimoine informatique. Dans le cadre du développement de notre agence de Lille, nous recherchons un Lead Tech IA pour accompagner la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions d’intelligence artificielle innovantes. Vos missions En tant que Tech Lead IA, vous êtes le référent technique sur les projets d’intelligence artificielle. Vous intervenez de la définition des architectures jusqu’à la mise en production des solutions, tout en accompagnant les équipes de développement dans leur montée en compétences. 1/ Concevoir et développer des architectures IA agentiques Définir les architectures cibles et les standards de développement IA dans un environnement multicloud : AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI et Azure Foundry. Concevoir le harness des agents : orchestration, intégration des outils et serveurs MCP, gestion du contexte et sécurité. Développer des composants réutilisables pour faciliter la création et l’industrialisation des solutions IA. Faire évoluer les cas d’usage à forte valeur ajoutée, du prototype à la mise en production. 2/ Évaluer les modèles et les agents IA Construire un dispositif commun d’évaluation des modèles et des agents, avec des jeux de test élaborés en collaboration avec les équipes métiers. Comparer les performances des différents LLM et fournisseurs sur des cas d’usage concrets. S’appuyer sur des résultats mesurables pour orienter les choix technologiques. 3/ Industrialiser les solutions et maîtriser les coûts Collaborer avec l’équipe DevOps pour mettre en place les pipelines CI/CD, l’observabilité et les mécanismes de contrôle et de sécurité (guardrails). Définir les critères de passage en production en intégrant les exigences de cybersécurité et les contraintes réglementaires. Piloter les coûts d’exploitation des solutions IA : suivi de la consommation de tokens et des ressources de calcul, optimisation et prévisions budgétaires. 4/ Accompagner les équipes sur les pratiques IA Partager les bonnes pratiques de développement agentique, notamment autour de Claude Code et des outils équivalents. Intervenir comme référent technique IA auprès des équipes Développement, Infrastructure, Data, Cybersécurité, Juridique et des métiers. Assurer une veille sur les évolutions des modèles, frameworks agentiques et méthodes d’évaluation pour faire évoluer les pratiques techniques. Votre profil Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation supérieure en informatique (Bac+5, école d’ingénieurs ou équivalent) et justifiez d’une expérience confirmée en développement logiciel, avec une expertise en intelligence artificielle. Une expérience en conception d’architectures, en industrialisation de solutions IA et en accompagnement technique d’une équipe sera particulièrement appréciée. Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre esprit d’analyse, votre autonomie, votre curiosité et votre capacité à fédérer une équipe autour de choix techniques pertinents. Vous aimez relever des défis technologiques et souhaitez contribuer à des projets innovants ? Rejoignez-nous ! Notre environnement Selon votre potentiel et vos souhaits de carrière, plusieurs possibilités s’offriront à vous : pilotage de projet, management d’équipe, ou encore expertise métier. Lors du processus d’embauche, vous serez amené(e) à remplir un questionnaire visant à faciliter l’échange lors de vos rencontres avec les différents interlocuteurs (recruteurs, directeurs). Nos chargés de recrutement restent à disposition si vous souhaitez en savoir plus sur nos valeurs et nos engagements. Seit 1987 bietet FERI für institutionelle Investoren, Familienvermögen und Stiftungen maßgeschneiderte Investmentlösungen, die aktives Vermögensmanagement und wissenschaftlich fundierte Analysen verbinden. Gemeinsam mit MLP betreut FERI derzeit ein Vermögen von über 68 Milliarden Euro, davon mehr als 18 Milliarden Euro in alternativen Investments. Das IT Development der FERI AG ist ein kompetenter Lösungsanbieter für individuelle und leistungsfähige Softwareentwicklungen: Es ist maßgeblich verantwortlich für die Erstellung oder Anpassung individueller und leistungsfähiger Software-Lösungen sowie den professionellen Betrieb von Anwendungen. DEINE AUFGABEN Bringe KI von der Idee in den produktiven Einsatz Du möchtest Künstliche Intelligenz nicht nur kennenlernen, sondern in Anwendungen überführen, die wirklich eingesetzt werden? In der FERI IT entwickelst du gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen KI-Agenten, Softwarelösungen und Automatisierungen für konkrete Geschäftsprozesse. Dabei begleitest du Lösungen vom Prototyp bis zum sicheren und nachhaltigen Betrieb. Du entwickelst, erweiterst und betreibst KI-Agenten sowie agentenbasierte Anwendungen Du integrierst KI-Modelle, KI-Dienste, Datenquellen und externe Systeme über APIs und andere Schnittstellen Du untersuchst neue KI-Technologien anhand konkreter Anwendungsfälle und überführst geeignete Prototypen in produktive Lösungen Du entwickelst Anwendungen, Services und Automatisierungen für IT- und Geschäftsprozesse, unter anderem mit individueller Softwareentwicklung und Microsoft Power Automate Du berücksichtigst Anforderungen an Sicherheit, Datenschutz, Berechtigungen, Monitoring und technische Dokumentation Du arbeitest mit unseren Fachbereichen zusammen und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in technische Lösungen DEIN PROFIL Qualifikation: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Artificial Intelligence, Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang Erfahrung: Erste praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Entwicklung oder Automatisierung, beispielsweise durch Studienprojekte, Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder eigene Projekte Kompetenzen: Praktische Programmierkenntnisse in mindestens einer modernen Programmiersprache, vorzugsweise C# oder Python Grundkenntnisse: in Machine Learning, generativer KI, Large Language Models oder KI-Agenten Fähigkeiten: Analytisches und strukturiertes Denkvermögen, hohe Sorgfalt und Qualitätsorientierung Soft Skills: Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative und ausgeprägte Lern- und Entwicklungsbereitschaft Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse Grundkenntnisse in: SQL, APIs, Cloud-Plattformen, Git, DevOps oder automatisierten Tests Von Vorteil: Erfahrungen mit Microsoft Power Automate oder vergleichbaren Automatisierungsplattformen Wichtig : Du musst noch nicht jede genannte Technologie beherrschen. Entscheidend sind eine solide technische Grundlage und die Bereitschaft, dich strukturiert in neue Themen einzuarbeiten. items.title: Data Scientist
items.card: Cosa farai Il tuo obiettivo è possedere le metriche di Jet HR e trasformarle in modelli predittivi , dal dato grezzo alle decisioni di Sales, Growth e Ops. Nel concreto: Sei owner dei modelli dbt che sono la source of truth delle metriche di Jet per Ops, Growth, Sales, Finance e Product. Costruisci il semantic layer delle north star metrics: la base della self-service analytics e degli agenti AI che interrogano i
items.desc: Avrai completo controllo dei numeri con cui Jet HR prende ogni decisione, e ci costruirai sopra modelli predittivi e agenti AI per scalare. Cosa farai Il tuo obiettivo è possedere le metriche di Jet HR e trasformarle in modelli predittivi , dal dato grezzo alle decisioni di Sales, Growth e Ops. Nel concreto: Sei owner dei modelli dbt che sono la source of truth delle metriche di Jet per Ops, Growth, Sales, Finance e Product. Costruisci il semantic layer delle north star metrics: la base della self-service analytics e degli agenti AI che interrogano i dati. Costruisci MCP e agenti AI per l’analisi dati e per automatizzare i processi GTM (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success), misurandone l’impatto. Crei analisi che orientano le decisioni concrete di Growth e Ops. Porti la self-service su Metabase a tutta l’azienda, a partire dai domini ancora scoperti. Test, documentazione e monitoring inclusi. Sviluppi modelli predittivi end-to-end - lead scoring, attribution multi-touch, forecasting - dalla definizione del problema al deploy e al monitoraggio. Come lavoriamo Il team Data di Jet HR non è un semplice team di supporto. È la funzione che costruisce l’intera piattaforma dati su cui gira il prodotto e i prodotti AI che lo estendono. Data platform. Lavoriamo su una piattaforma scalabile e robusta: architettura, automazione, data products. Niente one-off, niente workaround. Self-service. Ogni team di Jet deve poter lavorare sui dati in autonomia. Dobbiamo essere un moltiplicatore, non un collo di bottiglia. Tech-first. Il team è composto da data engineers, analytics engineers, data scientists e AI engineers. Collaboriamo strettamente con prodotto, sales e operations per trasformare i dati in asset strategici. Niente task banali. Non esistono report manuali da tenere in vita. Automatizziamo, ottimizziamo, costruiamo soluzioni che durano. Tech stack DBT · Snowflake · Python · Metabase · DltHub · Apache Airflow · Docker · AWS Chi cerchiamo 3+ anni di esperienza in analytics engineering, data science o data engineering. Parli italiano. Per combattere la burocrazia bisogna prima capirla profondamente. Statistica applicata. Hai usato modellazione statistica e causal inference (A/B test, metodi quasi-sperimentali) su problemi di business reali. Data modelling. Hai lavorato con modelli dimensionali (star/snowflake schema) e/o Data Vault. Python solido. Lo usi ogni giorno per analisi, modelli e pipeline, con codice pulito e testabile. Cosa offriamo €45.000 – €60.000 di RAL. Full remote. Per davvero. Puoi lavorare da dove vuoi, basta che sia in una timezone compatibile con l’Italia. Se vuoi, il nostro ufficio a Milano è pronto ad accoglierti. Due volte l’anno abbiamo un meetup di 3 giorni, tutto pagato da Jet. Ownership di quello che fai. Non hai spec iper-dettagliate, non sei un mero esecutore. Sei tu responsabile dell’output finale. Impatto concreto. Siamo una start-up, ognuno dà un contributo essenziale allo sviluppo dei prodotti e alla crescita di Jet. Il tuo lavoro fa la differenza per migliaia di clienti. Start-up environment. Non è una startup qualsiasi, ma una ben finanziata e zeppa di talenti. In 6 mesi vedrai ed imparerai cose che altrove forse vedresti in anni, con un altissimo livello di responsabilità e coinvolgimento. Processo di selezione Prima interview con Talent Tech interview con Head of Data & AI Final interview con il team

items.desc: Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam Ben je benieuwd naar onze cultuur, opdrachten en ontwikkelmogelijkheden? Bezoek op 11 november 2026 ons event Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam. Spar met onze consultants over actuele ontwikkelingen in IT, kom meer te weten over onze uitdagende opdrachten en krijg advies over jouw carrièremogelijkheden en de vaardigheden die de komende jaren het verschil maken. Meld je aan (hyperlink naar https://www.cimsolutions.nl/aanmelden-open-huis-next-step-in-ict-amsterdam/) Als Data Analytics Specialist / Data Analist / Data Scientist ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verzamelen, analyseren en interpreteren van data om inzichten te verkrijgen en te gebruiken voor datagedreven besluitvorming bij of voor onze gerenommerde klanten waaronder Belastingdienst, Gemeente Den Haag, diverse ministeries, Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau of VGZ. Afhankelijk van het ervaringsniveau ligt de focus op verschillende aspecten van data-analyse en data science. Waarom past deze vacature bij jou? Je bent analytisch, nieuwsgierig en gedreven om maatschappelijke impact te maken met data. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen techniek en beleid en weet abstracte analyses te vertalen naar concrete inzichten. Je draagt graag bij aan kennisdeling, continu verbeteren en datagedreven werken binnen onze klanten. Je vindt het leuk om kennis te delen met collega’s, klanten en vakgenoten. Je voelt je thuis in een informele, collegiale en professionele omgeving, waar de aandacht voor de klant en voor de medewerker centraal staan. Wat ga je doen? Verzamelen, opschonen, transformeren en valideren van data uit verschillende bronnen. Toepassen van statistische methoden en data-analyse technieken om patronen, trends en inzichten uit data te halen. Ontwikkelen van geavanceerde machine learning modellen. Resultaten van analyses visualiseren en presenteren in heldere dashboards, rapporten en presentaties. Adviseren over datagedreven besluitvorming aan management en stakeholders. Coachen en (bege)leiden van medior en junior Data Specialisten. Effectief samenwerken met Data Engineers, Data Stewards, business analisten en andere stakeholders. Wat kun jij van ons verwachten? Een vast dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 8.000,- bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding; Opdrachtkeuzevrijheid: Jij bepaalt in overleg waar je aan werkt, met de begeleiding van een personal coach; Per jaar € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast ook nog eens 5-10 dagen studietijd; Kennissessies met vakgenoten en inhoudelijke events; Minimaal 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen op te bouwen of te verkopen; Sociale events zoals sportdagen, weekend weg en gezellige borrels; Een vestiging bij jou in de buurt. Jouw ontwikkeling, onze prioriteit CIMSOLUTIONS biedt jou een omgeving waarin je kunt doorgroeien naar Data Architect / Data Consultant. Je krijgt ruimte, ondersteuning en middelen om je te specialiseren en te excelleren. We bieden toegang tot diverse opleidingen en ondersteunen je met ervaren collega's. Onze slogan "Learn, create and make it work" is niet zomaar een zin – het is de kern van hoe wij werken en ontwikkelen. CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar o.a. leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Hierbij benadrukken wij dat wij gelijke kansen belangrijk vinden in de selectie. Wat breng jij mee? Een afgeronde wo-opleiding in Data Science, AI, Informatiekunde, Business Analytics of vergelijkbaar; Minimaal drie jaar aantoonbare ervaring in een Agile omgeving met het analyseren en interpreteren van data en het vertalen van inzichten naar concrete adviezen; Vaardig in het ontwerpen van dashboards en visualisaties die inzichten helder presenteren; Diepgaande kennis van statistische methoden, machine learning technieken en algoritmen; Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en trainen van machine learning modellen; Kennis van actuele ontwikkelingen op het gebied van data-analyse, data-ethiek en relevante wet- en regelgeving; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk; Voor senior functies ervaring met het leiden van data science projecten en kennisdeling; AI-affiniteit is een pré. Waarom CIMSOLUTIONS? 15 keer Top Employer! Uitstekend salaris; Vrije keuze leaseauto; € 5000,- opleidingsbudget; Aantrekkelijke bonussen; Veel sociale evenementen; Uitdagende projecten; Gevarieerde opdrachten; Gerenommeerde klanten. Heb je interesse? Wij vinden het leuk om op ons hoofdkantoor of één van onze lokale vestigingen of online kennis te maken. items.desc: Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam Ben je benieuwd naar onze cultuur, opdrachten en ontwikkelmogelijkheden? Bezoek op 11 november 2026 ons event Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam. Spar met onze consultants over actuele ontwikkelingen in IT, kom meer te weten over onze uitdagende opdrachten en krijg advies over jouw carrièremogelijkheden en de vaardigheden die de komende jaren het verschil maken. Meld je aan (hyperlink naar https://www.cimsolutions.nl/aanmelden-open-huis-next-step-in-ict-amsterdam/) Als Data Scientist lever je inzichten uit gegevens door het analyseproces te optimaliseren en visuele gegevensrepresentaties te presenteren. Je zoekt, beheert en voegt meerdere gegevensbronnen samen en zorgt voor consistentie van gegevenssets. Je identificeert de wiskundige modellen, selecteert en optimaliseert de algoritmen om bedrijfswaarde te leveren door middel van inzichten. Je stelt patronen vast en beveelt manieren aan om gegevens toe te passen. Waarom past deze vacature bij jou? Jij wilt jezelf blijven ontwikkelen en dat zit in ons DNA! Met jouw inzicht in cijfers, data en techniek leg je elke complexiteit simpel uit aan de klant. Klanttevredenheid is belangrijk voor je, dus je luistert goed en geeft inzichtelijke antwoorden die de klant het vertrouwen geeft dat het probleem wordt opgelost. Aan de hand van de informatiebehoefte van jouw stakeholders ontwikkel, test en implementeer je data science-modellen en help je collega’s om de mogelijkheden die schuilen in de rijke data bij onze gerenommeerde klanten, optimaal te benutten. Natuurlijk houd je daarbij de ontwikkelingen in het vak goed in de gaten. Krijg jij energie van het ontdekken van nieuwe kansen met data science? Je voelt je thuis in een informele, collegiale en professionele sfeer waar de aandacht voor de klant en voor de medewerker centraal staan. Wat kun jij van ons verwachten? Naast een dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 8.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding; € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast 5-10 dagen studietijd; Kennissessies met andere SIG Data Analytics en Competence Center Data Analyse, Big data en BI; 25 vakantiedagen en snel oplopend tot 28 vakantiedagen per jaar; Het aan- of verkopen van vakantiedagen; Regelmatig sociale uitjes zoals sportdagen, weekendjes weg en gezellige borrels. Jouw ontwikkeling, onze prioriteit We bieden jou persoonlijke ontwikkeling aan en zo werk je aan jouw carrière. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar is ons DNA. Als Data Scientist kun je doorgroeien naar diverse rollen, zoals Data Science Consultant, Business Analist, Senior Consultant. CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar o.a. leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Hierbij benadrukken wij dat wij gelijke kansen belangrijk vinden in de selectie. Wat breng jij mee? Minimaal een afgeronde WO-Masters opleiding met een sterk ICT-component Ervaring met het structureren en analyseren van grote hoeveelheden data om daarin relevante inzichten te ontdekken; Kennis van artificial intelligence, predictive analysis of Deepen/of Machine learning (libraries zoals TensorFlow, Keras, sklearn, Caffe, Torch); Kennis van en ervaring met één of meerdere analytics tools zoals R, Spark, Storm, HIVE, QlikView, Power BI, Splunk, MatLab, of SAS Suite etc.; Kennis van en ervaring met databasetechnologieën (Hadoop, SQL NoSQL, NewSQL etc.); Ervaring met het visualiseren van data met behulp van de laatste state-of-the-art technologieën; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Waarom CIMSOLUTIONS? 15 keer Top Employer! Uitstekend salaris; Vrije keuze leaseauto; € 5000,- opleidingsbudget; Aantrekkelijke bonussen; Veel sociale evenementen; Uitdagende projecten; Gevarieerde opdrachten; Gerenommeerde klanten. Ben je overtuigd? We willen graag kennis met je maken. items.title: Temp AI Engineer
items.card: In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing AI solutions to ensure the quality and reliability of embedded software developments. You will work closely with software developers, system architects and product owners to provide them the best AI state of the art solutions. Have you ever wondered how smartphones, connected cars, smartwatches, and IoT devices securely connect to mobile networks?
items.desc: G+D makes the lives of billions of people around the world more secure. We shape trust in the digital age with built-in security tech in three segments: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. We have been a reliable partner for our customers for over 170 years with our innovative solutions for SecurityTech! We are an international technology group and traditional family business with over 14,000 employees in 40 countries. Creating Confidence is our path to success. Trust is the basis of our collaboration within G+D. We are the reliable partner for all challenges resulting from the Internet of Things. We offer a complete connectivity portfolio for mobile network operators, automotive manufacturers, technology companies such as chip and module manufacturers as well as transport and logistics providers. Our portfolio includes highly secure solutions in the area of connectivity & IoT, from classic SIM, eSIM and iSIM, to the associated embedded operating systems and life cycle management, through to services for global connectivity and IoT solutions. Do you want to actively shape the digital transformation with us? At G+D Mobile Security, the global leader in SIM and eSIM technologies, we are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented AI Engineer to join our SW development team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing AI solutions to ensure the quality and reliability of embedded software developments. You will work closely with software developers, system architects and product owners to provide them the best AI state of the art solutions. Have you ever wondered how smartphones, connected cars, smartwatches, and IoT devices securely connect to mobile networks? Join us in Barcelona and help shape the future of secure digital connectivity. What We Do Our Barcelona R&D center develops innovative products that are shaping the future of communications worldwide. We work directly with leading smartphone manufacturers, automotive companies, and major IoT players. Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability, and security of next generation solutions. Duties & Responsibilities Contribute to the R&D AI strategy definition and operation. Design and implement useful AI use cases and agent orchestration for embedded software developments. Analyze AI solution results, identify root causes of failures, and work with development teams to promote and increase the value of the provided AI solutions. Contribute to continuous improvement of SW development process, tools, and methodologies. Maintain AI solution documentation and generate dynamic KPIs and reports for internal stakeholders. Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related field. Proven experience in AI solutions and agent orchestration. Strong knowledge of large language models and cloud AI architectures. Experience in Java full stack development. Proficiency in scripting and programming languages (e.g., Python, C/C++). Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and teamwork abilities. Fluent in written and spoken English. Desirable Skills Experience with version control and CI/CD tools (e.g., Git, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps). Experience with project tracking and documentation tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence) Experience with artifact dependency management tools (e.g. Nexus) Experience with test automation tools and frameworks (e.g. Jenkins). What’s great about working with us: Culture and diversity: Join a people oriented environment with different nationalities and a great team spirit, flat hierarchies (everyone speaks to everyone). Equal Opportunity Employer and LGBT+ friendly. Global Collaboration: Work collaboratively with stakeholders around the globe. Career Development: Benefit from continuous training, coaching, and talent development programs. Social Benefits: flexible compensation (transport tickets, training, private insurance), etc. Canteen: take a break with our breakfast and lunch service: chose between a wild range of menus, salad desk, and sandwiches service. Nicely prices! Work-Life Balance: Flexible working hours with the option for remote work (M-Th 8.30 – 17.30 and Fri 8.30 – 15.30; 1 day of remote work). Location: Sant Joan Despí. Easy communication by public transport. Explore what makes G+D unique – check out this video: Giesecke+Devrient – We make the lives of billions of people more secure. Privacy Notice The personal data you provide will be processed to manage your application in accordance with the GDPR and our Privacy Policy, available at Data Privacy | G+D.

Junior AI Engineer Do you have an inquisitive mindset, enjoy problem solving, and have an interest in tech? Our Technology Academy provides you with the opportunity to learn everything you need to build a successful career in IT, across a range of roles, without any previous experience or a specific degree. In fact, if you don’t have a degree we definitely want to hear from you! Why choose CTA? We are an inclusive and diverse technology academy committed to creating equitable opportunities for those looking to work in tech. Our academy pays a competitive salary, above the National Living Wage from day one while you train, before finding the ideal client project for you to work on using the skills you've gained. About the role You’ll be joining us as an Associate Technology Consultant, working across AI Engineering and Software Quality Engineering . It all starts with our introductory training courses, covering everything you need to know to get started in the world of consulting. Our in-depth training is full time and is delivered on a hybrid learning basis (classroom & and remote). You'll learn a lot quite quickly – it will be fast-paced, but enjoyable and highly engaging! After the training period you’ll have the opportunity to gain industry experience by working with our clients on their projects. For this specific role you’ll be working as part of a global consultancy’s specialist team who are involved in the end-to-end design and implementation of solutions that the business and technology teams use to manage work, products and programmes! After a period of training you’ll have the opportunity to gain industry experience by working with one or more of our clients as an AI Engineer & Software Quality Engineer. While doing this you’ll get continued support from us and the client you work with. Our programme is designed as a two-year journey, giving you the opportunity to build meaningful industry experience, develop your technical and professional skills, and establish a strong foundation for your career. At the end of the programme, there may be opportunities to move into a permanent role with your client, depending on individual performance and opportunities available within the client organisation at the time. What does our Academy offer? A route into the tech industry as an Associate Technology Consultant, specialising in AI Engineering and Software Quality Engineering A structured career path and ongoing progression opportunities within the first years of employment. Training in a range of technologies and tools vital to the tech industry, including Agile and Scrum, databases, SQL, websites, Web Services and APIs, programming, software testing and test automation. You'll learn how these technologies work and how they're used in real-world projects. An introduction to data science, including how to prepare, analyse and interpret data, use statistics to understand patterns, and creating visualisations. Training in Python and tools such as NumPy and Pandas for working with data and PyTest for testing software. An introduction to AI and Machine Learning (ML), exploring how models learn from data, recognise patterns and work in practice, including large language models (LLMs), small language models (SLMs) and traditional ML models. Training in how AI systems are developed, trained, deployed and monitored to ensure they perform as expected. Specialist training in AI and Machine Learning testing, including checking data quality, evaluating model performance, testing AI tools and large language models (LLMs), and using test automation to improve reliability and efficiency. A role with one of our industry leading clients on one or more projects so you can explore where you want your career to go Ongoing learning and development opportunities, including on-the-job training and ongoing support from our experienced trainers and consultants. Access to a range of certifications covering various roles and technologies, including ISTQB, AWS, Azure, Scrum and more. items.desc: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Design and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks. Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems. Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company. Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking. Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time. Location Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland). The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. items.desc: A Direção de Compliance pretende recrutar um Data Scientist para a área de Fraude. A Direção de Compliance tem como missão a gestão da Função Conformidade do Grupo Crédito Agrícola, garantindo o adequado cumprimento da legislação regulamentação aplicável e a Prevenção de Crime Financeiro. Principais responsabilidades: Investigar e analisar novos e emergentes modus operandi de fraude, acompanhando a evolução dos padrões e tendências no contexto bancário; Analisar grandes volumes de dados transacionais e comportamentais, recorrendo a SQL, Python e/ou R, com vista à identificação de padrões, anomalias e potenciais situações de fraude; Desenvolver, testar e otimizar modelos analíticos e de Machine Learning aplicados à prevenção e deteção de fraude; Traduzir os resultados das análises e investigações em insights acionáveis, contribuindo para a melhoria da eficácia e precisão dos mecanismos de deteção; Monitorizar e avaliar o desempenho dos modelos e mecanismos de deteção existentes, identificando eventuais lacunas, desvios e necessidades de ajustamento face à evolução dos padrões de fraude; Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos mecanismos de deteção, procurando assegurar um equilíbrio entre a identificação eficaz de situações de fraude e a redução de falsos positivos; Trabalhar em estreita articulação com as áreas de Fraude, Tecnologia, Risco, Compliance e outras áreas relevantes, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções de prevenção e deteção de fraude e para uma resposta integrada a novas ameaças; Documentar os resultados das análises, modelos e metodologias desenvolvidas, contribuindo para o reforço e partilha do conhecimento interno em matéria de fraude. Perfil pretendido: Formação superior em Data Science, Matemática, Estatística, Engenharia Informática, Engenharia ou área similar; Experiência profissional mínima de 4 anos em Data Science, Advanced Analytics ou Machine Learning, preferencialmente aplicada ao setor financeiro; Experiência sólida na utilização de SQL e na análise de grandes volumes de dados; Experiência na utilização de Python e/ou R; Conhecimentos de ferramentas de visualização e reporting, como Power BI, serão valorizados; Conhecimentos sólidos de análise estatística, Machine Learning e técnicas de deteção de anomalias; Forte capacidade analítica, de pensamento crítico e de resolução de problemas; Capacidade para trabalhar e interpretar grandes volumes de dados; Boas capacidades de comunicação e apresentação, incluindo experiência de contacto direto com clientes; Domínio da língua inglesa, oral e escrita; Será valorizada experiência nas áreas de fraude, pagamentos, cartões, serviços financeiros ou banca; Será valorizada experiência no desenvolvimento e aplicação de modelos de Machine Learning à deteção de fraude; Serão valorizados conhecimentos de AML, KYC e PSD2, bem como de outros referenciais relevantes no âmbito da prevenção e deteção de fraude. O que oferecemos: Integração numa instituição sólida, com forte presença no setor financeiro; Remuneração e benefícios de acordo com o ACT e práticas do setor bancário; Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional numa equipa colaborativa e especializada; Perspetivas de evolução e crescimento na carreira. Se considera que o seu perfil se alinha com os nossos requisitos, este desafio é para si! O Grupo Crédito Agrícola destaca-se como uma entidade empregadora de referência, oferecendo um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza a segurança, a inovação, a sustentabilidade e o desenvolvimento profissional dos seus colaboradores. Com uma presença sólida no sector bancário e segurador, o Grupo proporciona oportunidades em diversas áreas, promovendo o crescimento contínuo e a formação especializada das suas equipas. Além disso, o Grupo está comprometido com práticas de responsabilidade social e ambiental, alinhando-se com políticas de sustentabilidade que reforçam o seu papel como agente de mudança positiva junto das comunidades locais. Integrar a equipa do Grupo Crédito Agrícola significa fazer parte de uma instituição que valoriza o talento, a diversidade, o compromisso com a excelência e a portugalidade, oferecendo um percurso profissional enriquecedor e alinhado com os desafios do mercado atual.

Sede: Reggio Emilia Modalità: ibrida, con 4 giorni a settimana in presenza Descrizione del ruolo La risorsa entrerà nel team che lavora su soluzioni di prevenzione e rilevamento delle frodi. Si occuperà di analizzare i dati e supportare lo sviluppo di modelli e strumenti basati su Python, Machine Learning e Intelligenza Artificiale, utilizzando l’ambiente Google Cloud Platform. Attività Analizzare i dati per individuare anomalie e comportamenti potenzialmente fraudolenti. Supportare la preparazione e l’elaborazione dei dati con Python e SQL. Collaborare allo sviluppo e alla verifica di modelli di Machine Learning. Contribuire alla valutazione delle prestazioni dei modelli e dei risultati delle analisi. Utilizzare i servizi GCP e gli strumenti della suite Google. Collaborare con il team nella documentazione delle attività e nella condivisione dei risultati. Requisiti Esperienza in ambito Data Science, Machine Learning, AI o analisi dati. Conoscenza di Python. Interesse o esperienza in progetti di prevenzione delle frodi. Familiarità con Google Cloud Platform e con la suite Google. Capacità analitiche, precisione e attitudine al lavoro in team. Laurea in Scienze giuridiche Competenze preferenziali Conoscenza di SQL, BigQuery, pandas e NumPy. Familiarità con librerie di Machine Learning come scikit-learn. Conoscenza di Vertex AI o Cloud Storage. Esposizione a Pub/Sub o Dataflow, in particolare per l’elaborazione di dati in tempo reale. Le tecnologie indicate come preferenziali possono essere adattate in base allo stack effettivamente utilizzato dal team. Cosa offriamo? Formazione continua su hard e soft skills. Follow-up costante con HR e Business Manager. Un percorso di crescita chiaro e strutturato in un ambiente innovativo, dinamico e internazionale. La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 22.000 EUR e 29.000 EUR. La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato dalla nostra società. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna The world needs you ADENTIS Italia è un equal opportunities employer: crediamo che tutte le forme di diversità siano fonte di arricchimento reciproco. Ci impegniamo a garantire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, nel quale ogni singola risorsa possa apportare un valore unico alla nostra realtà. Pertanto, accogliamo candidature senza distinzione di età, genere, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o stato civile. Inoltre, teniamo fede ai nostri impegni prestando attenzione alle risorse appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi degli articoli 1 e 18 della Legge 68/99. I dati personali saranno trattati in conformità alle disposizioni contenute nel regolamento UE 2016/679.

items.title: Research Scientist - Computer Science
items.card: Responsibilities Identify and investigate complex, unsolved research problems. Develop and evaluate algorithms, mathematical proofs, and computational simulations. Validate research findings for accuracy, originality, and scientific significance. Conduct literature reviews and assess emerging research developments. Prepare technical research reports documenting findings, challenges, and potential breakthroughs.
items.desc: 🌍 Work Mode: Remote 📋 Engagement: Flexible Contract | Part-Time or Full-Time We are seeking exceptional research professionals to work on challenging problems at the intersection of computer science, theoretical research, and computational physics. 🔬 Key Responsibilities Identify and investigate complex, unsolved research problems. Develop and evaluate algorithms, mathematical proofs, and computational simulations. Validate research findings for accuracy, originality, and scientific significance. Conduct literature reviews and assess emerging research developments. Prepare technical research reports documenting findings, challenges, and potential breakthroughs. Recommend promising research directions and methodologies. 🎯 Required Qualifications 7–10+ years of active research experience in Computer Science, Computational Physics, or a related field. Strong publication record in leading journals or conferences, including recent research contributions. Expertise in computational methods, numerical analysis, algorithms, simulations, or high-performance computing. Demonstrated ability to solve complex theoretical or computational problems. Strong critical thinking, technical writing, and research evaluation skills. Significant research contributions, scholarly recognition, or experience addressing challenging open problems. ⭐ Preferred: Experience with formal verification tools, research committees, editorial boards, or advanced mathematical and computational methods.

items.desc: Pet Pawr Group AB är ett snabbväxande entreprenörsdrivet bolag med en omsättning på ca. 1 Mdkr. Vi är ett av Nordens mest moderna zoofackhandelsbolag – både online och i fysisk butik - och står bakom flera välkända varumärken: ZOO.se, Tinybuddy, Pritax och norska PetXL. Vi är en av Nordens ledande aktörer inom e-handel för husdjursprodukter och tillsammans driver vi sju online-butiker i Sverige, Norge och Finland samt flertalet fysiska butiker i Sverige och Norge. Vill du bygga AI-agenter som används på riktigt, i butik, lager och på kontor? Pet Pawr Group söker en specialist som tar egna AI-tjänster hela vägen från affärscase till drift och mätbar effekt. Om rollen Du äger de tjänster och agentbaserade flöden vi utvecklar inhouse och du bygger dem själv. Målet är mindre manuellt arbete, kortare ledtider och bättre beslutsunderlag i alla avdelningar. Du ansvarar för utveckling, drift och första support, och rapporterar till vår CTO. Rollen passar dig som i dag arbetar som AI Engineer, AI-utvecklare eller fullstackutvecklare med fokus på automation. Det här gör du Bygger och driftsätter agentbaserade flöden med tydliga gränser för vad agenten gör själv och när en människa godkänner Kartlägger manuella moment tillsammans med avdelningarna och prioriterar efter störst effekt Äger roadmap, backlog och acceptans för dina produkter Sätter vårt arbetssätt för AI-driven utveckling: specifikation, kod, granskning, test och produktion Mäter effekt i sparade timmar och följer kostnaden för modeller mot nyttan Utbildar kollegor och tar fram riktlinjer för ansvarsfull AI, informationssäkerhet och GDPR Du har Minst 3 års erfarenhet som fullstackutvecklare Byggt och driftsatt agentbaserade flöden själv Erfarenhet av automation i handel till exempel supply chain, prissättning, innehåll eller masterdata Vana att värdera initiativ i kronor och timmar och att föra dialog på ledningsnivå Gott omdöme kring säkerhet och personuppgifter Meriterande är erfarenhet från detaljhandel med både butik och e-handel. Så arbetar vi AI är ett medel, inte ett mål. Den enklaste lösningen som ger effekten vinner. En lösning som inte används räknas inte som levererad. Vi erbjuder Mandat över prioriteringar, verktyg och modeller inom givna ramar Avsatt tid varje kvartal för att utforska nya verktyg och modeller Hybridarbete från vårt kontor på Linnégatan i Stockholm Bra att veta Våra butiker har öppet kvällar och helger. Ibland kan ett akut fel i dina tjänster behöva åtgärdas utanför kontorstid, men det ska vara undantag och inte regel. Om oss Pet Pawr Group är en nordisk detaljhandelskoncern med cirka 500 medarbetare i Sverige och Norge och varumärkena ZOO.se, PetXL.no och Tinybuddy. Ansökan Skicka ditt CV och en kort beskrivning av något du byggt och vilken effekt det gav. Urval sker löpande. Hos Pet Pawr Group får du inte bara möjligheten att utvecklas i din roll, du får även vara en del av ett professionellt team som varje dag arbetar för att skapa den bästa upplevelsen för både kunder och deras djur! Välkommen att ta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med oss!

items.desc: Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam Ben je benieuwd naar onze cultuur, opdrachten en ontwikkelmogelijkheden? Bezoek op 11 november 2026 ons event Open Huis - Next Step in ICT in Amsterdam. Spar met onze consultants over actuele ontwikkelingen in IT, kom meer te weten over onze uitdagende opdrachten en krijg advies over jouw carrièremogelijkheden en de vaardigheden die de komende jaren het verschil maken. Meld je aan (hyperlink naar https://www.cimsolutions.nl/aanmelden-open-huis-next-step-in-ict-amsterdam/) Als Data Scientist lever je inzichten uit gegevens door het analyseproces te optimaliseren en visuele gegevensrepresentaties te presenteren. Je zoekt, beheert en voegt meerdere gegevensbronnen samen en zorgt voor consistentie van gegevenssets. Je identificeert de wiskundige modellen, selecteert en optimaliseert de algoritmen om bedrijfswaarde te leveren door middel van inzichten. Je stelt patronen vast en beveelt manieren aan om gegevens toe te passen. Waarom past deze vacature bij jou? Jij wilt jezelf blijven ontwikkelen en dat zit in ons DNA! Met jouw inzicht in cijfers, data en techniek leg je elke complexiteit simpel uit aan de klant. Klanttevredenheid is belangrijk voor je, dus je luistert goed en geeft inzichtelijke antwoorden die de klant het vertrouwen geeft dat het probleem wordt opgelost. Aan de hand van de informatiebehoefte van jouw stakeholders ontwikkel, test en implementeer je data science-modellen en help je collega’s om de mogelijkheden die schuilen in de rijke data bij onze gerenommeerde klanten, optimaal te benutten. Natuurlijk houd je daarbij de ontwikkelingen in het vak goed in de gaten. Krijg jij energie van het ontdekken van nieuwe kansen met data science? Je voelt je thuis in een informele, collegiale en professionele sfeer waar de aandacht voor de klant en voor de medewerker centraal staan. Wat kun jij van ons verwachten? Naast een dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 8.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding; € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast 5-10 dagen studietijd; Kennissessies met andere SIG Data Analytics en Competence Center Data Analyse, Big data en BI; 25 vakantiedagen en snel oplopend tot 28 vakantiedagen per jaar; Het aan- of verkopen van vakantiedagen; Regelmatig sociale uitjes zoals sportdagen, weekendjes weg en gezellige borrels. Jouw ontwikkeling, onze prioriteit We bieden jou persoonlijke ontwikkeling aan en zo werk je aan jouw carrière. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar is ons DNA. Als Data Scientist kun je doorgroeien naar diverse rollen, zoals Data Science Consultant, Business Analist, Senior Consultant. CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar o.a. leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Hierbij benadrukken wij dat wij gelijke kansen belangrijk vinden in de selectie. Wat breng jij mee? Minimaal een afgeronde WO-Masters opleiding met een sterk ICT-component Ervaring met het structureren en analyseren van grote hoeveelheden data om daarin relevante inzichten te ontdekken; Kennis van artificial intelligence, predictive analysis of Deepen/of Machine learning (libraries zoals TensorFlow, Keras, sklearn, Caffe, Torch); Kennis van en ervaring met één of meerdere analytics tools zoals R, Spark, Storm, HIVE, QlikView, Power BI, Splunk, MatLab, of SAS Suite etc.; Kennis van en ervaring met databasetechnologieën (Hadoop, SQL NoSQL, NewSQL etc.); Ervaring met het visualiseren van data met behulp van de laatste state-of-the-art technologieën; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Waarom CIMSOLUTIONS? 15 keer Top Employer! Uitstekend salaris; Vrije keuze leaseauto; € 5000,- opleidingsbudget; Aantrekkelijke bonussen; Veel sociale evenementen; Uitdagende projecten; Gevarieerde opdrachten; Gerenommeerde klanten. Ben je overtuigd? We willen graag kennis met je maken. Solliciteer vrijblijvend of neem contact met ons op via: Mail: recruitment@cimsolutions.nl; Telefoon: 0499-366 000; of bezoek onze website: www.cimsolutions.nl/werken-bij/

items.desc: Localisation : Paris 13e Démarrage : Asap Type de mission : Longue durée Contexte de la mission Dans le cadre de l’accélération de sa transformation Data et Intelligence Artificielle, une organisation recherche un ML Engineer spécialisé en industrialisation de solutions IA sur Dataiku . Vous interviendrez sur la transformation de modèles de Machine Learning développés par les Data Scientists en solutions robustes, performantes et exploitables en production, tout en contribuant à la mise en place des bonnes pratiques MLOps. Missions principales Industrialiser les modèles de Machine Learning et transformer les prototypes en solutions prêtes pour la production. Concevoir, développer et maintenir des workflows sur Dataiku : recettes, scénarios d’automatisation et API endpoints. Mettre en place des pipelines CI/CD pour automatiser le déploiement des modèles IA. Assurer le monitoring des modèles en production : performances, détection de dérive (model drift) et suivi de leur fiabilité. Garantir la scalabilité, la maintenabilité et la qualité des solutions déployées. Intégrer les modèles dans les systèmes d’information en collaboration avec les équipes Data, IT et métiers. Documenter les solutions et contribuer à la standardisation des pratiques MLOps. Compétences recherchées Expérience confirmée en Machine Learning Engineering et MLOps. Très bonne maîtrise de Dataiku DSS, notamment en conception de workflows, automatisation et déploiement. Maîtrise des pratiques CI/CD appliquées aux projets IA. Bonne connaissance des architectures Data et des flux ETL/ELT. Connaissance des environnements Cloud et des technologies de conteneurisation, notamment Docker et Kubernetes. Capacité à déployer et maintenir des modèles de Machine Learning en environnement de production. Profil candidat: Profil recherché Nous recherchons un profil opérationnel, rigoureux et autonome, capable de faire le lien entre la Data Science et la production, avec une expertise solide sur Dataiku et une approche orientée fiabilité, automatisation et industrialisation des solutions IA.
