items.desc: Wil jij jouw analytische talent inzetten op het snijvlak van data, duurzaamheid en strategie? Werk je graag in een team dat midden in de complexe uitdagingen van de energiemarkt staat? Dan zoeken wij jou. Als Data Scientist versterk je het team Energie-Inkoop, Risicomanagement en Prijsbeleid. Dit team bepaalt de inkoopstrategie voor groene elektriciteit en gas en vertaalt deze naar scherpe en verantwoorde prijzen voor onze klanten. Want welke energieproducten we ook aanbieden, het begint altijd met het zo nauwkeurig mogelijk voorspellen van het verbruik, de onzekerheden en de kostprijs. Elke verbetering verlaagt de kosten voor onze klanten en helpt ons om de energietransitie te kunnen versnellen. De energiemarkt verandert snel. Door de energietransitie wordt het inkopen en prijzen van energie steeds complexer en minder voorspelbaar. Slimme analyses en toepassingen die steeds dichter bij real time komen, zijn daarom essentieel. En daar ga jij mee aan de slag! Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van prijs- en voorspelmodellen voor energieverbruik en kostprijzen; Toepassen van AI om voorspelkracht te vergroten en verbeteringen breed te implementeren; Je benut de nieuwe mogelijkheden van machine learning en A.I. om de verbeterstappen sneller en over volle breedte te implementeren. Je ontwikkelt je tot expert in toepassing van A.I. bij deze modellen en processen; Signaleren van trends zoals slim laden, zon-curtailment en thuisbatterijen, en hun effect op onze portfolio; Vertalen van inzichten naar concrete verbeterkansen in pricing, sourcing en risicomanagement; Actief bijdragen aan kennisopbouw binnen het team en implementatie van innovaties. Je krijgt de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, je te ontwikkelen, verbeterkansen te ontdekken en deze te realiseren. Je rapporteert aan de Director Customer Value Optimization. Functie-eisen Wie ben jij? Je bent analytisch en verdiept je graag in bovenstaande materie om je te ontwikkelen tot een topspecialist. Je werkt accuraat en hebt een proactieve houding. Je werkt nauw samen met andere specialisten op het gebied van inkoop, forecasting, pricing en rapportage binnen de afdeling. Daarnaast werk je samen met specialisten op het gebied van data science, machine learning en data-engineers buiten de adeling. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen kritisch te bekijken en brengt nieuwe perspectieven in. Tegelijkertijd kun je jouw analyses en ideeën begrijpelijk overbrengen aan collega’s. Daarnaast Heb Je Een relevante universitaire studie afgerond, met sterke wiskundige, natuurkundige en/of econometrische componenten; Enige relevante werkervaring; Je beschikt over ruime en aantoonbare ervaring met Python (bv pandas, numpy, matplotlib, scipy, sklearn packages), en het werken met grote data sets; Ervaring met toepassing van machine learning technieken en A.I. en een sterke behoefte om frontrunner te blijven of worden op dit gebied; Goede communicatieve en schriftelijke vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels. items.desc: At Motia, we're at the forefront of fleet solutions, providing innovative services that power businesses across the UK. We're committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive. Our culture fosters collaboration, innovation, and growth, ensuring you can build a career, not just a job. With over 300 employees across five offices, we support over 55,000 customers nationwide. About the role Reporting to the Head of Business Intelligence, the Graduate Data Scientist will support the development of data-driven insights, predictive models, and analytical solutions that help improve business performance. This is an exciting opportunity for a recent postgraduate to apply advanced analytical techniques in a commercial environment while developing their skills alongside experienced data professionals. The successful candidate will contribute to projects across marketing, sales, pricing, and customer analytics, helping the business make informed decisions and identify opportunities for growth as we migrate to Microsoft Fabric. Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role, applicants must already have the right to work in the UK. Duties & Responsibilities Support the development and enhancement of customer value, segmentation, and predictive models. Assist in analysing customer, sales, and operational data to identify trends and opportunities. Contribute to the design, build, testing, and deployment of machine learning and statistical models. Support pricing and commercial analysis through data exploration and modelling techniques. Work with stakeholders across the business to understand analytical requirements and business challenges. Help develop dashboards, visualisations, and reporting solutions that communicate insights effectively. Participate in test-and-learn initiatives to measure the effectiveness of business strategies and campaigns. Collaborate with the Business Intelligence team to improve data quality, reporting, and analytical capabilities. Present findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences. Stay up to date with developments in data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and analytics. What You'll Gain Structured development and mentoring from experienced data and analytics professionals. Exposure to real-world commercial data science projects. Opportunities to develop technical and business skills. A collaborative and innovative working environment. Clear career progression opportunities within Data Science and Analytics. Requirements Master's degree in Data Science (or closely related subject such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or Analytics). Strong understanding of statistical analysis, data modelling, and machine learning concepts. Experience using Python and/or R through academic projects, internships, or personal development. Knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Ability to work with large datasets and transform data into actionable insights. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly. Highly organised with strong attention to detail. Eagerness to learn, develop, and build a career within data science. Ability to work collaboratively within cross-functional teams Experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Knowledge of cloud analytics platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Understanding of predictive modelling, customer analytics, or commercial analytics. Experience of applying machine learning techniques through university projects or internships. Familiarity with Git or other version control tools. Benefits Hybrid working - 2/3 days on site at our Leeds Head Office a week Basic Salary - £30,000 per annum Bonus - up to £2k per annum Annual leave - 25 days plus bank holidays An additional day annual leave for your birthday after 1 year service Holiday purchase Scheme - buy/sell up to 5 days annual leave after 2 years service Free breakfast Early Friday finish - 2:45pm Fun, supportive working environment Cycle to work scheme Dress down office Pension 4 x salary life assurance

items.desc: Equal Plus Consulting has been engaged to search for a Translation & AI Ecosystem Analyst / Consultant to work hybrid for a client in Kontich Belgium. TITLE Translation & AI Ecosystem Analyst / Consultant LOCATION Kontich Belgium or Prague Czech REQUESTED START DATE 9 Nov 2026 END DATE 31 Jan 2027 MAX BUY-IN PRICE 0.00 LANGUAGES English DESCRIPTION Important: this role can be done from Belgium or Prague Role Summary We are seeking a Translation & AI Ecosystem Analyst / Consultant for a 3-month strategic assignment to conduct a comprehensive, helicopter-view assessment of our current translation landscape. We want to investigate the internal business expectations and the translation output from our department and our external partner (specifically regarding Machine Translation quality). To address this, we require a seasoned professional to independently evaluate our setup, investigate modern AI translation alternatives, and deliver a strategic roadmap across people, process, governance, resources, AI capabilities, and tools. This position is key to provide an objective, data-backed foundation to decide on future operating models, tool selections, and process enhancements. Key Objectives & Scope of Work Ecosystem Assessment: Analyze the end-to-end translation ecosystem from a high-level perspective to identify root causes behind stakeholder dissatisfaction. AI & Tool Investigation: Lead a targeted investigation into AI-powered translation tools to evaluate potential alternatives to or enhancements for the current provider. Process Analysis: Map the variance between business needs/expectations and the actual quality and efficiency delivered. Strategic Recommendations: Provide actionable recommendations in Tools & AI Capabilities: investigation into other AI-powered translation tools to evaluate potential alternatives to or enhancements for the current provider People & Training: Identifying training needs. Processes Governance & Vendor Management: Establishing SLAs, and vendor accountability. Key Responsibilities Collaborate closely with the internal lead to gather context, access existing workflows, and connect with key business stakeholders. Audit current Machine Translation (MT) quality, feedback loops, and supplier delivery mechanisms. Research, test, and benchmark alternative enterprise AI translation tools and engines. Synthesize findings into a clear, executive-ready assessment report and improvement roadmap. Candidate Profile & Requirements Must-Have Experience Seniority: Solid, demonstrable experience in a similar position within the translation/localization domain. Deep AI & MT Expertise: Strong hands-on knowledge of modern Machine Translation (MT), Neural Machine Translation (NMT), Large Language Model (LLM) translation workflows, and enterprise translation tools. Vendor & Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with major TMS (Translation Management Systems) and translation vendors/partners. Consulting & Analytical Mindset: Proven ability to look beyond daily operations, perform root-cause analysis, and translate business frustration into structured, objective solutions. Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills to interface with internal stakeholders, translate technical gaps into business impacts, and present clear strategic choices to management.

items.desc: Soreli Paris is a fine jewelry brand built around a strong cinematic visual identity: deep Black & Gold contrast, warm golden hour lighting, ultra-pronounced bokeh, and a fashion editorial aesthetic that sets us apart from standard e-commerce. We are looking for a skilled AI image creator to produce visuals for our jewelry collections (rings, necklaces, bracelets, earrings). You will receive a complete, detailed Art Direction document — no guessing, no creative interpretation needed. We work with talented freelancers worldwide. Applicants based in India, Georgia, and similar markets are especially welcome. Vos missions Generate AI images for 4 jewelry collections using Midjourney v6+ and/or Stable Diffusion Strictly follow our 7 visual pillars: absolute black/gold contrast · warm golden hour lighting · ultra-pronounced bokeh · precise model expressions · black gloves signature · tight fashion editorial framing · glowing skin Deliver images in portrait ratio 3:4 or 4:5, maximum quality (8K prompt quality) Self-validate each image against our 15-point checklist before delivery Perform light post-production adjustments when needed (contrast, warm tones, gold luminosity) Communicate clearly in English and iterate quickly on feedback Vos compétences We don't want someone who 'knows Midjourney'. We want someone who understands light, composition, and fashion photography — and uses AI as a precision tool. Required: Advanced Midjourney v6+ and/or Stable Diffusion — precise control of depth of field, light temperature, expression Strong understanding of photography vocabulary: bokeh, golden hour, backlighting, shallow depth of field, fashion editorial Ability to deliver on-brief from batch #1 — our Art Direction is detailed enough Fast turnaround and availability for batch deliveries (10–30 images per collection) Good written English for communication Strong advantage: Portfolio showing fashion, jewelry, or luxury AI imagery Experience with warm/cinematic tone grading (sepia, golden tones — no cold/blue lighting) Automatic rejection if: No portfolio submitted Portfolio shows cold/blue lighting or flat e-commerce style Test question answer is vague, incomplete, or missing MANDATORY TEST QUESTION — answer this in your application: « In Midjourney, how do you achieve ultra-pronounced bokeh with a sharp focus on a jewelry piece in the foreground? What keyword combination do you use to simulate warm golden hour lighting? Please provide a full prompt example. » A precise, technical answer with a prompt example = you move to the next step. A vague answer = application rejected. Avantages 100% remote — work from anywhere, at your own hours Complete Art Direction document provided from day one — no creative guesswork Payment per delivery batch (per image or per batch), negotiated based on your market Payoneer, Wise, Upwork, or your preferred international payment method Regular work: new collections every 6–8 weeks Long-term partnership for the right profile — we value consistency over one-shot projects If you have a real eye for luxury aesthetics, you know how to make jewelry shine in a cinematic frame, and you can deliver consistently — this is a long-term opportunity with a growing Parisian jewelry brand. To apply, send us: A portfolio or AI image samples in fashion / luxury / jewelry style Your answer to the mandatory test question above Your availability, rates (per image or per batch), and preferred payment method No portfolio + no test answer = application not read.

items.desc: Welcome to dexter health! At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams. Our mission is to reduce administrative workload in healthcare so caregivers can spend more time with patients. We are looking for a high-agency AI Engineer to help us build new AI features faster and improve the quality, reliability, and speed of existing AI workflows. This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features. The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed. You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles. product ideas into working software quickly Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs Serious experience using If you want to build AI product features that ship, improve real workflows, use AI tools every day, and take ownership in a fast-moving team, we would like to hear from you.

The value they create flows to middlemen, while the brands who want to reach them are stuck in a non-transparent, fragmented market. So we built the tools to fix both sides at once. Creators turn an account into an income: join a campaign in minutes, make something they're proud of, and get paid fairly for creativity, not follower count. Brands brief once, activate hundreds of creators, and see content live within 24 hours. Next year, 10,000 creators will make a living from WePush. When a creator earns, a brand grows. When a brand grows, more creators earn. WePush is the fastest-growing creator marketing platform in Europe, with over 150,000 creators and 500,000+ collaborations powering brands like L'Oréal, ABOUT YOU, Zalando, and Sony Music. Two numbers matter to us: how many people make a living through WePush, and how many millions of people brands reach through them. We're looking for a Fullstack AI Product Engineer who is comfortable moving across all of those layers and who uses AI agent tools as genuine leverage. We use these tools daily to read unfamiliar services, ship changes, and move fast. Tasks What you'll actually work on: A native iOS app: SwiftUI, rewritten natively Web Frontend: our marketplace apps are built in Angular, and newer internal tooling is React. An application server layer: a Node/TypeScript service sitting between the frontend and the backend fleet, handling booking, scheduling/matching logic, invoicing, and PDF generation. A polyglot microservices fleet, with a shrinking Hack/HHVM legacy core and a growing set of services in Node.js and Go, each independently versioned, containerized, and deployed via Helm to Kubernetes A real CI/CD pipeline: GitLab CI building images with Kaniko, tag-based semver releases (nightly unstable builds, stable releases promoted through dev to test to a manually gated prod), and cross-service pipeline triggers when a shared dependency publishes Scheduled workloads at scale: a couple dozen CronJobs per environment (reminders, payout checks, stat rollups, token refreshes, media polling), each independently schedulable, tunable, and killable without redeploying the whole service Money movement: a ledger service backing real balances and payouts A scraper fleet: services that scrape platforms which actively fight back (rate limits, bot walls, reshaped responses), running on their own schedule with their own failure modes A newer AWS/serverless edge: internal tooling and some integrations are moving onto Lambda/API Gateway/DynamoDB. This is where a lot of new, greenfield work is happening What "AI-driven builder" means here: You use AI tools openly, as your default way of working, to read and understand an unfamiliar service fast, not just to generate new code. You've operated real distributed systems, not just built a monolith and called it done. You're just as comfortable tracing a bug from a UI symptom (web or native) down through the application server into the backend that caused it as you are building the fix on either end You're comfortable being dropped into someone else's code, in a language you may not know, with real production traffic on it, and using AI tools plus your own judgment to figure out how it actually behaves You're honest about uncertainty. items.desc: Unikum är Sveriges största digitala verktyg för lärande och har redan passerat 1 miljon användarkonton i tusentals förskolor och skolor. Vår ide är enkel: Unikt lärande för unika barn! Vi är inne i ett väldigt kul skede där data och AI gör livet lättare för både våra användare och oss på Unikum. Det gäller så klart också support - vill du leda resan? Om rollen Vi söker en tekniskt nyfiken supportspecialist till vårt Customer Success-team. Ditt uppdrag är att samla supporten i ett gemensamt system med gemensamma processer och att bygga en support där AI, kunskap och smarta flöden gör det enkelt att ge kunderna rätt hjälp snabbt. Samtidigt äger du tekniska ärenden från första analys till lösning eller eskalering. Så utvecklas rollen I början lägger du mest tid på ärendehantering och migrering till det gemensamma systemet. Där lär du känna kunderna, produkterna och utmaningarna. Det är grunden för nästa steg. Med tiden flyttas fokus till att bygga bort återkommande ärenden genom bättre processer, kunskap och AI-stöd. Ju bättre vi lyckas, desto mer av din tid går till utveckling. Det här kommer du att göra Utveckla AI-stöd för kunskapssökning, klassificering, prioritering och svarsförslag, och följa upp att det faktiskt fungerar Bidra till migrering till ett gemensamt supportsystem med nya ärendeflöden, kategorier, mallar och uppföljning Utreda tekniska ärenden kring behörigheter, konfigurationer, integrationer och dataflöden Ta fram reproducerbara steg och tekniskt underlag tillsammans med produkt- och utvecklingsteamen Förklara tekniska frågor begripligt för kunderna och hålla dem uppdaterade om nästa steg Använda ärendedata och AI för att hitta mönster, förbättra hjälpartiklar och föra kundinsikter vidare till rätt team Vi tror att du har god teknisk förståelse och är van att felsöka systematiskt är intresserad av hur system, databaser och integrationer hänger ihop är nyfiken på AI och vill bygga lösningar, inte bara använda dem tycker om kunddialog och kan förklara tekniska saker enkelt skriver och talar mycket god svenska och god engelska Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av SaaS, API, SSO, databaser, logganalys, systemigrering, automatisering eller kunskapshantering i support. Skolbakgrund är också ett plus. Bockar du inte av allt? Sök ändå! Vi värdesätter nyfikenhet och viljan att lära minst lika mycket som en komplett lista med erfarenheter. AI med omtanke Våra kunder är skolor, och våra användare är barn, elever och lärare. Därför bygger vi AI-stöd som hjälper människor, inte ersätter dem, och vi hanterar data tryggt och ansvarsfullt. Du kommer arbeta tillsammans och ha stöd av vår AI channel transformation och kunniga kollegor. Bli en del av Unikum! Vi är 60 engagerade medarbetare i Sverige och Tyskland som tillsammans förbättrar lärandet för över 1 miljon användare – från förskola till vuxenutbildningen. Vi är på en spännande tillväxtresa och har nyligen välkomnat StudyBee och Tempus till vår företagsgrupp. Tillsammans stärker vi vår position på marknaden för att ge skolor ännu smartare och enklare verktyg för att se, förstå och förbättra lärandet. Våra digitala verktyg ger stöd i skolans viktigaste processer – från planering och bedömning till dialog och uppföljning, och skapar en trygg röd tråd genom hela lärresan. Hos oss präglas arbetet av samarbete, nyfikenhet och lekfullt allvar. Vi tror på frihet under ansvar och på att växa tillsammans, i en miljö där det är lätt att dela med sig, utvecklas och göra skillnad för barn och unga. Vi erbjuder stort utrymme att påverka hur supporten utvecklas distansarbete två dagar i veckan konkurrenskraftig lön och attraktiva förmåner friskvårdsbidrag, massage på jobbet och frukost varje vecka kollegor som värdesätter skratt och teamwork, och tårta i tid och otid Start så snart som möjligt. Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande, så vänta inte med att söka. Ansvarig för rekryteringen är Karoline Börjel, teamledare för supporten. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Eleni Joannou, eleni.joannou@unikum.net

items.desc: Doktorarbeit: Sichere KI für maritime Antriebe / Safe Artificial Intelligence for Maritime Engines Doktorarbeit: Sichere KI für maritime Antriebe / Safe Artificial Intelligence for Maritime Engines Job-ID: 13257 Standort: Augsburg, DE, 86153 Land: DE Das sollten Sie über uns wissen Everllence ebnet den Weg in eine klimaneutrale Weltwirtschaft. Ob Industrieproduktion, Energie- oder maritime Wirtschaft: Wir denken ganzheitlich und packen schon heute die Herausforderungen von morgen an – für eine nachhaltige Wertschöpfung unserer Kunden. In unserem Technologieportfolio steckt die Erfahrung aus über 250 Jahren Ingenieurstradition. Everllence hat seinen Hauptsitz in Deutschland und beschäftigt rund 15.000 Mitarbeiter an mehr als 120 Standorten weltweit. Unsere Kunden profitieren außerdem vom globalen Service-Center-Netzwerk unserer After-Sales Marke, Everllence PrimeServ. Folgende Aufgaben können wir Ihnen anbieten Die Doktorarbeit beschäftigt sich mit der Entwicklung sicherer KI-Methoden für maritime Antriebssysteme, die mit alternativen Kraftstoffen wie Methanol betrieben werden. Ziel ist es, die Betriebsflexibilität zu erhöhen und Emissionen zu reduzieren - ein wesentlicher Beitrag zur Dekarbonisierung der Schifffahrt im Einklang mit den Zielen der International Maritime Organization (IMO). Die zentralen Forschungsaspekte sind: Optimierung des Motorbetriebs durch KI: Analyse von Motorbetriebsdaten zur Anpassung von Verbrennungs- und Antriebsstrategien. Effiziente Nutzung alternativer Kraftstoffe: Dynamische Anpassung an variierende Eigenschaften von Methanol und anderen Kraftstoffen. Simulation und Bewertung von Betriebsszenarien: Einsatz von KI zur Modellierung und Analyse zahlreicher Szenarien für maximale Effizienz und Nachhaltigkeit. Sicherheitsaspekte: Gewährleistung des sicheren Betriebs innerhalb physikalischer und mechanischer Grenzen maritimer Antriebssysteme. Validierung der Methoden: Umsetzung und Tests sowohl in Simulationen als auch an realen Motoren in Zusammenarbeit mit einer Universität und einer Testeinrichtung. Mit diesen Qualifikationen helfen Sie uns weiter Sehr guter Masterabschluss (oder gleichwertig) in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder verwandten Disziplinen (typischerweise Mathematik, Physik). Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind erforderlich. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Machine Learning, sowie mindestens einer Programmiersprache, z. B. Python, MATLAB oder C/C++. Hohe Motivation und Freude an der Arbeit in einem internationalen und interdisziplinären Team. Vorkenntnisse in den folgenden Bereichen sind von Vorteil: Regelungstechnik Verbrennungskraftmaschinen Unsere Benefits Für Sie Kantine, Essenszulage, Barrierefreiheit, betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement, Betriebsarzt, Fitnessraum, Parkplatz, gute Verkehrsanbindung, Mitarbeiterrabatte, Studentennetzwerk, Frauennetzwerk Gut zu wissen Bei Fragen können Sie sich gerne per E-Mail an Ihren Recruiter, Nicola Hasl, wenden. E-Mail: nicola.hasl@everllence.com. Bitte bewerben Sie sich nur über den Button "Jetzt bewerben". Bewerbungen via Email können leider nicht berücksichtigt werden. Hier sind Sie beruflich zuhause Am Hauptsitz von Everllence in Augsburg wurde einst der Dieselmotor erfunden, mit dem Rudolf Diesel der Dampfmaschine den Kampf ansagte. Heute ist die Bewältigung der Herausforderungen in den Bereichen Marine, Energie und Industrie zu unserer Hauptaufgabe geworden – nicht nur für den Erfolg unserer Kunden, sondern auch für den Erhalt unserer Umwelt. Jeden Tag arbeiten rund 5.000 Mitarbeitende an unserem Standort in der schönen Renaissancestadt Augsburg an einer besseren Zukunft: Von kleinen Effizienzsteigerungen bei einzelnen Komponenten, wie zum Beispiel Dual-Fuel- Motoren, Abgasnachbehandlungssystemen oder Softwarelösungen bis hin zu großen Innovationen auf Systemebene. Auch Sie können uns dabei unterstützen. Bei uns sind Sie richtig, wenn Sie etwas bewegen möchten. Das ist uns wichtig Integrität und Compliance sind wesentliche Elemente unserer Unternehmenskultur. Zudem fördern wir Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über vielfältige Online-Bewerbungen. Klicken Sie einfach auf „Jetzt bewerben“ und starten mit uns durch. items.desc: We're building the technology that will change how consumers buy and sell furniture. Resale is one of the biggest shifts in consumer behaviour of our generation. Fashion has been transformed by it. Electronics too. But furniture, one of the largest, most valuable categories in every home, has been left behind. It's big, bulky, hard to photograph, hard to price, hard to trust and hard to move. Most of it still gets dumped, sold for nothing, or sent to landfill or the incinerator. That's not a furniture problem. It's a technology problem. And it's wide open. Sofalistic is a resale technology company. We started with the hardest category there is, and we're building the AI, platforms and experiences to make buying and selling pre-loved furniture online as easy as buying new. Trust, pricing, logistics, fraud prevention, payments, disputes: we've built the hard parts that others avoid. Now we're scaling fast, and building the next generation of AI-powered resale experiences. The ambition is simple: to become the technology that powers furniture resale, in the UK and beyond. The role We're looking for our first engineer: a builder with a founder's brain. Someone who will own our AI and technology from day one, and grow into leading our tech team. This isn't a job where you wait for tickets. You'll sit next to our CEO and co-founder, Marc, and help decide what we build, why, and how fast. Some days you'll ship three things before lunch. Other days you'll be the one saying "we're solving the wrong problem." Years of experience matter less to us than what you've built and how you think. How we build AI isn't a feature for us. It's how we build. Claude Code writes much of our code. We architect, direct, review, test and ship. An idea in the morning is a working prototype by the afternoon. Everything below is live, used by real people, and built this way by a tiny team: AI dispute resolution handling real buyer and seller disputes end to end Computer vision that reads contact details hidden in photos and shuts down organised fraud rings Intelligent seller automation: sold alerts, offer negotiation and listing refresh across email, SMS and push A logistics platform replacing spreadsheets and manual bookings Native iOS and Android apps Imagine what we'll build with you. What's next We're only scratching the surface of what AI can do for resale. How furniture is discovered, listed, priced, trusted and delivered is all still up for reinvention, and we intend to lead it. You'll help decide what we build next, and the experiences no one has imagined yet for this category. You might be the one if you Think like a founder. You see the business, not just the code. You spot opportunities, challenge ideas (including ours) and care whether something actually moves the needle. Build like a doer. You'd rather ship something today and improve it tomorrow than plan it for a month. Are AI-native. You're exceptional with Claude Code or similar, you direct AI with real skill, and you know when it's wrong. Are technically sharp. You're comfortable in PHP and JavaScript/TypeScript, with a solid grasp of APIs, databases, security and production systems. Take production seriously. We move real money. You test properly, ship safely and stay calm when something breaks. Can't stop thinking about it. The best ideas come in the shower, on a walk, at 10pm. You genuinely love building, and you want to build something that matters. Own it completely. No egos, no "that's not my job." Bonus if you Have started something of your own, a company, a product or a side project people actually use Have worked with Next.js, Flutter or Cloudflare Have built marketplace, payments, computer vision or fraud-prevention systems What you get £70,000 salary Share options, so you own a real piece of what you help build A genuine founding role, with real influence over product, technology and direction Top-spec kit and every AI tool you need A clear path to leading engineering as we grow The chance to define the technology for an entire category, and to look back and say "I built that" How we work We build together, not in silos. You'll be in our Bournemouth office most of the week, working alongside the founders, with one day a week from home. Flexibility grows as the team does. How to apply Skip the cover letter. Show us something you've built with AI: a repo, a live demo, a 2-minute Loom, or just a few paragraphs on what you built and how. If your best work is under NDA, tell us about it without the confidential bits. We want to know what the AI did and what you did. And tell us one thing you'd build or change at Sofalistic if you joined tomorrow. Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway. What you've built matters more than your CV. Our process: a call to get to know each other, a build session with the founders for shortlisted candidates, then an offer. Fast.

items.desc: We know that the quality of a training dataset is an important indicator of model performance, but how well does a data quality framework developed on a simple machine learning task generalize to real-world ML scenarios? In this thesis, you’ll extend and test an existing framework on diverse datasets, models and tasks, including LLMs. You’ll explore new quality dimensions and benchmark generalizability, building towards a practical tool that helps teams evaluate and improve their data in complex AI pipelines The impact of data quality on machine learning performance is well established, yet most frameworks are tested only in limited, controlled environments. Previously, we developed an automatic data quality framework ( Automatic Assessment of Dataset Quality for ML ), which showed promising results by quantifying data quality across three core dimensions: completeness, consistency and accuracy using synthetic data and a small set of machine learning models. However, real-world systems operate in far more varied and complex contexts. Today’s AI models range from classical algorithms to advanced LLMs, and datasets span structured tables, text, sensor streams, and more. Without validating how such a framework performs across these environments, its insights remain confined to the lab. The question is not just does it work, but how well does it generalize? The Assignment This thesis explores the generalizability of the developed data quality assessment framework across a wide spectrum of machine learning use cases. You will: Extend dataset coverage using both real-world and synthetic data from diverse domains (e.g., healthcare, finance, social media, e-commerce, public benchmarks). Diversify task types, including classification, regression and clustering. Broaden algorithmic scope by comparing a range of machine learning models. Evaluate the role of LLMs in assessing data quality across different data domains. Compare model responses to varying data quality degradations across model sizes and architectures. Add quality dimensions such as uniqueness, timeliness, accessibility, believability and statistical measures. Benchmark generalizability by measuring the framework’s reliability across tasks, models, and datasets. The final deliverable is an empirically validated, modular extension of the original framework – capable of guiding users towards improving their datasets for machine learning. items.desc: Join our team and build the future of space technology We´re expanding our team at Alén Space, and are looking for a DSP Engineer; with passion in what you do , talented and experienced. You will be part of a multidisciplinary team of software, FPGA, and digital signal processing engineers and will support the implementation of DSP (Digital Signal Processing) algorithms in programmable devices (FPGAs). What you will be doing? Design digital communication systems using platforms including software defined radios (SDRs) and FPGAs. Functional modeling of DSP algorithms and their implementation in RTL (Verilog/VHDL) or high-level languages (C/C++). Support the evolution of our custom space-tailored radio platforms. Main languages/technologies used: Verilog/SystemVerilog. Yosys/Xilinx Vivado. Python. C/C++. GNURadio. Examples of existing applications already developed by Alén Space: DVB-S2 transmitter in Verilog. ADS-B receiver in Verilog. AIS receiver, hybrid between FPGA (VHF channelizer) and CPU (GNURadio/C++). Proprietary M2M modem implemented in C. What Do We Need In Our Team Bachelor or Master’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering. More than 3 years of experience in developing signal processing algorithms for communication systems in Python, C/C++ or Matlab using both floating point and fixed-point design techniques. Experience in migrating modeled algorithms to implementations in FPGAs or SDR frameworks. Understanding of RF concepts such as AGC, noise figure, power amplifiers, phase noise, PLL, oscillators/mixers. Valuable knowledge: Expertise with Software-Defined Radios (SDR) frameworks such as GNU Radio. Experience with Xilinx Zynq or Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ series FPGAs, Analog Devices AD9361, and other common RF chipsets. Some experience with Python or other scripting languages. Knowledge of coding theory and techniques: LDPC, Turbo codes… Candidate qualifications and skills Work remotely a percentage of the time to be defined with the manager Flexible start/finish times; reduced intensive working hours on Fridays and in summer Monday to Friday. items.desc: Overview Susquehanna is seeking talented graduates to join their growing Dublin office in August 2027. As a trading system engineer, you'll work in a computationally intensive role that will allow you to use your strong technical skills to solve problems at the intersection of trading and technology. You will have the chance to work on challenging engineering problems across our trading teams in areas such as trading systems engineering, low-latency C++ strategy development, and high-performance C++ libraries that enable large-scale quantitative research and data processing. You’ll work on the desk side by side with senior developers who understand the nuances of building performant, reliable systems for complex trading strategies. You will begin with a comprehensive education program designed to build a broad understanding of the role trading system engineers play across our trading teams. Once you complete the program, you’ll be placed on a trading team that aligns with your interests and background. This will give you the best preparation possible for a career in trading system engineering. What We're Looking For Class of 2027: You are a master’s or bachelor’s student in their final year of study, majoring in a quantitative and/or STEM discipline such as computer science, computer engineering, mathematics or data science for example. Clear Communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with and are comfortable sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts, and listening to the views of others. Ambitious: You’re someone that enjoys setting personal goals and giving your all to achieve them. Be it in Arts, Sports, Academics, or another passion; you’re not afraid to put in the effort to reach your full potential. Technically Proficient: Strong software development skills in C++, C, or Rust, along with some Python experience. You will have exceptional quantitative, logical reasoning, and analytical skills. Problem Solver: When it comes to solving problems, you use clear and sound reasoning. You’re rational and like to use numbers and data to come up with sensible solutions. What's In It For You Education: We are renowned for our market-leading education and training programmes. You will start off in a multiweek education program designed to give you a broad understanding of the spaces where quantitative strategy developers add value. Once you complete education, you’ll be placed on a trading team that aligns with your interests and background. This will give you the best preparation possible for a career in quantitative strategy development. Collaboration : You will get to work with a wide range of people in the classroom and through your project work; people who share a passion for mathematics, problem-solving, game theory, and technology. Culture : We are not your typical trading firm - our non-hierarchical, casual, and collaborative culture allows employees of every level to thrive, and we focus on continuous development, no matter how long you’ve been in Susquehanna. Perks : We offer a highly competitive compensation package to our graduates. Located in Ireland's Financial Services Centre, in the heart of Dublin's city centre, our office features free onsite catering, a games room, and a fully equipped in-house gym. Throughout the summer, interns enjoy weekly social events. For those joining us from outside Dublin, we also provide accommodation for the duration of the internship. About Susquehanna Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. items.desc: Het handmatig verwerken van documenten is een tijdrovende en foutgevoelige klus, een uitdaging die veel organisaties hebben. Zeker binnen sectoren waar documenten essentieel zijn voor landelijke systemen kan vertraging of menselijke fout direct maatschappelijke impact hebben. Dit vraagt om een innovatieve aanpak. Bij het automatiseren en optimaliseren van deze processen speelt machine learning een cruciale rol. Jij gaat aan de slag met het ontwikkelen van een Proof of Concept die de verwerkingstijd flink verkort en het aantal fouten minimaliseert, waardoor organisaties sneller, betrouwbaarder en veerkrachtiger kunnen handelen in situaties die Nederland in beweging houden. Deze afstudeeropdracht maakt deel uit van het project ‘Critical IT Protocol NL’. Met dit project geven we Nederland een digitale boost door het bouwen van IT-oplossingen voor kritieke maatschappelijke uitdagingen. Van betaalverkeer en overheidsdiensten tot cybersecurity en crisisdetectie: samen versterken we de digitale infrastructuur van Nederland met impact die telt. Het huidige proces van documentverwerking is bij veel organisaties een tijdrovende en handmatige klus. Daarom is er behoefte aan een geavanceerde automatiseringsoplossing voor het verwerken van deze documenten om aanzienlijke besparingen in mankracht te realiseren en de efficiëntie te verbeteren. De opdracht Onderzoek hoe we documenten met behulp van machine-learning kunnen herkennen en verwerken Ontwikkel een Proof of Concept om te bewijzen dat jouw gekozen oplossingsrichting werkt Schrijf een advies hoe we de oplossing bij klanten kunnen inzetten Over Info Support Info Support is specialist in maatwerksoftware, data/AI solutions, beheer en trainingen en actief in de sectoren Finance, Industry, Agriculture, Food & Retail, Mobility & Public en Healthcare. Wij bieden solide en innovatieve oplossingen voor complexe en bedrijfkritische softwarevraagstukken. Onze hoofdkantoren zijn gevestigd in Veenendaal (NL) en Mechelen (BE). Op dit moment zijn er circa 500 medewerkers bij Info Support in dienst. De werkwijze van Info Support kenmerkt zich door een aantal kernwaarden: soliditeit, integriteit, vakmanschap en passie. Deze kernwaarden zijn verweven in ons werk en de manier waarop we met elkaar omgaan. Om te zorgen dat alle medewerkers altijd op de hoogte kunnen zijn van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen beschikt Info Support over een inhouse IT Academy waar graag wordt voldaan aan de honger naar meer of andere kennis en vaardigheden. Om deze opdracht te kunnen doen is B2-taalvaardigheid in het Nederlands vereist.

items.desc: Overview Susquehanna is seeking talented graduates to join their growing London office in August 2027. As a trading system engineer, you'll work in a computationally intensive role that will allow you to use your strong technical skills to solve problems at the intersection of trading and technology. You will have the chance to work on challenging engineering problems across our trading teams in areas such as trading systems engineering, low-latency C++ strategy development, and high-performance C++ libraries that enable large-scale quantitative research and data processing. You’ll work on the desk side by side with senior developers who understand the nuances of building performant, reliable systems for complex trading strategies. You will begin with a comprehensive education program designed to build a broad understanding of the role trading system engineers play across our trading teams. Once you complete the program, you’ll be placed on a trading team that aligns with your interests and background. This will give you the best preparation possible for a career in trading system engineering. What We're Looking For Class of 2027: You are a master’s or bachelor’s student in their final year of study, majoring in a quantitative and/or STEM discipline such as computer science, computer engineering, mathematics or data science for example. Clear Communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with and are comfortable sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts, and listening to the views of others. Ambitious: You’re someone that enjoys setting personal goals and giving your all to achieve them. Be it in Arts, Sports, Academics, or another passion; you’re not afraid to put in the effort to reach your full potential. Technically Proficient: Strong software development skills in C++, C, or Rust, along with some Python experience. You will have exceptional quantitative, logical reasoning, and analytical skills. Problem Solver: When it comes to solving problems, you use clear and sound reasoning. You’re rational and like to use numbers and data to come up with sensible solutions. What's In It For You Education: We are renowned for our market-leading education and training programmes. You will start off in a multiweek education program designed to give you a broad understanding of the spaces where quantitative strategy developers add value. Once you complete education, you’ll be placed on a trading team that aligns with your interests and background. This will give you the best preparation possible for a career in quantitative strategy development. Collaboration : You will get to work with a wide range of people in the classroom and through your project work; people who share a passion for mathematics, problem-solving, game theory, and technology. Culture : We are not your typical trading firm - our non-hierarchical, casual, and collaborative culture allows employees of every level to thrive, and we focus on continuous development, no matter how long you’ve been in Susquehanna. Perks : We offer a highly competitive compensation package to our graduates. Located in our brand new office in London’s city centre, our office features free onsite catering, a games room and dedicated education space. About Susquehanna Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. items.desc: Wer wir sind Magellan AI Systems GmbH ist ein kleines, hocheffizientes Unternehmen mit Sitz in Entlebuch, das Apotheken in Deutschland mit KI automatisiert. Wir entwickeln mehrere Produkte parallel — unseren Blütenshop (Cannabis-Gesamtlösung), eine Computer-Use-Software und unseren virtuellen Grosshandel für einen vollautomatischen, optimierten Bestellprozess in der Apotheke. Klingt erst einmal unspektakulär, bringt aber echte KI-Nutzung und signifikante Zeitersparnisse in echte Apotheken. Das begeistert uns und unsere Kunden! Entwicklung und Sysadmin laufen bei uns KI-nativ: Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex und eigene Automatisierungs-Agents erledigen den Grossteil der technischen Umsetzung. Du schreibst nicht mehr jede Zeile selbst — du spezifizierst, steuerst, beurteilst und verantwortest, was die KI baut. Du musst nicht jede API-Doku auswendig kennen, aber du brauchst ein solides mentales Modell davon, wie Systeme zusammenhängen. Besonders wichtig ist, KI als das zu erkennen, was sie ist: die Zukunft. Und dieses Thema gilt es so intensiv wie möglich und intrinsisch motiviert zu erlernen — dann passen wir zusammen! Wir bauen Magellan gerade radikal zu einem wirklich KI-first-Unternehmen um. Dafür suchen wir keine Mitläufer, sondern jemanden, der „all in on AI“ ist — und das schon heute lebt. Was du übernimmst • PROKAS Computer Use: unsere Windows-Automatisierung der Apothekenkasse (PowerShell-Engine, Screenshot → OCR → Eingabe). Du rollst neue Flows pro Apotheke aus und hältst sie stabil. • MSV3-Bestell-Tool & Kassentool: Next.js / Supabase / Vercel — Features bauen, Bugs fixen, Sicherheit härten. • Schnelle Prototypen für neue Produkt- und Paketideen. Was wirklich zählt Was du mitbringst, ist wichtiger als das, was du heute weisst. • Eigenverantwortung — du wartest nicht immer nur auf Anweisungen, du erkennst Chancen und Probleme und handelst. • „All in on AI“ — du tüftelst längst mit KI und hast in Beruf und/oder Privatleben bereits die unterschiedlichsten KI-gestützten Lösungen gebaut und eingesetzt; du willst täglich rund ums Thema KI wachsen. • IT-/Entwickler-Hintergrund — solide Programmier- und IT-Grundlagen (Ausbildung, Studium oder Praxis): APIs, Datenbanken, Git, Linux, ein Gefühl dafür, wie Systeme zusammenspielen. Ausnahme: Überzeugst du uns stattdessen mit deinen KI-(Hacking-)Skills, sind wir ganz Ohr. • Urteilsvermögen — du übernimmst KI-Ergebnisse nicht blind, sondern spezifizierst, prüfst, priorisierst und verantwortest sie. • Gewissenhaftigkeit — unsere Systeme verarbeiten echte Rezepte und Bestellungen. Dinge werden zu Ende gebracht, Fehler dokumentiert, nichts fällt durchs Raster. • Kommunikation — sehr gutes Deutsch oder Englisch, klar und direkt. (Deutsch von Vorteil, aber kein Muss.) Was wir bieten: • Vollzeit (100 %) vor Ort in Entlebuch; nach der Probezeit (3 Monate) hybrides Arbeiten nach Absprache möglich • Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins — kein Praktikum, kein Ticket-Abarbeiten. • Direkter Einblick in eine vollständig KI-native Betriebsstruktur — du lernst und gestaltest, wie hocheffiziente Automatisierung in der Praxis aussieht. • Mitarbeit an Produkten an der KI-Frontier: Apotheken-Computer-Use und der virtuelle MSV3-Grosshandel — Bereiche, in denen wir gerade aktiv neue, unschlagbare Lösungen mit Industriepartnern entwickeln. • Faire Fixvergütung — optional ergänzt um eine Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg. • Ein klarer Weg nach oben — bis zur technischen Verantwortung in einem kleinen Team mit viel Wachstumspotenzial.

items.desc: Über tomoro tomoro ist eine spezialisierte Unternehmensberatung für den Finanzsektor mit Sitz in Eschborn. Wir begleiten Banken, Versicherungen und ihre Dienstleister bei komplexen Veränderungsvorhaben im Spannungsfeld zwischen Geschäftsmodell, IT und Regulatorik — von der Strategie bis zur produktiven Umsetzung. Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen in IT-Compliance (MaRisk, BAIT, DORA), IT-Migration, Test- und Projektmanagement, Outsourcing-Steuerung sowie dem Einsatz von KI in Bankprozessen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine analytisch starke Beraterpersönlichkeit, die KI-Potenziale in Bankprozessen identifiziert, fachlich übersetzt und gemeinsam mit unseren Mandanten in tragfähige Lösungen überführt. Aufgaben Worum es bei uns wirklich geht Du identifizierst KI-Anwendungsfälle in Bankprozessen, bewertest Machbarkeit und Nutzen und überführst sie in fachliche Konzepte, die in der Linie funktionieren. Du erhebst fachliche Anforderungen, übersetzt sie in User Stories, Datenmodelle und Akzeptanzkriterien und hältst die Brücke zwischen Fachbereich, IT und Data Science. Du denkst MaRisk, BAIT, DORA und den EU AI Act von Anfang an mit: Modellgovernance, Nachvollziehbarkeit, Datenqualität und Risikobewertung gehören für Dich zur Lösungsarchitektur dazu. Du analysierst Datenbestände, prüfst Datenqualität, evaluierst Prompt-Strategien und Modellergebnisse und machst Stärken wie Schwächen für Entscheider greifbar. Du gestaltest tomoro mit: Methoden, Frameworks und KI-gestützte Tools für Compliance und Analyse. Qualifikation Was Du mitbringst Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in vergleichbarer Rolle im Finanzsektor. Praktische Erfahrung mit KI- oder Machine-Learning-Projekten: Use-Case-Bewertung, Datenanalyse, Modellevaluierung oder GenAI-/LLM-Anwendungen. Souveräner Umgang mit BA-Methoden (z. B. User Stories, Use Cases, Process Mining, BPMN) sowie agilen Frameworks wie Scrum oder SAFe. Ein Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Data Science oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation — wichtiger ist uns, was Du seitdem gelernt hast. Erste Erfahrung mit Python, SQL oder gängigen ML-/LLM-Frameworks ist ein Pluspunkt, aber kein Muss. Souveränes Auftreten in Deutsch, idealerweise auch in Englisch. Du erklärst Komplexes ohne Buzzwords und hältst auch im Vorstandsmeeting Stand. Punktuelle Reisebereitschaft: Wenn der Kunde Dich mal vor Ort braucht. Benefits Was wir bieten Anspruchsvolle Mandate bei renommierten Häusern des Finanzsektors — mit hoher fachlicher Tiefe und sichtbarem Wirkungsgrad. Die Substanz eines etablierten Beratungshauses kombiniert mit der Beweglichkeit eines fokussierten Teams: kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien, Raum für eigene Ideen. Strukturierte Entwicklungsperspektiven mit individuellen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (werden jährlich gemeinsam mit Dir festgelegt) und Mentoring durch erfahrene tomoro-Mitarbeiter. Ein modulares Vergütungsmodell mit ergänzenden Benefits bei flexibel gestalteter Arbeitszeit. Individuelle Mobilität — ein Dienstfahrrad, bei dem wir die komplette Leasingrate übernehmen, sowie je nach Senioritätslevel einen Dienstwagen on top. Flexible Homeoffice-Option: Außer bei kundenspezifischen Anlässen darfst Du ortsunabhängig arbeiten, so wie es für Dich gerade passt. Ein kollegiales Umfeld mit regelmäßigen Offsite-Events und einer Kultur, die Verlässlichkeit, Qualität und persönliche Verantwortung verbindet. Klingt nach Dir? Dann möchten wir Dich gerne kennenlernen. Bewirb Dich jetzt mit Deinem Lebenslauf, relevanten Zeugnissen sowie Angaben zu Eintrittstermin und Gehaltsvorstellung.

Gemeinsam mit externen Partnern und einem engagierten internen Team treiben wir Digitalisierung und den praktischen Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz im Unternehmen voran. Ihre Rolle: Sie unterstützen die Umsetzung von KI- und Digitalisierungsprojekten und wirken aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung moderner IT- und KI-Anwendungen mit. Gemeinsam mit dem internen KI-Team, unseren Fachbereichen und externen Dienstleistern gestalten Sie innovative Lösungen für den Arbeitsalltag und tragen dazu bei, die digitale Zukunft des DAI nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Aufgaben KI, Digitalisierung & Innovation Umsetzung von KI-Use-Cases und Digitalisierungsprojekten in Zusammenarbeit mit externen Dienstleistern Aktive Mitarbeit im internen KI-Team bei der Einführung und Ausgestaltung von KI-Anwendungen Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden beim Einsatz von KI Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung zukünftiger KI-Use-Cases IT-Projekte & Koordination Unterstützung bei der Organisation und Dokumentation von KI- und Digitalisierungsprojekten Zusammenarbeit mit externen Dienstleistern und internen Projektbeteiligten Zentrales Lizenzmanagement für IT- und KI-Anwendungen IT-Betrieb & Teamunterstützung Unterstützung des internen IT-Supports bei Störungen und operativen Aufgaben Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Infrastruktur, Microsoft 365, IT-Sicherheit und Anwendersupport Profil Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Ausgeprägtes Interesse an Künstlicher Intelligenz und deren praktischer Anwendung im Arbeitsalltag Erste Berufserfahrung in IT- oder KI-Projekten Freude daran, sich in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten Eigenständigkeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Lösungsorientierung Teamplayer – Sie bringen sich aktiv ein und tragen zu einer positiven Arbeitsatmosphäre bei. Wir bieten Aktive Mitgestaltung der digitalen Zukunft des DAI Mitarbeit an innovativen KI- und Digitalisierungsprojekten mit unmittelbarer Wirkung im Arbeitsalltag Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz, Digitalisierung und IT Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen, IT-Experten und externen Technologiepartnern Flexible Arbeitszeiten und moderne IT-Ausstattung Hohe Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege Bereit für den nächsten Karriereschritt? Als Ansprechpartnerin für Fragen steht Ihnen Frau Snowley gerne unter 0234 9706411 zur Verfügung. Promover a utilização responsável, segura e eficiente da IA no exercício da função. Contribuir para a disseminação de boas práticas de utilização de IA junto das diferentes áreas da organização. Um ambiente colaborativo assente em Honestidade, Apoio Mútuo e Agilidade. Aprendizagem contínua e apoio a certificações ao longo do teu percurso. Oportunidades de crescimento através da exposição a boas práticas de gestão da qualidade, segurança da informação, governação de AI e cibersegurança. Vida na Hexa Fazer parte da Hexa significa integrar uma comunidade de Builders. Trabalhamos com transparência, apoiamo-nos entre projetos e geografias e mantemo-nos focados em aprender, adaptar e entregar trabalho que cria impacto real. Se cumpres os critérios acima e estás preparado para uma oportunidade desafiante num ambiente dinâmico, envia-nos o teu CV!

items.desc: We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers. Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY). This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub. The AI Center of Excellence Engineer will support Lenovo’s Europe and META HPC/AI Innovation Centre located within the Ullo manufacturing facility. This role is responsible for ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of a high-performance lab environment used for customer proof-of-concepts, demonstrations, and technology validation activities. The position requires strong hands-on technical expertise combined with a professional, customer-facing approach. The successful candidate will collaborate with global teams, solution architects, data scientists, and external partners, contributing to successful customer outcomes and maintaining a world-class AI validation environment. Key Responsibilities Operate and maintain AI and HPC infrastructure within the Innovation Centre, ensuring continuous availability and performance Install, configure, and troubleshoot hardware components, including GPUs, CPUs, storage, and networking equipment Rack, cable, deploy, and document lab systems in alignment with operational standards Manage hardware inventory, coordinate repairs, and ensure timely replacement of faulty components Support customer and partner proof-of-concept activities from setup through completion Configure tailored testing environments based on specific customer requirements Administer and maintain Linux-based systems, including networking, storage, and virtualization platforms Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge-sharing materials for internal teams Position Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred Minimum 1 year of experience in IT infrastructure, system administration, or data center operations Proven hands-on expertise with server hardware, rack integration, cabling, networking, and infrastructure troubleshooting Experience supporting lab environments, testing setups, or infrastructure validation activities Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to interact with customers and partners Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with international and cross-functional teams Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) Strong items.desc: Description Du Poste 🎯 Chargé(e) de Gouvernance Data & IA (H/F) 🎯 🚀 Votre rôle Au sein du Département Technologies, le Data Management Office (DMO) pilote la gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Il accompagne les métiers sur la valorisation, la qualité, la maîtrise et la conformité des données, ainsi que sur les usages de l'Intelligence Artificielle. Vous rejoignez une équipe de 9 personnes, dont trois collaborateurs dédiés à la gouvernance Data & IA. Aux côtés des deux collaborateurs déjà en poste, vous faites de la Data et de l'IA des leviers responsables, maîtrisés et créateurs de valeur. Votre rôle ne se limite pas à appliquer un cadre. Vous le faites vivre, vous le challengez et vous le faites progresser. Vous intervenez au croisement des métiers, de la technologie, de la réglementation et de la maîtrise des risques, dans un environnement bancaire où la confiance dans la donnée est un enjeu stratégique. 🧩 Vos missions Vos missions s'organisent autour de quatre axes. 1- Piloter les usages Data & IA Vous pilotez et suivez le développement des usages Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous accompagnez le déploiement de l'Offre de Service Data et diffusez les bonnes pratiques associées auprès des métiers. Vous analysez et challengez les dispositifs existants, identifiez les axes d'amélioration et contribuez à leur mise en œuvre. 2- Garantir la gouvernance, la conformité et la maîtrise des risques Vous contribuez aux travaux de gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous participez aux démarches de conformité et de maîtrise des risques, notamment BCBS 239 et le cadre normatif IA. Vous préparez et contribuez aux instances de gouvernance : Comité Data & IA, Comité de Qualité des Données, Comité d'Homologation IA. Vous assurez une veille sur les évolutions Data, IA, technologiques et réglementaires, et contribuez à leur prise en compte en interne. 3- Améliorer la connaissance et la qualité des données Vous accompagnez les métiers dans la connaissance et la documentation de leurs données. Vous les aidez à identifier les écarts de qualité et à mettre en place des actions d'amélioration concrètes. Vous transformez des problématiques complexes en recommandations claires et opérationnelles. 4- Diffuser une culture Data & IA Vous animez les communautés Data & IA et coordonnez les différents acteurs de la gouvernance des données. Vous concevez et déployez des actions de sensibilisation et d'acculturation à la Data et à l'IA. Vous animez des ateliers et vous faites le lien entre les experts et les métiers. 🧩 Environnement Une équipe DMO de 9 personnes, rattachée au Département Technologies. Un pôle gouvernance Data & IA de trois collaborateurs, dont vous. Des interlocuteurs variés : métiers, équipes techniques, risques, conformité et instances de gouvernance. ⚒ Environnement réglementaire et outils Réglementation : BCBS 239, cadre normatif IA Gouvernance : qualité des données, documentation, homologation des usages IA Outils appréciés : Python, SQL ou tout autre langage d'analyse de données Profil recherché 🧬 Profil recherché 🎓 Formation supérieure en data, gestion des risques, audit, finance, ingénierie ou équivalent. 💼 Expérience réussie en audit, contrôle interne, gestion des risques ou conformité, idéalement en environnement bancaire ou financier. Nous recherchons avant tout un profil hybride. Vous savez prendre de la hauteur sans perdre le fil opérationnel. Vous aimez les sujets complexes, vous savez challenger l'existant et vous formulez des recommandations qui se mettent en œuvre. La Data et l'IA vous passionnent, et vous voulez mettre cette curiosité au service d'usages utiles et maîtrisés. 🤝 Savoir-être et compétences clés Gestion de projet et coordination transverse. Capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et de challenge. Connaissance ou forte appétence pour la gouvernance, la qualité et la valorisation des données. Intérêt marqué pour l'IA et ses enjeux de gouvernance, de maîtrise et de conformité. Aisance pour animer des ateliers, des communautés et des instances de gouvernance. Excellentes qualités relationnelles, rédactionnelles et pédagogiques. Curiosité, pragmatisme et sens du collectif. Ce poste ne sera malheureusement pas pour vous cette fois-ci si : vous n'avez aucune expérience en audit, contrôle, gestion des risques, conformité ou gouvernance des données ; Vous ne connaissez pas les principes BCBS239 vous recherchez un poste purement technique de développement ou de data engineering ; vous n'êtes pas à l'aise pour animer des communautés, présenter en comité et embarquer des interlocuteurs variés ; la Data et l'IA ne suscitent pas chez vous une vraie curiosité. 🎯 Ce qui fera la différence Votre capacité à relier les enjeux métiers, technologiques, réglementaires et de maîtrise des risques. Votre goût du challenge constructif, qui fait avancer les dispositifs sans bloquer les projets. Votre pédagogie pour rendre la Data et l'IA accessibles à tous. Une pratique de Python, SQL ou d'un outil …

items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - UK/EU
items.card: you will be on the front lines of technical delivery—partnering directly with customers to tailor Strider’s platform to their specific mission needs. Your role will span engineering execution and mission integration, requiring technical depth, situational awareness, and operational agility. You Will Architect, develop, and deploy mission-aligned software solutions in government and commercial environments.
items.desc: Strider Technologies delivers strategic intelligence that helps organizations make faster, more confident decisions in an increasingly complex global environment. Using cutting-edge AI and proprietary methodologies, we transform open-source data into actionable insights that help protect technology, talent, and supply chains from nation-state risks. Strider is seeking a mission-driven Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to deliver cutting-edge technical solutions in dynamic, high-stakes environments. As a key member of our deployment team, you’ll bridge the gap between our advanced platform and real-world mission requirements—embedding with customers, engineering bespoke solutions, and serving as a trusted technical partner. This is a unique opportunity to directly impact national security and commercial innovation while helping shape Strider’s future product development. If you thrive on building in the field, solving critical problems, and working side-by-side with analysts and operators, we want to hear from you. Key Qualifications 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a focus on full-stack or systems-level development. Proficiency in Python, Java, or similar languages. Experience with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), APIs, and modern front-end frameworks. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to rapidly prototype, iterate, and deploy in fast-paced environments. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous or evolving mission contexts. Willingness to travel 30–70% of the time based on mission requirements. Active U.K. security clearance (SC/DV) or eligibility to obtain one strongly preferred. Description As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be on the front lines of technical delivery—partnering directly with customers to tailor Strider’s platform to their specific mission needs. Your role will span engineering execution and mission integration, requiring technical depth, situational awareness, and operational agility. You Will Architect, develop, and deploy mission-aligned software solutions in government and commercial environments. Collaborate with operators, analysts, and executives to translate evolving requirements into actionable technical outcomes. Integrate Strider’s platform with diverse data sources, internal workflows, and external IT systems. Build custom applications, features, and data pipelines that unlock insights from unstructured, multi-lingual datasets. Serve as Strider’s technical lead in the field, owning project outcomes from inception to implementation. Prototype quickly and iterate continuously, adapting to high-priority demands and real-time feedback. Provide critical field insights to inform and influence Strider’s internal product roadmap. Why Join Strider? Be a key contributor to a high-impact mission that directly supports innovation and national resilience. Join a collaborative, fast-paced team that values creativity, autonomy, and trust. Work across domains—engineering, intelligence, product—on some of today’s most complex challenges. Develop leadership skills at the intersection of technology and mission. Benefits Competitive Compensation Flexible PTO in addition to statutory annual leave Two paid company breaks Wellness Reimbursement UK Statutory Holidays (Office Closed) Paid Parental Leave Pension Scheme with employer contributions Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Strider is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate against employees or applicants based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We comply with all relevant employment laws in the locations where we operate. This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, and professional development.

items.desc: ABOUT BUILD AI for the Built World: Build helps the world's largest real estate and infrastructure institutions find, test and plan sites a magnitude faster than the market. Clients get site sourcing, due diligence, feasibility and test fits delivered in days rather than months, by a team of experts working alongside AI. It covers the projects that matter most: digital infrastructure, energy and industrial, from concept to completion. Our mission is to accelerate and amplify the world's most important built projects - inventing a better way to build through a collaboration between human experts and AI. We envision a future where the world's buildings are driven from concept to completion. Without delays, cost or complexity. Enabling people to deliver a magnitude more deals. To make decisions, build relationships and create. We're partnering with the world's biggest built world institutions, from $T alternative asset investors to prolific developers and even governments, to push the frontier of what's possible. We're backed by c-suite from Blackstone and OpenAI alongside the world's best venture capital firms. Join us in shaping the future of the Built World and exponentially accelerate your career in the process. We welcome you to do your life's work here. ABOUT THE ROLE The Computational Design Engineer owns how Build looks, feels and works, and ships it in production code. This is a design role and an engineering role in equal measure. You'll design the product and the 3D and site design tools behind it, then build them yourself: production React and TypeScript on the front end, and Rhino, Grasshopper and Python for the geometry underneath. Our clients make big decisions about land, power and buildings. What they see from us has to be clear enough to act on and good enough to defend in an investment committee. You'll design and build the product they use every day, the tools that lay out a site in minutes and the deliverables that land on their desk. There's no handoff. You sketch it, model it, build it, ship it and watch how clients use it. You'll be the design lead on a small team that ships fast, working directly with James SE and alongside our engineers and domain experts. WHAT YOU WILL OWN Spatial and 3D design tools: the parametric logic, site layouts, 3D views and CAD outputs behind the test fits clients use to decide what a site can hold Product design end to end: user flows, interfaces and the details inside them, from first concept to shipped feature The front end: building what you design in React and TypeScript, reviewed and shipped to the same standard as our engineers The design system: one set of components, type, motion and rules that keeps every surface consistent and lets the whole team ship good work without you in the room Making complex work clear: turning maps, site data and multi-step workflows into screens and reports a client can read in a minute and trust Everything around the product: flagship demos, the website and the deliverables clients actually receive Time with clients: seeing how decisions get made and approved on real projects, and feeding that straight back into what we build EXAMPLE PROJECTS Taking a site layout tool from a working prototype to something a client runs on their own, from the rules that place each block to the screen they adjust it on Building a single design package and moving the product onto it Redesigning the map so every type of site data reads at a glance Turning a complex workflow into an interface a client can follow and defend internally Redesigning the decks and drawings we deliver so they read like they came from the best firm in the market WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR A designer who engineers. You've trained in architecture, product or computational design, and somewhere along the way you started writing production code yourself. You see systems, not one-off screens, and you'd rather make a tool that produces a hundred good answers than draw one by hand. You have real taste and you're unreasonable about quality, but you ship. YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF You work in 3D and geometry: Rhino and Grasshopper, Python or C#, Three.js or similar, and you've built tools, not just used them You've shipped production front end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) as well as designing it You have a few years at a leading architecture, design or engineering practice, or at a product company building design or spatial tools, or your own practice with this at its core You've made complex tools simple enough for people who aren't technical to use Your portfolio shows both the thinking and the working thing that shipped You hold your own with engineers and want to be held to an engineering standard You care about AI, software and how the physical world gets built THIS PROBABLY ISN'T YOU IF You can design but not build, or build but have no taste You need tightly scoped specs before you can start You see polish as optional or the small details as someone else's job BONUS POINTS …

Ses activités diversifiées (nutrition des sols, des plantes, des animaux, agroalimentaire), centrées sur les besoins humains, montrent l’ouverture d’esprit d’un Groupe connecté aux enjeux d’avenir. Avec 109 unités industrielles, partout dans le monde, c’est un Groupe, toujours en mouvement, qui fait de l’innovation et de l’amélioration continue un défi quotidien et qui donne à ses cinq activités ; TIMAC AGRO, Phosphea, la Magnésie, Paticeo et la Plasturgie ; toute l’autonomie et la liberté de tester et d’avancer. Le Centre Mondial d'Innovation, véritable activateur de croissance du Groupe Roullier, regroupe, à Saint-Malo et Dinard, ses pôles de R&D en nutrition végétale, en nutrition animale et innovation industrielle. Le support au développement international et l’Innovation sont les objectifs affichés de ce Centre où toutes les nationalités se côtoient pour participer à l’agriculture de demain. Faire mieux, faire différemment, explorer les possibles, c’est la façon d’agir du Groupe Roullier. Description du poste : Le pôle Nutrition végétale joue un rôle central dans la mise en œuvre des projets de recherche et développement au sein du Centre Mondial de l’Innovation Roullier, en étudiant et en proposant des solutions innovantes pour la nutrition des plantes, la santé des sols et l’amélioration de la résistance des cultures face aux stress. Au sein de ce département, l’Unité Soil and Plant Care contribue à la conception de solutions visant à améliorer la qualité des sols et à aider les plantes à mieux résister aux bioagresseurs (agents pathogènes et ravageurs). Afin de renforcer notre expertise, nous recrutons un(e) Ingénieur(e) de Recherche en Science du Végétale / Stress Biotiques des Plantes , en CDI à Saint-Malo. À propos du poste : Rattaché(e) au chef de projet Gestion des stress biotiques, vous participerez à des projets de recherche visant à mieux comprendre les relations entre les plantes et leurs bioagresseurs, et sur les mécanismes permettant d’améliorer la tolérance des plantes aux stress biotiques. À ce titre, vous devrez démontrer de solides connaissances en interactions plante-bioagresseurs (agents pathogènes et/ou ravageurs), microbiologie et/ou entomologie, ainsi qu’en physiologie végétale. Missions : Identifier, développer et mettre en œuvre des méthodes permettant de sélectionner, d’évaluer et d’étudier l’efficacité des produits développés. Étudier les mécanismes impliqués dans la tolérance des plantes aux stress biotiques ainsi que dans la virulence et/ou la fitness des bioagresseurs. Planifier et conduire des essais, analyser les données obtenues et assurer la synthèse et l’interprétation des résultats. Participer à la production des livrables associés aux projets : rapports, documents de synthèse, etc. Participer à la valorisation scientifique des projets : posters, communications, publications scientifiques, brevets.
