items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As Signal Processing Engineer within RF Processing & Analytics, you own the algorithms that turn raw electromagnetic intercepts into an actionable picture of the RF environment — detecting, characterizing, and identifying the emitters around our platforms in contested environments. You work across the signals captured by our Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare modules, building the classification and analytics layer that turns isolated detections into a real-time electronic order of battle for operators and downstream autonomy. Responsibilities Signal Detection & Characterization: Build algorithms to detect, deinterleave, and extract parameters (PRI, pulse width, frequency, modulation) from intercepted RF emissions. Emitter Classification & Identification: Develop classification pipelines — combining feature-based methods and machine learning — to identify emitter types and match them against threat libraries. Electronic Order of Battle: Design the analytics that turn individual detections into a coherent, real-time picture of emitters, tracks, and threat posture. AI-Assisted Analytics: Apply machine learning to modulation recognition, anomaly detection, and emitter fingerprinting where it improves classification confidence in dense, contested spectrum. Cross-Module Data Fusion: Work with signals captured by Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare to build a unified processing pipeline rather than siloed, single-sensor analysis. Real-Time Pipeline Engineering: Take algorithms from offline prototyping (MATLAB/Python) to real-time or near-real-time implementation, alongside software and embedded/FPGA engineers. Field Validation: Validate detection and classification performance against simulated and real-world RF datasets, in lab and field-test conditions. Candidate Requirements Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. 3-6 years of experience in RF/radar signal processing, ideally with exposure to ELINT, ESM, or SIGINT applications. Strong fundamentals in DSP: spectral analysis, filtering, multi-rate processing, statistical/adaptive signal processing. Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for algorithm prototyping; working knowledge of C/C++ for production-oriented implementation. Comfortable applying machine learning to signal classification problems. Clear communicator, able to work across RF hardware, software, and data science disciplines. Fluency in English required; French is a plus. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.desc: Är du en student som är ivrig att tillämpa dina teoretiska kunskaper och nya perspektiv på verkliga utmaningar? På Saab tror vi att innovationer växer på nya idéer, och ditt examensarbete kan vara gnistan som tänder vårt nästa tekniska genombrott. Din roll Vi ser det enorma värdet som studenter tillför vårt företag. Din akademiska precision, i kombination med din entusiasm för avancerad teknik, gör att du kan närma dig problem med en unik och insiktsfull lins. På Saab får du möjlighet att samarbeta med erfarna ingenjörer och specialister, få ovärderlig praktisk erfarenhet och samtidigt bidra till vår tillväxt och utveckling. Bakgrund Verifiering av digitala styrsystem i moderna flygplan bygger till stor del på omfattande simuleringar där flygegenskaper och systembeteenden utvärderas under olika förhållanden. För stridsflygplan ställs dessutom höga krav på att styrsystemet ska vara "care-free", vilket innebär att piloten ska kunna genomföra relevanta manövrar utan att riskera att hamna i ett farligt tillstånd. För att verifiera dessa egenskaper används idag ett stort antal fördefinierade manövrar som syftar till att utmana styrsystemet under olika förhållanden. Trots detta kan det fortfarande finnas kombinationer av manövrar, flygtillstånd och lastkonfigurationer som leder till mer kritiska utfall. Utmaningen blir särskilt relevant för framtida stridsflygsystem där nya koncept och användningsfall kan innebära helt andra dimensionerande manövrar än idag. Verifieringsutmaningen kan därför formuleras som ett sökproblem där målet är att identifiera dessa worst-case-fall. I dagsläget är verifierings- och klareringsprocessen både tidskrävande och resursintensiv, eftersom ett mycket stort antal scenarier behöver analyseras och utvärderas. Att identifiera kritiska testfall på ett mer automatiserat sätt är därför en viktig utmaning inom flygindustrin. En sådan förmåga har potential att både effektivisera verifieringsarbetet och öka testtäckningen för framtida flygsystem. Inom flygteknisk forskning har arbetet mot en automatiserad klarering främst innefattat metoder såsom Monte Carlo-simuleringar och metaheuristiska optimeringsalgoritmer. Dessa metoder optimerar dock vanligtvis mot en enskild lösning och har sämre prestanda när problemet omfattas av ett stort antal komplexa bivillkor. Reinforcement Learning (RL) har däremot visat stor potential som metod för att effektivt utforska omfattande parameterrymder och identifiera worst-case-scenarier samtidigt som givna bivillkor beaktas. Beskrivning av examensarbetet Examensarbetet syftar till att undersöka hur RL-baserade metoder kan användas för att identifiera worst-case manövrar givet en mängd olika flygtillstånd, lastkonfigurationer och andra variabler. Målet är att utveckla och utvärdera ett ramverk som kan bidra till en mer effektiv och systematisk klareringsprocess. Arbetet ger möjlighet att kombinera artificiell intelligens, optimering och simulering för att lösa ett verkligt problem inom utvecklingen av framtida flygsystem. En viktig del av arbetet kommer även att vara att analysera och visualisera den stora mängden utforskade testfallsparametrar. Detta är tänkt att användas som ett beslutsstödsunderlag som gör det möjligt att identifiera trender, avvikelser och potentiella problemområden. Arbetet kan innefatta: Litteraturstudie på tidigare forskning inom området. Formulering av lämpliga ”reward functions” utifrån systemets krav och begränsningar. Design och implementering av RL-ramverkets arkitektur och flöde. Presentation av data och worst-case fall. Jämförelse mot nuvarande metodik. Examensarbetet genomförs inom sektionen Verifiering och Validering för styrsystem på Saab Aeronautics, som arbetar med verifiering av styrsystem för både nuvarande och framtida stridsflyg. Studenten kommer att arbeta i nära samarbete med ingenjörer med specialistkompetens inom bland annat styrsystem, simulering och verifiering, och får stöd av erfarna handledare under arbetets gång. Projektet adresserar ett verkligt verksamhetsbehov och har potential att effektivisera den tidskrävande verifieringsprocessen, vilket kan bidra till snabbare utveckling av framtida stridsflygsystem. Din profil Arbetet är lämpligt för 1–2 studenter med intresse för maskininlärning, optimering och programmering. Intresse för flyg är också meriterande. Du/ni är i slutet av er civilingenjörsutbildning inom teknisk fysik, datateknik eller motsvarande utbildning och ska påbörja ert examensarbete om 30 hp. Du ska ha god analytisk förmåga och fallenhet för att tänka utanför boxen. Utbildning/erfarenhet inom följande är meriterande för detta examensarbete: Maskininlärning, specifikt Reinforcement Learning. Goda kunskaper inom exempelvis Python, Git och Matlab. Vi ger dig det stöd och den vägledning du behöver för att omsätta dina teoretiska kunskaper i praktiska lösningar. Bli en drivande kraft bakom Saabs tekniska framsteg! Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande …

items.desc: WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON​ Gameloft Barcelona is seeking a Data Scientist to join Gameloft Global Data team. As a Data Scientist, you will be able to deep dive into our massive streams of player data in-game, prototype and deploy machine learning models to increase game revenue. You will help move projects from exploratory analysis to deployed models across live titles, including life-simulation and racing games. What it means on a daily basis​ Analyse large-scale player data with Python and SQL, transforming it into clear, actionable insights. Perform feature engineering on large-scale data from the data warehouse, managing your code with Git. Prototype and improve machine learning models and prediction pipelines, using experimental design, causal inference, and A/B testing to raise performance baselines. Present findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders across the game teams. What success will look like​ In your first months, you will ramp up on our data infrastructure and deliver your first exploratory analyses.By the middle of your onboarding, you will be responsible for features or models end-to-end, framing problems clearly and presenting them to non-technical stakeholders. By the end of your onboarding, you will be conducting experiments and delivering improvements on your own, with your insights adopted across the game teams. Who you will be working with As a Data Scientist in our Global Data Science and Analytics team, you will be reporting to our Lead Data Scientist and collaborate very closely with other Data teams (Data Analyst, Data Engineering) and with our local Game teams. Our teams operate across multiple studios worldwide, including Paris, Barcelona, Montreal, Sofia, Bucharest, and others, offering opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Your recruitment journey​ First interview: An initial discussion to explore how the role aligns with your background and to address your main questions.​ Test: You will be given a case study to complete.​ Second interview: A technical interview focused on presenting your test and discussing your approach, reasoning, and methodologies in more depth.​ Final interview: A conversation to discuss your experience, vision, and how you approach data topics at a broader level.​ ​Where this role can take you​ This role can be a stepping stone toward a more senior position, with the possibility of leading increasingly large and complex projects, so that your work shapes game performance and business results more widely over time. WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED​ Proficient in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, seaborn) and in SQL for large-scale data analysis. Skilled in machine learning workflows, including experimental design, causal inference, and A/B testing. Experienced with Git and comfortable working with large-scale data in a data warehouse environment. Master's degree in a quantitative field (computer science, applied mathematics, data science, or related). WHO YOU ARE​ Able to communicate and present to non-technical stakeholders in English, translating analytical work into clear, actionable recommendations. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU​ Permanent contract, full-time employment with comprehensive Social Benefits. 25 vacation days per year + Birthday day off. Private medical health insurance. Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card. Free language courses. Work-from-home hybrid model. Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package. Life at Gameloft Our Barcelona studio offers real career development opportunities and a positive working environment in a centrally located office. We value supportive working conditions and a balanced work-life approach, and our teams work together with a collaborative mindset. Ready to level up your career? Apply now with your CV in English.

You care about making a model behave like a cautious technical analyst, not a confident guesser. You are comfortable with Python, LLM orchestration, structured JSON/JSONL data, and fuzzy retrieval.
items.desc: All roles Open role AI / Document Intelligence Engineer Remote Full-time You will build and harden the multi-pass pipeline at the core of Sparengine: page-level vision extraction, document typing, entity and event extraction, and the knowledge graph that serves as the system's truth memory. You care about making a model behave like a cautious technical analyst, not a confident guesser. You are comfortable with Python, LLM orchestration, structured JSON/JSONL data, and fuzzy retrieval. Bonus: prior exposure to OCR pipelines or graph data structures. Full-time, Remote, AI / Document Intelligence Engineer Company Overview Sparengine is an AI-powered aviation technical records reconstruction and audit platform. We process raw maintenance documentation (logbooks, work orders, AD compliance records, CAMP exports) through a multi-pass pipeline that produces structured asset snapshots, component history reports, and pre-purchase inspection deliverables. We operate an international hybrid model with European direction and a high-performance technical team. We prioritize rigor and clarity in a domain where being confidently wrong is the worst possible failure. The Role: Scope & Execution This is the engineering core of the product. You will build and harden the multi-pass pipeline that turns thousands of unstructured pages into a verifiable knowledge graph. Build the pipeline: page-level vision extraction, document typing and segmentation, entity and event extraction, and graph construction Own the knowledge graph: the system's truth memory, where every claim is attached to evidence with confidence and provenance Make the model cautious: enforce the distinction between a task listed on a card and a task actually signed off, so the system behaves like a careful analyst rather than a confident guesser Improve retrieval: fuzzy part number and serial number matching, proximity search, and cross-document linking across large dossiers Technical Requirements Python and solid LLM orchestration experience Structured data: comfortable with JSON and JSONL at scale, streamable and queryable Retrieval: practical understanding of fuzzy matching and context-aware relevance A natural instinct for clean code and for catching silent failures before they reach a deliverable Professional Qualifications Proven execution: you have built and shipped real data or AI pipelines beyond tutorials Technical maturity: you simplify complex requirements and keep the system reliable Bonus: prior exposure to OCR pipelines, vision models, or graph data structures Evidence of work: a portfolio or GitHub showing end-to-end systems you have built Practical Details Location: Remote Type: Full-time Compensation: Based on profile Why Sparengine You will work at the point where messy reality meets structured truth. The product only works if the engineering is honest about what it does not know, so the work rewards people who care about precision, provenance, and shipping systems that experts can trust. You will see your code directly change how high-value aviation assets are bought, sold, and audited. About Sparengine Every aircraft has a hidden story. We make it legible. Sparengine is aircraft intelligence. Decades of scattered records, scans, inspection photos and systems become one connected view of an aircraft: its condition, its history, what the evidence supports and what is missing. Lessors, MROs and traders use it to decide what an aircraft is really worth. A small team in Toulouse and remote. Real problems, real customers, and ownership from day one. Apply for this role Apply for this role 1. Your CV and a short conversation 2. A reply within 2 business days 3. A recorded video, about 14 min 4. Meet the team One application covers every role you are interested in.

The IrrEO project is funded by a four-year (2025-2029) investment from the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Due to the nature of the funding,
items.desc: Job reference: SAE-032577 Salary: £37,694 to £42,254 per annum depending on relevant experience Faculty/Organisational Unit: Science and Engineering Location: Oxford Road Employment type: Fixed Term Division/Team: Department of Civil Engineering and Management Hours Per Week: 35 Closing date (DD/MM/YYYY): 08/11/2026 Contract Duration: 24 months School/Directorate: School of Engineering We are seeking to appoint a talented and enthusiastic Postdoctoral Research Associate (PDRA) to play a key role in delivering an exciting investment project (IrrEO) that will develop satellite-based irrigation mapping tools for governments and development actors in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). Earth Observation (EO) technologies are enabling agricultural mapping at increasingly large scales and fine resolutions. This brings exciting opportunities to understand complex farming systems, particularly in data-sparse smallholder farming regions. However, recent research has revealed the social risks of EO-based land monitoring. Examples include imperfect representations leading to poorly informed decision-making or biased investments, and marginalised people being made visible through EO in ways which may expose them to harm. There is an urgent need for improved social risk analysis and development of good practice guidance for EO-based agricultural mapping. As part of the IrrEO project, the PDRA will lead on developing guidance for the socially responsible development and use of EO-based agricultural mapping tools in small-scale farming systems in Sub-Saharan Africa. They will catalogue existing scholarship and frameworks on the ethical and equitable use of EO in agricultural mapping. They will also carry out document-based and qualitative interview research to identify potential risks of EO-based agricultural mapping in different socio-political and agricultural contexts, focusing particularly on risks to farmers and farming communities. Based on these two workstreams and consultation with the IrrEO partners, they will devise and share strategies for socially response EO-based agricultural monitoring. The PDRA will be an integral member of the IrrEO project team, working closely with Principal Investigator Prof. Tim Foster (Department of Civil Engineering and Management) and Co-Investigators Dr. Rose Pritchard (Global Development Institute). They will also work closely with a wider team of investigators and postdoctoral researchers at the University of Manchester involved in the IrrEO project and other aligned research on socially-just use of Earth Observation including the Just Earth Observation for Conservation project (JEOC – https://www.justearthobservation.org/) which is co-led by Pritchard and Foster. The role will involve close collaboration with academic and non-academic partners in the project’s case study countries (Kenya, Nigeria, and Ethiopia) and active engagement with UK and international partners including the World Bank and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. The IrrEO project is funded by a four-year (2025-2029) investment from the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Due to the nature of the funding, this post is available for a fixed term of up to 24 months with an end date of 31 August 2029. We are looking for a candidate to start in early 2027, with some flexibility over the exact start date. Enquiries About The Role, Shortlisting And Interviews Name: Prof Tim Foster, Professor of Land and Water Informatics and Director of Manchester Environmental Research Institute (MERI) Email General enquiries and administrative support

items.card: About The Role Callosum believes that orders of magnitude improvements in AI systems will come through application-aware orchestration across heterogeneous hardware. As workloads become increasingly disaggregated, the performance of the system is determined not only by where computation happens, but by how efficiently state and data can move between the hardware best suited to each part of the workload.
items.desc: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence. We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. About The Role Callosum believes that orders of magnitude improvements in AI systems will come through application-aware orchestration across heterogeneous hardware. As workloads become increasingly disaggregated, the performance of the system is determined not only by where computation happens, but by how efficiently state and data can move between the hardware best suited to each part of the workload. Communication latency sets the boundary on how far that disaggregation can go. This role owns that boundary. You will develop the communication systems that allow heterogeneous accelerators to operate as parts of one system, working across protocols, memory movement, networking hardware, and the software layers above them. That means understanding where overhead actually comes from, removing assumptions inherited from more general-purpose workloads, and finding new ways to move data directly and efficiently across vendor boundaries. The remit is intentionally broad: from RDMA paths and programmable NICs to cache transfer formats and emerging interconnect technologies, you will own the technical strategy for making communication less of a constraint on the systems we can build. What You'll Build Characterise and simplify communication paths between accelerators, tracing latency and unnecessary overhead across networking, runtime, memory, and device layers Develop faster data movement across heterogeneous hardware, exploring RDMA, programmable NICs, DPUs, switches, and software approaches to cross-device memory management Build flexible mechanisms for transferring model state across accelerator types and execution strategies, including KV cache connectors across different forms of parallelism Evaluate existing and emerging scale-up and scale-out fabrics, informing cluster architecture, infrastructure integration, and how heterogeneous accelerator communication should evolve What Sets You Apart Deep understanding of networking and communication systems, with the ability to reason across protocols, hardware, memory systems, and software layers Experience with high-performance data movement such as RDMA, Ethernet fabrics, accelerator interconnects, programmable networking, or similar latency-sensitive systems Strong systems performance instincts, with the ability to trace bottlenecks across abstraction layers and distinguish fundamental constraints from accidental ones A demonstrable tendency to question existing abstractions, generalise across unfamiliar technologies, and simplify systems around the requirements of the workload What We Offer Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience Equity & Ownership Private …

items.desc: Arbeit anders leben Die Stelle ist ab sofort in Teil- und Vollzeit (mind. 30h/Woche) zu besetzen. Du visualisierst und präsentierst Erkenntnisse und leitest daraus fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Du hast ein Studium in Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik, Data Science oder einer vergleichbaren quantitativen oder technischen Fachrichtung abgeschlossen. Du bringst Berufserfahrung als Data Scientist im HR-Umfeld und im Umgang mit Mitarbeitenden- und Recruitingdaten mit. items.desc: Steeds meer ontwikkelaars gebruiken Large Language Models (LLM’s) tijdens het programmeren. In deze opdracht onderzoek je hoe meerdere lokale open source LLM’s objectief met elkaar kunnen worden vergeleken, zodat ontwikkelaars voor elke stageopdracht het meest geschikte model kunnen kiezen. Ontwikkelaars gebruiken steeds vaker LLM’s om code te schrijven, fouten te analyseren of technische vragen te beantwoorden. Vaak gebeurt dit via cloudoplossingen, maar dat is niet altijd wenselijk. Broncode, klantinformatie of interne documentatie mag niet zomaar naar externe diensten gestuurd worden. Open source LLM’s die lokaal draaien, bieden hiervoor een alternatief. Toch is het moeilijk om te bepalen welk model het beste resultaat geeft voor een specifieke opdracht. Elk model heeft andere sterktes, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van codegeneratie, uitleg of redeneervermogen. Er is daarom behoefte aan een lokaal systeem dat één opdracht aan meerdere open source LLM’s kan voorleggen, de antwoorden vergelijkt en het beste resultaat helpt kiezen. De opdracht Onderzoek hoe een lokaal systeem ontwikkelaars kan ondersteunen bij het vergelijken van meerdere open source LLM-agents. Bouw een Proof of Concept waarin een ontwikkelaar één opdracht invoert, waarna het systeem deze opdracht lokaal doorstuurt naar verschillende modellen. Vergelijk de antwoorden op criteria zoals correctheid, volledigheid, snelheid, uitlegbaarheid en bruikbaarheid. Onderzoek ook de beperkingen van lokale modellen, zoals hardwarevereisten, responstijd en modelgrootte. Het resultaat is een werkende Proof of Concept met een onderbouwde vergelijking van meerdere open source LLM’s. items.desc: Automated code review tools like GitHub Copilot are on the rise, but how do their reviews compare to those written by human developers? This thesis explores the quality, depth, and relevance of AI-generated reviews to understand whether these tools truly support or replace peer review. Expect to dive into real-world code review data, assess review performance and uncover when AI adds value, or falls short, in development workflows. Code reviews are a key practice in modern software engineering, improving code quality, maintainability and knowledge sharing within development teams. Traditionally, these reviews are conducted manually by peers. However, with the rise of AI tools like GitHub Copilot, developers can now request automated pull request reviews. While these AI-generated reviews promise greater efficiency, there is little empirical evidence on how their quality compares to that of human reviewers. The Assignment In this thesis, you will investigate the quality of AI-generated code reviews. Your focus will be on identifying differences in quality, depth and relevance compared to reviews written by humans. By analyzing these aspects, you will assess whether and how AI can support or complement human reviewers. Your findings will highlight current limitations and provide insights into how development teams can best utilize AI-based review tools in practice. Il ruolo prevede l'analisi delle esigenze di modellazione e simulazione, la loro traduzione in requisiti funzionali e attività di programmazione, nonché lo sviluppo e l'integrazione di soluzioni software negli ambienti simulativi, utilizzando prevalentemente il linguaggio C++ e, ove necessario, altri linguaggi e strumenti di programmazione. In particolare dovrà: Analizzare le esigenze operative e tecniche connesse alle attività di modellazione e simulazione, individuando i requisiti funzionali e traducendoli in specifiche attività di programmazione; Progettare, sviluppare e implementare software, componenti e algoritmi prevalentemente in linguaggio C++, all'interno di ambienti di Modelling & Simulation; Sviluppare e integrare modelli software per la rappresentazione e la simulazione di sistemi, scenari operativi e comportamenti all'interno di ambienti simulati; Contribuire alle attività di verifica, test, debugging e validazione del codice e delle soluzioni software sviluppate; Analizzare i risultati delle simulazioni, individuando eventuali esigenze di aggiornamento, ottimizzazione e miglioramento dei modelli e degli algoritmi implementati; Contribuire, ove richiesto, allo sviluppo e all'integrazione di algoritmi di Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) a supporto delle funzionalità degli ambienti simulativi; Valutare la compatibilità e l'integrazione delle nuove funzionalità con i sistemi e gli strumenti software preesistenti; Redigere la documentazione tecnica relativa alle attività di analisi, progettazione, programmazione e validazione. Requisiti e Competenze Richieste Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria Elettronica, Matematica o Fisica; Programmazione: costituisce elemento essenziale la conoscenza del linguaggio C++, con capacità di progettazione, scrittura, debugging e ottimizzazione del codice. La conoscenza di altri linguaggi utilizzati in ambito M&S, quali Python, e di strumenti come MATLAB costituisce un elemento preferenziale. Modelling & Simulation: Conoscenza dei principi di modellazione matematica, simulazione numerica e sviluppo di modelli computazionali; AI & Machine Learning: Conoscenza di base dei principali concetti e algoritmi di Intelligenza Artificiale e Machine Learning; Competenze analitiche: Capacità di analizzare problematiche tecniche, individuare requisiti funzionali e tradurli in soluzioni software; Lingue: Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata Chiarezza espositiva: capacità di esporre concetti tecnici complessi in modo chiaro e logico Orientamento all'obiettivo e proattività Propensione naturale all'aggiornamento (studio di paper e riviste scientifiche) ALTRE INFORMAZIONI Si offre: assunzione diretta, CCNL Commercio, inquadramento impiegato. Range di ral 33.000 € – 38.000 € oltre a buoni pasto e welfare aziendale. Inserimento in contesto tecnologico sfidante e ad alto contenuto innovativo. Sede di lavoro: Pratica di Mare Altre informazioni: l'assunzione è soggetta al rilascio del Nulla Osta Sicurezza (NOS) che sarà richiesto dalla società secondo le procedure nazionali vigenti. L'annuncio è rivolto a tutte le persone, senza distinzione di sesso, in riferimento al D. Lgs. 198/2006. Rifiutiamo ogni forma di discriminazione, crediamo nelle pari opportunità, nelle diversità e nell'inclusione.

items.desc: Goede documentatie is essentieel voor begrijpelijke en onderhoudbare software, zeker wanneer applicaties intensief met elkaar communiceren. Nieuwe ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI maken het mogelijk om documentatie automatisch en contextgericht te genereren. In deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek en bouw je een Proof of Concept die communicatiestromen inzichtelijk maakt en documentatie structureel integreert in het ontwikkelproces. In welke sector je ook consultancydiensten aanbiedt, code moet duidelijk en beschrijvend zijn en goed worden gedocumenteerd. Voor dat laatste zijn er de afgelopen tijd veel ontwikkelingen geweest die het mogelijk maken om een klantoverstijgende documentatietechniek toe te passen. Wanneer communicatiestromen automatisch worden gedocumenteerd, ontstaat er meer overzicht en draagvlak bij andere afdelingen over opgeleverde functionaliteit en wordt achterstallige documentatie voorkomen. Er is veel vooruitgang geboekt op het gebied van AI en we zijn tegenwoordig in staat om deze via Context Engineering zeer klant- en applicatiespecifiek in te zetten als assistent. De opdracht Onderzoek in welke mate het overzicht over het landschap en de actualiteit van documentatie van verschillende stromen verbeterd kan worden. Doe dit door het automatisch genereren van documentatie, zoals diagrammen met bijvoorbeeld PlantUML of Mermaid, en contextuele toelichting met bijvoorbeeld Markdown. Dit zou geïntegreerd moeten worden in het ontwikkelingsproces. Dit betreft initieel documentatie voor een enkele applicatie, maar er zijn mogelijk ook kansen om communicatiestromen over meerdere applicaties heen inzichtelijk te maken, bijvoorbeeld door Model Context Protocols te integreren voor externe componenten of door het uitlezen van SwaggerDocs van koppelingen. Bouw hiervoor een Proof of Concept om dit aan te tonen. Over Info Support Info Support is specialist in maatwerksoftware, data/AI solutions, beheer en trainingen en actief in de sectoren Finance, Industry, Agriculture, Food & Retail, Mobility & Public en Healthcare. Wij bieden solide en innovatieve oplossingen voor complexe en bedrijfkritische softwarevraagstukken. Onze hoofdkantoren zijn gevestigd in Veenendaal (NL) en Mechelen (BE). Op dit moment zijn er circa 500 medewerkers bij Info Support in dienst. De werkwijze van Info Support kenmerkt zich door een aantal kernwaarden: soliditeit, integriteit, vakmanschap en passie. Deze kernwaarden zijn verweven in ons werk en de manier waarop we met elkaar omgaan. Om te zorgen dat alle medewerkers altijd op de hoogte kunnen zijn van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen beschikt Info Support over een inhouse IT Academy waar graag wordt voldaan aan de honger naar meer of andere kennis en vaardigheden. Om deze opdracht te kunnen doen is B2-taalvaardigheid in het Nederlands vereist.

items.desc: Het opzetten van een microserviceslandschap volgens Domain Driven Design kost vaak veel tijd en vraagt om specifieke kennis. Wat als AI kan helpen bij het maken van cruciale ontwerpkeuzes? Tijdens deze opdracht onderzoek je hoe non-functional requirements kunnen worden gebruikt om automatisch de juiste patterns, frameworks en designprincipes te selecteren of zelfs software te genereren. Met jouw oplossing kunnen ontwikkelaars sneller en efficiënter aan de slag met complexe DDD-projecten. Domain Driven Design (DDD) biedt een reeks patterns die afhankelijk van de gewenste non-functional requirements (NFRs) kunnen worden toegepast. Deze NFRs, zoals schaalbaarheid, consistentie en beveiliging, bepalen in grote mate welke patterns en ontwerpkeuzes relevant zijn. In de initiële fase van een softwareproject besteden ontwikkelaars vaak veel tijd aan het opzetten van een microserviceslandschap volgens DDD-principes. Dit omvat het ontwerpen van services, integreren van event bus frameworks (zoals MassTransit of NServiceBus) en toepassen van designprincipes zoals idempotentie, exactly-once message delivery, message signing, message encryption en eventual consistency. Deze opstartfase kost vaak veel tijd en vereist diepgaande kennis die niet altijd direct beschikbaar is. Het opzetten van een full-blown DDD-project kan daardoor lang duren en hoge kosten met zich meebrengen. De uitdaging ligt dan ook in hoe de complexiteit en kosten van de oplossing in balans gebracht kunnen worden. Het gebruik van bestaande frameworks, libraries of standaardoplossingen kan hierin een belangrijke rol in spelen. Omdat veel van onze klanten gebruik maken van Domain Driven Design, kan de kennis die uit deze opdracht voortkomt bijdragen aan snellere en effectievere softwareontwikkeling. De opdracht Het kiezen van DDD-patterns, het inzetten van een event bus framework en het kiezen van design-principes gebeurt op basis van non-functional requirements. Onderzoek in hoeverre het mogelijk is om deze non-functional requirements te gebruiken als input voor een AI die keuzes kan automatiseren. Of nog beter: om op basis van deze non-functional requirements software te genereren waarin deze patterns, framework en design-principes al geïmplementeerd zijn. Deze AI moet de gemaakte keuzes kunnen onderbouwen, zodat deze keuzes gevalideerd en gedocumenteerd kunnen worden. items.title: Ingénieur systèmes infrastructure IA H/F
items.card: Bull c’est une histoire. Un siècle d’innovation Européenne et un environnement de travail où des experts conçoivent des solutions numériques puissantes, durables et souveraines, permettant aux États et aux industries de garder la pleine maîtrise de leurs données et de leur IA. Bull c’est aussi des milliers d’ingénieurs, de chercheurs, de passionnés de tech, façonnant l’avenir du calcul de haute performance, de l’IA
items.desc: Bull c’est une histoire. Un siècle d’innovation Européenne et un environnement de travail où des experts conçoivent des solutions numériques puissantes, durables et souveraines, permettant aux États et aux industries de garder la pleine maîtrise de leurs données et de leur IA. Bull c’est aussi des milliers d’ingénieurs, de chercheurs, de passionnés de tech, façonnant l’avenir du calcul de haute performance, de l’IA et des technologies quantiques. Chaque jour, nos équipes repoussent les limites du possible - des architectures HPC de nouvelle génération aux supercalculateurs exascale - soutenues par une R&D de rang mondial, plus de 1 600 brevets et des capacités de bout en bout uniques, couvrant la conception matérielle, l’ingénierie logicielle, la data science et la recherche quantique. Centrés sur l’humain et portés par l’innovation, où la collaboration s’étend à l’Europe, aux Amériques et à l’Inde, nous partageons cette même vision d’une innovation responsable et durable, avec un impact concret pour nos clients. Contexte La business unit AI & Cloud Infrastructure (ACI) de Bull construit un portefeuille d’infrastructures IA à l’échelle des racks pour les fournisseurs de services cloud, Neo Clouds et les programmes européens AI Gigafactory — en commençant par le NVIDIA NVL72 de marque Bull (génération Vera Rubin) fabriqué en Europe, suivi d’autres projets non divulgués. L’ingénieur transforme ces designs en systèmes fonctionnels et supportables mise en route, intégration, validation et responsabilité technique de la configuration Bull, à l’interface entre les fournisseurs de silicium (NVIDIA, AMD), le partenaire de fabrication et les équipes produit, avant-vente et support de Bull. Mission Faire passer une plateforme IA à l'échelle du rack du design de référence à un produit Bull validé et supportable mettez en place les premiers systèmes, qualifiez la configuration spécifique Bull (options matérielles, firmware, pile de gestion, réseau), lancez les campagnes de validation avec les partenaires, et transformez les résultats en matériel de référence sur lequel la présales, la livraison et le support peuvent compter. Responsabilités clefs Mise en route, intégration et validation Mettre en route et tester les premiers racks Bull (racks d'échantillons hébergés chez le partenaire, puis sur les systèmes Bull eux-mêmes) firmware et pile BMC/gestion, gestion des nœuds et des racks, NVLink / architecture scale-up, réseau scale-out, télémétrie de refroidissement liquide. Définir et exécuter le plan de validation de la configuration Bull fonctionnement, performance (calcul, interconnexion, chemin de stockage), comportement thermique et consommation d'énergie, RAS et facilité de maintenance. Qualifier les choix spécifiques à Bull par rapport à la référence du fournisseur pièces de nomenclature provenant du partenaire, options de sécurité/root-of-trust de la plateforme. Reproduire, isoler et documenter les défauts avec les équipes d'ingénierie du partenaire et du fournisseur ; assurer le suivi technique jusqu'à résolution. Architecture de référence et responsabilité de conception (avec le Portfolio) Contribuer au contenu technique des revues de propositions de conception avec le partenaire de fabrication et des réponses aux programmes de qualification des partenaires du fournisseur. Soutenir le Directeur du Portfolio sur la définition des produits et les Architectes Presales / Solutions sur les configurations spécifiques aux clients et la due diligence technique. Outils, automatisation et labo Mettre en place et faire fonctionner l'environnement de labo d'ingénierie autour des racks provisionnement / nœud principal, accès hors bande, suivi et collecte de télémétrie, modèle d'accès à distance avec le partenaire. Automatiser les procédures de démarrage, de test et de collecte de données afin que les campagnes soient reproductibles à travers les générations et les sites partenaires. Support, livraison et documentation Produire la documentation technique qui part de l'ingénierie rapports de validation, guides de configuration, listes de problèmes connus, notes de support sur le terrain pour l'organisation de maintenance et de support. Servir de point d'escalade technique de niveau 3 pour les systèmes déployés, en collaboration avec le partenaire de service. Compétences requises Hard Skills Personne n’est censé maîtriser les cinq domaines dès le premier jour nous recherchons une bonne base dans les deux premiers, une expérience réelle dans au moins un des trois autres, et la volonté d’apprendre le reste sur le terrain. Indispensables Systèmes à l’échelle des racks ou HPC/IA — expérience pratique dans le déploiement, l’intégration ou la validation de serveurs GPU accélérés ou de solutions à l’échelle des racks BIOS / BMC / firmware, topologies PCIe et accélérateurs, NVLink ou réseau haute vitesse. Ingénierie des systèmes Linux — provisionnement et gestion de configuration de flottes, piles noyau / pilotes, conteneurs, Slurm …

items.desc: Commit messages shape how teams understand and maintain their code, but AI tools are starting to take over this task. In this thesis, you analyze the quality of AI-generated commit messages and compare them to human-written ones. The goal: uncover how well these tools capture the intent behind code changes and where they still fall short. Commit messages are a vital part of modern software development. They help teams track changes, understand decisions and maintain codebases over time. More and more, AI tools like GitHub Copilot generate these messages automatically. While this can speed up workflows, it’s unclear how this shift affects message quality. AI may summarize code effectively but often lacks the context behind decisions. To evaluate this development, we need a clearer picture of what makes a commit message effective and how AI compares to humans in practice. The Assignment In this thesis, you will contribute to improving commit message quality by exploring how AI can support this part of the development workflow. The goal is to understand how AI-generated commit messages compare to human-written ones in terms of clarity, relevance and usefulness for understanding code changes. Based on your findings, you will draw conclusions about the strengths and limitations of current AI-generated commit messages and identify opportunities for improvement. items.desc: About Sona Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment. We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here. About The Role Sona's Labour AI team builds the forecasting, rules and scheduling tools that help hospitality and retail businesses get staffing right. This role is about getting that tooling to work for a specific site: its trading patterns, its staff, its quirks. You'll work directly with customers to turn Sona's tools into labour models that are used on site and have a huge impact. You'll derive labour rules from real trading data, spend time on site with customer teams to learn how the business runs, and build the trust with site managers. You'll present the impact and ROI of that work to customer executives and general managers, and act as the subject matter expert for labour optimisation in sales conversations. You'll also be the person site managers trust enough to change how they staff, and the person customer executives and General Managers trust enough to back the changes you're proposing. You'll need as much influence as analysis to make that work. You'll report back to customer leadership on the impact, in numbers they can take to their own board. You'll adapt the same underlying labour model across different business types, from QSR to premium dining to retail. items.desc: Recommendation systems often favor dominant sellers and ignore user context, leading to biased and irrelevant suggestions. This thesis examines how AI can improve both fairness and trustworthiness in e-commerce recommendations. You’ll analyze existing methods, test algorithms on real-world data, and design a solution that balances market visibility with user relevance. Recommendation systems are a cornerstone of modern e-commerce platforms. They shape customer behavior, influence satisfaction and directly affect market dynamics. However, the fairness and reliability of these systems are questionable, as studies have shown that many popular algorithms tend to favor products from dominant sellers, creating a biased product offering. This undermines the visibility of smaller vendors and reduces consumer trust. Additionally, these systems often lack contextual awareness. They may recommend items that have already been purchased or fail to distinguish between multiple users sharing the same account (e.g., family members), leading to irrelevant suggestions. These inefficiencies not only diminish the user experience but also further question the effectiveness of the recommendation engine. The Assignment The aim of this thesis is to contribute to the development of fair and trustworthy recommendation algorithms for e-commerce platforms using AI. This assignment addresses both aspects through three main stages: Literature review and analysis Explore existing research on bias in recommendation systems. Identify fairness metrics used in literature and industry, and review approaches to mitigate bias. Also, study methods for incorporating user feedback directly into the recommendation process (customer-in-the-loop systems). Algorithmic evaluation Compare algorithms that explicitly aim to optimize fairness. Evaluate these algorithms using publicly available datasets (e.g., Amazon Reviews, MovieLens), comparing their performance in terms of recommendation quality, fairness, and diversity. Solution design Develop an approach that addresses and combines both fairness and trustworthiness, improving the overall usability of e-commerce recommendations. Measure the impact on the recommendation system’s performance using clearly defined metrics, for example through a prototype webshop. This thesis should contribute to the academic discourse on fairness in AI, while offering practical insights for improving recommendation systems in online commerce. Du har måske en baggrund inden for softwareudvikling eller data og har samtidig udviklet en stærk forretningsforståelse. Du ser naturligt muligheder for at optimere arbejdsgange, udfordre eksisterende processer og skabe værdi gennem teknologi. Vi leder efter dig, der er oprigtigt optaget af AI. Dig, der eksperimenterer med nye teknologier, undersøger mulighederne på eget initiativ og motiveres af at finde løsninger på udfordringer, som andre endnu ikke har fundet svaret på. Du skal både kunne sætte retningen, udarbejde roadmaps, skabe opbakning og selv tage operationelt ansvar for, at idéerne bliver omsat til konkrete resultater. En nyoprettet rolle med stor indflydelse Danske Fragtmænd har allerede integreret AI i softwareudviklingen. Nu ønsker vi at bringe teknologien endnu tættere på forretningen og udnytte potentialet på tværs af organisationen. Det handler ikke om administrative processer, men i høj grad om at undersøge, hvordan AI kan skabe værdi i virksomhedens operationelle aktiviteter, hvor transport, logistik, terminaldrift og daglige arbejdsgange skal fungere effektivt. Du bliver en del af vores Data & AI-team på 7,5 medarbejdere og refererer til Head of Data & AI. Samtidig får du en bred kontaktflade til ledere, medarbejdere og softwareudviklere på tværs af organisationen. Din opgave bliver at forstå forretningens udfordringer, identificere de mest værdifulde AI-muligheder og omsætte dem til løsninger, der skaber mærkbare forbedringer i hverdagen. Stillingen er nyoprettet, og du får derfor stor mulighed for at præge både rollen, arbejdsformen og den fremtidige anvendelse af AI hos Danske Fragtmænd. Fra AI-roadmap til operationel eksekvering Du kommer til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem teknologi, data, mennesker og forretning. Du skal kunne sætte dig ind i komplekse arbejdsgange og forstå, hvordan virksomheden fungerer i praksis. Det kræver nysgerrighed, analytisk sans og lysten til at komme tæt på de medarbejdere og processer, hvor teknologien skal gøre en forskel. Du skal kunne identificere forbedringsmuligheder, vurdere deres forretningsmæssige potentiale og prioritere de initiativer, der giver størst værdi. Men du skal også selv være en aktiv del af eksekveringen. Det er ikke tilstrækkeligt at udarbejde strategier og præsentere gode idéer. Du skal kunne eksperimentere, afprøve teknologier og drive initiativerne frem mod konkrete løsninger i samarbejde med forretningen og de tekniske specialister. Dine vigtigste ansvarsområder bliver at: Identificere og analysere processer og arbejdsgange på tværs af organisationen, med særligt fokus på mulighederne i den operationelle forretning. Udarbejde business cases, investeringsforslag og et prioriteret AI-roadmap med tydelige mål og forventet forretningsværdi. Tage ejerskab for udvalgte AI-initiativer og sikre fremdrift fra idé til afprøvning og implementering. Undersøge mulighederne inden for blandt andet AI-agenter, sprogmodeller og computer vision. Skabe relationer, engagere stakeholders og sikre opbakning til nye initiativer på tværs af organisationen. Samarbejde tæt med udviklere (du kan også noget selv teknisk), ledere og medarbejdere om at omsætte teknologien til løsninger, der fungerer i praksis. Følge op på effekten af implementerede løsninger og sikre, at de skaber den forventede værdi. Bidrage til AI-governance, videndeling og udbredelsen af AI i organisationen. Inden for de første 6–12 måneder forventer vi, at du har identificeret og kvalificeret relevante forretningscases, gennemført de første konkrete AI-afprøvninger og bidraget til et roadmap for virksomhedens videre AI-udvikling. Du har en relevant videregående uddannelse, eksempelvis inden for softwareudvikling, datalogi, IT, data science eller en tilsvarende teknisk retning. Du har samtidig en stærk forståelse for forretning og data og evner at se sammenhængen mellem teknologi, processer og de mennesker, der skal anvende løsningerne. Vi ser gerne, at du har dokumenteret erfaring med at udvikle, afprøve eller implementere AI-baserede løsninger, og at du kan fortælle om konkrete projekter, hvor du har været med til at skabe resultater. Det er dog mindst lige så vigtigt, at du er passioneret omkring området og aktivt udforsker nye teknologier og anvendelsesmuligheder. items.desc: Job Description Are you interested in working at the intersection of data engineering, integration, and artificial intelligence? Do you enjoy connecting systems, working with data, and exploring how AI can improve the way businesses operate? We are looking for a Data Engineer with a focus on Integration and AI to join our global team in Prague. In this role, you will work alongside integration and AI experts to design and develop data solutions that connect applications, APIs, databases, and modern data platforms. You will have the opportunity to work with SAP Integration Suite, Databricks, cloud technologies, and AI-enabled solutions, while developing your skills in data engineering and enterprise integration. What You'll Bring Essential knowledge of AI/ML concepts, with preferred experience working with AI/ML workflows or integrating AI-driven capabilities into applications and data solutions. Foundational knowledge of SQL and programming skills in Python or Java. Understanding of data pipelines, ETL/ELT concepts, and how data flows between applications and systems. Familiarity with data preparation, data validation, and data profiling. Interest in or exposure to cloud platforms and modern data technologies; experience with Databricks or similar platforms is a plus. Interest in enterprise integration and willingness to develop expertise in SAP Integration Suite and SAP Business Technology Platform. Strong communication skills in English and the ability to work effectively in an international, collaborative environment. A university degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field. We also welcome early-career professionals who have gained relevant experience through internships, student placements, or a junior role in integration, data engineering, consulting, or a related field. What You'll Build Be part of a global team of integration and AI experts working on innovative data and integration solutions. Design, develop, test, and maintain integration solutions using SAP Integration Suite. Integrate data from APIs, databases, applications, and other enterprise systems using SAP technologies and Databricks. Apply AI-enabled capabilities to improve data quality checks, data validation, and data processing. Work closely with AI experts and project teams to translate project requirements into robust and scalable data solutions. Learn and apply SAP integration and data engineering best practices while working on real-world projects. Where you belong You will join a global team working at the intersection of integration, data engineering, and AI. Our team helps connect applications and data across complex enterprise landscapes and explores new ways to use AI to create intelligent and efficient data solutions. You will collaborate with colleagues from different technical areas and have the opportunity to learn from skilled integration and AI specialists. Together, we build solutions that help customers make better use of their data and adopt modern cloud and AI technologies. This is an opportunity to grow your technical skills while contributing to projects involving SAP Integration Suite, data engineering, cloud technologies, and AI. items.desc: Job Description As part of Mantu’s continued growth and digital transformation, we are looking for an AI FinOps & Platform Cost Analyst to join our IT team. Reporting to the Data & AI Manager , you will help establish and operate Mantu’s AI FinOps capability. Your role will sit at the intersection of IT operations, data analytics, AI platform management, and financial governance . You will provide visibility into AI and LLM consumption, build the data foundations and dashboards required to monitor usage and costs, and help the organisation optimise the performance, scalability, and commercial value of its AI platforms. You will work closely with the Data & AI, IT, Finance, Procurement, Security, and business teams to ensure that AI services are used efficiently, sustainably, and in line with Mantu’s technical and commercial objectives. Your missions Build dashboard-level visibility into AI platform spend (e.g., Dust, Claude), identifying which agents and use cases drive costs Develop predictive consumption models that go beyond linear extrapolation, enabling accurate forecasting of AI/LLM costs Report monthly on cost, consumption trends, and risk exposure to relevant stakeholders Identify and shift workloads off premium models where not justified, optimizing spend by aligning tasks with appropriate model tiers Track model pricing evolution and reassess cost/quality tradeoffs as new models are released Monitor consumption against contracted thresholds and flag commercial risks proactively Support contract negotiation and renewal discussions with AI platform vendors in collaboration with Procurement and the AI team Build and continuously refine Mantu’s AI cost model, incorporating external advisory input and documenting methodology for future client-facing offers[doc1] Your profile You have a strong interest in the intersection of IT, data, artificial intelligence, cloud platforms, and cost optimisation . items.desc: Since 2008, Language Inspired has grown from a translation provider into a language solutions integrator. Today, we're a fully remote team with a global network of linguists. We combine human expertise, AI, and language technology to help international companies make localization smarter in every market. We're currently looking for a Language Quality & AI Specialist to join our Language Talent Team. In this role, you will manage quality processes across human and AI-assisted localization, including recurring AI evaluation and linguistic asset management programmes. You will work closely with the Global Head of Language Talent on quality frameworks, priorities, and continuous improvement. Tasks As a Language Quality & AI Specialist, you'll own the language quality lifecycle across human and AI-assisted workflows. You will: Evaluate linguistic quality using industry frameworks and standards such as MQM, ISO 5060, ISO 17100, ISO 18587, and client-specific scorecards. Run recurring AI quality evaluation cycles: calibrate evaluators, validate findings, and track improvement from one round to the next. Design, maintain, and improve validation and evaluation workflows across multiple TMS platforms and MT/AI engines. Apply a risk-based approach to quality by defining quality tiers and estimating effort based on content type, sensitivity, and business impact. Assess the health of translation memories, termbases, and style guides, and coordinate maintenance with linguists and technical teams. Handle client and internal feedback cases, making objective, consistent, and well-documented quality decisions. Track quality KPIs, spot trends and root causes, and propose data-driven improvements and AI-enabled workflows. Prepare structured quality analyses and feedback reports for linguists, internal teams, and clients, working with the Global Head of Language Talent. Act as the go-to quality contact for key clients, contributing to style guides, termbases, onboarding materials, and quality guidelines. Work with the Client Solutions & Support team and linguist teams to align quality expectations, workflows, and improvement actions. Requirements Essential: Fluency in English. Linguistic degree (translation, linguistic studies). 3+ years of experience owning language quality in the localization industry. Strong multilingual awareness: a solid understanding of i18n/l10n/g11n across markets, fit-for-purpose content solutions, and how languages work, including ones you don't speak. Strong quality expertise: hands-on experience with quality frameworks and standards such as MQM, ISO 5060, ISO 17100, and ISO 18587, and with assessing, maintaining, and improving language assets such as translation memories, termbases, and style guides. Strong language technology awareness: hands-on experience with TMS platforms, MT engines, and AI tools, and the ability to evaluate their output, judge fitness for purpose, and use findings to improve quality and reduce risk. Strong analytical, reporting, and communication skills: including confidence with spreadsheet analysis, clear documentation, and presenting findings to clients and external stakeholders. Strong ownership and sharp eye for detail: the ability to manage recurring quality work independently, set priorities, and stay objective and consistent in your assessments. Strong advantage: Additional languages. Experience with multiple cloud-based TMS platforms, MT engines, and AI/LLM tools in localization. Experience applying risk-based or tiered quality models across content types, from software and technical content to regulated domains such as finance, legal, and life sciences. Experience calibrating language experts or managing multilingual language programmes. Benefits Remote-first workplace with freedom, trust & accountability. Work-life balance and a supportive company culture. Best software & hardware. Real impact – shape quality processes and influence client success. A unique experience in a dynamic, multicultural environment and a thriving, fast-paced industry. Competitive salary based on experience & expertise. Seriously great colleagues – we mean it! This role is ideal for someone comfortable taking ownership and building structure where it does not yet exist. If you enjoy shaping how things work rather than simply following predefined or legacy processes, this role is for you. You will help improve, test, and document language quality practices across human and AI-assisted workflows at Language Inspired, working closely with the Global Head of Language Talent and cross-functional teams. Bij CM krijg je als Technology Coach de kans om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van onze organisatie. We zijn volop bezig met de integratie van AI en andere innovatieve tools in onze werking. Jij krijgt de ruimte om te experimenteren, nieuwe technologieën te verkennen en mee vorm te geven aan hoe we werken. Denk aan het integreren van intelligente AI-agenten & tools in het dagelijkse werkproces, waarbij zowel technische als culturele verandering centraal staan. Je zet AI Tools in om je werk te optimaliseren, Copilot of andere AI tools. As an AI Training Expert, you will apply your professional knowledge and judgement to evaluate AI-generated content, identify errors, improve responses and create realistic questions and scenarios based on your field of expertise. You will initially work on a Social Media AI Training Project, with potential opportunities to contribute to additional projects aligned with your professional background as they become available. Full training, structured guidelines and ongoing support from a dedicated project trainer will be provided. We welcome qualified professionals from healthcare, law, finance, business, technology, engineering, science, education, research, creative industries and other specialist fields. Compare alternative AI-generated responses and assess which best meets the task requirements. Develop realistic questions, professional scenarios and examples based on your industry knowledge. Provide structured feedback to help improve AI model performance. Quality Assurance and Professional Judgement Apply your professional knowledge to complete tasks in line with project guidelines. Check responses carefully before submission to maintain high standards of accuracy and consistency. Incorporate feedback from project trainers and reviewers. Flag ambiguous instructions, quality concerns and technical issues promptly. Maintain confidentiality and follow applicable project security requirements. Project Coordination and Documentation Complete assigned task sets within agreed deadlines. Follow task instructions, quality standards and project workflows. Maintain accurate records of completed work and progress where required. Communicate questions, updates and issues to your project trainer. Participate in brief project check-ins when required. Law and compliance: Solicitors, barristers, legal executives, compliance specialists and regulatory professionals. Finance and business: Accountants, auditors, financial analysts, economists, consultants, HR and operations professionals. Technology: Software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity specialists, IT professionals and cloud engineers. Engineering and the built environment: Civil, mechanical, electrical and chemical engineers, architects and surveyors. Science and research: Chemists, biologists, physicists, mathematicians and statisticians. Education and humanities: Teachers, lecturers, historians, writers, editors, translators and linguists. Creative and media industries: Marketers, designers, journalists and other relevant subject-matter experts. Professionals from other industries are also encouraged to apply if they have relevant expertise and strong written communication skills. Requirements A degree or recognized professional qualification in a relevant field. Professional experience in your industry, either currently practising or recently practicing. Strong written English, analytical thinking and attention to detail. The ability to assess information critically and identify inaccuracies. Clear written communication and the ability to explain complex concepts accurately. Good organizational skills and the ability to work independently. The ability to follow detailed instructions and incorporate feedback. A reliable laptop or desktop computer and a stable internet connection. Eligibility to work as a self-employed contractor in the UK. Desirable Experience Current professional registration, certification or chartered status, where relevant. Un siècle d’innovation Européenne et un environnement de travail où des experts conçoivent des solutions numériques puissantes, durables et souveraines, permettant aux États et aux industries de garder la pleine maîtrise de leurs données et de leur IA. items.desc: Bull c’est une histoire. Un siècle d’innovation Européenne et un environnement de travail où des experts conçoivent des solutions numériques puissantes, durables et souveraines, permettant aux États et aux industries de garder la pleine maîtrise de leurs données et de leur IA. Bull c’est aussi des milliers d’ingénieurs, de chercheurs, de passionnés de tech, façonnant l’avenir du calcul de haute performance, de l’IA et des technologies quantiques. Chaque jour, nos équipes repoussent les limites du possible - des architectures HPC de nouvelle génération aux supercalculateurs exascale - soutenues par une R&D de rang mondial, plus de 1 600 brevets et des capacités de bout en bout uniques, couvrant la conception matérielle, l’ingénierie logicielle, la data science et la recherche quantique. Centrés sur l’humain et portés par l’innovation, où la collaboration s’étend à l’Europe, aux Amériques et à l’Inde, nous partageons cette même vision d’une innovation responsable et durable, avec un impact concret pour nos clients. Contexte La business unit AI & Cloud Infrastructure (ACI) de Bull construit un portefeuille d’infrastructures IA à l’échelle des racks pour les fournisseurs de services cloud, Neo Clouds et les programmes européens AI Gigafactory — en commençant par le NVIDIA NVL72 de marque Bull (génération Vera Rubin) fabriqué en Europe, suivi d’autres projets non divulgués. L’ingénieur transforme ces designs en systèmes fonctionnels et supportables mise en route, intégration, validation et responsabilité technique de la configuration Bull, à l’interface entre les fournisseurs de silicium (NVIDIA, AMD), le partenaire de fabrication et les équipes produit, avant-vente et support de Bull. Mission Faire passer une plateforme IA à l'échelle du rack du design de référence à un produit Bull validé et supportable mettez en place les premiers systèmes, qualifiez la configuration spécifique Bull (options matérielles, firmware, pile de gestion, réseau), lancez les campagnes de validation avec les partenaires, et transformez les résultats en matériel de référence sur lequel la présales, la livraison et le support peuvent compter. Responsabilités clefs Mise en route, intégration et validation Mettre en route et tester les premiers racks Bull (racks d'échantillons hébergés chez le partenaire, puis sur les systèmes Bull eux-mêmes) firmware et pile BMC/gestion, gestion des nœuds et des racks, NVLink / architecture scale-up, réseau scale-out, télémétrie de refroidissement liquide. Définir et exécuter le plan de validation de la configuration Bull fonctionnement, performance (calcul, interconnexion, chemin de stockage), comportement thermique et consommation d'énergie, RAS et facilité de maintenance. Qualifier les choix spécifiques à Bull par rapport à la référence du fournisseur pièces de nomenclature provenant du partenaire, options de sécurité/root-of-trust de la plateforme. Reproduire, isoler et documenter les défauts avec les équipes d'ingénierie du partenaire et du fournisseur ; assurer le suivi technique jusqu'à résolution. Architecture de référence et responsabilité de conception (avec le Portfolio) Contribuer au contenu technique des revues de propositions de conception avec le partenaire de fabrication et des réponses aux programmes de qualification des partenaires du fournisseur. Soutenir le Directeur du Portfolio sur la définition des produits et les Architectes Presales / Solutions sur les configurations spécifiques aux clients et la due diligence technique. Outils, automatisation et labo Mettre en place et faire fonctionner l'environnement de labo d'ingénierie autour des racks provisionnement / nœud principal, accès hors bande, suivi et collecte de télémétrie, modèle d'accès à distance avec le partenaire. Automatiser les procédures de démarrage, de test et de collecte de données afin que les campagnes soient reproductibles à travers les générations et les sites partenaires. Support, livraison et documentation Produire la documentation technique qui part de l'ingénierie rapports de validation, guides de configuration, listes de problèmes connus, notes de support sur le terrain pour l'organisation de maintenance et de support. Servir de point d'escalade technique de niveau 3 pour les systèmes déployés, en collaboration avec le partenaire de service. Compétences requises Hard Skills Personne n’est censé maîtriser les cinq domaines dès le premier jour nous recherchons une bonne base dans les deux premiers, une expérience réelle dans au moins un des trois autres, et la volonté d’apprendre le reste sur le terrain. Indispensables Systèmes à l’échelle des racks ou HPC/IA — expérience pratique dans le déploiement, l’intégration ou la validation de serveurs GPU accélérés ou de solutions à l’échelle des racks BIOS / BMC / firmware, topologies PCIe et accélérateurs, NVLink ou réseau haute vitesse. Ingénierie des systèmes Linux — provisionnement et gestion de configuration de flottes, piles noyau / pilotes, conteneurs, Slurm …

items.card: About The Role We are looking for an experienced software engineer to lead the development of tools that support every stage of the autonomy lifecycle. items.desc: Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond. About The Role We are looking for an experienced software engineer to lead the development of tools that support every stage of the autonomy lifecycle. You will be responsible for building and evolving core internal platforms that allow engineers to test new ideas, diagnose system behaviors, and understand complex interactions between software and the physical world. This role combines backend systems work with front-end visualization, and requires a strong sense of software design, developer experience, and a passion for enabling others through effective tooling. The systems you build will be used daily by autonomy developers, test engineers and other stakeholders across the company. Areas Of Responsibility Design and build robust replay and analysis systems that enable engineers to inspect and reproduce recorded autonomy behavior, with fine-grained control over system state, perception outputs, and decision-making at every stage of the stack. Develop scalable infrastructure for automated testing and failure triage, expanding our simulation and log-driven test coverage while accelerating root-cause analysis through automated log processing and diagnostics. Operate at the interface between autonomy software and core robotics middleware, defining clear APIs, data contracts, and performance requirements for messaging, state propagation, and coordination across subsystems, while partnering closely with downstream teams to support their implementation and integration. Design and implement high-quality developer infrastructure and tools that prioritize reliability, performance, and usability, enabling rapid iteration, safe experimentation, and sustained velocity across the autonomy organization. What You’ll Do Lead the design and implementation of scalable tools used across autonomy development and testing workflows. Collaborate with autonomy, QA, and infrastructure teams to gather requirements, align on priorities, and deliver impactful tooling. Build tools that streamline stages of the robotics development process. Take ownership of internal services from concept through deployment and monitoring. Contribute to the long-term vision and roadmap for developer tools that improve debugging efficiency, test coverage, and system understanding. Qualifications 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, ideally in robotics, simulation, or systems development. Proficiency in C++ and Python, with a strong grasp of performance-sensitive and multi-threaded systems. Experience with simulation frameworks, time-synchronized data systems, or state-machine-driven applications. Familiarity with structured data visualization, log processing, or developer tooling design. Strong communication skills and the ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams. Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where requirements evolve and priorities shift. Bonus Experience Experience building performance-sensitive systems (profiling, multithreading, real-time constraints) in robotics, aerospace, automotive, or similar domains. Exposure to robotics / simulation / physics engines. Background in telemetry systems, log ingestion pipelines, or automated test environments. Front-end development skills in modern web frameworks (e.g., React, TypeScript, Three.js, Plotly) with a focus on data interaction and visualization. Familiarity with distributed systems or cloud-hosted services used to support internal tools and customer applications. At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws. For positions located in the United States of America, Skydio, Inc. uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility.
