items.desc: Ul. Żubra 1 / praca hybrydowa / umowa o pracę Dołącz do nas! Dołącz do Biura Walidacji Modeli i pomóż nam budować ramy bezpiecznego, odpowiedzialnego i zgodnego z regulacjami wykorzystywania sztucznej inteligencji. Poszukujemy osoby, która będzie interpretować wymagania dotyczące AI, przekładać je na wewnętrzne zasady Banku oraz wspierać ocenę najbardziej złożonych rozwiązań AI. W naszym zespole będziesz odpowiadać za: monitorowanie i analizowanie unijnych oraz krajowych regulacji, wytycznych i standardów dotyczących sztucznej inteligencji, a także przekładanie wynikających z nich wymagań na procesy, mechanizmy kontrolne i obowiązki wewnętrzne; rozwijanie i aktualizowanie Polityki AI oraz wewnętrznych regulacji, standardów i metodyk służących wdrażaniu wymagań w zakresie zarządzania ryzykiem i nadzoru nad systemami AI, w tym zapewnianie ich właściwego odzwierciedlenia w procesach i narzędziach AI Governance; opracowywanie i rozwijanie zgodnych z wymaganiami regulacyjnymi zasad klasyfikacji systemów AI oraz nadzorowanie tego procesu; merytoryczne wspieranie gestorów w prawidłowym przeprowadzaniu procesu klasyfikacja systemów AI; przygotowywanie, we współpracy z właściwymi jednostkami Banku, opinii w zakresie prawidłowości klasyfikacji, ryzyka oraz zgodności systemów AI z właściwymi wymaganiami; wspieranie gestorów systemów wysokiego ryzyka w zrozumieniu i spełnieniu wymagań regulacyjnych w zakresie wykorzystywania i nadzorowania tych systemów; prowadzenie działań informacyjnych i przygotowywanie materiałów wspierających gestorów oraz użytkowników rozwiązań AI w prawidłowym stosowaniu zasad AI Governance; udział w realizacji rekomendacji audytowych dotyczących regulacyjnych aspektów zarządzania systemami AI. Ta praca jest dla Ciebie, jeśli: posiadasz co najmniej dwuletnie doświadczenie w obszarze regulacji, compliance, zarządzania ryzykiem, audytu, prawa nowych technologii, ochrony danych, zarządzania modelami lub governance; masz praktyczne doświadczenie w interpretowaniu regulacji i przekładaniu ich na wewnętrzne zasady, procesy lub mechanizmy kontrolne; znasz wymagania AI Act lub jesteś gotowy szybko rozwinąć wiedzę w tym obszarze; potrafisz analizować złożone zagadnienia prawne i regulacyjne oraz formułować jednoznaczne, praktyczne rekomendacje; masz doświadczenie w tworzeniu polityk, regulacji, procedur, metodyk albo standardów; potrafisz prowadzić uzgodnienia z wieloma interesariuszami i dochodzić do wspólnego stanowiska w złożonych kwestiach; cechują Cię samodzielność, dociekliwość, precyzja, odpowiedzialność oraz umiejętność krytycznego myślenia; posiadasz wykształcenie wyższe, preferowane w zakresie prawa, ekonomii, finansów, zarządzania ryzykiem, informatyki, etyki technologii lub kierunków pokrewnych; posługujesz się językiem angielskim w stopniu pozwalającym na analizę regulacji, standardów i specjalistycznych materiałów dotyczących AI. Dodatkowym atutem będzie doświadczenie w bankowości, ubezpieczeniach lub innym sektorze regulowanym; udział we wdrożeniu wymagań wynikających z AI Act, RODO lub innych regulacji dotyczących nowych technologii; wiedza dotycząca systemów AI wysokiego ryzyka oraz ocen zgodności; znajomość zasad zarządzania ryzykiem modeli; znajomość ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI Risk Management Framework lub innych standardów zarządzania AI; wiedza dotycząca modeli uczenia maszynowego, generatywnej AI i dużych modeli językowych; doświadczenie w projektach regulacyjnych angażujących biznes, IT, compliance oraz obszar prawny. Oferujemy Ci: zatrudnienie w ramach umowy o pracę; możliwość współtworzenia funkcji AI Governance w Biurze Walidacji Modeli; realny wpływ na Politykę AI oraz sposób wdrażania wymagań AI Act w Banku; udział w opiniowaniu najważniejszych i najbardziej złożonych zastosowań AI; możliwość rozwoju na styku regulacji, ryzyka, technologii i bankowości; współpracę z ekspertami reprezentującymi jednostki biznesowe, technologiczne, prawne, compliance, bezpieczeństwa i ochrony danych; szerokie możliwości rozwoju, w tym udział w szkoleniach i programach rozwojowych; prywatną opiekę medyczną dla Ciebie i Twojej rodziny na preferencyjnych warunkach; kartę MultiSport i ubezpieczenie grupowe na korzystnych warunkach; pracę w stabilnym i zaangażowanym zespole; przyjazną atmosferę pracy opartą na otwartej komunikacji i współpracy.

Dodatkowym atutem będzie: doświadczenie w bankowości lub innej organizacji działającej w silnie regulowanym otoczeniu; udział w projektowaniu lub prowadzeniu rejestrów systemów, modeli, ryzyk, aplikacji albo innych obiektów podlegających nadzorowi; doświadczenie w automatyzacji procesów workflow; znajomość narzędzi do modelowania procesów, raportowania, zarządzania wymaganiami lub zarządzania danymi; doświadczenie związane z integracją danych pomiędzy systemami; znajomość AI Act i podstawowych zasad klasyfikacji systemów AI; znajomość metodyk zarządzania projektami lub procesami; umiejętność posługiwania się narzędziami analitycznymi i raportowymi, w szczególności Excel, Power BI lub narzędziami klasy workflow; podstawowa znajomość rozwiązań low-code wykorzystywanych do automatyzacji procesów. We are looking for a leader who can bridge business and technology, inspire executive stakeholders, define strategic direction, and guide organizations through meaningful AI transformation. In this role, you will: As a trusted advisor, coach, and transformation leader, you will help clients: Assess organizational readiness and identify high-impact AI opportunities Lead workshops, executive discussions, and business transformation programs Define AI visions, strategies, and roadmaps that deliver measurable business value Lead multidisciplinary teams and ensure successful delivery of client engagements Translate AI possibilities into practical initiatives, operating models, and investment decisions Become a trusted advisor to clients on AI adoption, governance, organisational readiness and change Your profile Extensive consulting, advisory, transformation, or AI leadership experience Strong understanding of AI, Generative AI, automation, and emerging technologies Ability to build trust with senior stakeholders and communicate confidently at both boardroom and delivery-team level Experience in facilitating executive workshops and strategic conversations Experience creating business cases, roadmaps, and transformation plans Strong commercial mindset and experience supporting sales pursuits You may bring experience from one, or a combination of the following backgrounds: Option 1: AI Architect Turned Business Leader You have a strong AI, Data, or Solution Architecture background and now want to spend more time: Engaging with executives Shaping transformation agendas Leading large client engagements Developing business opportunities Influencing strategic decisions Option 2: Engagement Manager with AI Expertise You have a consulting, program management, or transformation background and have developed strong knowledge within: Generative AI AI strategy AI governance AI operating models AI adoption and change management You want to become a leading advisor helping organizations transform through AI. Sedan starten 1994 har Newsec vuxit till cirka 2 500 medarbetare verksamma på de sju nordiska och baltiska marknaderna och är idag Sveriges ledande fastighetsförvaltare. Vi har hög tillväxttakt och efterfrågan på våra tjänster ökar, vi rekryterar därför aktivt och behöver utöka vår verksamhet med API & AI Integration Specialist. API & AI Integration Specialist Vill du arbeta med API, integrationer och samtidigt vara med och bygga den tekniska grunden för hur AI-lösningar på ett säkert och kontrollerat sätt får tillgång till verksamhetsdata? Newsec SSC - Group IT söker nu en API & AI Integration Specialist till vårt Integration Competence Center (ICC) . ICC ansvarar för centrala integrationsplattformar och integrationslösningar inom Newsec. Vi arbetar idag bland annat med Microsoft Azure API Management, Azure Logic Apps och Azure Data Factory och samarbetar nära verksamheten, olika IT- och projektinitiativ samt externa partners. Nu vill vi stärka vår interna kompetens inom framför allt API Management och API-utveckling , samtidigt som vi etablerar nästa generation av integrationsförmåga för AI genom bland annat AI Gateway och MCP (Model Context Protocol) . Om rollen I rollen får du ett brett ansvar inom API-området och blir en viktig teknisk kompetens inom ICC. En stor del av arbetet kommer att handla om Microsoft Azure API Management (APIM) och utveckling, publicering och förvaltning av API. Du kommer även att arbeta med kravinsamling och hjälpa verksamheten och olika projekt att hitta rätt tekniska lösningar för integration och API-exponering. Samtidigt kommer du tillsammans med andra delar av organisationen att vara med och etablera hur Newsec använder AI Gateway och MCP servers för att på ett säkert, skalbart och kontrollerat sätt låta AI-agenter och andra AI-lösningar konsumera data och funktionalitet via företagets API. Rollen innebär bland annat att: utveckla, konfigurera och förvalta API i Microsoft Azure arbeta med Azure API Management , inklusive policies, säkerhet, autentisering, routing, certifikat, loggning, övervakning och API lifecycle ta ett övergripande tekniskt ansvar för ICC API Management-miljö och bidra till dess vidareutveckling samla in och analysera krav från verksamheten och olika projektinitiativ omsätta verksamhetsbehov till lämpliga API- och integrationslösningar etablera och vidareutveckla MCP servers för att exponera relevanta API och funktioner på ett kontrollerat sätt till AI-lösningar bidra till etablering och förvaltning av AI Gateway och gemensamma principer för hur AI-agenter får tillgång till API och data arbeta med säkerhet, accesskontroll, governance, logging, rate limiting och monitorering för både traditionell API-trafik och framtida AI-/agenttrafik samarbeta med Newsecs interna AI-, IT- och projektinitiativ samarbeta med verksamheten samt tekniska och icke-tekniska stakeholders samarbeta nära med vår externa integrationsleverantör i Kroatien och beställa, koordinera och följa upp utvecklingsarbete när det behövs bidra till arkitektur, tekniska riktlinjer, dokumentation och best practices inom API- och integrationsområdet. Vem söker vi? Vi söker framför allt dig som är självgående, tekniskt nyfiken och bekväm med att ta ansvar . ICC är ett relativt litet team, vilket innebär att rollen passar dig som inte behöver en färdig instruktion för varje uppgift utan kan sätta dig in i ett behov, diskutera med berörda personer, föreslå en lösning och driva arbetet framåt. Du behöver samtidigt trivas med att samarbeta. Rollen innebär kontakt med såväl verksamheten som utvecklare, arkitekter, projektledare, externa leverantörer och andra delar av Group IT. Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden: Microsoft Azure Azure API Management REST API och API-design utveckling och integration mot API API security och autentisering, exempelvis OAuth 2.0 och Microsoft Entra ID Azure networking och säker kommunikation certifikat och secrets management logging, monitoring och troubleshooting API lifecycle management, versionering och governance Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions eller liknande Azure-tjänster. Erfarenhet av MCP, AI Gateway, Azure AI Foundry eller integration mellan AI-agenter och enterprise-API är meriterande, men vi ser inte att du måste kunna allt från början. Det viktiga är att du har en stark teknisk grund inom API-området och ett stort intresse för att tillsammans med oss bygga upp denna kompetens internt. Varför rollen är viktig API blir en allt viktigare del av hur system och data kopplas samman inom Newsec. Samtidigt skapar utvecklingen inom AI ett nytt behov: AI-agenter behöver kunna komma åt företagets information och funktioner utan att säkerhet, kontroll och governance försvinner. Vår ambition är därför att skapa en gemensam och kontrollerad mekanism där API Management, MCP och AI Gateway tillsammans kan användas …

items.desc: AI håller på att förändra mjukvaruutveckling i grunden. På Softhouse i Luleå vill vi ligga i framkant av den utvecklingen och söker nu fler erfarna utvecklare och arkitekter som vill vara med och forma framtidens mjukvaruutveckling. Vi letar efter dig som har en gedigen teknisk grund, men som också har omfamnat de nya möjligheterna med AI. Du använder redan AI som en naturlig del av ditt utvecklingsarbete och är nyfiken på hur vi kan bygga bättre mjukvara, snabbare och smartare. Vi tror på AI Native Software Development För oss handlar AI Native inte bara om att använda Copilot för att skriva kod snabbare. Det handlar om att tänka nytt kring hela utvecklingsprocessen: Hur AI hjälper oss att gå från idé till fungerande lösning snabbare Hur utvecklarens roll förändras när AI-agenter kan ta ett större ansvar för implementation, testning och dokumentation Hur vi använder tekniken utan att kompromissa med kvalitet, säkerhet och långsiktig hållbarhet Det här är frågor vi vill utforska tillsammans med dig, samtidigt som vi fortsätter leverera riktigt bra mjukvara till våra kunder. Vem söker vi?‍ Vi tror att du är en erfaren och självgående utvecklare med flera års professionell erfarenhet av att bygga och vidareutveckla mjukvarusystem. Du har en stark teknisk grund inom exempelvis .NET, Java, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript eller andra moderna språk och ramverk. Du känner dig bekväm med komplexa system, arkitektur och tekniska vägval. Framför allt söker vi dig som: Redan använder AI-verktyg aktivt i ditt dagliga utvecklingsarbete, exempelvis Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor eller liknande. Har börjat utveckla ett AI-native arbetssätt där AI är en integrerad del av hur du planerar, bygger, testar och förbättrar mjukvara. Har ett starkt tekniskt omdöme och förstår när AI-genererad kod är bra, när den behöver förbättras och när andra angreppssätt är bättre. Är nyfiken på agentbaserad utveckling, automatisering och hur AI kan förändra mjukvaruutveckling på riktigt. Trivs med att arbeta nära kunder, förstå deras verksamhet och omsätta behov till välbyggda tekniska lösningar. Gillar att dela erfarenheter, utmana gamla arbetssätt och utvecklas tillsammans med andra. Kan uttrycka dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska. Du behöver inte kunna allt om AI, men vi tror att du redan har kommit längre än att bara experimentera med enstaka promptar. Känner du inte igen dig i precis allt? Hör av dig ändå! Vi letar lika mycket efter rätt tankesätt och nyfikenhet som ett visst antal års erfarenhet. Vad du får göra hos oss Vi befinner oss i en spännande fas där vi stärker vår traditionella affär inom avancerad mjukvaruutveckling, samtidigt som vi bryter ny mark inom AI och digital transformation. Här får du arbeta med varierande uppdrag hos både stora och små organisationer i regionen, från komplexa affärskritiska system till nya skräddarsydda lösningar. Du kliver in som erfaren specialist eller arkitekt i kundernas team, men får också en nyckelroll i att utveckla vårt eget erbjudande. Vi vill bygga en miljö där vi tillsammans utforskar AI-native arbetssätt i praktiken. Kort och gott får du hos oss: Vara med och forma framtiden: Du får en aktiv roll i att utveckla våra tekniska erbjudanden och omsätta AI-drivna arbetssätt från teori till verklighet. Påverka på riktigt: Hos oss är det nära mellan idé och beslut. Det finns ett stort utrymme att prova ny teknik och dina initiativ gör verklig skillnad. Utvecklas tillsammans med andra: Vi värdesätter kompetensdelning, nyfikenhet och att gemensamt utmana gamla sanningar. Ha roligt på jobbet: Vi har en prestigelös kultur med engagerade kollegor som tycker om att göra saker tillsammans och där vi känner igen oss i våra värdeord: Team, Enkelhet, Mod och Passion. items.desc: Job Description At H&M Creative Studios, we develop and deliver H&M’s customer-facing brand and content experiences globally. Bringing together strategists, creatives, designers, creators, producers and specialists, we are responsible for H&M’s global campaigns, editorial storytelling, creator marketing, organic social channels, e-commerce content, brand design and physical brand experiences. Together, we shape how millions of customers discover, experience and engage with H&M every day. WHAT YOU’LL DO As an AI Creative, you are responsible for creating high-quality product imagery using generative AI tools and image enhancement technologies. Working from production needs, visual guidelines and creative briefs, you combine creativity, visual expertise, and aesthetic judgement with emerging AI technology to produce imagery at scale, from generating new visual content to enhancing existing product imagery. You will work closely with creative and production teams to ensure that all output aligns with our brand direction, visual standards, and responsible AI principles. You will: Create and enhance product imagery and creative still life using AI generation and enhancement tools, aligned with brand direction, visual guidelines, and creative briefs. Work consistently within established creative and production workflows while maintaining a high level of visual quality and accuracy, following brand standards and AI policies. Ensure production targets are met by working efficiently towards set timelines and deadlines. Support the testing, evaluation, and implementation of new AI tools and develop scalable AI-enabled workflows for product imagery and still life production. Collaborate with creative and production colleagues to deliver consistent, high-quality output. WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH You’ll be part of H&M Creative Studios, collaborating closely with different creatives, Photographers, Stylists and production colleagues. Together, you’ll create clear, inspiring, and high-quality product imagery that helps our customers experience and understand our products. Ability to build and refine complex node-based workflows, with strong judgement in selecting the right tools and workflow structure for the task at hand. An understanding of composition and visual storytelling, with the ability to work within established visual and brand guidelines and translate creative briefs into consistent, high-quality visual output. Experience from a creative environment such as photography, design, content production, retouching, art direction, styling, or other relevant creative fields. The ability to work efficiently within structured workflows, production targets, and deadlines. The ability to quickly learn and adapt to new AI tools, technologies, and creative workflows. And people who are… Passionate about technology and curious to explore the possibilities of AI within creative production. Proactive, self-driven, and solution-oriented, comfortable working autonomously and adapting to changing needs and priorities. Hands-on and comfortable experimenting with new tools and ways of working. Visually driven, with strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain high quality while working at pace. Collaborative and open-minded, with a willingness to continuously learn and develop. Additional Information WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. 25% staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET) H&M Incentive Program – HIP JOIN US Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things — our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. This is a full-time permanent role based in Stockholm. items.desc: Vill du vara med och driva den digitala utvecklingen inom ett börsnoterat industriföretag? Vi söker dig som vill kombinera verksamhetsutveckling, affärssystem, automation och artificiell intelligens för att skapa konkreta resultat i en internationell decentraliserad industrikoncern. Du kommer att arbeta nära våra bolag världen över och bidra till att modernisera arbetssätt, öka produktiviteten och skapa nya affärsmöjligheter genom ERP, data, automation och AI. Om rollen Rollen ger dig en central roll med tydligt mandat i AQ:s digitala transformation. Du kommer att arbeta tvärfunktionellt mellan verksamhet, IT och ledning för att säkerställa att våra ERP-lösningar används på bästa sätt och att nya möjligheter inom automation och AI omsätts till verkligt affärsvärde. Rollen omfattar över 50 AQ-bolag globalt och ger stora möjligheter att påverka hur AQ arbetar och utvecklas under många år framåt. Du rapporterar till koncernens IT-chef. Dina ansvarsområden: Du kommer bland annat att: Driva standardisering och utveckling av ERP-processer inom AQ Group Säkerställa att ERP-system används enligt best practice och med fokus på affärsnytta Leda och koordinera vårt nätverk av ERP Super Users inom våra affärsområden Prioritera och driva förbättringsinitiativ tillsammans med verksamheten Arbeta nära ERP-leverantörer kring roadmap, utveckling och framtida funktionalitet Säkerställa framgångsrika ERP-uppgraderingar och implementationer och förändringsinitiativ Utveckla utbildningskoncept, kunskapsdelning och kompetensutveckling inom ERP-området Driva ERP-audits och säkerställa uppföljning av förbättringsåtgärder Identifiera och realisera möjligheter inom AI, generativ AI, AI-agenter, automation, RPA, EDI och low-code/no-code-plattformar Leda eller koordinera strategiska digitaliserings- och transformationsprojekt Utvärdera ny teknik och driva innovation inom ERP, data, automation och AI Stödja förvärvade bolag med digital due diligence, ERP-strategi och integrationsarbete Din profil/kompetens: Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av att leda förändring i skärningspunkten mellan verksamhet och IT. Du har erfarenhet av ERP-system och affärsprocesser. Därtill erfarenhet av digital transformation, verksamhetsutveckling eller förändringsledning. Du besitter en god förståelse för processutveckling, integrationer, data och automation och har dessutom ett starkt intresse för AI, generativ AI och framtidens digitala arbetssätt. Som van projektledare hanterar du komplexa förändringsinitiativ med en positiv attityd. Ditt kunnande, din professionalitet och din förmåga till samarbete skapar förtroende och engagemang hos både ledning, verksamhet och IT. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från tillverkningsindustrin, kunskap om Monitor ERP samt erfarenhet av att bygga eller implementera AI-agenter. Givetvis talar du obehindrat både svenska och engelska. Varför AQ? Inom AQ får du möjlighet att påverka på riktigt. AQ Group är en börsnoterad koncern med huvudkontor i Västerås. Vi är ett värderingsstyrt företag med korta beslutsvägar och prestigelös atmosfär. Hos oss får du möjligheten att vara en drivande kraft och utvecklas i en dynamisk koncern där initiativrikedom och genomförandeförmåga uppmärksammas och belönas. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att uppnå goda resultat. AQ Group har 8000 medarbetare globalt inom sju olika affärsområden med en total omsättning på över 9 miljarder SEK. För mer information, besök: www.aqgroup.com AQ:s värdegrund: Kunden i Fokus, Enkelhet, Entreprenörsanda, Kostnadseffektivitet, Mod & Respekt. Din ansökan: Urval sker löpande därför uppskattar vi om du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Dock senast 15 november. Frågor om tjänsten besvaras av rekryterande chef Fredrik Spännare via e-post: fredrik.spannare@aqgroup.com Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

items.desc: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. This is the Volvo Group Graduate Program A new era of manufacturing and R&D is here. Are you passionate about technology, eager to solve real business challenges, ready to drive innovation, and join our transformation journey? Then this Graduate program is for you! As part of the Graduate Program at Volvo Group, you will tackle real challenges from day one and contribute to the development of next-generation production solutions. The 15-month Graduate Program combines 50% time in your home department with 50% dedicated program activities, giving you broad exposure across Volvo Group. Through local and international rotations, short-term assignments and targeted training in areas such as operations, engineering and purchasing, you will build a strong understanding of our business, brands and strategy. The program also includes direct customer exposure and encourages collaboration, knowledge-sharing and an end-to-end mindset, enabling you to contribute to transformation across the organization from day one. Your future team Welcome to Volvo Trucks Technology Industrial Division (TTI) in Umeå. Our plant is one of the Volvo Groups largest plants with over 1800 employees and we are one of Northern Sweden’s largest industries. We produce cabs for Volvo Trucks, with everything from stamping sheet metal to welding and painting complete cabs. Our facility is one of the world’s most modern, with advanced technology and competent employees. You will join the BIW Maintenance Engineering team in Umeå, working closely with our other engineers, project teams and the larger Maintenance teams. How you’ll contribute The primary responsibilities will include working cross-functionally to synchronize maintenance methods and reinvestment needs. You will develop models that ensure maintainability in new facilities. Alongside other maintenance engineers, technicians, managers and colleagues, you will actively participate in, and drive the development of maintenance methods. Together, you will find the best solutions within our network at the Umeå factory and across other Volvo production units. We are on an exciting digitalization journey at the plant, creating real opportunities for development in the maintenance field, where data and IT are powerful tools. You will work with data analytics, machine learning and AI. This helps create the conditions for preventive and condition-based maintenance, enabling us to become more proactive. Who are you? We are looking for someone with a strong transformation and collaborative mindset who is eager to learn, explore and understand the business. You thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new challenges and ambiguity, and take ownership of your own development and growth. With strong analytical skills, you take initiatives and drive tasks forward with determination while bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to the team. You enjoy building relationships and leveraging a global network to create impact while working collaboratively across teams and functions. In addition, you contribute to a culture of continuous learning by actively sharing knowledge, exchanging insights and supporting the development of others. To qualify for the Graduate program, you: Have completed a bachelor or master’s degree prior to the start of the program but not more than three years ago. Should not have more than three years' full-time relevant working experience in the field prior to starting the program, excluding part-time work during studies. You have a relevant education within Mechanical, Automotive, Industrial Engineering, Civil Engineer or a related field Are fluent in Swedish and English, both written and verbal. Are willing to travel and participate in international short-term assignments Valid work or study permit for Sweden if not a citizen What’s in it for you? Our Volvo Group Graduate Program starts in August 2027, and you will be offered a permanent position at Volvo TTI Maintenance, with placement in Sweden, Umeå. These are some of the benefits of joining our program: An opportunity to work with the latest technology. An exciting and global working environment with experienced colleagues. Possibility to gain international experience through a short-term assignment abroad. A competitive salary and a permanent position from day one. Various workshops and seminars designed to help you grow into your future career at Volvo Group. The possibility to shape your own career with endless career opportunities. The application process The journey begins! An email confirmation will be sent when you submit your application. After this, it is still possible to update your personal profile by …

It combines flexible, location-independent part-time distance learning with an active, interdisciplinary research culture on its campus in Brig. Across five faculties – Law, Psychology, Business & Economics, History, and Mathematics & Computer Science – we have been shaping modern teaching, learning and research for more than 30 years. To strengthen and/or further develop its research competencies in educational technologies in distance learning settings, the research center for Learning and Instruction with Future Technologies (LIFT) is looking for a: Research Software Engineer in Educational Technologies (100 %) Place of work : Brig, partial remote working possible (within Switzerland) Start date: 1January 2027, or upon agreement Contract duration: 2 years (renewable) The research center for Learning and Instruction with Future Technologies (LIFT) is an interdisciplinary research center dedicated to research on learning and instruction in education. items.desc: Job title Research Fellow in Applied AI and Cybersecurity Job reference BEDS2978 Date posted 23/10/2026 Application closing date 15/11/2026 Location Luton Salary Grade 7 £40,704 - £48,337 Contract Full time Fixed Ter Contractual hours 35 Basis Full time Job category/type Research Attachments Blank Job information The University of Bedfordshire’s Luton AI initiative is seeking a talented Research Fellow in Applied AI and Cybersecurity to develop new approaches to identifying unmanaged wireless and Internet of Things (IoT) security threats. The post forms part of SAZT-Wi-Fi (Spatial-Aware Zero-Trust Platform for Shadow Wi-Fi IoT Threat Detection), an Innovate UK-funded project developing a standalone, plug-and-play cybersecurity proof of concept for critical infrastructure. About Luton AI Luton AI is the University of Bedfordshire's growing applied AI research and innovation initiative, connecting researchers, engineers and industry partners to solve real-world problems. Since 2024, we have engaged more than 600 organisations and undertaken over 60 bespoke AI projects, spanning aviation, public services, cybersecurity and critical infrastructure. Our expanding AI computing and cybersecurity facilities support the development of new technology, from early research to working demonstrators. You will join a collaborative, interdisciplinary team focused on turning ambitious technical ideas into useful, deployable solutions. About the role Working with Luton AI academics and industry partners, you will lead day-to-day technical development and integration of a working proof of concept combining Wi-Fi radio-frequency (RF) telemetry, machine learning, cybersecurity software and locally deployed AI for human-readable threat explanations. You will translate research into a functional demonstrator, with an emphasis on robust software, reproducible experimentation and evaluation in realistic environments. You will also participate in a core programme of behavioural development to enhance your skills and professional expertise and network with peers across the NDA group. You'll contribute to decommissioning projects, plant operations, safety assessments, inspections, design and maintenance, all while helping to develop and integrate cutting-edge technologies in a sector ripe with opportunity and challenge. items.desc: About Reserv Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you. About the Role We are seeking an experienced QA Analyst to join our Quality Assurance team. This is a strategic, client-facing role focused on identifying systemic issues before they impact our customers. You will conduct hypothesis-driven target audits, partner with account management teams, and drive root cause analysis that protects our commercial relationships and drives meaningful operational improvements. This role is perfect for someone who loves investigative work, has deep claims expertise, and wants to make a tangible impact on business outcomes. What You'll Do Proactive Issue Identification: Find problems before clients do by conducting strategic target audits across accounts, lines of business, and exposures Hypothesis-Driven Investigations: Develop and test hypotheses about potential quality issues, then execute detailed audits to validate findings Strategic Analysis: Conduct deep-dive, exposure-specific, LOB-specific, and client-specific reviews that require seasoned claims judgment Account Partnership: Participate in account management calls, discuss client expectations, and serve as a trusted quality advisor Root Cause Analysis: Lead root cause investigations with leadership teams, present findings with clear recommendations and action plans Accountability & Escalation: Follow through to ensure action plans are executed; escalate when teams don't follow through on required actions Collaboration: Work closely with the QA team on escalated issues and with leadership to drive systemic improvements What Makes This Role Unique Unlike traditional QA roles focused on individual file audits, this is focused on strategic and investigative claims handling. You'll have the autonomy to identify what to investigate, design your approach, and drive change at the account and organizational level. Your work directly protects revenue and strengthens client relationships. Required Qualifications Claims Experience: 3-5+ years of claims adjusting experience across multiple lines of business Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of exposures, coverage, and regulatory requirements QA/Audit Background: Previous quality assurance, audit, or quality review experience Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to identify patterns, trends, and root causes in complex data Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting findings to leadership Strategic Thinking: Ability to see both details and big picture; hypothesis development and problem-solving skills Preferred Qualifications Experience working across multiple client accounts or business units Track record of identifying and resolving systemic operational issues Client-facing or account management experience Experience with data analysis tools and dashboards Familiarity with AI/LLM tools in claims or quality processes Key Competencies Investigative Mindset: Natural curiosity about why issues occur, not just what occurred Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop hypotheses and design audits to test them Independence: Self-directed and comfortable working with ambiguity Influence: Can challenge leaders constructively with data-backed recommendations Detail-Oriented: Thorough in analysis while maintaining big-picture perspective Relationship Management: Builds trust with stakeholders at all levels Proactive: Takes initiative to surface issues before they escalate What Success Looks Like Identifying systemic issues before clients raise concerns Building trusted relationships with account managers and directors Driving measurable improvements in quality outcomes through root cause work Contributing strategic insights that inform operational decisions At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. As part of the Data Science Development team in Uppsala R&D, you will contribute to advancing data analysis capabilities for both external and internal use. This role offers the opportunity to work across the full product lifecycle, from concept development through post-launch support, applying cutting-edge data science and bioinformatics expertise. Advanced proficiency in R, Python, and SQL, for data processing, transformation, analysis, and automation. Demonstrated strong communication skills, both oral and written in English To succeed in this role, you need to have a strong analytical mind and an interest in modern statistical and data analysis methods including machine learning. If you are a team player with a curious and collaborative mindset and a passion for technology in the proteomics and life sciences field, we would love to hear back from you! items.desc: About The Role We’re looking for experienced software engineers to help develop ExecuTorch, PyTorch’s framework for running AI models efficiently on edge devices. You’ll join a team building software across AI model optimisation, compilers, runtimes and hardware acceleration. Our technology spans Python developer tools and ahead-of-time compilation through to portable C++ runtimes and hardware-accelerated backends, giving you the opportunity to contribute at different layers of the software stack. A key part of this role is understanding how AI models execute on hardware, identifying bottlenecks and improving cycle count, latency, memory use and power efficiency. You’ll move between high-level model transformations and low-level runtime and hardware behaviour to solve complex performance problems. ExecuTorch targets Arm technology including Mali GPUs with Neural Graphics, Cortex-A and Cortex-M CPUs, and Ethos-U NPUs. We contribute to ExecuTorch in the open and work with the wider PyTorch community to help developers deploy AI models efficiently across mobile, embedded and other resource-constrained platforms. What You’ll Do Develop and optimise components of the ExecuTorch compiler, runtime and developer tooling, ranging from Python APIs and model transformations to low-level C and C++ components. Analyse and profile AI workloads to identify bottlenecks, improving latency, memory use, cycle count and power efficiency across model transformations, generated code, runtimes and hardware backends. Develop optimised backends for Mali GPUs, Cortex-A and Cortex-M CPUs, Ethos-U NPUs and other edge platforms, while investigating software and performance challenges across the stack. Identify technical opportunities and take solutions from initial idea through delivery, working with engineers across Arm and contributors in the PyTorch open-source community. Share technical knowledge and, depending on your experience, contribute to technical projects and mentor other engineers. What We’re Looking For We’re looking for professional software engineering experience using C++ and Python, including developing, debugging and maintaining production-quality software. You’ll have knowledge of programming, compilers, runtimes or performance optimisation, along with an interest in understanding how software executes on hardware and how its efficiency can be improved. An interest in AI and deploying models on resource-constrained devices will also be valuable. You should be able to identify technical problems, determine a practical approach and take work through to completion. The role also requires good communication, technical judgement and the ability to work effectively with engineers across different teams. You don’t need to meet every preferred qualification. AI and edge computing are evolving quickly, and relevant experience can come from different technical areas. If you’re keen to develop your knowledge and tackle new technical challenges, we’d like to hear from you! Useful Additional Experience Experience with PyTorch, ExecuTorch or another machine-learning framework would be useful, as would knowledge of ahead-of-time compilers, graph transformation or model optimisation. We’re also interested in experience with embedded systems, mobile or edge computing, hardware-accelerator programming, performance analysis, Vulkan, open-source development, technical leadership or mentoring. Why Join the Team? Help develop open-source AI technology used by developers around the world! You’ll have opportunities to build expertise across AI software, compilers, runtimes and edge computing while solving problems that connect software directly with the underlying hardware. The breadth of the role allows you to explore both high-level AI frameworks and low-level hardware optimisation, improving performance and power efficiency across a wide range of edge devices. You’ll also work with specialists across Arm and the wider PyTorch ecosystem, with opportunities to develop and share your technical expertise. We support different needs and ways of working. If you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know and we’ll work with you to provide the support you need. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. items.card: you will turn data from systems including EDGE, Florence, Tableau and NIHR reporting platforms into clear, actionable intelligence. items.desc: We are looking for an experienced and motivated Data Scientist to join our Research and Innovation (R&I) Division. This is an exciting opportunity to use advanced analytics, predictive modelling and data visualisation to help shape the future of clinical research at The Christie. Working across a complex research portfolio, you will turn data from systems including EDGE, Florence, Tableau and NIHR reporting platforms into clear, actionable intelligence. You will work closely with R&I leaders, operational teams and colleagues across the wider Trust to improve visibility of the clinical trial pipeline, forecast demand, identify risks and capacity pressures, and support evidence-based decisions about workforce, resources and service development. We are seeking someone who can combine strong technical expertise with curiosity, sound judgement and the ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Please note that this role is hybrid working, with 2 days on site per week required. The post holder will collect, link, analyse and interpret large and complex datasets from multiple sources, ensuring that outputs are accurate, timely and meaningful. They will develop and maintain dashboards, reports, forecasts and analytical products for audiences including the R&I Leadership Team, ERIG, Trust Board, senior committees and external stakeholders. Using statistical and machine-learning techniques, the post holder will model future trial activity and demand, identify trends, inequalities, risks and capacity constraints, and translate findings into practical recommendations. This will support research performance, workforce and resource planning, patient recruitment, the national 150-day site set-up target, and improved diversity and inclusivity in research participation. The successful candidate will have substantial experience of data science, statistics or business intelligence, including strong skills in R, Python, TSQL, data modelling and visualisation. They will work autonomously and collaboratively, manage complex projects, maintain clear technical documentation, support safe change management, and ensure solutions comply with NHS data, information governance, security and quality standards. The role also includes providing technical guidance and line management support to junior staff. The Christie is one of Europe’s leading cancer centres, looking after more than 64,000 patients a year. We are based in Manchester and serve a population of 3.2 million across Greater Manchester & Cheshire, but as a national specialist around 25% patients are referred to us from other parts of the country. We are the largest radiotherapy provider in the NHS with one in 20 treatments delivered at The Christie. We have up to 15 linear accelerators operating across our network of sites. We operate the largest chemotherapy unit in the UK on our main site and treatments are also provided at 13 other networked sites, and in patients homes. And as a specialist tertiary surgical centre, we focus on rare cancers, complex procedures, and multidisciplinary approaches to cancer surgery, specialising in colorectal, peritoneal, gynaecological, urological and plastic surgery. We are also an international leader in research, with world first breakthroughs for over 100 years. We have been named by the UK’s National Institute for Health Research (NIHR), as one of the best hospitals providing opportunities for patients to participate in clinical research studies, with more than 800 studies open at any time, caring for over 3,000 patients. For further details / informal visits contact: Name: Kirstie Shearman Job title: R&I Service Manager Email address: Kirstie.shearman1@nhs.net

items.desc: About Us & The Product Jeppesen Foreflight is one of the largest software development companies in Gothenburg.We develop and implement innovative resource management and optimization solutions for the world’s leading airlines. We are dedicated to continuous improvement and delivering more value to our clients. At Jeppesen’s office in central Gothenburg you will work in a one-of-a-kind software development organization with solutions that make a real difference to people around the world. You will be working in an agile learning organization, surrounded by a team of talented, creative and dedicated colleagues. You will learn and broaden your perspective by working with 400 professionals from more than 50 different nations, but also be part of a global organization allowing for collaboration with customers and colleagues across the world. Most importantly, you will be expected to make a difference. How do we best use AI to keep our competitive edge? That question is very much alive across our organization right now. Our AI enablement team works closely with product teams across the organization. We don't deliver finished features ourselves — we help other teams understand what's possible, show them how to build it and support them along the way. The work is hands-on, collaborative and moves fast. About You You're a software developer or machine learning engineer who has gotten genuinely into generative AI. You've built things with it that actually work in production, and you understand what that takes. You're the kind of person who picks things up and runs with them. When something needs to happen, you figure out how to make it happen without waiting to be told. You ask when you're unsure, but then you move. You also like helping other developers grow. You contribute in meetings, you share what you know and you're comfortable jumping into an unfamiliar team and being useful quickly. You think about how your own work can be done better and faster, and you're already using AI tools to get there. You move between teams and contexts with ease, enjoy meeting new people and you're deliberate about how you hand over knowledge when you move on so that the value you created stays behind. What We Think You Have Drive to teach, coach and inspire others A solid software engineering foundation. You write code that others can read, test and build on. You think about clean interfaces and long-term maintainability, not just getting something to run. Real experience working with LLMs in practice like context management, tool calling, structured output, retrieval. You know which details matter when you need something to behave reliably, not just impressively. Experience building agents or agentic systems and an understanding of what makes them fail. You think about failure modes, state, fallbacks and how to know when something has gone wrong. Experience from the production phase of an AI product — not just shipping it, but the ongoing work of keeping it running, handling real edge cases and improving it based on how actual users interact with it. Some instinct for evals and observability. You care about whether what you shipped is actually working, and you've thought about how to measure that. Comfortable developing and running AI systems in a cloud environment. You don't need to be a cloud infrastructure specialist, but you need to be able to find your way around and get things deployed without being blocked. items.desc: Chez MBDA, le sens de notre mission est ce qui nous unit : contribuer à la souveraineté des nations et préserver notre sécurité et notre liberté en Europe. Pour y parvenir, la collaboration et la confiance sont essentielles. MBDA doit relever des défis uniques pour répondre aux besoins des forces armées face à de nouvelles menaces. Motivés par les challenges technologiques, nous repoussons les limites de l’innovation, de la science et de la technologie pour développer des solutions au meilleur niveau. Nous encourageons le dépassement de soi dans un environnement unique qui offre des opportunités à chacun d’entre nous. Ensemble, nous sommes fiers du rôle que nous jouons. Au sein de la Direction Technical, vous rejoignez le Centre d'Excellence franco-britannique dédié aux senseurs de navigation. Vous participez au développement de technologies de navigation de haute précision intégrées aux systèmes de défense de nouvelle génération. Au sein d'une équipe d'une quinzaine d'ingénieur(e)s, vous intervenez sur la conception, la modélisation et la validation d'algorithmes embarqués pour des récepteurs GNSS et des fonctions de navigation résistantes aux environnements les plus exigeants. Vous évoluez dans un environnement fortement technique, au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires (antennes, traitement du signal, électronique, système, essais...) et bénéficiez d'un accompagnement technique vous permettant de développer rapidement votre expertise sur le domaine GNSS. Au Sein De L'équipe, Vous Participez Au Développement Des Futures Solutions De Navigation En Intervenant Sur L'ensemble De La Chaîne D'études Pour concevoir, développer et valider des algorithmes de traitement du signal appliqués aux systèmes GNSS ; réaliser des études de performances, des simulations numériques et des modélisations sous MATLAB/Simulink ou C/C++ ; analyser les résultats d'essais (simulation, laboratoire, vols ou tirs) afin de valider les performances des solutions développées ; contribuer à l'intégration des algorithmes dans les équipements et les modèles de référence ; participer aux investigations techniques et au traitement des faits techniques en collaboration avec les différents métiers ; assurer le suivi technique de certaines activités confiées à des partenaires externes ; rédiger la documentation technique et présenter vos travaux aux équipes projets. Des déplacements sont à prévoir sur les sites de Bourges et Selles Saint Denis. Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en radiofréquences, traitement du signal ou télécommunications, vous justifiez d'une première expérience (stage, apprentissage ou premier emploi) en conception d'algorithmes, modélisation ou développement de systèmes RF. Vous possédez des connaissances en traitement du signal, radiofréquences ou systèmes de navigation . Des compétences en MATLAB, Simulink et/ou C/C++ seront appréciées. Une expertise préalable en GNSS n'est pas indispensable : vous bénéficierez dès votre arrivée d'un accompagnement et d'un parcours de formation dédié pour monter progressivement en compétences. Curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et doté(e) d'un bon esprit d'analyse, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et les environnements techniques multidisciplinaires. Un niveau d'anglais professionnel est requis. 🛰️ Développer des algorithmes de navigation de pointe au cœur des futurs systèmes de défense. 🎓 Bénéficier d'un accompagnement technique et d'une montée en compétences sur les technologies GNSS auprès d'une équipe d'experts. 🤝 Évoluer dans un environnement pluridisciplinaire mêlant traitement du signal, radiofréquences, modélisation, essais et ingénierie système. Notre rémunération comporte un salaire fixe et des éléments additionnels individuels (une part variable pour nos salariés cadres et une prime d’ancienneté ainsi qu’une prime annuelle pour nos salariés non-cadres) ou collectifs dépendant de la performance et des résultats de l’entreprise (participation, intéressement). De nombreux services/avantages sont également proposés : restaurant d’entreprise, épargne salariale (PEG, PERCOL), protection sociale (mutuelle et prévoyance), comité social et économique, infirmerie et service de santé au travail interne...

items.desc: The way people discover and book holidays is changing, and we're rebuilding our technology for what comes next. We are Awaze, Europe’s largest managed vacation rentals and holiday resorts business, bringing together some of the continent’s most recognised travel brands, including cottages.com, Hoseasons, NOVASOL and James Villa Holidays. With more than 1.5 million bookings every year, 100,000+ properties and customers across Europe, we already operate at serious scale. But the next chapter for Awaze is about much more than scale. We’re embarking on an ambitious AI transformation that will reshape how our customers discover, plan and book their holidays, and how our engineering teams build the technology behind those experiences. Our strategy spans AI-powered search, natural-language discovery, intelligent recommendations, richer property data and AI-assisted engineering, all underpinned by a platform built around speed, trust, quality and real-time data. Position: Data Scientist We're looking for an exceptional product-minded Data Scientist who can build and operate warehouse-based ML pipelines, design decision-relevant metrics and experiments, and reason about ranking well enough to decide what should be modelled, monitored and changed. The role will extend Awaze's existing sort-order capability: training tabular propensity models; combining their outputs with commercial and customer criteria through multi-criteria scoring; tuning and evaluating criteria and weights; and designing reliable ranking outputs for Search and other customer surfaces. This is primarily a Data Science role rather than a pure ML Engineering role. Strong engineering practice is essential, but the differentiator is the ability to connect models, experiments and business decisions: formulate hypotheses, distinguish prediction from causal impact, understand interactions between ranking, price, promotion and channel decisions, and turn evidence into a product recommendation. The data scientist will also own work beyond initial delivery: stakeholder discovery, roadmap shaping, experiment readouts, production monitoring, documentation, mentoring and knowledge transfer. A bit more about what you'll be doing: Building intelligent ranking and recommendation capabilities Develop, improve and operate Machine Learning models that predict customer preferences, propensity to book and property relevance. Evolve our existing ranking capability using Python, CatBoost, optimisation techniques and multi-criteria decision-making. Explore more advanced ranking approaches, including personalised search, destination-specific ranking and recommendation systems. Balance multiple commercial and customer objectives, including conversion, relevance, pricing, margin and inventory exposure. Design reliable ML pipelines and ensure model outputs can be effectively integrated into customer-facing products. Driving experimentation and commercial impact Design and run A/B tests to understand how ranking changes influence customer behaviour and business outcomes. Partner with Product and Commercial teams to define hypotheses, success metrics and measurable business opportunities. Apply statistical reasoning and causal thinking to distinguish correlation, predictive performance and genuine incremental impact. Evaluate trade-offs between ranking, pricing, promotions, inventory and marketing decisions. Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations that influence product and commercial strategy. Building scalable, production-ready Data Science Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines using Python, SQL, Snowflake and AWS. Establish robust model evaluation, monitoring, alerting and retraining processes. Develop reporting tools and dashboards that provide visibility into model performance and commercial outcomes. Apply strong engineering practices across version control, testing, documentation and production deployment. Improve existing systems pragmatically while laying the foundations for more advanced capabilities. Who We're Looking For: We're looking for someone who combines strong applied Data Science expertise with commercial curiosity, product thinking and the ability to turn insight into action. You'll ideally bring: Strong hands-on experience developing and deploying Machine Learning models using Python. Advanced SQL skills and experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data platform. Experience implementing and evaluating ranking models, recommendation systems or optimisation solutions. Exposure to search relevance, learning-to-rank, recommender systems or personalisation. A strong understanding of A/B testing, statistical experimentation, hypothesis testing and causal reasoning. Experience designing meaningful product and commercial metrics, including guardrails and experiment success measures. Knowledge of multi-criteria optimisation, weighted scoring or similar decision-making approaches. Experience building and operating …

items.desc: Vill du vara med att utveckla framtidens kraftsystem? Om tjänsten Som Data Scientist inom Kapacitetsmodeller har du en central roll i att utveckla metoder för att analysera och höja kvaliteten på de prognosticerade modeller enheten skapar. Rollen är en kombination av analys, utveckling och verksamhetsnära förbättringsarbete där du bidrar till att höja kvaliteten och träffsäkerheten i våra modeller. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: analysera stora datamängder för att identifiera förbättringsområden och säkerställa kvaliteten i de modeller och prognoser som verksamheten använder utveckla metoder, verktyg och applikationer för uppföljning, analys och kontinuerlig kvalitetsutveckling av modeller och data driva analyser som ligger till grund för framtida utveckling och förbättringar av modeller, arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar identifiera behov av nya eller vidareutvecklade lösningar samt ta fram krav, följa upp och kvalitetssäkra leveranser från externa leverantörer vid behov delta i och bidra till arbetsgrupper både internt och nordiskt för att utveckla metoder, processer och lösningar inom området självständigt driva ansvarsområden och förändringsinitiativ från analys och idé till genomförande och uppföljning. Du får möjlighet att utveckla enhetens strategi kring hur analyser kan appliceras på kraftsystem för att generera insikter om hur data påverkar utfallet och framför allt uträknade kapaciteter i systemet. Du får även möjlighet att utvecklas genom kunskapsutbyte med nordiska systemoperatörer samt genom relevanta utbildningar och kurser inom kraftsystemanalys. Du kommer att tillhöra enheten Kapacitetsmodeller som består av 10 medarbetare och är organiserad i tre team: operativt team, utvecklingsteam och produktägarteam. Samtidigt är du samarbetsorienterad och trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med andra för att nå gemensamma mål och driva utveckling framåt. Du ska också leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden. I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Our technology spans Python developer tools and ahead-of-time compilation through to portable C++ runtimes and hardware-accelerated backends, giving you the opportunity to contribute at different layers of the software stack. A key part of this role is understanding how AI models execute on hardware, identifying bottlenecks and improving cycle count, latency, memory use and power efficiency. You’ll move between high-level model transformations and low-level runtime and hardware behaviour to solve complex performance problems. ExecuTorch targets Arm technology including Mali GPUs with Neural Graphics, Cortex-A and Cortex-M CPUs, and Ethos-U NPUs. We contribute to ExecuTorch in the open and work with the wider PyTorch community to help developers deploy AI models efficiently across mobile, embedded and other resource-constrained platforms. What You’ll Do Develop and optimise components of the ExecuTorch compiler, runtime and developer tooling, ranging from Python APIs and model transformations to low-level C and C++ components. Analyse and profile AI workloads to identify bottlenecks, improving latency, memory use, cycle count and power efficiency across model transformations, generated code, runtimes and hardware backends. Develop optimised backends for Mali GPUs, Cortex-A and Cortex-M CPUs, Ethos-U NPUs and other edge platforms, while investigating software and performance challenges across the stack. Identify technical opportunities and take solutions from initial idea through delivery, working with engineers across Arm and contributors in the PyTorch open-source community. Share technical knowledge and, depending on your experience, contribute to technical projects and mentor other engineers. What We’re Looking For We’re looking for professional software engineering experience using C++ and Python, including developing, debugging and maintaining production-quality software. You’ll have knowledge of programming, compilers, runtimes or performance optimisation, along with an interest in understanding how software executes on hardware and how its efficiency can be improved. An interest in AI and deploying models on resource-constrained devices will also be valuable. You should be able to identify technical problems, determine a practical approach and take work through to completion. The role also requires good communication, technical judgement and the ability to work effectively with engineers across different teams. You don’t need to meet every preferred qualification. AI and edge computing are evolving quickly, and relevant experience can come from different technical areas. If you’re keen to develop your knowledge and tackle new technical challenges, we’d like to hear from you! Useful Additional Experience Experience with PyTorch, ExecuTorch or another machine-learning framework would be useful, as would knowledge of ahead-of-time compilers, graph transformation or model optimisation. We’re also interested in experience with embedded systems, mobile or edge computing, hardware-accelerator programming, performance analysis, Vulkan, open-source development, technical leadership or mentoring. Why Join the Team? Help develop open-source AI technology used by developers around the world! You’ll have opportunities to build expertise across AI software, compilers, runtimes and edge computing while solving problems that connect software directly with the underlying hardware. The breadth of the role allows you to explore both high-level AI frameworks and low-level hardware optimisation, improving performance and power efficiency across a wide range of edge devices. You’ll also work with specialists across Arm and the wider PyTorch ecosystem, with opportunities to develop and share your technical expertise. We support different needs and ways of working. If you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know and we’ll work with you to provide the support you need. Please note that no relocation package is available for this role. Our 10x Mindset At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. items.desc: Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. Role Overview: As a Data Scientist, you will help measure the impact of PlayStation's products, features and commercial initiatives through experimentation, causal inference and applied data science. Working at the intersection of data science, machine learning, product and commercial strategy, you will apply robust analytical techniques to solve complex business problems, generate actionable insights and support evidence-based decision-making across PlayStation. This role goes beyond traditional A/B testing. You will apply modern causal inference, statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to evaluate initiatives where controlled experiments are difficult or impossible, collaborating closely with product, engineering, analytics and business teams to deliver high-quality measurement and insights. This is an opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives affecting millions of PlayStation players while developing your expertise in experimentation, causal inference and applied data science. What You'll Be Doing: Apply measurement methodologies across experimentation, causal inference and advanced analytics to evaluate product and commercial initiatives. Design and execute robust measurement approaches across randomised experiments, quasi-experimental methods and observational causal inference where controlled experimentation is impractical. Apply statistical, machine learning and AI techniques to solve complex measurement challenges and generate actionable business insights. Apply advanced data science and machine learning techniques where appropriate to complement experimentation and support complex business decisions. Contribute to the development and adoption of best practices for experiment design, statistical analysis and causal measurement. Partner closely with product managers, engineers, analysts and business stakeholders to identify high-impact measurement opportunities and ensure product and commercial decisions are supported by rigorous evidence. Collaborate with engineering teams by providing feedback on experimentation and measurement capabilities to improve tooling and workflows. Develop reusable analytical solutions, dashboards and code that improve the quality, consistency and efficiency of measurement. Communicate analytical findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Stay current with emerging developments in statistics, machine learning and AI, identifying opportunities to improve measurement capabilities and analytical workflows. Contribute to a culture of evidence-based decision-making by sharing knowledge, collaborating across teams and promoting analytical best practices. What We're Looking For: Required: Master's degree (or equivalent industry experience) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science or another quantitative discipline. PhD preferred. 3+ years of industry experience applying experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling, machine learning or related analytical techniques to solve business problems. Good understanding of experimental design, A/B testing and modern causal inference methods, including quasi-experimental approaches. Experience applying data science, machine learning and statistical modelling techniques to analyse complex datasets and generate actionable insights. Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for analytical workflows. Experience developing robust analytical solutions using sound statistical principles and software engineering best practices. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Curiosity, creativity and a pragmatic approach to solving ambiguous business problems. A collaborative mindset with a passion for continuous learning and improving analytical capabilities. Preferred: Experience working in gaming, digital products, consumer technology, e-commerce or subscription businesses. Familiarity with modern data engineering and analytics tooling such as Databricks, Snowflake, Git and Airflow. Experience with modern business intelligence and data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Domo or Power BI. Experience applying AI tools, including large …

By focusing on the outcomes that matter most to our customers, we are also working towards our ambition to be the National Leader in sustainable water and wastewater services. We are building a dedicated team to create our PR29 business plan, which will set out what we will deliver for customers and the environment, and the investment needed to achieve it, between 2030 and 2035. We are recruiting a number of key roles to join this team, offering an exciting opportunity to work with colleagues across Northumbrian Water, influence important decisions and help develop an ambitious and compelling plan that delivers lasting value for our customers and communities. About The Role We have new opportunities for Asset Modelling Data Scientists who will play a key role in delivering solutions to strategic, tactical and operational business challenges through data analytics, statistical modelling, simulation and optimisation. Working within the Asset modelling team, the role uses asset, operational and business data to identify trends, forecast future performance, model investment scenarios, inform PR29 planning and provide evidence-based recommendations to decision makers. You will work collaboratively and build positive relationships with stakeholders including operational, maintenance and planning teams to improve data quality, strengthen modelling approaches, transfer knowledge and encourage innovation in analytical decision making. You will develop, maintain and enhance asset performance, deterioration and forecasting models and apply optimisation techniques to identify the most efficient intervention and investment solutions. items.desc: We are seeking a motivated and collaborative individual to join our team as a Research Associate in Indoor Air Quality . This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the Retrofit Advanced Materials & Manufacturing Innovation Centre (RAMMIC), a major collaborative research and innovation programme supported through the UKRI Local Innovation Partnership Fund. RAMMIC brings together Greater Manchester capabilities in building performance, advanced materials, indoor air quality, acoustics, environmental sustainability assessment, and innovation support to establish a collaborative innovation ecosystem for smart and sustainable retrofit products and processes. You will be responsible for: Develop and lead research examining indoor air quality within retrofit environments at the Energy House. Design experimental protocols for evaluating retrofit products, materials, ventilation systems and other interventions. Undertake measurements in Energy House facilities and other project locations. Deploy, operate and maintain appropriate sensor systems and research-grade atmospheric instrumentation. Work closely with the Research Associate in Sustainable Materials to coordinate experiments and integrate indoor air-quality and material-sustainability evidence. We welcome candidates who bring diverse perspectives, experiences, and approaches to their work. About You We encourage applications from individuals with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. You should demonstrate: Essential Criteria Have, or be about to obtain, a PhD or equivalent qualification in atmospheric science, or a very closely related discipline. Specialist knowledge of atmospheric composition measurements and their application to indoor or outdoor air quality. Demonstrable experience of designing and undertaking atmospheric measurement studies. Experience of quantitative data processing, quality assurance, analysis and interpretation. Understanding of the physical and chemical processes influencing indoor air quality. Desirable Criteria Experience of indoor air-quality measurements in homes, test buildings or other occupied environments. Experience of online mass spectrometry, including Chemical Ionisation Mass Spectrometry, or other advanced gas- or particle-phase measurement techniques. Knowledge of emissions from building materials, consumer products or retrofit interventions. Experience of investigating ventilation, damp, mould related indoor air-quality problems. Experience of controlled intervention studies or building-performance experiments. We value transferable skills and real-world experience as much as formal qualifications. Our benefits include: Generous employer contribution pension 29 days annual leave plus bank holidays, along with Christmas closure Ride to work and EV car scheme available For more information, please see University of Manchester Benefits. You can also find information on our Flexible and Hybrid working arrangements. We are an open place of enquiry and challenge. We embrace and celebrate difference, diversity and debate, and we pride ourselves on being a place of education, learning and community where we are able, within the law, to question and test received wisdom, express new ideas and explore controversial or unpopular topics and opinions. Enquiries About The Role, Shortlisting And Interviews Name: Thomas Bannan Email Address: thomas.bannan@manchester.ac.uk General enquiries and administrative support recruitmentservices.people@manchester.ac.uk Technical and job portal support Jobtrain Client Support Hub Applications close at midnight on the closing date. items.card: Cosa farai Entrerai nel nostro team tecnico, lavorando a stretto contatto con il CTO e con gli sviluppatori che ogni giorno portano in produzione modelli e microservizi AI. Ti occuperai principalmente di: Sviluppare applicazioni di Agentic AI, integrando e orchestrando OpenAI, Gemini e modelli open-source per creare sistemi intelligenti capaci di ragionare, pianificare e agire in autonomia. Sperimentare e fare
items.desc: 👋 Chi siamo Siamo m-ai, una startup italiana che sviluppa software basati su Intelligenza Artificiale. Il nostro team è ancora piccolo ma con una visione molto grande: rendere la potenza dell’AI accessibile, utile e produttiva per risolvere problemi del mondo reale. Cerchiamo qualcuno che abbia voglia di crescere insieme a noi, imparando sul campo come progettare soluzioni intelligenti che automatizzano processi, comprendono documenti, analizzano immagini e alimentano sistemi di ricerca, raccomandazione e decision-making. 🎯 Cosa farai Entrerai nel nostro team tecnico, lavorando a stretto contatto con il CTO e con gli sviluppatori che ogni giorno portano in produzione modelli e microservizi AI. Ti occuperai principalmente di: Sviluppare applicazioni di Agentic AI, integrando e orchestrando OpenAI, Gemini e modelli open-source per creare sistemi intelligenti capaci di ragionare, pianificare e agire in autonomia. Sperimentare e fare fine-tuning di reti neurali (es. BERT, ViT, Yolo, Stable Diffusion) su dataset reali. Sperimentare con piccoli LLM e pipeline di fine-tuning, esplorando il bilanciamento tra velocità, accuratezza e costo. Costruire e containerizzare API con FastAPI, Redis e Docker, ottimizzate per velocità e scalabilità. Portare le idee dal prototipo al prodotto, sviluppando interfacce interattive web e desktop in Next.js e PyQt/PySide che connettono utenti e modelli di AI in tempo reale. Lavorare su infrastrutture cloud moderne (Azure, AWS) per il deployment, il monitoraggio e l’ottimizzazione di microservizi e workload GPU. 🔍 Sei quello giusto se Sei uno studente o neolaureato in Informatica, Ingegneria, Data Science (o qualcosa di simile) e hai una vera passione per l’AI. Hai un pensiero analitico: ragioni per principi, scomponi i problemi e vai dritto al punto. Hai curiosità e grinta e ti piace sperimentare, imparare e vedere le cose prendere forma grazie a ciò che costruisci. Hai solide basi tecniche: sai smanettare con Python, API e framework di machine learning senza paura di rompere qualcosa (e poi sistemarlo meglio). Ti senti a tuo agio lavorando in autonomia, ma anche in squadra, condividendo idee e risultati. 🛠️ Stack & Skillset Linguaggi: Python (obbligatorio), JavaScript/TypeScript Framework: FastAPI, Next.js, PyQt/PySide AI/ML: PyTorch, transformers, yolo, diffusion models Cloud: Azure / AWS (Functions, EC2, S3, Container Apps) Plus: conoscenza di C++ e curiosità verso GPU, CUDA, ottimizzazione dei modelli ❤️ Cosa offriamo Uno stage vero e retribuito, non da spettatore: lavorerai fianco a fianco con il CTO su progetti AI che vanno davvero in produzione. Un ambiente ad alta intensità, dove si impara tanto e in fretta, costruendo cose che hanno un impatto reale (niente demo da laboratorio). Libertà totale di sperimentare, proporre e costruire: se hai un’idea, la testiamo insieme. Un percorso chiaro di crescita e integrazione in azienda dopo lo stage. Lavoro ibrido, orari flessibili e massima autonomia: ci interessa cosa realizzi, non da dove lavori o quante ore stai davanti al monitor (anche se sei in spiaggia va bene, basta che il Wi-Fi regga). Presenza in sede, seppur flessibili crediamo molto nel rapporto umano e che questo si possa consolidare in ufficio, quindi ci farebbe piacere garantissi una presenza di 8 giorni al mese presso il nostro ufficio di Grottaglie (Taranto). RAL: 26k-30k Non ci piacciono le gerarchie rigide, preferiamo persone che si prendono responsabilità, fanno domande, provano e migliorano.
