items.card: Vos missions Transformer les opérations R&D grâce à l’automatisation et à l’intelligence artificielle, afin d’améliorer la productivité des équipes, d’accélérer la résolution des problèmes et de renforcer la qualité des produits SIMULIA : Automatiser et optimiser les validations logicielles Contribuer à l’automatisation et à l’industrialisation des validations pour garantir la qualité et la fiabilité des produits
items.desc: Au sein de la R&D SIMULIA de Dassault Systèmes, vous rejoindrez l’équipe SIMULIA RelOps, au cœur du développement et de la validation de nos solutions logicielles de simulation. Vous évoluerez dans une équipe dynamique et conviviale, où l’entraide, le partage des connaissances et la collaboration sont essentiels. Vous contribuerez à des projets concrets de transformation de la R&D par l’intelligence artificielle, avec l’opportunité de proposer vos idées, d’explorer de nouvelles technologies et d’améliorer la productivité des équipes. Un environnement international stimulant, qui encourage les initiatives, la curiosité et l’expérimentation, tout en offrant de belles opportunités de progression technique. Vos missions Transformer les opérations R&D grâce à l’automatisation et à l’intelligence artificielle, afin d’améliorer la productivité des équipes, d’accélérer la résolution des problèmes et de renforcer la qualité des produits SIMULIA : Automatiser et optimiser les validations logicielles Contribuer à l’automatisation et à l’industrialisation des validations pour garantir la qualité et la fiabilité des produits SIMULIA. Identifier les tâches répétitives et optimiser les processus pour réduire les interventions manuelles et accélérer les cycles de validation. Accélérer la transformation par l’IA Identifier et développer des cas d’usage de l’IA, notamment générative, pour améliorer l’efficacité des opérations et des équipes de développement. Explorer l’automatisation de l’analyse des logs, la synthèse des résultats de validation et l’identification des causes de régression. Prototyper et industrialiser des solutions permettant de réduire les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et de mesurer les gains de productivité. Exploiter les données pour anticiper les anomalies Analyser les données de validation et les diagnostics pour détecter les anomalies, identifier les tendances et prévenir les régressions. Évaluer les approches statistiques et de Machine Learning pour améliorer les diagnostics. Vos Qualifications Titulaire d’un Bac+5 en informatique, école d’ingénieurs ou cursus universitaire équivalent, vous disposez idéalement d’une première expérience en développement logiciel. Vous avez un intérêt pour la qualité logicielle, l’automatisation et l’amélioration de la productivité grâce à l’IA. Vous possédez des connaissances en Python et C++, ainsi qu’un intérêt pour le Machine Learning, le Deep Learning et l’IA générative. Vous faites preuve de curiosité, d'autonomie, vous aimez analyser des problèmes complexes et transformer des idées en améliorations concrètes. Vous maîtrisez l’anglais à l’écrit comme à l’oral dans un contexte professionnel international. Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement multiculturel Cadre de travail convivial axé sur le bien-être et la santé (salles de sport & de musique, conciergerie…) Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Politique dynamique de développement de carrière : plan de formation, mobilités internes, etc Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

items.desc: As a Graduate Quantitative Trader, you will undergo an extensive six-month training program that combines advanced theory with hands-on market-making experience. Your journey includes : First 4 Weeks : Mastering the fundamentals of options theory, trading systems, and tools through engaging lectures and hands-on shadowing sessions led by our experienced traders. Next Phase : Applying your knowledge by contributing to a research or development project aligned with your assigned desk’s current focus, working under the close guidance of a mentor quant, and supported by ongoing coaching, technical training, and performance feedback. In this role, you will: Learn options theory and our business operations, then apply them by researching and designing systematic strategies rather than trading by hand. Build and backtest signals, pricing tools, and automated trading algorithms, and take them from idea to production within your first months. Spend most of your time on research and development: analysing data, testing hypotheses, and finding statistical edge. Monitor live strategy performance, diagnose why it deviates from expectations, and improve it. Enhance and extend our pricing models and volatility analytics. Own and improve core parts of the codebase and tech stack (Python/C++ etc., adjust to your stack). Programming is a daily, central part of the job, not a side task. Contribute to P&L through the strategies and tools you build; your impact is measured by the quality and performance of your systematic work rather than by discretionary trading calls. Your Profile: A Master’s degree or higher in a quantitative field: STEM, Statistics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance (or related fields). Strong interest in option trading and financial markets, demonstrated through courses attended and/or experience. Result-driven and able to prioritize. Strong at pattern recognition. You excel at applying theoretical knowledge to practical challenges. Coding is second nature to you, with Python experience considered a valuable asset. Ready to excel in a fast-paced environment. Excellent verbal and written English skills. Currently based in Europe. Why Join All Options? At All Options, we offer a dynamic role with room for growth, collaboration, and recognition. Enjoy a competitive salary, bonus opportunities, profit sharing, 29 vacation days, and perks like a well-being allowance and in-house meals. Celebrate success with monthly drinks and festivities, and take advantage of our bicycle plan, NS Business Card, and the option to work from abroad. Apply Now! If this sounds like your next challenge, submit your CV and cover letter. Our interview process ensures we find the right fit—and if it’s a match, we can’t wait to welcome you to the team! About the cover letter: Think of your cover letter as the part of your application where you add value, not repetition. We are not interested in a summary of your CV. Instead, tell us: What excites you about the role beyond “markets”, "fast-paced and dynamic environment", "applying theory in practice" and “problem-solving”? Finish your letter with the following sentence: "I want to become a trader because…" Ask yourself: Why should we remember you after screening hundreds of applications? Surprise us with something genuine. Share a motivation, experience, or perspective that does not appear on your CV. Available start dates: March and September 2027 Please apply to only one of our graduate roles. If you apply to both, we will assign you to one recruitment process, as candidates cannot take part in both processes simultaneously. Note that candidates who are unsuccessful at any stage of the selection process will not be reconsidered for the same or a similar role for a period of six months.

items.desc: Job Description Be a part of the data revolution in sports! This is a great opportunity to join our growing Data Science and BI developer team. Our team is responsible for the development and operations of both our internal and customer-facing reporting and dashboard solutions, as well as our data science and machine learning products. We are focused on making our rich tracking data more actionable to customers as well as supporting our internal product development and operations with useful insights. We also use our data to develop data science and machine learning solutions that enhance our product experiences. In collaboration with our cutting-edge radar and computer vision-based tracking technology, we are building products used by the best athletes in the world. Example Projects We Are Working On Reporting for environmental variations between stadium tracking locations based on athlete performance models and statistical analysis Dashboards for trends and detecting outliers in radar tracking and computer vision diagnostics across thousands of remote devices Translating ball tracking metrics into coaching-orientated measures to help amateur athletes improve their performance Supervised learning models to suggest both practice and gameplay recommendations to make our sophisticated products easier to use Vision-based person detection combined with predicting the position they play on the field for game strategy Your Profile You have hands-on experience working with data day to day in SQL and python, from the fundamentals of loading, ETL, and pipeline automation to answering ad-hoc questions from the business and operations teams. You have experience developing reports and dashboards to address the questions that are reoccurring. You are familiar with using a developer tool stack and operating in a scrum team. You also have experience using data science modelling techniques to derive next-level insight from data, as well as an appreciation for running machine learning in production. Your focus is on the practical outcome and value to the business of using data to inform everything we do. You like working in an international team across many cultures. You like sports. Responsibilities Develop internal and customer-facing BI reports and dashboards Use dimensional modelling to develop database schemas and semantic layers Manage data warehouse data pipeline automation rules, ensure smooth operations Work with our Data Engineers to acquire and prepare working data, initial data cleaning, statistical analysis, and mining Interface with product owners, operations, and developers to refine requirements Identify and perform data science model selection, feature engineering, and tuning, develop an experiment based and evaluation workflow, package for production Job Requirements A strong educational background where coursework required heavy use of data and a scientific or engineering based workflows Experience with data processing, preparation, cleansing, and mining, in SQL and Python Experience developing dashboards and reports in a BI toolset Experience with applying data science and machine learning methods and move across a variety of unsupervised and supervised approaches, experience with NumPy, pandas, sci-kit learn Working in a fast-paced, team-based environment also demands a certain degree of self-planning, as well as the ability to work independently. Your colleagues are highly skilled, innovative, and proactive in their work approach. They possess strong analytical skills, are good communicators in English, and take pride in their job and deliverables. The Office We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff. Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work. Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead …

items.desc: Per un importante Cliente operante nel settore Energy & Utilities , siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Data Engineer / Machine Learning Engineer da inserire all'interno di un contesto tecnologicamente complesso, con particolare riferimento alle tecnologie cloud e alle soluzioni di Data Intelligence. La risorsa contribuirà allo sviluppo e all'evoluzione di soluzioni per la gestione e l'elaborazione dei dati, collaborando alle attività di sviluppo e manutenzione evolutiva di modelli e componenti di Machine Learning. Principali attività Sviluppo e gestione di soluzioni per l'elaborazione e la trasformazione dei dati. Progettazione e implementazione di pipeline per l'elaborazione dei dati. Sviluppo, integrazione e manutenzione evolutiva di modelli e componenti di Machine Learning. Utilizzo di servizi e componenti dell'ecosistema AWS a supporto delle attività progettuali. Collaborazione con i team tecnici per l'evoluzione e l'ottimizzazione delle soluzioni esistenti. Supporto alla gestione di architetture e processi di elaborazione dati in contesti cloud. Requisiti richiesti Esperienza professionale in ambito Data Engineering e/o Machine Learning Engineering . Buona conoscenza dell'ecosistema AWS e dei relativi servizi cloud. Esperienza nello sviluppo e nella gestione di soluzioni per l'elaborazione dei dati e/o di componenti di Machine Learning. Familiarità con processi di integrazione, trasformazione ed elaborazione dei dati. Buone capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di gestione delle attività assegnate. Attitudine al lavoro in team e capacità di operare in contesti progettuali strutturati. Requisiti preferenziali Conoscenza di Apache Spark e delle tecnologie per l'elaborazione distribuita dei dati. Esperienza con Databricks . Familiarità con architetture e soluzioni di Data Intelligence in ambiente cloud. Esperienza nella manutenzione evolutiva di modelli e componenti di Machine Learning. Offerta economica e inquadramento Il tipo di contratto proposto sarà a tempo indeterminato. Retribuzione: Range RAL €27.000 - €38.000 + ticket restaurant + welfare aziendale. La proposta verrà definita in funzione dell'esperienza maturata e delle competenze tecniche possedute. Modalità di lavoro Full Remote, dall'Italia ___ La job position è aperta a tutti i generi nel rispetto di quanto disposto dal d.lgs 198/2006. ___ Rispondendo al presente annuncio/email, la società Niuma srl, Titolare del Trattamento, otterrà i Suoi dati definiti dal GDPR (regolamento UE 2016/679) "dati personali". L'informativa estesa ai sensi dell'art. 13 del GDPR è reperibile sul sito internet all'indirizzo https://www.niuma.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/GDPR_Informativa_CV25.pdf , alla quale si fa espresso richiamo, intendendosi qui come espressamente trascritta e riportata. Si specifica in ogni caso: (A) I dati sono trattati e conservati in relazione a finalità connesse ad esigenze di recruiting e contrattuali e verranno trattati per la durata delle attività di recruiting, anche non inerenti il presente annuncio. La base giuridica del trattamento è la volontà del candidato di sostenere un colloquio professionale. Il consenso al trattamento è condizione necessaria per le finalità sopra descritte. Pertanto, il trattamento non potrà essere effettuato senza il consenso dell'interessato. (B) La nostra società effettua operazioni di trattamento sui dati anagrafici su supporti informatici e cartacei; i dati personali saranno trattati internamente alla società titolare del trattamento e non ceduti a terzi; (C) In qualità di interessato, il candidato è titolare dei diritti di cui all'art. 15 del GDPR, che potranno essere esercitati mettendosi in contatto con Niuma S.r.l. all'indirizzo privacy-policy@niuma.it.

items.desc: Hybrid in London, United Kingdom We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Credit Cards team. You'll build the credit risk, pricing, and customer lifetime value models behind iwoca's business credit card – who gets a card, with what features, and at what rate. The Company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team iwoca launched its business credit card at the start of 2026. It gives small businesses a fast, flexible way to pay for what they need and control their cash flow, alongside iwoca's loans. The card is a core part of iwoca's long-term growth. The Credit Cards team builds the card on iwoca's existing lending infrastructure and customer base. The team is made up of commercial strategy product, engineering, operations, and a data scientists. The role As a Data Scientist in Credit Cards, you'll do the analysis and modelling for the card's commercial decisions. You'll often have small samples and incomplete data, which suits Bayesian methods. You'll quantify the uncertainty in each estimate and explain what it means for the decision. You'll run your own projects, from framing the question with the commercial lead to helping the team act on the result. Your models will shape how the card grows. You will be embedded in a broader Credit Cards Team and learn about the product and customer needs. You'll share methods with Credit Risk Modelling, especially where card and lending models overlap, and with data scientists across iwoca in the analytics guild. Live project examples: Credit limits. Setting initial limits that balance risk with what each customer needs, and designing a framework that adjusts them as spending and repayment data comes in. Pricing. Modelling how interest and fees affect take-up and spending,, to find pricing that works for iwoca and its customers. Customer lifetime value. Estimating activation, spending, and retention from early signals, and updating the estimates as each cohort matures. Card and loan together. Measuring cross-sell and combined credit exposure for businesses that hold both the card and an iwoca loan. Designing the mechanisms to optimise how the two products interact. The Requirements Essential: Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns. Bayesian reasoning. You've used priors, updating, and hierarchical models in real work. You know when a Bayesian model is worth the extra complexity, and when something simpler will do. Analytical ownership. You've taken loosely defined problems from framing the question to a decision the business acted on. Business curiosity. You've used what you learnt about a business's customers and economics to shape your analysis. AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – a prototype, an automation, or a modelling pipeline others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles. Bonus: Lending experience. You've worked on credit risk, pricing, or customer lifetime value in lending or financial services. Small-sample modelling. You've worked with scarce data and made principled choices about regularisation or sequential updating. Production machine learning. You've taken models from exploration through to deployment and monitoring. Coding in Python. The team works in Python and you’ll write analyses and code in that language. The salary We expect to pay from £80,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and …

items.desc: Are you an experienced Data Scientist who is passionate about using data, advanced analytics and machine learning to improve business decision-making — and ultimately help deliver greater impact for dogs and animal welfare? We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our Data Engineering team, turning complex data into insight, predictions and practical recommendations that help Dogs Trust make better decisions. What does this role do? As Data Scientist, you'll: develop propensity and segmentation models to support better business decisions, apply statistical and machine-learning techniques to identify patterns, predict outcomes and uncover actionable insight, design, develop and operationalise machine-learning models and analytical data products, lead end-to-end analytics and AI projects focused on real business challenges and measurable value, work closely with stakeholders, including senior leaders, to turn complex findings into clear recommendations and action. Screening calls for this role are provisionally scheduled for week commencing 23rd November 2026, with panel interviews the following week. Could this be you? You’ll combine strong Data Science and analytical skills with business thinking and excellent stakeholder management. We’re particularly interested in how you’ve used data to solve real problems, influence decisions and deliver tangible outcomes. Your experience could come from any sector. What matters is your ability to understand a business challenge, identify where advanced analytics can add value and communicate your recommendations clearly. At Dogs Trust, you’ll use Data Science to help us work smarter, make better decisions and ultimately deliver greater impact for dogs and animal welfare. What does this team do? You’ll be part of a skilled and supportive IT team that values curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. We work across a variety of exciting initiatives; from developing digital platforms that help dog owners to enhancing volunteer and data systems that expand our impact. Our culture is friendly, flexible, and purpose-driven, with most of your time spent working from home and regular, focused collaboration days in our London office. It’s an environment where people share ideas, learn from each other, and take pride in building technology that truly makes a difference. About Dogs Trust We love dogs. That’s why we do whatever we can to make sure every four-legged friend gets the love they deserve. We’ll never put a healthy dog down, so our work is focused on helping dogs in need, supporting owners every step of the walk, and creating a better world for dogs in the future. It’s what we’ve been doing since 1891 and how we’ve grown to become the UK’s leading dog charity, helping 12,000 loyal friends find their forever homes every year. To apply for this position please click the APPLY NOW button. Our application process requires you submit a personal statement explaining your interest and suitability for the role. Dogs are incredibly diverse, much like the humans that love them! At Dogs Trust we value diversity, and we're committed to fostering an inclusive culture. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, abilities, and cultures and believe that a diverse workforce helps us to achieve our mission. Our colleague networks give our people a voice, acting as vehicles for real and meaningful change within Dogs Trust. We truly want to see every candidate shine throughout the entire job application process, interview stages, and during their time with us. If there's anything on your mind or any adjustments you may need, don't hesitate to reach out to us. Feel free to send us an email at jobs@dogstrust.org.uk. We're here to support you every step of the way.

items.desc: About Us Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI. In The Last Few Months Alone We Launched Fireworks Training, Partnered With Microsoft Azure Foundry, And Published Research Straight From Our Production Systems. A Few Examples Of What That Looks Like In Practice Frontier RL is cheaper than the mega-cluster narrative suggests: we ran cross-region rollouts using 98% sparse weight deltas and published what we learned. (blog) Open source agents with frontier advisors: matching frontier performance through training and harness engineering. (blog) The fine-tuning bottleneck is not the algorithm: integration friction and iteration speed are what actually stall teams; we documented the patterns across dozens of customer engagements. (blog) The Role AI Field Engineers at Fireworks are the technical tip of the spear. You embed with our most ambitious customers and technology partners to turn complex AI problems into production systems, fast. The role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer delivery. You are hands-on-keyboard building POCs, MVPs, and production integrations, while also holding your own in executive-level conversations about architecture, strategy, and business outcomes. You spend most of your time building. You ship code, run benchmarks, debug production issues, and architect deployments. But you also lead discovery conversations, align stakeholders, and translate customer pain points into product improvements that compress the feedback loop from field to roadmap. This is a role for engineers who are comfortable on-site with customers, building the relationships and trust that happen in person, not just over a call. The Segment As a Field Engineer in the Enterprise track you will work with large organizations and digital-native companies adopting GenAI across the business. These engagements span more stakeholders and longer cycles, so you will manage executive relationships and align teams while staying hands-on in the code. The emphasis is on pairing strong technical delivery with the executive presence to earn trust across an org: discovery, solution design, POC execution, and the path to production at enterprise scale. What You'll Work On Technical Delivery and Deployment Build end-to-end POCs and MVPs alongside customer engineering teams, working inside their codebases, infrastructure, and constraints. For customers whose core product is built on GenAI, architect the inference foundations that capability depends on, and size deployments so they can scale in their market without infrastructure becoming the bottleneck. Run load tests and establish latency, throughput, and cost baselines against realistic customer traffic profiles, and tune deployments to hit those targets Deploy and validate new model families on inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang), determining optimal shapes, quantization configs, and serving patterns across workloads. Model Strategy and Fine-Tuning Guide customers on model selection, fine-tuning strategy (SFT, DPO, RFT), and evaluation methodology. Build and run fine-tuning pipelines directly with customers, navigating trade-offs between model families, compute cost, and quality targets. Design and implement evaluation frameworks that measure production-quality metrics, not just benchmark scores. Customer Engagement and Stakeholder Management Many of our customers exist because of GenAI. Help them bake frontier model capabilities into their core offering and turn that into a durable competitive edge. Lead structured discovery conversations to unpack customer pain points, constraints, and success criteria before proposing solutions. Own the technical relationship from first engagement through production deployment. Earn trust with ML engineers and VPs in the same meeting. Spend time on-site with customers. Build trust and momentum in person, embedding with their teams where the work happens. Product Feedback and Platform Improvement Identify recurring customer pain points and translate them into concrete product proposals, working directly with engineering and product to ship fixes and features. Codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute them back to internal tooling, documentation, and the platform itself. Feed customer signals (deployment patterns, failure modes, feature gaps) back into the product roadmap with specificity and urgency. Minimum Qualifications What We're Looking For 5+ …

items.desc: About Us At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels. Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet. We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel. Introducing Data Science & Analytics at Trainline👋 Data Science & Analytics (DSA) is central to how we build products, delight our customers and grow our business. Our Data Scientists are embedded alongside Data Analysts in cross-functional teams which exist across product and marketing. Data Scientists have a high degree of autonomy and are empowered to drive the success of their teams, using all data and techniques at their disposal. As a Data Scientist, you will be involved in driving insights and strategy for the product team, creating and measuring value through experimentation, creating focus through metrics and goals, and building deep learning about what is most impactful for each team. You will be able to determine the underlying dynamics of our complex ecosystem and use this to deliver insights and strategic direction, but your main focus will be a complete obsession with driving impact within the product team, drawing on whatever analytical and statistical techniques that will unlock the most benefits. Data Science and Analytics at Trainline exists within the wider data organisation as part of the tech org, and is complemented by data engineering teams, data platform teams, and ML teams for when deep ML and AI techniques are required. Our autonomous model creates a huge opportunity for personal influence and impact – as the data scientist on the team you will be actively driving innovation on the team by contributing to strategy, execution and continuous learning. As a Data Scientist at Trainline, you will... 🚄 As a Data Scientist in our New Business team, you'll help shape how Trainline grows beyond train tickets. From insurance and protection to hotels, car hire, attractions and other travel experiences, we're exploring new ways to add value throughout the customer journey, including making it easier for customers to plan more of their trip in one place. You'll use customer insights, experimentation and analytical techniques to uncover new opportunities, influence product strategy and create meaningful value for both our customers and Trainline. About As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for influencing product and business outcomes, have the autonomy to make things happen and must obsess about having business impact. More specifically you will: Own data science work from start to finish within an embedded product team, from shaping the right question with your colleagues to delivering a solution and measuring its impact Explore customer behaviour and product usage to uncover areas of friction, spot new opportunities and estimate the benefit of acting on them Contribute to simple, seamless customer journeys by identifying where we can remove barriers and add value Design, run and analyse experiments using sound statistical methods, and help define metrics Build, test and improve models such as forecasting, personalisation or customer behaviour prediction that enhance the customer experience and support business growth Turn your findings into clear, practical recommendations that help shape product and monetisation strategy, tailoring your message for both technical and non-technical audiences We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔍 Hands-on experience applying data science to real product or customer problems, ideally within an embedded or cross-functional team Confidence using Python and SQL to explore large datasets of customer activity, build models and write efficient, readable code Experience of product engagement evaluation and measurement of success. For example, running A/B tests to evaluate product effectiveness or using front-end data to quantify the effectiveness of new features and how it changes user engagement. The ability to explain complex ideas simply and adapt how you communicate for different audiences Ideally, an interest in monetisation, advertising, recommendations or e-commerce, and familiarity with tools such as dbt, Looker or Tableau, although none of these are essential Tech Stack: SQL, Python, R, Tableau, AWS Athena + More! items.desc: Data u nás nejsou jen čísla, ale příběhy o tom, co naši zákazníci chtějí a jak můžeme být lepší. Hledáme nadšeného absolventa, který dokáže v obrovském množství dat najít souvislosti, vytvářet prediktivní modely a pomáhat nám tak s byznys rozhodováním. Jestli máš analytické myšlení a chceš vidět reálný dopad své práce v jednom z největších retailových řetězců, přidej se k nám. Co tě u nás bude bavit analýza velkých datových sad (Big Data) – budeš pracovat s daty z našeho věrnostního programu (Kaufland Card XTRA), prodejními statistikami a logistickými daty pro odhalování trendů a optimalizaci procesů tvorba a testování prediktivních modelů – využiješ statistické metody a machine learning (např. v Pythonu nebo R) pro predikci poptávky, analýzu nákupního chování a optimalizaci zásob reporting, dashboardy a alerting systémy – navrhneš přehledné dashboardy a systémy včasného varování napříč různými datovými sadami, které týmu umožní okamžitě reagovat na významné výkyvy a trendy v datech data mining a zpracování dat – postaráš se o přípravu datových sad a jejich čištění s využitím pokročilého SQL v prostředí DWH/Cloudových řešení vyhodnocování a interpretace – tvým úkolem bude srozumitelná interpretace výsledků a navrhování konkrétních byznys doporučení, včetně prezentace výstupů mezinárodním, kros-funkčním týmům (v angličtině/němčině) s přímým vlivem na zákaznickou zkušenost spolupráce a rozvoj – budeš úzce spolupracovat s oddělením BI/Customer & Market Insights INT, postupně se zaškolíš do moderních analytických a vizualizačních nástrojů a budeš se podílet na inovacích v datové analytice Jak si tě představujeme máš ukončené VŠ vzdělání (magisterské nebo bakalářské) v oborech jako Matematika, Statistika, Informatika/Aplikovaná informatika, Ekonometrie nebo Datová analytika (pozice je vhodná i pro čerstvé absolventy) máš analytické a koncepční myšlení, umíš pracovat s čísly a máš chuť se dále rozvíjet v oblasti Data Science ovládáš základy programování pro datovou analýzu (ideálně Python, R) a orientuješ se v SQL využíváš generativní AI (např. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) jako chytrého asistenta, více než mechanické biflování syntaxe je pro nás důležité, že umíš AI správně zadat zadání, kriticky ověřit výsledek a pochopit logiku řešení domluvíš se dobře anglicky (požadujeme dobrou znalost AJ anebo NJ ) nechybí ti komunikační a prezentační schopnosti a umíš složitá data vysvětlit srozumitelnou formou jsi flexibilní osobnost, které nechybí tah na branku a chuť učit se nové věci Co za to dostaneš stabilní zázemí u TOP zaměstnavatele odměnu : motivující finanční ohodnocení flexibilitu : po zaškolení možnost 2 dní v týdnu na home office (hybridní model) kvalitní zaškolení : nenecháme tě v tom, všechno tě krok za krokem naučíme (podpora zkušenějších kolegů v týmu) cenné zkušenosti : hluboký vhled do práce s reálnými Big Data v enterprise měřítku u předního mezinárodního retailera 5 týdnů dovolené na pořádný relax bohatý balíček benefitů : Cafeteria, stravenkový paušál, MultiSport karta, parkování, online lékař a příspěvky při životních událostech Chceš být tím, kdo ukazuje směr díky přesným datům a predikcím? Přidej se k #tymkaufland.

Mit über 5.000 Mitarbeitenden an 3 Standorten machen wir digitales Banking von heute leistungsfähig und entwickeln smarte Finanz-Services von morgen. Dabei bieten wir ein breites Aufgabenspektrum, in dem die individuellen Stärken hervorragend eingebracht werden können. Ob App-Entwicklung, Netzwerktechnologien und Serverbetrieb oder Beratung, Schulung und Support – bei uns findet jede:r seine bzw. ihre Berufung! Als Spezialist:in oder auch als Generalist:in. Alles mit besten Karrierechancen, viel Raum für persönliche Entfaltung und zahlreichen Benefits. Für die Organisationseinheit ZV-Datengetriebene Betrugserkennung, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Termin für den Standort Hannover, Münster oder Frankfurt einen Data Scientist für Compliance (m/w/d) Die Organisationseinheit ZV-Datengetriebene Betrugserkennung entwickelt und betreibt KI-Modelle, die Betrug im Zahlungsverkehr der Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe erkennen, bevor Schaden entsteht. Weitere datengetriebenen Methoden nutzen wir auch für Compliance-Anforderungen wie die Embargo- und Sanktionsprüfung. Unsere Modelle sind präzise, erklärbar und regulatorisch belastbar, und sie haben einen direkten Nutzen für Millionen von Kundinnen und Kunden. Aufgaben: Automatisierung datenanalytischer Prozesse mit Python und Machine Learning Konzeption und Implementierung KI basierter Lösungen Entwicklung und Optimierung komplexer Datenbankmodelle Anwendung fortgeschrittener Datenanalysetechniken zur Mustererkennung und Ableitung fundierter Handlungsempfehlungen Speicherung, Aufbereitung und Bereitstellung großer Datenmengen für datenbasierte Entscheidungen Entwicklung, Evaluierung und Optimierung prädiktiver Machine Learning Modelle Profil: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes fachbezogenes Studium oder vergleichbare Ausbildung sowie mindestens 2-3 Jahre fachbezogene Berufserfahrung Erweiterte Kenntnisse in Python, PySpark, SQL sowie Erfahrung im Aufbau von Analysepipelines Fähigkeit zur Konzeption, Validierung und Optimierung datenbasierter Modelle Erfahrung mit Frameworks, Datenbanken, Servern, Entwicklungswerkzeugen und Entwurfsmustern Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und Problemlösungskompetenz zur Durchführung von fachspezifischen Analysen und Auswahl geeigneter Lösungsansätze Kommunikations- und Präsentationsstärke sowie Teamfähigkeit Engagement, Belastbarkeit und Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung Klingt interessant? Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerbungen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung, Religion, ethnischer Herkunft oder sexueller Identität, unter Angabe der Kennziffer 650/B.

items.card: What You'll Work On: Perform data cleansing, data integration, and data quality assurance activities to maintain the accuracy and integrity of large datasets. Develop and maintain Foundry pipelines using Pipeline Builder to ingest, transform, and integrate data. Build modular applications and workflows leveraging Python, and Foundry AIP. items.desc: Job Number: R0249763 Data Scientist The Opportunity: As a data scientist operating and supporting a four-star Army Headquarters, you'll bring your technical, computer science, data analysis, and data science expertise to collaborate, design and build innovative Solutions at an Army Service Component Command in support of operations in Europe and Africa. As a data scientist, you’re excited at the prospect of unlocking the secrets held by a data set, and you’re fascinated by the possibilities presented by IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. In an increasingly connected world, massive amounts of structured and unstructured data open new opportunities. On our team, you’ll use your analytical skills and data science knowledge to create real-world impact. You’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. You’ll develop algorithms and systems and use the right combination of tools and frameworks to turn sets of disparate data points into objective answers to help clients make informed decisions. Ultimately, you’ll provide a deep understanding of the data, what it all means, and how it can be used. What You'll Work On: Perform data cleansing, data integration, and data quality assurance activities to maintain the accuracy and integrity of large datasets. Develop and maintain Foundry pipelines using Pipeline Builder to ingest, transform, and integrate data. Build modular applications and workflows leveraging Python, and Foundry AIP. Assist in providing training to guide stakeholders in using Maven Smart System applications. Support testing, debugging, and performance tuning of Foundry applications. Troubleshoot data-related problems and provide innovative solutions to address complex data challenges. Join us. The world can’t wait. You Have: 4+ years of experience utilizing programming and querying languages, including Python, R, Scala, or SQL 4+ years of experience developing and maintaining data applications for reporting and analytics Experience creating workflows for retrieving, parsing, and processing structured and unstructured data Experience creating solutions within a collaborative and cross-functional team environment Ability to manage tasks and projects independently with minimal guidance and direction Secret clearance Bachelor’s degree Nice If You Have: Experience with distributed data and computer tools, including Spark, Databricks, Hadoop, Hive, AWS EMR, or Kafka Experience with data visualization or geospatial tools such as Tableau, Qlik, PowerBI, or ArcGIS Experience working within a Combatant Command or other DoW organizations Top Secret clearance Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or Mathematics Clearance: Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required. Compensation At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page. Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,500.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date. Identity Statement As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. items.desc: Do you want to use your technical expertise in Data Engineering to shape solutions that drive business value and innovation? Join us! Do you want to use your technical expertise in Data Engineering and AI to shape solutions that drive business value and innovation? Are you curious about the intersection of artificial intelligence, cloud technology, and advanced data platforms? At Evidi, we are looking for a team player who sees opportunities where others see challenges and who wants to be more than “just tech.” About The Data Engineer Opportunity Join a growing company where you can have a real impact on both your day-to-day work and our exciting journey in data-driven innovation. You’ll play a key role in building, optimising, and maintaining modern data platforms, enabling advanced analytics and AI-powered solutions that support our customers’ digital transformation. About Evidi As part of our inclusive working environment, you’ll enjoy strong professional development, high participation in team activities, and the support of a dedicated wellbeing leader at each location. Evidi Active also provides opportunities to join or lead sports teams and social events, helping you to connect with colleagues across our organisation. Key Responsibilities as Data Engineer Design, implement, and maintain robust data pipelines and architectures for analytics, machine learning and AI workloads. Work closely with business stakeholders, data scientists, and developers to understand requirements and transform them into scalable data solutions. Contribute actively to the delivery of projects, taking responsibility for the data and AI aspects in client implementations. Evaluate and integrate new tools and technologies, optimising for performance, scalability, and security. Document solutions and processes, and provide training to colleagues and end-users when needed. Drive usage and best practices of modern data platforms among customers and internally. Support the team with advice on data engineering, AI and MLOps, ensuring optimal use of resources and platforms. Your Skills And Experience Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related field. Relevant experience can compensate for formal education. Hands-on experience with data engineering technologies (e.g. Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, SQL, Python, Spark, Power BI). Experience deploying, maintaining, or utilising machine learning and AI solutions in a production environment. Strong understanding of cloud data solutions and modern data platforms (preferably Microsoft Azure or comparable). Ability to translate business processes and requirements into technical data solutions. Curious about new AI advancements and data-driven applications. Collaborative team member with excellent communication skills, comfortable sharing expertise and helping others to grow. Self-driven, structured, and eager to learn new technologies and concepts. What We Offer Work with meaningful and impactful customer projects, leveraging the latest in AI and data technology. A supportive and diverse team environment with experienced colleagues committed to knowledge-sharing. Flexible work arrangements, including the opportunity for home office and adaptable working hours. Opportunity for competence development and personal growth in a rapidly evolving sector (a place to grow). Good pension and insurance schemes. Freedom to shape your own working life and influence the company’s direction. Company ownership opportunities for employees. We Are Evidi Our values and attitudes empower us and our customers to rise to new challenges. We thrive on solving problems, exceeding expectations, and building more than just solutions – we build relationships. We deliver to some of Norway’s most ambitious businesses, and we’re always happy to share our experiences. Our work covers the entire spectrum from digital strategy to development, integration, and management of critical IT solutions. More Than Just Tech People We are passionate, committed, and genuinely care about our craft, colleagues, clients, partners, and the society we live in. If you want to contribute to a truly collaborative environment and help shape the future of data and AI, we would love to hear from you.

items.desc: Data & AI Engineer We have an exciting opportunity for a bright, passionate, and driven individual to join our successful, dynamic, and reputable multi-utilities business. This role will sit within our Technology team and requires an individual with a high-level of competency in data analytics, automation and AI and a proactive approach to problem solving and the confidence to independently learn new technologies. This is a junior role within the team and would suit a recent graduate in Computer Science or similar. This role will be dedicated to identifying opportunities and improvements to enhance our current systems and their ability both through the use data analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) solutions to identify opportunities, realise efficiency savings, minimise risks and improve customer service. This role is based onsite full time in our Leatherhead, Surrey office. Key Accountabilities The Data & AI Engineer is accountable for using software, artificial intelligence and machine learning to analyse and interpret large amounts of data and support the successful implementation of new technologies and improved system functionality, including automation across ESP. Review and understand business processes and data requirements and specify data analytics and automation solutions Produce simple to understand management insight using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and machine learning to analyse large amounts of data to support improved decision making, Implement process automation solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power platform (and other AI solutions and relevant scripting languages) to help the business to improve business efficiency and customer experience Maintain and support data platform to ensure data security, integrity and accuracy in all reports and analytics. Maintain and support automation solutions to ensure continued efficient operation, and business process continuity. Continuously improve and optimise existing reports and automation processes. You will be an advocate for Data Analytics and AI within the business and will take a proactive role in ensuring that individuals and teams have the systems and resources in place that will enable ESP to deliver in line with our fast-paced and agile commercial strategy. This individual will produce simple to understand management insight by using technologies including artificial intelligence (AI), to analyse large amounts of data to help improve decision making. Key Responsibilities Analyse and interpret large amounts of data from a range of sources – using technical, analytical and communication skills to collect and examine data to help provide management insight to make better informed decisions and solve problems. Development of automation solutions – understanding business processes and requirements and identifying appropriate solutions to improve business efficiency and customer outcomes through the use of automation and AI Support and maintain the data platform and automation solutions to ensure the ongoing integrity or the environment and ensure efficient operation of the solutions Inspire stakeholders to recognise opportunities that are beyond their current understanding – helping break down the barrier of how things are ‘now’ and articulate the future alternatives which would support improved working practises, process enhancements and a greater sense of ease of business for our external stakeholders. Share regular presentations – with audiences at all levels within the business as appropriate to help illustrate project progress, achievements, challenges, and a commitment to departmental/business strategy. Support the system Super User community – reviewing feedback collected via this forum, helping articulate how system development could support any pain points/change requests raised and delivering actions assigned as an output of the work inspired by this community. Hands-on support / participation in system testing – on an as required basis, undertake system testing for new developments and changes thus allowing the opportunity to track back to the original business requirements, testing may sometimes be addressed before handing across to the business for further testing or be carried out alongside the business itself. Skills Needed: Degree in Computer Science, or a related field An aptitude for understanding IT software, systems and highly technical solutions Advanced knowledge of relevant scripting languages (e.g.Python, R, SQL, Java Script Experience Microsoft Power platform, Fabric, PowerBI A passion and ability to learn new technologies, as full training will be provided Strong analytical and problem-solving skill including experience with data analytics A positive and innovative approach to problem solving, be able to understand and empathise with business users’ issues and problems Must be collaborative and not confrontational in approach An ‘eye’ for improvements and realising opportunities for efficiency gains …

items.desc: Contexte de la mission Dans le cadre du développement de ses projets d’intelligence artificielle générative et agentique, notre client souhaite mettre en place un outil permettant d’estimer la consommation de tokens et les coûts associés à l’utilisation des modèles LLM. L’objectif est de permettre aux équipes projet d’anticiper leurs dépenses en fonction de leurs besoins, des volumes d’utilisation prévus et des modèles d’IA utilisés. Pour cela, nous recherchons un AI Engineer capable de participer au cadrage du besoin et au développement d’une calculatrice de prévision de consommation de tokens. Missions Le consultant interviendra sur les différentes étapes du projet : Recueillir les besoins des équipes et définir les principales fonctionnalités de l’outil. Identifier les paramètres à prendre en compte pour estimer la consommation de tokens selon les cas d’usage. Développer en Python une calculatrice permettant de simuler les volumes de consommation et les coûts associés. Prendre en compte les spécificités des différents modèles LLM et leurs modalités de tarification. Intégrer les particularités des projets agentiques, notamment les appels successifs aux modèles et les interactions entre agents. Tester et fiabiliser les calculs afin de fournir des estimations cohérentes. Rédiger la documentation technique et fonctionnelle de la solution. Compétences recherchées Bonne maîtrise de Python. Connaissance des LLM et des mécanismes de tokenisation. Expérience dans l’utilisation d’API de modèles d’IA générative. Compréhension des coûts associés à la consommation de tokens. Capacité à cadrer un besoin et à proposer une solution technique adaptée. Une expérience sur des projets d’IA générative, des architectures agentiques ou des sujets LLMOps constituera un réel atout. Livrable attendu Développement d’une calculatrice de prévision de consommation de tokens, accompagnée de sa documentation. Profil recherché Nous recherchons un profil technique et pragmatique, capable de comprendre les besoins des équipes, de les traduire en fonctionnalités concrètes et de développer un outil fiable et facilement utilisable. Unser Team aus rund 50 Expert:innen in ServiceNow, Software Development und Security baut aktuell den Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz von Grund auf auf – eine grüne Spielwiese mit Start-up-Spirit im Konzern. Hier hast du die Chance, unsere AI-Community mitzugestalten, eigene Lösungen zu entwickeln und Kunden in verschiedensten Branchen Mehrwert zu liefern. Wir begleiten unsere Kunden von der Beratung bis zum Betrieb – und setzen dabei auf Technologieoffenheit. Keine starren Vorgaben, sondern die besten Tools für jede Aufgabe – gern auch deine Ideen. Dich erwarten spannende Projekte, gelebte Vielfalt und regelmäßiger Austausch im Team. Außerdem profitierst du von Erfahrungstransfer und individuellen Karrierepfaden. Ob Fach- oder Führungslaufbahn: Du bestimmst die Richtung, wir unterstützen dich. Aufgaben Aufbau, Automatisierung und Betrieb von ML-/AI-Produktionsumgebungen Entwicklung und Pflege von MLOps-Pipelines (CI/CD, Deployment, Monitoring) Sicherstellung von Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit, Sicherheit und Kostenoptimierung Implementierung von Monitoring-, Logging- und Alerting-Systemen Zusammenarbeit mit Data Scientists & Engineers beim Übergang von Modellen in den Betrieb Analyse & Optimierung bestehender Architekturen, Workflows und Ressourcenverbrauch Qualifikation Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Data Science oder vergleichbar; alternativ: mindestens 5-jährige Berufserfahrung im IT-Umfeld Mindestens 3-jährige Praxiserfahrung auf dem Gebiet Künstliche Intelligenz oder vergleichbar Kenntnisse in Cloud-Umgebungen (AWS, Azure, GCP) & Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) Erfahrung mit CI/CD-Tools & Infrastructure as Code (z. B. GitLab CI, Terraform, Ansible) Programmierkenntnisse (Python, Bash oder Go) sowie Monitoring-Tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (nachweisbar mindestens C1-Niveau) in Wort und Schrift sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse Knowhow im Umgang mit MLOps-Frameworks (MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker) von Vorteil Was wir bieten Bei uns findest du Kolleg:innen, mit denen die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir begegnen uns offen, duzen uns über alle Positionen hinweg und denken nicht in Hierarchien oder Silos. Du arbeitest meist direkt an deinem Heimatort – weil wir Kundennähe wörtlich nehmen und uns Work-Life-Balance am Herzen liegt. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und hast je nach Kundensituation die Möglichkeit, von zuhause zu arbeiten. Die richtigen Trainings und Zertifikate bringen deine Weiterbildung voran. Unsere E-Learning-Plattform Academia ermöglicht dir das Lernen, wo und wann du willst. Einen Teil deines Bruttogehalts kannst du in CGI Aktien investieren – bis maximal 3 % des Monatsgehalts geben wir für jeden Euro einen weiteren hinzu. Außerdem beteiligen wir dich am Unternehmenserfolg: Du erhältst eine Gewinnbeteiligung, die sich nach deiner individuellen Leistung richtet, sowie danach, wie wir als Unternehmen unsere finanziellen Ziele erreichen konnten. Mit Jobticket und Jobbike fördern wir umweltfreundliche Mobilität. Abhängig von deiner Rolle und Projektsituation sind auch Bahncard oder Elektro-Firmenwagen möglich. Sabbatical oder Elternzeit werden unterstützt. Sie sind bei uns kein Karriere-Stopper! Wir sind an deiner Seite, auch wenn es einmal nicht so gut läuft: Du kannst Sonderurlaub nehmen, und unsere Beratungshotline steht dir immer zur Verfügung. Eine Vielzahl an gemeinsamen Events und Freizeitaktivitäten stärkt deine Verbundenheit mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. 1976 gegründet und nach wie vor familiengeführt, ist CGI heute einer der weltweit größten unabhängigen Anbieter von IT und Business Consulting. Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Teamwork, Respekt und Zusammenhalt machen das Arbeiten bei uns besonders. Bei uns kannst du dein volles Potenzial entfalten! Du darfst dich vom ersten Tag an als Miteigentümer:in von CGI verstehen. Wir lassen unsere Vision gemeinsam Wirklichkeit werden. Wir profitieren von unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und haben die Möglichkeit und die Verantwortung, die Strategie und Ausrichtung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten. Deine Arbeit schafft Mehrwert. Du findest innovative Lösungen und stärkst dein Netzwerk aus Kolleg:innen und Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du Zugang zu globalen Ressourcen, um große Ideen zu verwirklichen, neue Chancen zu nutzen und von der immensen Branchen- und Technologie-Kompetenz zu profitieren. Du bringst deine Karriere voran, da du in einem Unternehmen arbeitest, das auf Wachstum und Langlebigkeit ausgelegt ist. Du wirst von Führungskräften unterstützt, die deine Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit fördern – und dir Möglichkeiten bieten, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und deinen Horizont zu erweitern.

items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Rejoignez une nouvelle aventure, avec la création d'une activité dédiée à l'industrialisation des usages de l'Intelligence Artificielle au sein du département de la Qualité du Système d'Information et contribuez à transformer des idées innovantes en solutions concrètes utilisées par les collaborateurs au quotidien. Vos missions : Concevoir des prototypes d'applications IA en Python et JavaScript, ou des prompts, répondant aux besoins des équipes Maquetter et développer des cas d'usage permettant d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle des collaborateurs Intégrer et exploiter des services d'IA générative au sein d'outils et de démonstrateurs Participer aux phases de tests, de validation et d'amélioration continue des solutions développées Contribuer à la documentation et à la diffusion des bonnes pratiques auprès des utilisateurs Ce que nous vous proposons : Participer à la création d'une nouvelle activité dédiée à l'IA Développer des cas d'usage concrets à destination des collaborateurs du département QSI Monter en compétences sur les technologies d'IA générative et leur intégration dans des outils métier Bénéficier d'un accompagnement et des outils pour mener à bien vos missions Durée du stage : 4 mois. Et si c’était vous ? Vous êtes étudiant en Bac+2/3 en informatique, développement logiciel, génie logiciel ou équivalent Vous maîtriser le développement en Python et disposer de bonnes bases en JavaScript pour concevoir rapidement des prototypes fonctionnels Vous faites preuve de curiosité et d'appétence pour l'Intelligence Artificielle, notamment les usages de l'IA générative et l'automatisation des tâches Vous savez analyser un besoin utilisateur et le traduire en une solution simple, pragmatique et à forte valeur ajoutée Vous savez travailler efficacement en équipe, partager ses idées et collaborer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés Vous faites preuve d'autonomie, de rigueur et d'esprit d'initiative dans la réalisation et l'amélioration continue des développements Vous avez un esprit d'initiative, curiosité et capacité à travailler en équipe Vous êtes à l'aise dans la réalisation de prototypes et dans la résolution de problèmes techniques Plus qu’un poste, un tremplin Rejoignez-nous pour faire grandir vos ambitions ! Dès votre arrivée, vous serez intégré dans nos équipes et apprendrez chaque jour aux côtés de nos experts qui vous accompagneront dans vos missions. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. Vous découvrirez également toute la diversité de nos métiers, dans un secteur qui évolue et innove en permanence. A la fin de vos études, diverses opportunités pourront s’offrir à vous, en France et à l’international. Pourquoi nous choisir ? Attentif à votre qualité de vie et conditions de travail , vous bénéficiez d’avantages : Prise en charge de 60% de votre titre de transport Billetterie à prix réduits de notre Comité d’Entreprise (concerts, cinéma, sport…) Offre variée de restaurants d’entreprise et de cafétérias à tarifs compétitifs ainsi que des titres restaurants dématérialisés quand vous êtes en télétravail Créer, oser, innover, entreprendre font partie de notre ADN. Si vous aussi vous souhaitez être dans l’action, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, vous sentir utile au quotidien et développer ou renforcer votre expertise, nous sommes faits pour nous rencontrer ! Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nos collaborateurs peuvent s’engager quelques jours par an pour des actions de solidarité sur leur temps de travail : parrainer des personnes en difficulté dans leur orientation ou leur insertion professionnelle, participer à l’éducation financière de jeunes en apprentissage ou encore partager leurs compétences avec une association. Les formats d’engagement sont multiples.

items.desc: Hos West er vi et dedikeret team, der har som fælles mål at forbedre patienternes liv. Et mål, som har været centrum for vores virksomhed i mere end et århundrede. Vores historie begyndte, da Herman O. West løste problemet med at levere penicillin i store mængder til den amerikanske regering under anden verdenskrig. Gennem vores arbejde med at levere tusindvis af livreddende og livforbedrende injektionsmedicin til millioner af patienter hver dag er Wests uudslettelige mærke på sundhedsindustrien lige begyndt. Et navn startede vores historie. Hvordan hjælper dit med at skrive vores fremtid? Der er ikke noget bedre sted at slutte sig et inkluderende fællesskab af fagfolk med muligheder for livslang læring, vækst og udvikling. Med personalegoder giver vi vores teammedlemmer og deres familier mulighed for et godt helbred fysisk, mentalt, følelsesmæssigt og økonomisk. Vi tror på at give tilbage for at hjælpe dem, der har brug for det, i de lokalsamfund, hvor vi bor og arbejder. Og vi er lige så engagerede i at skabe et sundere miljø og en sundere planet gennem vores bæredygtighedsindsats. Der tilbydes ingen flytning i forbindelse med denne mulighed. Dette er en onsite-stilling. Joboversigt Dine primære ansvarsområder vil være at sikre optimering af eksisterende visionsinspektionssystemer på produktionslinjen samt at understøtte produktionen i den daglige drift. Du vil blive en del af ingeniørafdelingen og arbejde tæt sammen med de andre fire medlemmer af visionsteamet. Du kan se frem til at blive et vigtigt internt kontaktpunkt i virksomheden, og der er mange visionsrelaterede projekter i støbeskeen. West Pharmaceutical tilbyder et introduktionsprogram med grundig træning i visionssystemet. Du vil rapportere til Vision & Data Team Leader. Væsentlige pligter og ansvar Drift, vedligeholdelse og forbedring af virksomhedens eksisterende maskinvisionssystem Dataanalyse Dokumentation og validering Udarbejdelse og opdatering af SOI'er (Standard Operating Instructions) Håndtering af hændelser Uddannelse IT-baggrund eller gennemført uddannelse som ingeniør eller lignende Erhvervserfaring Minimum 3 års relevant erfaring kræves Erfaring med konfiguration og parametrisering af vision-kvalitetskontrolsystemer i produktion er en fordel Foretrukken viden, færdigheder og evner Interesse for IT og forståelse af digitale billeder (pixels, gråtoner, Deep Learning osv.) Kendskab til delkomponenterne i et visionssystem (pc'er, belysningsprincipper og kameraprincipper) er en fordel Flydende dansk- og engelskkundskaber Foretrukken erfaring med koncepterne: Change Control, GMP, URS, IQ, OQ og PQ, LEAN, OEE og Six Sigma Struktureret, systematisk og selvstændig arbejdsmetode Evne til at finde på enkle og effektive løsninger på komplekse problemstillinger Opretholde overblik over hele processen, samtidig med at være opmærksom på detaljer Drift, tænk proaktivt og klar til at tage imod eventuelle udfordringer, der måtte opstå Åben og udadvendt og i stand til at interagere komfortabelt på alle niveauer i organisationen samt serviceminded Skift Denne stilling ansættes kun til nattevagt, helst 5 dage om ugen eller 2 x 12 timer i weekenden. Følgende vagtplaner er mulige. Nattevagt 5 Dage Om Ugen Søndag 22:30 - 06:00 Mandag 22:30 - 06:00 Tirsdag 22:30 - 06:00 Onsdag 22:30 - 06:00 Torsdag 22:30 - 05:00 Eller 2 x 12 Timers Nattevagt Fredag 21:30 - 10:00 Lørdag 21:30 - 10:00 Den årlige grundløn for denne stilling er kr472.648,00 - kr601.552,00. Den samlede løn fastsættes ud fra objektive og kønsneutrale kriterier, herunder relevant erfaring, kvalifikationer, færdigheder, markedssammenligninger, geografisk placering samt rollens omfang og ansvarsområder. Denne stilling kan være berettiget til variabel kompensation og andre incitamentsprogrammer i overensstemmelse med vilkårene i de gældende regler i ansættelseslandet. Derudover er teammedlemmer berettigede til at deltage i virksomhedens medarbejdergoder og samlede belønningsprogrammer, som er gældende for deres geografiske placering og ansættelsesforhold. West hylder diversitet og lige muligheder. Vi fremmer et miljø, hvor alle mennesker er sikre, bliver behandlet retfærdigt, værdsat og respekteret. Vi diskriminerer ikke på baggrund af race, religion, hudfarve, national oprindelse, køn, sex, kønsidentitet, seksuel orientering, alder, ægteskabelig status, veteranstatus, invaliditetsstatus eller andre relevante juridisk beskyttede karakteristika. Hvor det er tilladt ifølge loven, er et ansættelsesforhold i West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc. eller ethvert andet af dets datterselskaber eller tilknyttede virksomheder betinget af tilfredsstillende afslutning af baggrundscreening. Om West 2023 markerer Wests 100-årige milepæl for innovation og den afgørende rolle, virksomheden fortsat spiller i sundhedssektoren og patientoplevelsen. Med 10.000 teammedlemmer på tværs af 50 lokationer over hele verden leverer West over 47 milliarder komponenter og enheder hvert år. Med hovedkvarteret i Exton, Pennsylvania, …

items.desc: Ken jij de accountantspraktijk en zie je hoe AI het werk kan ondersteunen? Als Business Analyst AI Products gebruik je jouw ervaring als accountant of samensteller om de praktijk en productontwikkeling met elkaar te verbinden. Je vertaalt de dagelijkse werkzaamheden naar duidelijke eisen voor AI-producten en toetst of die producten goed aansluiten op het werk. Je werkt aan AI-producten die collega’s al gebruiken. Denk aan AI-producten die facturen lezen, boekingen voorbereiden en vragen van klanten beantwoorden. Je ziet wat goed werkt, waar verbetering nodig is en wat het product oplevert. Je krijgt een eigen productdomein en wordt daarin een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor de praktijk en het productteam. Over PIA Group PIA Group is een ondernemend professioneel netwerk met meer dan 70 kantoorlabels en zo'n 3.500 collega's in Nederland, België, Luxemburg en Duitsland. De labels behouden hun eigen naam, mensen en klantrelaties. PIA Group voegt schaal, gedeelde data en gezamenlijke AI-producten toe. Vanuit PIA Group International werk je met de kantoren aan oplossingen die passen bij het dagelijkse werk. Wat ga je doen als Business Analyst AI Products? Je kent de werkzaamheden op een accountantskantoor uit eigen ervaring. Die kennis gebruik je om productteams te laten zien wat accountants, samenstellers en fiscalisten nodig hebben. Je bespreekt de praktijk met collega’s uit de kantoren en vertaalt hun kennis naar concrete producteisen. Je maakt ook duidelijk wat een goede AI-uitkomst is. Je brengt uitzonderingen en btw-situaties in kaart en legt vast wanneer een collega de uitkomst moet controleren. Tijdens de ontwikkeling test je de producten met praktijkvoorbeelden. Na de introductie meet je hoe collega’s ze gebruiken en wat ze opleveren. Je bent onder andere verantwoordelijk voor: Praktijkervaring vertalen naar duidelijke eisen voor jouw productdomein. Vastleggen welke uitkomsten goed zijn, inclusief uitzonderingen en btw-situaties. Bepalen wanneer een collega een AI-uitkomst moet controleren. Producten testen met voorbeelden uit de accountantspraktijk en beoordelen of ze klaar zijn voor gebruik. Vooraf de verwachte impact inschatten, in bespaarde uren en verwerkt volume, en na de livegang gebruik en werkelijk resultaat meten. Experts uit de kantoren betrekken en hun ervaringen met het product ophalen. Binnen zes maanden het inhoudelijke aanspreekpunt zijn voor jouw productdomein en met cijfers kunnen laten zien of jouw producten werken. Wat maakt jou succesvol? Je hebt zelf in de accountantspraktijk gewerkt en begrijpt hoe het werk verloopt. Je kunt die ervaring vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen voor AI-producten. Je communiceert makkelijk met accountants én productcollega’s, werkt kritisch en durft aan te geven wanneer een product nog niet goed genoeg is. Verder breng je mee: Je hebt 2 tot 4 jaar ervaring als (junior) accountant of samensteller bij een accountantskantoor. Je hebt zelf een werkende AI-toepassing gebouwd die door anderen wordt gebruikt. Je ervaring gaat dus verder dan het gebruiken van een chatbot. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Je werkt graag met concrete praktijkvoorbeelden en meetbare resultaten. Je neemt initiatief en vindt het prettig om mee te bouwen aan een functie die nog in ontwikkeling is. Wat krijg je bij PIA Group? Je krijgt een vaste, fulltime rol waarin je werkt aan AI-producten die al in gebruik zijn. Je rapporteert aan de Head of Product & AI en werkt samen met productcollega’s en experts uit de kantoren. Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw productdomein verder te ontwikkelen en mee te werken aan producten die het dagelijkse werk ondersteunen. Verder bieden we jou: Een salaris tussen € 70.000,- en € 90.000,- bruto per jaar op basis van 40 uur, 25 vakantiedagen, pensioenregeling, mobiliteit/leaseauto, opleidingsbudget en ruimte voor hybride werken. Een standplaats in Utrecht met twee tot drie kantoordagen per week. Bezoeken aan PIA-kantoren tellen mee als kantoordag. De middelen en ondersteuning om je werk goed te doen. Ready to join the ride? 🚀 Wil jij jouw ervaring uit de accountantspraktijk inzetten voor AI-producten die collega’s echt gebruiken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Het selectieproces bestaat uit drie gesprekken: eerst met de Head of Product & AI, inclusief een korte case over AI in het accountancywerk, daarna met het Business Improvement-team, en tot slot met de Group CTO en de HR Business Partner. Solliciteer via onze officiële sollicitatiepagina. Zo komt jouw sollicitatie op de juiste plek terecht en kunnen we deze zorgvuldig behandelen. Sollicitaties via e-mail nemen we daarom niet in behandeling. PIA Group – changing the game in accountancy.
