items.desc: Data Engineer met AI-ambities? Zet de volgende stap bij ons! Dit bieden wij jou Een groeiende organisatie met uitdagende klanten en projecten in verschillende branches; Een leuke functie in een gezellige werkomgeving met veel autonomie; Uitstekend salaris, een leaseauto, een bonusregeling, een smartphone en een laptop; De mogelijkheid om parttime te werken (minimaal 24 uur), 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid meer dagen op te bouwen; Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een premievrij pensioen en de optie om gunstig aandelen te kopen; De ruimte en de middelen om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je o.a. toegang tot de Vinci Academy en andere omgevingen waar een heel afwisselend aanbod aan trainingen en opleiding wordt aangeboden. Wil je meer weten of vrijblijvend eens koffie drinken? Leuk! Bel of app dan met Bert van Oort, 06 13 84 29 76, of mail [email protected] , of maak een connectie met jouw LinkedIn profiel. Bert van Oort neemt dan contact met je op. Hier krijg jij energie van Als Data & AI Engineer voeg jij daadwerkelijk slimme AI toe aan de data van onze klanten, zodat zij er direct meer waarde uit kunnen halen. Je werkt praktisch en hands-on: op het snijvlak van data science, data engineering, cloud engineering en softwareontwikkeling zorg je ervoor dat data tot leven komt met AI. Samen met je collega’s integreer je AI-oplossingen in bestaande processen, waardoor data niet alleen inzichtelijker wordt, maar ook direct bijdraagt aan betere besluitvorming en efficiënter werken. Betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid en concrete impact staan daarbij altijd voorop. Je richt je op het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en verfijnen van geavanceerde AI-oplossingen, zoals generatieve AI en LLM’s, waarbij de nadruk ligt op het benutten van de nieuwste AI-technieken. Je brengt deze modellen naar productie door gebruik te maken van moderne MLOps-methoden. Daarnaast bouw je robuuste AI-platformen in Azure en schakel je naar andere cloudomgevingen wanneer dat nodig is. Het integreren van AI in bedrijfsprocessen gebeurt bijvoorbeeld via API’s, SDK’s of copilots, waarbij je slimme methodieken en geavanceerde prompt engineering inzet om AI direct te koppelen aan de kenmerken van de organisatie. Je werkt nauw samen met jouw collega data engineers, architecten, specialisten en uiteraard met klanten. Je begeleidt implementaties en helpt medewerkers om AI-oplossingen te omarmen, zodat deze blijvende waarde opleveren. Ook draag je actief bij aan onze interne AI community en deel je jouw kennis tijdens kennissessies om gezamenlijk te groeien. Hier herken jij jezelf in In deze rol zoeken we iemand met een breed en veelzijdig profiel. We realiseren ons dat het volledige plaatje complex is en dat het goed mogelijk is dat je slechts een deel van het profiel beheerst. Dat is geen probleem. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je nieuwsgierig bent, wilt leren en energie krijgt van nieuwe uitdagingen. Deze functie raakt verschillende delen van ons vakgebied en sluit aan op nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen. Waar nodig helpen we je graag om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, zodat je in deze rol kunt groeien. Je bent bekend met het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI en ML-modellen en beschikt over solide kennis van Python, SQL en ETL-principes. Je hebt ervaring met Azure AI en Azure Machine Learning en vindt het geen probleem om ook met andere omgevingen te werken. Daarnaast weet je hoe je AI-oplossingen integreert via API’s of SDK’s. Je voelt je thuis in een multidisciplinaire omgeving waarin heldere communicatie essentieel is. Je schakelt gemakkelijk met klanten en collega’s en denkt actief mee over hoe AI waarde kan genereren binnen verschillende organisaties. Je bent nieuwsgierig, oplossingsgericht en altijd op zoek naar nieuwe technologieën en manieren om werk slimmer te maken. Je geniet van complexe vraagstukken en krijgt energie van het vinden van elegante en effectieve oplossingen. Je voelt je thuis in een dynamische werkomgeving waarin je de ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen en eventueel door te groeien richting rollen als bijvoorbeeld Senior, Lead Engineer of Architect. Dit is jouw team Bij Axians geloven we dat onze mensen het verschil maken. Binnen onze Business Analytics unit werk je met de nieuwste Microsoft en IBM-technologieën, waaronder met ons eigen dataplatform Maestro. Samen helpen we klanten om hun data écht te benutten en om te zetten in waardevolle inzichten en innovatieve toepassingen.

items.desc: Application Deadline: 8 November 2026 Department: GTM Adoption Location: London Compensation: £51,872.50 - £76,555.50 / year Description We're hiring an AI Learning Designer to write lessons for our AI masterclasses and lead the improvement of the AI-marked assignments that show whether learners actually change how they work. This isn’t a traditional instructional design role. You won’t build e-learning modules or storyboard compliance courses. Our masterclasses pair short video lessons with role-specific assignments, built with prompts and marked by AI with immediate feedback. You’ll lead how we review and improve those assignments across our curriculum: what we ask learners to do, how we mark it, and whether it leads to meaningful outcomes. You’ll also share ownership of our curriculum with our AI Learning Writer, split by AI provider, such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot. For your provider, you’ll write the scripts and lessons, and keep them current as new features ship. What you'll own Assignment quality: Develop clear quality standards with the Head of AI Learning, then review, test and redesign our prompts, tasks and marking criteria using learning science and sound prompt engineering. Your first big project is auditing assignments across our masterclasses and delivering the agreed redesigns. Your provider’s courses: Write scripts and demonstrations for new and refreshed courses. When your provider ships something that matters, test it yourself, decide what learners need to know, and update the course. Our content management system: Run day-to-day publishing and maintenance, fix problems as they come up, and improve the agentic tools we use to manage content. Learning objectives: Keep your provider’s objectives sharp, so what we teach, what we assess and what learners can do afterwards all line up. Learning what works: Use submission, feedback, completion and drop-off data to judge whether an assignment does its job. AI handles much of the analysis. We need your judgement on what it means for learners and the business. What we're looking for We hire for aptitude, hunger and a bias to action over years of experience. This role works best for someone who thinks in outcomes, cares how people learn, and opens a new AI tool the day it launches. You might come from consulting, product, research, teaching, edtech or learning design itself. You'll bring evidence of: Sustained, hands-on use of AI: prompts that do real work, comfort with agentic tools, and a feel for where models are reliable and where they need checking Thinking hard about how people learn, whether through teaching, tutoring, coaching or building training. You don’t need formal training in learning science, but you’ll want to go deep on it. Thinking in outcomes and working rigorously: you define success, measure what matters and act on what you find, moving quickly while catching the details others miss Clear writing that makes technical ideas simple without making them dull Learning fast and taking ownership of finished work, to deadlines Useful but not essential: Experience in learning design, assessment, learning science or edtech A background in consulting, product, research or similar analytical work Experience evaluating AI outputs or designing marking rubrics Experience with content management systems, automation or no-code tools We know great candidates don't always tick every box. If the scope excites you and you think your experience could translate, we'd love to hear from you. What you'll get A small, high-performing learning team, where everyone owns substantial work and what you build reaches hundreds of organisations in the UK and internationally. Equity: Everyone at PAIR is offered equity, because we want everyone to share in what we build together. Holiday: 25 days, plus bank holidays Learning: access to the best AI tools and PAIR’s own masterclasses A path to grow your career: we’re an early stage company that promotes from within. As we continue to scale, the opportunities to grow with us will only increase. Regular social events: to celebrate the wins, unwind and enjoy the journey together! The fine print This role is hybrid, with 2 days per week in our central London office We also come together for 7 company-wide Anchor Weeks each year (in person, Monday to Thursday). Inclusion and adjustments We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Every candidate for this role is assessed against the same published criteria, by interviewers using the same core questions. If you need any reasonable adjustments at any stage - a different format, more time, or flexible scheduling - just let us know.

items.desc: About This Role As an AI Business Operations Graduate, you will be part of Biogen's Customer Excellence & Operations (CE&O) team in Benelux, embarking on a dynamic 12-month paid program. This role offers a unique opportunity to explore the intersection of artificial intelligence and business operations within the pharmaceutical industry. You will contribute to the EU18 AI Accelerator, a collaborative hub where AI agents are designed, tested, and implemented to solve real business challenges across 18 European countries. You will work closely with the CE&O Omnichannel Manager, building AI agents using low-code tools like Microsoft Copilot Studio and transforming proven solutions into reusable blueprints. This program asks you to automate key processes, support various teams, and ensure compliance with Biogen's data privacy and responsible AI standards. By the end of the program, your contributions will help shape recommendations for scaling the AI accelerator across Europe. What You’ll Do You will be part of BioTrain, Biogen’s graduate program, combining hands-on experience with structured training, mentoring and exposure to different areas of the pharmaceutical industry. You will build practical skills, expand your professional network and gain valuable experience to support your future career. Map business processes, and identify ways that they can be redesigned, to maximally leverage AI Design and test AI agents for the EU18 AI Accelerator, transforming ideas into functional solutions. Collaborate with IT and business partners to ensure agents meet local needs and compliance standards. Support automation of Customer & Market Insights and Field Force Effectiveness processes. Leverage AI and automation to reduce manual effort in recurring insight generation, reporting, and field-force analytics. Provide operational assistance to Commercial, Medical, and Value & Access teams. Train and assist users in adopting AI agents, collecting feedback for continuous improvement. Document and report progress, tracking key performance indicators to measure success. Ensure all developments adhere to Biogen’s compliance, data privacy, and responsible AI guidelines. Engage with cross-functional teams to enhance workflow optimization and process improvement. Present your work and recommendations to senior leadership, showcasing your impact. Who You Are You are a recent graduate with a passion for exploring how AI can transform business operations. Your curiosity drives you to understand and leverage technology to achieve business goals. You possess a strong foundation in a relevant discipline, combined with a broad interest in business and data. Your analytical mindset allows you to solve problems methodically, while your communication skills help you convey ideas clearly and motivate others. You thrive both independently and collaboratively, eager to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment. Required Skills Recent Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Digital Marketing, or a related field. Hands-on experience with AI technologies, such as building custom GPTs or automation tools. Fluent in English, both written and spoken; Dutch and French are advantageous. Understanding of generative AI applications and their limitations. Awareness of data privacy (GDPR) and responsible AI practices. Structured working style with strong planning and documentation skills. Ability to collaborate with diverse teams across functions and countries. Valid permit or right to work in the Netherlands or Belgium. Preferred start date: January 2027, with flexibility for the right candidate. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. items.desc:
Applied AI Engineer - Direct Acquisition
 We're planning this as a six-month secondment. There may be an opportunity to extend it or make it permanent.
 We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join the Direct Acquisition team. 
 You'll design and build AI agents that run whole business processes, from planning the work to learning from the results. What you find will steer how far iwoca takes agents across the business.
 The company 
 Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.
 That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.
 We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.
 The team 
 Direct Acquisition includes iwoca's Marketing, Sales, Brand and Acquisition Tech teams. Together, they reach UK businesses of all shapes and sizes through paid and organic marketing channels and direct sales.
 A new team in Direct Acquisition builds agents that automate and improve acquisition processes. That's its only focus, and it works closely with Acquisition Tech. It's small – a product owner and you – and everyone builds. You'll report to the Head of Direct Acquisition, who sets the commercial direction.
 The role 
 As the Applied AI Engineer, you'll build the agents and the systems around them. Most of the work is system design and backend engineering.
 You'll start with direct mail. The first goal is an agent that plans each monthly round, uses iwoca's existing predictive models to build the mailing file, and learns from the results as they come in. The pattern is simple to say and hard to get right: the agent orchestrates, deterministic code does the work, and a human in the loop approves the file before it goes to print. You'll work with the people who run each process to understand the edge cases, and with Core Systems and Compliance on access and controls.
 The agents don't exist yet, and much is still open: which processes the team takes on, and what the architecture looks like. You'll own those design decisions and write most of the code yourself, much of it with AI coding tools. Some of this won't work, and finding out why is one of the main outputs of the role.
 Architecture. You'll design what agents need to run reliably: memory that persists between runs, task management, access to tools, permissions, and a record of every decision and why. You'll build each piece so the next process can reuse it. 
 Guardrails. You'll decide where the agent uses judgement and where code enforces rules the agent can't change, like suppressions, compliance checks and budget limits. 
 Delivery. You'll own each agent end to end: connect it to iwoca's predictive models, data pipelines and channel tools, and run it alongside the current process until it has shown it works. 
 Measurement. You'll track how often agents need a person, where they fail, what they cost, and what they're worth. 
 The requirements 
 We're looking for the depth of someone who has solved hard problems, and the pace of someone who moves fast in areas that are new to them.
 Essential:
 System ownership. You've owned a complex system end to end, from design to running it in production, and lived with the consequences of your architecture choices. 
 Design judgement. You've made architecture decisions other people built on, and you can explain the trade-offs and what you'd change. When an idea won't work, you say so and offer a better one. 
 Pace. You've got things live quickly in unfamiliar areas and they kept working once people relied on them. 
 Agent engineering. You've built systems where LLMs take actions – more than chat or summaries – and you can explain what went wrong and how you fixed it. You know when a problem needs an agent and when it needs a for-loop. 
 Controls. You've built permissions, data access rules and audit trails into systems from the start. 
 Constructive challenge. You work well with commercial and product colleagues, and when an idea won't work, you say so and offer a better one. 
 AI leverage. You've used AI coding tools to produce engineering work you couldn't have delivered without them – a service, an integration, or an internal tool others use. You have opinions on how to get the most out of them, and you check their output before it reaches production. 
 Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

items.desc: La Fondazione Biotecnopolo di Siena, fondazione di diritto privato senza scopo di lucro con sede legale e operativa in Siena, istituita con Legge n. 234/2021, art. 1, commi 945 – 950 e avente come membri fondatori il Ministero dell’Università e della Ricerca, il Ministero della Salute, il Ministero dell’Economia e delle Finanze e il Ministero delle Imprese e del Made in Italy, ha avviato la selezione di N.3 SCIENTIST DATA SCIENCE. ATTIVITA’ La risorsa verrà impiegata nelle attività di sviluppo scientifico e nelle attività del Laboratorio di Data Science, contribuendo alle capacità di analisi avanzata della Fondazione e del CNAP attraverso attività di ricerca, sorveglianza, modellistica e integrazione di dati multi-omici. Contribuirà inoltre all’attuazione delle linee di ricerca strategiche sui patogeni di interesse per il CNAP. I candidati selezionati si occuperanno, in base allo specifico ambito di attività cui saranno assegnati all’interno dell’ufficio, di: Machine Learning for Life Science Compiere ricerca computazionale nel settore della microbiologia molecolare applicata a batteri ad alto profilo di resistenza agli antibiotici e ai virus a rischio epidemico/pandemico. Assistere e formare i colleghi più giovani nel disegno e nella realizzazione di modelli algoritmici e pipeline di analisi a supporto di saggi che richiedono expertise di microbiologia. Supervisione di studenti di dottorato e in tesi di laurea. Cooperare con colleghi interni ed esterni, anche nell’ambito di progetti di ricerca condivisi. Cooperare con il responsabile del gruppo nella gestione e cura della strumentazione di laboratorio e delle infrastrutture di calcolo. Sviluppo di modelli di deep learning per task di classificazione biologica e l’analisi di proteine e acidi nucleici; Integrazione di strumenti di machine learning con pipeline di dati sperimentali. Computational Imaging Compiere ricerca computazionale applicata all’analisi di immagini nel settore della microscopia confocale e high-content applicata a batteri ad alto profilo di resistenza agli antibiotici, a virus, a linee cellulari e cellule primarie. Assistere e formare i colleghi più giovani nel disegno e nella realizzazione di saggi che richiedono expertise di microscopia confocale e high-content. Supervisione di studenti di dottorato e in tesi di laurea. Cooperare con colleghi interni ed esterni, anche nell’ambito di progetti di ricerca condivisi. Cooperare con il responsabile del gruppo nella gestione e cura della strumentazione di laboratorio e delle risorse di calcolo dedicate all’image analysis. Sviluppare, addestrare e validare modelli di Machine e Deep Learning per la segmentazione, l’annotazione funzionale e l’analisi quantitativa automatizzata di grandi moli di dati di microscopia. Computational Biology Conduzione di simulazioni di dinamica molecolare (classica e avanzata) di complessi anticorpo antigene; Analisi di interfacce di legame, cambiamenti conformazionali e stabilità dei complessi; Applicazione di docking molecolare, calcolo di energie libere (es. MM/PBSA, metodi alchemici) e modellistica strutturale; Supporto a mappatura di epitopi, studi di maturazione ed ingegneria degli anticorpi; Integrazione dei dati MD con risultati di laboratorio (ELISA, SPR, saggi di neutralizzazione); Contributo alla redazione di pubblicazioni scientifiche e deliverables di progetto; Partecipazione a riunioni interdisciplinari e presentazione dei risultati computazionali. REQUISITI E COMPETENZE Per l’ammissione alla procedura di selezione i candidati devono essere in possesso dei seguenti requisiti minimi: Laurea magistrale in discipline scientifiche pertinenti le attività descritte nel presente bando, seguita da esperienza lavorativa di almeno 5 anni nell’esercizio di funzioni analoghe a quelle oggetto del presente avviso presso laboratori di ricerca di enti pubblici o privati. In alternativa alla precedente, dottorato di ricerca in discipline coerenti con lo scopo del lavoro, i.e. bioinformatica, biologia molecolare, chimica computazionale, biologia strutturale, seguito da esperienza di almeno 2 anni presso laboratori di ricerca di enti pubblici o privati. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese scritta e parlata. I requisiti di ammissione devono essere posseduti alla data di scadenza del termine utile per la presentazione delle candidature e desumibili chiaramente dal cv. Nella valutazione delle candidature, costituiscono requisiti preferenziali a seconda delle rispettive aree di attività: Machine Learning for Life Science Esperienza pregressa nel campo della ricerca sulle malattie infettive con particolare riferimento allo sviluppo di anticorpi monoclonali e vaccini. Capacità di lavorare in gruppo dimostrando, al tempo stesso, autonomia organizzativa e di pianificazione delle attività di ricerca. Capacità di supervisionare studenti in tesi di laurea o di dottorato. Esperienza nello sviluppo di metodi di Deep learning (LLMs, GNN) per l’analisi di acidi nucleici e/o proteine …

items.desc: Position Description At CGI, you will help design and deliver advanced AI solutions that support mission-critical systems across the Space, Defence and Intelligence sector. As an AI Developer / Engineer, you will build and deploy intelligent applications that unlock the value of data, enhance decision-making, and drive operational impact. Working with cutting-edge technologies and expert teams, you will take ownership of complex challenges, contribute innovative ideas, and grow your career within a collaborative and supportive environment. The Space, Defence and Intelligence business unit in CGI is a true IT Systems Integrator. We work, build, and operate bespoke, technically complex, mission-critical systems which help our clients keep us all safe and secure. We bring innovation to our clients using proven and emerging technologies, agile delivery processes and our deep expertise across the breadth of space, defence, intelligence, aerospace and maritime, all underpinned by our end-to-end cyber capability. We work collaboratively with global technology companies, cutting edge SMEs and academia to deliver the optimal solution for each client. CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK ‘Best Employer’ by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you’ll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We’ll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go. Due to the secure nature of the programme, you will need to hold UK Security Clearance or be eligible to go through this clearance. This position will be based on site near Gloucester 5 days a week. Your future duties and responsibilities In this role, you will design, build and deploy AI-enabled applications within secure, often disconnected environments. You will take ownership of developing machine learning and AI solutions, including large language models, retrieval systems and data pipelines, ensuring they are scalable, reliable and optimised for performance. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, you will integrate AI capabilities into existing systems and contribute to solving complex operational challenges. You will bring creativity and technical expertise to developing innovative solutions, while being supported by a collaborative and forward-thinking environment. Design & Develop AI-enabled applications and machine learning solutions Build & Optimise end-to-end ML pipelines and data workflows Train, Fine-tune & Deploy models, including LLMs and other AI systems Integrate & Enhance AI capabilities within existing platforms Deploy & Manage AI workloads using containerisation and orchestration tools Collaborate & Innovate with cross-functional teams to solve complex challenges Monitor & Improve model performance and scalability in production Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role You should have strong experience in AI or machine learning development, with solid programming skills and an understanding of modern AI frameworks and deployment practices. Experience delivering AI solutions into production environments is essential. You should have strong Python development skills Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals and AI concepts Experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or LangChain Experience developing and deploying machine learning models into production Knowledge of data pipelines and CI/CD practices Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or similar technologies Familiarity with LLMs, retrieval systems or vector databases (desirable) Experience working with GPU or on-premise AI environments (advantageous) Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because… You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction. Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise. You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons. …

items.desc: Founding AI Engineer | Stealth AI Start-Up We are working with a London start-up using AI to transform a core, heavily regulated part of financial services. Rather than building tools for an existing industry, they’re rebuilding the service itself from the ground up, with AI doing the routine work and expert professionals focused on judgement. The team is small, well-funded and backed by top-tier investors, with paying clients already live on the platform. They’re now hiring a Founding AI Engineer to own how AI does the real work inside the product, from first prototype to something clients depend on. What you’ll own: Agentic workflows over live company financial data, from harness and evaluation through to what the end user actually sees Problems end to end: you pick them up, decide how to solve them and ship them into the product The control and evidence layer around the models, so every step is logged, traceable and accountable A weekly feedback loop with the domain experts who use what you build Messy, real-world integrations with financial systems, which is where most of the value sits What they’re looking for: Depth in LLM development, harness building or LLM product engineering, strong in one and able to work across the stack when it counts Evidence over seniority: what you’ve shipped matters more than years, and side projects count You build with AI natively, not bolted on afterwards You think about what doesn’t exist yet, not what’s currently done Strong fundamentals over familiarity with any specific tool The package: Up to £170k base + meaningful founding equity On-site, London

items.desc: Bei uns kommen AI-Kompetenz, Engineering-Exzellenz und fundiertes Branchenverständnis zusammen – getragen von Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen wollen. So entstehen zukunftsfähige Lösungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Das gelingt durch Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Chancen erkennen und technologische Möglichkeiten in greifbare Ergebnisse verwandeln. Dafür schaffen wir ein Umfeld, das von gegenseitiger Unterstützung geprägt ist: Raum für fachliche Weiterentwicklung, offene Communities, in denen Wissen gerne geteilt wird, Peer Groups und Trainingsangebote, die sich an dir orientieren. Vertrauen, Wertschätzung und gemeinsam gefeierte Erfolge prägen dabei unser Miteinander und machen Entwicklung zu etwas, das bei uns einfach dazugehört. br.AI.n steht für KI im Kern des Unternehmens – und damit auch für vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für alle br.AI.ners. Wir wachsen gemeinsam und lernen voneinander: in anspruchsvollen Projekten, interdisziplinären Teams und mit zielgerichteten Trainingsangeboten. Wir haben semantische KI im Herzen und den Erfolg unserer Kunden im Fokus. Als Treiber der Agentic Enterprise verbinden wir Mut zur Veränderung mit technologischer Tiefe und zukunftsfähigen Lösungen. Was uns stark macht, sind unsere br.AI.ners, die etwas bewegen wollen und das einfach machen. Dieses Handeln lebt von unserer Kultur, die auf Offenheit, Verantwortungsübernahme und gemeinsamen Erfolgen basiert. Aufgaben DEINE ROLLE Plattform-Backend mitbauen & weiterentwickeln: Du entwickelst skalierbare, wartbare Microservices für br.AI.n und SemReasoner — mit Java & Spring Boot als technischem Fundament und einem klaren Blick auf Architekturqualität. Agentic Integrations realisieren: Du bindest externe Dienste und Protokolle in unsere Plattform ein — darunter MCP-Server, LLM-APIs und Drittsysteme — und erweiterst damit gezielt die Fähigkeiten unserer Agenten-Architektur. Semantisches Backend verstehen & erweitern: Du arbeitest eng mit dem SemReasoner-Kern zusammen — Ontologien, Wissensgraphen und semantisches Reasoning sind für dich keine Buzzwords, sondern Bausteine, die du in produktionsreife Services überführst. CI/CD & Deployments verantworten: Du baust und pflegst robuste Deployment-Pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions o.ä.) und sorgst dafür, dass neue Features schnell, sicher und reproduzierbar in Produktion gehen. Cloud & Container betreiben: Du bringst unsere Services in Kubernetes und Cloud-Umgebungen (AWS, Azure oder GCP) — mit dem Anspruch, nicht nur lauffähig, sondern operativ solide zu sein. MLOps anpacken: Du integrierst KI-Workflows in unsere Produktionsinfrastruktur — von der Modellbereitstellung bis zur Automatisierung von Trainings- und Inferenz-Pipelines (z.B. mit Kubeflow, MLflow oder Argo Workflows). Proof-of-Concepts vorantreiben: Du testest neue Ideen früh, pragmatisch und mit klarem Validierungsziel — und weißt, wann ein POC produktionsreif ist und wann nicht. . Profil Solides Backend-Handwerk: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Java und Spring Boot, Microservice-Architekturen und dem Design skalierbarer, lose gekoppelter Systeme — du weißt, was in Produktion hält und was nicht. Agentic-AI-Verständnis: Du denkst AI-native — du verstehst, wie LLMs, Agenten und semantisches Reasoning zusammenspielen, und kannst dieses Verständnis in Backend-Architekturentscheidungen einfließen lassen. DevOps-Kompetenz: CI/CD ist für dich kein Add-on, sondern Standard. Du baust Pipelines, die das Team schneller machen — nicht langsamer. Cloud & Kubernetes: Du hast bereits Services in Cloud-Umgebungen betrieben und weißt, wie man Container-Workloads sauber orchestriert. Vendor-Präferenz ist kein Muss — Erfahrung schon. MLOps-Affinität (Pluspunkt): Wenn du schon mit Kubeflow, MLflow oder ähnlichen Tools gearbeitet hast, umso besser — wenn nicht, bringst du die Neugier und Lernbereitschaft mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten. Analytische Tiefe: Du liebst es, komplexe Probleme zu durchdringen — und findest Lösungen, die nicht nur funktionieren, sondern auch in sechs Monaten noch verständlich sind. Teamorientierung & Kommunikation: Du arbeitest offen, teilst Wissen proaktiv und bringst dich in Architektur-Diskussionen konstruktiv ein — auch wenn es unbequem wird. items.desc: AI verandert de manier waarop marketingteams werken. Van het ontwikkelen van content tot het automatiseren van processen en het persoonlijker maken van klantcommunicatie. Ook voor een organisatie als ENGIE, waar grote ambities op het gebied van digitalisering en klantgerichtheid samenkomen, biedt dat volop mogelijkheden. Maar hoe vertaal je die ontwikkelingen naar slimme toepassingen die niet alleen op papier interessant zijn, maar ook in de praktijk écht iets toevoegen? ENGIE Nederland is onderdeel van een van de grootste internationale energiebedrijven ter wereld. Met de kennis, slagkracht en ervaring van een wereldwijde organisatie speelt ENGIE ook in Nederland een belangrijke rol in de energietransitie. Onder andere met de recente opening van een van de grootste batterijparken van Nederland en een leidende positie in de zakelijke energiemarkt. In de consumentenmarkt is ENGIE juist een challenger met grote groeiambities, die de markt wil uitdagen met slimme, duurzame en klantgerichte energieoplossingen. Die ambitie vraagt om meer dan alleen duurzame energie. Ook de manier waarop ENGIE klanten bereikt, helpt en bedient, verandert. Klanten verwachten steeds persoonlijkere, relevantere en eenvoudigere digitale ervaringen. Tegelijkertijd bieden data, technologie en AI volop kansen om commerciële processen slimmer in te richten, de klantbeleving te verbeteren en verdere groei te realiseren. ENGIE investeert volop in deze ontwikkelingen. Er zijn al verschillende AI-tools, mogelijkheden en trainingen beschikbaar. De volgende stap? Die mogelijkheden vertalen naar concrete toepassingen die het dagelijkse werk verbeteren en daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor klanten en collega's. Daarom bouwen ze binnen Marketing & Sales aan een nieuwe manier van werken, waarin AI niet alleen wordt verkend, maar ook structureel wordt ingezet. Van AI-experiment naar dagelijkse praktijk Een salescollega die met behulp van AI sneller tot een passend klantadvies komt. Een slimme workflow die contentcreatie versnelt. Of een toepassing die klantdata gebruikt om communicatie persoonlijker te maken en de juiste vervolgstap richting een klant te bepalen. Als AI Marketing & Content Engineer onderzoek je hoe generatieve AI en automatisering dit soort verbeteringen mogelijk maken. Je beweegt op het snijvlak van AI, marketing, content en sales en vertaalt technologische mogelijkheden naar praktische oplossingen voor de commerciële organisatie. Soms ontdek je zelf een nieuwe toepassing, soms komt een team met een concreet vraagstuk. Jij onderzoekt wat mogelijk is, bouwt een eerste oplossing, test deze met gebruikers en verbetert haar totdat collega's er daadwerkelijk mee kunnen werken. Je zorgt ervoor dat goede ideeën niet blijven steken in losse experimenten, maar uitgroeien tot bruikbare en schaalbare toepassingen. Wat ga je doen? Je ontwikkelt en implementeert AI-toepassingen Je bouwt, implementeert en beheert AI-agents, GPT's en andere AI-assistenten voor commerciële processen. Je onderzoekt waar AI het verschil kan maken en vertaalt ideeën naar werkende oplossingen die aansluiten op de praktijk van ENGIE. Je automatiseert en verbetert commerciële processen Je ontwerpt slimme workflows die werkzaamheden versnellen, de kwaliteit verhogen en processen schaalbaarder maken. Denk aan toepassingen voor contentcreatie, salesondersteuning en klantcommunicatie, maar ook aan personalisatie, lead scoring, next-best-action en retentie. Je maakt AI toegankelijk voor collega's Je ontwikkelt prompt libraries, formats en praktische richtlijnen waarmee collega's AI effectief en verantwoord kunnen inzetten. Je inspireert, traint en begeleidt teams en helpt hen nieuwe toepassingen onderdeel te maken van hun dagelijkse werk. Je test, leert en verbetert continu Je werkt nauw samen met commerciële teams om kansen te identificeren, oplossingen te testen en feedback op te halen. Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen generatieve AI, automation en conversational AI en bepaalt welke innovaties relevant zijn voor ENGIE. Kansrijke toepassingen verbeter je en schaal je waar mogelijk verder op. Je zorgt voor verantwoord gebruik van AI Je houdt bij het ontwikkelen en implementeren van toepassingen rekening met kwaliteit, privacy, veiligheid en verantwoord gebruik. Je bouwt AI-capabilities die de gehele commerciële organisatie kunnen ondersteunen. Het commerciële resultaat en het eigenaarschap van de processen blijven bij de betreffende domeinen. Dit is jouw speelveld Je wordt onderdeel van het team Marketing Automation & AI en werkt vanuit het ENGIE-kantoor in Zwolle. Je trekt samen op met collega's uit onder andere content, digitale marketing en klantbehoud om technologie praktisch toepasbaar te maken en klanten beter en persoonlijker te helpen. ENGIE is volop in beweging. Binnen Marketing & Sales worden nieuwe teams gevormd en nieuwe manieren van werken ontwikkeld. Omdat deze functie nieuw is, ligt nog niet alles vast. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelf kansen te signaleren, …

items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Intelligente Applikationen entwickeln: Du konzipierst und entwickelst Geschäftsanwendungen mit Power Apps und setzt dabei konsequent auf KI-gestützte Funktionen wie AI Builder und Copilot-Integration auf Basis unternehmensinterner Datenquellen. Beratung und Governance: Du führst Envisioning- und Discovery-Workshops durch, priorisierst Automatisierungs- und Agenten-Kandidaten und unterstützt beim Aufbau von Center-of-Excellence-Strukturen sowie Governance-Frameworks für den skalierbaren und sicheren Einsatz der Power Platform im Enterprise-Umfeld. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens drei Jahre im Power Platform-Umfeld und technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahre mit konkretem Fokus auf Microsoft Copilot Studio im produktiven Einsatz. Fundierte Ausbildung: Ein Studienabschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich bildet die theoretische Basis. Power-Platform-Erfahrung: Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio und Dataverse mit. Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. items.desc: Ready to turn business problems into practical AI and automation solutions — and to say so when AI is not the right answer? Interested in owning a use case from the first workshop through to enterprise deployment, rather than picking it up after someone else has scoped it? Practical Information Location: Sofia, Bulgaria | Reports to: Service Delivery Lead - Azure & DWP | Work Arrangement: Hybrid | Language Requirements: Fluent/professional English, written and verbal | Learn more: softwareone.com As our new Microsoft AI & Automation Engineer , you work directly with customers to identify valuable use cases, recommend the right solution and take it through to enterprise deployment. Sometimes that means an agent built in Microsoft Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry. Sometimes it means Power Platform automation, classic search or another deterministic approach. This is a customer-facing delivery role on enterprise AI enablement engagements, working alongside the architect who owns the platform decision and alongside the strategy, security and adoption workstreams. Alongside hands-on delivery, you will help ensure that Responsible AI and governance principles are designed into solutions from the beginning rather than added at the end. We care more about solving the problem than using the most powerful technology. Key Responsibilities A dvise and implement governance guardrails with in the customer's Power Platform — managed environments, DLP connector policies, the custom connector approval route, capacity and license consumption, and the Center of Excellence tooling that keeps the estate visible Use agile and design-thinking methods to uncover, challenge and prioritise valuable AI and automation use cases B uild and customize agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry — instructions, knowledge grounding, connectors, actions and the enterprise AI workflows behind them Support the Solution A rchitect on the platform decision for each enterprise AI use case — Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry or the Power Platform — working from the business outcome rather than the product, choosing the least powerful option that meets the requirement, and defending that trade-off in design review Say so when the answer is not an agent at all: structured, predictable work belongs in deterministic automation, and static retrieval in classic search. Recommending that is part of the job Build and manage enterprise integrations — REST APIs, authentication, permissions, and connections into Dataverse, SharePoint and third-party systems Develop and maintain solutions across Power Apps and Power Automate Support enterprise AI rollout by embedding security, governance and Responsible AI principles across the solution lifecycle For everything you build, ensure the following : a first-class agent identity with least-privilege scope, registration in the agent inventory, human approval gates on anything that writes, data-protection checks across grounding and action paths, and audit-mode monitoring from day one Stay current on Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform and MCP developments, and share what you learn across the team Job Requirements Hands-on Copilot Studio agent building. You have built and customized agents in production — instructions, knowledge grounding, topics, connectors and actions — and you have extended them with tools Power Platform and Microsoft 365 depth, with real integration experience. Around five years across Power Apps, Power Automate and SharePoint Online, and the integration work that comes with it — REST APIs, authentication, permissions, and Dataverse and SharePoint connections Governance literacy. You understand environment strategy, ALM and deployment across dev, test and production, plus tenant and connector policy — and you understand that an agent inherits whatever those policies allow. You do not need to have run a tenant; you do need to know what to ask for and why Alongside those three, we look for how you work: agile, open-minded, strong design-thinking skills, and the judgement to challenge assumptions rather than accept the first use case offered Consulting presence: you run workshops, write documents customers sign, and handle estimation and scope conversations without escalation Fluency in English (both verbal and written) Considered a strong advantage None of the following is required , and nothing here will cost you the role. But each one is a genuine advantage, and if you bring it, you will be building on it from your first week: Microsoft Foundry — agent projects, model deployment and the Microsoft Agent Framework pro-code path . Semantic Kernel or AutoGen counts . The single strongest differentiator on this list Agent identity and lifecycle — Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Microsoft Agent 365 : registration, least-privilege scoping and retirement. items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Agentic Low Code: Du entwickelst als Agentic Low Code Developer mit Copilot Studio und der Power Platform agentische Geschäftslösungen für die Fachbereiche unserer Kunden – von intelligenten Apps und Hyperautomation bis zu Multi-Agenten-Szenarien im Enterprise-Umfeld. Du verbindest Low Code, KI und Prozessautomatisierung zu produktiven Lösungen und unterstützt beim Aufbau skalierbarer Governance-Strukturen. Agentische Low-Code-Entwicklung mit Copilot Studio: Du entwickelst mit Copilot Studio maßgeschneiderte KI-Agenten und Copiloten – inkl. Anbindung an Microsoft 365, Dataverse und branchenspezifische Datenquellen – und etablierst agentische Low-Code-Entwicklungsprozesse als gelebte Praxis: von der Orchestrierung mehrerer Agenten über Qualitätskriterien und Evaluierung bis zur Überwachung im Produktivbetrieb. Intelligente Applikationen entwickeln: Du konzipierst und entwickelst Geschäftsanwendungen mit Power Apps und setzt dabei konsequent auf KI-gestützte Funktionen wie AI Builder und Copilot-Integration auf Basis unternehmensinterner Datenquellen. Prozessautomatisierung und Hyperautomation: Du entwirfst und implementierst intelligente Workflows mit Power Automate – von klassischen Geschäftsprozessen über RPA bis hin zu KI-gestützten Automatisierungen, die Daten analysieren, klassifizieren und Entscheidungen vorbereiten. Architektur und Integration: Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen, die Power Platform und Copilot Studio mit Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Azure-Diensten und Drittsystemen nahtlos verbinden. Beratung und Governance: Du führst Envisioning- und Discovery-Workshops durch, priorisierst Automatisierungs- und Agenten-Kandidaten und unterstützt beim Aufbau von Center-of-Excellence-Strukturen sowie Governance-Frameworks für den skalierbaren und sicheren Einsatz der Power Platform im Enterprise-Umfeld. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens drei Jahre im Power Platform-Umfeld und technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahre mit konkretem Fokus auf Microsoft Copilot Studio im produktiven Einsatz. Fundierte Ausbildung: Ein Studienabschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich bildet die theoretische Basis. Power-Platform-Erfahrung: Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio und Dataverse mit. Agentische und AI-Kompetenz: Du bist begeistert von Copilot Studio und den Möglichkeiten, die agentische KI in der Low-Code-Entwicklung eröffnet, und bringst Interesse oder erste Erfahrung in der Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten und Multi-Agenten-Szenarien im Low-Code-Umfeld mit. Integrations- und Architekturkompetenz: Du hast Erfahrungen mit Konnektoren, APIs und der Anbindung von Azure-Diensten oder Drittsystemen sowie die Fähigkeit, übergreifende Lösungen zu entwerfen, die Power Platform sinnvoll in bestehende IT-Landschaften einbetten. Beratungs- und KI-Kompetenz: Du überzeugst Fachbereiche und IT-Entscheider gleichermaßen, übersetzt technische Sachverhalte in Business-Sprache und nutzt KI-Tools souverän im Fachgebiet – inklusive kritischer Bewertung der Ergebnisse und Enablement von Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden. Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.desc: At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise - it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way. Creators of technology trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500, Sysdig gives teams the real-time clarity to move fast and defend what matters most. Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be. If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you. What You Will Do Build and maintain hands-on lab scenarios and technical content (YAML- and Markdown-based) that reflect real-world use cases, with support from senior team members. Script and automate parts of the training environment (Bash/Python), and help troubleshoot the delivery platform (e.g. Instruqt, LMS) when issues come up. Help design and deliver training sessions, demos and workshops, starting alongside senior instructors and taking ownership of smaller sessions over time. Use AI coding/agent clients (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, or equivalents) to help build labs, write scripts and draft content faster, learning when to trust and when to verify their output. Collaborate with peers and cross-functional teams, ask for feedback often, and steadily build both technical depth and presentation confidence. What You Will Bring With You A working understanding of core DevOps and cloud-native concepts (containers, orchestration, CI/CD, Linux, cloud fundamentals), and eagerness to go deeper. Hands-on comfort scripting in at least one language (Bash or Python) and working with YAML/Markdown. Clear written and verbal communication and genuine enthusiasm for teaching and presenting to technical audiences, with room to grow. Comfort experimenting with AI coding/agent CLI clients (Claude Code, Codex, or similar). Curiosity, reliability, and a habit of asking for and integrating feedback. Professional English, written and spoken (an additional language is a plus). What We Look For Someone who applies newly acquired skills to deliver small components of training independently and connects technical topics to customer use cases. A dependable, collaborative team member who follows best practices, seeks feedback, and shows initiative in improving content and delivery. Growth potential toward a well-rounded enablement professional who can both build and teach. The technology stack combines Python and C++ and runs across both on-premises and cloud environments. The Role Build reliable software and frameworks used in quantitative research and trading. Deliver fast market data into trading systems where performance is critical. Develop integrated research and execution frameworks for fast predictors. Create simulation and research tooling for cloud environments. Support the development of research infrastructure for new asset classes. Work across Python and C++ systems deployed both on-premises and in the cloud. What We're Looking For Strong programming ability, with the engineering judgement to build robust quantitative systems. items.desc: Job Description Market Risk Analytics & Reporting (A&R) is a group within Core Engineering in the Risk Division of Goldman Sachs. The group ensures the firm’s senior leadership, investors and regulators have a complete view of the positional, market, and client activity drivers of the firm’s market risk profile allowing them to take actionable and timely risk management decisions. Risk Engineering is a multidisciplinary group of quantitative experts who are the authoritative producers of independent risk & capital metrics for the firm. Risk Engineering is responsible for modeling, producing, reviewing, interpreting, explaining and communicating risk & capital metrics and analytics used to ensure the firm adheres to its Risk Appetite and maintains the appropriate amount of Risk Capital. Risk Engineering provides risk & capital metrics, analytics and insights to the Chief Risk Officer, senior management, regulators, and other firm stakeholders. Role Responsibilities A&R delivers critical regulatory and risk metrics & analytics across risk domains (market, credit, liquidity, operational, capital) and firm activities via regular reporting, customized risk analysis, systematically generated risk reporting and risk tools . This role will focus on Market Risk. Responsibilities A&R has a unique vantage point in the firm’s risk data flows that, when coupled with a deep understanding of client and market activities, allows it to build scalable workflows, processes and procedures to deliver actionable risk insights . The following are core responsibilities for A&R: Delivering regular and reliable risk metrics, analytics & insights based on deep understanding of the firm’s businesses and its client activities. Building robust, systematic & efficient workflows, processes and procedures around the production of risk analytics for financial & non-financial risk, risk capital and regulatory reporting. Attesting to the quality, timeliness and completeness of the underlying data used to produce these analytics . Qualifications, Skills & Aptitude Eligible candidates are preferred to have the following: Masters or Bachelors degree in a quantitative discipline such as data science, mathematics, physics, econometrics, computer science or engineering. 1-3 years of experience, preferably in financial, regulatory or consulting environment Entrepreneurial, analytically creative, self-motivated and team-oriented. Excellent written, verbal and team-oriented communication skills. Working knowledge of the financial industry, markets and products and associated non-financial risk. Working knowledge of mathematics including statistics, time series analysis and numerical algorithms. Experience with programming in Python and SQL for extract transform load (ETL) operations and data analysis (including performance optimization). Experience in using languages such as R, Java, C++ is beneficial. Experience in developing data visualization and business intelligence solutions using tools such as, but not limited to, Tableau, Alteryx, PowerBI, and front-end technologies and languages. About Goldman Sachs At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. items.desc: Job portal Faculty and academic p... Research Assistants in the Svejstrup group at Department of Cellular and Molecular Medicine We are looking for one or two highly motivated research assistants for 4-month period to investigate how a long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) variant of ASCC3 regulates transcriptional recovery following DNA damage, in the Svejstrup lab, DNRF Center of Excellence, Center for Gene Expression (CGEN), Department of Cellular and Molecular Medicine (ICMM), Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. Staring date: January 1, 2027 Previous work from the Svejstrup group identified two gene products of ASCC3 implicated in this response: a protein, encoded by the long mRNA transcript, that suppresses transcription during the late stages of the UV-induced global shutdown; and a short mRNA transcript that acts as a regulatory lncRNA, suppressing the ASCC3 protein's function and enabling transcriptional recovery. The project will be focused on understanding how the ASCC3 lncRNA regulates RNAPII-mediated transcription and its recovery after DNA damage, using CRISPR/Cas9 technologies to generate and manipulate ASCC3 transcript variants, combined with state-of-the-art transcription profiling approaches such as TTchem-seq and RNA-seq. Information on the Department can be found at: https://icmm.ku.dk/english/ Our Center and Research CGEN is an interdisciplinary research center consisting of 6 research groups located in modern laboratories in the Mærsk Tower at the Panum Institute. Our mission is to use a cutting-edge ensemble of genetic, cell biological, biochemical, organismal, and modern ‘omic’-approaches to achieve a comprehensive understanding of the process of gene expression. CGEN performs ground-breaking research in a collaborative and ambitious environment, where young researchers are offered the best conditions to engage in bold and imaginative research. CGEN is also a center of learning, where PhDs and postdocs receive comprehensive insights in the cellular processes underlying gene expression, as well as a clear view of their medical importance and potential for a future research carreer. items.desc: Type: Full Time, Hybrid Team: Research Focus: AI & Agent Systems Who We Are We're a team of founders, engineers, researchers, creatives, and operators building what we believe will be one of the defining companies of the AI era. Some of us came from startups. Some from academia. Some from hospitality, defense, design, or completely different worlds. We don’t care how you got here - we care about your energy, intelligence, curiosity, resilience, and ambition. Who We Are Not We are not remote. We value the spontaneous moments that happen when we’re together - over dinner, in the hallway, around whiteboards. We like being around each other because the best conversations here rarely happen in meetings. We are not your typical team. It’s not just the 10 countries we’re from, the languages we speak or our non-traditional backgrounds. We’re solving hard problems with people we respect - we make the most of our time together, we make it special. We are not another “polished” SF startup . We value velocity over speed, raw talent over brands, and genuine human connection above all else. We value being successful, not looking successful. What You’ll Own & Build As a Member of Technical Staff within the Research Tribe, you’ll be one of the early engineers shaping the core systems that power Seldon. You won’t just build agents - you’ll design the infrastructure that governs how they operate: how they coordinate, how they’re evaluated, and how their behavior improves over time . This is a deeply technical role bridging distributed systems, machine intelligence, and product - turning stochastic models into reliable, production-grade systems. Multi-Agent Systems Architecture: Design and implement agentic systems, rather than prompt chains, at scale. You’ll define agent topologies, robust orchestration layers, structured state management, persistent and scoped memory, tool-use registries and execution, and build structured, inspectable systems. You’re building a long-running harness-based agentic platform, not wiring together LLM API calls. Behavioral & Persona Modeling: Simulate user archetypes with goal-directed behavior. You’ll design data-grounded personas, enable “computer-use” on real interfaces, and develop agents with critique and reflection loops. You’re producing measurable, actionable behavior. Evaluation & Prompt Engineering: Design prompt schemas and reasoning templates as integrated systems. You’ll build frameworks that measure behavioral fidelity and failure modes, and implement automated and HITL feedback. If it can’t be measured, it doesn’t ship. Signal & Insight Systems: Build systems that transform raw agent outputs into high-signal insights. You’ll cluster observations across runs, implement severity scoring, and map behavioral signals to product decisions. Turn noisy outputs into decisions. Production Reliability: Build the infrastructure to operate agents in production. You’ll implement tracing, attribution, and cost monitoring, detect failure modes and design fallbacks, circuit breakers, and evaluation pipelines. The bar is production reliability. Who You Are Systems, Not Prompts: You prioritize state machines, orchestration layers, and tool-use contracts over prompt hacking. You build for reliability, inspectability, and improvability - you’re uncomfortable with “it just works sometimes.” If it can’t be measured, it doesn’t ship. Production Experience: You have 5+ years building complex software and 2+ years shipping agentic LLM systems. You’ve built harnesses where agents manage tool selection, error recovery, and multi-step execution autonomously in production environments that run, break, and evolve. Orchestration Systems: You’re experienced with multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution, and complex backends. You optimize for coordination, scoped memory & context, and how agents degrade gracefully under pressure. Python Mastery: You’re an expert in async programming and structured data modeling (Pydantic), building maintainable, scalable systems designed for extensibility. Fast, Iterative Builder: You thrive when research and product move together. You’re comfortable shipping quickly, learning from real users, and refining systems in tight loops. High Ownership, Low Ego: You take responsibility for what you build. You’re willing to be wrong, change your mind, and prioritize being effective over being “theoretically right. Comfortable at the Frontier: You’re excited by ambiguous problems. You’re not waiting for best practices - you’re helping define them. Product Intuition: You prioritize signal over noise because outputs matter. You care that what you build helps someone make a decision. All Backgrounds Welcome: S ome of us are dropouts, some have PhDs. Some are tech veterans, some are first-timers. What matters - how you think, how you build, and how you work in teams. Nous cherchons un(e) ingénieur(e) chercheur(se) spécialisé(e) dans le développement de systèmes de mesure pour l’instrumentation des rayonnements ionisants. Ce poste de cadre en CDD de 24 mois est basé sur le site Nano-Innov de Paris-Saclay, Essonne (91). Ce poste est à pourvoir dès que possible. QU’ATTENDONS-NOUS DE VOUS ? Dans le cadre du projet FRATHEA, le SIMRI développe plusieurs systèmes de monitoring en dose et en forme de faisceaux. Dans ce contexte, le(la) candidate(e) travaillera sur l’intégration de moniteurs faisceaux dédiés à la mesure des faisceaux de très haut débits de dose (UHDR) et de très haute énergie électron (VHEE), ces moniteurs étant basés sur des éléments de détection différents. En partenariat avec les membres de l’équipe projet CEA ainsi qu’en interaction avec les partenaires du projet, il(elle) définira le design le plus adapté au moniteur faisceau, participera aux discussions du cahier des charges des électroniques multivoies associées et optimisera l’intégration et à la validation du dispositif intermédiaire de preuve de concept ainsi que du système final en tenant compte des différentes contraintes liés à l’environnement de la machine délivrant les faisceaux. Ce processus d’optimisation passera par plusieurs développements d’une version simplifiée intermédiaire vers la finale intégrée et regroupant les contraintes du cahier des charges de l’industriel. Vos missions : Définition et intégration des moniteurs : Preuve de concept et version finale : Design du support, design des PCB ; reprise des contacts etc. Choix des matériaux optimisés pour la mesure des faisceaux, prise en compte des contraintes machine associées Intégration de l’électronique multivoies du POC : discussion avec les partenaires extérieurs en charge du développement de l’électronique Obtention d’un dispositif de mesure intégré POC : prise en compte de l’électronique et des contraintes machines Participation aux essais : Participation active aux essais opérationnels et rédaction de notes de synthèse ou de modification des prototypes Documentation : Rédaction de documentation technique Collaboration avec l’équipe pour assurer la traçabilité et la qualité des livrables Pour en savoir plus sur le laboratoire, cliquez ICI. #CEA-List ; #LI-PV1 ; #Ingénieure ; #Chercheuse ; #Research Engineer ; #Industry4.0 ; #Capteurs ; #Scintillateurs plastiques Profil du candidat Vous êtes spécialisé(e) dans le développement de système de mesure de rayonnement. De formation, master, ingénieur ou docteur en physique, instrumentation ou domaine connexe. Vous recherchez un poste dans une équipe dynamique et pluridisciplinaire. Vous participerez à des projets de recherche et développement innovants dans ce domaine. Une première expérience couvrant la conception, le développement et les essais d’un système embarqué d’instrumentation est un atout. Vos compétences principales : Compétences en CAO pour fabrication additive (SolidWorks, FreeCad ou similaires) Compétences en programmation (Python, C#) Compétences avec les outils de CAO de saisie de schémas électroniques ainsi que de routage de circuits imprimés (Eagle, KiCAD ou similaires), notions de la programmation en C et C++ pour microcontrôleur Rigueur, autonomie, esprit d’initiative et qualités relationnelles. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? En intégrant notre équipe, vous aurez l’opportunité de : ✅ Travailler sur un projet Européen à fort impact, ✅ Collaborer avec des partenaires de renom en France et en Europe, ✅ Évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et contribuer à des avancées technologiques majeures. Le CEA propose des aménagements et/ou des possibilités d'organisation pour l'inclusion des travailleurs handicapés. items.desc: Remuneration Group 13 | Limited: 3 years (Tenure Track) | Starting date: 01.01.2027 | ID: FSMA053/2026 | Deadline: 30.10.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists. The research activity of the DESY theory group "X-ray Irradiated Materials: Theory and Computation" (FS-CFEL-XM) encompasses computational studies of X-ray irradiated materials and nanoparticles relevant for the areas of materials science, diffractive imaging, plasma, and warm dense matter physics investigated with XFEL and synchrotron light sources, with the focus on possible technology development and potential industrial applications. The group is integrated into the Center of Free-Electron Laser Science CFEL, and collaborates with various experimental and theory groups on the DESY campus and at the European XFEL, as well as with various national and international research partners. About your role: Supervision of theoretical and computational projects within the field of ultrafast X-ray science Exploration of the potential applications of project results for industry (technology transfer) Maintenance and development of open-source simulation tools to model various X-ray-induced transitions in solid materials Code optimisation to enable efficient computations, as well as the open-source release of the simulation tools to user community Supervision of PhD students Good reasons to join: Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our staff are central to us, with gender equality forming a key part of this commitment. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations. Limited: 3 years (Tenure Track) About you: Proven excellent expertise in: PhD in theoretical physics with focus on interaction of ultrashort laser pulses with solid matter Proven excellent expertise in: (I) modelling X-ray-free-electron-laser-induced transient modifications materials out of equilibrium using the FS-CFEL-XM group codes suite (https://xm.cfel.de/research/scientific_software/) (II) large-scale scientific computing, (III) code optimization, and (IV) scientific programming, demonstrated through a respective publication record and extensive code development experience Interest in focusing on possible technology development and potential industrial applications of the developed modelling concepts and simulation tools Good knowledge of English and strong interpersonal skills The ability to work in an interdisciplinary environment The ability to work closely with experimental groups For further information please contact Beata Ziaja-Motyka (beata.ziaja-motyka@cfel.de). Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation, CV, publication list and relevant certificates). We look forward to receiving your application via our application portal: DESY promotes equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion. We therefore welcome applications from people of all dimensions of diversity. The professional development of women is very important to us and therefore we strongly encourage women to apply for the vacant position. Applications from severely disabled persons and those with equivalent status will be given preference if they are equally qualified (sbv.desy.de). You can find further information here: https://www.desy.de/career/apprenticeship/ Deutsches Elektronen-Synchrotron DESY Personalabteilung Notkestraße 85 22607 Hamburg Phone: +49 40 8998-3392 Deadline for applications: 31.10.2026

items.card: What you'll do Design, build, and iterate on A/B tests and experiments that increase first purchases on GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab. Build and improve registration, trial, onboarding, and in-product upgrade and purchase experiences to increase completion of these steps. Implement backend features and services in Ruby on Rails and frontend experiences using Vue.js. Analyze experiment results and product usage
items.desc: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As an Intermediate Fullstack Engineer (Ruby/Vue.js), Growth at GitLab, you'll help turn GitLab's self-serve funnel into a reliable source of new paying customers. You'll work on the in-product journey from a user's first visit through sign-up, trial, and first purchase, on both GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Data Analysts, with a particular focus on backend development in Ruby on Rails and frontend work in Vue.js. This role gives you the opportunity to combine your fullstack engineering skills with product thinking and experimentation, shipping small changes quickly and measuring their impact on real customer outcomes. Some examples of our projects: Making it easier for self-managed users to try and buy GitLab Building upgrade prompts where users run into paid features Improving the trial experience, including trials of GitLab Duo Improving the tooling the team uses to run and read out experiments What you'll do Design, build, and iterate on A/B tests and experiments that increase first purchases on GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab. Build and improve registration, trial, onboarding, and in-product upgrade and purchase experiences to increase completion of these steps. Implement backend features and services in Ruby on Rails and frontend experiences using Vue.js. Analyze experiment results and product usage data with Data Analysts to decide which changes to keep, iterate on, or roll back based on first-purchase outcomes. Collaborate with Product Managers and UX Designers to define hypotheses and success metrics before shipping experiments, then compare results against those metrics. Maintain and improve our experimentation framework and tooling to increase experiment throughput and reduce the time from setup to results. Collaborate with other Engineering teams, including Fulfillment, to remove purchase barriers across GitLab’s codebase. Document decisions, review code, and share experiment results asynchronously so distributed teammates can track shipped changes and their measured outcomes. What you'll bring Professional experience developing with Ruby on Rails and modern JavaScript, along with solid Git, feature development, and deployment workflows. Experience working with relational databases and a solid understanding of web performance optimization. A track record of shipping features to production and owning them after release. Ability to use product data to decide what to build, keep, or roll back. Ability to document decisions and share updates asynchronously with distributed Product Management, UX, and Data teammates. Ability to organize your work, seek and apply feedback, and collaborate inclusively with teammates from diverse backgrounds, in line with GitLab’s values. Preferred, not required: experience with Vue.js, PostgreSQL, A/B testing, feature flags, experimentation frameworks, or SaaS sign-up, trial, billing, or checkout flows. We'll help you learn our tooling. About the team We’re GitLab’s Growth team: one team with one roadmap, prioritizing work by how directly it helps people buy. We work fully remotely and asynchronously across multiple regions, guided by GitLab’s values of transparency and iteration. Our challenge is running more high-impact experiments, faster, while coordinating changes with teams like Fulfillment and Pricing across the parts of the product they own. For more on how we work, see the Growth and Product sections of the GitLab handbook. Poland base salary range: zł 248,000 - zł 372,000 The base salary range for this role’s listed level is …
