items.desc: We believe in the power of process and its potential to unlock growth in teams everywhere. Who we are Process Street is an AI software and compliance operations platform startup from San Francisco. We help our customers build, document, automate, and track recurring workflows. Our platform automates the work, enforces the standards, and proves compliance so our global customers can run their businesses. We service over 3k customers around the world, and are VC-backed by Accel, Salesforce, and Atlassian. Our Mission To make work fun, fast, and faultless for teams everywhere. Our culture Process Street was founded on a strong belief in the work-life benefits of a healthy, collaborative remote culture. We value flexibility because many of us are parents, travelers, or just creatives who aren't inspired by the construct of a mundane 9-to-5. Spread across 9 different time zones, we communicate asynchronously, work autonomously, and take real ownership of our work. We know human connections are what make teams strong, so we regularly do coffee chats, game-playing, story-telling, and more, to build strong relationships. If you're entrepreneurial and seek an environment that values impact, ownership, and flexibility we look forward to meeting you! The Opportunity Dash is a managed AI teammate for small teams, built by Process Street. It picks up the recurring work that falls between people — the follow-ups, the handoffs, the things everyone assumes someone else did — and does it in Slack or Microsoft Teams, checking with a human before anything goes out. Dash is new, and most of the people who'd love it haven't heard of it yet. Your job is to change that, and to turn the attention you create into pipeline. This is demand creation, not demand capture, and the distinction shapes everything. There's no proven channel to scale, no playbook to inherit, and no installed base to build referral or expansion programs on. Every source of growth has to be invented and proven before anyone can optimize it. The role has four connected parts: create attention, produce the content that sustains it, convert it into pipeline, and keep finding the next advantage. They're one job. The campaigns only work because there's a content engine behind them, the content only compounds because there's a conversion engine in front of it, and none of it holds for long without constant experimentation. Dash runs like a startup inside a funded one. Process Street has investors behind it. Dash has a small team, its own budget, and has to earn its next dollar — which is exactly why this role exists. Budget won't be the lever that makes a campaign succeed. Creativity, timing, partnerships, and earned attention will be. We want someone whose instinct is to manufacture reach rather than purchase it, and who treats a small budget as a design constraint rather than an obstacle. The same discipline applies to the direct marketing engine: spend should be deliberate, measured, and defensible against the pipeline it produces. You'll have real leverage behind you. Much of our content, research, and distribution runs on an automated production layer, so one person here can put far more into market than they could at a company doing this by hand. You won't be limited by how much you can produce. You'll be limited by what you decide is worth making — and whether it's good enough to ship, backed by a system that moves as fast as you think. What You'll Do Run stunts that earn attention. Conceive and execute the kind of campaign people stop for and share. This is a distinct craft, and we're hiring for it deliberately. Build launch moments. Time the creative, the paid push, and partner distribution to land together. One well-built moment is worth more than months of steady output. Build creative partnerships. Source, negotiate, and close deals with creators, communities, and complementary brands, including working out what makes each one worth their while. Invent channels, online and off. Prove new routes to an audience that doesn't know us yet, using events and activations as part of an integrated campaign, and be as quick to abandon what doesn't work as to pursue what does. Own the content calendar and the output. We publish at high volume across search, video, social, and community. You own what gets made, when it ships, and whether it's good enough. Direct the automated production layer. Brief the agents, review what comes back, correct what's wrong, and extend the system into new formats and channels. Make modern content — short-form video, images, ads, and written work — at a pace that only works if you use AI as a genuine force multiplier. Own discovery in both directions. Traditional search optimization and AI-assisted discovery, where a growing share of buyers now form their shortlist. Work the conversation through community and reply marketing where our audience already is, kept human rather than automated into noise. Hold the brand line. Dash has a …

items.desc: At SWEP, we believe our future rest on give more energy than we take – to our planet and to our people. As the world´s leading supplier of efficient heat transfer technology, we are driving the conversion to sustainable energy usage in heat transfer. We are dedicated to constantly creating more from less energy, material, and space. We are a growing company and a part of the Dover Corporation family. We are dedicated to supporting our customers with the optimal solutions and we believe in close, rewarding partnerships. We are represented in more than 50 countries and have production facilities in Sweden, USA, Slovakia, China and Malaysia. For us at SWEP, it's more than just a job, it´s a commitment to making a difference and an impact by finding new ways to make energy last longer – globally and locally. We are striving for record-breaking growth and are looking for individuals who think like entrepreneurs, have an open mind, care about the environment, and want to inspire and be inspired. Come and join us! SWEP - Innovation Engineer, Thermodynamics If you love developing advanced mechanical systems and turning thermodynamic research into real products, this is an exciting opportunity for you! Come and join us pursuing engineering excellence. This role focuses on bringing applied research and technology concepts into practical industrial applications. What you will do In this role, you will primarily focus on thermodynamic simulations within technology development in our R&D hub, turning new ideas into practical concepts and driving technical solutions forward. You will collaborate with a talented team of engineers and work closely with cross-functional specialists across our global organization who all share a passion for our products and technological evolution. Key Responsibilities Responsible to, in line with superior manager, participate, start-up and lead projects in applied research, technology and concept development Develop methods and best practices within your area of thermodynamics Plan and perform updates of technology trends within your area of expertise Drive, contribute, participate in conceptual development Based on request participate in sales and marketing activities related to area of expertise On regular basis search and evaluate competition and technology development globally by available methods from databases, conferences and literature You will be based in Landskrona reporting to the Innovation Director and be part of an innovation team consisting of 7 technical multi-disciplinary team members. We offer the flexibility that life sometimes requires, but we believe that collaboration and value creation happen best when we sit and work together from our office. Your background Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related field with a focus on Thermodynamics or Fluid Dynamics Relevant experience from CFD, Matlab and or AI usage for mathematical simulations Experience in mechanical design, product development or R&D environments Experience from technical development projects, either in industry or university research Fluent in Swedish and English Who you are You have an open mindset and a strong interest in technology trends and industrial development. You enjoy leading technical projects, solving complex problems, and have the multidisciplinary engineering skills needed to understand both technology and market needs. For more information , please contact Thomas Dahlberg, Innovation Director at thomas.dahlberg@swepgroup.com Sounds interesting? Do not hesitate - apply today! You are welcome with your application and CV in English, not later than 13th November 2026. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other factors prohibited by law. Fraudulent Recruiting Disclaimer: Dover Corporation and our affiliated operating companies want to alert applicants to internet job posting fraud, where parties posing as Dover employees, recruiters, or other agents, try to engage with online candidates in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. We do not endorse or engage in any recruitment practices that involve payment or personal information outside of our official application and hiring process. Please verify the authenticity of an invitation to apply for a job, or for a job offer by contacting us directly through our Dover and affiliated operating company websites at https://careers.dovercorporation.com/ . To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice on our careers site.

 Náplň práce, právomoci a zodpovednosti 
 Do nášho vývojového tímu hľadáme vášnivých a na detail orientovaných testovacích inžinierov a inžinierky (alebo členov či členky testovacieho tímu ), ktorí budú zohrávať kľúčovú rolu pri zabezpečovaní bezchybnej funkčnosti našich produktov. Ak ťa baví odhaľovať skryté nedostatky a navrhovať komplexné testovacie stratégie, si na správnom mieste!
 Čo bude tvojou úlohou v tejto roli v našom tíme:
 Architekt/ka kvality: Budeš navrhovať a definovať testovacie stratégie a plány pre mikroprocesorové zariadenia a zabezpečovať tak ich spoľahlivosť od samého začiatku.
 Tvorca/kyňa test scenárov: Budeš tvoriť prepracované testovacie scenáre, ktoré dôkladne overia funkčné a systémové vlastnosti vyvíjaných produktov s rôznym zameraním:
 Hladká integrácia softvéru a hardvéru;
 Komplexné testovanie softvéru pre embedded systémy a aplikačného softvéru;
 Overovanie interakcie medzi zariadeniami a systémami.
 Praktický tester / testerka: Budeš realizovať manuálne a automatizované testovanie a odhaľovať a analyzovať chyby z pohľadu bezpečnosti, výkonu, funkčnosti a použiteľnosti, aby sme mali istotu, že naše produkty dosahujú najvyššiu kvalitu.
 Analytik/čka a komunikátor/ka: Výsledky testovania budeš prenášať do zrozumiteľných reportov a dokumentácie, aby s nimi mohli pracovať ostatné vývojové tímy.
 Tímový hráč / hráčka: Budeš úzko spolupracovať s inými vývojovými tímami a projektovými manažérmi, koordinovať testovacie aktivity a zabezpečovať bezproblémovú integráciu testovania do vývojového cyklu produktu.

items.desc: About The AI Security Institute The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally. We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action. Expression of Interest - Cyber and Autonomous Systems Team (CAST) CAST is open to expressions of interest from talented cyber security experts and software engineers of all levels of seniority who want to work at the forefront of frontier AI security but do not see a role listed that matches their skills and experience. Our talent team will reach out should a role arise that may be a good match. About The Team AI capabilities in cybersecurity and autonomy are advancing faster than at any point in history. Frontier models can now work through multi-step network intrusions, discover and exploit software vulnerabilities, and carry out long-horizon technical tasks with increasing independence. These are extraordinary tools for scientific and economic progress, but also have the potential for serious harm if misused or deployed without adequate oversight. The team evaluates the capability of both frontier and open-weight AI models in cybersecurity, autonomy and AI R&D, ensuring the UK government and its partners have an accurate view of risks and capabilities. We use realistic cyber ranges and a large CTF suite for our evaluations, run pre-deployment testing of frontier models, and collaborate with our partners across UK government, frontier labs, and NCSC. Your day-to-day work might include building state-of-the-art evaluations (e.g., cyber ranges), running pre-deployment testing exercises (e.g., Claude Mythos Preview), validating novel model behaviours (e.g., models cheating in evaluations), and answering timely research questions (e.g., the capabilities of open-weight models). Working alongside you would be engineers and researchers who care deeply about the impact of their work, take pride in their craft, and have a high level of autonomy. If that sounds exciting to you, we'd love for you to apply! Salary £65,000 - £145,000 GBP What We Offer Impact you couldn't have anywhere else Incredibly talented, mission-driven and supportive colleagues. Direct influence on how frontier AI is governed and deployed globally. Work with the Prime Minister’s AI Advisor and leading AI companies. Opportunity to shape the first & best-resourced public-interest research team focused on AI security. Resources & access Pre-release access to multiple frontier models and ample compute. Extensive operational support so you can focus on research and ship quickly. Work with experts across national security, policy, AI research and adjacent sciences. Growth & autonomy If you’re talented and driven, you’ll own important problems early. 5 days off and annual stipends for learning and development, and funding for conferences and external collaborations. Freedom to pursue research bets without product pressure. Opportunities to publish and collaborate externally. Life & family* Modern central London office, or where applicable, option to work in similar government offices in Birmingham, Cardiff, Darlington, Edinburgh, Salford or Bristol. Hybrid working, flexibility for occasional remote work abroad and stipends for work-from-home equipment. At least 25 days’ annual leave, 8 public holidays, extra team-wide breaks and 3 days off for volunteering. Generous paid parental leave (36 weeks of UK statutory leave shared between parents + 3 extra paid weeks + option for additional unpaid time). On top of your salary, we contribute 28.97% of your base salary to your pension. Discounts and benefits for cycling to work, donations and retail/gyms. These benefits apply to direct employees. Benefits may differ for individuals joining through other employment arrangements such as secondments. Salary Annual salary is benchmarked to role scope and relevant experience. Most offers land between £65,000 and £145,000 made up of a base salary plus a technical allowance (take-home salary = base + technical allowance). An additional 28.97% employer pension contribution is paid on the base salary. This role sits outside of the DDaT pay framework given the scope of this role requires in depth technical expertise in frontier AI safety, robustness and advanced AI architectures. As a Data Scientist at Systematic, you'll design and build the AI capabilities that give defence forces a real operational edge – and work directly with the people who use them. The job: AI that makes a difference, from concept to customer Working closely with Defence customers and internal teams, you will design, implement, and support AI-driven solutions within Systematic's SitaWare ecosystem, contributing directly to real-world operational effectiveness. You'll take AI capabilities from concept through to deployment, always keeping the end user's needs in focus. In short, you can look forward to: Integrating AI services, including agentic workflows, to automate data processing and analysis, generating high-value outputs that support senior decision-makers Engaging users and stakeholders to capture AI requirements, drive solutions and adoption Collaborating with Data Engineers and Intelligence Domain Advisors to deliver customer value during experimentation and operational activities, including military exercises Training customers on data and AI tools to ensure effective operational use of SitaWare products You'll be based in Farnborough, Hampshire, UK, and should expect around 30% travel time – mainly domestic travel to support customers on-site at their locations across the UK, plus some international travel for customer activities and internal company activities such as training. The Western Europe team is a multidisciplinary group of project managers, solution architects, engineers, trainers and consultants, working highly collaboratively to ensure successful delivery of our projects. You'll report to a Senior Manager and work alongside Data Engineers and Intelligence Domain Advisors on a daily basis. What you bring: technical capability and a problem-solving mindset You hold a Bachelor's degree or higher in Data Science, Computer Science or a related field, along with around 2 years of experience in a Data Scientist role within the software/IT industry. items.desc: Everfield acquires and holds European software companies for the long term. We own 100% of the Business Units (BUs) we buy, but we do not run them directly. Each BU is led by its own CEO. We support and steer the portfolio through a small set of operating ratios that translate strategy into measurable performance. We believe the software industry is going through a paradigm shift: from tools that help customers do the job to agents that do the job for them . Our portfolio has tens of companies, around 500 product ideas in the pipeline, and tens of thousands of customers across European verticals. The companies that adopt the agent paradigm first will define the next decade of their categories. This is one of the most exciting product surfaces in European B2B SaaS right now, and it needs a builder. We're hiring a AI Builder to be the hands-on engineering force inside Everfield's product team. You'll work as the technical counterpart to the Product Lead: jumping into BU codebases, prototyping with agentic coding tools, and shipping agent-first features end to end on real products with real customers. You will not be short on problems to solve. We have a deep pipeline of customer-validated ideas, a portfolio of BUs that are eager to be first movers, and the freedom to prototype in days rather than quarters. What you will do Build agent-first products end to end inside the codebases of Everfield's BUs. Spec, prototype, ship, iterate, hand off. Drop into any BU codebase, get productive in days, and produce working software fast. Backend systems, data platforms, workflow tools, and the occasional UI heavy product. Run agentic coding (Claude Code, Codex, SpecKit and whatever comes next) as the default mode of work, not as a novelty. Where AI tooling does not yet exist for a problem, you build it. Prototype directly with BU customers and iterate based on what they actually use, not what they say in interviews. Work side by side with BU engineering teams on their own codebase so the BU has first-hand experience of how the product was built and can maintain and extend it after you move on. Translate validated ideas into shipped products in weeks rather than quarters. Hand off cleanly: production-ready code, the documentation a BU engineering team needs to keep it alive, and a short technical narrative the BU CEO can use. Spot the next build opportunity while you're delivering the current one. The Product Lead will run customer discovery, but you will be in the room and your technical instinct on what's actually buildable matters. Help codify what works into a repeatable build playbook so the model can scale to additional builders over time. What we are looking for Senior engineer who has shipped real software to real users. An engineering degree or self-taught, either is fine. What matters is the body of shipped work. Founder or near-founder experience. You have founded or co-founded a tech startup (B2B SaaS preferred but not required), or operated as a near-founder with full ownership of a product. You know what it costs to ship. AI-native ways of working. Daily, hands-on use of agentic coding tools. You build with AI by default. You have a clear point of view on where these tools are strong, where they're brittle, and how to wire them into a real codebase without creating maintenance debt. Polyglot pragmatism. You can work across stacks. You've shipped in at least two languages in production. You're not religious about any of them. You can read an unfamiliar codebase and be useful inside a week. You can work inside that reality and choose intelligently between greenfield, brownfield, and "greyfield" (a clean rebuild wired into existing UI and APIs). Direct customer exposure. You're comfortable demoing to customers, watching them use what you built, and changing it on the spot. 3 to 8 years of experience, typically in engineering, founding, or hybrid product/engineering roles. Probably did a stint at a larger company and got frustrated. Comfort with ambiguity and jumping between BUs, codebases, and customer segments without getting stuck. Strongly preferred Experience operating across multiple companies, portfolios, or accelerator-style environments rather than spending years on a single product. General familiarity with B2B SaaS fundamentals. Working in English at the executive level. Other European languages are a bonus. Exposure to post-acquisition or M&A integration environments. items.desc: A Different Kind Of Job Description At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make. Why this is a terrible job This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable. You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall. Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four. And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless. Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise. The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening. The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that. We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win. What You'll Build As a Fullstack AI Developer, you'll build the agentic systems at the heart of Filed: Agentic workflows that mirror how tax professionals actually work, judgment call by judgment call Evaluation and verification systems that measure our accuracy against professional standards, not benchmarks we invented for ourselves The model integrations and tooling that turn probabilistic systems into something firms trust with high-stakes work You'll work at the frontier of applying AI to subjective domains, where two different answers can both be correct, and where shipping means earning the trust of professionals who scrutinize every output. What You'll Be Responsible For Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told Making LLMs work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale Your Hard Skillset Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python: you've built complex, data-heavy UIs and backend services before Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it Your Soft Skillset Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it A championship team We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together. We measure …

items.desc: Graag motivatiebrief toevoegen m.b.t de eisen Bouw mee aan een productiewaardige AI-oplossing voor vergunningverlening De Omgevingsdienst Brabant Noord werkt aan een innovatieve AI-oplossing waarmee duizenden omgevingsvergunningen automatisch worden geanalyseerd en vertaald naar betrouwbare karakteristieken en metadata. De eerste Proof of Concept staat. Nu zoeken wij een ervaren AI Engineer die deze oplossing verder mee ontwikkelt naar een schaalbaar, beheersbaar en productiegeschikt platform. Hierbij ligt de focus niet alleen op het toepassen van (Generative) AI, maar vooral op de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en controleerbaarheid van de resultaten. Hallucinaties moeten zoveel mogelijk worden voorkomen, consistentie is belangrijk en de uitkomsten moeten aantoonbaar bruikbaar zijn binnen een publieke organisatie. Je komt terecht in een relatief kleine organisatie waar je breed inzetbaar bent en veel verantwoordelijkheid krijgt. Ook wordt van je verwacht dat je je interne collega’s meeneemt in de ontwikkeling en zorgt voor kennisdeling. Je hoofdtaak zal zijn het doorontwikkelen van onze AI oplossing voor vergunningdata. Daarnaast zal ook je inzet gevraagd worden voor de implementatie van Databricks in onze organisatie. Mocht er ruimte over zijn, kan je gevraagd worden andere AI initiatieven op te pakken. De opdracht Als AI Engineer werk je mee aan de doorontwikkeling van het project AI Vergunningen. Je houdt je bezig met: Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van GenAI-oplossingen op Microsoft Azure. Ontwerpen en bouwen van productieklare AI-workflows. Implementeren van prompt engineering strategieën voor betrouwbare resultaten. Verwerken en extraheren van informatie uit vergunningdocumenten. Verbeteren van de kwaliteit, nauwkeurigheid en reproduceerbaarheid van AIuitkomsten. Ontwikkelen van Databricks-data pipelines voor het verwerken, transformeren en verrijken van vergunningdata. Ontsluiten en voorbereiden van grote hoeveelheden documentdata binnen Databricks voor AI- en LLM-toepassingen. Bouwen van schaalbare backend-oplossingen in Python. Opzetten en onderhouden van CI/CD-processen. Samenwerken met functionele experts en interne medewerkers. Actief kennis delen en collega's meenemen in de mogelijkheden van AI. Meedenken over Azure-architectuur, security en beheer. Wat breng je mee? Eisen Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring in Data Engineering of vergelijkbare data-gerelateerde softwareontwikkeling. Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met Generative AI / LLM-oplossingen. Aantoonbaar HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau (beta/technisch profiel). Uitstekende kennis van Python waaronder software design patterns en coding standards. Ervaring met Microsoft Azure, waaronder: o Azure Functions o Azure AI Foundry Ervaring met prompt engineering. Ervaring met CI/CD-processen, GitHub Actions en Terraform Ervaring met Data Engineering binnen Databricks. Nice to have Ervaring met entity extraction en documentverwerking binnen Azure AI Foundry. Ervaring met Docker en Azure Container Apps. Ervaring met FastAPI. Kennis van Azure Networking en Security. Wie ben jij? Wij zoeken iemand die niet alleen technisch sterk is, maar ook initiatief neemt en eigenaarschap toont. Je bent: Proactief. Communicatief sterk. Verantwoordelijk en betrouwbaar. Resultaatgericht. In staat om zelfstandig te werken. In staat om technische keuzes helder uit te leggen aan collega's en stakeholders. Bereid om interne medewerkers mee te nemen in de ontwikkelstappen en kennisdeling. Waarom deze opdracht? Deze opdracht biedt de kans om te werken aan een innovatieve AI-toepassing met directe maatschappelijke waarde. Je helpt een publieke organisatie om grote hoeveelheden vergunninginformatie toegankelijk en bruikbaar te maken met behulp van de nieuwste Generative AI-technologieën. Je werkt aan de stap van Proof of Concept naar een toekomstbestendige productieoplossing en hebt daarbij veel invloed op architectuur, techniek en werkwijze. Interesse? Reageer met een recent CV en een korte motivatie waarin je jouw ervaring met Azure, Generative AI en Data Engineering toelicht. #Jobster

items.desc: Why This Team The Chief Information Security Office (CISO) is home to deeply talented colleagues that work to ensure the safety of Citi's clients', our revenue, our employees and our proprietary data. We manage information security as one end-to end program – one with a clear mandate and accountability. Our mission is a program that is fully anchored to modern control and architectural frameworks, is fully aligned with the enterprise architecture of the firm and is deeply integrated into the businesses and functions. AI Security Specialist AI models can now autonomously discover and exploit zero-day vulnerabilities in production software — and we're building the defensive capability to match. We're hiring across four CISO teams working at the intersection of AI and cyber security. What Makes This Different The problems we're solving don't have playbooks yet. AI-driven vulnerability management. When frontier models can generate thousands of findings in a weekend, the bottleneck shifts from discovery to triage, verification, and remediation. We're building the pipeline that makes this sustainable. Security architecture for the AI era. Defining how a global bank deploys, monitors, and governs agentic AI — from standards and evaluation frameworks to production runtime monitoring. AI at scale, not in a lab. Citi has deployed AI tools to 180,000+ employees, equipped 30,000 developers with AI coding assistants, and is rolling out agentic AI capabilities firm wide. Securing that footprint and the platforms that underpin them is the job. Securing AI agents that can behave like insider threats. Frontier models can harvest credentials, escape sandboxes, and adapt when they detect monitoring. We're designing the containment architectures and runtime controls to operate them safely at enterprise scale. Real security engineering. This isn't a cyber seat where you'll spend your time in administration . You will be expected to understand the code, the architecture, the threats, and find solutions. You'll have the mandate and the backing to build something meaningful. What You'll Work On Depending on your background and interests, you could join one of four teams: Offensive Security & Vulnerability Management — AI-assisted pen testing at a scale previously impossible. Automated exploit validation. Bridge the gap from "AI found a vulnerability" to "the application team has a PR to fix it." AI & Emerging Technology Security — Define how the bank deploys AI safely. Security architecture and assurance for new implementations, plus building the next generation of AI-powered tools for our CISO colleagues. Test new models at the cutting edge of creation and influence. Cyber Security AI Services — Own the AI products CISO depends on in production — security assurance, cyber security operations, governance and controls, vulnerability assessment. Keep them reliable, evolve them fast. Cyber Security Operations — Detection, triage, and response for a world where adversaries use AI to find and exploit vulnerabilities faster than traditional detection can keep up. Behavioral analytics for AI agents. Playbooks for AI-originated attack scenarios. Why Citi, Why Now Real and urgent. Not an innovation lab. The threats are active, the work ships into production, and it protects one of the world's largest financial institutions. Technical teams. These are engineering-led functions. Small teams, high autonomy, minimal governance overhead. We build tools, ship code, and measure ourselves by what we deliver — not slide decks. Strong mandate. Executive sponsorship to move fast. You'll have the backing and resources to act on what you find. Unique scope. Very few organizations operate at this intersection at this scale. The solutions you build will influence how the industry responds. Qualifications Strong record of technical leadership and architecture on complex, novel systems. Deep expertise building and scaling agentic/LLM systems with rigorous evaluation, guardrails, and production reliability. Demonstrated depth across both domains - able to lead credibly in offensive security and detection/SecOps. items.desc: About Oper Oper, a European Fintech company, is a leader in cloud-based digital mortgage software. We provide personalized journeys for borrowers and lenders. Oper's technology streamlines the mortgage application process, eliminates paperwork, and increases transparency. The fastest growing part of our business is Herman , our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else. Phase by phase, it automates more of the origination process: first employed borrowers, then the self-employed, and onward. This is not a chatbot bolted onto old software. It is agentic software doing real work in a regulated environment. A passionate and engaging team of around 30 stellar Fintech operators works vigorously to transform European mortgages by enhancing efficiency and alleviating borrower anxiety. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Motive Ventures, we have raised EUR 14 million, placing Oper at the forefront of revolutionizing mortgages in Europe. items.desc: Company Description Within Publicis Groupe's Intelligent Creativity business, Publicis Production specializes in bringing creative ideas to life, and to consumers. Our 6,000-strong talent across 52 locations worldwide radically redefine content production by delivering Intelligent Content. Together, they leverage a 100-year history of craft excellence, the world's biggest studio network, and the industry's richest data through the power of agentic AI. Intuitively delivering through the world's first Intelligent Content agent, Marcel Make. The result? A production company that leads the way. A category-defining promise to the market with predictively performing content that unlocks unprecedented business growth. And a workplace with countless opportunities, at the forefront of innovation, AI and award-winning craft. Overview We’re building a new AI capability to respond to client briefs across advertising, production, and post-production, and we’re looking for an AI Artist to help deliver it. This role is ideal for a hands-on AI practitioner with strong operator skills who can work across fast-moving briefs, build and refine outputs, and contribute confidently within a growing team structure. Working closely with the AI Artist Lead and Creative Director, you’ll help translate briefs into executable AI workflows, create and iterate assets, and support delivery across projects while working within real-world production timelines and quality expectations. This is a hands-on delivery role. You’ll spend the majority of your time in the tools, making, refining, testing, and troubleshooting work across a range of AI-driven production tasks. learning, problem-solving approaches, and workflow knowledge with the wider team Collaborate effectively with freelance and in-house specialists as project needs evolve Stay Hands-On in the Tools Build, refine, and troubleshoot AI workflows across video, visual, and audio generation Test different models, approaches, and settings to achieve the best output for the brief Work across adjacent technologist, or similar hands-on role Background in agency, production, or post-production environments is preferred Clear understanding of real-world production workflows, approvals, and deadlines Ability to work independently on defined tasks while collaborating closely with leads and wider teams Comfortable taking feedback and iterating quickly under time pressure AI & Creative Skillset items.desc: WHO IS ENGIE? ENGIE puts sustainable development at the center of its activities (electricity, natural gas, energy efficiency, and services) to meet the challenges of the energy transition to a low-carbon economy: access to a sustainable economy, climate change mitigation and adaptation, and resource optimization. ENGIE, a global leader in low-carbon energy and services, relies on its Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management (GBU S&EM) to provide reliable, sustainable, and affordable energy to all its customers. This strategic unit optimizes the Group’s and clients’ production assets and designs tailored energy solutions for our 200,000 professional clients and 15 million consumers. The Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management leverages ENGIE’s assets to deliver secure and sustainable energy to its B2B and B2C customers. It uses its expertise in energy management to provide decarbonized electricity 24/7. Joining Supply & Energy Management means becoming part of a team of over 10,000 passionate experts spread across 20 countries, all united by a shared mission: shaping a greener and more efficient energy future. Together, we push the boundaries of innovation to deliver decarbonized energy 24/7. Join us and be part of those shaping the energy of tomorrow! WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? We are looking for a Forecasting Data Scientist Senior in Supply & Energy Management Italy, based in Milan . The ideal candidate is a data-driven professional with a strong quantitative background and hands-on experience in data science and machine learning, particularly in time series forecasting. The role combines solid programming skills (Python and R) with a practical, business-oriented mindset and the ability to transform complex data into actionable insights. He/she has curiosity for energy markets and the energy transition, along with the willingness to deepen knowledge of market design and regulatory frameworks. He/she has experience with energy supply processes, modern data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Spark), and cloud-based analytics environments. Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-experts complete the profile. WHAT WILL YOU DO? As a Forecasting Data Scientist Senior, you will contribute to the development and delivery of forecasting processes and models that support the energy supply business. Under the guidance of the Digital & Portfolio Modelling Manager, you will collaborate closely with forecasting, portfolio managers, pricers, and other business stakeholders to ensure forecasting models are accurate, timely, and aligned with operational needs. Your work will be based on rigorous data collection and analysis, and will directly contribute to optimizing costing, forecasting, sourcing, and hedging strategies within a defined business mandate. You will be actively involved in the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of forecasting tools and methodologies, ensuring alignment with global standards and contributing to their evolution. Your role will also include cross-functional collaboration within the SPM community and with data and forecasting teams in other countries to promote knowledge sharing and consistency. You will be responsible not only for the technical development of forecasting models but also for ensuring their operational reliability and relevance to business needs. You will provide scientific expertise for bespoke analyses and contribute to the continuous improvement of forecasting practices. Key Responsibilities Model and Process Development: Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of forecasting tools, models, and processes used to support the energy supply business. Commercial Offer Support: Participate in the development of forecasting components for new commercial offers, ensuring alignment with business needs and market dynamics. Customer Insights: Analyze customer behavior using diverse data sources to enhance forecasting accuracy and business relevance. Data Utilization: Leverage a wide range of internal and external data sources to ensure robust and accurate portfolio and consumption representation. Best Practices Promotion: Advocate for good practices in data handling, model development, and coding standards across the team and broader community. Code Quality Assurance: Ensure high-quality, maintainable code by adhering to established development standards and guidelines. Cross-Team Collaboration: Actively engage with other quantitative analysts and data scientists across teams to exchange ideas, models, data, and technical insights, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment. About You Personal Attributes Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to tackle complex forecasting challenges and translate data into actionable insights. Clear and effective communication skills, especially in explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. …

items.desc: Vos missions Dans l’unité Identification, Guidage, Navigation et Contrôle (IGNC) du Département Traitement de l’Information et Systèmes (DTIS), vous contribuerez au développement de méthodes innovantes de commande et de planification de trajectoires pour le Guidage-Pilotage des systèmes aérospatiaux autonomes. Les travaux de l’unité visent à accroître les capacités d’autonomie de plateformes aériennes, spatiales et de défense évoluant dans des environnements complexes, dynamiques et incertains. Vous participerez à des études appliquées et à des activités de recherche amont portant notamment sur la génération de trajectoires sous contraintes, l’optimisation temps réel et la commande de systèmes dynamiques. Les applications visées sont défenses, civiles ou duales et concernent en particulier les drones, les missiles et les véhicules spatiaux. Les études sont réalisées principalement pour le compte de la DGA ou en lien avec les grands industriels français du secteur aérospatial (ArianeGroup, MBDA, Thales, …). Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Concevoir et développer des méthodes de commande et de planification de trajectoires pour le Guidage-Pilotage des systèmes autonomes ; Développer des algorithmes fondés sur l’optimisation, la commande optimale, la commande robuste, la commande prédictive et l’intelligence artificielle ; Évaluer les performances et la robustesse des approches proposées par simulation et sur démonstrateurs ; Participer à des projets de recherche nationaux, européens ou institutionnels en collaboration avec des partenaires académiques et industriels ; Valoriser les résultats obtenus à travers des publications scientifiques, revues et conférences internationales, et des actions de transfert ; Contribuer au montage de nouvelles actions de recherche et au développement de collaborations scientifiques ; Encadrer ou co-encadrer des stagiaires, doctorants et post-doctorants. Le poste offre la possibilité de développer une activité scientifique propre, de proposer de nouvelles thématiques de recherche et d’évoluer vers des responsabilités scientifiques au sein de l’unité et du département. Vos missions sont conditionnées par l’obtention d’une habilitation de défense nationale Votre profil Titulaire d’un doctorat en automatique, robotique, mathématiques appliquées ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur complété par une expérience significative en recherche et développement, vous disposez de solides compétences en modélisation et analyse des systèmes dynamiques. Vous possédez des connaissances dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : navigation-guidage-pilotage, planification de trajectoires, commande optimale, optimisation numérique, systèmes aérospatiaux, intelligence artificielle appliquée à la commande et simulation de systèmes dynamiques. Vous maîtrisez au moins un environnement de calcul scientifique tel que Python, MATLAB/Simulink ou C/C++, ainsi que l’anglais scientifique écrit et oral. Une expérience réussie en développement d’algorithmes embarqués, en rédaction d’articles scientifiques, en encadrement de stagiaires ou doctorants, ou dans le cadre de projets collaboratifs serait appréciée. Engagé, autonome et rigoureux, vous faites preuve d’initiative dans la conduite de vos travaux et êtes capable de développer une vision scientifique à moyen et long terme. Votre capacité d’analyse, votre curiosité scientifique et votre goût pour le travail en équipe vous permettront de contribuer au développement de nouvelles activités de recherche, à l’encadrement de jeunes chercheurs ainsi qu’au rayonnement scientifique de l’unité. Votre environnement Le Département Traitement de l'Information et Systèmes (DTIS) mène des études et recherches pour maîtriser conception, opérations et autonomie des systèmes aérospatiaux (commande systèmes, traitement de l’information, IA, ingénierie systèmes-logiciels, interaction homme-système, math. appl., conception-optimisation systèmes, sûreté-sécurité, robotique-autonomie). L’unité Identification, Guidage, Navigation et Contrôle (IGNC) mène des activités d’études et de recherche visant à élaborer, développer et évaluer des méthodes innovantes pour la chaine de Navigation-Guidage-Pilotage des véhicules aérospatiaux. Rejoignez l'ONERA, façonnez l'avenir ! L'ONERA, expert étatique de la recherche aéronautique et spatiale, façonne l’innovation et la défense de demain. Ses 2200 collaborateurs relèvent les défis du futur et renforcent la compétitivité de l'industrie aérospatiale à travers les grands programmes français et européens, porteurs de l’ADN ONERA. Intégrer l’ONERA, c’est s’engager dans une aventure où chaque jour est une occasion d’innover, de repousser les limites de la connaissance et de construire le futur. Rejoignez l’ONERA, et prenez votre envol vers l’avenir !

items.card: Dans le cadre des activités de recherche et développement du laboratoire Antennes, Propagation et Couplage Inductif (LAPCI) du CEA-Leti, le ou la candidat.e sera en charge de l’étude, de la caractérisation, de la simulation et de la modélisation de la propagation des ondes électromagnétiques pour des applications de télécommunications sans fil et de capteurs électromagnétiques innovants, notamment de type radar
items.desc: Dans le cadre des activités de recherche et développement du laboratoire Antennes, Propagation et Couplage Inductif (LAPCI) du CEA-Leti, le ou la candidat.e sera en charge de l’étude, de la caractérisation, de la simulation et de la modélisation de la propagation des ondes électromagnétiques pour des applications de télécommunications sans fil et de capteurs électromagnétiques innovants, notamment de type radar hyperfréquence. Les travaux porteront sur la caractérisation et la modélisation du canal de propagation dans différents environnements. Ils viseront à comprendre les principaux mécanismes d’interaction des ondes avec l’environnement, notamment dans des scénarios urbains, industriels, indoor/outdoor, terrestres, aériens ou satellitaires. Le/la candidat.e spécifiera et validera les moyens expérimentaux nécessaires au sondage, à la caractérisation et à l’émulation du canal radiofréquence. Il/elle participera à la conception de bancs de mesure et à la réalisation de campagnes expérimentales en s’appuyant sur les moyens du laboratoire : sondeurs et émulateurs de canal, chambres anéchoïques et instruments de mesure hyperfréquence. En complément des mesures, il/elle développera et mettra en œuvre des méthodes de simulation de propagation basées notamment sur le lancer ou le tracer de rayons, l’optique géométrique et physique et les solveurs électromagnétiques numériques. Les simulations seront confrontées aux données expérimentales afin de développer et valider des modèles déterministes, stochastiques ou hybrides du canal. Un second axe majeur concernera la modélisation des signatures électromagnétiques et radar des objets et des scènes. Le/la candidat.e étudiera les phénomènes de diffusion et de rétrodiffusion et contribuera au développement de modèles physiques permettant de prédire la réponse radar des cibles et leur interaction avec l’environnement. Ces travaux alimenteront le développement de méthodes d’imagerie radar et l’exploitation de données multidimensionnelles pour la détection, la localisation et la caractérisation d’objets et de scènes. Le traitement des données pourra s’appuyer sur des techniques avancées de traitement du signal, de statistiques et d’Intelligence Artificielle. Le/la candidat.e travaillera avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et dans le cadre de collaborations industrielles et académiques, nationaux et internationaux. Il/elle assurera le suivi et la restitution de ses travaux et pourra être amené.e à assurer la coordination technique ou la gestion de projets. Il/elle contribuera à la définition de nouveaux axes de recherche, à l’encadrement de collaborateurs et d’étudiants, ainsi qu’à la valorisation scientifique des résultats au travers de publications, conférences et de propositions de brevets. Profil du candidat Niveau école d’ingénieur ou doctorat, avec une formation en systèmes de télécommunications, radar, électromagnétisme ou électronique hyperfréquence. Une première expérience, académique ou industrielle, dans la caractérisation et la modélisation du canal radio, la simulation électromagnétique, les mesures hyperfréquences, la modélisation de signatures radar ou le traitement du signal est souhaitée. Les principales compétences recherchées sont : Modélisation déterministe, stochastique et/ou hybride du canal de propagation, en champ proche et en champ lointain Simulation de la propagation électromagnétique et analyse des mécanismes de réflexion, diffraction, diffusion et multi-trajets Expérimentation et caractérisation hyperfréquence appliquées à la propagation des ondes Modélisation des signatures électromagnétiques et radar des objets et des scènes Traitement du signal appliqué aux télécommunications, au radar et à l’imagerie Une bonne connaissance des moyens d’expérimentation hyperfréquence est demandée, notamment des sondeurs et émulateurs de canal, analyseurs de réseau, analyseurs de spectre et équipements de mesure associés. Le/la candidat.e devra également disposer de connaissances en modélisation du canal de propagation pour des applications de communications sans fil, de réseaux de capteurs, de systèmes cellulaires et de capteurs électromagnétiques de type radar. Des compétences en simulation électromagnétique et en modélisation physique de la propagation et de la diffusion seront particulièrement appréciées. La maîtrise d’outils de lancer ou de tracer de rayons tels que Sionna, Volcano, Altair ou équivalents constituera un atout, de même qu’une expérience avec des outils de simulation électromagnétique tels que CST Studio Suite ou Ansys HFSS. Une bonne compréhension des problématiques de propagation des ondes au sein d’une chaîne de communication sans fil ou radar est attendue. Une expérience en modélisation de signatures radar, calcul de surface équivalente radar, génération de données radar synthétiques ou imagerie radar 2D/3D sera également valorisée. items.title: Affiliated Researcher position in the project ‘Solving the integration challenge of high-skilled migrants: the central role of merits’ – at the Stockholm School of Economics Institute for Research
items.card: you will be expected to independently and together with the other researchers in the project contribute to: Conducting the analysis of a unique, large-scale recruitment database from a major Nordic company, containing applicant-level information across different positions Mapping and relating to current research on recruitment, discrimination, and labor market inclusion in Sociology and Management studies Conducting
items.desc: About The Position As an affiliated researcher joining an existing project, you will be expected to independently and together with the other researchers in the project contribute to: Conducting the analysis of a unique, large-scale recruitment database from a major Nordic company, containing applicant-level information across different positions Mapping and relating to current research on recruitment, discrimination, and labor market inclusion in Sociology and Management studies Conducting the analysis of the data from our survey experiments from a nationally representative sample using the Swedish Citizen Panel. The experiments investigate perceived integration merits of immigrants in Sweden Publishing original research on the basis of the recruitment database and the survey experiment Being part of the Center for Migration and Integration Research -CMIR is optional. If you wish to be part of CMIR, you will be expected to participate in the Center’s research activities (e.g. research seminars) and multistakeholder activities (e.g., workshops, roundtables, and dialogue forums) Your profile The successful candidate will have built a research agenda during their PhD, as evidenced by publications or conference papers, in the broad field of migration and integration. Their general disciplinary background should be within the social sciences, preferably in sociology or management with a focus on migration and integration. They master quantitative methods and have a very good understanding of survey experiments. Candidates should thrive in a collaborative environment while driving their contribution to the project independently. The applicants must hold a PhD by time of employment. They have shown ability and ambition to publish manuscripts in highly ranked, international scholarly journals. We expect the candidate to relocate to Stockholm and to be physically present in the office. How To Apply Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform by latest November 1st, 2026. The following documents should be included in your application: A curriculum vitae A separate document listing published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals, as well as other academic peer-reviewed publications (e.g., book chapters, conference proceedings). Copies of representative research, that is, copies of your publications or work in progress (max 5) Names and contact information for three people willing to provide references. We recommend that you apply as soon as possible and at the latest before November 1st, 2026. Starting date is flexible but preferably around December 2026. The employment is up to the end of December 2027. For further questions on the position, please contact Laurence Romani: laurence.romani@hhs.se or Andrea Voyer: Andrea.voyer@sociology.su.se The position is formally at the Stockholm School of Economics Institute for Research About Stockholm School Of Economics Institute For Research Stockholm School of Economics Institute for Research is an independent research foundation, founded in 2010. The overall aim is to conduct qualified academic research within the economic sciences, which aims to unite scientific stringency with empirical relevance. The purpose of the Institute’s publications is to disseminate research concerning corporate enterprises and society. About The Center For Migration And Integration Research The Center for Migration and Integration Research (CMIR), housed at the SSE House of Governance and Public Policy (GaPP), aims to create a platform to support the sustainable integration of third-country nationals in Sweden. Together with key stakeholders in the migration and integration process, experiences and insights are researched and incorporated into a systemic perspective. The Center emphasizes the importance of the collaboration of multiple stakeholders in the governance of migration and integration, at multiple levels, and focuses not only on employment, but also on other dimensions of sustainable migration and integration. The research team collects, creates, and disseminates multiple-actor, science-based knowledge on the governance of migration and integration in Sweden for societal and social sustainability.

items.desc: Description Advertising at Amazon is a fast-growing, multi-billion dollar business that spans across desktop, mobile and connected devices; encompasses ads on Amazon and a vast network of hundreds of thousands of third party publishers; and extends worldwide. Traffic Quality, within Amazon Advertising, builds technology to detect invalid traffic (IVT) and ensure that Advertiser spend worldwide is directed towards human audiences and protected from ad fraud. As the Security engineering team within Traffic Quality, we research programmatic advertising risk landscapes to build an understanding of existing and emergent threats. We build specialized techniques to detect and mitigate these threats, contributing to a robust Traffic Quality platform that is a bedrock of advertiser trust and saves hundreds of millions of dollars in ad spend that would otherwise be lost to IVT. The Security Engineering team is responsible for: (a) Targeted threat hunting, including on the dark web, to consistently stay updated on modus operandi and risks associated with advertising fraud, (b) Building sophisticated mitigation techniques through reverse engineering known software, identifying network layer signatures, and conceiving client-side scripting methods, and, (c) Collaborating with security teams across Amazon for sharing intelligence and devising durable detection techniques. As a Security Engineer in the team, you are passionate about unraveling ad fraud tactics utilizing a diversity of highly specialized skills in reverse-engineering, deep packet inspection of network traffic, understanding of network security, operating systems and browser architectures. You accomplish your tasks by applying expert level knowledge to tools to understand not only what a particular piece of malware for perpetrating ad fraud can do but also how it does it. You work with internal security teams to identify and mitigate botnets, as well as leverage the ethical hacking community to obtain standard modus operandi, source code and tactics used by malware and botnets. The role requires influencing leaders across the company to improve our security bar and protect advertiser trust. A Security Engineer also works with other product and security teams to proactively identify problems and suggest approaches to solve them. Given the high level of ambiguity in the advertising fraud space, and the need to prepare for unknown unknowns, your creativity, judgement and bias for action will all be key ingredients towards delivering the right results for advertising customers. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP Experience programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C++ or similar object oriented language You have passion for reverse engineering, malware analysis, threat detection and risk hunting. Preferred Qualifications Experience with AWS products and services Experience with any combination of the following: threat modeling, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. About the job
 Build the framework support that helps AI developers unlock Graphcore hardware.
 You will help Graphcore accelerators work seamlessly with state-of-the-art ML frameworks, including Triton and PyTorch. Reporting to a Team Lead in Frameworks, you will design, implement, optimise and support critical software.
 Your work will shape how researchers and engineers use Graphcore hardware for demanding machine learning workloads. You will improve performance, quality and usability across a complex software stack.
 You will join our Triton team, delivering new features, reviewing code, writing technical documentation and working with upstream communities. You will also help coordinate open-ended technical work across teams.
 This role offers deep technical ownership and visible impact as the ML software landscape evolves. You will keep learning and may contribute across other framework teams.
 The team and culture
 The Frameworks team connects Graphcore hardware with the tools ML engineers and researchers rely on. We work across PyTorch, Triton, JAX and TensorFlow, focusing on usability and performance.
 Work happens through agile practices, close technical discussion and clear ownership. Engineers are trusted to speak up, solve hard problems and move work forward with pace.
 Decisions are shaped by evidence, code quality and business outcomes. You will work across Graphcore and with open-source communities to deliver software developers can trust.
 What we’re looking for
 · Strong software engineering skills, with the judgement to manage quality, complexity and technical debt.
· Experience developing in Python and C++.
· Experience in compiler development.
· Ability to manage complex technical tasks with cross-team dependencies.
· Clear communication skills, with a proactive approach to collaboration and technical leadership.
· Interest in AI, ML frameworks, performance optimisation or computationally intensive engineering.
 Benefits
 · Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn
 We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.
 Join the Team at Graphcore
 Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.
 As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.
 Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.
 If you want to shape the frameworks developers use to push AI compute forward, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to be part of the journey.

items.desc:
We are hiring builders to define how people talk to, show things to, and hear from AI

In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. We've scaled beyond the millions of people using Perplexity every day for research, shopping, investing and curiosity into a new paradigm of using AI to transform knowledge into action.

The Multimodal team builds the experiences and infrastructure that move AI interaction beyond touch and text — realtime voice, vision, and the platform systems behind them. We own the full path from a user speaking into a device to an answer coming back: the realtime session infrastructure that connects clients to frontier audio models, the backend orchestration that routes, records, and supervises live sessions, and the SDK that powers voice and multimodal experiences across Perplexity's apps.



As a backend engineer on Multimodal, you will design and scale the distributed systems that carry live voice sessions in production — and drive entirely new products at the intersection of voice, vision, and agents.




WHY PERPLEXITY IS DIFFERENT

 - Craftsmanship. We build high quality, tasteful products targeting both the AI native and AI curious.

 - Ownership. You identify the problem, design the solution and ship it.

 - Entrepreneurship. We think like founders, act with urgency, and hustle to deliver for each other and our users.

 - Scholarship. Work among highly talented peers, pursuing knowledge and truth, upleveling ourselves, our teams, and our products.

 - Partnership. We amplify each others' strengths, break down silos, and give selflessly to help our colleagues deliver excellence.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, build, and scale the backend session-worker architecture that powers realtime voice: durable per-session workers, provider routing, and stateful streaming over gRPC.

 - Own distributed-systems problems end-to-end — session lifecycle, crash recovery, reconnection and replay, multi-region deployment, and graceful degradation under real production load.

 - Build provider-agnostic streaming protocols from our backend to the Rust SDK that powers voice across every client stack.

 - Drive new products and initiatives in voice and multimodal AI from problem definition through technical design, implementation, and launch.

 - Build the orchestration layer that lets live voice models delegate work to tools, agents, and long-running tasks — safely, asynchronously, and at scale.

 - Partner closely with SDK, client, infrastructure, and model teams; work across the stack when the product demands it, from backend services to client-facing APIs.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend or distributed systems.

 - Strong experience in Rust, Python, or Go (we work primarily in Rust and Python).

 - Experience designing and operating production distributed systems: streaming RPC (gRPC or similar), stateful services, message-driven architectures, and failure recovery.

 - Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure — deploying, scaling, and operating services on AWS or equivalent.

 - Strong product judgment and the ability to translate user problems into simple, effective technical solutions.

 - Genuine interest and adoption of AI products and willingness to learn quickly.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with realtime media systems: voice, audio streaming, WebRTC, or low-latency transport.

 - Full-stack range — comfort building end-to-end, from backend services through client SDKs or web frontends.

 - Experience integrating LLMs, speech models, or computer vision into production systems.

 - Experience with agent frameworks, tool-calling architectures, or sandboxed execution environments.

 - Time spent at a fast-growing startup or on a high-ownership engineering team.




OUR MISSION

Perplexity’s mission is to power curiosity. Curious people are the people who drive change in the world. Driving change is a continuous cycle of learning, building, and integrating.

Learn: curious people constantly learn new things by asking more. They question the status quo in their own expertise and they constantly learn outside of it. Research is essential to them and never ending.

Build: curious people make and create things, to show the world their new answers to problems no one else ever questioned. They take action on what they’ve learned. Makers need tools to create their products, their companies, their reality.

Integrate: they must interact with the world as it is to drive change and adoption. True leaders do not simply build something and hope. They must have armies of agents and workers who can constantly work in millions of small ways.

Repeat. For curious people this is a cycle that never ends.

About the role

Perplexity's fraud prevention team protects our products, users, and infrastructure from fraud and abuse across the whole lifecycle: sign-up, authentication, payments, API usage, and product features. We build and operate a real-time decisioning platform together with the surrounding systems: data pipelines for detection and model training, integrations with product and payment systems, and internal tooling for investigation and response. As a software engineer on the team, you will own services end to end, from design to production operations, and work closely with fraud analysts, ML engineers, and product teams to make abuse expensive and legitimate usage frictionless.


Responsibilities

 - Design, build, and operate high-throughput, low-latency backend services for fraud detection and prevention

 - Build data pipelines and real-time feature computation that power detections and ML models

 - Collect and process trust signals

 - Integrate fraud decisions into product, auth, and payment flows across Perplexity

 - Own reliability of production services: observability, alerting, safe rollouts, incident response

 - Build internal tooling for investigation, enforcement, and auditability

 - Partner with fraud analysts to turn new abuse patterns into production detections quickly

Qualifications

 - 5+ years building and operating high-throughput, latency-sensitive backend systems in production

 - Strong systems programming skills; Rust, Go, or C++ experience preferred (we write Rust)

 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Terraform and cloud infrastructure

 - Solid data fundamentals: stream/batch computations, caching and storage trade-offs

 - Pragmatic, ownership-driven approach: ship incrementally, measure, and make failures degrade safely

Nice to have

 - Fraud prevention, anti-abuse, or payments-risk domain experience

 - Experience serving ML models in production

 - Client-side experience (web or mobile) for signal collection

items.desc:
About Huawei 
 Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. With integrated solutions across four key domains – telecom networks, IT, smart devices, and cloud services – we are committed to bringing digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world.
 At Huawei, innovation focuses on customer needs. We invest heavily in basic research, concentrating on technological breakthroughs that drive the world forward. We have more than 200,000 employees, of which 55% are employed in R&D, and we operate in more than 170 countries and regions. 
 Huawei invests more than 20% of revenues in R&D every year: in the past 10 years our total R&D investments exceed 150B USD. 
 By the end of 2025, Huawei held +150.000 active patents. 
 Huawei’s Pisa Research Institute is a core innovation hub in the field of automotive software and embedded systems 
 We are looking for a: 
 Researcher in Operating System architecture 
 The opportunity: 
 You will lead design efforts across smart cockpit and autonomous driving domains. The successful candidate will own system architecture design from kernel to framework, tackle reliability, safety isolation, and AI acceleration challenges, and lay the groundwork for the next-generation vehicle computing platform. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Automotive-Grade Reliability Architecture : Build a high-reliability OS framework with strong fault-tolerance for cockpit, driving, and vehicle control scenarios.
 • Smart Cockpit OS Architecture : Contribute end-to-end architecture design and evolution of the cockpit OS, from kernel to framework, ensuring industry-leading performance and robustness.
 • Multi-Domain Convergence : Contribute to the design of virtualization, isolation mechanisms, and efficient resource sharing architectures to support convergence of cockpit, vehicle control, and autonomous driving domains . 
 • Next-Gen AI-Centric OS : Develop key OS technologies to support efficient AI-Agent and heterogeneous resource scheduling and sandboxing enabling a solid foundation for onboard AI applications.
 Required Qualifications: 
 • Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
 • 3+ years of OS kernel development experience in embedded systems
 • Good understanding of low-level system performance and reliability optimization
 • Experience with kernel sub-systems such as scheduling, memory management, device drivers, and system debugging
 • Excellent cross-cultural communication and strategic thinking
 • Fluent in English and confident in public technical discourse
 Nice to have: 
 • Publications or patent record in system software
 • Publications in top-tier conferences (OSDI, ASPLOS, EuroSys, etc.)
 • Contributions in mainstream OS kernels, real-time systems, or embedded OS
 • Familiarity with automotive functional safety standards (ISO 26262, ASIL levels)
 • Expertise in OS safety, virtualization, and domain isolation
 • Extensive collaboration experience with multinational R&D teams
 What We Offer 
 We offer you an exciting professional career in one of the leading and fastest growing multinational telecommunication companies, challenging work and a competitive salary package. Personal development is ensured through many training opportunities in Western Europe and abroad. 
 We offer a gross annual salary typically ranging from €60,000 to €80,000 determined according to objective criteria such as professional experience, competencies, and seniority. Employees may also be considered for a discretionary annual bonus ranging from 0 to 2 monthly salaries, subject to company evaluation. The applicable collective bargaining agreement is the CCNL Telecommunications, within levels C3 and C4. 
 Privacy Statement 
We therefore commit to protecting your privacy following the local legal data privacy legislation. Please read and understand our West European Recruitment Privacy Notice before submitting your personal data to Huawei so that you fully understand how we process and manage your personal data received ( http://career.huawei.com/reccampportal/portal/hrd/weu_rec_all.html ) 
 If you have any queries in regards to Huawei WEU Data Privacy please feel free to contact our WEU Data Protection Officer by clicking here ( https://www.huawei.com/en/personal-data-request ). 
 Huawei is an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these characteristics. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace
