items.desc:
This post is part of ESA’s Junior Professional Programme. We are looking for enthusiastic candidates with up to 3 years of relevant professional experience after their Master's degree to join ESA for a four-year assignment. During this time, you will be actively working and learning on the job and will benefit from valuable mobility and developmental opportunities that will prepare you for a successful career at ESA. Subject to performance, it is therefore the intention to offer you an indefinite contract which will start at the end of the four years. 
 Recruitment will take place at the A1 grade on the Coordinated Organisations’ salary scale . At the end of the fourth year and if you are offered an indefinite contract at the end of your Junior Professional assignment, you will be upgraded to the A2 grade. 
 Location 
ESOC, Darmstadt, Germany 
 Developmental assignments form an integral part of the Junior Professional Programme and may entail a temporary relocation to another ESA establishment or other location. 
 Description 
 Junior Professional in Resilient and Secure Ground Operations Services. If selected for this position, you will report to the Head of the Mission Operations IT (MOI-IT) and Operations Control Centre (OCC) Section in the Ground Facilities Operations Division, Mission Operations Department, Directorate of Operations.
 The unit is responsible for the coordination and end-to-end provision of services and facilities to all users of the mission operations infrastructure, which consists of the following elements that support routine spacecraft operations and launches:
 The Operations Control Centre deployed at ESOC and in the ESA network of ground stations, such as data centres, or dedicated and main control rooms;
 Mission Operations Infrastructure IT services and facilities, such as managed IT services, cybersecurity operations, local and wide area networks, or platform services.
 You will work under the functional guidance of senior staff responsible for cybersecurity, operations resilience, and satellite telemetry, tracking and command (TT&C) services. In the context of system accreditation and system certification, you will interface with the ESA Security Office, as required.
 Within the context of ESA’s ESTRACK TT&C services to third-party customers and partners, you will help improve the dependability and resilience of ground operations services by applying methods drawn from the complementary fields of site-reliability engineering (SRE) and cybersecurity. In doing so, you will support ESA’s ability to continue service delivery in the presence of disruptions and to reduce recovery times following operational incidents. 
 As a Junior Professional, you will support this transformation by promoting SRE and cyber security best practices across the ground operations environments, while gaining hands-on experience in operational contexts and working closely with experienced engineers and stakeholders.
 Duties 
 During your first year, you will work closely with experienced engineers to enhance the resilience and cybersecurity of TT&C services delivered by ESA to external entities, both commercial and institutional.
 By the end of the first year, you will be expected to:
 analyse aspects of solution architecture and operational behaviour of the selected services, identifying cybersecurity and resilience risks based on a systematic assessment of cyber threats and potential systemic failures;
 contribute to the refinement of service reliability and cybersecurity objectives, availability expectations and recovery targets appropriate for mission operations;
 propose candidate enhancements to the target architecture to strengthen the overall security and reliability posture, such as applying automation-based solutions to replace repetitive manual activities, including system provisioning, configuration enforcement or operating system upgrades;
 support improved observability and recoverability by refining procedures with the Cybersecurity Operations Centre at ESOC, including monitoring of signals, recovery workflows and rollback mechanisms;
 support controlled security and reliability testing, such as safe disruption or incident simulations in non-operational environments, to validate assumptions and improve recovery readiness;
 produce and maintain integrated, version-controlled documentation that accurately reflects the design, operation and recovery processes of the services. 
Clear goals, success criteria and milestones for this first-year assignment will be defined prior to your start, ensuring a structured and successful introduction to the role.
 Development programme 
 In addition to your daily work, you will take part in an extensive learning and development programme. From day one, you will learn on the job and benefit from tailored development opportunities, including participation in technical and key skills training courses. 
 Furthermore, there is a mobility component to the …

 Tasks Global Customer Service & Parts (GCSP) ist für das weltweite Teile- und Service-Geschäft der Mercedes-Benz AG verantwortlich. Das Global Logistics Center in Germersheim ist mit über einer Million Quadratmeter Lagerfläche das weltweit größte Lager für automobile Ersatzteile und gleichzeitig das Headquarter des globalen Mercedes-Benz After-Sales Supply Chain Netzwerks. Mit modernster Lagertechnik und innovativen Systemen sorgen unsere Mitarbeitenden tagtäglich dafür, dass die Fahrzeug-Kunden weltweit den besten Service erhalten.
 Wir, die Konzernsicherheit Deutschland, verantworten die operative Sicherheit sowie die Sicherheitsberatung und -betreuung der deutschen Standorte der Mercedes-Benz AG – 24 Stunden am Tag, 365 Tage im Jahr.
 Die Zuständigkeit der Konzernsicherheit Deutschland erstreckt sich sowohl über die Werke als auch die regionale Betreuung der Tochtergesellschaften innerhalb Deutschlands. Die Sicherheit des Unternehmens und seiner Mitarbeitenden steht dabei für uns an erster Stelle. In einem sich permanent verändernden Umfeld sind wir immer wieder herausgefordert, risikobasiert und lösungsorientiert zu arbeiten, um die Sicherheit an den Standorten der Mercedes-Benz AG zu gewährleisten.
Unser Team der Werkfeuerwehr besteht aus 38 Mitarbeitenden und verantwortet den Brandschutz im Werk Germersheim. Hierzu gehören neben den Umfängen des abwehrenden Brandschutzes auch die Brandschutzplanung sowie die Sicherheitsleitstelle.
 Die Arbeit in unserem Team zeichnet aus:
 Ein sehr gutes Arbeitsklima in einem motivierten Team
 Spannende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten
 Eine offene Feedback-Kultur
 Eine faire, ansprechende Vergütung und tarifliche Leistungen

 Einsatzdienst bei der Werkfeuerwehr im 24 h-Dienst

 Disponent*in Tätigkeit in der Einsatzzentrale/Sicherheitsleitstelle/Sicherheitszentrale

 Durchführung von Wartungs-, Überprüfungs- sowie Instandsetzungsarbeiten an den feuerwehrtechnischen Gerätschaften, Sonderfahrzeugen und der Ausrüstung
 Ausbildung der Mitarbeitenden z. B. zur/zum Brandschutzhelfer*in
 Feuergefährliche Arbeiten z. B. Schweißarbeiten unter brandschutztechnischen Gesichtspunkten/Vorgaben bewerten

items.desc: #StormYourCareer ? Rejoins STORM GROUP et construis ta carrière avec nous ! Industrialise le potentiel algorithmique et propulse les modèles d?apprentissage en productionDans le cadre de l?industrialisation globale de ses modèles de Machine Learning, un grand compte recherche un(e) Machine Learning Engineer. Ton rôle sera technique et stratégique : tu assureras la transition des modèles algorithmiques du stade expérimental (Proof of Concept) vers des environnements de production haute disponibilité, tout en garantissant leur scalabilité, leur monitoring continu et leur maintien en conditions opérationnelles. Ton futur environnementTu évolueras au sein d?un pôle d?ingénierie data et IA de pointe, à la jonction entre la Data Science, le génie logiciel et les opérations (DevOps). En interface quotidienne avec les data scientists, les data engineers et les équipes de production informatique, tu interviendras sur des flux d?inférence critiques. C?est le cadre idéal pour appliquer les standards les plus stricts du génie logiciel à l?écosystème du Machine Learning, exploiter des infrastructures de calcul accéléré (GPU) et déployer des pratiques MLOps avancées. Tes missions clésIndustrialisation, Packaging & Services d?Inférence (Mode BUILD) : Reprendre, refactoriser et packager le code issu des équipes de data science selon les standards de production (modularité, robustesse, tests unitaires et d?intégration). Développer et optimiser les microservices et APIs d?inférence temps réel et batch (Python, FastAPI). Assurer la conteneurisation (Docker) et le déploiement sur des clusters orchestrés (Kubernetes) exploitant des ressources de calcul accéléré (GPU). Concevoir et automatiser les pipelines d?entraînement, de réentraînement continu (CT) et de validation automatisée des modèles. Piloter le versioning des jeux de données, des artefacts et le tracking des expérimentations via MLflow et du stockage objet (S3). Observabilité, Monitoring & Optimisation (Mode RUN & MLOps) : Mettre en ?uvre les mécanismes de surveillance continue en production : détection de la dérive des données (data drift) et de la dérive des concepts (concept drift) via des outils spécialisés (Evidently, Grafana). Configurer le système d?alerting et assurer le maintien en conditions opérationnelles des services exposés. Optimiser les performances d?inférence (latence, débit) et maîtriser les coûts de calcul liés aux infrastructures GPU. Rédiger la documentation technique et diffuser les bonnes pratiques logicielles au sein des équipes data. Solide compréhension des modèles et bibliothèques de Machine Learning (scikit-learn, PyTorch ou TensorFlow). Culture éprouvée du code de production : tests automatisés, intégration continue (CI/CD), revue de code et gestionnaire de versions (Git). Culture MLOps & Infrastructure : Maîtrise des environnements conteneurisés (Docker, Kubernetes) et de la gestion des ressources GPU. Pratique confirmée de MLflow et des outils de monitoring de modèles (Evidently, Grafana). Connaissance du stockage distribué et stockage objet (S3). Langues : Anglais professionnel opérationnel. Tes atoutsCulture du Génie Logiciel : Rigueur absolue dans la structuration du code, l?automatisation des tests et le respect des normes d?architecture logicielle. Sens de la Passerelle Métier : Faculté à dialoguer efficacement avec les data scientists pour comprendre les algorithmes, tout en répondant aux contraintes opérationnelles des équipes d?exploitation. Pragmatisme et Sens de l?Optimisation : Recherche permanente du meilleur compromis entre vitesse d?inférence, fiabilité du service et consommation de ressources. items.card: About the Role We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Agentic Commerce team to build the core systems, protocols, and customer-facing tools powering machine-to-machine payments, metering, and monetization. items.desc: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in. Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid) About the Department Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare's edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization. About the Team We build the infrastructure that makes the web Payable , powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce. Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the Agentic Internet. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We build tools that make the new internet payable by giving our users the ability to monetize access to their content, data, services, products, and outcomes across the Internet, regardless of where they are hosted. Building these capabilities requires solving complex engineering problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, usage metering, outcome verification, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols (such as x402, WBA, ACP, and UCP). We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale. We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard. About the Role We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Agentic Commerce team to build the core systems, protocols, and customer-facing tools powering machine-to-machine payments, metering, and monetization. In this role, you will design and ship scalable software across edge infrastructure, transaction engines, protocol layers, and developer tooling (such as our Monetization Gateway). You will work on cutting-edge standards, cryptographic authentication, and commerce controls that enable businesses to define pricing terms, authenticate agents, verify outcomes, and manage agent-generated revenue streams. What you'll do Design and ship production-ready, low-latency services that make web resources Payable for autonomous agents using emerging standards (x402, WBA, ACP, UCP). Build high-precision systems for usage metering, pricing definition, outcome verification, and value attribution tailored for agentic workflows. Build secure protocols and capabilities for authenticating and authorizing buyers, sellers, and autonomous agents across host-agnostic endpoints. Develop capabilities and APIs that give businesses granular visibility, telemetry, and control over agent-generated revenue, billing, and settlement. Build resilient bridges between mainstream fiat commerce rails, digital wallets, and decentralized/cryptographic payment protocols for Internet-scale micropayments. Write clean, secure, well-tested code, maintain strict accounting/financial precision, and advocate for high reliability, security, and low-latency performance. Partner with software engineers, researchers, product managers, design engineers, and cross-Cloudflare stakeholders to take capabilities from concept to production. Examples of Desirable Skills, …

items.desc: As a Scientist in Radiochemistry you will be responsible for the development of radiopharmaceutical products in line with the company's strategy. You will participate in the elaboration of the specifications of the products to be developed, design and carry out the useful experimental plans and ensure the conformity of the results with the specifications of each product. When the development is finalized, you ensure the technology transfer and follow-up with the first customers. Your responsibilities : In charge of the design of the processes and consumables necessary for the synthesis of radiopharmaceuticals. Implement and optimize the automated synthesis of radiopharmaceutical tracers. Participate in the definition of research protocols, develop experimental designs necessary for product development, evaluation of their robustness, and their continuous improvement. Develop and write the specifications for each product. Maintain the laboratory notebook and complete and structured experiment reports Write the different reports (development, tests and analyses…) Write and maintain technical documentation and user manuals for TRASIS compounds and chemical material. Design, implement and validate methods for product quality control. Carry out conformity controls. Consult and master the technical characteristics of equipment and consumables, and define processes compatible with them. Communicate and manage the necessary actions in case of anomaly and suggest ways to improve. Carry out installations at the customer’s site when required and necessary. Participate in the research and selection of suppliers. Participate in regulatory inspections (FAMHP,…) and others if necessary. Participate in the drafting of patents. items.desc: L’ENAC, École Nationale de l’Aviation Civile, est la plus importante des Grandes Écoles ou universités aéronautiques en Europe. Elle forme à un spectre large de métiers : des ingénieurs ou des professionnels de haut niveau capables de concevoir et faire évoluer les systèmes aéronautiques et plus largement ceux du transport aérien ainsi que des pilotes de ligne, des contrôleurs aériens ou encore des techniciens aéronautiques. Ses laboratoires de recherche sont à la pointe de l’innovation et travaillent activement en coopération avec des universités internationales de haut niveau pour un transport aérien toujours plus sûr, efficace et durable. L’ENAC est un établissement public à caractère scientifique, culturel et professionnel – grand établissement (EPSCP-GE), sous tutelle de la DGAC (Direction Générale de l’Aviation Civile), Direction du Ministère de la Transition Écologique et Solidaire. L’ENAC comprend une direction générale localisée à Toulouse et 8 sites en France. Pour soutenir sa dynamique en faveur de la promotion de la diversité, l’ENAC facilite l’accueil et l’intégration des travailleurs en situation de handicap. The SIGNAV research group, part of ENAC's TELECOM laboratory, has activities in signal processing and satellite navigation for civil aviation. One important source of degradation of airborne civil aviation GNSS receiver is Radio Frequency Interference. Civil aviation standards currently under preparation are standards for Dual Frequency Multi Constellation GNSS receivers, and the assessment of jamming and spoofing threats to these receivers is an important part of the activity for the elaboration of these standards. ENAC contributions to these standards mostly relate to the prediction of bounding of the impact of radio-frequency interference. ENAC is therefore opening a position for a resarch engineer for 1 year, for which the overall goal would be to contribute to the development, validation, and application of models characterizing the impact of radio-frequency interference on GNSS receivers used in civil aviation, addressing both established and emerging interference sources: DME/TACAN pulsed interference in the L5/E5a band JTIDS/MIDS Intra- and inter-GNSS interference, including cross-correlation and spectral separation between GPS, GALILEO, and other constellations signals Terrestrial emitters Portable electronic devices (PEDs) carried on board aircraft LEO PNT The main tasks to cover would be : Develop and refine models of interference-to-noise power spectral density ratios, spectral separation coefficients (SSC), and their impact on receiver acquisition, tracking, and demodulation performance Implement and validate simulation tools (MATLAB/Python) assessing aggregate interference impact under realistic operational scenarios Contribute to defining interference protection criteria and thresholds supporting standardization activities (ICAO, RTCA, EUROCAE) Analyze measurement campaigns and/or spectrum monitoring data to characterize real-world interference environments Present results in technical working groups, contribute to deliverables for institutional and industrial partners (DGAC, EUSPA), and publish in international conferences and journals Required Profile Master's degree or PhD in signal processing, telecommunications, aerospace engineering, or a related field Solid background in digital signal processing, statistical modeling, and/or GNSS signal structure and receiver architectures Proficiency in MATLAB and/or Python for scientific computing Familiarity with radio-frequency interference, spectrum compatibility analysis, or link-budget modeling is a strong asset Good written and spoken English; working knowledge of French is a plus Rigorous, autonomous, comfortable working within a multidisciplinary research team

items.desc: About the Role Soil is one of the largest carbon sinks we have, and one of the hardest to measure. Our growing team is looking for a Solutions Engineer to deliver that measurement for the companies and project developers investing in regenerative agriculture. In this role, you'll own client projects from first conversation to delivered result, shape how our science is applied in the field, and turn what each project teaches us into a stronger product. We're looking for someone curious about the science, rigorous with data and code and comfortable in front of a client: someone who enjoys owning a problem and seeing it through. You'll work alongside business development, data scientists and engineers, applying our methodology to real farms, real data and real deadlines. You will join a cross-functional, mission-driven team dedicated to bringing transparency and integrity to climate action. Impact You’ll Own Solutions Engineers provide a variety of services and deliverables to clients and internal stakeholders, owning the long-term success and impact of the solutions we build and use. Own client projects end to end: from scoping to delivered results, reports and maps, as the client’s technical counterpart in workshops and results presentations. Shape how carbon gets measured: design the sampling strategy and estimation approach for each project, from design-based to model-based, and make the calls that let our results stand up to the scrutiny of verifiers and carbon standards. Turn project work into product: identify what our pipeline should learn from each project, and build it into the shared codebase the team relies on. Sharpen our methodology: run the analyses that show how our methods perform and where they can improve, drawing on the latest research and standards in soil carbon. Enable long-term impact: results that can be traced and reproduced years later, with ex-post analyses showing how estimates hold up as new data comes in. Help set the standard: over time, lead projects with new approaches, define the practices our team builds on, and help clients and the industry raise the bar on how soil carbon is measured. What You Bring 3+ years working with geospatial data in Python (e.g. GeoPandas, Rasterio, GEE) and GIS software (e.g. QGIS), in industry or applied research A solid foundation in statistics and machine learning applied to spatial or environmental data, such as sampling design, spatial modelling, model validation or uncertainty estimation Experience writing clean, collaborative code (Git, code reviews, reproducible workflows), using AI tools effectively and critically, and finding your way quickly in an existing codebase Experience owning projects end to end and making sound decisions when not everything is known Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and a genuine drive to contribute to climate action Fluency in English What Makes You Stand Out Geostatistics (e.g. kriging) or digital soil mapping Experience with soil, agricultural or remote sensing data Familiarity with carbon markets or standards such as Verra’s VM0042 or the EU CRCF Hands-on experience training and validating ML models for spatial prediction Client-facing experience, e.g. in consulting or technical pre-sales Production engineering practices such as CI/CD, testing or pipeline tooling Benefits While Working At Seqana Real ownership, and a direct line from your work to measurable climate impact Be part of our highly motivated, committed, and international team with flat hierarchies that is working on solving one of society’s biggest challenges: climate change Witness and shape the evolution of a new business being built Hard, open problems, tackled with design docs, honest debate and scientific integrity Remote-friendly: up to 4 days/week remote when based in Berlin, or fully remote from elsewhere in Germany, with flexible hours Drinks, snacks, team events, and your choice of hardware Seqana is committed to building a workplace culture based on the values of proactivity, authenticity, creativity, and empathy, where equal employment opportunity is guaranteed to all applicants and team members regardless of their race, color, ethnicity, sex, sexual identity, religion, or disability. If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all of the qualifications, please do apply anyway. We are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute in more ways than just what is listed in this job description. We are excited to build a team that celebrates diversity in all its forms. Join us if you want to advance climate action in your daily work and are open to new insights and opportunities everyday.

items.desc: A strong breeding pipeline starts with translating molecular insights into practical breeding decisions. In this role as Junior Molecular Breeder Open Field Crops, you will support the development and implementation of strategic traits within our global breeding programs. Working at the intersection of molecular science and breeding, you will help bridge research and practical breeding applications, contributing to the development of innovative vegetable varieties for the future. Make a difference as Junior Molecular Breeder Open Field Crops As a Junior Molecular Breeder Open Field Crops, you will play an important role in supporting breeding teams around the world. Based in Enkhuizen, the Netherlands, you will work in an international environment where science, innovation, and collaboration come together to develop the next generation of vegetable varieties. While your primary focus will be on Brassica crops, you will also contribute to projects involving leek, radish, beetroot, onion, carrot and others. Working closely with breeders, molecular scientists, and researchers, you will support breeding programs globally and help accelerate the implementation of strategic traits in breeding pipelines. You will divide your time between data analysis, greenhouse and field evaluations, and project coordination activities. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience while translating scientific insights into practical breeding solutions. In this role, your work will include: Supporting pre-breeding and molecular breeding projects focused on strategic trait development; Analyzing molecular and phenotypic data to support breeding decisions and trait introgression; Contributing to the development, validation, and implementation of molecular breeding tools and methodologies; Supporting the establishment and optimization of breeding pipelines for complex traits; Collaborating with breeders, researchers, and other specialists across international teams; Supporting the coordination of activities across projects and global breeding programs. What you bring as our future colleague As a Junior Molecular Breeder Open Field Crops, you are curious, analytical, and eager to translate scientific insights into practical applications. You have a connection with plants and are excited to see how molecular insights translate into improvements in the greenhouse and field. You enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams and are comfortable balancing multiple priorities in an international environment. With a proactive mindset and strong collaboration skills, you know how to connect data, people, and breeding objectives. In addition, you have: An MSc degree in Plant Sciences, Plant Breeding, Biotechnology, Genetics, or a related field; Preferably 0-3 years of experience in plant breeding, molecular breeding, genetics, biotechnology, or applied research; Knowledge of genetics, molecular biology, marker technologies, and data analysis; Strong analytical, planning, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously; A proactive, collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills in English and an eagerness to learn and develop; Willingness to travel internationally 1-3 times per year. Enza Z aden as your employer Enza Zaden is an international family-owned company that has been developing innovative vegetable varieties since 1938. Together with more than 3,300 colleagues worldwide, we work on vegetable seeds with better flavor, higher yields and strong resistances. We do this from our mission: “Breeding to feed the world.” Every day, more than 480 million people eat vegetables grown from our seeds, and that is something we are very proud of. We are passionate about our work and care about one another. Good ideas are given room to grow and together we keep moving forward. This is how we continue to grow and innovate, both as a company and as colleagues. We are part of Elsevier’s STMJ (Science, Technology and Medical Journals) division, which publishes peer-reviewed research across scientific and medical disciplines. About the role You will manage and develop a portfolio of 10–12 life sciences journals, taking responsibility for their publishing performance. You will build strong relationships with editors, editorial boards and societies, and develop your journals in partnership with them, using market data and community insights. This role combines a clear interest in academic publishing with commercial awareness, data-driven decision-making and strong relationship-building skills. You will work independently while collaborating on wider team projects. Responsibilities Follow the market: Keep up to date with developments in publishing and research, identifying needs and opportunities for your journals and the communities they serve. Set portfolio strategy: Use market knowledge and data analysis to develop strategies that meet STMJ targets and keep your journals competitive. Gather, present and interpret data to support decisions. Develop the portfolio: Grow content and financial performance through existing journals and acquisitions, while exploring new content formats, extensions and channels. Manage contracts with editors: Negotiate and manage contractual relationships with journal editors. Manage budgets: Take responsibility for the editorial fees budget. Build relationships: Maintain regular contact with editors and editorial boards and engage with research institutes, societies, funding bodies and the wider research community. Contribute to wider projects: Participate in projects across STMJ and Elsevier, including pilots for new products, services or business models and improvements to ways of working. Qualification: A university degree or PhD Minimum two years of journal publishing experience, equivalent relevant industry experience. Strong English communication and networking skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently and collaboratively across cultures and locations. A data-driven mindset with commercial and financial awareness. Adaptability and an interest in the changing publishing landscape. Good judgement when using AI tools and evaluating their outputs. Willingness to travel, averaging 3–4 trips per year. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world. items.desc: At BMAT Music Innovators, we connect music usage data with the information needed to identify rights holders and support accurate royalty distribution. Our work combines music expertise, data, technology, and operational delivery. We're looking for an Operations Specialist who enjoys analyzing how things work, solving complex problems, and finding better ways to get things done. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of clients, data, operations, and technology. You'll assess customer needs, coordinate operational delivery, and collaborate with technical teams to turn challenges into practical, scalable solutions. What you'll do Understand and deliver: Learn our services and operational workflows, grasp client needs, and ensure reliable execution. Bridge business and technology: Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Analyze data and solve problems: Investigate datasets, identify inconsistencies, uncover root causes, and turn findings into actionable improvements. Improve and automate: Spot repetitive tasks, streamline inefficient workflows, and partner with relevant teams to implement automation. Collaborate across teams: Work closely with clients, Operations, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders to resolve issues and improve service delivery. Drive scalability: Look for opportunities to reduce operational effort and enhance quality as our services and customer needs evolve. Requirements What we're looking for 3+ years of experience in project management, technical account management, or client support within technical environments. Highly organized multitasker with strong attention to detail. Initiative, drive, enthusiasm, and entrepreneurial attitude. Excellent decision-making, critical thinking, and problem-solving. Passion for listening, asking, understanding, and communicating. Love for teamwork and learning. Technical literacy: you can follow technical discussions, understand concepts such as backend and frontend systems and data pipelines, and read and write technical documentation. Coding experience is welcome but not required. Be comfortable dealing with a large amount of data and numbers. Fluency in English is a must. Proficiency in Indonesian or Filipino are a plus but not mandatory. Based in Europe or APAC region Knowledge or experience about music publishing and internal CMOs documentation and distribution processes is highly desired. What success looks like Within 30 days: Understand BMAT's services, the team's operational responsibilities and the main data and technical workflows. Within 60 days: Take ownership of assigned operational responsibilities, lead client communication and deliver a straightforward assignment using existing processes and guidance. Within 90 days: Work independently on core responsibilities, contribute to problem-solving and identify opportunities to improve or automate existing workflows. Benefits You Can Enjoy Flexible working hours and location Unlimited time off because we believe that you know best when you need to rest. You can make the role your own and run your own development Flat hierarchy Online language classes to improve your Spanish or English Online and onsite courses and music industry workshops run by inhouse experts We’ll provide you with all equipment needed for you to be comfortable Barcelona HQ office available to you, kitted out with a rehearsal room https://www.bmat.com/bmat-house/ Who the FAQ are BMAT BMAT started in 2005 when a group of engineers with a passion for music decided to spin-off from an audio research lab in Barcelona. We’re now over 200 people, spread across Barcelona, Buenos Aires, Lima, Rio de Janeiro, London, Paris, Nairobi, Oslo, Tel-Aviv, Singapore, Tokyo, Manila, Bangkok and Lagos. We’re a team of pretty decent people who enjoy working with each other. We’re open-minded and well-traveled, coming from all parts of the world. We’ve got rappers, producers, cello players, DJs, and songwriters. The passion for music, the excitement for innovative technology and Barcelona as a backdrop has proven to make a good combination. Join us from wherever you are on our mission to help make music live forever. Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and innovation is kind of our thing. Our open-minded and flexible culture organically fosters this diversity. We've learnt that we thrive on learning from each other, so we don't just welcome but actively hire a range of open-minded people from all walks of life. Our team is made up of people with different backgrounds, perspectives, orientations, abilities, musical tastes, dress sense and time-zones - but we all have one common goal: Making the music world a better place. With equal opportunities for everyone, BMAT is a pretty nice place to work.

items.desc: A position exists for a Research Assistant in the Department of Engineering, to work on mechanics of fusion materials. The post holder will be located in Central Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, UK. We are starting a new research project focused on developing damage-tolerant materials for space and fusion-energy applications with an emphasis on refractory, body-centered cubic alloys, and high stacking fault energy alloys. Materials used in space and fusion systems must retain their structural integrity under extreme combinations of mechanical loading, temperature, and irradiation. These materials are often very brittle, but new processing techniques, including but not limited to additive manufacturing, can potentially mitigate this issue. The project will investigate the fundamental mechanisms that govern deformation and damage in these materials and use this understanding to identify new approaches to their design. The role holder will conduct experimental research to characterise how candidate materials deform plastically (if at all) and resist fracture. The work will involve performing mechanical characterisation including tensile, toughness and fatigue testing at room and elevated temperatures, performing electron microscopy characterisation including electron backscatter diffraction and transmission electron microscopy, and analysing/interpreting the resulting data. The candidate will be familiar with ASTM E399, E1820, and E647, dislocation mechanics, and microscopy techniques. The job will also include developing equipment including a micronotcher, vacuum-furnace and cryogenic testing system. The findings will be used to establish a first principles understanding and for the development of materials with improved resistance to damage and neutron irradiation. The role holder will work closely with other members of the research group at Cambridge and with external collaborators, including at Lawrence Livermore National Labs. They will be expected to contribute to group meetings, present their findings, prepare research publications, and assist with grant administration. The skills, qualifications and experience required to perform the roles are wide. The specific skills include excellent laboratory skills and data analysis capabilities. The applicant is expected to have at least a Bachelor's degree in Engineering Science or Materials Science and Engineering. A Master's degree is preferable. Salary Range: £33,662 - £36,320 Fixed-term: The funds for this post are available for 4 months in the first instance. Please ensure that you upload your Curriculum Vitae (CV), a covering letter and publication list in the Upload section of the online application. If you upload any additional documents which have not been requested, we will not be able to consider these as part of your application. Please submit your application by midnight on the closing date. If you have any questions about this vacancy or the application process, please contact Dr David Cook by email at dhc40@cam.ac.uk. items.desc: Can robots and machine learning help us outsmart antimicrobial resistance? Join a pioneering international project – Nanoheal, from bench to bedside – developing the next generation of antimicrobial and wound-healing materials. You will combine laboratory automation with computational design to discover advanced delivery systems, taking formulation discovery from slow, manual trial and error to rapid, data-driven optimisation. Antimicrobial resistance is one of the greatest threats to global health, and discovering new antimicrobials is only half the battle. They also need to reach the site of infection, stay active, and work alongside the body’s own healing mechanisms. This project tackles that challenge by developing biocompatible eutecto-gels: multifunctional, non-dehydrating gels built from deep eutectic solvents, combining antimicrobial agents with healing factors. You will use automated, programmable high-throughput screening technology to build and test a broad library of candidate gel formulations. You will then pair the experimental data with quantum mechanical calculations, molecular dynamics, and cheminformatic descriptors to train machine-learning models. Ultimately, you will optimise gel performance against targets defined with partners across the wider project. Join us and be part of a vibrant community at Loughborough University delivering high-impact science. Here’s more about the role and what we’re looking for: What you will be doing: Adapting formulation methods for on-platform gelation and rapid functional assessment using automated screening. Preparing and characterising gels, including rheology, viscometry and thermal analysis, to build a high-quality experimental property database. Integrating experimental and computational data to build predictive models and identify promising new formulations. Using machine learning to optimise gels across a range of functional parameters. Working with partners across the globe to align your results with project needs and present your findings. What we are looking for: A PhD (or close to completion) in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, soft matter physics, computational chemistry, or a related discipline. Hands-on experience with laboratory automation or high-throughput experimentation, and/or strong skills in computational modelling or machine learning (Python experience is highly desirable). A background in formulation, soft materials, ionic liquids, deep eutectic solvents or gels is a plus, as is familiarity with rheology or thermal analysis. The ability to work independently, think across disciplines, and move comfortably between the in-lab experimentation and computation. Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working in an international team. You don’t need to tick every box; we welcome applicants strong in either the experimental or the computational side who are keen to grow into the other. What we offer A leading role in a high-impact, EU-funded international project tackling one of the greatest current global health challenges. Access to state-of-the-art automation and computational facilities, and the chance to build a distinctive skillset across both experimental and data-driven research. Collaboration with partner groups across the network, with opportunities for joint training and knowledge exchange. A strong launchpad for your next step. You will have the opportunity to establish a publishable dataset, gain hands-on experience with automated and machine-learning-driven discovery, make international connections, and be supported in developing fellowship and grant applications or follow-on funding. A supportive, interdisciplinary research environment and support for your career development. An excellent benefits package. This is a full-time, fixed-term post for 10 months, with part-time working considered pro-rata. Candidates who have not yet been awarded their PhD will be appointed at Research Assistant level. For an informal discussion about the role, please contact Professor Anna Croft, a.k.croft@lboro.ac.uk. For more information refer to the Job Description and Person Specification. We are happy to consider any reasonable adjustments that candidates may need during the recruitment process. If there are additional adjustments, you’d like to request please contact Sarah Hawker s.a.hawker@lboro.ac.uk. We also offer reasonable adjustments on the job. Our Benefits At Loughborough, our benefits are designed to support your life inside and outside of work, helping you to thrive and feel valued as part of our community. Examples of our benefits include: Time off - generous holiday allowance, including 14 university closure days and bank holidays, with the option to buy extra through our holiday purchase scheme. Support integration of spatial data with internal customer, operational and commercial datasets. Experience designing repeatable spatial ETL/data-processing workflows. Strong understanding of coordinate reference systems, topology, spatial accuracy and data quality. Experience consuming APIs and geospatial web services. Ability to translate business requirements into spatial analytical rules. Working knowledge of Earth Observation and satellite imagery. items.desc: AI Expert For Advanced Driving Systems European Tech Recruit are working closely with a multinational Telecommunications & SW R&D company, based in Munich, who are looking for a talented AI Expert For Advanced Driving Systems to join their team. In this role you will work on next-generation automated driving safety, addressing complex challenges around emerging technologies such as E2E, VLA, and world models. You'll define safety concepts, architectures, validation strategies, and risk management approaches for L2–L4 systems. This is a strong opportunity for someone who wants real technical ownership and to work on the future of automated driving at a global R&D organization. Responsibilities as AI Expert For Advanced Driving Systems : Have an innovation-driven mindset, explores AI solutions to deliver safer advanced driving functions from L2 to L4 automation, and challenge and lead industry's technology forefront. Significantly influence the field of applied AI to autonomous driving/robotics and demonstrate a strong advanced technical drive. Understand the challenges of diverse ODDs for automated driving systems and able to design technical architectures tailored for deployment in various multiple ODDs. Requirements: Master's or PhD. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field. Original work published at top international conferences (e.g., CVPR) is an advantage. 5+ years of work experience in the ADAS/ADS field, with successful product deployment experience in different ODDs. Experience in implementing key AI technologies for autonomous driving/robotics, such as end-to-end models, VLA, world models, and RL; relevant experience in the safety of advanced driving systems is an advantage. Proactive work attitude, able to motivate and inspire team members; professional-level English, proficiency in German beneficial. Willingness to work abroad (up to 25% of total working time). If this role is of any interest please apply directly on LinkedIn or send a copy of your CV to nh@eu-recruit.com. Przygotowanie, czyszczenie i przetwarzanie danych tekstowych/strukturyzowanych oraz praca z relacyjnymi i wektorowymi bazami danych. Monitorowanie jakości odpowiedzi modeli, ich opóźnień (latency) i kosztów w środowisku produkcyjnym. Udział w analizie wymagań, projektowaniu architektury technicznej oraz dzielenie się wiedzą i wsparcie zespołu w obszarze dobrych praktyk ML/Software Engineering. Min. 3–4 lata doświadczenia w komercyjnym programowaniu w Pythonie (backend / inżynieria danych / ML). Bardzo dobra znajomość Pythona, standardów czystego kodu, testowania, budowania i integracji API (np. FastAPI), oraz bibliotek ML/NLP (np. transformers, PyTorch, scikit learn) Doświadczenie w budowaniu produkcyjnych rozwiązań opartych o LLM (zarówno modele open-source uruchamiane lokalnie/na serwerze, jak i API). Praktyczna znajomość technik RAG, zarządzania kontekstem, embeddingów oraz integracji z bazami danych (SQL / bazy wektorowe). Doświadczenie w testowaniu i mierzeniu jakości odpowiedzi modeli (unikanie halucynacji, metryki jakości). Mile widziane: Doświadczenie w dostrajaniu modeli (fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, przygotowywanie zbiorów danych treningowych). Wiedza z zakresu MLOps/LLMOps (monitoring latency/kosztów, wersjonowanie, konteneryzacja). Doświadczenie w budowie agentów AI lub zaawansowanych potoków decyzyjnych. Doświadczenie w pracy w środowiskach regulowanych lub instytucjach publicznych.

items.desc: Nous ouvrons un poste de Data Scientist pour renforcer l’équipe de notre client basé à Genève . Vous interviendrez sur des projets de valorisation de données et d’intelligence artificielle, depuis la préparation des données jusqu’à la mise en production de modèles avancés. Le poste combine expertise technique, compréhension des enjeux métiers et collaboration avec différentes équipes. Responsabilités du poste Collecter, consolider et préparer des données issues de sources variées, notamment en automatisant leur extraction, leur intégration et leur actualisation. Réaliser des analyses exploratoires afin d’identifier les tendances, relations et informations pertinentes au sein des données. Concevoir et faire évoluer des modèles de Data Science et d’IA exploitant notamment le Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision ou Reinforcement Learning. Mesurer la performance des modèles à l’aide d’indicateurs adaptés et les optimiser afin d’améliorer leur précision et leur capacité de généralisation. Assurer avec les équipes d’ingénierie l’intégration et le déploiement sécurisé des modèles au sein des applications et systèmes existants. Accompagner les équipes métiers dans la traduction de leurs besoins en objectifs Data et IA réalistes et exploitables. Identifier les risques associés aux solutions proposées et contribuer activement à la définition des approches les plus pertinentes. Restituer les analyses et résultats de façon claire et synthétique auprès des différentes parties prenantes. Prérequis du poste Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine de la Data Science, avec une solide maîtrise de la conception et du déploiement de modèles. Master ou formation jugée équivalente en Data Science ou dans un domaine connexe. Excellente maîtrise de Python et Jupyter, ainsi que des principaux outils et bibliothèques de l’écosystème : PyTorch, TensorFlow, Conda et Scikit-learn. Expertise en Machine Learning, Deep Learning et traitement du langage naturel, avec une bonne compréhension des autres approches avancées d’intelligence artificielle. Très bonne maîtrise des problématiques de qualité des données, complétée par de bonnes connaissances des technologies de bases de données. Bonne compréhension des principes d’organisation des services IT et de l’approche ITIL. Capacité à travailler de manière autonome, à prendre des décisions, à anticiper les risques et à proposer des solutions adaptées aux problématiques métiers. Excellent esprit d’équipe, aisance rédactionnelle et capacité à synthétiser et présenter des sujets complexes, avec adaptabilité et efficacité dans des environnements exigeants. Rejoindre Sword, c’est… 💼 Formation continue : Un budget formation qui croit tous les mois à utiliser dans un large catalogue de formation 🏝 25 jours de congés payés : Tous nos employés ont droit à 25 jours de congés payés par an 🚑 Une couverture assurance-accident internationale 🎉 Evènements réguliers : Des événements mensuels pour se retrouver en petit ou grand comité 🌍 Environnements internationaux : Des missions dans des groupes d'envergure internationale 🛠 Innovation : Contribuez à des projets impactants et innovants dans de nombreux secteurs d'activité 🎁 Des petits plaisirs : Nos employés bénéficient d'un programme d'avantages et remises très intéressantes

items.desc: At Kramp, we are continuously improving how we manage and use product information across our organization and for our customers. In this role, you will lead the applied AI capability for product content automation. You will translate business challenges into practical solutions using large language models, AI agents and intelligent workflows. The focus is on applying and improving existing models—not training new machine-learning models—and working with internal engineers to deploy successful solutions securely and reliably on Google Cloud. Your role You will design, build, evaluate and improve LLM-powered solutions that support product content processes, such as extracting, enriching, classifying, validating and generating product information. Working closely with Product Content Automation team, business stakeholders, and internal engineering specialists, you will take ideas from an initial problem through experimentation and validation to production use. Your Responsibilities Will Include Shape and validate AI use cases by exploring business problems, clarifying desired outcomes and defining measurable success criteria before deciding whether an LLM-based approach is appropriate. Build LLM-powered agents and workflows by designing prompts, tool use, structured outputs, context management and orchestration logic, and by connecting solutions to internal data, APIs, search systems and business processes. Collaborate on deployment and integration by working with engineers and architects on APIs, cloud architecture, security, CI/CD and operational reliability, and by continuing to improve solutions after release. Your team You will join the newly established Product Content Automation team, consisting of a Team Lead, Data Analyst and Data Scientist. Accurate and complete product content is essential to helping customers find and select the right parts from 3.5 million highly technical and diverse products. The team develops smart automation and AI solutions to maintain this content at scale, working closely with business stakeholders across Kramp. Who are you? You are an experienced applied AI specialist or data scientist with a strong engineering mindset. You combine hands-on knowledge of LLM applications with pragmatic business judgment and a systematic approach to quality. What You Bring Masters degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Computer Science or related fields Strong Python skills Experience building LLM applications within Gemini Agent Platform or comparable services.. Strong communication and business-awareness skills Experience with CI/CD, observability, guardrails and evaluation. The Following Experience Would Be Beneficial Experience building backend services, APIs and integrations in TypeScript, Java or a comparable language. Familiarity with Google Cloud, containers, infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD. Understanding of event-driven and batch architectures, IAM, secrets management and observability. What do we offer? At Kramp, we believe meaningful rewards help people grow, perform and thrive. Our reward package is designed to be fair, transparent, and competitive, giving you confidence and support to do your best work. We offer an attractive salary of €5,062 – €6,328 gross per month, based on 40 hours per week, depending on your experience, qualifications and location (Utrecht). The compensation package also includes an 8% holiday allowance on top of your gross monthly salary. 25 vacation days and 12 ADV days (based on a fulltime contract) Flexible working policy in hours and location Travel- and working from home allowance Profit sharing bonus Great budget for training and courses Opportunities to work with modern cloud technologies, automation, and AI solutions A collaborative international environment where you can make a visible impact Generous pension plan Procedure and contact If this role and its requirements excite you, we’d love to hear from you. items.desc: Vuoi iniziare una nuova avventura professionale come Autonomous Systems Software Engineer in una delle nostre opportunità nel settore Defense & Aerospace a Roma ? 👉 Cosa farai? Ti occuperai della progettazione, dello sviluppo e dell'integrazione di soluzioni software per sistemi robotici autonomi e interoperabili. Svilupperai applicazioni e componenti software complessi in Python , adottando moderne pratiche di ingegneria del software. Lavorerai su architetture software distribuite, utilizzando paradigmi di programmazione asincrona, multi-threading e multi-processing. Contribuirai allo sviluppo e all'integrazione di sistemi robotici attraverso ROS2 e middleware di comunicazione. Utilizzerai ambienti di simulazione come Gazebo, AirSim o Isaac Sim per attività di sviluppo, testing e validazione. Collaborerai allo sviluppo di funzionalità per la navigazione autonoma, il coordinamento multi-agente e l'interoperabilità tra piattaforme. Parteciperai alle attività di integrazione e validazione del software su piattaforme hardware reali. Lavorerai in stretta collaborazione con team multidisciplinari e con le altre sedi del laboratorio, contribuendo all'evoluzione delle soluzioni sviluppate. ✍️ Cosa richiediamo? Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Informatica, Automazione, Aerospaziale, Elettronica, Telecomunicazioni, Robotica, Intelligenza Artificiale, Meccatronica o discipline affini. Esperienza professionale di 3-5 anni per profili Expert o 5-10 anni per profili Senior , preferibilmente maturata nello sviluppo di sistemi robotici autonomi. Solida conoscenza dell'ingegneria del software, con esperienza nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di sistemi complessi. Ottima padronanza di Python , utilizzato per lo sviluppo di applicazioni e architetture software complesse, non limitatamente ad attività di scripting. Esperienza con programmazione asincrona, multi-threading e multi-processing. Ottima conoscenza di ambienti Linux e strumenti di sviluppo come Git e Docker . Conoscenza di ROS2 e dei principali framework di simulazione robotica, come Gazebo, AirSim, Isaac Sim o equivalenti. Esperienza concreta nello sviluppo, nell'integrazione o nella validazione di software su sistemi reali. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata ( livello B2 o superiore ). Costituiscono un plus: Conseguimento di un PhD in discipline tecnico-scientifiche pertinenti. Esperienza con algoritmi di guida, navigazione, controllo e coordinamento di sistemi autonomi. Conoscenza di sistemi multi-agente, percezione 3D e algoritmi di Computer Vision basati su AI. Conoscenza di C++ per lo sviluppo di componenti software ad alte prestazioni. Familiarità con stack di controllo per droni, come PX4 e ArduPilot . Esperienza con piattaforme hardware embedded, come NVIDIA Jetson . Conoscenza di framework di Machine Learning, in particolare PyTorch . Familiarità con middleware di comunicazione DDS (Data Distribution Service) . Completano il profilo proattività, problem solving, capacità di lavorare in team multidisciplinari, orientamento ai risultati e forte senso di responsabilità rispetto alle soluzioni sviluppate. Ulteriori requisiti: Disponibilità a trasferte. Possesso della patente di guida B. ✨ Che cosa offriamo? Una comunità internazionale che riunisce oltre 110 nazionalità diverse. Un ambiente in cui la fiducia è centrale e la crescita interna è valorizzata. Un solido sistema di formazione con Academy interna e moduli disponibili. Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico con eventi interni (afterwork, team building, ecc.). Un forte impegno verso benessere e work-life balance. Benefici locali in Italia: Buoni pasto. Programma di welfare con sconti e vantaggi per le persone dipendenti. Opzioni di lavoro flessibili secondo policy aziendale. Assicurazione sanitaria e programmi di benessere, ove applicabili. 💰 Remunerazione e trasparenza Gross Annual Salary Range / RAL iniziale fissa: EUR 26,000.00 – EUR 50,000.00 CCNL del Commercio. La fascia retributiva è definita secondo criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. Componente variabile: eventuali premi discrezionali non garantiti non inclusi nella RAL indicata. Durante il processo di selezione non chiederemo informazioni sulla tua retribuzione attuale o precedente. Le nostre fasce salariali sono volutamente ampie, perché assumiamo persone di talento, non profili standardizzati. Uno stesso ruolo può attrarre candidati con esperienze e competenze molto diverse, e per questo crediamo sia importante lasciare il giusto margine di flessibilità. La posizione all'interno della fascia dipende dalla tua esperienza specifica, dalle tue competenze e dal valore che puoi portare al ruolo. 🙌 La persona ideale si riconosce in questi valori: Boldness: il nostro spirito di avventura imprenditoriale è ciò che ci unisce tutti e ci porta al successo. items.desc: Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, Adanola and Huel use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin. About The Role We're looking for a Data Scientist to join Fospha's Data Science team in London. Fospha builds marketing measurement products for ecommerce brands — attribution, marketing mix modelling, incrementality testing, and brand impact measurement. Our Data Science team owns the models behind all of it, from methodology through to production code. You will work across our technical stacks and own maintaining and growing the codebases that power our product and solutions. This role suits an established data scientist who wants to own things properly. You'll lead larger production projects, choose the modelling approach rather than being handed it, and talk to clients as the modelling expert in the room — supported by a team that reviews each other's work seriously, and a company that rewards high agency with ownership. Team: Data Science Level: Career (Data Science Career Development Framework) Location: London What you'll do Lead larger production projects end to end — scoping, building, and shipping production-level code, rather than working through tickets someone else has specified Choose the modelling approach — independently selecting and applying the right method within our suite, across attribution, marketing mix modelling, incrementality testing, and brand impact. You will be given time to keep up-to-date on the latest methodologies in the industry Resolve bugs and queries independently — including in parts of the codebase you didn't write, without needing to route them upwards Use AI as leverage, not as a crutch — solving coding tickets quickly, unblocking yourself on product and engineering dependencies, and building automation workflows that save the team time Work with QA properly — using our automated tooling efficiently and flagging the gaps in it rather than working around them Communicate as a modelling expert — confidently and independently, with clients and with colleagues, including when the message is that a number they like is wrong Help develop the people around you — code review, methodology critique, and hands-on support for less experienced colleagues. Breaking down tickets and helping those more junior is essential What we're looking for Essential Solid commercial data science experience — typically 3–5 years, with a track record of shipping models into production Strong ML knowledge across multiple algorithm families, and the judgement to pick the right approach for the problem rather than the one you know best Strong Python and SQL, with the ability to lead on production-level code and set the standard others work to Able to debug and resolve issues independently across unfamiliar repositories, using AI tooling to accelerate rather than to guess, while still understanding the problem fully Strong AI fluency — you solve tickets quickly with it, you unblock cross-department dependencies with it, you build automation workflows with it, and you never send AI-assisted output without checking it Confident, independent communication with clients and stakeholders as the technical authority on the work Emerging mentorship — you're ready to develop junior colleagues, and you want to Initiative in accepting and planning your own work, rather than waiting to be allocated it Genuine attention to detail — much of this work involves noticing when a number is wrong Nice to have Bayesian modelling experience, particularly hierarchical models Experience with AWS or comparable cloud tooling Familiarity with automated QA tooling and test coverage practices Experience with marketing, ecommerce, or advertising data Not required Experience with attribution methodology, MMM, incrementality testing, or Bayesian modelling is genuinely an advantage at this level — but it isn't a filter. Our stack takes time to learn regardless of what you arrive with, and we'd rather hire strong modelling judgement and teach the domain. How You'll Grow We run a published Data Science Career Development Framework with six levels. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we’re only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of “teaching machines to hear like human beings.” At ai-coustics, we’re building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like Perplexity, Retell, LiveKit or AssemblyAI use the ai-coustics SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month. We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital , as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity . We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers. If you’re motivated by developing technology that is used in production, shaping an emerging category and setting a new standard for how Voice AI works in the real world, you’ll feel at home at ai-coustics. items.desc: Avanda est une société de services Franco-Suisse. Ces opportunités long terme (plusieurs années) nécessitent une présence régulière sur Genève (ou dans la région frontalière). Ces rôles sont pour des consultants (Permanent ou Freelance) intéressés à rejoindre un grand projet dans la région de Genève. LE ROLE Au sein du service Data science, vous collectez les données pertinentes, les nettoyez et les préparez pour l'analyse, puis appliquez des techniques statistiques et des algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique pour en extraire des informations utiles. Vous développez des modèles de data science et d'IA (Deep Learning, Computer Vision, langage naturel, Reinforcement Learning ou autres méthodes avancées selon les besoins du projet). Collecter et analyser des données issues de sources variées (automatiser l'extraction, l'intégration et la mise à jour des données). Réaliser l'analyse exploratoire des données avec des outils statistiques et des visualisations. Concevoir et développer des algorithmes et des modèles de data science et d'IA, et en améliorer les résultats. Évaluer la performance des modèles avec des mesures appropriées et les ajuster pour améliorer leur précision et leur généralisation. Collaborer avec des ingénieurs logiciels pour intégrer les modèles dans des applications ou des systèmes existants, et assurer leur déploiement efficace et sécurisé en production. Présenter et partager les résultats de manière claire et compréhensible aux parties prenantes. Démarrage prévu en janvier 2027. Profil candidat: VOTRE PROFIL Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master (ou équivalent) en data science ou domaine similaire. 5 ans et plus d'expérience dans le domaine. Très bonnes connaissances de Python et de Jupyter, des bibliothèques PyTorch, TensorFlow, Conda et Scikit-learn. Très bonnes connaissances du traitement du langage naturel, du Machine Learning et du Deep Learning, ainsi que de la qualité des données. Bonnes connaissances de la technologie de gestion des bases de données et de l'organisation orientée service (approche ITIL). Important: aider les métiers à définir des objectifs réalistes à partir de leurs besoins et de leurs données; autonomie dans la réalisation et le déploiement des algorithmes et des modèles de data science et d'IA. Qualités: travail en équipe et partage des connaissances, excellente capacité rédactionnelle, de synthèse et de présentation, capacité à prendre des décisions, à challenger les besoins et à être force de proposition, autonomie, dynamisme, capacité à travailler sous stress, gestion des risques. Une accréditation de sécurité peut être demandée.

items.desc: Most organizations don't have an AI problem. They have an adoption problem. Licenses for Copilot, Claude, and Gemini get bought — and then sit unused while people keep working the old way. That's the gap you'll close. As our FDE , you'll sit right next to the people doing the work and help them rebuild their daily habits around frontier AI apps. You'll teach prompting, design reusable workflows, build custom agents and skills inside the tools, and make adoption actually stick. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for someone who is a genuine power user of AI — not a backend engineer. What You'll Do Coach people, one-on-one and in groups — run hands-on sessions, workshops, clinics, and office hours that help users apply AI to their actual daily tasks: drafting, research, summarization, analysis, meeting prep, reporting, and more. Teach great prompting — and make it repeatable. Build prompt libraries, workflow playbooks, quick-start guides, demos, and FAQs that people can reuse without you in the room. Build agents and skills inside the apps — create custom agents, assistants, and "skills" using Copilot Agents, Claude (Projects & Skills), and Gemini. Find the use cases that matter — work with each team to identify high-value, repeatable tasks and match them to the right tool and workflow. Drive adoption end to end — stakeholder engagement, change management, and building AI champion communities that share wins and reusable workflows across teams. Close the feedback loop — capture user pain points, questions, and successful prompt patterns, then turn them into better enablement and tooling. Track what's working — monitor adoption KPIs like usage, satisfaction, time-to-proficiency, training completion, and productivity signals. Promote responsible use — help users understand data privacy, security, model limitations, and governance in everyday work. Who We're Looking For 2-3 years in AI adoption, change enablement, digital transformation, L&D, consulting, product operations, or business analysis — or equivalent hands-on experience. A true power user of at least one frontier AI app (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, or ChatGPT), with strong, teachable prompting skills. Comfort configuring agents, skills, and writing python — no deep coding skills are required, but you're the person who figures out how to make the tool do the thing. Excellent communication and facilitation skills — you're genuinely at ease in front of clients and users, translating between business needs and AI capabilities. A solid grasp of how AI supports knowledge work : research, drafting, summarization, analysis, knowledge retrieval, and decision support. An analytical mindset for tracking adoption, usage, and impact. Keen on Business Understand processes, business challenges and opportunities and you have the curiosity to find solutions with AI Nice to Have Change management frameworks , readiness planning, stakeholder mapping. Experience with adoption dashboards, surveys, feedback loops, or champion networks. Exposure to low-code/no-code automation, prompt libraries, or knowledge assistants. Fluency in [Greek and English / additional languages]. What's In It For You Competitive salary and benefits package [customize: health/life insurance, bonus scheme, etc.]. A flexible, [hybrid / remote] work model. Continuous learning and certifications across the leading AI platforms. Exposure to a wide range of clients and cutting-edge tools while they're still new. A role at the front line of how organizations actually adopt AI — with real, visible impact.

Je helpt een publieke organisatie om grote hoeveelheden vergunninginformatie toegankelijk en bruikbaar te maken met behulp van de nieuwste Generative AI-technologieën. Je werkt aan de stap van Proof of Concept naar een toekomstbestendige productieoplossing en hebt daarbij veel invloed op architectuur, techniek en werkwijze. Interesse? Reageer met een recent CV en een korte motivatie waarin je jouw ervaring met Azure, Generative AI en Data Engineering toelicht.

items.desc: About Us CYTENA is a young and fast-growing high-tech company dedicated to the development of automated, high-precision laboratory instruments for life science research and the pharmaceutical industry. Our award-winning instruments are used in renowned academic and pharmaceutical laboratories worldwide to automate workflows across a wide range of applications, including stable cell line development, single-cell omics, high-throughput screening, and drug discovery. Since 2019, CYTENA has been part of the BICO Group. Our mission is: At CYTENA, we make the development of modern therapies faster, safer, and more affordable. Join CYTENA as an Application Scientist (m/f/d) Live Cell Imaging Product Development and play a key role in shaping the development of innovative live-cell imaging solutions. In this hands-on R&D role, you will bring the perspective of scientists and end users into the product development process and translate biological workflows, assay requirements, and user needs into actionable input for our software and hardware engineering teams. This position is based at our office in Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany . You will take ownership of the application workstream, establish and execute relevant cellular assays and test strategies, and work closely with interdisciplinary teams to shape how our instruments and software operate and how their performance is verified and validated. We work AI-first , with AI tools forming an integral part of our daily work for analysis, prototyping, documentation, and testing. Responsibilities Act as the applications expert within live-cell imaging product development projects and represent the perspective of scientists and end users throughout product and feature development. Define biological use cases, cellular assays, imaging workflows, and experimental scenarios to support product development. Independently plan, establish, optimize, and execute cell-based assays to evaluate and demonstrate the performance of instruments and software. Translate scientific workflows and user needs into clear application requirements, workflow descriptions, use cases, and acceptance criteria. Develop and execute application-focused verification and validation activities, including test cases, biological models, data requirements, and expected outcomes. Conduct and document structured software, workflow, usability, and application testing from an end-user perspective and identify opportunities for improvement. Work closely with software developers, hardware engineers, project management, and other interdisciplinary stakeholders throughout the development process. Provide structured and reproducible feedback on scientific, workflow, usability, and performance-related topics and support their investigation and resolution.
