items.desc: About This Position A liveable future for everyone that is what we contribute to as the Naval and Offshore Structures department. We design, analyse and test a wide range of mechanical structures for the maritime and offshore industries and for defence applications. Our primary focus is the safety of these structures under the most extreme conditions and throughout their entire service life. We support the Dutch and European maritime industry in becoming more sustainable through the safe introduction of alternative fuels and energy sources, such as methanol, ammonia and nuclear energy. This requires a systematic approach that combines safety, sustainability and affordability. Drawing on our expertise in naval architecture and materials science, we contribute to a TNO-wide approach, including in-depth knowledge of new material ageing and damage mechanisms. Would you like to help create the sustainable and safe ships of the future? Then this position could be for you. What will be your role? As a Medior Scientist Materials Science, you will contribute to a safe and affordable fuel transition. You will develop materials science models and conduct experiments to understand material ageing and degradation. You will use these insights to develop better solutions for the application of new energy systems. You will work in a multidisciplinary team of experts from across TNO and collaborate closely with customers and partners. Drawing on your expertise, you will provide technical direction for projects and help initiate new research projects. You will also enhance TNO’s visibility through publications and presentations. You will join the Naval and Offshore Structures department, which comprises 60 dedicated experts with backgrounds in naval architecture, civil engineering, aerospace engineering, applied physics and mechanical engineering. The principal application areas of our research are defence and the maritime and offshore sectors. Our well-equipped laboratories for mechanical testing combine practical and theoretical knowledge, enabling us to solve highly complex problems and validate innovative structural solutions. Our research ranges from the safe use of alternative fuels on board ships and the structural safety of offshore wind turbines to shock- and blast-resistant ship structures. We work on today’s key challenges the energy transition and the growing focus on safety at sea. What we expect from you You hold a university degree in technical disciplines, such as Naval Architecture, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Civil Engineering, with a specialization in materials science. You have substantial experience—more than five years—in the maritime and/or offshore sector and combine a strong theoretical foundation with practical insight into material behavior. Or, you are an expert in material science and would like to translate this to the maritime and offshore sector. In addition to technical expertise, we place great value on communication skills and a customer- and results-oriented approach, enabling you to work effectively as part of a team towards outcomes that are useful and applicable for our customers. You have a proven ability to translate customer needs into concrete research questions and a clear plan of action. You have experience providing technical leadership to small teams and successfully delivering complex projects. You have a good command of both Dutch and English, spoken and written. What you'll get in return Challenging and varied work with a real impact. And plenty of opportunities as, at TNO, you are in charge of shaping your career. We offer a gross monthly salary between € 4.819,- and € 6.884,- (based on your knowledge and experience), 8% holiday pay, a 13th month bonus of 8.33% and a flex budget (5.58% + € 180). In addition, you will be given every opportunity to develop yourself. TNO offers optional employee benefits, enabling you to tailor your benefits package to match your personal situation. You may also expect An extremely professional, innovative working environment where colleagues are leading experts in their field. The opportunity to attend courses, workshops and conferences, and to receive training and coaching based on your needs. 33 days annual leave plus a flexible holiday that can be used on a cultural, religious, or otherwise important day of your choosing (on a full-time basis). An employer working towards a respectful, inclusive, and equitable work environment where every employee can flourish, with various initiatives such as Jong TNO, numerous expertise based guilds, Rainbow Community and Round Tables on diverse inclusion topics. We offer a comprehensive and flexible mobility plan that also includes full compensation for public transportation for commuting and business travel. Great social events with your team and other TNO colleagues. That’s how you will get to know a lot of people really quickly. Flexible working hours, the possibility to work …

items.desc: « Rejoignez le CEA pour donner du sens à votre activité, mener ou soutenir des projets de R&D nationaux et internationaux, cultiver et faire vivre votre esprit de curiosité. » EN SYNTHESE, QU’EST-CE QUE NOUS VOUS PROPOSONS ? Nous cherchons un(e) ingénieur(e) chercheur(se) spécialisé(e) dans le développement de systèmes de mesure pour l’instrumentation des rayonnements ionisants. Ce poste de cadre en CDD de 24 mois est basé sur le site Nano-Innov de Paris-Saclay, Essonne (91). Ce poste est à pourvoir dès que possible. QU’ATTENDONS-NOUS DE VOUS ? Dans le cadre du projet FRATHEA, le SIMRI développe plusieurs systèmes de monitoring en dose et en forme de faisceaux. Dans ce contexte, le(la) candidate(e) travaillera sur l’intégration de moniteurs faisceaux dédiés à la mesure des faisceaux de très haut débits de dose (UHDR) et de très haute énergie électron (VHEE), ces moniteurs étant basés sur des éléments de détection différents. En partenariat avec les membres de l’équipe projet CEA ainsi qu’en interaction avec les partenaires du projet, il(elle) définira le design le plus adapté au moniteur faisceau, participera aux discussions du cahier des charges des électroniques multivoies associées et optimisera l’intégration et à la validation du dispositif intermédiaire de preuve de concept ainsi que du système final en tenant compte des différentes contraintes liés à l’environnement de la machine délivrant les faisceaux. Ce processus d’optimisation passera par plusieurs développements d’une version simplifiée intermédiaire vers la finale intégrée et regroupant les contraintes du cahier des charges de l’industriel. Vos missions : Définition et intégration des moniteurs : Preuve de concept et version finale : Design du support, design des PCB ; reprise des contacts etc. Choix des matériaux optimisés pour la mesure des faisceaux, prise en compte des contraintes machine associées Intégration de l’électronique multivoies du POC : discussion avec les partenaires extérieurs en charge du développement de l’électronique Obtention d’un dispositif de mesure intégré POC : prise en compte de l’électronique et des contraintes machines Participation aux essais : Participation active aux essais opérationnels et rédaction de notes de synthèse ou de modification des prototypes Documentation : Rédaction de documentation technique Collaboration avec l’équipe pour assurer la traçabilité et la qualité des livrables Pour en savoir plus sur le laboratoire, cliquez ICI . #CEA-List ; ; #Ingénieure ; #Chercheuse ; #Research Engineer ; #Industry4.0 ; #Capteurs ; #Scintillateurs plastiques Profil du candidat Vous êtes spécialisé(e) dans le développement de système de mesure de rayonnement. De formation, master, ingénieur ou docteur en physique, instrumentation ou domaine connexe. Vous recherchez un poste dans une équipe dynamique et pluridisciplinaire. Vous participerez à des projets de recherche et développement innovants dans ce domaine. Une première expérience couvrant la conception, le développement et les essais d’un système embarqué d’instrumentation est un atout. Vos compétences principales : Compétences en CAO pour fabrication additive (SolidWorks, FreeCad ou similaires) Compétences en programmation (Python, C#) Compétences avec les outils de CAO de saisie de schémas électroniques ainsi que de routage de circuits imprimés (Eagle, KiCAD ou similaires), notions de la programmation en C et C++ pour microcontrôleur Rigueur, autonomie, esprit d’initiative et qualités relationnelles. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? En intégrant notre équipe, vous aurez l’opportunité de : ✅ Travailler sur un projet Européen à fort impact, ✅ Collaborer avec des partenaires de renom en France et en Europe, ✅ Évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et contribuer à des avancées technologiques majeures. Conformément aux engagements pris par le CEA en faveur de l'intégration des personnes handicapées, cet emploi est ouvert à toutes et à tous. Le CEA propose des aménagements et/ou des possibilités d'organisation pour l'inclusion des travailleurs handicapés. items.title: Data Quality Specialist - Polish, AGI Data Services - G T Quality
items.card: responsibilities * Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows * Create prescriptive actions for quality issues * Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality * Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements * Analyze data trends and develop solutions * Monitor quality performance and coach operations
items.desc:
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.
Key job responsibilities
* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows 
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues 
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality 
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions 
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams 
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports 
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations 
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools 
* Support process documentation and implementation
A day in the life
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams. 
Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams). 
You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality. 
About the team
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 
 The Position
 A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. 
 Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new computational sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide. 
 Within the CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making. 
 Join the newly formed Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) as a Data Modeling Expert, a key role within our Data Connectivity team. You will serve as a key contributor in the data modeling, semantics, ontologies, and standards space, ensuring our data are FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable), high-quality, and trustable; enabling scientists, computational tools, and AI algorithms from across our Research and Early Development (REDs) organizations to effectively leverage and utilize these data assets. 
 As our Data Modeling Expert, you will: 
 Act as a key subject matter expert on data modeling, ontologies, semantics, and standards efforts, interfacing closely with business/scientific stakeholders and informatics/engineering colleagues. 
 Translate complex scientific requirements from various parts of R&D into clear draft data models that can be leveraged by the wider FAIR data modeling team.

Job Description Summary 
Au sein de GE HealthCare et de la division Hardware Engineering MICT ISS XRAY GENERATION, le/la technicien(ne) de Laboratoire – Câblage, Installation Bancs de Tests et Essais – accompagne les équipes R&D dans les projets de conception et de maintenance des générateurs Haute Tension et Tubes à Rayons X. Pour ce faire, il/elle réalise les câblages de cartes et des composants, met en place des bancs de tests, installe des configurations logicielles et est amené à réaliser des tests unitaires et des tests de performances. 
 Job Description 
 Câblage 
 Câblage de cartes électroniques (numérique et puissance) et d’éléments électrotechniques (soudure de composants sur carte, convertisseurs de puissance, blocs haute tension…)
 Câblage des bancs de tests et de composants tels que des power units et coolers
 Routage et installation de câbles dans les laboratoires engineering.
 Gestion des flux de pièces pour la construction des prototypes : 
 Organiser et gérer le stock des cartes électroniques en vue de suivre les évolutions de design, de préparer les kits de matériel, et de tracer les mises à jour avec les fournisseurs de cartes
 Gérer les flux entrants et sortants des étapes de tests des cartes
 Assure la traçabilité des révisions des composants et des configurations
 Installation de bancs de tests 
 Mettre en place les bancs de tests fonctionnels selon les besoins des différents projets.
 Assembler et installer les différents modules (charges, tubes RX, caissons, inverters, blocs haute tension, ordinateurs, câbles, circuits de refroidissement,…)
 Proposer des optimisations concernant les installations des manipulations (ergonomie, sécurité électrique, ..)
 Organiser et gérer le parc informatique composé de 60 ordinateurs engineering de laboratoires, en assurant leur maintenance et le suivi de leur configuration.
 Assurer la migration IT GEHealthCare des ordinateurs du laboratoire engineering.
 Exécuter les tests unitaires et tests de performances 
 Exécuter les tests prédéfinis par l’équipe de conception (test unitaires des circuits électroniques, chargement de logiciel, déroulement de tests automatiques, mesures au voltmètre, à l’oscilloscope etc .. )
 Documenter les résultats de tests, les défauts et les pannes, et les résultats d’investigations. Proposer des solutions techniques.
 Maintenance 
 Apporter du support aux équipes engineering et de production en assurer la maintenance des installations de certains composants et outillages.
 Qualifications requises 
 BAC+2 minimum – Niveau Technicien supérieur en Electronique/ Electrotechnique
 Aisance avec travail sur ordinateur
 Maitrise du Pack Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
 Habilitation risques électriques plateformes d’essais HE/BE essai
 Formations Rayonnements ionisants
 Formations LOTO (Lockout/Tagout)
 Qualifications souhaitées 
 Polyvalence, Curiosité, Rigueur et Autonomie
 Travail d’équipe
 La connaissance du secteur de l’imagerie médicale, des contraintes de routage de cartes et de câbles, de l’electronique de puissance, et de la compatibilité électromagnétique serait un plus.
 Inclusion et diversité : 
 GE HealthCare est un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances où l'inclusion compte. Les décisions relatives à l'emploi sont prises sans tenir compte de l’origine nationale ou ethnique, de la religion, du sexe, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'identité ou de l'expression de genre, de l'âge, du handicap, du statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou d'autres caractéristiques protégées par la loi.
 Nos rémunérations totales sont conçues pour libérer votre ambition en vous donnant la motivation et la flexibilité dont vous avez besoin pour transformer vos idées en réalités qui changent le monde. Nos salaires et nos avantages sociaux correspondent à tout ce que vous attendez d’une organisation ayant une dimension internationale, avec des possibilités de développement de carrière, dans une culture qui favorise la collaboration et le soutien.
 A propos de nous : 
 GE HealthCare est l'un des leaders mondiaux dans le domaine des technologies médicales et des solutions numériques. Il permet aux cliniciens de prendre des décisions plus rapides et plus pertinentes à travers des équipements intelligents, des analyses de données, des applications et des services. Avec plus de 100 ans d'expérience dans le secteur de la santé et environ 47 000 employés dans le monde, la société est au centre d'un écosystème qui travaille pour une médecine de précision. Présent en France depuis 1987 avec aujourd’hui 2 800 collaborateurs, c’est un acteur solidement ancré dans l’hexagone à travers son empreinte industrielle, son centre de R&D et de production à Buc dans les Yvelines et des partenariats de recherche avec des entreprises et des centres de recherche français. www.gehealthcare.com

items.desc:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands 
 C/C++ RADAR SOFTWARE ENGINEER 
 For the SMU Team (sensor management unit) we are looking for a software engineer (C/C++) with strong analytical skills and effective communication abilities. You will not only be a developer writing software but also be involved in integrations and troubleshooting, primarily ensuring the software operates correctly across various radar systems. In this role, you will act as a connector across disciplines and work within a close-knit team.
 About Thales 
 Thales designs highly advanced radar systems and optical sensors that are part of a complete and integrated defense system. The product portfolio ranges from small portable radars for applications such as border or object surveillance to complex four-dimensional radars capable of detecting small objects at distances from hundreds up to thousands of kilometers.
 Within the software department, the Sensor Processing group is responsible for software development of the optimal control and digital processing functions within the sensors. This work is carried out in multidisciplinary teams collaborating with specialists in system engineering, functional sensor design, and the design and implementation of real-time systems.
 About the job 
 Within this Sensor Processing group, the complete radar software is developed. This includes various domains such as controlling the radar systems, organizing radar transmissions, and processing the digital information stream. The ultimate goal is to detect and classify specific objects, such as aircraft and drones, track them, and display them on an operator console.
 The software architecture is designed to be highly modular and supports the development of robust and evolutionary systems. Development takes place in Agile teams supported by a modern development toolchain. The teams themselves are responsible for the ongoing development and maintenance of the architecture, the toolchain, and the Agile process.
 About you 
 Do you have a passion for technology and enjoy working on radar controls or complex algorithms? Then you might be the person we are looking for. We would like to offer you the opportunity to build a career in the international high-tech environment at Thales.
 The requirement is a completed Master’s degree in (technical) computer science or a related field. We expect substantial experience (minimum 2 years or more) with the programming languages C and C++ and with developing real-time software. Experience with other programming languages such as Java is a plus. 
 You are creative, open-minded, and flexible, and you can operate effectively as a team player. Additionally, you are results-oriented, show initiative, and communicate clearly. A good command of both Dutch and English is necessary for successful function fulfillment.
 Screening Criteria 
 Minimum of 2+ years of experience in C++ software development
 Experience with Real-Time Software development
 Proficiency with Linux operating systems
 Experience working as part of a large software development organization
 Effective team player 
 Familiarity with build and deployment tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven 
 Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent 
 Reskilling is possible, but only if the candidate has prior real-time software experience
 Eligibility for VGB-B clearance and eligibility for Dutch Eyes Only classification

 Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills.
 A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work/life balance.
 You can usually work where and when you want, to be able to do your work as well and efficiently as possible. Within Thales we implement hybrid working, where you can, for example, work from home two days a week if your role allows it.
 A good salary, fitting travel allowance, and the ability to personalize your employment conditions. For instance, you can trade days off for our bicycle plan or company fitness.
 40 days paid-time-off per year.

 Apply now! Click on the button below to upload your profile and show your interest.
 To ensure that we are a good match, we may ask you to participate in an assessment.
 A government clearance will be requested as part of standard Thales procedures.

 We actively support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions. items.card: The role You will build and validate flight dynamics models for Helsing's aerial platforms. The work runs from first principles, through numerical simulation and test campaigns, to validation against flight-test data. These models feed directly into control law design, simulation environments and autonomy development, so their accuracy sets how quickly and safely new capabilities reach the air. You will work in a
items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams, and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
 The role 
 You will build and validate flight dynamics models for Helsing's aerial platforms. The work runs from first principles, through numerical simulation and test campaigns, to validation against flight-test data. These models feed directly into control law design, simulation environments and autonomy development, so their accuracy sets how quickly and safely new capabilities reach the air. You will work in a small team alongside control, aerodynamics and test engineers, specify the experiments needed to verify each model, and report the results to internal teams and external partners.
 The day-to-day 
 Develop flight dynamics models for aerial platforms end to end, from model architecture and specification through to validation against flight-test data
 Specify and run numerical and experimental campaigns, and set the acceptance criteria that decide when a model is fit for use in simulation and control design
 Work with the control, aerodynamics and test teams so that models feed directly into control law design, simulation environments and autonomy development
 Attend and analyse flight tests, turning telemetry and anomalies into measurable gains in model fidelity
 Document and present model assumptions, limitations and validation results so that programme decisions rest on evidence
 You should apply if you 
 Have built and validated flight dynamics models from first principles, and tested them against real flight or experimental data
 Bring a thorough grounding in aerodynamics, stability and control, and systems modelling, gained through an engineering degree or equivalent practice
 Work fluently in Matlab and Simulink
 Write clean, well-structured code in Matlab and at least one of Python, Rust, Java or modern C++
 Report findings clearly, in writing and in person, to technical and non-technical audiences
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to have 
 Have applied system identification, control systems design or applied aerodynamics in a flight programme
 Have deployed dynamics models onto real-time test rigs, such as hardware-in-the-loop setups
 What we offer 
 Competitive salary and VSOP options
 Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation
 Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance
 Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)
 Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances
 Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers
 Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work
 These are the core benefits across all locations; there may be additional benefits in specific sites.

Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

Vos missions en tant que Consultant(e) en déploiement Grands Comptes

Job Description: 
 In order to support our structure development team, Airbus Aerostructures is looking for an 
 Airframe Design Approver (d/f/m) 
 Your location 
 Bremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It’s also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour’s drive from the North Sea coast.
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 Guarantee product quality and airworthiness by taking full responsibility for design approval according to established processes
 Develop and optimize metal, composite, and hybrid components and assemblies with regard to weight, cost, performance, manufacturing, and assembly requirements.
 Collaborate in multifunctional teams alongside structural analysis, production, program, project, configuration, and systems functions to achieve optimal technical solutions.
 Evaluate design changes, estimate implementation efforts, and ensure full compliance with regulations, design principles, and guidelines.
 Manage engineering partner and supplier activities, serving as their key technical contact.
 Drive digitalization and automation innovations actively, taking all relevant regulations and stakeholders into account.
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 Technical university degree or similar professional qualification.
 First experience in structural design. 
 Solid understanding of metal, composite, and hybrid design principles, including manufacturing/assembly requirements and tolerance definition.
 Practical knowledge in project management and motivation to work with agile methodologies.
 Hands-on proficiency with CATIA V5 and a PLM tool.
 Collaborative mindset and strong communication skills to align diverse stakeholders, foster continuous improvement, and achieve team goals. Interest in both detailed work and the big picture.
 Ideally experience in AI within the work context.
 Business-fluent communication skills in English and German.
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

 To impulse the use of methods and tools within and without Airbus aiming to setup new design to manufacture standard.
 To influence the Supply Chain network and industrial strategy for a reliable and performant procurement system.

Job Description: 
 Zur Unterstützung sucht Airbus Operations GmbH einen
 Technologen für Funktionstestsysteme / Manufacturing Engineer – Functional Test (Avionik) (d/m/w) 
 Für die Neuausrichtung und den Aufbau unseres Bereichs suchen wir Pioniergeister: Profitiere von einer fundierten Einarbeitung durch unser Expertenteam und nutze die Chance, im Anschluss Strukturen eigenverantwortlich zu gestalten und den Bereich in die Zukunft zu führen.
 Dein Standort 
 Buxtehude - eine malerische Stadt in unmittelbarer Nähe zu Hamburg mit direkter Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel - ist die Heimat von Airbus Cabin Electronics. Wir sind verantwortlich für die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette der Kabinenmanagement- und Konnektivitätslösungen für alle Airbus-Flugzeuge: In jeder Airbus-Kabine schlägt ein Herz aus Buxtehude. Wir bieten eine einzigartige Möglichkeit der direkten Zusammenarbeit über alle Fachbereiche hinweg, um ein innovatives Hightech-Portfolio für Passagierkomfort, Flugzeugsicherheit und Konnektivität zu liefern. Stell dir die Möglichkeiten vor!
 Unsere Benefits für dich 
 Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien.
 Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical)
 Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven
 Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, teils standortnaher Kindergarten
 Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird
 Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 Operative Betreuung und Fehleranalyse: Du stellst die maximale Verfügbarkeit der Testsysteme (ATE/Prüfstände) sicher und führst tiefgehende Fehleranalysen (Troubleshooting) durch, um zwischen Produkt- und Prozessfehlern zu unterscheiden.
 Technologische Betreuung von Maschinen und Anlagen sowie Durchführung von Fehleranalysen (Troubleshooting) bei „Fail“-Ergebnissen zur Unterscheidung zwischen Produkt- und Prozessfehlern
 Arbeitsplanung & SAP-Steuerung: Du bist verantwortlich für die Erstellung und Pflege detaillierter Arbeitspläne und Fertigungsstücklisten in SAP für die Neu- und Serienfertigung. Dies beinhaltet die Anlage von Arbeitsfolgen, die Zuweisung von Prüfmitteln sowie die Definition von Vorgabezeiten.
 Design for Testability (Konstruktionsberatung): Bereits in der Entwicklungsphase berätst du die R&D-Abteilung hinsichtlich der Testbarkeit von Platinen (DfT) und der industriellen Umsetzbarkeit, um spätere Probleme in der Serienfertigung zu vermeiden.
 Prozessoptimierung (KVP): Du analysierst Zykluszeiten und „Bottlenecks“ in den Testsequenzen. Durch die Anwendung von Lean-Methoden und Root-Cause-Analysen leitest du Maßnahmen zur Effizienzsteigerung und Fehlervermeidung ein.
 Compliance und Qualitätssicherung: Du fungierst als technischer Ansprechpartner bei Audits (z.B. LBA, EASA &EN 9100).
 Beschaffung und Projekte: Du definierst Anforderungen an neue Testmittel (Lastenhefte), koordinierst deren Beschaffung im Rahmen des Budgets und begleitest die Einführung neuer Produkte (NPI) durch Prototypen-Validierungen.
 Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen 
 Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (Elektronik/Mechatronik) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation (Techniker/Meister) mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung.
 Fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich Manufacturing Engineering, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt auf elektronische Testsysteme (Avionik, ATE).
 Kenntnisse in der Analyse von Fehlern auf Komponentenebene sowie ein tiefgehendes Verständnis für die Logik elektronischer Schaltungen.
 Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Arbeitsplänen und der Anwendung von REFA Methoden ist von Vorteil.
 Gutes Verständnis für Lean-Management-Prinzipien und Prozessoptimierung.
 Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
 Teamfähigkeit, positive Ausstrahlung und eine selbstständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

Job Description: 
 We are seeking a maintenance data analyst to join the “Fleet performance monitoring & Data” team supporting the sustainment of the A400M fleet. The candidate will provide data-driven support to the optimization of the maintenance plan, with the objective of improving operational availability and maintenance efficiency.
 Key responsibilities :
 Collect, process and analyse in-service maintenance and operational data from the A400M fleet, including scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, failures, removals and defect reports to support the optimization of the A400M maintenance plan.
 Monitor performance indicators related to aircraft maintenance (findings rates, maintenance man hours etc). Evaluate and interpret the outcomes ensuring consistency and traceability
 Produce and deliver regular performance reports, technical summaries and dashboards.
 Interface with maintenance organizations, customers and relevant stakeholders to ensure requirements are met and assisting other areas in Airbus DS with the updated information on fleet performance.
 Requirements :
 Degree in Engineering (aeronautical, industrial, computer science or similar)
 Experience in data analysis, preferably within aerospace, aviation maintenance or industrial environments
 Knowledge of in-service maintenance processes and reliability concepts.
 Experience working with maintenance databases and maintenance systems
 Strong analytical skills, results oriented mindset and attention to detail
 Skills in data analysis tools (advance excel, python, R, SQL or similar) desirable
 Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
 Strong English skills (verbal and written).

Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space , recherche Développeur Logiciel Full Stack (Java/Angular) pour son site de Toulouse (France) ou de Friedrichshafen (Allemagne) . 
 L'équipe Data Management (TSEED1) est chargée du développement et du déploiement de solutions logicielles d'ingénierie des données dédiées à la conception de systèmes spatiaux. Nos solutions et services sont au cœur de nombreux processus métier tout au long du cycle de vie des systèmes spatiaux (appels d'offres, conception, vérification et validation). Acteur clé de la stratégie de digitalisation de l'entreprise, notre équipe stimule l'innovation dans la gestion et l'exploitation des données spatiales. 
 En tant que Développeur Logiciel Full Stack (Java/Angular) , vous serez responsable de l'ingénierie et de l'architecture des développements logiciels, depuis la création de nouvelles fonctionnalités jusqu'à la résolution d'anomalies complexes. Vous piloterez le processus de développement, que ce soit par du développement pratique ( hands-on ) ou par la supervision des travaux confiés à des équipes sous-traitantes. 
 Principales responsabilités 
 Dans ce rôle, vos activités majeures comprendront : 
 Développement Full Stack : Participer au développement des interfaces côté client (Angular) et de la logique côté serveur (Java). 
 Backend Java : Concevoir, tester et maintenir des API RESTful et des microservices backend (ex. Spring Boot) connectés à des bases de données. 
 Frontend Angular : Développer des composants d'interface utilisateur responsives, modulaires et réutilisables avec Angular (TypeScript, HTML5, SCSS/CSS). 
 Qualité du code et tests : Rédiger un code propre et maintenable, mettre en œuvre des tests unitaires/d'intégration et participer aux revues de code entre pairs ( code reviews ). 
 Maintenance des systèmes : Contribuer au débogage, à l'optimisation des performances et au maintien en conditions opérationnelles des modules logiciels existants du périmètre TSEED1. 
 Collaboration : Collaborer étroitement avec les membres d'équipes pluridisciplinaires et les experts métier dans un environnement transnational. 
 Compétences requises et profil recherché 
 Backend Java : Solides connaissances de base en développement Java, principes de la programmation orientée objet (POO) et concepts fondamentaux des frameworks (ex. Spring / Spring Boot). 
 Frontend Angular : Expérience académique ou pratique (projets) avec Angular et TypeScript (incluant HTML5/CSS3 et l'intégration d'API REST). 
 Outils : Bonne maîtrise du versioning avec Git. 
 Bonnes pratiques d'ingénierie : La compréhension de la conteneurisation (Docker) et des flux de travail modernes (concepts CI/CD) constitue un plus. 
 Qualités relationnelles ( soft skills ) : Soif d'apprendre, fortes capacités de résolution de problèmes et aptitude à communiquer efficacement au sein d'une équipe transnationale. 
 Langues : Niveau d'anglais avancé requis (à l'écrit comme à l'oral). 
 Informations complémentaires 
 Environnement de travail : Vous intégrerez une équipe enthousiaste, dynamique et portée sur l'innovation, évoluant dans un contexte transnational selon la méthodologie SCRUM. 
 Habilitation de sécurité : Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité (défense) ou l'éligibilité pour en obtenir une auprès des autorités compétentes.

Job Description: 
 Rejoignez l’équipe chargée du développement des « systèmes Cockpit » d’Airbus Protect et développez vos compétences sur un système avionique opérationnel en tant que « Safety Focal point». 
 Business Unit Safety : 
Assurer la sécurité à long terme, la fiabilité, la navigabilité et l'optimisation des performances des solutions/systèmes des moyens de transports actuels et nouveaux. Notre mission est d'améliorer la sécurité en contribuant à de nouvelles normes de sécurité, en assurant la conformité réglementaire et en veillant à ce que les utilisateurs finaux soient toujours protégés.
Avec plus de 650 spécialistes , nous soutenons nos clients en garantissant le niveau de sécurité et la performance de disponibilité de leurs produits (plateformes, systèmes, équipements) et services. Ceci couvre l'ensemble du processus du cycle de vie du produit/service, de la conception à la fabrication, de l'exploitation au recyclage, tant pour les clients civils que militaires. 
 Missions & Responsabilités: 
 Intégré au Bureau d’Etude “Avionics Platform & Cockpit Systems” en tant que point focal Safety, vous aurez en charge la gestion des activités Safety en considérant les contraintes projet: 
 La planification et la définition des activitées Safety (FHA, SSA, T205G, CMA, MMEL, warnings…), 
 La création d’analyses safety fonctionnelles et/ou système en coopération avec les spécialistes Safety 
 Le suivi des fournisseurs pour les activités Safety 
 Les échanges avec d'autres systèmes sur les exigences et les impacts de sécurité (T205G, analyse en cascade ) 
 La coordination des activités avec les différentes interfaces internes Airbus (Programmes avion, Équipes de tests, Certification…), 
 De par l’aspect central des systèmes concernés (systèmes cockpit, ATA42) , vous serez amené à être interfacé avec l’ensemble des systèmes avion, ce qui vous permettra notamment d’acquérir une solide culture multi-ATA.
 Les compétences qui comptent pour nous: 
 Formation: grandes école/ universités/ école d’ingénieur 
 Idéalement une spécialisation en aéronautique 
 Quelques années d’expérience, mais peut être compensé par de la motivation 
 Connaissances/expériences: En Architecture des systèmes avioniques 
 En Safety 
 En Spécification et développement système avionique
 Sur un système avionique 
 Une connaissance de l’ADCN (Avionics Data Communication Network) serait un plus
 Une connaissance des processus, des méthodologies Airbus et des normes pour la conception de systèmes/équipements aéronautiques (ABD0100/ABD0200,ARP4754, ARP4761, DO178/254…) serait un plus
 Une connaissance en MBSA serait un plus
 As an international company, we work in a multicultural environment: an Advanced level in English is mandatory. 
 Qualités : Ce que vous apporterez à votre future équipe 
 Esprit de synthèse / qualité rédactionnelles 
 Rigueur/organisation 
 Esprit d'équipe / Collaboration 
 Flexibilité / Adaptabilité 
 Autonomie 
 Airbus Protect c’est aussi… 
 Un management de proximité et à l’écoute 
 Un parcours de carrière adapté à vos aspirations (formation, plan de développement…) 
 Accords sur la diversité, l'inclusion et le handicap 
 Prime d’intéressement et de participation 
 Plan d’actionnariat salarié et d’épargne salariale 
 Télétravail : Jusqu’à 3 jours par semaine 
 Politique de temps de travail adaptable à l’équilibre vie pro/perso (forfait jour réduit) 
 Congés calculés sur l’année civile, déblocage dès le 1er jour du contrat. Compte épargne temps 
 Valorisation de l’ancienneté (prime, congés) 
 Politique de mobilités durable vélo/covoiturage/80% des frais de transport en commun remboursés 
 Un CSE avantageux: chèques cadeaux, voyages et week end, enveloppe de remboursement personnel, billetterie 
 D’autres avantages à découvrir lors de nos futurs échanges… ☺
 Votre processus de recrutement : 
 Nous valorisons le contact humain. Afin de mieux vous connaître, voici les étapes habituelles de notre processus de recrutement après analyse de votre candidature : 
 Dossier de candidature à remplir envoyé par votre chargé(e) de recrutement. 
 Entretien technique avec le manager. 
 Entretien avec le/la Chargé(e) de Recrutement. 
 Un feedback personnalisé après le processus 
 Votre poste sera basé/rattaché à… Blagnac 
 Le site d’Airbus Protect à Blagnac est un pôle dynamique dédié à la cybersécurité, la safety et la sustainability. Située à proximité de Toulouse, la ville de Blagnac offre une riche diversité culturelle et gastronomique, avec de nombreux restaurants, boutiques et événements locaux. Ce mélange d'innovation, de nature et de culture fait d'Airbus Protect à Blagnac un lieu de travail attrayant et inspirant.

 Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Jobsharing, Teilzeitmodelle, flexible Arbeitszeiten, individuelle Auszeit)

 Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Informationstechnologie/Informatik oder gleichwertiger Abschluss
 Mehr als fünf Jahre Erfahrung in SW-Engineering, Systemkonzeptdesign und -analyse sowie Systems-Engineering-Prozessen und -Tools im Bereich BMC4ISR

Job Description: 
 Zur Unterstützung der Abteilung "Strategic SW and Infrastructure" sucht Airbus Defence and Space einen Projektleiter Software (m/w/d)
 Als Projektleiter Software (m/w/d) am Standort Ottobrunn sind Sie verantwortlich für die erfolgreiche Planung, Steuerung und Durchführung von Software Projekten im komplexen Umfeld der Verteidigungs- und Raumfahrtindustrie. Sie stellen die Einhaltung von Zeitplänen, Budgets und Qualitätsstandards sicher und agieren als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen internen Abteilungen und externen Partnern.
 Standort 
 Am Airbus-Standort in Ottobrunn arbeitest du dort, wo die Zukunft von Connected Intelligence, Space entsteht. In einer Umgebung, die Weitblick bietet, gestaltest du technologische Innovationen über Domänen hinweg.
 Unser Standort lebt vom Dialog: Auf dem Campus triffst du auf ein einzigartiges Netzwerk aus Experten für Satellitentechnik, militärische Luftfahrt, Cyber-Security, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Combat Cloud und Ground Support von morgen. Auch unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von Dynamik – in agilen Teams widmen wir uns den komplexesten Fragestellungen, von KI-gestützter Erdbeobachtung bis zur sicheren Cloud-Architektur. Wer technologische Exzellenz und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit sucht, findet hier das ideale Umfeld.
 Unsere Benefits 
 Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien.
 Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical)
 Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven
 Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, Kindertagesstätte am Standort
 Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird
 Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 Leitung von Software Projekten über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus (von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur Implementierung und Übergabe).
 Erstellung und Verwaltung von Projektplänen, Meilensteinen und Budgets.
 Koordination interdisziplinärer Projektteams und Steuerung externer Dienstleister.
 Definition und Überwachung von Projektzielen, -umfängen und -leistungen.
 Risikomanagement und Entwicklung von Minderungsstrategien.
 Regelmäßiges Reporting des Projektstatus an Stakeholder und Management.
 Sicherstellung der Einhaltung relevanter Standards, Prozesse und Richtlinien (z.B. ITIL, agile Methoden).
 Qualitätssicherung von Softwareprodukten und IT-Lösungen.
 Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Management auf allen Ebenen.
 Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen 
 Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
 Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Leitung von Software Projekten, idealerweise im industriellen Umfeld.
 Kenntnisse in Projektmanagement-Methoden (z.B. PRINCE2, PMI, SCRUM, SAFe). Zertifizierungen sind von Vorteil.
 Nachweisliche Erfahrung im Umgang mit komplexen IT-Infrastrukturen und Softwareentwicklungsprozessen.
 Sehr gute analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten.
 Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Moderations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten.
 Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Durchsetzungsvermögen und Problemlösungskompetenz.
 Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
 Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen.
 Kenntnisse im Bereich Cybersecurity oder Defence/Space sind wünschenswert.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space recherche un Ingénieur Modélisation et Environnement Spatial (f/h) pour rejoindre notre Département Ingénierie et Simulation Spatiale basé à Toulouse , France. 
 Vos missions : 
 Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui développe des satellites et véhicules spatiaux de pointe. Au sein du département d'ingénierie physique et analyse de mission, vous serez impliqué(e) dans l’étude et la simulation des contraintes spatiales (radiations, plasma, effets thermiques et particulaires) visant à garantir la fiabilité et les performances des missions en orbite. 
 Vos responsabilités : 
 Analyses et études d'impact : Évaluer les phénomènes physiques liés à l'environnement spatial et mesurer leurs effets sur la durée de vie, la charge utile et les performances globales des engins spatiaux. 
 Modélisation et optimisation des outils : Développer, perfectionner et automatiser les outils de calcul, scripts de simulation et méthodes d’ingénierie utilisés pour les études prédictives. 
 Support technique et conception : Formuler des recommandations concrètes pour les équipes de conception, d'essais et d'opérations afin de minimiser les risques techniques dans le respect des normes internationales. 
 Innovation et dynamique collaborative : Participer aux projets de Recherche & Technologie (R&T) et de Recherche & Développement (R&D), tout en contribuant activement au partage d'expertise au sein de l'équipe transnationale. 
 Votre profil : 
 OBLIGATOIRE : 
 Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. 
 Le candidat doit posséder la nationalité française conformément à l’IGI 1300 du 9 Août 2021 (§1.2.2.1). 
 Compétences et qualifications : 
 Formation et expérience : Compétences avancées en physique appliquée, simulation numérique, énergétique ou domaine connexe. Poste ouvert aux profils en début de carrière (première expérience, stage de fin d'études ou alternance compris). 
 Expertise technique : Solides bases en physique de l'environnement spatial, analyse de données et traitement numérique. La maîtrise de la programmation en Python et/ou d'outils de simulation numérique constitue un atout significatif. 
 Compétences méthodologiques : Rigueur d'analyse, capacité à planifier ses tâches, à assurer le suivi technique et à synthétiser les résultats sous forme de rapports d'ingénierie clairs. 
 Aptitudes relationnelles : Autonomie, proactivité, curiosité technique et forte aisance pour le travail collaboratif en équipes pluridisciplinaires et internationales. 
 Langues : Niveau de français et d’anglais avancé 
 Votre environnement de travail : 
 Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! 
 Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : 
 Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d'actions souscrites. 
 Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : Des jours de congés supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales et des options de transfert de congés, un comité d'entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et d’autres services. 
 Bien-être / santé : Couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage. 
 Développement individuel : Des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale). 
 Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. 
 V ous ne matchez pas à 100% ? Pas d'inquiétude ! Airbus vous accompagnera dans votre plan de développement. 
 Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en candidatant en ligne maintenant !

items.desc:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.




🛠️ ABOUT TALENT OPERATIONS

Talent Operations partners with Wayve’s hiring teams to deliver a thoughtful, well-organised experience for candidates, interviewers and hiring teams. In this London-based role, you’ll work closely with approximately six recruiters and take ownership of interview coordination across multiple regions. You’ll help keep hiring moving smoothly while building strong relationships across the London office and wider business.



🧠 YOUR DAY-TO-DAY

 - Coordinate interviews from request through to completion, managing schedules, changes and candidate communications.

 - Prioritise a busy queue of requests, keeping records and handovers accurate and flagging capacity or blockers early.

 - Provide warm, proactive support to candidates, recruiters, interviewers and hiring managers.

 - Handle recruitment support requests and job-approval tasks promptly and accurately.

 - Learn our systems and processes quickly, using documentation and colleagues to investigate issues and solve problems independently.

 - Work with Talent Partners and teams across the business to resolve scheduling challenges and improve how we work.
   


🧩 WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON

 - Supporting around 90–100 individual interviews each week across the UK, Japan, Europe and Israel, with overflow support for the US.

 - Managing interview scheduling in a fast-moving environment where priorities and availability can change.

 - Maintaining reliable hiring records and clear handovers so candidates and colleagues know what to expect.

 - Spotting recurring friction in a defined area of the process and helping address the root cause alongside day-to-day delivery.

 - Using AI thoughtfully and exploring opportunities to improve hiring workflows through automation; boosting efficiency while keeping candidate experience and good judgement at the centre.
   


🙌 YOU SHOULD APPLY IF:

You bring experience from recruiting coordination or another detail-heavy, service-focused role, such as executive support, customer operations or events, and can show that you:

 - Take ownership, prioritise competing requests and communicate early when something needs attention.

 - Build trust through warm, clear and proactive communication with candidates and stakeholders.

 - Stay accurate and calm when plans change, and take responsibility for your work.

 - Learn new systems quickly, investigate problems and apply feedback.

 - Are curious about improving processes and confident using AI tools thoughtfully in your work.

Recruitment or ATS experience, including Ashby, would be useful, but it isn’t essential if you can demonstrate strong coordination, judgement and an ability to learn systems quickly.



🌱 NOT TICKING EVERY BOX? THAT’S TOTALLY OKAY!

If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.




MORE ABOUT WAYVE:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.



HOW WE WORK 💻 — LOCATIONS & FLEXIBLE WORKING

This role is based in our London hub, with a minimum of 2 days in the office. Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with …

Job Description: 
 Leonardo è un gruppo industriale internazionale, tra le principali realtà mondiali nell’Aerospazio, Difesa e Sicurezza che realizza capacità tecnologiche multidominio in ambito Elicotteri, Velivoli, Aerostrutture, Elettronica, Cyber Security e Spazio. Con oltre 62.000 dipendenti nel mondo, l’azienda ha una solida presenza industriale in Italia, Regno Unito, Polonia, Stati Uniti, e opera in 150 paesi anche attraverso aziende controllate, joint venture e partecipazioni. Protagonista dei principali programmi strategici a livello globale, è partner tecnologico e industriale di Governi, Amministrazioni della Difesa, Istituzioni e imprese.
 All’interno della Divisione Velivoli di Leonardo nell'area di Assicurazione Qualità e Certificazione , all'interno dell' Unità Organizzativa Audit e Processi Speciali, stiamo ricercando un/a Internal Auditor per la nostra sede di Caselle Nord e Venegono 
 La risorsa si occuperà principalmente di: 
 Garantire il rispetto degli standard di qualità definiti, in linea con i requisiti interni ed esterni 
 Garantire l’attuazione e l’efficacia delle attività di audit interni, come da programma aziendale
 Garantire la conformità del regolamento aziendale ai requisiti di certificazione 
 Gestire, implementare e monitorare il programma di audit del SGQ Gestire le Non Conformità e le azioni correttive degli Audit eseguiti 
 Gestire il Sistema Qualità Interno, nel rispetto degli Schemi di Qualificazione e Certificazione definiti 
 Svolgerà audit interni complessi con vari campi certificativi in ambito sia civile che militare da monitorare (campi certificativi aziendali quali es. EN9100-EN9110-AQAP2310-PART21G-PART145-AER(EP).P-145-AER(EP).P-21 G)
 Titolo di studio: preferibilmente laurea magistrale in ingegneria gestionale e/o aerospaziale o diploma tecnico aeronautico

 Conoscenze e competenze tecniche: 
 Conoscenza normativa in ambito aerospazio, militare e civile sia in ambito produttivo che manutentivo EN9100, PART civili, AER(EP) militare

 Auditor mondo aerospazio EN9100
 Competenze comportamentali: 
 Capacità a lavorare in team
 Flessibilità
 Capacità di comunicazione e di relazione con clienti e con i fornitori
 Capacità organizzative
 Problem solving ed orientamento al risultato
 Curiosità ed attitudine all’apprendimento
 Conoscenze linguistiche: 
 Buona conoscenza dell’inglese scritto e orale
 Conoscenze informatiche: 
 Pacchetto Office

 Disponibilità a trasferte tra gli stabilimenti e le basi aziendali
 Riconoscimento minimo auditor interno mondo aerospazio 9100 e conoscenza/corsi delle norme certificative mondo militare e civile
 Lavorando con noi avrai modo di confrontarti costantemente con le sfide dell’alta tecnologia, di accrescere le tue competenze e costruire un percorso professionale di eccellenza. 
 aspettiamo la tua candidatura : inviaci il tuo CV entro tre settimane dall’apertura dell’annuncio di lavoro. 
 Come funziona il processo di selezione? 
 A seguito della raccolta delle candidature, vengono valutati e identificati i CV maggiormente in linea con i requisiti richiesti. 
 Le/i candidate/i selezionate/i sostengono un colloquio conoscitivo con il team delle Risorse Umane, motivazionale e attitudinale, seguito da un’intervista di approfondimento tecnico con il Business. 
 Al termine del processo, alla persona viene restituito un feedback, sia in caso di esito positivo che negativo. 
 Coinvolgimento , valorizzazione delle competenze , cura del benessere e della sicurezza delle persone sono i cardini della nostra cultura aziendale. 
 Ci impegniamo ogni giorno a favorire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e stimolante , promuovendo attivamente i principi di inclusione, equità e valorizzazione delle diversità. 
 Cosa offriamo? 
 Retribuzione fissa commisurata all’esperienza e al livello della persona selezionata, accompagnata da premialità legate ai risultati di business;

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Electronic Engineering Summer Placement – 3 Months 
 Your impact 
 Do you want to work on real-time projects, alongside leading scientists and engineers, within a globally renowned company, based on our Edinburgh Site?
 Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one? At Leonardo, we’re looking for summer placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
 Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates.
 Our Summer Placement Programme 
 Our 13-week Summer Placement Programme gives you the chance to work on meaningful projects alongside subject matter experts, within multidisciplinary teams, and across the product lifecycle. Throughout your paid placement, you’ll receive coaching and support from a dedicated team, with the potential to return for future placements or progress onto our Graduate Development Programme.
 The programme will run from 1st June to 27th August 2027. 
 You are required to spend at least three or four days each week on site, to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience by designing, testing or integrating electronic circuits and components on the Edinburgh site.
 As an Electronic Engineering Summer Placement student, you will: 
 Contribute to solving real life engineering problems on state-of-the-art avionics sensor systems. Particular emphasis will be placed on learning practical skills that may not be easily gained or experienced in the academic environment of university.
 Collaborate with colleagues across multiple disciplines to help project targets and solve problems
 Apply your academic knowledge to real projects, including design, testing, qualification and/or technology support
 To learn the skills required for hardware development, you will develop practical skills in design techniques for aerospace applications, understand key technologies, and develop your experience using ECAD tools and test equipment
 Develop your skills with the guidance of an experienced supervisor and the wider engineering community
 What you’ll bring: Entry Requirements 
 All of our placement students should be working towards:
 a minimum of an upper Second class Bachelors/Integrated Masters degree, or
 a higher degree, such as an MSc or PhD.
 The subject should be Electronics Engineering, Engineering Science, Physics or another relevant discipline.
 You should demonstrate an interest in one or more of the disciplines within Electronic/ Hardware Engineering (e.g. RF, Microwave, Power Supply, FPGAs or High-Speed Digital Circuitry). If you have a preference, please indicate this on your CV or screening questions.
 Competencies we look for: 
 Strong communication skills, written and verbal, needed to communicate problems and their solutions to your project team
 Self-motivated, enthusiastic, and able to use initiative to understand issues and find solutions
 Adaptable to changing priorities imposed by product-led milestones and pressures
 Collaborative and flexible in approach
 Security Clearance 
 At Leonardo, many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 
 To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 
 For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting 
 Why join us 
 At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do, key contributors in shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your wellbeing, learning and development, and work–life balance: 
 Time to recharge : Our employees are entitled 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays. As a Summer …

items.desc:
Join our Team
 About this opportunity: 
 The Researcher Standardization 6G PHY is responsible for developing concepts for Ericsson to contribute in the 3GPP RAN1 working group. You will contribute to the development and maintenance of technical specifications for the 6G RAN standard as be part of a team developing concepts and working with standardization delegates. The researcher plays a key role in shaping the future of mobile communication by collaborating with industry experts and stakeholders both internally and externally. 
 What you will do: 
 • Develop research concepts for Ericsson’s contributions to the 3GPP RAN1 working group. 
• Contribute to the development and maintenance of technical specifications for the 6G RAN standard. 
• Work as part of a team developing concepts and collaborating with standardization delegates. 
• Engage with industry experts and stakeholders, both internally and externally. 
• Carry out computer simulations to support research and standardization activities. 
• Develop new research concepts and work towards their acceptance by technical committees. 
• Build expertise and become a technical authority within a sub-domain of the standardization area. 
 The skills you bring: 
 • PhD or Master’s degree in electrical engineering or related field. 
• Proven experience in evolving radio access technologies and standards. 
• Deep knowledge of 5G NR physical layer and FEC. 
• Understanding of 5G RAN products and deployments. 
• Understanding of the 3GPP standardization process. 
• Proficiency in spoken and written English, able to clearly convey complex technical information to diverse audiences. 
• Ability to carry out computer simulations. 
• Strong collaborator in a global environment. 
 Why join Ericsson? At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
 What happens once you apply? Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

items.desc:
Company: 
QT Technologies Ireland Limited 
 Job Area: 
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > ASICS Engineering 
 General Summary: 
 About the role 
 Qualcomm’s Mixed-Signal IP (MSIP) Design Verification team is seeking Mixed-Signal Design Verification Engineers to join our team in Cork, Ireland. The Qualcomm Cork site is home to a range of MSIP teams working on cutting edge designs for the latest Snapdragon SoCs in the latest technology nodes, and the successful candidate will work on mixed-signal verification for several key mixed-signal PHY IPs including DDR, USB, PCIE, eDP, DPRX, HDMI, SGMII, DSI, CSI as well as PLL IP and more.
The Design Verification team in Cork uses the latest tools and verification techniques in leading edge silicon nodes at 3nm and below and team members work directly with architecture, design, software and SoC teams in Ireland and other global Qualcomm locations.
 Responsibilities Will Include: 
 SV/UVM based Design Verification of SerDes, DDR & PLL Mixed-Signal PHY IP
 Emulation experience is desired along with SV/UVM based simulation.
 Work closely with analog and digital front-end design teams to verify RTL and Analog/Mixed-Signal Designs in next-generation SerDes, DDR & PLL IP
 Interact with architecture, design, physical design, software, test and SoC teams to verify and integrate SerDes, DDR & PLL IP designs into the latest Qualcomm Snapdragon products
 Skills And Experience We Would Love To See 
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or related field.
 Experience in design and verification of hardware and software on SoCs and SoC/IP Methodologies for verifying complex units using industry standard tools and technologies
 Knowledge in developing unit and SoC/IP level test benches using UVM.
 Constrained random functional verification environment in System Verilog/UVM with excellent debugging skills.
 Experience in Low power verification using UPF at RTL and GLS simulation level.
 Experience in Power Aware Gate Level Simulation (GLS) verification flow with zero delay and SDF annotated simulation.
 Experience of pre and post-silicon verification testflow and automated test benches. Post silicon ATE/PTE vector bringup and bench characterization support.
 Knowledge of test-plan development, coverage (code/functional) analysis, transaction level modelling, constrained random verification, assertion based and formal verification techniques with System Verilog
 Experience with Verilog, SystemVerilog, Assertions, Python/TCL/Perl/shell-scripting.
 Experience in analog mixed signal verification techniques will be a plus.
 Excellent communication skills
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field.
 2+ years design verification, or related work experience.
 Where you will be working 
 Cork has a proud reputation as Ireland's second largest economic engine and is now one of the Top 20 location choices in Europe with 39,000 people being employed by over 170 overseas companies.
There's a growing diversity in the region with people from many nationalities relocating to Cork, relishing the opportunity to work and live in a location that offers an excellent quality of life.
A gateway to Europe, Cork airport provides access to almost 50 international destinations including transatlantic air routes.
 Equal Opportunities 
We are an Equal Opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any protected classification.
 What's on Offer 
 Apart from working in an open, relaxed and collaborative space, you will enjoy:
 Salary, stock and performance related bonus
 Maternity/Paternity Leave
 Employee stock purchase scheme
 Matching pension scheme
 Education Assistance
 Relocation and immigration support (if needed)
 Life, Medical, Income and Travel Insurance
 Subsidised memberships for physical and mental well-being
 Bicycle purchase scheme
 Employee run clubs, including, running, football, chess, badminton + many more
 Minimum Qualifications: 
• Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
 OR
Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
 OR
PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.

items.desc:
Jouw uitdaging 
 Als Application Engineer vorm je de schakel tussen klantwensen en technische oplossingen. Je analyseert complexe vraagstukken, vertaalt specificaties naar slimme systeemoplossingen en zorgt ervoor dat klanten kunnen vertrouwen op de kwaliteit en prestaties van de gekozen toepassing. 
 Je werkt nauw samen met klanten, sales, productspecialisten en engineering collega's. Daarbij krijg je veel vrijheid om jouw technische expertise in te zetten en oplossingen te ontwikkelen die echt waarde toevoegen. De rol omvat technische analyse, engineering, configuratie, validatie en ondersteuning tijdens de implementatie van systemen. 
 Op de afdeling Application Engineering zijn we op zoek naar een Application Engineer Mobiel Electronics. Een MEL engineer richt zich op de mobiele toepassingen en specifiek op het besturingssysteem. We maken hierbij gebruik van platformsoftware welke we integreren in de machine van de klant. Voor deze functie heb je ‘mobiel DNA’ nodig, de focus ligt op mobiele machines zoals landbouwmachines, bouwmachines, material handling en speciale voertuigen. 
 Wat ga je doen? 
 Vertalen van klantwensen naar technische oplossingen en systeemconcepten. 
 Analyseren van technische specificaties en identificeren van mogelijke risico's. 
 Selecteren en specificeren van aandrijf- en besturingscomponenten. 
 Opstellen van technische documentatie, schema's, specificaties en berekeningen. 
 Configureren en parametreren van besturingssystemen. 
 Technische ondersteuning bieden tijdens projectuitvoering en inbedrijfstelling. 
 Valideren en testen van systeemfunctionaliteiten volgens klant- en kwaliteitseisen. 
 Fungeren als technisch aanspreekpunt voor klanten en interne stakeholders.
Wat breng jij mee? 
 Een afgeronde technische HBO- of WO-opleiding. 
 Sterk technisch en analytisch inzicht. 
 Affiniteit met aandrijf- en besturingstechnologie. 
 Ervaring met engineering-, configuratie- of simulatietools. 
 Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en klantgerichtheid. 
 Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal; Duits is een pré.
Wat Bosch jou biedt: 
 Marktconform salaris passend bij jouw ervaring  
 40 verlofdagen (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV)  
 Sterke pensioenregeling (PME)  
 Jaarcontract met intentie tot langdurige samenwerking  
 Laptop 
 Hybride werken mogelijk  
 Standplaats Eindhoven  
 Opleidingen en certificeringen 
 Veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid  
 Professionele, betrokken en vakinhoudelijk sterke collega's  
 Een stabiele internationale organisatie met lange termijnvisie  
 Waarom Bosch Rexroth?  
 Wat deze functie bijzonder maakt, is niet de techniek alleen. Het is de verantwoordelijkheid die je krijgt en de impact die je kunt maken.  
 Bij Bosch Rexroth help je klanten die afhankelijk zijn van installaties waar stilstand simpelweg geen optie is. Jij brengt structuur in complexe situaties, verbindt de juiste mensen met elkaar en zorgt ervoor dat oplossingen werkelijkheid worden.
