Horaires : 35h/semaine, télétravail possible Rémunération : Entre 29k€ et 39k€ brut annuel fixe, selon notre grille de rémunération, en fonction du diplôme obtenu, des compétences et des expériences professionnelles. Informations supplémentaires Votre quotidien ? Contribuer chaque jour à acheminer l’électricité dont tout le monde a besoin pour se déplacer, se chauffer, recharger son véhicule ou faire tourner son entreprise. Un quotidien utile, sans routine, où l’impact de votre travail se voit tout de suite et à long terme. Envie de rejoindre une entreprise qui compte vraiment ? items.desc: Job-ID: 70914/26 | Department: Technology | Salary: as per tariff (TV-L) | Working Time: 40h/week (part-time work option) | Limitation: initially 2 years with option of extension for three more years | Starting Date: as soon as possible IHP is an institute of the Leibniz Association and conducts research and development of silicon-based systems and ultra-high-frequency circuits and technologies including new materials. It develops innovative solutions for application areas such as wireless and broadband communication, security, medical technology, industry 4.0, automotive industry, and aerospace. IHP employs approximately 400 people. It operates a pilot line for technological developments and the preparation of high-speed circuits with 130 nm-SiGe-BiCMOS technologies, located in a 1500 m² cleanroom that meets the highest industrial nanotechnology requirements. The position As a member of the Process Integration Group within IHP’s Technology Department, you will contribute to the research and development of advanced semiconductor technologies. You will work in an international team of highly motivated researchers, engineers, PhD candidates and technicians. Flat hierarchies, close collaboration and mutual support are important to us, and we value the diversity of perspectives and expertise within our team. Your work will focus on the development and integration of photonic devices and technologies within advanced silicon-based technology platforms, in particular SiGe BiCMOS and photonic BiCMOS technologies. This includes the development and optimization of devices such as germanium photodetectors, as well as related process modules and their integration into complex semiconductor technology platforms. Your tasks will comprise device and process development, characterization, data analysis and the evaluation and optimization of semiconductor fabrication processes. The work will focus on extending the functionality of integrated photonic and SiGe BiCMOS technologies through novel devices and enabling applications beyond current technology capabilities. Your qualifications You hold a Master’s or PhD degree in electrical engineering, physics, materials science or a related field. You have a solid understanding of semiconductor device physics and ideally experience in the development of semiconductor or photonic devices. Knowledge of silicon-based semiconductor technologies, SiGe BiCMOS, silicon photonics or germanium-based optoelectronic devices is particularly welcome. Practical experience with common semiconductor cleanroom processes, such as lithography, etching, thin-film deposition, epitaxy, ion implantation or thermal processing, is an advantage. You enjoy working in an interdisciplinary team and are able to organize your work independently and systematically. We are looking for a colleague with strong experimental, analytical and problem-solving skills, who is motivated to develop a deep understanding of the interaction between device design, fabrication processes and device performance. Good communication skills and the ability to quickly become familiar with new experimental equipment and software tools are important for this position. A confident command of English is required. Knowledge of German is welcome; further development of German language skills is encouraged and supported, for example through in-house language courses and intensive courses. Our Offer Do research in a challenging, multinational environment giving you excellent career opportunities. You will have the chance to establish international reputation at the edge of top-notch technologies. An orientation guide will help you to quickly integrate into the institute and to familiarize yourself with the field. It is important to us to support the individual career developments (e.g. conferences, advanced trainings) as well as the personal needs of our employees by offering flexible working hours and the possibility to work off-site. The compatibility of work and family is highly valued. More information about our scientific excellence and the working environment at IHP can be found on our website. IHP is TOTAL E-QUALITY-certified for equal opportunities for women and men at work and actively pursues the equality of all gender and all groups of people. We promote the professional development of women and strongly encourage them to apply. Disabled applicants, qualified according to the above criteria, will be given preference over other candidates with equivalent relevant qualifications. items.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Counter-Drone Systems (m/f/d)
items.card: Your mission Build real autonomous systems that operate in the real world, not in the lab. Join our engineering team and help build the core autonomy that powers our next generation robotic systems used for defense and mission-critical operations. You will design, implement, and harden robotic software that must perform under real operational conditions : outdoors, under uncertainty, with real consequences. Your
items.desc: What we offer Work in an international, agile team creating the future of autonomous systems Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture Your mission Build real autonomous systems that operate in the real world, not in the lab. Join our engineering team and help build the core autonomy that powers our next generation robotic systems used for defense and mission-critical operations. You will design, implement, and harden robotic software that must perform under real operational conditions : outdoors, under uncertainty, with real consequences. Your work will directly shape the reliability, safety, and tactical capability of the systems we deliver. You will contribute to the development and integration of core robotic capabilities, including: Designing and implementing robust, real-time robotics software components Working with multi-modal sensor data, ensuring timing, synchronization, and frame correctness Developing and improving algorithms in areas such as estimation, perception, planning, control, or integration Ensuring deterministic behavior, reliability, and system-level stability Debugging and validating robotic systems during field tests, under real-world constraints Collaborating with a cross-functional team of robotics, embedded, and domain experts Maintaining high engineering standards: code reviews, CI, reproducible builds, documentation You will execute on real hardware and iterate based on operational performance, field results are the final metric. Your profile Technical Fundamentals : Strong proficiency in modern C++ (17/20) Experience with ROS/ ROS 2 Solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and numerical methods Experience developing software that runs on real robots, embedded systems, or hardware-in-the-loop setups Comfortable working with raw sensor data (timing, noise characteristics, transforms, calibration) Strong debugging skills: runtime issues, latency, performance bottlenecks, integration failures Ability to architect clean, modular, maintainable software systems R obotics Foundation : Understanding of at least one robotics domain: state estimation, perception, tracking, planning, control, sensor fusion, or integration Ability to reason about real-time behavior, latency budgets, and reliability requirements End-to-end thinking: understanding how individual modules affect the whole system Nice to have Python for tooling or prototyping Experience with robotics middleware or real-time systems Background in optimization, filtering, or physical modeling Experience with embedded platforms, GPUs, or simulation tools We hire for core engineering ability, everything else can be learned here. What else Builder mentality: you ship working solutions, not theoretical concepts Hands-on ownership: you proactively solve problems, even outside your direct scope Field-driven mindset: you care about what survives real operations, not “lab perfect” High quality bar: you aim for reliability, determinism, and clarity in your engineering Startup drive: you execute fast despite ambiguity, and adapt quickly Mission alignment: genuine motivation to work on defense-relevant, safety-critical robotics Nationality of a NATO member nation or close ally is required About us The world is changing. Exponential technologies are enabling new types of security threats. ATS is committed to staying ahead by building nimble, scalable, and cost-effective defences. We are looking for passionate team members who are eager to create exceptional products, safeguard our freedom, and strengthen the resilience of democracies. Who we are: Autonomous Teaming is a defence-tech start-up specializing in machine vision solutions. Driven by cutting-edge innovation, our team works on next-generation technologies designed to meet rapidly evolving security challenges. What we do: We develop systems that enable computers and sensors to operate as coordinated teams, collaborating in real time to counter AI-powered asymmetric threats at scale — including drone swarms and other UXVs. Our mission is to build resilient, intelligent defence capabilities that perform reliably in the most demanding environments. How we work: We value close, in-person collaboration as the foundation for building complex, high-impact technology, while maintaining flexibility aligned to role and team needs. Our culture is built on ownership, responsibility, and trust — with a shared commitment to growing and building together. Where we are: Based in Munich, Berlin, and Toulouse, we are expanding rapidly across Europe with plans to open additional office hubs.

Exponential technologies are enabling new types of security threats. ATS is committed to staying ahead by building nimble, scalable, and cost-effective defences. We are looking for passionate team members who are eager to create exceptional products, safeguard our freedom, and strengthen the resilience of democracies. Driven by cutting-edge innovation, our team works on next-generation technologies designed to meet rapidly evolving security challenges. What we do: We develop systems that enable computers and sensors to operate as coordinated teams, collaborating in real time to counter AI-powered asymmetric threats at scale — including drone swarms and other UXVs. items.desc: Your Role Freshly cooked food. Everywhere. All the time. With our robots, we’re transforming the way the world cooks and enjoys food. Through technology that empowers the foodservice industry, automates fresh meal preparation, and elevates culinary quality to a new, scalable level. Accessible to everyone. Everywhere. Anytime. We give our all to make this happen – across every level, team and function. As Deployment Engineer , you make sure our robotic kitchens are prepared correctly and run reliably in the field. You install and configure operating systems and the required components on our edge servers, deploy release updates, verify system health, and troubleshoot technical issues across Kubernetes, Linux, networking, server hardware, and applications. You work with established processes and tools while continuously expanding your knowledge of our systems and technologies. These are the tasks you will be responsible for: Edge-server preparation & deployment: You prepare the edge servers that run our robotic kitchens – from checking the server hardware and installing the operating system to configuring the required system and application components. Software release deployments: You deploy release updates to our robotic kitchens using our existing processes and tools, and verify that the systems and applications are working correctly before and after deployment. Kubernetes operations: You deploy and operate applications in existing Kubernetes environments and investigate workload issues using logs, events, resource status, and configuration. System troubleshooting: You investigate technical issues systematically across applications, Kubernetes, Linux, networking, and server hardware. You gather the relevant information, identify possible causes, resolve manageable issues, and provide clear findings when support from another team is required. System health & maintenance: You monitor the health of deployed systems, perform routine maintenance, and follow established procedures for updates, backups, recovery, and other operational activities. Documentation & collaboration: You document deployments, technical findings, and solutions, and work closely with DevOps, Software, Robotics, Manufacturing, and Operations to keep our robotic kitchens running reliably. Continuous improvement: You contribute to improving deployment procedures, troubleshooting guides, scripts, and automation as your knowledge of our environment grows. Your profile You’re passionate about innovative technologies, excited about the role, and ready to help us revolutionize the worlds of tech and culinary even further? Let’s get cooking! These are the qualities helping you thrive in this role: Linux foundation: You have a solid grasp of Linux systems and feel at home on the command line. You understand core concepts like services, processes, permissions, logs, storage, and resource usage – and you can install and set up the basic configuration of a Linux OS yourself. Kubernetes & containers: You understand container fundamentals and bring hands-on Kubernetes experience – deploying and troubleshooting containerized workloads in an existing cluster. Logs, events, resource status, and configuration are your go-to tools for investigating common issues. Troubleshooting mindset: You tackle unfamiliar technical problems in a structured way – gathering information, checking logs and system state, testing assumptions, and narrowing down causes. You don't need to have seen every issue before; you just know how to start digging. Infrastructure know-how: You understand networking fundamentals like IP addressing, gateways, DNS, DHCP, ports, and connectivity, and you know your way around core server hardware – CPU, memory, storage, network interfaces. You can run basic troubleshooting on both. Scripting & release workflows: You bring basic scripting skills, ideally in Bash or Python – reading and adapting existing scripts, working with config files, and building simple automation. You're also comfortable with Git and understand repositories, branches, commits, tags, and release versions. Hands-on edge & robotics mindset: You love working close to the hardware and are drawn to self-managed edge infrastructure – not just cloud-based systems. Learning, collaboration & languages: You're eager to learn, enjoy new technical challenges, and bring a careful, reliable approach. You thrive in cross-functional teams, communicate your findings clearly, and are fluent in English. About us At goodBytz, you're more than just part of a team – you'll be a key contributor who helps shape what we build. We're looking for colleagues who don't just go along for the ride, but have the courage to speak up and share critical perspectives. Because respect, trust, and open dialogue are the foundation of our success and satisfaction. Previous GIS experience is an advantage but is not required. items.desc: Gierre Srl, azienda specializzata nella commercializzazione di accessori e sistemi per vetro, box doccia, porte, parapetti e pensiline, ricerca una persona da inserire nel proprio organico per supportare lo sviluppo delle attività digitali, grafiche, marketing ed e-commerce dell'azienda. Cerchiamo un profilo junior, dinamico e curioso , con una buona dimestichezza con gli strumenti digitali e un particolare interesse per grafica, intelligenza artificiale, marketing online ed e-commerce . Non cerchiamo necessariamente una persona con molti anni di esperienza: per noi sono più importanti la capacità di utilizzare gli strumenti digitali, la voglia di imparare, la creatività e la predisposizione a sperimentare nuove tecnologie. Di cosa si occuperà creazione e modifica di immagini e contenuti grafici; realizzazione di materiale per sito web, cataloghi, newsletter e social; utilizzo di strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale per la creazione e l'ottimizzazione di testi, immagini e contenuti; gestione e aggiornamento dei prodotti sull'e-commerce; caricamento di immagini, descrizioni, caratteristiche tecniche e contenuti delle schede prodotto; supporto nella gestione del sito aziendale; Requisiti Cerchiamo una persona che abbia: buona dimestichezza con computer e strumenti digitali; conoscenze di base di grafica e fotoritocco ; interesse e familiarità con gli strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale generativa ; conoscenze di base di marketing digitale; interesse per il mondo e-commerce; capacità di creare contenuti chiari e graficamente curati; precisione e attenzione ai dettagli; voglia di imparare e crescere professionalmente; autonomia nell'utilizzo del web e nella ricerca di nuove soluzioni. Competenze preferenziali Saranno considerate positivamente conoscenze, anche di base, di: Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva o software analoghi; ChatGPT e altri strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale; WordPress; WooCommerce; SEO; Google Ads e Meta Ads; newsletter ed email marketing; gestione di Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn e altri social; editing di immagini e brevi video. Non è necessario conoscere già tutti questi strumenti: cerchiamo soprattutto una persona versatile, sveglia e interessata al mondo digitale , che abbia già delle buone basi e voglia sviluppare ulteriormente le proprie competenze. Cosa offriamo La persona entrerà direttamente a contatto con diversi progetti digitali dell'azienda e avrà la possibilità di seguire concretamente lo sviluppo del nostro sito, e-commerce, catalogo prodotti, contenuti, marketing e utilizzo dell'Intelligenza Artificiale . L'obiettivo è formare nel tempo una figura interna capace di gestire con crescente autonomia le principali attività digitali e di marketing di Gierre. Sede di lavoro: Trezzano sul Naviglio (MI) Orario: Full time, dal lunedì al venerdì. La tipologia contrattuale e l'inquadramento saranno valutati in base all'esperienza e alle competenze del candidato. Retribuzione: €1.200,00 - €1.500,00 al mese Sede di lavoro: In presenza

items.desc: Chi siamo Siamo una cooperativa sociale attiva a Sesto San Giovanni da quarant'anni. Diamo opportunità d'impiego a persone che incontrano difficoltà a inserirsi nel mondo del lavoro, attraverso i servizi (pulizie, trasporti, disinfestazioni, servizi museali) che offriamo ai nostri clienti. Cosa facciamo: più di un luogo di lavoro, un progetto! La struttura alberghiera in cui lavorerai fa parte di un progetto a forte impatto sociale che combina ricettività alberghiera, housing sociale e inserimento lavorativo di persone con fragilità. Per questo motivo cerchiamo una persona che sappia lavorare con sensibilità, rispetto e capacità di collaborazione in un contesto eterogeneo e inclusivo. Chi cerchiamo Cerchiamo un/a cameriere/a ai piani da inserire nella nostra struttura alberghiera di nuova apertura. La persona selezionata si occuperà della pulizia, del riordino e della cura delle camere e degli spazi comuni della struttura, contribuendo a garantire agli ospiti un ambiente accogliente, pulito e confortevole. La figura lavorerà in un contesto attento alle persone, in cui la qualità del servizio si accompagna alla valorizzazione delle differenze e alla promozione di opportunità di inserimento lavorativo. Principali mansioni Pulizia, riordino e riassetto delle camere e dei bagni. Cambio della biancheria da letto e da bagno. Pulizia e sanificazione degli spazi comuni, nel rispetto delle procedure igienico-sanitarie. Rifornimento dei prodotti di cortesia e del materiale necessario al servizio. Segnalazione di eventuali guasti, anomalie o necessità di manutenzione. Utilizzo corretto delle attrezzature e dei prodotti per la pulizia. Collaborazione con il team per garantire un servizio efficiente e rispondente agli standard della struttura. Rispetto della privacy degli ospiti e delle regole di sicurezza sul lavoro. Requisiti e competenze Precisione, attenzione ai dettagli e cura degli ambienti. Affidabilità, puntualità e senso di responsabilità. Capacità di organizzare il proprio lavoro e rispettare le priorità. Attitudine al lavoro di squadra e alla collaborazione. Rispetto, sensibilità e disponibilità a lavorare in un contesto eterogeneo e inclusivo. Flessibilità e disponibilità a svolgere mansioni operative. Esperienza pregressa nel ruolo gradita, ma non indispensabile. Tipologia assunzione Contratto da definire in relazione all’esperienza, con garanzie di continuità Inquadramento: CCLN Cooperative Sociali, livello A2/B1 Sede di lavoro: Milano, zona Bande Nere part time/full time 6 giorni su 7 Disponibilità: da gennaio 2027 Retribuzione: €1.372,00 - €1.437,00 al mese Sede di lavoro: In presenza

Write and maintain unit and integration tests, following the program's testing standards. Support in architectural design analysis and technical validation for MES Local Projects. Demonstrating a strong commitment to health, safety, and environmental standards. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Motivation, initiative, and the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team. Good organizational skills and attention to detail. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic environment. Flexibility and willingness to travel nationally to support project requirements. Strong personal initiative, adaptability, and eagerness to learn. Full driving licence valid in Italy (essential). items.desc: Job Description: Closer to Space, closer to the Future: join Telespazio – Leonardo Space Division! Leonardo is a leading global industrial group in Aerospace, Defence and Security, delivering advance multi-domain technologies across Helicopters, Aircraft, Aerostructures, Electronics, Cybersecurity, and Space. As part of the Leonardo Space Division, Telespazio a joint venture between Leonardo (67%) and Thales (33%) , is a global reference in the field of satellite solutions and services. With a workforce of over 3.500 professionals across its offices in Europe and around the world, Telespazio operates an international network of Space Centres and Teleports, offering cutting-edge solutions in Geoinformation Services, Satellite Systems and Operations, and Satellite Communications. Join us as we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible in Space. Inside the Satellite Operations Area at the Fucino Space Centre, we are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Junior Spacecraft Operations Engineer to join our Flight Control Team. In this role, you will be actively involved in supporting in-orbit spacecraft operations and preparing future satellite missions at one of the world's premier commercial spaceports. RESPONSIBILITIES & ACTIVITIES The selected candidate will report to the Head of the Satellite Operations Organizational Unit and will be responsible for the following activities: Operations Preparation & Execution: Assist in preparing, planning, and executing satellite flight operations across all mission phases, including Launch and Early Orbit Phase (LEOP), Commissioning, and Routine operations. Flight Documentation & Database Management: Support the development, testing, validation, and maintenance of Flight Operations Plans (FOP), operational procedures, satellite databases, and critical flight tools. Testing & Simulation Campaigns: Contribute to the preparation and execution of System Validation Tests (SVT) with the satellite on the ground, participate in mission simulation campaigns, and support operational readiness activities. In-Orbit Operations & Anomaly Resolution: Monitor satellite health and status, assist in long-term trend analyses and performance assessments, and support the investigation of operational events and anomalies across satellite and ground segment elements. Control Centre Operations & Training: Support the operational validation of the Mission Control Centre (MCC), assist in providing training to operational personnel, and coordinate satellite activity schedules with system-level operations. Technical Reporting & Reviews: Prepare technical notes, generate mission operations reports, and participate in technical meetings and project reviews. REQUIREMENTS Academic Background & Experience: Master’s Degree in Aerospace, Astronautical, Electronic, or Telecommunications Engineering. Desirable: 2–3 years of experience in satellite operations; alternatively, academic project experience, master's thesis work, or internships focused on satellite operations, flight dynamics, or space mission design/analysis will be highly considered. Technical Skills and IT Tools: Solid programming and software development skills, with proficiency in MATLAB and at least one of the following languages: Python, C++, or Java . Knowledge of satellite subsystems, space mission phases (LEOP, Commissioning, Routine), and ground segment/Mission Control Centre architectures. Familiarity with satellite databases, flight operations procedures, and system validation testing (SVT) concepts. Soft Skills: System-minded approach with strong analytical, synthesis, and problem-solving skills. High self-motivation, discipline, and a results-oriented mindset. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a strong capability for teamwork in complex, technical environments. Flexibility and adaptability to dynamic operational scenarios. Language & Mobility Requirements: Fluency in written and spoken English. Availability for business trips and support to shift work during critical operational phases (e.g., LEOP, Commissioning), if required WHAT WE OFFER Our Applicable Collective Labor Agreement is the CCNL for the Private Metalworking Industry and Plant Installation Sector . Working Arrangement: Hybrid / On-site . Employment Category: Employee . Contract Type: Permanent-term . 13th-month salary payment . Performance bonus linked to business results. Welfare Vouchers worth €250 per year. Meal Vouchers worth €9,00 per day, usable at the company canteen or for external expenses. items.title: Cloud Systems Analyst
items.card: Your role We are looking to recruit a Cloud Systems Analyst to work as a member of the Cloud Systems team in support of activities in all aspects related to the evolution, release, and deployment of our on-premises OpenStack and Proxmox Cloud environments. ECMWF provides high quality on-premises Cloud Computing services to its Member States and internal users by providing state-of-the-art compute and object storage
items.desc: Your role We are looking to recruit a Cloud Systems Analyst to work as a member of the Cloud Systems team in support of activities in all aspects related to the evolution, release, and deployment of our on-premises OpenStack and Proxmox Cloud environments. ECMWF provides high quality on-premises Cloud Computing services to its Member States and internal users by providing state-of-the-art compute and object storage resources available in close proximity to the meteorological data archive and the existing HPC facilities. The cloud services are based on two platforms, the Common Cloud Infrastructure (CCI) and the MCLOUD, both supported 24x7. The CCI service consists of two OpenStack Clusters with approximately ten-thousand cores and two CEPH storage clusters of approximately six petabytes each. On these systems ECMWF runs a number of operational services such as the European Weather Cloud (http://europeanweather.cloud) and the new version of the Copernicus Data Stores (http://cds.climate.copernicus.eu) as well as many other internal and external projects. The MCLOUD holds the virtual machines and processes that are critical to the delivery of our daily weather forecasts. The service is in the later stage of being migrated from vSphere to five Proxmox clusters. Both platforms provide services for a growing number of AI ecosystems, like Anemoi, MLflow services, AIFS Assistant, and several Member States and internal AI workloads. ECMWF is now looking for a qualified Cloud Systems Analyst to help support the Cloud platforms that power both services. ECMWF recognises that the role requires a broad skill set and offers training to help applicants develop any missing skills. Your responsibilities You will: Assist with the platform migration from vSphere to Proxmox Monitor, manage and optimize our on-premises Cloud solutions based on Proxmox and OpenStack, including CEPH and virtual networking, and optimize performance Collaborate with other sections and departments at ECMWF to ensure proper integration with our Cloud environments Use automation and AI tools to efficiently manage our Cloud environments Liaise with vendors, external partners and provide support to users for the collaborative support of our Clouds Work closely with Development teams in identifying and finding solutions to problems Participate in a 24/7 on-call system What we are looking for You will bring: Ability to communicate with and understand complex requirements Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, listening to and respecting the views of others Good analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach An interest in identifying, investigating and resolving technical problems The ability to work under pressure and with limited supervision The flexibility to adapt to changing organisational priorities and user needs Dedication and enthusiasm to work in a small team Your profile Education & Experience University degree, or equivalent, in a discipline related to IT, science or mathematics Strong background in Linux based systems Strong background in Proxmox, OpenStack, Ceph and/or other Cloud technologies is a strong requirement with demonstratable experience Experience with vSphere would be advantageous Experience in configuring and scripting automation tools such as Ansible and Terraform. Experience with monitoring/visualizing stacks like ELK, Grafana, Prometheus/InfluxDB, Fluentd or similar would be advantageous Understand the complexities of the underlying IP fabric and related technologies which power a high bandwidth system would be advantageous Understanding and deploying Kubernetes would be an asset. Experience with Veeam Backup and Recovery would be advantageous Basic experience running AI/ML workloads locally or on cloud platforms, like Ollama or LMStudio, GPU-enabled services, or managed AI platforms, including familiarity with MCP for managing infrastructure, would be advantageous Knowledge & Skills Training opportunities are available to support the development of needed skills Candidates must be able to work effectively in English and interviews will be conducted in English. A good knowledge of one of the Centre’s other working languages (French or German) is an advantage but not required If you feel that you have the motivation and many of the skills for this role but don't meet precisely all of the criteria listed above, we still encourage you to apply. About ECMWF The European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) is a world leader in Numerical Weather Predictions providing high-quality data for weather forecasts and environmental monitoring. As an intergovernmental organisation we collaborate internationally to serve our members and the wider community with global weather predictions, data and training activities that are critical to contribute to safe and thriving societies. The success of our activities depends on the funding and partnerships of our 35 Member and Co-operating States who …

items.desc: Onderzoeksmedewerker selectieve vangmethoden voor platvis Wil jij bijdragen aan innovatieve vistechnologie voor een selectieve en toekomstgerichte platvisvisserij? Functieomschrijving Als onderzoeksmedewerker ben je betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkeltraject: van het bedenken en ontwerpen van nieuwe concepten tot het testen en valideren van prototypes. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen: Uit het onderzoek ontstaat een conceptueel ontwerp, je maakt de vertaalslag van het onderzoeksidee naar een praktisch werkbare opstelling/experiment Experimenteren en testen: je bereidt de experimenten voor en voert ze uit met behulp van bestaande methoden en technieken Rapid prototyping en proof-of-principle: je ontwikkelt, ontwerpt, bouwt en test diverse opeenvolgende prototypes om de technische haalbaarheid van verschillende oplossingen aan te tonen. De aanpassingen aan het ontwerp worden samen met de betrokken wetenschappers uitgewerkt Je rapporteert de resultaten aan de onderzoekers betrokken bij het onderzoeksproject Prototypeontwikkeling op praktijkschaal: je ondersteunt binnen het project de ontwikkeling naar een minimum viable product (MVP) dat op ware grootte kan worden ingezet tijdens prototypetests in het Visinnovatiecentrum in Stellendam Je werkt nauw samen met een promovendus aan de TU Delft en de vakgroep Experimentele Zoölogie van Wageningen University & Research. Deze samenwerking biedt je de mogelijkheid om technische kennis en experimenteel onderzoek te combineren en bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van innovatieve en toekomstgerichte vismethoden. De functie is ondergebracht bij de vakgroep Maritieme en Transporttechnologie en wordt begeleid door Rudy Helmons en Geert Keetels. Functie-eisen Achtergrond in werktuigbouwkunde of een vergelijkbare opleiding Kennis en ervaring met gereedschap-zeebodem interactie is een pre Ervaring met (conceptueel) ontwerpen en het doen van experimenten is een pre Kan goed communiceren in zowel Nederlands als Engels TU Delft Werken bij TU Delft betekent bijdragen aan oplossingen die er echt toe doen. Al meer dan 180 jaar leiden we ingenieurs op die wereldwijd impact maken bij bedrijven, overheden of als ondernemer. Onze alumni zetten kennis om in concrete oplossingen voor de uitdagingen van vandaag en morgen. Die uitdagingen veranderen snel. Daarom werken we elke dag aan thema’s zoals energie, klimaat, digitalisering, AI en slimme mobiliteit. Ons onderwijs en onderzoek sluiten direct aan op wat de samenleving nodig heeft, nu en straks. Bij TU Delft maken mensen het verschil. Met hun kennis en nieuwsgierigheid zorgen zij voor sterk onderwijs, vernieuwend onderzoek en innovaties die verder komen dan de campus. Je krijgt de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, samen te werken en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Wie bij TU Delft werkt, sluit zich aan bij een internationale community van professionals en studenten. Samen bouwen we aan kennis, innovatie en oplossingen die de wereld vooruithelpen. Faculteit Mechanical Engineering Van chip tot schip. Van machine tot mens. Van idee naar oplossing. Vanuit de wil om de omgeving te begrijpen en te achterhalen welke mechanismen daaraan ten grondslag liggen, richten onderzoek en onderwijs zich op fundamenteel begrip, ontwerp, productie, toepassing en verbetering van producten, materialen, processen en (mechanische) systemen. De faculteit ME is een dynamische en innovatieve faculteit met een internationale scope en high-tech lab-faciliteiten. Omdat we zo groot en veelzijdig zijn, kunnen we unieke dwarsverbanden leggen en vakgebieden combineren. Dit vindt zijn weerslag in uitstekend en modern onderwijs dat studenten opleidt tot maatschappelijk betrokken en verantwoordelijke ingenieurs en onderzoekers. De kennis en inzichten die we opdoen, vertalen we in oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken, bijdragen aan een duurzame samenleving en aan de ontwikkeling van welvaart en welzijn. items.desc: Mechanical Engineer bij het Projecten team van JASA, wat doe je dan? Dan doe je veelzijdig, uitdagend, en bijzonder boeiend werk. Je vertaalt verpakkingswensen van de klant naar een compleet ontwerp, een weeg- en verpakkingslijn (en). Ook denk je mee aan een optimalisatie van een reeds bestaande verpakkingslijn en werkt je dit uit in een nieuw ontwerp.In het projecten team zijn de lijnen kort, je werkt samen met een team van medewerkers zoals bijvoorbeeld de sales engineers, accountmanagers en projectleiders. Dus dat jij een people person bent is een must. Jij bent de Mechanical Engineer met: Ervaring in de machinebouw, en je vindt dit werk nog steeds leuk!; 3-5 jaar werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie; Technisch inzicht om binnen prijs/kwaliteitsverhouding de juiste ontwerp keuzes te maken; Een afgeronde Werktuigbouwkunde opleiding, of een vergelijkbare afgeronde opleiding; HBO of universitair werk- en denkniveau; Je bent accuraat en initiatiefrijk; Ervaring met 3D Inventor of Solidworks is een pré; Een klantgerichte, enthousiaste en proactieve houding, je hebt er zin in!; Goede kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift. Waarom je Mechanical Engineer bij JASA wilt worden: Omdat werken bij JASA superleuk is; Je wilt meer redenen? Komt ‘ie: Je vervult een uitdagende functie in een succesvolle en dynamische organisatie, die internationaal opereert en zeer snel groeit. Oftewel, een grote vis in de verpakkingsvijver; JASA streeft naar een duurzame wereld, dus ook jij zal bijdragen aan het reduceren van plastic; Is stilstaan niet jouw ding? Dat komt goed uit, want binnen JASA kun je je eigen kwaliteiten blijven ontwikkelen, en zijn er veel doorgroeimogelijkheden. Wij geven je daar graag de ruimte voor! Vanzelfsprekend bieden wij jou uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden die in overeenstemming zijn met de functie, ervaring en leeftijd. Want wij vinden dat jij dat verdient; Heb jij je blik op de toekomst? Wij bieden een goede pensioenvoorziening (we volgen de CAO voor Kleinmetaal). Wie of wat is JASA nou eigenlijk? Onze vrienden noemen ons JASA, maar onze volledige naam is JASA Packaging Solutions, en wij zijn partner in verpakkingsoplossingen. Noem ons maar gewoon JASA. JASA staat voor innovatie, kwaliteit en flexibiliteit in verpakkingstechnologie. En zoals je misschien al wel gezien hebt op onze site, stoppen wij alles zo veel mogelijk in een duurzaam jasje. We zijn specialist in weegtechniek en in het ontwikkelen, vervaardigen, en (inter)nationaal verkopen van machines en verpakkingslijnen voor producten die jij altijd in de supermarkt ziet liggen, zoals maaltijdsalades, groentepakketten, appel schalen, fruit en aardappelen. Die tapasbakjes die je bij de supermarkt haalt voor bij de borrel? Yep, die worden ook gevuld op onze machines. Het team En wij vormen een mega enthousiast team waar jij echt héél goed in past. Al ruim 40 jaar bouwen wij verpakkingsmachines waarbij de focus ligt op hygiëne, efficiency, gebruiksgemak en service. En ja, de laatste paar jaar groeien wij double digit en heel internationaal. Dat vinden we allemaal super tof om te doen. Innovatie: onze road to happiness Net als jij staat JASA niet graag stil. Innovatie is onze weg en de belangrijkste pijler van onze groeistrategie. items.desc: Eindhoven | 32-40 uur | Data Science Bouw mee aan data science in een snel veranderende energiemarkt Hezelaer Energy groeit hard. Met die groei neemt ook de rol van data binnen onze organisatie steeds verder toe. Daarom bouwen we aan een sterk en professioneel Data Science-team dat de organisatie helpt om betere beslissingen te nemen en slimmer te werken. Binnen het team werken we onder andere aan forecasting, pricing, reporting en energy trading. Van het voorspellen van ontwikkelingen op de energiemarkt tot het ontwikkelen van modellen die commerciële en operationele beslissingen ondersteunen. Er is het afgelopen jaar al veel opgebouwd. Tegelijkertijd zijn we nog volop in ontwikkeling. We willen onze manier van werken verder professionaliseren, nieuwe toepassingen ontdekken en Data Science steeds beter laten aansluiten op de behoeften van de organisatie. Daarom zoeken we een Data Scientist die niet alleen graag met data, modellen en machine learning werkt, maar het ook interessant vindt om mee te bouwen aan een vakgebied dat binnen Hezelaer volop in beweging is. Wat ga je doen? Als Data Scientist werk je aan uiteenlopende Data Science-vraagstukken binnen Hezelaer Energy. De ene keer ontwikkel je een forecastingmodel voor de energiemarkt, de volgende keer onderzoek je hoe data kan helpen bij pricing of energy trading. Ook werk je aan vraagstukken vanuit Finance, Operations of Sales. Je werkt onder andere met Python, SQL, statistische modellering en machine learning. Afhankelijk van het vraagstuk gebruik je bijvoorbeeld predictive modelling, forecasting en tijdreeksanalyse om data om te zetten in bruikbare voorspellingen en inzichten. Je werkzaamheden kunnen daardoor behoorlijk verschillen. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan: Ontwikkelen, verbeteren en toepassen van Data Science- en machine learning-modellen; Ontwikkelen van forecastingmodellen en toepassen van tijdreeksanalyse; Werken aan vraagstukken rondom pricing en energy trading; Analyseren en verwerken van datasets met Python en SQL; Onderzoeken hoe predictive analytics en nieuwe AI-technieken waarde kunnen toevoegen; Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van rapportages en dashboards; Vertalen van data en analyses naar concrete inzichten en praktische toepassingen; Ondersteunen van collega's en teams bij datagedreven vraagstukken; Signaleren van kansen om processen en besluitvorming slimmer en meer datagedreven te maken; Samenwerken met IT, Finance, Operations, Sales, Trading en andere disciplines; Bijdragen aan het verder professionaliseren van Data Science binnen Hezelaer Energy. Je bent daarbij niet alleen bezig met de technische oplossing. Je probeert vooral te begrijpen welk probleem we willen oplossen, welke data daarvoor nodig is en hoe een model of analyse daadwerkelijk waarde kan toevoegen. Een Data-Science-team dat nog volop in ontwikkeling is Het Data Science-team maakt onderdeel uit van een organisatie die sterk groeit. Dat betekent dat we voortdurend in beweging zijn. We hebben de afgelopen periode al veel stappen gezet, maar we zijn er nog niet. We willen onze processen, technieken en manier van samenwerken verder ontwikkelen. Dat betekent dat je niet in een omgeving terechtkomt waarin alles al is bedacht en vastgelegd. Sommige vraagstukken zijn duidelijk. Andere moeten we samen nog ontdekken. Soms is vooraf niet precies duidelijk wat de beste oplossing is en verandert de vraag onderweg. Dat vinden we juist interessant! We zoeken daarom iemand die energie krijgt van die dynamiek. Iemand die het leuk vindt om zelf structuur aan te brengen, vragen te stellen, mogelijkheden te onderzoeken en samen met collega's tot een goede oplossing te komen. Met wie werk je? Data Science raakt binnen Hezelaer Energy steeds meer onderdelen van de organisatie. Je werkt daarom nauw samen met verschillende teams, waaronder IT, Trading, Finance, Operations en Sales. Je werkt met mensen die vanuit verschillende perspectieven naar een vraagstuk kijken. Jij brengt jouw kennis van data, analyses, modellen en machine learning mee en helpt collega's om data op een praktische manier in te zetten. Daarbij is het belangrijk dat je complexe materie kunt uitleggen aan mensen die niet dagelijks met Data Science bezig zijn. Je kunt de diepte in wanneer dat nodig is, maar weet ook wanneer een helder en praktisch antwoord belangrijker is dan een ingewikkeld model. Dit ben jij Je bent analytisch, nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken uit te pluizen. Je hoeft niet voor ieder probleem vooraf het antwoord te kennen. Je vindt het juist interessant om samen te onderzoeken wat werkt. Je werkt graag in een multidisciplinair Scrum-team en draagt actief bij aan refinement, planning en retrospectives. Daarnaast: Duik je graag in data en modellen; Ben je analytisch en conceptueel sterk; Werk je zelfstandig en neem je verantwoordelijkheid; Stel je vragen en bent niet bang om bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen; Vind je het leuk om nieuwe technieken, AI-toepassingen en mogelijkheden …

items.desc: Millions of people use Funda to find their next home. Behind every search, property listing and housing market insight lies an enormous amount of data. And that’s where you come in. As a Data Engineer at Funda, you turn complex data into reliable, well-structured data models. You help our teams make better decisions and contribute to data products that make life easier for homebuyers, sellers and real estate agents. You'll work with BigQuery, DBT, Python and GCP, building on our recently revamped data warehouse. Love a good SQL challenge? And enjoy making complex data surprisingly simple? Then you might just feel right at home with us. Your job in a nutshell You'll join our Core Data Team. Together, you'll make sure Funda's data is reliable, accessible and ready to use. We've recently rebuilt our data warehouse following the principles of Kimball dimensional modelling. Now it's time for the next step: expanding our data models, improving monitoring and developing new data products. Your work will provide the data that drives our strategic choices and product decisions, including those behind products like Waardecheck and Vraagscan. In doing so, you'll help people navigate one of the biggest decisions of their lives: buying or selling a home. And because you'll be part of a small team, your ideas won't get lost at the bottom of a backlog. You'll have plenty of ownership, room to experiment and a direct say in how we develop our data platform. What you'll be doing Build data models that actually make sense. You'll design, develop and maintain DBT models in BigQuery using Kimball star schemas, turning complex datasets into a reliable foundation for analysis. Make good data even better. You'll develop DBT macros, automated tests and monitoring to improve data quality, performance and reliability. And yes, that includes being able to prove the numbers really do add up. Keep the data flowing. You'll build and maintain ETL pipelines using Python, Airbyte and Azure, connecting different data sources to our data warehouse. Automate the smart way. You'll improve CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and manage job orchestration through Cloud Run, making our processes more efficient and reliable. Turn data into impact. You'll collaborate with data analysts and data scientists to unlock new insights, expand our analytics capabilities and develop machine learning pipelines. Your team You'll join the Core Data Team within Engineering, working closely with Data Engineer Esther Schrijer, Senior Data Scientist Edwin Thoen and Lead Service Owner Stephen Willems. We're a small, pragmatic team with a big love for data. We enjoy solving complex puzzles, bouncing ideas off each other and coming up with solutions that actually work in practice. Making things complicated just for the sake of it? Not really our style. We work in two-week sprints, with short daily stand-ups, regular refinement sessions and sprint reviews where everyone shares what they've been working on. You'll also collaborate closely with data analysts across our product teams. That way, you'll make sure the data you develop doesn't just sit neatly in our data warehouse, but actually gets put to good use. “We have so much interesting data, and I love bringing it all together and turning it into something valuable for our different users. Because we're a small team, we have a lot of freedom to decide what we work on. You can really take ownership from start to finish, from data ingestion to data modelling. And there's plenty of room to learn new things along the way.” Esther Schrijer, Data Engineer at Funda Why you'll love being a Data Engineer at Funda Data you won't find anywhere else. Funda has the most comprehensive dataset on housing demand in the Netherlands. That means you'll work with data that offers unique insights into how people search for properties, discover homes and ultimately choose their next place to call home. Build things people actually use. Your data models won't just sit somewhere in a data warehouse. They'll help our teams build better features and power products that provide valuable insights for sellers, real estate agents and home seekers. A modern platform, ready for your ideas. With our recently revamped, Kimball-based data warehouse, there's plenty of interesting work waiting for you. From developing new DBT models to improving our analytics macros and monitoring, you'll help shape the future of our data platform. Small team. Big impact. You'll have the freedom to improve the way we work, bring fresh perspectives and make important technical decisions. We love curious, pragmatic colleagues who enjoy figuring things out together. This is you You're a curious, detail-oriented Data Engineer who loves getting to the bottom of how things work. You appreciate well-structured data models, reliable pipelines and the little details that make sure the data really does add up. You also know that great data engineering is about more than just …

items.desc: Business Developer - Credits Data Domain (Hay 10) At a glance At ABN AMRO, our strategy is to be a personal bank in the digital age. We provide a fully digital banking experience while maintaining strong personal relationships with our clients. Reliable, high-quality credit data is essential to making informed lending decisions and supporting our customers when it matters most. We are looking for a highly motivated and solution-oriented Business Developer to join the Credits Data Domain Store (CDDS) department within Financing Solutions. Within CDDS, the Task Force team acts as the operational backbone of the department, supporting all other CDDS teams in maintaining stable, reliable, and efficient credits data. In this role, you will work in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same. You will investigate production issues, support releases, analyze incidents, resolve real-time data problems, and help prevent future disruptions. You will combine analytical thinking, business understanding, technical knowledge, and stakeholder management skills to ensure the continuity and quality of critical credit data services across the bank. Your job As a Business Developer within the CDDS Task Force team, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, coordinating, and resolving complex operational and data-related challenges. You thrive on investigating unknown situations, asking the right questions, and driving structural improvements that strengthen our services and data products. Your responsibilities will include: Supporting the daily operations of all CDDS teams by coordinating and resolving production incidents, data issues, and platform disruptions. Investigating complex production problems and performing root cause analyses to identify sustainable long-term solutions. Monitoring and managing real-time issues, ensuring timely resolution while minimizing impact on data consumers and business processes. Coordinating production releases and deployment activities, ensuring smooth implementation and successful delivery. Working closely with data engineers, architects, product owners, and business stakeholders to diagnose issues and implement corrective actions. Taking ownership of escalations, managing stakeholder expectations, and providing clear and timely communication during incidents. Challenging existing processes, identifying improvement opportunities, and proposing structural enhancements to increase platform stability and efficiency. Analyzing the impact of incidents and changes across the credit data landscape while considering long-term business and technical consequences. Supporting testing activities, validation, and release readiness to ensure high-quality data products and services. Driving continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen operational excellence, resilience, and customer satisfaction. Supporting the lifecycle management of CDDS data products, including analyzing the impact of source system changes, updating mappings and transformations, coordinating decommissioning activities, and ensuring data products remain accurate, compliant, and fit for purpose. By contributing to these activities, you will play a critical role in ensuring the stability, continuity, and future development of ABN AMRO’s credit data landscape. Working environment The CDDS plays a central role in delivering high-quality credit data across the bank. CDDS enables a wide range of business processes, regulatory reporting activities, analytics solutions, and lending decisions by ensuring that critical credit data is available, accurate, and consistent. The Task Force team operates across all CDDS teams and serves as a central support and coordination team. We assist other teams with production incidents, operational challenges, release support, defect resolution, and continuous improvements. Because of this unique position, the team has broad visibility across the entire credit data landscape and collaborates with a diverse stakeholder network throughout the organization. We operate in a dynamic and challenging environment where priorities can change quickly and new issues may emerge unexpectedly. Success requires curiosity, resilience, teamwork, and a proactive mindset. We encourage individuals to explore, challenge assumptions, learn continuously, and take ownership of outcomes. Our team consists of experienced professionals with diverse backgrounds who enjoy solving complex problems together. We value collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovation while maintaining a supportive and enjoyable working atmosphere. We work in an international environment with English as our primary working language and follow a hybrid working model with regular collaboration at our Amsterdam headquarters. items.desc: Business Developer - ALM Grid At a glance Do you thrive on solving complex challenges at the intersection of business and IT? Are you skilled at translating stakeholder needs into practical IT solutions, influencing decisions, and driving successful delivery? Then this opportunity at ABN AMRO may be the right fit for you. We are looking for a proactive Business Developer to join the Asset & Liability Management (ALM) Grid. ALM is responsible for managing the bank's balance sheet, including interest rate & liquidity risk, and funds transfer pricing (FTP). The ALM Grid supports this mission by delivering the data, tools, and technology needed for informed decision-making and risk management. In this role, you will work with a multidisciplinary Agile DevOps team to enhance ALM data processes and applications, delivering insights and reporting to stakeholders ranging from senior management and business units to regulators. Your job As a Business Developer in IRR, you act as an investigator who carries out thorough analysis, understands products and risk metrics. You translate complex ALM challenges and business requirements into practical, value-driven solutions. You work on multiple projects where you initiate, improve, and implement the processes, systems and data. items.desc: Medior Data Analyst / Data Modeler (Credit & Collateral Data) At a glance At ABN AMRO, we're building the future of lending through data. As we continue our journey to become a personal bank in the digital age, high-quality credit and collateral data is more important than ever. It powers lending decisions, strengthens risk management, supports regulatory compliance, and enables innovation across the bank. We're looking for a Medior Data Analyst / Data Modeler to join the Credits Data Domain Store (CDDS) within Financing Solutions. This is an opportunity to work on some of the bank's most strategic data initiatives and play a key role in shaping the Credit & Collateral Data Products that enable smarter lending decisions, stronger risk management, and sustainable growth across the bank. If you enjoy solving complex data challenges, influencing business change, and working with stakeholders across business and technology, this role offers the ownership, visibility, and impact you're looking for. Your job As a Medior Data Analyst / Data Modeler, you will be at the heart of ABN AMRO's credit data landscape. You won't simply gather requirements or create models; you'll help drive strategic change by turning business ambitions into trusted data products that enable better decisions throughout the bank. You will: Take ownership of high-impact data initiatives within the Credit & Collateral domain. Translate business challenges into scalable, future-proof data solutions. Work on strategic programs such as Definition of Default (DoD), Significant Risk Transfer (SRT), Early Warning Models (EWM), and NextGen Lending. Partner with business stakeholders, architects, engineers, and risk specialists to deliver business value through data. Analyse complex datasets, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive data quality enhancements. Shape and maintain the Credits Business Data Model (CBDM), ensuring consistency, traceability, and regulatory compliance. Support the development of advanced analytics and AI use cases by providing reliable and well-governed credit data. Lead initiatives from idea to implementation, including analysis, design, testing, and release activities. You will have the autonomy to drive multiple initiatives simultaneously while helping define how Credit & Collateral Data Products evolve within ABN AMRO. Working environment You will join the Credits Data Domain Store, a team with a clear mission: creating trusted Credit & Collateral Data Products that support lending, risk management, regulatory reporting, and capital optimisation across the bank. Our environment combines the pace of a large-scale digital transformation with the complexity of a highly regulated banking domain. You will collaborate with professionals from Financing Solutions, Risk, Data Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, and AI. What makes this role particularly exciting is the combination of: Strategic visibility across the bank. Direct impact on key lending and risk processes. Exposure to senior stakeholders and decision makers. A modern data environment focused on innovation and continuous improvement. Opportunities to deepen both your banking expertise and your technical data skills. You'll be part of a team that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and the courage to challenge the status quo. Your profile You are an analytical professional who enjoys connecting business objectives with data-driven solutions. You understand that data is not the goal itself, but a powerful enabler for better decisions and better customer outcomes. We're looking for someone who brings: Professional Experience 3-7 years of experience in Data Analysis, Business Analysis, Data Modelling, or a related discipline. Experience working within banking, lending, risk management, or another complex financial environment. Strong SQL skills and the ability to independently analyse large datasets. Experience with conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling. Understanding of data integration, ETL processes, and data quality management. Experience with testing, implementation, and release activities. Familiarity with Databricks, JSON, and modern data platforms is a strong advantage. Banking & Credit Expertise Strong understanding of lending processes and credit risk management. Knowledge of Credit & Collateral products and their lifecycle. Understanding of how data supports regulatory reporting, risk monitoring, and business decision-making. Experience working in complex stakeholder environments where business and technology come together. Personal Skills You take ownership and enjoy driving topics from idea to delivery. You can easily switch between strategic discussions and detailed analysis. You are comfortable challenging assumptions and asking the right questions. You communicate effectively with both technical specialists and senior business stakeholders. You thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities evolve and continuous …

items.desc: About this position Do you want to contribute to innovations that make the Netherlands smarter, more sustainable, and future-proof? As a Project Controller at TNO, you play a key role in a wide range of projects within the Services Organisation. You are more than a financial professional. You are a trusted sparring partner for project leaders, researchers, and managers. Through your advice, you help project teams turn ideas into tangible results. The profession is evolving rapidly. Digitalisation, data analytics, and AI are transforming the way we work and make decisions. At TNO, you will have the opportunity not only to follow these developments but also to help shape them. You will contribute to new ways of working, smart solutions, and the further development of project control within an innovative knowledge organisation. We are also committed to your personal growth. Whether you want to advance as a controller, deepen your expertise, or broaden your skill set, TNO offers the freedom, guidance, and training to help you achieve your ambitions. What will be your role? Within the departments CREF, IS, and Strategic Investments, significant (strategic) investments are made, creating a need for closer and more professional project monitoring. As a Project Controller, you support a broad portfolio of innovative research and development projects. You work closely with project leaders and help them stay in control of the financial aspects of their projects. You advise on budgets, project performance, and the financial implications of decisions. In addition, you review project proposals, quotations, cost calculations, and contracts. You identify opportunities and risks at an early stage and translate financial information into clear, practical insights that colleagues can act on immediately. You look beyond individual projects and focus on the bigger picture, creating value not only for today’s projects but also for tomorrow’s developments. Alongside your project responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the further professionalisation of Finance & Control within TNO. This includes improving processes, developing management information, and applying new technologies such as data analytics and AI. It is a varied and challenging role. You will focus on projects within the Services Organisation and be responsible for a portfolio of approximately 80 projects. You will oversee monitoring, analysis, and reporting within the Project Fitness system. As this is a relatively new approach within the Services Organisation, you will have plenty of opportunity to contribute your ideas, shape the way forward, and truly pioneer new practices. Your office location is The Hague (AvB). As a Project Controller within the Services Organisation, you will join an experienced, collaborative, and professional team. You will work closely with five direct colleagues and report to the Manager Corporate Control. Together, you will act as the financial conscience of the organisation. What we expect from you You are a confident and analytically strong professional who quickly distinguishes between main and secondary issues and effortlessly switches between different topics, interests, and priorities. In a complex environment with peaks in workload and tight deadlines, you are able to identify risks early and provide proactive advice. As a valued sparring partner, you build strong and lasting relationships and earn the trust of project leaders, researchers, and managers. Thanks to your organisational awareness, communication skills, and broad perspective, you connect different interests and make financial topics understandable for a wide range of stakeholders. You are conceptually strong, able to connect projects, business objectives, and TNO’s strategic ambitions, and you thrive in an environment where innovation, digitalisation, data analytics, and AI play an increasingly important role. You are also accurate, proactive, and enjoy solving complex puzzles, enabling you to make a meaningful contribution to both content-driven and process-related improvements. You also bring: A completed bachelor's degree (HBO) in Business Economics, Accountancy, Controlling, or a related field. At least 2 years of experience in a (project) control position, preferably within a complex, project-based environment. Affinity with digitalisation, data-driven decision-making, and emerging technologies that make the finance and control profession smarter and more effective. Preferably knowledge of SAP and Power BI. What you'll get in return Challenging and varied work with a real impact. And plenty of opportunities as, at TNO, you are in charge of shaping your career. We offer a gross monthly salary between € 3,530 and € 4,100 (based on your knowledge and experience), 8% holiday pay, a 13th month bonus of 8.33% and a flex budget (5.58% + € 180). In addition, you will be given every opportunity to develop yourself. TNO offers optional employee …

Sascha Krause, Team Manager, Sascha.Krause@kongsberg.com About KONGSBERG KONGSBERG protects people and critical infrastructure – from deep sea to space. We deliver advanced ocean and space technologies – from autonomous marine systems to satellites and data services – supporting sustainability, climate monitoring, infrastructure protection, and security. KONGSBERG also develop innovative technologies for defence, security, and surveillance markets, combining military and civilian expertise. Our defence and security solutions span missiles, weapon stations, air defence, command and control, and digital towers. Today, we have more than 7,500 employees in about 20 countries. The company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and the Norwegian government controls about 50.01 percent of the shares. About Discovery The Discovery division develops technologies for sustainable ocean resource management, climate monitoring, critical infrastructure protection, and national security. Its technology platforms and solutions support offshore operations, fisheries, ocean research, maritime operations, sea-based energy production, and naval defence. Products include sonars, underwater communication equipment, satellites, surveillance and positioning systems, and autonomous vehicles. Customers span offshore, fisheries, marine research, maritime, energy, surveillance, defence, and naval sectors. Du besøker forhandlere, bygger nye kunderelasjoner og hjelper butikkene med å lykkes med salget. Rollen kombinerer aktivt salgsarbeid med oppfølging av sortiment og produkter. Du vil blant annet: Øke salget hos eksisterende forhandlere og etablere nye kunder og salgskanaler. Presentere kolleksjoner og lære opp butikkmedarbeidere. Følge opp sortiment, priser, produktinformasjon og varetilgjengelighet. Samarbeide tett med Beretta i Italia og delta på kolleksjonsgjennomganger og messer. Du dekker hele Norge, med Kløfta som base. Kundebesøk og reising med overnatting er en naturlig del av jobben. Du trives med salg og kundeutvikling Vi ser etter deg som har erfaring med salg og kundeutvikling, gjerne mot forhandlere innen klær, sport, friluftsliv eller arbeidsklær. Du kan vise til resultater og forstår hva som skal til for at en butikk både tar inn produktene og lykkes med å selge dem videre. Relevant butikkbakgrunn med tydelig salgsansvar kan også være et godt utgangspunkt. Du tar initiativ, liker å oppsøke kunder og følger opp det du lover. Du holder innsatsen oppe også når salget tar tid, og planlegger godt nok til å håndtere både kundemøtene og produktarbeidet mellom besøkene. Du kommuniserer godt på norsk og engelsk. Rozwijamy się dzięki ludziom i dobrym relacjom. Tworzymy przyjazną atmosferę, wymieniamy się wiedzą i… lubimy ze sobą pracować. Działamy odpowiedzialnie. Dbamy o naszych klientów, pracowników i lokalne społeczności – to dla nas bardzo ważne. Jakie będą Twoje zadania? Sprzedawanie produktów bankowych oraz wyjaśnianie klientom ich cech i standardowych warunków. Rozpoznawanie potrzeb klientów, aktywne słuchanie i dopasowywanie produktów bankowych. Wspieranie klientów w codziennym bankowaniu, odpowiadanie na pytania, rozwiązywanie problemów oraz obsługa zapytań i reklamacji. Wprowadzanie klientów w świat bankowości mobilnej i internetowej . Budowanie relacji z klientami i dbanie o najwyższą jakość obsługi podczas każdej rozmowy. Aktualizowanie danych klientów w systemie CRM po każdym kontakcie. Realizowanie powierzonych zadań zgodnie z wymaganymi standardami jakości i terminowości. Przestrzeganie polityk, procedur i przepisów dotyczących wykonywanej pracy. Rozwijanie wiedzy i umiejętności. Do jakiego zespołu dołączysz? Jako Doradczyni/Doradca Junior ds. Obsługi Klienta wzmocnisz zespół Centrum Kontaktu z Klientem – odpowiadamy w nim za różne formy rozmów z klientem, zarówno te tradycyjne, jak i bardziej nowoczesne (chat, narzędzia AI). Tutaj będziesz mieć przestrzeń na zdobywanie doświadczenia i uczenie się wśród specjalistek i specjalistów – wiemy, jak ważna jest praktyczna nauka. Zbudujesz solidne podstawy kariery w stabilnej organizacji i zdobędziesz praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy z klientem. Dobrze odnajdziesz się w tej roli, jeśli: lubisz realizować cele i motywują Cię wyniki sprzedażowe i jakościowe; chcesz poszerzać swoją wiedzę; mówisz wyraźnie i potrafisz dopasować styl komunikacji do rozmówcy; lubisz rozmawiać przez telefon i jesteś osobą komunikatywną; masz minimum średnie wykształcenie; pasuje Ci praca w systemie zmianowym (również w weekendy i święta). Co pomoże Ci osiągnąć sukces w tej roli? #Zorientowanie na klienta Rozumiesz potrzeby klientów i tworzysz rozwiązania, które na nie odpowiadają. #Odpowiedzialność za wyniki Bierzesz odpowiedzialność za realizację zobowiązań i osiągane rezultaty. #Skuteczna komunikacja Przekazujesz informacje jasno i dbasz o wzajemne zrozumienie. Co oferujemy Tobie w zamian? Umowę o pracę w stabilnym miejscu , które daje przestrzeń na długofalową współpracę opartą na zaufaniu. System wynagradzania, który obejmuje wynagrodzenie stałe oraz premie sprzedażowe i jakościowe. Pracę hybrydową – po 3 miesiącach wdrożenia, obejmuje 2 dni w tygodniu w biurze i 3 dni pracy zdalnej. Kompleksowe wdrożenie - dni adaptacyjne w centrali we Wrocławiu, szkolenia, programy rozwojowe i jasną ścieżkę kariery. Realne możliwości rozwoju wewnątrz banku oraz w strukturach Grupy Credit Agricole w Polsce. Inicjatywy pracownicze – rozwojowe, charytatywne, wellbeingowe i sportowe. Zależy nam, by wspierać dobre samopoczucie zespołu i robić razem coś dobrego. Otwarte i różnorodne środowisko pracy , w którym cenimy Twoją autentyczność. Twój rozwój W naszej organizacji masz realny wpływ na tempo swojej kariery. Oferujemy Ci: transparentną ścieżkę awansu – jasne kryteria, które określają każdy etap Twojego rozwoju; tempo rozwoju, które zależy od Ciebie – Twoje wyniki sprzedażowe i jakość pracy bezpośrednio przekładają się na kolejne kroki w strukturze banku; wsparcie na każdym etapie – od kompleksowego wdrożenia na starcie, po przygotowanie do roli eksperckiej lub menedżerskiej; praktyczne kompetencje – rozwiniesz się w zakresie profesjonalnych negocjacji, technik sprzedaży oraz budowania relacji biznesowych. Prywatna opieka medyczna Klub Korzyści (zniżki i oferty specjalne z kontem w Credit Agricole) Karta Multisport 5 dodatkowych dni wolnych w roku na wolontariat

items.desc: IT Business Analyst (C-CLIPS Team) ABOUT THE JOB We are currently forming a new team in Warsaw that will be responsible for one the core global systems within BNP CIB. We will be developing a new application that aims to serve as the global platform for managing cash position incorporating latest AI tools available. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Collaboration with the global team responsible for the overall system roadmap to align local development with long-term strategic goals. Partnership with business stakeholders to analyse complex processes and translate business needs into detailed functional specifications. Designing high-level roadmaps categorized by system components and development streams. Acting as the key interface between business stakeholders and the delivery team, presenting functional requirements and resolving ambiguities to ensure seamless execution. Preparing comprehensive, high-quality documentation for both end-users and IT Support. Participation in the full rollout lifecycle, from strategic deployment planning to the delivery of user training. PROFILE & SKILLS Experience in a Business Analyst role, preferably within a complex corporate or financial environment. Strong capability in process analysis, synthesis, and the design of robust support systems. Good presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively to audiences of various sizes and levels of seniority. Deep understanding of the Scrum methodology and the software development lifecycle (SDLC). A solid understanding of front-end and back-end software development technologies, as well as UX/UI usability principles. Fluency in English is mandatory, as all project communication and documentation are conducted in English. A foundational knowledge of, and a willingness to leverage, AI tools WHAT WE OFFER: Hybrid work mode, 50% working from home within a month Equivalent for remote work expenses (120 PLN per month) Stable employment in the international company Fully paid private medical care for employee Pre-paid lunch card Employee Pension Plan Co-financed Multisport Card MyBenefit Cafeteria Platform Life insurance Car parking availability in the office building Trainings and development opportunities Starts on a fixed‑term contract; later possibility to change to permanent. WHY JOIN BNP PARIBAS? We are BNP Paribas S.A. (Branch in Poland), a part of BNP Paribas Group with 200years of experience in banking. Since 2008, we are at the heart of Warsaw, and now we are also in Krakow. As Corporate and Institutional Banking(CIB), we offer financial solutions for corporate and institutional clients in a number of locations globally. Our Securities Services business line is a multi-asset servicing specialist. We are an exciting, dynamic, and growing operations centre; therefore, we are looking for candidates who are willing to be a vital part of the expansion of BNP Paribas’ operational scope in Poland. It’s our values that drive us forward and are a cornerstone of our business. We rely on our strengths, which include stability, responsibility, expertise, and being a good place to work. READY TO MAKE A DIFFERENCE? RECRUITMENT PROCESS HR screening call – 15 min Technical interview with the hiring manager and future teammates Final interview with HR Offer & onboarding Recruitment process may differ depending on the position. If the offer sounds interesting to you - please be invited to apply with your resume in English.

items.desc: Dołącz do jednego z największych zespołów procesowych obsługujących sektor finansowy w Polsce. Nasz zespół liczy ponad 80 prawników i prowadzi kilkanaście tysięcy postępowań sądowych na rzecz czołowych banków oraz instytucji finansowych. Reprezentujemy klientów zarówno w sprawach masowych, dotyczących m.in. kredytów CHF, WIBOR, sankcji kredytu darmowego, jak i w najbardziej wymagających sporach precedensowych dotyczących zagadnień istotnych dla sektora finansowego. Poszukujemy radcy prawnego, adwokata lub aplikanta z doświadczeniem procesowym, który chce rozwijać się w obszarze sporów cywilnych oraz mieć realny wpływ na sposób prowadzenia powierzonych spraw. Cenimy doświadczenie w pracy przy projektach obejmujących znaczącą liczbę postępowań sądowych, wymagających dobrej organizacji pracy, umiejętności priorytetyzacji oraz współpracy w ramach wyspecjalizowanego zespołu procesowego. Jeżeli swobodnie poruszasz się w procedurze cywilnej, umiesz budować argumentację procesową, cenisz samodzielność i lubisz występować przed sądem, zapraszamy do udziału w rekrutacji. Zakres obowiązków samodzielne prowadzenie spraw sądowych, w tym postępowań złożonych i o wysokiej wartości przedmiotu sporu (od kilkuset tysięcy do kilkudziesięciu milionów złotych), współtworzenie i realizacja strategii procesowej, sporządzanie pism procesowych i opinii prawnych, reprezentowanie klientów podczas rozpraw i posiedzeń sądowych, analiza akt sprawy, przepisów prawa oraz aktualnego orzecznictwa bieżący kontakt z klientami kancelarii, dbanie o wysoką jakość merytoryczną i terminową realizację prowadzonych spraw, współpraca z innymi członkami zespołu przy realizacji powierzonych projektów. Mile widziane: doświadczenie w sporach dotyczących kredytów CHF, WIBOR, sankcji kredytu darmowego (SKD), lub innych sporach pomiędzy instytucjami finansowymi a konsumentami, doświadczenie w prowadzeniu postępowań apelacyjnych i kasacyjnych, doświadczenie w sprawach o wysokiej wartości przedmiotu sporu.
