items.desc: W Redge Technologies tworzymy innowacyjne rozwiązania w obszarze wideo streamingu oraz cyberbezpieczeństwa. Należymy do grupy Play, będącej częścią francuskiej grupy telekomunikacyjnej Iliad. Specjalizujemy się w technologiach chmurowych, wysokiej skalowalności, sieciach i programowaniu niskopoziomowym. Nasz flagowy produkt, Redge Media, to platforma technologiczna dla telewizji internetowej, wybierana przez globalnych nadawców i operatorów telekomunikacyjnych, takich jak TVN Warner Bros. Discovery, Grupa Play, TVP, Canal+, Go3 czy Wirtualna Polska. Nasze rozwiązania są wdrażane przez czołowych graczy w Europie, na Bliskim Wschodzie oraz w Ameryce Południowej, co daje możliwość zdobycia doświadczenia w międzynarodowym środowisku. Z uwagi na globalny charakter naszych działań, czasem dostosowujemy harmonogram pracy do stref czasowych naszych partnerów, co wymaga elastyczności, ale jednocześnie otwiera drzwi do ciekawych wyzwań i rozwoju zawodowego. Jeśli cenisz różnorodność, dynamikę i chcesz pracować na globalną skalę, dołącz do nas – porozmawiajmy o możliwościach! Zakres obowiązków Wspieramy zespoły deweloperskie we wdrażaniu, utrzymaniu i rozwoju rozwiązań działających w środowiskach on-premises w obszarach CDN, Origin, NPVR oraz kodowania wideo. Zapewniamy również wsparcie w zakresie wdrażania i utrzymania usług DNS klasy operatorskiej (Telco-grade DNS). Wymagania Znajomość systemów Linux. Znajomość podstaw dowolnego języka skryptowego (Bash, Python) Znajomość podstaw Git i kontroli wersji. Podstawowa orientacja w zagadnieniach sieciowych (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP(s)). Chęć nauki i rozwoju w obszarze zarządzania infrastrukturą AWS. Umiejętność samodzielnego rozwiązywania problemów i szukania informacji. Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie B2 lub wyższym. Mile widziane Podstawowa znajomość SQL i relacyjnych baz danych. Doświadczenie z konteneryzacją (Docker). Wiedza o CI/CD (Ansible, GitLab lub podobne). Ukończone kursy lub certyfikaty z zakresu Linux, DevOps. Oferujemy Indywidualny Budżet Szkoleniowy - Inwestujemy w Twoją wiedzę! 5 000 PLN brutto rocznie masz do wykorzystania na to, co przybliża Cię do celu: kursy, konferencje, certyfikaty, platformy e-learningowe czy dofinansowanie do nauki języków obcych. items.desc: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: T&E Hub Lead __ In this role, you will have the opportunity to ensure day-to-day processing of functional Travel and Expenses requests while handling both complex and escalated tasks. Each day, you will guarantee support to internal/ external customers and timely processing of information for all stakeholders. You will also showcase your expertise by delivering assigned T&E services in compliance with all procedures/policies that are in place and as per the defined Service Level Agreements. The work model for the role is: hybrid. You will be mainly accountable for: Auditing employee expense reports to ensure accuracy and compliance with Travel & Expenses (T&E) policies, identifying discrepancies, investigating audit-related issues, and supporting their resolution. Providing ad hoc guidance to employees on expense management systems and T&E policies, supporting resolution of inquiries and complaints through email and chat in a timely and professional manner, while ensuring effective customer service. Recommending process improvements and simplifications based on operational feedback and customer experience, while performing regular quality checks to improve team performance and ensure compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Supporting the optimization of expense management systems, supporting T&E operations during mergers and acquisitions, including system configuration and policy alignment. Collaborating with reporting and analytics teams to assemble and summarize data, prepare reports, and share findings, analyses, and recommendations with relevant stakeholders. Qualifications for the role: You have practical experience using MS Office applications; familiarity with SAP Concur, AI based tools or similar T&E management systems would be considered an advantage. You have knowledge of business administration, accounting, or finance. A relevant university degree would be considered an advantage but is not mandatory. You are comfortable communicating fluently in Business English (C1), both written and spoken, in an international professional environment. You demonstrate a customer-focused approach, with effective communication skills and the ability to respond to inquiries and resolve issues in a timely manner. Previous experience in a corporate environment, particularly in finance and/or Travel & Expenses services, would be considered an advantage. You enjoy collaborating with others and working in cross-functional, international teams, while ensuring tasks are completed within agreed deadlines. You have well-developed organizational and time management skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Your benefits: Enjoy a stable employment in a company with a long history in innovation and technology. Collaborate with experienced experts in an international environment. Seize individual development and training opportunities, from job specific to soft skills. Private medical care (including offers for family members) and life insurance. Receive attractive remuneration based on your experience and skills, and other financial benefits, such as annual bonus and internal share purchase program. Choose from various benefits in kind, ranging from healthy lifestyle offerings, to knowledge sharing, to teambuilding activities. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Projektowanie nowych i optymalizacja istniejących procesów, m.in. w obszarze współpracy z detalistami, obsługi sklepów i wsparcia sprzedaży. Prowadzenie wyodrębnionych obszarów projektów transformacyjnych – od rozpoznania problemu i zaprojektowania rozwiązania po jego wdrożenie i ocenę efektów. Analizowanie danych i wskaźników biznesowych oraz przygotowywanie rekomendacji zmian w oparciu o ich przewidywany wpływ na efektywność, koszty i jakość procesów. Przygotowywanie wymagań biznesowych i funkcjonalnych oraz współpraca z IT i dostawcami przy wdrażaniu nowych rozwiązań, w tym prowadzenie testów i odbiorów. Współpraca z interesariuszami na różnych poziomach organizacji, uzgadnianie rozwiązań i egzekwowanie realizacji przyjętych ustaleń. Identyfikowanie możliwości automatyzacji procesów i przekazywanie odpowiednio przygotowanych wymagań do zespołu AI/R&D. Monitorowanie rezultatów wdrożonych zmian, inicjowanie kolejnych usprawnień oraz aktualizowanie dokumentacji procesowej. DOŁĄCZ DO NASZEGO ZESPOŁU, JEŚLI: Masz minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w projektowaniu, optymalizacji lub transformacji procesów biznesowych w obszarze sprzedaży, obsługi sieci handlowych lub współpracy z detalistami. Masz doświadczenie w realizacji złożonych projektów transformacyjnych lub optymalizacyjnych, zdobyte w dużych organizacjach, firmach doradczych lub projektach o porównywalnej skali i złożoności. Samodzielnie odpowiadałeś/aś za wyodrębniony obszar projektu – od zidentyfikowania problemu i zaprojektowania rozwiązania po jego wdrożenie i ocenę rezultatów. Bardzo dobrze rozumiesz specyfikę procesów sprzedażowych i potrafisz samodzielnie identyfikować obszary wymagające zmian, zamiast jedynie realizować wcześniej przygotowane założenia. Masz na swoim koncie skutecznie wdrożone usprawnienia procesowe i potrafisz przedstawić ich konkretne, mierzalne efekty biznesowe. Potrafisz analizować dane, interpretować wskaźniki i uzasadniać rekomendacje liczbami, uwzględniając również przewidywane skutki proponowanych zmian. Masz praktyczne doświadczenie w mapowaniu i doskonaleniu procesów, np. z wykorzystaniem BPMN, Swimlane, VSM, SIPOC lub metodyk Lean, Kaizen i DMAIC. Potrafisz przekładać potrzeby biznesowe na wymagania funkcjonalne, współpracować z zespołami wdrożeniowymi i dostawcami oraz uczestniczyć w testach i odbiorach rozwiązań. Łączysz strategiczne spojrzenie na biznes ze sprawczością projektową, samodzielnością i konsekwencją w doprowadzaniu zmian do końca. Potrafisz przekonywać do swoich rekomendacji, prowadzić wymagające uzgodnienia i skutecznie współpracować z interesariuszami reprezentującymi różne obszary organizacji. Posiadasz wykształcenie wyższe i znasz język angielski na poziomie umożliwiającym korzystanie z dokumentacji technicznej. Jesteś gotowy/a do pracy hybrydowej oraz wizyt w sklepach i innych lokalizacjach biznesowych. Mile widziane: Doświadczenie w projektach transformacyjnych obejmujących rozbudowane sieci sprzedaży, w szczególności retail lub franczyzę. Doświadczenie w automatyzacji procesów sprzedażowych, np. z wykorzystaniem modeli językowych LLM. MAMY DLA CIEBIE: Realny wpływ na sposób funkcjonowania sprzedaży w Grupie Eurocash – możliwość projektowania zmian w procesach obsługujących sieć kilkunastu tysięcy sklepów Udział w budowaniu nowego zespołu transformacji procesów E2E – przestrzeń do proponowania rozwiązań i kształtowania standardów pracy. Odpowiedzialność za konkretne rezultaty biznesowe – od pomysłu i rekomendacji po wdrożenie oraz pomiar osiągniętych efektów. Współpracę z zespołem AI/R&D – możliwość wykorzystania nowych technologii do automatyzacji i usprawniania procesów sprzedażowych. Bliską współpracę z biznesem i obszarem cyfryzacji oraz możliwość realizowania zmian o znaczeniu dla całej organizacji. Hybrydowy model pracy, łączący pracę zdalną, biurową i bezpośredni kontakt z procesami w terenie. Umowę o pracę lub B2B. Benefity dopasowane do Twoich potrzeb. items.desc: Do you want to own how a bank secures the way its people work? At Avarda you get the mandate to design, enforce and improve the security of our laptops, mobile devices and Microsoft 365 identities. You will work hands-on with Intune, Defender, Entra ID and Sentinel, across Windows, macOS, iOS and Android, in a regulated environment with high demands on security and compliance. You will join the Workplace team in IT Operations, together with the IT Helpdesk, and work side by side with the rest of the operations team, our Security Engineer for infrastructure and our SOC partner. You will be the person who sets the security baseline for the workplace and the go-to person when security and workplace questions meet. About Avarda Avarda is an internet-based niche bank offering consumer banking and e-commerce solutions through our own highly automated IT platform. Our business spans Consumer Lending, E-commerce Solutions and Credit Cards, and we serve private individuals in 14 countries: Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, Germany, Austria, Ireland, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain. We are growing fast, and so is the scope and complexity of what we need to protect. What you will own Endpoint security. Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies and security baselines, and device deployment with Windows Autopilot, across Windows, macOS, iOS and Android, including mobile device and app management. Microsoft 365 security. Entra ID, Conditional Access and Defender for Endpoint and Office 365, together with security settings in Exchange Online, SharePoint and Teams. Threat detection and response. Detection, investigation and response on clients together with our SOC partner, using Microsoft Defender and Sentinel. Data protection. DLP and information protection, including security evaluation of new AI tools before they reach our users. Vulnerability management. Vulnerability scanning and follow-up of penetration test findings for the workplace environment, driven through to resolution. Support and escalation. 2nd line escalation point for the IT Helpdesk on security and workplace issues, and a trusted contact for other teams with IT Operations questions. Also part of the role Supporting the security of our server and cloud environment, Group Policy and privileged access (PIM/PAM), as well as documentation, security policies, audits, and our Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity work. You will have plenty of opportunity to shape how we do things. If you see a smarter or safer way to work, we want to hear it. Your future team You will be part of the Workplace team, which runs our workplace environment and IT Helpdesk as a part of IT Operations. You will work daily with the Helpdesk and with the rest of the operations team, who own our global infrastructure and services. Together with the Security Engineer working with infrastructure, you form the core of our security engineering: you own the workplace side, they own the infrastructure side. You will also work with our SOC provider and external security partners. It is a hands-on, collaborative environment where knowledge-sharing makes everyone better. Who are you? You enjoy solving problems hands-on and take ownership of your area. You are comfortable in a 2nd line support role and see every support case as a chance to make the environment a little more secure. We expect that you have: Hands-on experience administering and securing endpoints with Microsoft Intune, including Windows Autopilot Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender, Entra ID and Conditional Access Experience from IT Operations or 2nd line support, helping end users and other IT teams A structured, analytical approach to problem-solving Strong communication skills, and the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical colleagues Fluency in English. Swedish is a plus It is a plus if you also have: Experience with macOS and mobile device management (iOS, Android) Experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Purview (DLP, sensitivity labels) PowerShell or other scripting for automation Experience from a regulated environment, such as financial services Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, SC-200 or SC-300, or equivalent experience Do not worry if you do not check every box. If you are curious, driven and eager to grow into the role, we would still love to hear from you. Worth knowing This is a full-time, permanent position based in Málaga or Szczecin. Hybrid work flexibility is available. You will report into IT Operations and work in close proximity to the IT Helpdesk and the rest of the operations team, which gives you fast escalation paths and strong support from day one. We believe diverse teams build better solutions, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Ready to apply? If you have any questions about the role, feel free to reach out to our hiring manager, Robert Lööf, Head of IT Operations. We look forward to hearing from you!

items.desc: General Information Position Workday Functional Consultant Work arrangement Full-time City Gdansk, Katowice, Krakow, Lodz, Poznan, Warsaw, Wroclaw Country Poland Department Consulting Team Industry Solutions & Organization Transformation Area of interest Consulting, ERP Platforms Way of work Hybrid Description & Requirements Who we are looking for Workday Functional Consultant - Poland | Czech Republic | Hungary Take ownership of real HR transformation challenges You've built your first professional experience. Now you're ready for more ownership. As a Workday Functional Consultant at Deloitte , you'll work with local and international clients to understand business challenges, design better HR processes and translate them into technology solutions. You'll be more than someone who configures a system. We want you to develop into someone clients can trust to understand the problem, challenge assumptions and recommend a way forward. Who we're looking for We're looking for people with approximately 1–2 years of experience in HR technology and/or consulting . You don't need to come from a particular academic background. What matters more is whether you: Have initial experience with Compensation or Advance Compensation modules Learn quickly and enjoy tackling unfamiliar problems Can turn ambiguity into structured questions and actions Are comfortable speaking with clients Can explain complex topics simply Take ownership of your work and follow things through Manage deadlines and changing priorities Proactively seek answers, expertise and support Can challenge ideas constructively Enjoy building relationships and working with people Are fluent in English Previous Workday experience is valuable, but Workday knowledge alone isn't what we're hiring for . Your future role ‍ What you'll do Depending on the project and your experience, you'll: Translate business requirements into HR processes and Workday solutions Investigate complex problems and recommend practical solutions Run parts of client workshops and requirements discussions Challenge client requirements constructively when there's a better approach Configure and test Workday functional solutions Present designs and recommendations clearly Own defined project deliverables and deadlines Identify risks early and help resolve them Support your Stream Lead in keeping delivery moving Build your internal network and find the right expertise when you need it Collaborate with colleagues and clients across countries You'll have experienced colleagues and subject-matter experts around you. But at Consultant level, we also expect you to increasingly own the problem rather than wait for someone else to solve it . What you'll build This role gives you the opportunity to develop: Deep HR and business process expertise Workday functional expertise Client advisory and workshop skills Functional solution design capabilities Project delivery and stakeholder management skills Experience across local and international projects A strong network across Deloitte What we offer Grow from delivery professional to trusted adviser You'll develop through Workday training and certifications, client delivery and support from experienced Deloitte colleagues. But you'll also be expected to own your learning. Consulting means you will sometimes face a client question you've never answered before, an unfamiliar process or a challenging deadline. Success isn't about already knowing every answer. It's about being able to structure the problem, ask good questions, find the right expertise, make a recommendation and move things forward. And you'll do that within a team that helps each other learn and succeed. You'll work with one of today's leading HR technology platforms while developing capabilities that go beyond a single system. Technology will evolve. Great consultants evolve with it. If you're ready to take more ownership, work directly with clients and become a business and technology adviser, we'd like to meet you. ✈️ This role requires visits in office min. 2x/month and we are looking for candidates who accepts business travels. Selection process Application & Recruiter Call - we review your CV and, if there’s a good match, invite you to a short 15-minute conversation with our recruiter . Technical Interview - meet with a Senior Consultant to discuss your experience, expertise, and approach to technical and business challenges. Final Interview - have a conversation with a Senior Manager focused on the project, your potential role, and mutual fit. About Deloitte Deloitte is about diversity – of people, experiences, industries, and services delivered across 150 countries around the world. It’s a place of intellectual challenges, a strong start to your career, continuous growth, and valuable experiences that go beyond work. It all starts with one step – finishing your CV, sending it off, and eventually signing your contract. Deloitte is simply a good choice. Period. #LI-DS1

items.desc: Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects. Who we are supporting The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium. The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including: Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats. Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations. Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces. Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks. Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers. Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities. The program Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS) The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V. To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce. items.desc: Excited to grow your career? BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. About the job: Buscamos a una persona para incorporarse como Procurement Analyst en el equipo de Procurement Operation & Strategic Sourcing. Te integrarás en una estructura de pool horizontal basada en proyectos, donde tendrás la oportunidad de abordar retos tanto locales como globales. Este modelo te permitirá asegurar una visión transversal sobre todas las categorías de compras (Tecnología, Infraestructuras, Servicios al Negocio, Comunicación, etc.) y facilitará tu desarrollo profesional dentro de la función. Como Analyst, darás apoyo a compradores senior en ejecutar los procesos de negociación y gestión: Relación con áreas usuarias: Colaborarás directamente con los equipos internos para conocer sus necesidades, analizar volúmenes de compra y precios de adquisición. Ejecución de negociación y licitaciones: Prepararás la lista de proveedores participantes, elaborarás pliegos de licitación y establecerás criterios de selección. Análisis de costes: Realizarás evaluaciones de ofertas, desde análisis comparativos sencillos hasta modelos de sensibilidad complejos (TCO / TVO). Gestión del aprovisionamiento: Tramitarás las ofertas, calcularás los ahorros generados y prepararás la documentación para la Propuesta de Adjudicación ante la Comisión de Contratación. Sourcing de mercado: Participarás en la búsqueda de proveedores y en el control del riesgo proveedor de acuerdo a la estrategia del área. Conocimientos contractuales: Conocimiento de contratos. ¿Qué buscamos? Formación: Titulación universitaria superior o media en Ingeniería, Telecomunicaciones, Económicas, ADE o similar. Idiomas: Nivel alto de inglés (B2 o superior). Herramientas digitales: Experiencia en el uso de SAP/ARIBA y herramientas de negociación. Ofimática: Dominio avanzado de Excel y bases de datos, así como manejo fluido del entorno Google (AppScript, Data Studio, Sheets, etc.). Habilidades clave: Capacidades de negociación, comunicación e interlocución. Conocimientos técnicos: Interés y curiosidad por los mercados de tecnología, servicios profesionales o infraestructuras, valorando positivamente los conocimientos financieros. Valorable Experiencia previa 1 – 2 años en entornos multinacionales y gestión de proyectos. Disponibilidad para viajar a nivel internacional si el proyecto lo requiere. Skills: Client Orientation, Empathy, Ethics, Innovation, Proactive Thinking

items.desc: Vill du bidra i arbetet mot beständig och öppen tillgång till medicinsk information? Karolinska Institutet Universitetsbiblioteket söker en systemutvecklare med inriktning databas. Vill du arbeta med data som gör medicinsk forskning mer tillgänglig och användbar? Hos oss på Karolinska Institutets Universitetsbibliotek får du utveckla lösningar som samlar, berikar och tillgängliggör forskningsinformation. Du blir en del av ett litet och engagerat team där du får kombinera teknisk utveckling med verksamhetsnära samarbete. Din roll Du kommer arbeta med att samla in, strukturera och vidareutveckla data från flera olika system och källor. Ditt arbete bidrar till att skapa tillförlitlig och användbar information om den forskning som bedrivs vid Karolinska Institutet. Rollen är varierad och du kommer bland annat att arbeta med att: modellera data samt utveckla och optimera databaser utveckla och underhålla laddscript utveckla API: er och integrationer strukturera och koppla samman data från olika källor vidareutveckla arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar tillsammans med teamet aktivt bidra till tekniska lösningar som svarar mot behov i verksamheten Arbetet spänner över hela kedjan från datainsamling och datamodellering till integrationer, optimering och tillgängliggörande av information. Ena dagen kan du arbeta med att förbättra prestandan i ett dataladdningsflöde, nästa dag med att utveckla en integration eller förbättra teamets utvecklingsprocesser. Rollen är särskilt intressant för dig som tycker om att delta i hela processen, från att förstå användarnas behov, se samband och omsätta dem i hållbara tekniska lösningar. Vem är du? Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad, tycker om att förstå komplexa samband och lära nytt. Du tycker om att ta egna initiativ, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och omsätta idéer till lösningar tillsammans med teamet. För att trivas i rollen ser vi att du är en lagspelare som uppskattar att samarbeta, dela kunskap och bidra till att utveckla teamets arbetssätt. Du trivs i en miljö där verksamheten både kan vara planerad och händelsestyrd. Vi söker dig som har: relevant utbildning eller motsvarande kompetens som du har förvärvat på annat sätt god erfarenhet av relationsdatabaser, datamodellering och SQL erfarenhet av att utveckla, vidareutveckla och optimera databaser och dataflöden erfarenhet av att hämta, bearbeta och koppla samman data från flera system eller datakällor erfarenhet av programmering i Python förmåga att kommunicera väl på svenska och engelska Det är meriterande om du har: arbetat med publikationsdata, forskningsinformation eller andra komplexa informationsmängder erfarenhet av automatiserad testning och kvalitetssäkring av kod erfarenhet av CI/CD och automatiserade utvecklings- eller driftsättningsflöden arbetat med agil systemutveckling erfarenhet av maskininlärning eller intresse av att utvecklas inom området Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Teamet och vårt arbetssätt Du blir en del av ett litet team där vi stöttar varandra. Här finns utrymme att ställa frågor, testa idéer och bidra med egna perspektiv. Vi jobbar både i utvecklingsprojekt och löpande systemförvaltning, och du får möjlighet att vara med och påverka hur vi utvecklar våra arbetssätt och lösningar. Vi arbetar flexibelt med kontor på Karolinska Institutets båda campus, i Solna och Flemingsberg. För oss är det viktigaste att du vill vara en aktiv del av teamet, oavsett var du arbetar ifrån. Vad erbjuder vi? Hos oss får du arbeta i en kunskapsintensiv miljö där teknik, forskning och utveckling möts. Du får stor flexibilitet i arbetet, med möjlighet till distansarbete (del av veckan) och förtroendearbetstid, samt goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll. items.desc: Security Operations Engineer We are now hiring for a Security Operations Engineer to join our Security team. This team drives the security programs within the business, with a heavy focus on people, processes, and automation of services. Kambi is looking for someone who wants to encourage and foster a culture of security awareness and regulatory compliance by making it easy for those less knowledgeable to Do It Right. About the Security team: You would be implementing technologies for vulnerability management, authentication and identity management, and creating security with automation. A focus for our team is to create paved roads for Development and Operations teams, to ensure they can easily secure their applications and maintain security throughout the organization. The Security Operations team also responds to incoming security threats and incidents. We provides expert security knowledge to the wider organisation. We use automation tools like Puppet, Ansible and Terraform, and work in a diverse environment with physical and virtual machines, as well as containerized workloads both on-prem and in AWS. About you: We will be very happy if you have commercial industry experience working in a security team, in either offensive or defensive roles. Additionally, previous experience working with Linux or AWS is needed, and it’s a huge bonus if you have spent time working with actively with security in these areas. Prior experience with identity and authentication systems for web and Linux integrations are valued. We'd love if you were investigative, curious and passionate about security and privacy. What We Offer: At Kambi, you'll join a collaborative and international team where innovation, learning, and personal growth are encouraged. We believe great work happens when people feel supported, valued, and empowered to make an impact. Some of the benefits you'll enjoy include: Generous paid time off to support a healthy work-life balance Health and wellbeing benefits for you and your family Pension, retirement, and insurance programs that provide peace of mind Employee Assistance Program and wellbeing resources Learning and development opportunities to support your career growth Flexible benefits designed to support your lifestyle and personal needs Recognition programs and company-wide celebrations Modern tools and a collaborative environment that help you do your best work Opportunities to connect, learn, and grow with colleagues across our global teams Whether you're solving complex challenges, collaborating with talented colleagues, or taking the next step in your career, you'll have the support and flexibility to thrive at Kambi. Ready to Apply? If you're excited about this opportunity and ready to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you—apply via our careers page. Security Engineer I Security Operations Engineer I Cyber Security Engineer I DevSecOps Engineer I Security Consultant Diversity & Inclusion: Kambi’s ongoing commitment to Diversity and Inclusion in the workplace If you require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process, please notify your recruiter, who will assist you however they can. Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of who we are and who we aim to be. While we are proud of the positive and inclusive company culture we have created, we know we can do so much more. Kambi constantly evolves its Diversity and Inclusion strategy to ensure it becomes an even more inclusive and positive place to work, with the core management team reaffirming its commitment to delivering on employee feedback. Creating an inclusive environment We believe Kambi’s greatest strength is the collective talent of our employees. Kambi is committed to ensuring we create an inclusive work environment where everyone can feel valued, thrive and achieve their potential, regardless of who they are or what their background is. We know that it is only by having a balance of different voices, values and opinions that Kambi is able to be the market leader it is today. #wearekambi

I rollen ingår bland annat: • taktisk och operativ utveckling och arbete med arkitekturstyrning • arbete som systemarkitekt och systemförnyelse samt målarkitektur • framtagande av dokumentation och förslag till realisering i form av lösningsarkitektur, både i text och i modeller • framtagande av lösningsmönster för att arbeta med micro-services (API:er) och Kafkalösningar • framtagande av lösningsmönster för att arbeta med BI och AI med mönster, tränande, arkitektur, datastrategier och datarutinunderlag • presentation av lösningsarkitektur på ett tydligt sätt så att utvecklingsteam, it-styrning, verksamhet och att, i vissa • fall andra myndigheter förstår, och kan agera och implementera korrekt • samarbete med andra myndigheter i arkitekturfrågor, teknikstöd och normalisering. • arbete med Bolagsverkets datamanagement för utveckling av AI- och maskininlärningsmodeller • arbete med Front-end och Back-end arkitektur. items.desc: Vill du jobba med IT-säkerhet på riktigt? På CAG Security arbetar vi med säkerhet där den faktiskt gör skillnad. Vi hjälper företag och myndigheter att bygga säkrare system, hitta sårbarheter innan någon annan gör det och hantera en hotbild som förändras snabbare än någonsin. Nu söker vi fler erfarna IT-säkerhetsexperter som vill arbeta med tekniskt avancerade säkerhetsuppdrag – tillsammans med andra specialister som brinner för samma sak. Hos oss blir du inte en säkerhetsfunktion vid sidan av verksamheten. Säkerhet är vår verksamhet. Dina arbetsuppgifter Som IT-säkerhetsexpert på CAG Security arbetar du i varierande uppdrag hos kunder med höga krav på säkerhet, tillförlitlighet och kvalitet. Uppdragen kan exempelvis innebära att du: genomför penetrationstester av webbapplikationer, API, nätverk, molnmiljöer eller andra IT-system genomför tekniska säkerhetsgranskningar och sårbarhetsanalyser arbetar med Red Teaming och adversary simulation granskar arkitektur och design ur ett säkerhetsperspektiv tar fram säkerhetskrav och rekommendationer för tekniska lösningar hjälper kunder att bygga säkra infrastrukturer och plattformar arbetar med identitet, autentisering, behörighetsstyrning och Zero Trust analyserar och hanterar tekniska säkerhetsincidenter genomför tekniska riskanalyser och threat modelling hjälper utvecklings- och driftorganisationer att integrera säkerhet i sina processer deltar i utvecklingen av CAG Securitys tekniska tjänster och erbjudanden. Ett uppdrag kan vara ett fokuserat penetrationstest under några veckor. Ett annat kan innebära att du under längre tid fungerar som säkerhetsarkitekt eller teknisk säkerhetsexpert i ett större utvecklings- eller förändringsprojekt. Gemensamt är att du ska kunna omsätta teknisk kompetens till konkret säkerhetsnytta för kunden. Vem är du? Vi tror att du har flera års erfarenhet av IT- eller cybersäkerhet och har byggt upp en djup teknisk kompetens inom ett eller flera områden. Du kan exempelvis ha bakgrund inom penetrationstestning, säkerhetsarkitektur, infrastruktur, nätverk, cloud security, IAM, incidenthantering, utveckling eller teknisk säkerhetsgranskning. Du behöver inte kunna allt. Vi söker hellre personer som är riktigt bra inom sitt område och samtidigt är nyfikna på resten. Vi tror att du: har ett genuint tekniskt säkerhetsintresse förstår både hur system byggs och hur de kan angripas kan analysera komplexa tekniska miljöer kan förklara tekniska risker för både tekniker och beslutsfattare trivs med stort eget ansvar uppskattar att arbeta tillsammans med andra specialister behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Erfarenhet av exempelvis OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, Active Directory/Entra ID, Azure/AWS, Kubernetes, Windows/Linux, nätverkssäkerhet, säker kodgranskning eller etablerade pentestverktyg är meriterande. Certifieringar som OSCP, OSCE, CISSP, CISM eller motsvarande är också meriterande – men vad du faktiskt kan väger tyngre än vilka bokstäver du har på ditt CV. Vissa av våra uppdrag kan omfattas av säkerhetsprövning och kan ställa ytterligare krav på dig som konsult. Vad vi erbjuder På CAG Security arbetar du tillsammans med människor som kan säkerhet och som vill fortsätta utvecklas. Vi tror på stor frihet under ansvar. Du får möjlighet att påverka både vilka uppdrag du arbetar i och vilka områden du vill utvecklas inom. Hos oss får du bland annat: arbeta med kvalificerade säkerhetsuppdrag hos organisationer med höga säkerhetskrav arbeta tillsammans med erfarna IT- och informationssäkerhetskonsulter möjlighet att påverka ditt eget uppdrag och din kompetensutveckling vidareutbildningar och relevanta certifieringar möjlighet att bidra till utvecklingen av våra tjänster och vårt bolag flexibla arbetsformer där det fungerar för uppdraget ett flexibelt lönesystem ett starkt kompetensnätverk inom hela CAG-koncernen. Vi gillar dessutom teknik på riktigt. Labbar, CTF, nya attackmetoder, märkliga sårbarheter och diskussioner om hur saker egentligen fungerar är en naturlig del av miljön hos oss. Om CAG Security CAG Security är ett specialistbolag helt fokuserat på IT- och informationssäkerhet. Vi hjälper företag och myndigheter genom hela säkerhetslivscykeln – från styrning, risk och säkerhetskrav till säker arkitektur, penetrationstest, Red Teaming, incidenthantering och IT-forensik. Vi är en del av CAG-koncernen, vilket innebär att vi kombinerar specialistbolagets korta beslutsvägar och stora individuella påverkan med kompetensen och möjligheterna i en större IT-koncern. Vår ambition är enkel: Vi ska hjälpa våra kunder att ligga steget före. Och vi vill göra det tillsammans med några av Sveriges bästa säkerhetsexperter. Intresserad? Då vill vi gärna prata med dig. Du behöver inte ha bestämt exakt vad nästa steg i karriären ska vara. Hör av dig så tar vi ett första samtal om vad du kan, vad du vill göra mer av och om CAG Security kan vara rätt plats för dig.

Vi hjälper våra kunder med säkra och skalbara lösningar, från traditionell radio- och tv-utsändning till framtidens digitala kommunikationsvägar. Är du intresserad av att arbeta i en spännande och dynamisk bransch med erfarna och kompetenta kollegor? Är du ansvarstagande och gillar att tänka nytt? Då tror vi att du kommer att trivas hos oss! Om tjänsten: I rollen som IT-säkerhetsspecialist på Teracom:s SOC (Security Operations Center) arbetar du i ett team som tillsammans ansvarar för att skydda Teracoms nätverk och system, genom daglig uppföljning samt hantering av interna och externa projekt. Du arbetar med kunniga kollegor i din egen grupp samt andra delar av organisationen för att följa upp och integrera ny kunskap inom området både i nya och befintliga system. Ansvar och huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: I rollen som IT-säkerhetsspecialist kommer du primärt att arbeta med: Drift och underhåll av SOC-system ur ett säkerhetsperspektiv Övervakning och förbättring av säkerheten i system och nätverk Vidareutveckling av vår SOC och SIEM-lösning Kontinuitetshantering Säkerhetsintegrationer Omvärldsbevakning Säkerhetsgranskningar Ansvarsområden sträcker sig från drift och förvaltning av SOC-system till design och implementation av övervakningslösningar. Det ingår även att stötta övriga gruppen i arbetet med övervakning av loggar, larm- och incidenthantering. En viktig del av arbetet är att förbättra de verktyg och processer som används för säkerhetsövervakningen. Är du den vi söker? Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att ha arbetat inom drift och förvaltning av integrerade miljöer, incidenthantering och kontinuitetshantering. Du har god kommunikativ förmåga, både på svenska och engelska. Erfarenhet av säkerhetsstandards och ramverk är mycket meriterande. Du har djupa kunskaper om IT och datakommunikation och har några års erfarenhet av IT-säkerhetsarbete och har ett brinnande intresse för just säkerhet. Du har kunskaper inom: God förståelse inom nätverk, Windows och Linux Förståelse inom containerplattformar Incidenthantering och uppföljning Logghantering, intrångsdetektering och trafikövervakning Erfarenhet av säkerhetsprodukter som SIEM, IDS/IPS, proxy, etc. Erfarenhet av threat hunting Strukturerad dokumentation Meriterande om du har kunskaper inom: Query languages så som regex, KQL, DSL , DQL Scripting för generella ändamål i exempelvis Python, powershell eller bash Design, implementering och utveckling av SOC plattform Machine learning Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och ser att du har en god förmåga att kommunicera med personer inom olika kompetensområden och visar på ett stort engagemang och driv. Du är en person med hög personlig integritet och har ett högt säkerhetstänk. Vidare är du analytisk, strukturerad och konstruktiv i ditt sätt att arbeta. Har du dessutom en god förmåga att ta egna initiativ samtidigt som du trivs att arbeta i team kommer du att lyckas väl i denna roll. Naturligtvis är du också en person som identifierar dig med Teracoms tre kärnvärden; Mod, ansvar, innovation. Då tjänsten är säkerhetsklassad krävs Svenskt medborgarskap. En registerprövning kommer genomföras. Beredskap förekommer. Vi erbjuder: Hos Teracom får du vara med och göra skillnad varje dag. Det är vårt gemensamma ansvar att de samhällsviktiga tjänster vi levererar, med höga krav på både tillgänglighet, säkerhet och kvalitet, fungerar dygnet runt, året runt - oavsett. Vi erbjuder ett positivt arbetsklimat med högt engagemang, stort ansvarstagande och kompetenta kollegor. På Teracom strävar vi efter att skapa en kultur som inspirerar till lärande och utveckling där medarbetarna känner engagemang och trivs på jobbet, samtidigt som vi värnar om balans mellan arbete och fritid. Vi betraktar olikheter mellan människor som en styrka och är övertygade om att det bidrar till ett kreativt och trivsamt arbetsklimat. Hos oss får du marknadsmässiga villkor och goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll. items.desc: About us At Techrytera AB , recruitment starts with you. We are a staffing and recruitment company with deep expertise and a clear focus on IT and Engineering. With our industry knowledge and close dialogue with both candidates and clients, we create precise matches where the right skills meet the right needs. We believe that a truly great match is not just about a job description – it’s about your experience, your potential, and what you genuinely want to develop in. That’s why we always focus on the individual. By understanding your background, motivations, and ambitions, we can connect you with assignments and roles at our clients where you have the right conditions to grow and make an impact. Our goal is to build long-term and meaningful collaborations – for both you as a candidate and for our clients. Job Description We are seeking a Backend Engineer with experience in backend development to design, build, and operate critical distributed services for millions of users worldwide, meeting strict security, privacy, reliability, and scalability requirements. You thrive amid rapidly changing priorities and roadmaps and see opportunity in uncertainty. Working closely across engineering teams and technical domains, you will solve distributed systems challenges, improve availability, reliability, performance, and scalability, and develop reusable frameworks and platform capabilities for internal and external users. You will contribute to architecture and design, substantially influence technical decisions and implementation, and own services throughout their lifecycle, including production support. You value collaboration, ownership, accountability, and engineering quality. Required Qualifications: Comfort with documenting technical designs, discussing architecture, communicating with stakeholders with and without technical backgrounds, questioning assumptions, and putting forward alternative solutions. Practical experience across several of these technologies and practices: automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, REST APIs, Cassandra, Redis, Memcached, and Netty or comparable frameworks. Knowledge of engineering practices concerning reliability and operational excellence. Knowledge of the concepts underlying authentication and authorisation. Experience creating web services intended for customers. A strong grasp of how distributed systems work, including scalability, fault tolerance, consistency models, and performance tuning. Experience with the operation of systems deployed in production. Ability to explore and explain the reasoning behind technical design choices in detail. In-depth Java expertise supported by strong experience working with multithreading and concurrency, memory semantics under the Java Memory Model, garbage collection behaviour and tuning, allocation management and performance optimisation, the java.util.concurrent package, modern concurrency models including Virtual Threads, and architectures based on reactive principles. A background in backend development spanning around five years or more. It is considered an advantage if you have experience with cryptography and security protocols, PKCS, KMIP, X.509, AES, KDF, Certificate Authorities, machine learning platforms and algorithms, GitHub, Maven, Docker, Kubernetes, or Spinnaker. We want to get to know you, your experience, and your ambitions so that we can match you with the right opportunities at our clients. Does this sound interesting? Submit your application or get in touch with us to learn more. We look forward to discovering the next step in your career together with you.

Du erbjuds ett meningsfullt arbete där det du utvecklar bidrar till att förbättra patientvården möjlighet att utvecklas i ett tvärvetenskapligt team med bred kompetens inom genomik, bioinformatik, mjukvaruutveckling och IT en arbetsmiljö där nya teknologier och lösningar är en naturlig del av vardagen flexibla arbetstider och möjlighet till hybridarbete en inkluderande kultur som präglas av öppenhet, mångfald och respekt. Självklart får du också ta del av de generella förmåner som Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset erbjuder. Om tjänsten Tjänsten är placerad vid Genomic Medicine Center Karolinska (GMCK), som är en del av Medicinsk diagnostik Karolinska (MDK). GMCK ansvarar för att tillhandahålla storskaliga och avancerade genomikanalyser till samtliga laboratoriemedicinska specialiteter inom MDK. Vårt team består av cirka 50 medarbetare med bred kompetens inom genomik, bioinformatik, mjukvaruutveckling och IT. Vi arbetar nära varandra och samarbete och hjälpsamhet är en naturlig del av vardagen. Nya teknologier och patientgrupper innebär att vi ständigt möter nya och meningsfulla utmaningar med målet att förbättra vården för fler patienter. Du kommer tillsammans med ett team på sex utvecklare att underhålla och vidareutveckla de system som automatiserar våra dataflöden och tillgängliggör resultaten för kliniska experter. Systemen består av både CLI- och webbapplikationer och är till största del skrivna i Python. Webbapplikationerna utvecklas med FastAPI och Flask. Vi använder GitHub för versionshantering och Docker för containerisering, och våra system driftas on-premises. items.desc: Ö-borgen är en familjeägd koncern med flera bolag inom den marina sektorn i Sverige. VesselCare är vår egenutvecklade Fleet Management-plattform som samlar in och analyserar sensordata från fartyg via IoT-enheter. Informationen används bland annat för realtidsövervakning, analys av resor och bränsleförbrukning samt automatiserad larmhantering. Vi utvecklar hela lösningen själva, från datainsamling och molninfrastruktur till backend och webbapplikationer. Plattformen används redan av våra kunder och vi fortsätter att utveckla den med nya funktioner, förbättrad användarupplevelse och bättre prestanda. Nu stärker vi utvecklingsgruppen och söker en embedded systemutvecklare som vill vara med och vidareutveckla tekniken bakom VesselCare och våra marina digitala lösningar. Arbetsuppgifter Som embedded systemutvecklare arbetar du med utveckling av mjukvara för inbyggda system med fokus på marina tillämpningar. Rollen kombinerar elektronik, kommunikationsprotokoll och modern systemutveckling där målet är att skapa robusta och tillförlitliga lösningar för en krävande miljö. Du kommer att: Utveckla mjukvara för inbyggda system Integrera fartygssystem via CANBUS, NMEA och Modbus Utveckla och underhålla firmware Designa och implementera signaltolkning och datamodeller Testa och verifiera kommunikation mot marina system Samarbeta med vårt cloudteam kring dataflöden och API: er Arbetet är varierat och innebär att du rör dig mellan hårdvara, firmware, kommunikationsprotokoll och systemintegration. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av: Rust, C och/eller C++. Utveckling av firmware och embedded-lösningar. CANBUS, NMEA, Modbus eller liknande industriella kommunikationsprotokoll. Integration mellan olika system och tekniska plattformar. Testning, verifiering och felsökning av tekniska system Du trivs med att arbeta nära andra kompetenser, är nyfiken på att lära dig nya tekniker och har ett lösningsfokuserat förhållningssätt. Du gillar att ta ansvar för dina leveranser och bidrar till en positiv och hjälpsam laganda. Du behöver behärska svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift. Mer om tjänsten och rekryteringsprocessen Du blir en del av koncernens IT-avdelning, som ansvarar för support, underhåll och utveckling av tekniska lösningar för alla våra bolag. Inom IT-avdelningen finns en utvecklingsgrupp som idag består av tre personer och som nu växer. Två nya roller tillsätts, en med fokus på embeddedutveckling och en inom cloud/fullstack. Gruppen arbetar till stor del på distans, och tillväxten innebär goda möjligheter att påverka både arbetssätt, teknikval och den fortsatta utvecklingen av VesselCare. Två av våra största kunder är Försvarsmakten och FMV vilket innebär att den som blir aktuell för tjänsten kommer genomgå en säkerhetsprövning. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Kim Svensson (031 756 00 71, eller kim.svensson@oborgen.se). Ansök genom att klicka på "ansök nu" och fyll i formuläret där du kommer få besvara urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten - vi gör vårt första urval baserat på svaren på dessa frågor så vi ser gärna att du svarar utförligt. Vill du även bifoga ditt CV går det bra men det är inget måste. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Ö-borgen är en familjeägd koncern med flera bolag inom den marina sektorn i Sverige. Våra medarbetare är en viktig nyckel till framgång och i vår stora familj jobbar vi med olika saker men åt samma håll. Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas och växa tillsammans med oss! Du kan läsa mer om oss på vår hemsida: Ö-borgen

Conduct user research, including
items.desc: Love solving problems, building great digital products, and turning complex challenges into simple user experiences? Then we might be looking for you! About HomeQ HomeQ is Sweden's largest marketplace for first-hand rental apartments, connecting people looking for a home with property companies across the country. With over 1.4 million registered users and more than 1,000 property partners, we're making the rental market more accessible, transparent, and efficient. We're a small, ambitious team with big ideas. Since 2024, we've been part of Vend, the leading marketplace operator in the Nordics, giving us the best of both worlds: the speed and ownership of a scale-up, backed by the stability of an established company. Now we're looking for a curious and hands-on Product Designer to help us build even better experiences for our users. The team & how we work At HomeQ, we believe great products are built by small teams with a lot of ownership. We work with an adapted version of the Shape Up methodology, where small, cross-functional teams typically consist of a product designer, a frontend engineer, and a backend engineer. Together, you'll take on real user problems, explore solutions, and turn ideas into working products during six-week development cycles. You won't be handed a detailed list of tasks or told exactly what to design. Instead, we expect you to be curious, challenge assumptions, make decisions, and figure things out together with your team. Our product and engineering teams work across Stockholm and Lisbon, so collaboration and communication are a natural part of everyday life. What you'll do As a Product Designer at HomeQ, you'll have the opportunity to own the entire design process, from understanding a problem to shipping a solution that makes a difference. You'll: Own design projects end-to-end, from discovery and research to UX, UI, prototyping, and delivery. Solve real user problems by combining insights, creativity, and practical thinking. Conduct user research, including interviews, surveys, and usability testing. Work closely with engineers to turn ideas into well-designed, functional products. Create intuitive user experiences for both people looking for homes and the property companies using our platform. Challenge existing solutions and continuously look for ways to improve our products. Contribute to our design practices, tools, and design system. You'll have plenty of freedom to explore different approaches, experiment with new tools, and influence how we build products. Who we're looking for We're looking for a curious problem solver and design generalist who enjoys taking responsibility and turning ideas into reality. We think you'll thrive here if you: Have experience designing digital products and working closely with developers. Feel comfortable owning the full design process, from user research to polished interfaces. Have strong UX and UI skills and know when to focus on the details and when to keep things simple. Are confident using Figma and curious about exploring new tools, technologies, and AI. Enjoy understanding why something is a problem before jumping into solutions. Can make decisions independently, even when you don't have all the answers. Thrive in a small team where everyone contributes beyond their job description. Communicate confidently in both Swedish and English. Bonus points: You've built something cool on your own, experimented with AI or coding tools, or have a side project you're proud of. We'd love to see it! We're more interested in how you think, solve problems, and get things done than in a specific number of years of experience or a particular educational background. Why HomeQ? Real impact: Work on products used by over a million people, helping them with something as important as finding a home. Ownership from day one: Take responsibility for your work and see your ideas become real features. Small teams, big opportunities: Work closely with talented colleagues, with short decision-making paths and room to influence. Freedom to experiment: Explore new approaches, tools, and technologies to find better solutions. The best of both worlds: Enjoy the entrepreneurial energy of a scale-up with the backing of Vend. A word from our CPO, Felix Hey! I'm Felix, and I'll personally be looking at every application. I care much more about how you think and what you've created than about a perfectly polished CV or cover letter. So, if you want to catch my attention, make sure that: Your portfolio is easy to find. Show me what you've worked on and, ideally, how you approached the problems you were solving. You include three bullet points explaining why you're a great fit for HomeQ. That's it! We can talk about your experience and everything else later. Ready to help shape the future of renting? We'd love to hear from you!

items.desc: Job Description Join our team of control and automation experts and contribute to the development of applications based on the UNICOS-CPC framework, which is used CERN-wide for the development of PLC-based control systems. You will work alongside process and equipment experts from across CERN to develop, test, commission and maintain control systems across a wide range of domains. Your responsibilities Develop, commission and maintain control applications based on the UNICOS-CPC framework for standardised PLC application generation, supporting Siemens and Schneider PLCs. Work closely with process and equipment experts to specify, implement, commission and support control systems that meet their operational needs. Contribute to the maintenance and further development of tooling and testing infrastructure used to support application development. Contribute to the evaluation of emerging automation technologies and help shape the next generation of control at CERN. More information here. Your profile Background and/or interest in the field of automation and control. Basic hands-on experience developing, testing or troubleshooting PLC programs using IEC 61131-3 languages. Knowledge and experience in industrial communication protocols would be an asset. Initial experience with Python. Skills Strong problem-solving and technical communication skills. Basic knowledge of control theory and automation principles. Knowledge of PLC programming using IEC 61131-3 languages. Knowledge of Continuous Integration based on GitLab CI would be an asset. Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French. Eligibility criteria: You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State. By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Automation, Control Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree . You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before. Applicants without University degree are not eligible. Applicants with a PhD are not eligible. Additional Information Job closing date: 16.11.2026 at 23:59 CET. Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum. Working hours: 40 hours per week Job flexibility: Hybrid Target start date: 01-January-2027 This position involves: A valid driving licence. Job reference: BE-ICS-ACS-2026-247-GRAE Field of work: Data Science, AI & Analytics Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer Global Benefits A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree. 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure. Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund. Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances. A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances. Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months. On-the-job and formal training including language classes. Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible! At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive. Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success. If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART! More information about us, here: careers.cern

items.desc: Student Placement – Mechanistic Pharmacology (Lab based) Salary: £24,000 plus benefits Reports to: Scientist (Mechanistic Pharmacology) Directorate: Research & Innovation Contract: Fixed-term Contract 52 weeks Hours: Full-time 35 hours per week Location: Babraham Research Campus, Cambridge – Lab based Closing date: Sunday 8th November 23:55pm Recruitment process: Screening call followed by competency-based interview process. Visa sponsorship: You must be eligible to work in the UK to apply for this vacancy. Cancer Research UK is not able to offer visa sponsorship. At Cancer Research UK, we exist to beat cancer. As the world’s biggest medical research charity, we’ve helped bring eleven new cancer drugs to market. However, there is still an urgent need to bring more effective treatments to patients faster. Cancer Research Horizons (CRH) is CRUK’s internal translation engine. CRUK’s established drug discovery teams operate under one organisation and leadership team. Our unique combination of cancer biology expertise and access to CRUK’s world-class academic network, coupled with cutting edge technology platforms and clinical expertise enables us to 1) bring new treatments to patients faster and 2) tackle the biggest challenges in discovering cancer drugs by seeking out more radical ideas and embracing risk in our bid to achieve success. Based at sites in Cambridge, the CRUK Scotland Institute in Glasgow, and Newcastle University, Cancer Research Horizons employs ~180 staff from both industrial and academic backgrounds. About the placement This placement will contribute to the overarching mission of Cancer Research Horizons to discover novel cancer therapeutics that ultimately benefit patients. The successful applicant will undertake a laboratory-based research project designed to expand the technical capabilities of the Mechanistic Pharmacology team while addressing challenges relevant to drug discovery. The Mechanistic Pharmacology team plays a vital role in advancing new cancer medicines, generating the data and insights that guide key drug discovery decisions. We apply biochemical, biophysical, and cell-based approaches to understand how targets and compounds behave, develop novel assays, identify and evaluate promising compounds, investigate mechanisms of action, and support the progression of small-molecule discovery projects. Working alongside experienced Cancer Research Horizons scientists, the successful applicant will gain hands-on experience of the drug discovery process and develop proficiency in a broad range of in vitro laboratory techniques. They will contribute to meaningful research, analyse and present scientific data, and gain first-hand insight into how potential new cancer medicines are discovered and progressed towards the clinic. We are looking for a technically exceptional Integration Architect to join the Digital & Technology team at Compass Group UK & Ireland. You'll combine strong judgement with a practical, delivery-minded approach - evaluating platforms and approaches, shaping integration patterns that engineers can build to, and driving targeted modernisation where it will reduce risk and improve reliability. This is a role for someone who is comfortable producing technically rigorous architecture, and able to explain options, trade-offs, and roadmaps to senior stakeholders when required. If you are the kind of Integration Architect who is energised by complexity, motivated by the opportunity to build something that genuinely matters, and ready to leave a lasting mark on how a large organisation connects and operates - this is the role for you. About Compass Group UK & Ireland We're part of FTSE 100 Compass Group PLC, a global leader in food services. Our colleagues serve customers every day across thousands of locations, from schools and hospitals to stadiums, offices and visitor attractions. Digital & Technology (D&T) is around 260 people and is driving the business's AI First strategy. Integration Architect - The role Integration is the connective tissue of our technology estate. It influences how quickly we can deliver change, how reliably our systems operate, and how effectively our platforms - from SAP to e-commerce to our data estate - work together to serve the business and our customers. Getting this right is a key enabler for delivery and operational performance. The Integration Architect is a key domain expert within Digital & Technology, sitting at the intersection of architecture and engineering. The role partners closely with delivery teams building products, the architecture community shaping technology direction, and programmes across commerce, data, and SAP to ensure integrations are designed consistently, securely, and in a way that will scale. Key Responsibilities Integration Strategy and Platform Direction Lead the development of the integration strategy and target-state direction, working with Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, and programmes to establish a clear vision for how systems connect, share data, and enable business capabilities. Lead or support the evaluation of integration platforms and tooling (API management, event streaming, iPaaS, middleware), providing clear recommendations, reference architectures, and evidence to inform investment decisions. Assess the current integration estate with technical rigour, identify the highest-priority areas of fragility, duplication, and risk, and develop a phased modernisation roadmap with clear outcomes at each stage. Define and maintain the integration methodology - the patterns, standards, and decision frameworks that teams can use to design and deliver integrations consistently and well. Stay ahead of the curve on emerging integration technologies and approaches, ensuring the organisation's strategy reflects industry direction and does not accumulate avoidable technical debt. Technical Architecture and Hands-On Design Produce detailed, technically credible integration architectures across all integration domains - SAP and ERP connectivity, e-commerce and digital channels, mobile platforms, data pipeline and analytics integrations, and third-party SaaS and partner systems. Lead technical spikes and proof-of-concept work to validate architectural approaches, evaluate tooling options, and de-risk delivery - getting hands-on where the situation demands it. Define and curate the integration patterns library, covering REST and GraphQL APIs, event-driven and pub/sub patterns, webhooks, message queuing and streaming (e.g. Apache Kafka, Amazon SQS/SNS, Amazon EventBridge), batch and near-real-time data exchange, and EDI. items.desc: An exciting opportunity has arisen for an enthusiastic and highly organised Project Co-ordinator to support the delivery of a nationally significant workforce development programme for the Bowel Cancer Screening Programme (BCSP). This 12-month fixed-term role will coordinate the BCSP Accreditation and Mentorship Programme at a national level, supporting work across England rather than within a single region. The programme aims to increase the number of accredited BCSP endoscopists and help services prepare for the anticipated rise in demand associated with FIT80 implementation and the expansion of bowel cancer screening . Based within the North West Endoscopy Academy, the successful candidate will work as part of the Academy team while collaborating with multidisciplinary colleagues across England. This will include clinical leads, mentors, Higher Education Institution partners, NHS England colleagues, screening centres and representatives from Endoscopy Training Academies in other regions. Acting as the central point of coordination, the postholder will support delivery to agreed timescales, monitor progress against key milestones and provide high-quality project management support to this complex national initiative. The role offers a valuable opportunity to build relationships across regions and professions while contributing to a programme with national impact. Coordinating trainee recruitment, onboarding and engagement activities. Collecting, monitoring and analysing programme data. Producing regular reports, dashboards and performance updates for governance groups. Supporting programme evaluation and the collection of outcome measures. Organising meetings, webinars, workshops and stakeholder events. Maintaining risk, issue and action logs and supporting mitigation plans. Developing effective working relationships with regional and national stakeholders. Liaising with trainees, mentors, Academy Leads, NHS England, higher education partners and screening centres. Supporting communication and engagement activities across all participating academies. Ensuring accurate documentation and audit trails are maintained throughout the project lifecycle. NHS University Hospitals of Liverpool Group (UHL Group) was formed on 1 November 2024, born from a shared aim to improve the care we provide our communities. We are one of the largest employers in region, with over 18,900 colleagues who are dedicated to caring for our communities - from birth and beyond. For the 630,000 people across Merseyside, we are their local NHS. We provide general and emergency hospital care, alongside highly specialised regional services that extend to more than two million people in the North West. We operate from five hospital sites: Aintree University Hospital is the single receiving site for adult major trauma patients in Cheshire and Merseyside, and hosts a number of regional services including an award-winning stroke facility. Liverpool Women’s Hospital specialises in the health of women and babies, delivering over 7,200 babies in the UK’s largest single site maternity hospital each year. The Royal Liverpool University Hospital is the largest hospital in the country to provide inpatients with 100% single en-suite bedrooms and mainly focuses on complex planned care and specialist services. items.desc: If you enjoy the complexity, challenge and fast pace of working in acute mental health this role is for you. As a member of the multi-disciplinary Mental Health Liaison Team at St Richards Hospital you will be supporting people experiencing a Mental Health crisis in addition to those who may be experiencing a relapse in their diagnosed mental illness. A number of our patients are referred with self-harm or a history of self-harming behaviours. MHLT also receive referrals from patients admitted to the wards with complex physical and mental health problems. The role involves working alongside the Acute hospital and other colleagues including drugs and alcohol services, Social Services and charitable organistaions involved in the patients care and ongoing support. The team follow The Core 24 model and are a 24/7 service. Within the multi-disciplinary team you would be working with the Team Leader, Clinical Nurse Specialist, Consultant Psychiatrist, Psychologist, and Urgent Care Practitioners. The role of this team is the assessment and planning of care of patients and a sound knowledge of pathways of care. You will be liaising with other mental health services and agencies, in addition to acute inpatient units. This role will involve assessment and planning of onward care. It is preferable to have some experience of working in acute care (inpatient setting/crisis team/mental health liaison team). You will receive regular supervision and have the opportunity for personal and professional development as well as contributing to the team's development. Please contact the team leader if you wish to discuss this further. This is a seven day per week service which requires shift work and unsocial hours with enhancements. To protect the health and safety of our staff/workers, patients, and those attending our sites, we encourage our workforce to get fully vaccinated against COVID. items.desc: Job Overview: Young People's Work Coach, Chawleigh. Devon EX18 7EX About Ambe r The Amber Foundation provides supported accommodation and a structured programme for homeless, unemployed and disadvantaged young people aged 18 to 30. Residents may experience multiple disadvantage, including homelessness, unemployment, substance misuse, mental health difficulties and offending histories. Our residential centres provide 24-hour support alongside a full-time programme covering employability, independent living, health and wellbeing, and personal development. We help young people build the skills, confidence and resilience needed to move into paid employment and safe, sustainable accommodat ion Responsible to - Senior Team Leader and Service Manager Hours of Work - Monday to Friday, 9.00am to 5.30pm + one overnight shift per month + on-call responsibility (1/5 weeks) (included in the salary) Job Types: Full-time, Fixed Term Contract for up to 18 months Salary: £30,283.47 per annum . Purpose of the role The Young People’s Work Coach leads a team of residents through Amber’s programme, taking responsibility for purposeful support and measurable progress towards paid employment and independent living. A central responsibility is to proactively engage employers and create paid employment opportunities for young people who may struggle to access standard recruitment processes. The Work Coach builds relationships with recruitment decision makers, understands employers’ needs, promotes residents’ potential and agrees practical routes into interviews, job offers and employment. The role requires initiative, persistence and confident employer engagement alongside compassionate support, positive challenge and clear professional boundaries. Education, training, work experience and volunteering should address identified barriers and provide purposeful steps towards paid work. items.desc: This role is offered on a permanent basis. Working as an Employment Specialist for IPS Employment Services, for people with a serious and enduring mental health difficulties in Gloucester. Are you looking for a career where you can make a positive difference to the lives of people with Mental Health Difficulties? Do you believe you have the skills to support people back into employment? Are you passionate that occupation can support a person's wellbeing? If so these roles may be just what you're looking for! For people who need Mental Health support, getting back into work is a vital step on their recovery journey. The evidence backs this up and although 90% of people with Severe Mental Illness want to work, only 8% of them are in paid employment. This is why we are looking for people to join our friendly Individual Placement and Support (IPS) Service, as an Employment Specialist. This is an incredibly rewarding role - you will have the opportunity to transform the lives of your clients, to give them hope, direction and support their recovery journey. This is also a challenging role, so you’ll need to be resilient, empathetic and dedicated to finding clients employment that is right for them. As a people person, you will build a good rapport with your clients, gaining a real understanding of their key skills, their aspirations and their career goals. You will also spend time building productive relationships with employers, in order to identify and negotiate job opportunities in the hidden labour market. We welcome people from a range of backgrounds and with a variety of experience for this role. We will train you on the Individual Placement & Support (IPS) approach, giving you the tools you need to provide expert support and advice to clients, while also building positive relationships with employers and changing perceptions around mental health. The qualification, training & experience requirements for the role are underlined in the Job Description/Person Specification. We have a skilled and dedicated workforce of over 5000 colleagues working in a diverse range of services over 55 sites and within people’s homes. We strive to enable a welcoming workplace culture that builds and celebrates civility, inclusivity and diversity, while providing a sense of belonging and trust. Annual staff surveys, regular Pulse surveys and other engagement opportunities provide our people with lots of opportunity to tell us about their experiences of working with us. In the latest staff survey, 61% of colleagues gave us their views. It was great to hear that: 72% of colleagues would recommend the Trust as a place to work, ranking us 1st for Provider Trusts in the South West region on this question. 76% would recommend the standard of care provided in our services if a friend or relative needed treatment, also ranking us 1st in the South West region. 81% said that care of patients and service users is the Trust’s priority, compared with an average in comparable NHS Trusts in England of 64% This high-level overview shows we are in a healthy position, with higher scores than average for comparable organisations, alongside a great response rate, indicating good staff engagement. However, we also know we have plenty of room for improvement in many areas. To that end, we continue to prioritise and invest in our commitment to genuinely becoming a Great Place to Work with consistent top-quartile performance in the annual staff survey and Pulse surveys. You will be required to: Proactively manage a caseload of people, who have experienced Mental Health Difficulties, to either find and maintain paid employment, or to retain existing employment. Follow the IPS model, collate evidence and participate in Fidelity Reviews. Identify and meet the employment goals of clients by providing individually tailored programmes, using a person-centred approach. Work within a multi-disciplinary environment and liaise closely with a variety of stakeholders i.e. Department of Work and Pensions (DWP) and Citizen Advise Work proactively at Employer Engagement and research the labour market and spend time getting to know local employers, in order to negotiate job opportunities. Support Service Users and employers to identify reasonable adjustments and return to work strategies, to ensure job retention. Act independently, using own judgement, knowledge and initiative. Gloucestershire Health and Care is committed to embedding and providing personalised care through all of its services as part of our high-quality care strategy. The purpose of personalised care is to empower people to lead the lives they want to live. Personalised care starts with a conversation with people about what matters to them. It builds on what people can do, as well as addressing their health needs.
