items.desc: Lancashire & South Cumbria NHS Foundation Trust is on an exciting journey towards becoming a University Trust, strengthening our partnerships with leading academic institutions and expanding our research capability. Our Research & Development department plays a key role in achieving this ambition - driving innovation, collaboration and excellence across mental health research. We are looking for a Research Assistant to join the Mental Health Research Group (MHRG), a five year NIHR funded initiative based at Lancaster University. The MHRG is focused on tackling complex mental health needs among under served and excluded communities, co designing creative and inclusive solutions that improve access to care and reduce inequalities. items.desc: Salary: 68000 - 87500 GBP Annual London Company Description Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. Min fees. Max ease. Full speed. Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere. More about our mission and what we offer . Job Description We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join the Treasury Ledger team. Every time money moves at Wise, Treasury needs to know where it is and in which currency. Our team builds the ledger that answers that question: a real-time, accurate view of Wise's FX position and liquidity. This is high-volume, event-driven infrastructure where correctness matters. Your work directly supports how Treasury manages Wise's money, and the evolution of the ledger as the business grows. What will you be working on? Build new specialised ledgers that track Wise's FX risk and liquidity in real time, using modern stream-processing technology. Design real-time reconciliation and data-quality controls that catch discrepancies as they happen, not days later. Bring new Wise products into the ledger as they launch around the world, giving Treasury a complete picture of money moving across products and currencies. Scale the real-time event processing at the heart of Treasury, keeping it fast, resilient and observable as Wise grows. Technical responsibilities Own features end-to-end, from the product events Wise's systems produce to the real-time ledger streams Treasury relies on, working alongside experienced engineers. Help shape the architecture of new ledgers through design discussions and code reviews. Solve hard distributed-systems problems at scale: exactly-once processing, event ordering, replay and real-time aggregation. Build with a modern stack: Java 25, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, MariaDB and ClickHouse. Use AI tooling across the development lifecycle to move faster without compromising quality. Good understanding of databases and SQL. Care for data correctness and attention to edge cases. Writing well-tested, maintainable code. Willingness to learn new technologies and domains. Ownership and product mindset Ownership of your work from design through production. Understanding why something is being built and what problem it solves. Curiosity about how FX, liquidity and accounting work. Willingness to take part in incident resolution and post-incident learning. Participation in on-call support for your area when needed. Influence and collaboration Communicate clearly with engineers, analysts and business stakeholders. Ask questions, share knowledge, and give and receive feedback openly. Contribute to engineering communities or guilds across Wise. Nice to have Experience with Kafka, Flink or other stream-processing technologies. Experience with analytical databases such as ClickHouse. Experience with event-driven or data-intensive systems. Interest or experience in payments, banking, accounting or another financial domain. You will have authority over the delivery backlog, priorities and day-to-day delivery decisions within the direction set by Product Management. Product Management retains ownership of overall product strategy, roadmap direction, pricing and market positioning. This role will suit someone who enjoys being close to customers, Engineering and delivery, and who can turn broad product direction and complex customer needs into well-defined work that teams can confidently build and test. Key Responsibilities Own and prioritise the delivery backlog within Product Management’s agreed direction, making trade-offs, dependencies and delivery decisions visible. Identify and validate valuable customer-facing AI opportunities, defining quality thresholds, safeguards, human oversight and evaluation requirements for probabilistic features. Work closely with Product Design, Engineering and QA on workflows, data models, integrations, APIs, technical constraints and testability. Measure adoption, quality and customer outcomes; use evidence to guide iteration, priorities and recommendations to Product Management. Communicate progress, decisions, risks and dependencies clearly, and keep product documentation, release notes, Support and Customer Success briefings current. Knowledge, Skills & Experience Demonstrable experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst or in a closely related B2B SaaS delivery role. Practical experience owning and prioritising backlogs within an Agile delivery environment. A strong track record of translating customer and operational needs into clear user stories, requirements and testable acceptance criteria. Strong process, workflow and data analysis skills. Enough technical understanding to discuss APIs, integrations, data and dependencies confidently with Engineering teams. items.desc: Great journeys start with great people Here at LNER, we're shaping the future of rail on one of the UK's most iconic routes. From our high-speed Azuma fleet, redefining long-distance travel, to our next generation of trains, Serenza, this is a moment of real transformation for LNER. We're investing in cutting-edge technology, sustainability, and most importantly our people, to deliver outstanding experiences for our customers. There has never been a more exciting time to grow your career with LNER! THIS VACANCY IS FOR OUR TALENT POOLS FOR KINGS CROSS Starting Salary £25,214 plus an attendance allowance of £3818 for FT hours. Pro rata for Part Time. So what is a Future Talent Pool: We're always looking for talented people to join us at LNER. To help make our recruitment process more efficient, we sometimes recruit in advance to build our talent pools. This means that when a suitable role becomes available, we can reach out to candidates straight away rather than restarting the entire recruitment process each time. We are looking for people interested in either FT or PT. Our standard working hours cover a 7 day working week, with early starts, late finishes and weekend working. Part time contracts do tend to be weekend working only. Do bear this in mind when applying as we need to you to be able to get to and from our stations to commence your shift. So, what exactly does a Customer Experience Host do? By joining LNER as a Customer Experience Host you could be serving early morning coffees to our business commuters, handing out sweet treats for families on day trips or even be found rustling up bacon sandwiches for football fans travelling to support their teams. No matter the journey, you'll be on hand to provide an exceptional and personalised experience. You'll have the opportunity to bring a smile to our customers' faces through creating a welcoming on board atmosphere, assisting with luggage, as well as ensuring our customers leave with a positive memory of their journey with us. For our customers travelling in standard class, you'll offer a service from either the cafe bar or deliver a personal at seat service for customers using our 'Lets eat at your seat' app, while taking responsibility for both cash and stock management. Within First Class you'll serve customers our complimentary food and beverage offering, delivered to the highest standards. As a Customer Experience Host you'll also develop a good understanding of health and safety and be trained to ensure a safe, clean and tidy environment onboard our trains at all times. Think you can manage all of this while travelling at 125mph? Then this is the job for you! What you'll need To make it as a Customer Experience Host you'll need: Plenty of customer service experience and strong interpersonal skills A good track record of providing customers with a personalised and memorable service as well as a genuine passion for helping customers The ability to communicate effectively through the toughest of situations and relish stepping up to the challenge of disruption You'll have proven soft sales skills and experience of product management. You'll also enjoy developing your knowledge around our on board offering to share with both customers and colleagues As you will be serving and selling alcohol, you will need to be aged 18 or over to apply Finally, you'll need to be flexible. Our Customer Experience Hosts are on hand to assist our customers early in the morning, late in the evening and over weekends, so you'll need to be able to fully commit to working shifts. As we receive a large number of applications, we're only able to offer personalised feedback once candidates reach the face‑to‑face interview stage. You'll enjoy Free travel on LNER, plus 75% off other companies' tickets (for you and your dependants). Discounted international train tickets (after one year's service). 50% discount on LNER tickets for friends and family. Generous pension scheme. Annual cycle to work schemes/electric vehicle scheme. Discount, savings and cashback scheme from top retailers. Health and wellbeing schemes and discounts. A host of training opportunities to help further your career. Rewards and awards to recognise when you shine. Life at LNER We're on a mission to become the UK's most loved, forward-thinking, and responsible train operating company in the UK. This means making a real difference by doing the right thing for our customers, our people, and the communities and destinations we serve. Together, we're shaping the future of rail travel through our passion, our innovation, and our extraordinary people. Our people are at the heart of everything we do. We're committed to creating an inclusive and engaged culture that supports everyone at every stage of their journey. This means that when you're with LNER, you can truly be yourself—and it's why so many of our colleagues choose to stay and grow with us. items.desc: Position Overview Are you passionate about helping organisations identify, manage and mitigate risk while strengthening resilience and supporting sustainable growth? Join Crux and play a key role in developing and embedding risk management and assurance practices across our global business. Reporting directly to the Head of Quality, Regulatory, Risk & Assurance (QRRA), you will work closely with business leaders across the organisation to lead risk management and assurance activities across all aspects of Crux's global operations. Working with stakeholders across the business, you will proactively identify and assess risks, coordinate assurance activities, monitor emerging risks and support the implementation of effective controls to ensure the business continues to operate safely, compliantly and efficiently. At Crux, we believe curiosity drives innovation. As a specialist consultancy supporting world-leading medical device and consumer product organisations, we combine technical excellence with a collaborative culture to deliver innovative solutions that improve lives. Travel opportunities to support global project delivery Influence the development of life-changing healthcare technologies Be part of a consultancy that values curiosity, integrity, and collaboration Principal Responsibilities Own and develop the business risk and assurance framework across the organisation, ensuring governance, risk and assurance activities are aligned and consistently applied. Maintain and facilitate the company risk management process, working closely with business leaders across the organisation to ensure significant risks are identified, assessed, assigned, appropriately owned and periodically reviewed. Monitor emerging regulatory, technology, governance and operational risks, providing horizon-scanning insights to support proactive decision making. Support governance activities relating to clinical and pre-clinical research, research ethics, patient safety and adverse event management. Establish and oversee governance processes relating to confidentiality, intellectual property, conflicts of interest and sensitive client information. Coordinate assurance activities relating to insurance, liability exposure, international expansion and overseas operations, ensuring appropriate specialist input and risk ownership is established. Prepare risk and assurance reporting for leadership teams, highlighting key trends, emerging risks and areas requiring management attention. Coordinate internal assurance reviews and track the implementation of resulting corrective and improvement actions. Apply the Plan > Do > Check > Act methodology to governance and assurance programmes. Act as project manager for risk management and assurance initiatives, ensuring actions are effectively implemented and monitored. Oversee existing processes including change management, risk and opportunity registers, business policies, and client requests for information (RFIs). Act as Firewall Owner for projects subject to Independent Development controls, including oversight of conflict-of-interest assessments, maintenance of Firewall Registers, project onboarding activities and monitoring of firewall compliance. Maintain oversight of key business policies and controls, ensuring periodic review and organisational compliance. Experience in governance, assurance, risk management or compliance activities, including business and operational risk identification and management. Experience delivering assurance activities, driving organisational improvement and preparing risk, assurance or compliance reporting for leadership teams. Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in a regulated environment. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. items.desc: Join the University of Salford as Project Archivist and play a leading role in unlocking one of our largest and most used archive collections. Funded by Archives Revealed, this exciting project will make 90 metres of the Bridgewater Estates Archive accessible, combining traditional archival expertise with innovative AI-assisted technology to create an online catalogue. We are looking for a proactive and collaborative archivist with experience in cataloguing, archives management and engagement. Working closely with academic colleagues, you will create the online searchable catalogue for the collection, while ensuring high standards of archival description and access. You will also work with researchers, students, community partners and creative practitioners to transform access to local history while developing engagement activities that support research, teaching and public engagement. Key Responsibilities Lead the cataloguing of the Bridgewater Estates Archive, applying ISAD(G) standards, collaborating with academic colleagues to develop an online catalogue, and quality assuring AI-generated metadata to enhance discovery and access. Apply professional archives and collections care expertise, assessing preservation needs and implementing appropriate rehousing and repackaging solutions. Develop and deliver public engagement activities, including a website, talks and learning resources that connect diverse audiences with the collection. Collaborate with academics, researchers, community partners, students and creative practitioners to support workshops that reinterpret the collection in new ways Manage project delivery and reporting, demonstrating strong organisational skills, initiative and the ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment. About the Department Archives and Special Collections is part of the Library, Careers & Skills at the University of Salford and plays a vital role in supporting teaching, learning, research and public engagement through access to unique primary source collections. Our archives document the histories of communities, organisations and individuals, creating opportunities for discovery, creativity and new research. As part of the Content Team, we are committed to making collections accessible, discoverable and impactful through innovative approaches to cataloguing, preservation, digitisation and engagement. We work closely with students, academics, researchers and community partners to unlock the potential of our collections and bring the stories they contain to new and diverse audiences. What's in it for you? Our community - there's a real sense of belonging here at Salford. We value diversity, in backgrounds and in experiences. Our difference makes us stronger, and together we share a passion for improving students' lives The Perks! MySalford, our online employee portal offers a wide range of lifestyle benefits and discounts. You can also access onsite sports and fitness facilities including discounted gym memberships Greater Manchester - live and work in one of the most vibrant regions in the UK Our Peel Park campus is unique with lots of green spaces and great transport links including Salford Crescent train station means we're easy to get to A rewarding career opportunity - where everything you do will make a difference. To our students, our local community, and the world around you Please note this opportunity may close early depending on applicant volume.

 Nell’ambito del piano UniCredit Unlocked, che ha l’obiettivo di mettere al centro i nostri clienti in tutto ciò che facciamo, vogliamo rafforzare la nostra rete commerciale con consulenti solidi e competenti, che sappiano offrire servizi di qualità e soluzioni personalizzate, grazie al supporto di strutture dedicate alla ricerca e inserimento di professionisti. La struttura di Network Development si occupa di individuare ogni opportunità di crescita della Rete Wealth Management che del Private Banking attraverso anche l’analisi/scouting del mercato (ad es. consulenti finanziari abilitati all’offerta fuori sede con contratto di agenzia, dipendenti e/o figure con contratto misto) coordinando le connesse attività di value proposition del Gruppo e di relativa proposizione commerciale, nonchè contribuendo alla definizione dei relativi aspetti contrattuali e di commissioning.
 Cosa farai
 Le principali attività previste nel ruolo di Network Development Specialist sono le seguenti: 
 • Gestione del processo di reclutamento dei Consulenti Finanziari presidiandone, nel tempo, il rapporto contrattuale di concerto con le altre funzioni della Banca competenti nonché presidio del loro aggiornamento professionale, curandone le comunicazioni con gli enti interni ed esterni preposti; 
 • Coordinamento e controllo del processo di definizione, calcolo ed erogazione delle provvigioni agli Agenti; 
 • Predisposizione contrattualistica, sia in offerta che in ingresso, in collaborazione con le strutture di business; 
 • Presidio del rispetto dei requisiti regolamentari e delle disposizioni organizzative previste dal modello di servizio dedicato. 
 Cosa ti occorre
 I principali requisiti per il profilo richiesto sono: 
 o Almeno 2 anni di esperienza in posizione equivalente presso primarie banche o intermediari finanziari; 
 o Ottime capacità relazionali e negoziali 
 o Atteggiamento positivo, capacità di lavorare in team 
 Cosa ti offriamo
 Offriamo la possibilità di entrare in un gruppo bancario paneuropero, con un contratto a tempo indeterminato regolato da CCNL e un pacchetto retributivo competitivo, correlato alla tua reale esperienza. Potrai avvalerti di strumenti all'avanguardia e avrai l'opportunità di relazionarti con tutti i principali interlocutori dei business Private Banking e Wealth Management. 
 La nostra offerta di lavoro include anche: 
 o Salute e benessere: la tua salute e il tuo benessere sono importanti per noi. Ecco perché otterrai vantaggi come l'assicurazione sanitaria, un regime pensionistico completo e l'accesso scontato alle offerte di sport e benessere 
 o Equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata: orari flessibili, periodi sabbatici e diritto a congedi straordinari (ad es. per gli eventi della vita più rilevanti) rendono possibile questo equilibrio 
 o Benefit e servizi agevolati: offriamo ai nostri dipendenti il nostro conto gratuito, ampie offerte assicurative e altri vantaggi di servizi bancari 
 o Ambiente dinamico: farai parte di un ambiente internazionale, collaborativo e di supporto in cui le persone contano. Un luogo dove le persone sanno di essere 
 apprezzate non solo per quello che fanno, ma soprattutto per quello che sono. 
 L’offerta finale sarà definita sulla base dell’esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di responsabilità della persona selezionata. Eventuali ulteriori elementi saranno valutati e considerati nella fase finale di definizione dell’offerta.

Er beinhaltet, allen Stakeholdern erstklassige Produkte und Services zu bieten und dadurch das Potenzial unserer Kund:innen und Mitarbeitenden in ganz Europa zur Entfaltung zu bringen.

 Siemens Mobility is a leading provider of innovative mobility solutions and digital services for the rail industry. With Railigent X , Siemens Mobility provides an open IoT platform enabling predictive maintenance, asset analytics and data-driven services for railway operators worldwide. 
 Railigent X services are deployed across both cloud and on-premise environments. You will be part of the central Test Expert Team, responsible for providing and continuously evolving the test infrastructure for our product development teams and for conducting comprehensive integration and customer -specific system tests. 
 In this role, you drive software quality and testing topics within the development team, combining strong software engineering and test automation skills with a deep understanding of the SDLC, product architecture, and system behavior . You translate complex technical systems and business requirements into effective testing approaches, develop cross-component understanding of the product and its interactions, and act as the link between the development team and the wider QA and architecture communities. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Define, implement, and continuously improve test automation solutions, frameworks, and supporting tools; maintain and extend the existing test framework 
 Develop test concepts and test specifications for Railigent X software solutions based on customer and internal requirements 
 Design, implement, and execute test cases; analyze and document deviations systematically 
 Define and improve team-level testing approaches and QA processes; align with broader QA strategies, standards, and architectural principles 
 Analyze business requirements, technical specifications, and system behavior to derive appropriate testing approaches; identify quality risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities 
 Write high-quality, maintainable code and scripts for test automation, tooling, and QA 
 Collaborate with stakeholders to optimize and evolve agile processes and solutions, incorporating new technologies such as cloud and AI in test automation 
 Support and guide engineers in testing practices; take ownership of QA topics and lead improvements in processes, tools, and methodologies; contribute to cross-team QA discussions 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Degree in a STEM field (preferably Computer Science or Electrical Engineering) or equivalent qualification, combined with several years of professional experience in test automation or software testing 
 Strong programming skills in Python and experience with Playwright, Selenium, Robot Framework, and Cypress; Programming skills in TypeScript are a plus. 
 Solid knowledge of testing complex software systems; practical experience with cloud-based applications (e.g. AWS, Azure) and microservice architectures 
 Good understanding of communication protocols (HTTP, REST APIs) and software architecture (distributed systems, SOA) 
 Strong understanding of software engineering principles and the complete software development lifecycle, including version control, CI/CD, code quality, and debugging 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to understand complex technical systems, business requirements, and domain concepts 
 Several years of experience applying agile methods, ideally including the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) 
 Strong communication, collaboration, and technical leadership skills; ability to work independently and own QA topics 
 Excellent English skills; German is a plus 
 Nice to have: 
 Practical experience applying AI technologies in testing, and testing AI-powered systems (particularly generative AI in production applications) 
 ISTQB certification (e.g. Test Analyst, Test Automation Engineer) 
 Contributions to open-source projects or a public code repository demonstrating relevant software engineering and test automation skills

items.desc: We're starting a dedicated AI team to make our voice agents measurably better, and this is one of its first hires. You'll fine-tune models, build the tests that show what actually improved, dig through real call data, and turn new research into changes that ship. It's a hands-on Python role with plenty of room to shape what the team works on. 𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗶𝘁 Chaseit builds AI voice agents for loan servicing and collections. Our agents make tens of thousands of human-like calls every day for lenders across Europe and beyond. They handle everything from payment reminders to payment-plan negotiation, in 10+ languages, while staying compliant and genuinely empathetic. We're a VC-backed startup with live customers, real revenue, and a lean team where every person has outsized impact. 𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗲𝘅𝗶𝘀𝘁𝘀 Our agents already handle real conversations at scale. Making them meaningfully better from here takes more than prompt changes: models adapted to our domain, a rigorous way to measure every change, and someone keeping up with a field that moves every month. That's what the new AI team is for, and you'll be one of its first members. You'll work closely with our conversation design and deployment teams, who are closest to clients and live agents, and with the engineers who run our platform. What this team works on, and how, will be shaped a lot by its first people. 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗱𝗼 You'll work on the questions that decide how good our agents can get. Would a fine-tuned smaller model match our current setup at half the latency? Which of last month's changes actually improved payment-plan acceptance? Why do calls in one language escalate far more often than in others? You'll design the work to answer them, do it, and make sure the answer ships. You will: Fine-tune and adapt LLMs for our use cases: build training data from real calls, run supervised and preference tuning on open-weight models, and compare results against leading API models on quality, latency and cost Build our evaluation and testing setup: test sets, simulated callers, LLM-as-judge and human review, and regression checks that catch problems before a change goes live Analyse call data at scale: transcripts, outcomes and agent behaviour across clients and languages, to find where agents fail and which fixes are worth making Follow state-of-the-art research in LLMs, speech and agents, reproduce what looks promising, and turn it into experiments with clear answers Look beyond the LLM where it matters: turn-taking, interruptions, response latency, and how speech recognition errors ripple through a conversation Write a lot of Python: data pipelines, training and eval code, analysis, and tools the rest of the company can use Plan your own work: break vague goals like "sound more natural" into concrete experiments, estimate effort, and share findings so others can act on them 𝗪𝗵𝗼 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗮𝗿𝗲 Strong, hands-on Python. You write clean, tested code that others can run and build on, not only notebooks Practical LLM experience beyond calling an API: you've fine-tuned, trained or seriously evaluated models, and you know where that goes wrong Solid ML fundamentals: data splits and leakage, overfitting, choosing the right metric, and enough statistics to tell a real improvement from noise At home with data: SQL and pandas (or similar), and turning messy logs and transcripts into clear findings You read papers, can judge which ideas are worth trying, and can reproduce one from the paper and its code Independent and organised: you take an open-ended goal, plan the steps, and report progress without anyone chasing you Clear written English, because much of the job is explaining results and decisions to people who aren't ML specialists Typically a few years in ML or AI engineering or research, or a strong MSc/PhD with hands-on projects. What you've built matters more than titles 𝗡𝗶𝗰𝗲 𝘁𝗼 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲 Experience with voice AI: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, telephony, or real-time voice agent frameworks such as Pipecat or LiveKit Hands-on work with AI agents of any kind: tool use, multi-step workflows, frameworks such as LangGraph Fine-tuning and serving tools: Hugging Face Transformers and TRL, Unsloth or Axolotl, vLLM Industry-standard automation and analysis tools: orchestration such as Airflow, Prefect or n8n; experiment tracking such as Weights & Biases or MLflow; LLM observability such as Langfuse; BI tools such as Metabase Training and running models on AWS, including GPU jobs (our platform runs on AWS in Frankfurt) Multilingual NLP, especially European languages (our agents speak 10+) Publications, open-source contributions or competition results you can point to Familiarity with lending, collections, or another regulated industry 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗴𝗲𝘁 Salary: €4500 - €7000 gross per month, or more in exceptional cases Equity: early team members get stock options, so you share in what we build One of the first seats on our AI team, with a real say in its direction, tools and …

items.desc: Company NestAI builds the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. Most AI systems are built once, validated at deployment, and expected to stay sufficient after that. That assumption holds until conditions change, and in defence, they always do. Our team develops adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions, deployed in environments where there is no internet, no GPS, and failure is not an option. NestOS, our open, modular, and interoperable platform, enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI has grown to over 200 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry. We're ambitious about what we're building and honest with each other. The bar is high, and so are the standards we hold ourselves to. But this is also a place built on humility, trust, and looking after each other. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, keep reading. Role Description NestAI builds the software and intelligence layer for autonomous defense systems: technology deployed in live operational environments where "it worked in the demo" isn't good enough. We're looking for an AI Engineer (Forward Deployment Engineering) to sit at the center of that mission: embedded directly in customer environments, at the intersection of advanced machine learning and real-world execution. This is a high-agency role with no clean spec. You'll shorten the distance between prototype and fielded capability, validating our technology against operational reality, adapting it on the fly to the constraints and data of each deployment, and feeding what you learn back into the core product. Most of what you encounter here won't have a known answer yet; you'll work it out alongside a small, senior team that has full ownership of the problems in front of it, and a product organization that takes field feedback seriously enough to ship it back into the platform in days, not quarters. We're looking for strong AI/ML engineers with real breadth across machine learning, deep learning, decision-making, and increasingly LLM-driven or agentic workflows — people who can adapt to whatever a deployment demands. Solid grounding in signal processing, whether from classical methods or modern learned/deep approaches, is particularly valuable given the sensor-heavy, real-time nature of our operating environments, but we don't expect mastery of both AI and signal processing in one person. Day-to-Day Responsibilities: Working directly with customer teams to understand operational requirements, constraints, and failure modes, and translating those into concrete technical problems. Designing and implementing algorithms for sequential decision-making, autonomous behavior, or specialized application workflows — drawing on whichever combination of ML, LLMs, control, or signal processing the deployment calls for, often alongside teammates with complementary backgrounds. Adapting and fine-tuning models to perform reliably against real operational data, which is often noisier and more constrained than anything you've seen in the lab. Rapidly building and iterating on prototypes in the field or in customer development environments, then hardening the ones that prove out for production. Collaborating with our internal platform, embedded, and perception teams to bring field learnings back into NestOS and ensure deployed solutions are supportable long-term. Building lightweight simulations, test harnesses, or data pipelines on-site to validate algorithms before they scale. Adapting state-of-the-art research in deep learning, signal processing, reinforcement learning, or NLP/LLMs into working, production-ready code under real deployment pressure. Qualifications: Working knowledge of signal processing: either a strong background in classical Digital Signal Processing (filtering, spectral analysis, estimation) or in modern learned/deep approaches to signal data, with genuine curiosity about the other side. Strong working knowledge of machine learning theory and common deep learning architectures, with the ability to pick up new subfields (decision-making, reinforcement learning, LLMs, or signal processing) as a deployment requires. Proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and modern LLM tooling (e.g., Ollama, LangChain). Strong communication skills and genuine comfort engaging with customer or non-ML stakeholders; a consultative mindset is a plus but can be developed on the job with support from the team. You are also able to communicate fluently in Swedish with our local customers. Understanding of data processing pipelines and model deployment basics (predominantly edge-based). items.desc: About Verve At Verve, we’re redefining how insight works in an AI-powered world — combining Human, Cultural and Artificial Intelligence to help clients act with greater speed and confidence. Through Verve Vero — our AI-powered platform and consultancy ecosystem — we build AI-enabled insight tools, simulations and models that bring human truth into the heart of decision-making. From Verve Intelligent Personas & Simulations to bespoke solutions grounded in client data, everything we create is designed to enable confident decisions of consequence with real-world impact. Our work spans categories and continents, helping global brands navigate complex challenges — from innovation and brand strategy to customer experience and future planning. We combine deep human understanding with AI to deliver insight that is faster, more scalable, and more actionable. This is a hands-on environment. We move quickly, test and learn, and continuously build and refine the tools that power our work. Curiosity, experimentation and practical application sit at the heart of how we operate. About the Role If you’re a hands-on technical builder who wants to experiment with AI and turn ideas into working products — this is it. As a Technical AI Developer in our R&D Lab, you’ll be responsible for bringing ideas to life — rapidly prototyping, testing emerging technologies and building the technical foundations of new Vero tools and processes. This isn’t a role where you’ll simply oversee development. You’ll build. You’ll work closely with our product team and wider R&D colleagues to explore what’s possible, test ideas quickly and turn the strongest experiments into robust, scalable solutions. You & your role As an AI Engineer - RAG Platform, you are responsible for continuously improving the quality, accuracy and effectiveness of Client's internal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform. You work at the intersection of Information Retrieval, Data Science and Software Engineering. Rather than building AI applications or platform infrastructure, your primary responsibility is improving the performance of the RAG system itself. The RAG platform serves thousands of users across Client and acts as a foundation for multiple AI-powered products. Your focus is understanding where and why the system underperforms, designing experiments to validate improvements and translating insights into measurable production outcomes. You contribute across the entire improvement lifecycle, from failure analysis and hypothesis generation to evaluation, implementation and monitoring. You leverage user feedback, retrieval metrics, evaluation datasets and production telemetry to continuously increase answer quality and user trust. This role is designed for a highly analytical and hands-on specialist who wants to deepen their expertise in retrieval systems, evaluation methodologies and applied AI rather than moving towards people management or generic product development. You will work closely with Software Engineers, Platform Engineers, Data Scientists and Product Managers, while acting as the driving force behind the continuous improvement of Client's RAG capabilities. Examples of what you will work on What kind of challenges could land on your sprint board? Investigating why certain user questions produce lower-quality answers and identifying the underlying retrieval or grounding issues; Improving our automated evaluation framework to measure retrieval quality, answer quality and user satisfaction; Running large-scale experiments to determine the impact of different chunking, embedding and retrieval strategies; Analyzing user interactions and system performance data in Databricks to uncover improvement opportunities; Building feedback loops that continuously identify weak responses and feed insights back into the development process; Defining and monitoring quality metrics that ensure every release results in measurable model improvements. Facts & figures What gives this role its reach and relevance? 36 hours per week; A strategic AI platform used across Client; Working on a production AI system where quality improvements directly impact thousands of users; Part of a multidisciplinary team combining engineering, product and AI expertise; Key responsibilities Drive continuous RAG model improvement Improve retrieval performance, answer quality and overall user experience through experimentation, analysis and optimization. Build evaluation and measurement capabilities Develop automated frameworks that measure RAG quality, identify regressions and provide actionable insights for future improvements. Turn insights into production outcomes Translate data analysis and experimentation results into scalable, maintainable engineering solutions that deliver measurable business value. Together we achieve more than alone The RAG platform is not a research project. It is a production product that must continuously improve. You will join a team of experienced engineers who are building and operating critical AI capabilities within Client. Success in this role comes from combining scientific rigor with engineering excellence. We value people who challenge assumptions, validate ideas through data and continuously raise the quality bar. You & your talent We are looking for someone who enjoys solving hard problems and is driven by measurable outcomes. Someone who is equally comfortable discussing statistical significance, retrieval metrics and system architecture. You take ownership of results rather than activities. You are naturally curious, analytical and passionate about improving complex systems. Mandatory skills Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG); Large Language Models (LLMs); Python; Databricks; Evaluation frameworks for GenAI systems; Embedding models; Prompt optimization; Data pipelines and workflow automation; CI/CD practices; Azure. Nice to have Experience with fine-tuning language models; Experience with ranking and retrieval systems; Experience with AI observability and monitoring; Experience working with large-scale production AI platforms; Knowledge of synthetic evaluation datasets and benchmark creation. items.desc: Smartedge Client is looking for an individual to help with their AI Engineer (RAG Platform) @ Utrecht, Netherlands (Hybrid Working) Job description As an AI Engineer - RAG Platform, you are responsible for continuously improving the quality, accuracy, and effectiveness of Client's internal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform. You work at the intersection of Information Retrieval, Data Science and Software Engineering. Rather than building AI applications or platform infrastructure, your primary responsibility is improving the performance of the RAG system itself. The RAG platform serves thousands of users across Client and acts as a foundation for multiple AI-powered products. Your focus is understanding where and why the system underperforms, designing experiments to validate improvements and translating insights into measurable production outcomes. You contribute across the entire improvement lifecycle, from failure analysis and hypothesis generation to evaluation, implementation and monitoring. You leverage user feedback, retrieval metrics, evaluation datasets and production telemetry to continuously increase answer quality and user trust. This role is designed for a highly analytical and hands-on specialist who wants to deepen their expertise in retrieval systems, evaluation methodologies and applied AI rather than moving towards people management or generic product development. A strategic AI platform used across Client. Working on a production AI system where quality improvements directly impact thousands of users. Part of a multidisciplinary team combining engineering, product, and AI expertise. Please clearly indicate in the motivation field whether the candidate has any planned vacation or special leave during the duration of this assignment. Want to improve one of Client's most strategic AI platforms through data-driven experimentation and measurable model improvements? You will work closely with Software Engineers, Platform Engineers, Data Scientists and Product Managers, while acting as the driving force behind the continuous improvement of Client's RAG capabilities. What kind of challenges could land on your sprint board? Investigating why certain user questions produce lower-quality answers and identifying the underlying retrieval or grounding issues; Improving our automated evaluation framework to measure retrieval quality, answer quality and user satisfaction; Running large-scale experiments to determine the impact of different chunking, embedding and retrieval strategies; Analyzing user interactions and system performance data in Databricks to uncover improvement opportunities; Building feedback loops that continuously identify weak responses and feed insights back into the development process; Defining and monitoring quality metrics that ensure every release results in measurable model improvements. Key responsibilities Drive continuous RAG model improvement Improve retrieval performance, answer quality and overall user experience through experimentation, analysis and optimization. Build evaluation and measurement capabilities Develop automated frameworks that measure RAG quality, identify regressions and provide actionable insights for future improvements. Turn insights into production outcomes Translate data analysis and experimentation results into scalable, maintainable engineering solutions that deliver measurable business value. Together we achieve more than alone The RAG platform is not a research project. It is a production product that must continuously improve. You will join a team of experienced engineers who are building and operating critical AI capabilities within Client. items.desc: The Opportunity Newfire Global Partners is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer for a high-impact engagement with a national healthcare organization. You will build the production systems that move machine learning and AI from experimentation into secure, reliable use across clinical and operational workflows. This role sits at the intersection of data science, software engineering and cloud platforms. You will develop reusable pipelines and inference services, improve the machine learning platform and make sure models remain observable, scalable, governed and cost-effective in production. What You Will Do Production Machine Learning Own the engineering lifecycle from technical design and model handoff through deployment, monitoring, retraining, rollback, retirement and incident response. Build reusable batch, streaming and real-time pipelines for training and inference. Develop containerized model services and APIs with clear contracts, versioning, resilience and rollback patterns. Integrate model outputs into healthcare products and clinical or operational workflows. Platform Engineering and MLOps Build automated CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code workflows for packaging, validation, security scanning and deployment across environments. Use Python, SQL, PySpark, Delta Lake, MLflow and Unity Catalog within Azure and Databricks environments. Implement model registration, approval, lineage, reproducibility, access control and auditability. Improve developer experience through shared libraries, templates, automated testing, documentation and code review. Support capacity planning, performance tuning and cost-aware cloud architecture. Reliability and Observability Define controls for data quality, feature availability, latency, service reliability, model performance, drift, bias and cost. Establish service objectives, alerts, runbooks, escalation paths and production troubleshooting practices. Create safe processes for retraining, environment promotion, rollback and incident response. Healthcare Data and Governance Engineer dependable feature and training datasets from claims, EHR, laboratory and care operations data. Build controls for provenance, schema changes, freshness, data leakage and training-serving consistency. Protect health information through secure engineering practices appropriate for HIPAA-regulated environments and HITRUST-aligned controls. Support models that may influence clinical or patient-facing decisions with appropriate documentation and governance. Implement technical controls supporting clinical validation, human oversight, auditability, and safe-failure mechanisms for AI solutions influencing patient care. Applied Generative AI Evaluate and operationalize foundation models, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, model gateways and agentic workflows when appropriate. Apply sound judgment about where generative AI adds value and where simpler approaches provide better reliability or economics. Implement evaluation, security, quality and supportability requirements before emerging capabilities reach production. Technical Partnership Convert research code into modular, tested and maintainable production software in partnership with data scientists. Establish engineering acceptance criteria and challenge designs that will not scale or operate safely. Translate ambiguous clinical or business needs into measurable engineering requirements. Explain architecture choices, delivery risks and production performance to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. What Success Looks Like Machine learning solutions move from experimentation to production through a repeatable engineering path. Production services remain reliable, observable, secure and cost-conscious. Data scientists can move faster because common platform capabilities and deployment patterns already exist. Models and AI services can be reproduced, governed, monitored and safely retired. Production performance is measured and continuously improved through KPIs for service reliability, inference latency, model quality, data freshness, and operating cost. Skills, Knowledge & Expertise Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, statistics or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. At least three years of experience building and operating production software, data or machine learning systems. At least two years of experience deploying and supporting machine learning models in production. Strong Python and SQL skills, plus experience with PySpark and distributed data processing. Demonstrated ability to write modular, tested and maintainable software. Hands-on experience with Azure and Databricks or comparable cloud and lakehouse platforms. Experience serving models through scheduled batch workloads, streaming pipelines or real-time APIs using containers and orchestration tools. items.card: You will feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company committed to employee development, collaboration and long-term career growth. Role Overview: This is an exciting opportunity to join Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) Benelux as a Risk Engineer / Consultant Construction & Liability . In this role, you will assess complex construction and liability risks and act as a trusted advisor to customers,
items.desc:
About Us: 
 In today’s complex world, tackling risk is fast-paced, unpredictable and rewarding. Challenge yourself to find ways to protect the things people value from all kinds of risks, big and small. If you want to love what you do, work with us.
With about 55,000 employees serving customers in more than 170 countries, Zurich is one of the world's leading insurers. Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) is Zurich's global risk engineering and advisory business, bringing together approximately 1,000 risk professionals around the world who help customers understand, manage and build resilience against a wide range of risks. The success of our business is built on the contributions of our highly talented employees. You will feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company committed to employee development, collaboration and long-term career growth.
 Role Overview: 
 This is an exciting opportunity to join Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) Benelux as a Risk Engineer / Consultant Construction & Liability .
In this role, you will assess complex construction and liability risks and act as a trusted advisor to customers, Underwriting and other key stakeholders. You will help customers identify, evaluate and manage risks across construction projects, operations, products and services, supporting both resilience and informed underwriting decisions. Drawing on your technical expertise and practical experience, you will provide risk consulting services, conduct site surveys and assessments, and deliver pragmatic recommendations that help customers manage risk effectively. As part of Zurich Resilience Solutions, a global network of approximately 1,000 risk professionals, you will collaborate with experts across disciplines including Property, Marine, Energy, Natural Hazards & Climate, Cyber and Business Continuity to deliver holistic risk solutions.
This is a full-time or part-time role with occasional travel in Benelux and internationally.
Key Responsibilities: 
 Deliver construction, product liability and general liability risk consulting services to customers across a range of industries.
 Act as a trusted advisor to customers, Underwriting and other stakeholders on construction and liability risk matters.
 Conduct desk-based reviews and on-site surveys, providing clear risk assessments and practical recommendations.
 Evaluate construction projects, operational activities and liability exposures to support underwriting and risk management decisions.
 Review project execution, quality and safety standards, and identify opportunities for risk improvement.
 Support claims investigations and provide expertise on losses and emerging risks.
 Collaborate with other ZRS risk disciplines to deliver integrated risk solutions.
 Contribute to knowledge sharing, business development and the continuous enhancement of Zurich's risk consulting capabilities.
Qualifications: 
 Degree in Engineering, Construction, or another relevant technical discipline.
 Experience in construction, liability, risk engineering or a related field.
 Strong understanding of construction risks, project execution, quality and safety standards, and risk management principles.
 Experience with complex commercial and/or industrial construction projects is preferred.
 Ability to analyse complex risks and translate findings into practical recommendations.
 Strong communication, relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
 Collaborative mindset with an interest in working across multiple risk disciplines.
 Professional accreditation, international experience and additional language skills are an advantage.
What You Can Expect From Us: 
 Flexible working options include part-time, job-share and full-time opportunities. 
 A varied, challenging and rewarding role with significant autonomy. 
 Collaboration with an experienced and high-performing international team. 
 Exposure to a broad range of industries, construction projects and liability challenges.
 Access to innovative risk engineering tools, technologies and global expertise.
 Opportunities to work alongside specialists from multiple risk disciplines.
 Ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities within a leading global insurer.
How to Apply: 
 Please submit your resume and any supporting information demonstrating your experience and suitability for the role. We look forward to hearing from talented professionals who are passionate about risk consulting and helping customers thrive. 
Join Zurich Benelux and take the next step in your career. We can create a brighter future together!

 Proven agile delivery (Scrum/Kanban). 
 Fluent in English. 
 Experience with UAT, release planning, and performance/security validation. 
 Familiarity with insurance risk modeling or exposure data.

items.desc:
Voor ons filiaal in Genk (Collegelaan) zoeken we momenteel een Audicien - Audioloog ! 
 Wil jij als audicien/audioloog de meest geschikte hooroplossing vinden voor onze klanten en zo hun levenskwaliteit en gezondheid verbeteren? 
Wil jij terechtkomen in een warm team, met toffe collega’s die kwaliteit vooropstellen? 
Wil jij jezelf blijven ontwikkelen en daarin gestimuleerd en ondersteund worden? 
 Ja, ja, en nog eens ja? 
Met je diploma Audiologie (BA of MA), een RIZIV nummer op zak én een stevige portie empathie sta jij te popelen om iedereen die ons hoorcentrum binnenkomt, verder te helpen. 
 Herken jij je hierin: 
 Variatie in je job maakt je gelukkig - Iedere dag en iedere klant zal verschillend zijn
 Oog voor detail, dat heb jij – En dat zal van pas komen bij het uitvoeren van verschillende geavanceerde audiometrische testen om de meeste geschikte hooroplossing voor te stellen
 Verantwoordelijkheid nemen is voor jou een evidentie – Wij kunnen op beide oren slapen, jij volgt het gehele proces op van A tot Z
 Commerciële feeling komt vanzelf – Je zet je in om te zorgen voor een uitnodigend hoorcentrum waar mensen zich welkom voelen
 Je bent een geboren netwerker – Je bouwt de nodige professionele contacten op met NKO-artsen en huisartsen.
 Nog steeds enthousiast? 
Weet dat je komt werken bij de marktleider van hooroplossingen in België, met meer dan 270 hoorcentra in België en meer dan 70 jaar expertise, die op zijn beurt behoort tot de Sonova Group, de belangrijkste fabrikant van hooroplossingen ter wereld.
 Bovendien bieden wij je: 
 Een voltijds contract van onbepaalde duur, met start idealiter in december 2026. 
 Extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, ADV-dagen, groepsverzekering en hospitalisatieverzekering, GSM, bedrijfswagen, 13de maand en flex income plan. 
 Verder krijg je ook een gepersonaliseerd ontwikkelingsplan met kwalitatieve coaching en feedbackmomenten om je professionele vaardigheden te ontwikkelen.
 De garantie dat je écht een verschil kan maken voor mensen met gehoorverlies. Hoe geweldig is dat?

items.desc:
High-tech car manufacturing fur us. An inspiring, innovative workplace for you.
 At the BMW Group, everything starts with passion. It turns a profession into a vocation. It drives us to keep reinventing mobility and bring innovative ideas onto the roads. Enthusiasm for joint projects turns a team into a strong unit where every opinion is valued. It is only when expertise, highly professional processes and enjoyment of work unite that we can shape the future together. All employees can and should contribute with their special skills to the unique culture of the BMW Group. We're searching for people who are as passionate as we are. Your expertise, your skill set, your motivation, and your individuality are what drive us forward. As a Quality Steering Specialist at BMW Group Plant Debrecen you're a crucial part of our vision to revolutionize the way we think about cars.
 What awaits you? 
 Work environment – you work in a modern and well-equipped office environment at Plant Debrecen, with access to all tools and systems needed for efficient daily operations. 
 Team environment – you become part of a motivated, supportive, and collaborative team of quality specialists working in a dynamic automotive production environment. 
 Quality steering & customer protection – you are responsible for quality steering and for identifying quality-related topics (Q-topics) for specific vehicle components, ensuring customer protection in close collaboration with various departments across the plant. 
 Cross-functional coordination – you act as the link between the plant and the broader process chain, introducing qualified quality topics into the control loops of product lines, driving their implementation, and confirming effectiveness after corrective measures have been applied. 
 Collaboration & stakeholder management – you work closely with quality specialists across plant technologies and product lines, as well as with counterparts at other production sites, ensuring alignment and best practice sharing.
 What should you bring along?
 Educational background – you have a degree in technical discipline or a comparable qualification with relevant advanced training. 
 Professional experience – you gained 2+ years of work experience in quality management and production, ideally within the automotive industry. 
 Work schedule – you are willing to work on-site during regular business hours. Remote work may be considered based on alignment with your line manager. 
 Industry knowledge – you obtain strong automotive product knowledge and experience within a vehicle development environment. 
 Technical skills – you are confident with handling of MS Office; experienced with big data analysis and identifying quality patterns is considered an advantage. 
 Additional expertise – if you have electrotechnical knowledge that is a plus. 
 Language skills – you speak English fluently; Hungarian and German language skills are an advantage.
 What do we offer?
 Our goal is to motivate our employees and recognize their performance, which is why our benefits package includes the following elements in addition to the base salary:
 Bonus – performance-based bonus calculated based on corporate and personal results. 
 Cafeteria – annual cafeteria allowance paid out monthly. 
 Commuting Support – free, direct bus and train services from major cities in the region, aligned with shift schedules. Travel cost reimbursement for personal car usage is provided at the legally prescribed rate. 
 Healthcare Services – high-quality healthcare services, physiotherapy, and therapeutic exercise options are available at the on-site health center. 
 Private Health Insurance – after probation time, all associates entitled for health insurance, which contains outpatient care, laboratory- and diagnostics tests, outpatient and one-day surgery, screening tests, patient transport. 
 Accident and Life Insurance – in work and out of work group accident and life insurance. 
 Subsidized Meals – one daily discounted hot meal at the company cafeteria. 
 Employee car rental programme . 
 Learn more about our benefits via this link: BMW Group Plant Debrecen Careers | About us | What we offer, 
 Type of employment: 
Full-time, permanent employment. 
 Please kindly be aware that we can only consider applications in English. If you have any further questions, please contact our recruitment partner at +3652333603 on weekdays between 8:00 AM and 4:30 PM. 
 At the BMW Group, we place great importance on equal treatment and equal opportunities. Our recruiting decisions are based on the personality, experience, and skills of the applicants. 
 Learn more here . 
 Build the future with us!

items.desc:
Nekünk a csúcstechnológiás gyártás. Neked szakmai büszkeség. 
 A BMW csoportnál minden az elhivatottsággal kezdődik, amely képes egy szakmát hivatássá változtatni. Elhivatottságunk késztet bennünket arra, hogy folyamatosan újra értelmezzük a mobilitást, és innovatív ötleteket vigyünk az utakra. A közös projektek iránti lelkesedés alakít egy csapatot erős egységgé, ahol minden ötletet és véleményt értékelünk. Csak ha a szakértelem, a professzionális folyamatok és a munka élvezete egyesül, akkor alakíthatjuk együtt a jövőt. Olyan kollégákat keresünk, akik ugyanolyan elhivatottak, mint mi. A szakértelmed, a készségeid, a motivációd és az egyéniséged visznek minket előre. Mint a BMW Group Gyár Debrecen Adatelemző munkatársa, kulcsfontosságú szerepet töltesz be abban, hogy forradalmasítsuk azt, ahogyan az autózásról gondolkodunk.
 Mint a BMW Group Gyár Debrecen Adatelemző munkatársa te felelsz majd a minőségirányítási rendszerhez kapcsolódó IT-témák fejlesztéséért és továbbfejlesztéséért, valamint a gyártási adatok elemzésén és átláthatóvá tételén keresztül támogatod az adatvezérelt döntéshozatalt és egy jövőorientált gyártási rendszer kialakítását.
 Mi vár rád? 
 Munkakörnyezet – egy modern, digitalizált és jövőorientált gyártási környezetben dolgozol majd, ahol a legújabb technológiák és innovatív megoldások támogatják az elektromos járművek energia moduljainak gyártását.
 Csapat – egy magasan képzett csapat tagjaként dolgozol, amely a gyártási adatok felhasználásával támogatja az adatvezérelt döntéshozatalt és a minőségirányítás folyamatos fejlesztését.
 Minőségirányítás – felelős leszel a Quality Management System bevezetéséért az energia modulok gyártási területén, valamint annak folyamatos fejlesztéséért.

 Feladatok 
 Nyomtatott áramköri lapokon végzett hibaanalízis.
 Új hibaképek felismerése, megoldási javaslatok tétele.

 Munkaeszközök, berendezések karbantartása.
 Elvárások 
 Villamos vagy elektrotechnikai szakirányú végzettség
 Gyártóterületen szerzett tapasztalat
 Kiemelt finommotorikai képesség
 Rajzok és munkautasítások olvasásának képessége
 Problémamegoldó képesség
 MES rendszer használata
 Amit mi ígérünk 
 Kultúránk gyökere a robotika és a könnyű, felhasználóbarét automatizálási megoldások iránti szenvedélyünkben rejlik. Az eredmény? Világszerte egyszerűbbé és biztonságosabbá tesszük az emberek életét. Vállalatunk lelke a sokszínűség – nagyra értékelünk minden egyes ragyogó és merész ötletet. Mindenkit arra bíztatunk, hogy munkája során legyen teljesen önmaga, ezáltal egy olyan környezet tud létrejönni, ahol az inspiráció, a szakértelem és a személyes fejlődés kibontakozhat. Közös célunk? A nagyszerűség és az innovatív, pozitív változások beindítása és elérése – nem csak az automatizálási iparágon belül, hanem annak határain túl is.
 Juttatások és támogatások 
 Elkötelezettek vagyunk munkatársaink jóléte iránt, ezért juttatások széles skáláját biztosítjuk, a versenyképes juttatási csomagoktól a rugalmas munkarenden át a szakmai fejlődési lehetőségekig. Mindezzel célunk, hogy munkavállalóink elégedettek legyenek. Hiszünk abban, hogy munkatársaink elkötelezettségét és kemény munkáját elismerés illeti, és juttatásaink tükrözik ezt a hozzáállásunkat. Célunk, hogy olyan munkahelyet hozzunk létre, ahol az alkalmazottak értékesnek érzik magukat, inspiráltak és motiváltak, hogy a legjobbat hozzák ki magukból. Csatlakozz hozzánk, és élvezd az előnyeit egy olyan vállalatnak, amely a csapatának a jóllétét és fejlődését helyezi előtérbe!
 Sokszínűség, méltányosság és elfogadás 
 Alapvető meggyőződésünk, hogy kedvesen, nyitottan és kölcsönös tisztelettel egymás iránt egy olyan környezetet teremthetünk, ahol mindenki önmaga lehet a munkája során. 
 A KUKA az esélyegyenlőség iránt elkötelezett vállalat. Minden jelentkezést aprólékos gondossággal és odafigyeléssel kezelünk – olyan döntéshozatali folyamattal, amelyet nem befolyásol a származás, az iskolai végzettség, az életkor, a nem, a szexuális irányultság, továbbá a vallási vagy a politikai meggyőződés sem. Ha csatlakozol a KUKA-hoz, rengeteg lehetőséged lesz arra, hogy megoszd, mi motivál téged, és mi határozza meg egyéniségedet, ha szeretnéd.
 Csatlakozz az utazáshoz! 
 Ha úgy gondolod, hogy a KUKA által kínált karrier az, amit keresel, szívesen hallanánk felőled.
 Várjuk jelentkezésedet!

DISCOVER PIRELLI 
 We are a global leader in the tire industry, specialized in designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing high-performance tires for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. With a presence in over 160 countries and around 18 production facilities, we pride ourselves on our cutting-edge technology and commitment to sustainability. Innovation is at the heart of everything we do, and it is fueled by our commitment to the inclusion of unique perspectives and different experiences. Because power is nothing without our people! 
 WHY JOIN US 
 We are offering a rewarding role with scope for career progression along with:
 International, engaging, and supportive working environment
 Personal and professional development
 A highly technological and constantly evolving production environment
 Continuous technical training and opportunities for professional growth
 YOUR CORE ACTIVITIES 
 We are looking for a Production Assistant to join our team. This role is responsible for the operational and managerial coordination of production and maintenance activities in a high-automation department, ensuring the continuity and efficiency of production and automation systems, product quality, and compliance with safety regulations.
 Key responsibilities include:
 Coordinate daily production and automation activities, ensuring alignment with production plans and quality standards
 Organize preventive and corrective maintenance in collaboration with the technical team to minimize machine downtime
 Deal with suppliers and engineering department (at Plant and HQ level) in order to implement new procedures on automated systems, analyze problems and facilitate the conduction of machines
 Manage attendance, leave, overtime, and shift planning to ensure operational continuity
 Track and analyze production data and automatic systems, activating escalation procedures for complex technical issues
 Ensure adherence to operational procedures and workplace safety regulations
 Supervise, motivate, and support the growth of production and maintenance staff, including training and upskilling initiatives.Facilitate interdepartmental communication and collaborate with HR to manage disciplinary actions and resolve operational conflicts
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electronic, Automation, Management)
 1-3 years of experience in industrial production/maintenance with leadership roles
 Deep knowledge of production processes
 Proficiency in management software and reporting tools
 WHAT PUTS YOU IN POLE POSITION 
 Excellent organizational and planning abilities
 Strong leadership, team management, and problem-solving skills
 COMPENSATION PACKAGE 
 The employment contract will be regulated by “Gomma Plastica” National Collective Bargaining Agreement
 The gross annual base salary (RAL) offered will be no less than € 32.000
 The Company is committed to offering a competitive compensation package and, following the selection process, may propose a final gross annual base salary above the stated level, commensurate with the candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications

VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 1 850 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 550 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 300 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 1000 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch je možné získať jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Si ambiciózny/a? Máš v sebe ducha obchodníka? Rád/rada kominukuješ? Máš bankovú prax? Ak si odpovedal/a na všetky otázky áno, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku pre VÚB!
Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
Ako si šikovný/á, toľko si aj zarobíš.
A okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.

 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov!

items.desc: The Role We deploy agentic AI systems that handle real insurance claims for DAX-listed insurers. Not demos. Not decks. Production. We need an AI operator to get into the trenches - operate pilots hands-on, identify where AI replaces manual work, and build the systems that make it scalable. You will become our internal expert on frontier AI - and Claude specifically. That's not a side responsibility. It's a core part of the job. You will work directly with the founders (ex-BCG PLs) and elite AI engineers (ex-Amazon, ex-Meta). You'll sit in rooms with C-level insurance executives, helping us deliver product excellence and scale accounts. But first, you'll process claims, fix edge cases, and ship, leveraging AI. Aufgaben What You'll Do Master the tools. You'll develop deep, hands-on proficiency with Claude: prompt engineering, context management, multi-step reasoning, structured outputs, agentic workflows. You'll know the difference between a prompt that works in a demo and one that holds up across 10,000 real claims. You'll track model releases, test new capabilities the week they drop, and form a clear-eyed view of what's actually better - and what's hype. Deliver. Support enterprise pilot launches - from first claim to full operational rollout. You'll be in the room when things go wrong, and you'll be the one who fixes them. You'll learn what separates a pilot that converts into a multi-million € annual contract from one that stalls - and you'll build the operational muscle to make the former the default. Build. Every manual process is a target. You'll map workflows, identify failure points, and design automated systems that don't need babysitting. That means writing SOPs, building review queues, configuring AI pipelines, and ensuring the output meets the quality bar of a DAX-listed insurer communicating with its customers. Quality here isn't a vibe - it's measurable, and you own the measurement. Scale. Once something works, your job is to make it run without you. You'll identify bottlenecks, compress cycle times, and hand off systems that are documented, reliable, and ready for the next 10x of volume. The best outcome is that what you built keeps working after you've moved on to the next problem. (Internship) Year 1 Year 2+ (Internship): You start at the source. You won't learn our processes from a manual, but through hands-on execution: structuring data, analyzing client feedback, and automating your first sub-processes. You'll get real exposure to how a VC-backed AI startup operates - the decisions, the trade-offs, the pace. Your goal is to understand how the business breathes at its core, build a track record, and see if there's a long-term fit. Year 1: You're in the details. Processing claims, supporting client reviews, building fully automated workflows. You'll deepen your AI expertise - mastering the tools inside-out, running experiments, iterating fast. You'll gain strategic context - C-level meetings, business model exposure, full pilot lifecycle - but you earn it through operational results. No shortcuts. Year 2+: Paths open based on what you build. Account Ownership - own a major enterprise account end-to-end: commercial relationship, delivery quality, expansion AI Solutions - build the platform and own the delivery model across all clients Back in the trenches - launch the next pilot, compress timelines further, reset the benchmark Qualifikation What You Bring Top academic track record or equivalent proof of raw horsepower 0-3 years of experience in high-intensity environments: consulting, banking, or a BizOps / strategy role at a VC-backed startup Real proficiency with Claude or comparable frontier AI tools - you've used them extensively, you know how to prompt well, and you have an intuition for where they fail Structured, analytical thinking; comfortable building models, interpreting data, and turning outputs into decisions Strong project management instincts - you track what's moving, flag what's stuck, and close the loop without being asked Exceptional written and verbal communication - you can write a crisp client memo and a clear internal Slack message with equal ease German and English fluency Non-Negotiables Client-first. The insurer is your client. Their success is your KPI. Their customer's experience is your quality standard. Quality-obsessed. AI output going to a DAX insurer's customers must be flawless. Every edge case matters. You don't ship and hope - you verify. Extreme ownership. You see a problem, you own it until it's solved. No hand-offs to nobody. No "that's not my job." Benefits Why inca Timing. We're at the earliest stage of a category-defining company. The people who join now shape what this becomes - the culture, the processes, the product.
