items.desc: Chez Smile, on construit des solutions numériques ouvertes, performantes et durables, pour des acteurs majeurs de l’industrie, des services et du grand public. Ici, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la conception et l'évolution de leurs plateformes digitales à très forte audience et forte charge. Pas de techno imposée pour l’effet vitrine — les bons outils, maîtrisés de bout en bout. 1 500 experts à travers l’Europe, et une vraie culture de la qualité logicielle. La Mission En régie, intégré(e) à une équipe pluridisciplinaire en méthodologie Agile (Scrum / SAFe), vous concevez et développez les API et les microservices back-end en Node.js au cœur des écosystèmes applicatifs. Votre rôle se joue en trois temps : Concevoir et développer le back-end Vous concevez et développez des API REST et GraphQL performantes et hautement scalables en Node.js (TypeScript / Express / NestJS) pour supporter les fortes montées de charge. Vous mettez en œuvre une architecture orientée événements et microservices (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Redis) : couplage lâche, faible latence et cohérence des données. Vous appliquez les principes SOLID, les design patterns et l’architecture hexagonale / DDD — c’est vous le garant de la solidité de la conception. Garantir la qualité et fiabiliser Vous pratiquez le TDD / BDD et construisez une stratégie de test complète : unitaires, intégration, contractuels et E2E (Jest, Supertest, Mocha). Vous appliquez le Clean Code, le refactoring continu et les bonnes pratiques de sécurité (OWASP, gestion des identités et accès). Vous documentez l’architecture (Confluence, OpenAPI/Swagger) et livrez des services prêts pour la production. Déployer et faire progresser Vous déployez et gérez les microservices dans un environnement Cloud (AWS / GCP / Kubernetes) via une chaîne CI/CD automatisée (GitLab CI / GitHub Actions). Vous intégrez les assistants de code IA (GitHub Copilot) à votre quotidien : accélération, génération de tests et refactoring, avec un regard critique sur les résultats. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes Front, Ops et produit. Smile s’engage pour un environnement où la diversité est une force et l’inclusion un pilier. Chaque talent est reconnu, respecté et encouragé à aller plus loin. Votre environnement technique Langages / Frameworks : Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, Express.js Architecture : Microservices, Event-Driven (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Pub/Sub), REST, GraphQL, OpenAPI/Swagger, architecture hexagonale Bases de données : PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis Cloud & DevOps : AWS / GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) Qualité & Tests : Jest, Supertest, SonarQube, TDD Outillage IA : GitHub Copilot, assistants LLM Votre Profil Vous avez 4 ans d’expérience minimum en développement back-end Node.js / TypeScript et le goût du code propre, scalable et testé. On parie que vous cochez aussi ces cases : Maîtrise experte de Node.js, TypeScript et de la conception d’API RESTful et GraphQL. Expérience des architectures microservices, de la gestion du cache (Redis) et des flux événementiels. Pratique poussée du TDD et d’une stratégie de test complète. Sensibilité aux problématiques Cloud / DevOps (Docker, CI/CD) et d'optimisation de performances. Pratique des méthodes Agiles (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe). Rémunération : Selon profil et expérience. Votre future Agence Avec plus de 400 passionnés, l’agence d'Asnières-sur-Seine (notre siège) est un véritable terrain de jeu pour les experts et les curieux qui veulent progresser et innover. Pourquoi Smile ! Notre management de proximité par des pairs favorise l’échange et la mise en place d’un parcours de carrière adapté. Parce que le secteur du numérique est en perpétuel mouvement, Smile s'engage à faire de vous un expert dans votre domaine, grâce à une offre de formation complète : accès à une plateforme d'e-learning, financement de certifications, outils de partage de connaissances... Vous pourrez participer au développement de Smile via notre programme de cooptation interne rémunéré, allant jusqu’à 3000 €. Votre année sera animée par des événements groupe et agence : convention annuelle, participation à des salons, summer party, afterworks formels & informels. Et aussi : mutuelle & transports pris en charge à 50 %, minimum 9 RTT/an, prime de vacances, Tickets Restaurant (9,50 €, pris en charge à 55 %), CSE dynamique. Les prochaines étapes Premier contact : Un échange téléphonique pour discuter de vos aspirations et de ce que nous pouvons vous offrir. Rencontre : L'occasion de faire connaissance et d'explorer votre parcours professionnel. Échange métier : Une discussion avec un de nos experts pour évaluer vos compétences et définir vos objectifs. Bienvenue dans l'équipe ! Et si ça matche entre nous, nous serons ravis de vous accueillir pour une aventure passionnante. Alors, prêt(e) à rejoindre l'équipe ?

items.desc: L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Techniques de l'Informatique et de la Microélectronique pour l'Architecture des systèmes intégrés Type de Contrat CDD Doctorant Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 38031 GRENOBLE Durée du contrat 36 mois Date d'Embauche 01/01/2027 Rémuneration La rémunération est d'un minimum de 2300,00 € mensuel Date limite de candidature : vendredi 13 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Sujet De Thèse La caractérisation de la sécurité des systèmes embarqués en 'boite noire' ou 'boite grise' face aux attaques Side-Channel requiert fréquemment une phase préparatoire de Reverse-Engineering, qui peut être particulièrement chronophage, notamment sur un Sytem-on-Chip (SoC) complexe que l’on peut retrouver sur smartphone ou dans l’automobile. Cette phase peut, par exemple, consister en la détection d’une primitive cryptographique au sein de mesures Side-Channel pour une future attaque par observation, ou d’une routine cible pour une attaque par perturbation. L’objectif de cette thèse est de développer une méthodologie et des outils non-profilés permettant l’automatisation de cette phase de détection, tout en permettant d’exploiter la connaissance a priori d’un potentiel attaquant. La thématique du Reverse-Engineering non-profilé via Side-Channel gravite autour de problèmes bien connus en traitement de 'timeseries' comme la découverte de motifs, découverte d’anomalies, ou la segmentation sémantique. Un des objectifs de cette thèse sera ainsi de traiter ces problématiques en prenant en compte les particularités des attaques par Side-Channel sur SoC, comme le bruit et le jitter dans les mesures, et l’a priori d’un attaquant sur le code exécuté et les données manipulées. De ce fait, l’investigation d’une méthodologie alliant machine learning, modèles probabilistes et métriques exactes sur les 'timeseries', constitue une des pierres angulaires de cette thèse. Les scenarii couverts par les problématiques de recherche posés par cette thèse sont multiples. Quelques exemples significatifs, en plus de la préparation à des attaques physiques classiques, sont le reverse-engineering de bootloader ou la découverte d’architecture de réseaux de neurones. Votre Environnement de Travail Le laboratoire TIMA est un laboratoire public de recherche sous la tutelle du CNRS, de Grenoble INP et de l’UGA. Il est situé à Grenoble, sur le site Viallet de Grenoble INP-UGA (46 avenue Félix Viallet). TIMA est une équipe cosmopolite de 150 personnes environ, avec des chercheurs du monde entier (chercheurs permanents, enseignants-chercheurs, doctorants, post-doctorants, CDD ingénieurs, collaborateurs scientifiques, invités et stagiaires). Les sujets de recherches couvrent la spécification, la conception, la vérification, le test, les outils CAO et méthodes d’aide à la conception pour les systèmes intégrés. Une grande partie de la recherche s’effectue dans le contexte de projets coopératifs, avec des partenaires industriels et académiques, financés par des contrats régionaux, nationaux et européens. Le laboratoire entretient ainsi de forts contacts avec le milieu industriel et académique qui réclament une implication professionnelle tant sur le plan logistique que relationnel. Contraintes et risques Le poste est localisé en Zone à Régime Restrictif (ZRR), ce qui implique une procédure administrative préalable d’autorisation d’accès. Sites de travail : TIMA, CEA Grenoble Rémunération et avantages Rémunération La rémunération est d'un minimum de 2300,00 € mensuel Congés et RTT annuels 44 jours Pratique et Indemnisation du TT Pratique et indemnisation du TT Transport Prise en charge à 75% du coût et forfait mobilité durable jusqu’à 300€ À propos de l’offre Référence de l’offre UMR5159-VIVGIO-008 Section(s) CN / Domaine de recherche Sciences informatiques : signaux, images, langues, automatique, robotique, interactions, systèmes intégrés matériel-logiciel À propos du CNRS Le CNRS est un acteur majeur de la recherche fondamentale à une échelle mondiale. Intégrer le groupe Sagemcom, c'est rejoindre un groupe de dimension internationale, où vous pourrez chaque jour relever de nouveaux défis. Si le travail en équipe, l'agilité, la créativité et les nouvelles technologies vous intéressent, rejoignez l'aventure ! » Référence 2026-2398 Description du poste Titre du poste Architecte logiciel Cloud Native / AI-native H/F Contrat CDI Description de l'équipe Vous rejoignez les équipes R&D en charge du développement de SICONIA, notre plateforme logicielle serveur de Smart Metering, permettant aux opérateurs d'énergie de superviser et piloter leurs réseaux grâce aux compteurs communicants d'électricité et d'eau. Nous avons aujourd'hui une vingtaine de solutions SICONIA déployées en Europe, Afrique du Nord, Australie, Brésil et Canada. Nous engageons une évolution majeure de SICONIA en reconstruisant la plateforme sur de nouvelles bases Cloud Native et avec une approche de développement AI-native. Cette nouvelle architecture permettra notamment la collecte et le traitement en temps réel des données issues des compteurs communicants, avec de forts enjeux de montée en charge et de résilience. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Contribuer à des solutions Smart Grid permettant une gestion plus efficace des réseaux et des ressources énergétiques. Jouer un rôle central dans l'architecture de la nouvelle génération de SICONIA. Concevoir une plateforme Cloud Native répondant à des problématiques de systèmes distribués, IoT et traitement de données à grande échelle. Mettre en pratique une approche AI-native intégrant l'IA et les agents IA au quotidien. Évoluer au sein d'une R&D internationale, avec des équipes de développement en France, Tunisie et Hongrie. Description de la mission En tant qu’Architecte logiciel senior Cloud Native / AI-native, vous définissez et garantissez la cohérence de l’architecture de la nouvelle génération de SICONIA, de sa conception jusqu’à sa mise en œuvre par les équipes de développement. Vous intervenez sur les différentes dimensions de l’architecture : découpage fonctionnel, microservices, données, échanges entre services, interfaces, sécurité, résilience, observabilité et infrastructure Cloud Native, et portez les choix d’architecture auprès des équipes. Principales activités: Définir l’architecture Cloud Native cible de SICONIA et accompagner sa mise en œuvre. Structurer la plateforme en domaines fonctionnels et services autonomes, avec des responsabilités et interfaces clairement définies. Définir l’architecture des traitements distribués et des flux de données à forte volumétrie, notamment avec Kafka. Définir les principes d’architecture autour de Kubernetes : déploiement, résilience, sécurité, observabilité et capacité à monter en charge. Définir les exigences de performance, disponibilité et sécurité de la plateforme. Piloter les choix technologiques et les revues d’architecture, et accompagner techniquement les équipes de développement. Utiliser de manière avancée les outils et agents IA pour accélérer les activités d’architecture et de développement, tout en gardant la maîtrise des résultats. Garantir la cohérence des choix d’architecture dans la durée. Profil recherché : Vous disposez d’une solide expérience dans la définition et la mise en œuvre de l’architecture de suites logicielles Cloud Native complexes. Vous avez une vision d’ensemble de l’architecture logicielle et ne vous limitez pas aux dimensions Kubernetes, Cloud ou DevOps. Vous maîtrisez particulièrement : L’architecture de microservices et systèmes distribués. Java / Spring Boot et les problématiques de performance et de concurrence associées. Kafka et les architectures basées sur l’échange asynchrone de données et d’événements. Les architectures de données, notamment autour de PostgreSQL. Kubernetes, Docker/Podman et Helm, ainsi que les principes de déploiement, résilience, sécurité, observabilité et scalabilité associés. items.desc: DESCRIPTION Do you like helping customers implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve technical problems? Would you like to do this using the latest cloud computing and AI technologies? Do you have a knack for helping groups understand application architectures and integration approaches? Do you have the consultative and leadership skills to help customers succeed with their cloud efforts? Are you passionate about cloud computing with a special focus on virtualized desktops, applications, document collaboration, and AI-powered, agentic end user computing experiences? Amazon Web Services is looking for Solutions Architects to help establish AWS Agentic WorkSpaces (formerly known as Amazon End User Computing) as the market leader in end user computing. We are especially seeking SAs with a high level of AI fluency who are excited to help customers adopt the next generation of our portfolio, including Workspaces for Builders and Workspaces for Agents. We built AWS Agentic WorkSpaces services to give customers the agility to respond to the changing needs of their workforce. Customers can scale up or scale down on-demand, providing users with the resources they need, all without deploying and operating infrastructure. This is a highly technical position for someone who can dive deep, build complex, AWS-optimized architectures, and help customers accelerate their adoption of AWS services and AI-powered, agentic workflows. Your broad responsibilities include owning technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects. You should be as comfortable discussing complex technical details with a room full of engineers as you are briefing an executive audience. In addition, you will engage with other AWS solutions architects, partner and professional services organizations to drive large and highly complex sales opportunities to closure. The AWS Agentic WorkSpaces SA team is creating and migrating large scale and compelling workloads on AWS. You will be collaborating with and influencing technical teams requiring AWS expertise and in so doing will be making a significant impact on Amazon’s customers. Enjoy working with enterprise customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud and AI-enabled solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers. Key job responsibilities Work with customers to deploy Amazon Agentic WorkSpaces — Personal, Applications and Core — as well as Workspaces for Builders and Workspaces for Agents. Guide customers on designing and operating AI-powered, agentic end user computing experiences, helping them apply AI fluency to real-world builder and agent workflows. Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud. Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS. Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community. Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers, blogs, and technical guides. Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates. Act as a technical liaison between customers, partners, service engineering teams and support, advocating for the Voice of the Customer and channeling field insights to help shape product strategy and roadmap. About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating, that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. items.desc: À propos de Via Sana Médecins généralistes et spécialistes, kinés, psychologues, ostéopathes…, tous les professionnels de santé font face au même problème : trouver un espace où exercer. Via Sana repense l’expérience de la santé en libéral en proposant de magnifiques cabinets tout équipés, louables d’une journée par semaine jusqu’au temps plein, des outils digitaux et une véritable communauté de professionnels. Depuis la création en juin 2020, Via Sana est devenu le leader de son secteur avec plus de 70 superbes centres ouverts dans les grandes villes de France, plus de 650 professionnels de santé hébergés et une levée de fonds de près de 16 millions d’euros pour accélérer notre développement dans toute la France. Chaque mois, ce sont près de 45 000 patients qui se rendent dans un cabinet Via Sana. Notre mission ? Améliorer le quotidien de dizaines de milliers de professionnels de santé en les déchargeant du non-médical afin qu’ils puissent enfin se concentrer sur leurs patients. Vos missions Un centre qui tourne bien, c’est un lieu impeccable, sûr et fonctionnel : les équipements marchent, les incidents sont compris rapidement, les interventions sont bien coordonnées et les praticiens peuvent se concentrer sur leurs patients. Chez Via Sana, chaque Care Ops est responsable d’un portefeuille de centres . Le nombre de centres, la complexité des sujets confiés et le niveau d’autonomie attendu évoluent selon votre expérience, votre séniorité et votre maîtrise démontrée. Si vous êtes junior, vous démarrez avec un portefeuille adapté pour apprendre vite et bien. Si vous avez déjà de l’expérience, vous prenez rapidement plus d’autonomie, des sujets plus complexes et un périmètre plus large. Votre métier ressemble souvent à une enquête : une photo, un message incomplet, un bruit décrit au téléphone, l’historique d’un équipement, un retour d’agent technique ou le plan d’une installation… À vous de rassembler les pièces du puzzle, de distinguer les faits des hypothèses et de construire le bon plan d’action. Concrètement, cela passe par les missions suivantes : Piloter votre portefeuille de centres : prendre en charge les incidents du quotidien, les prioriser et suivre chaque dossier jusqu’à sa résolution complète, sans rien laisser disparaître entre deux relances. Enquêter et poser un diagnostic à distance : poser les bonnes questions, analyser les photos, vidéos, plans et historiques, formuler des hypothèses et distinguer ce qui peut être résolu immédiatement de ce qui nécessite une expertise terrain. Apprendre et renforcer vos fondamentaux techniques : progresser sur les sujets d’accès, plomberie, chauffage, climatisation, électricité, équipements et petits travaux, jusqu’à pouvoir piloter en autonomie les incidents courants et certains dossiers plus complexes. Transformer le diagnostic en action : choisir le bon intervenant, produire un brief précis, organiser son passage, anticiper les informations et accès nécessaires, suivre les délais et contrôler la qualité de la résolution. Rendre les problèmes techniques compréhensibles : structurer les faits, expliquer votre raisonnement, clarifier les incertitudes et formuler des consignes ou prochaines étapes suffisamment claires pour que chaque interlocuteur puisse agir sans ambiguïté. Piloter des dossiers longs ou multi-interlocuteurs : selon votre niveau d’autonomie, coordonner équipes internes, agents techniques, prestataires, propriétaires et syndics sans perdre l’historique ni les prochaines étapes. Escalader avec discernement : identifier les informations manquantes, exposer ce qui a déjà été vérifié et solliciter la bonne expertise avec une question précise plutôt que transmettre un problème brut. Faire progresser les standards de l’équipe : renseigner les outils de suivi, enrichir les procédures et FAQ, documenter les causes récurrentes et partager vos apprentissages avec l’équipe. Maîtriser l’IA comme un outil de travail professionnel : l’utiliser pour structurer une enquête, challenger un diagnostic, croiser des informations, produire de meilleurs briefs et automatiser les tâches répétitives — tout en restant responsable du raisonnement, des sources et de la qualité finale. Rémunération : 34 000,00€ à 40 000,00€ par an Avantages : Prise en charge du transport quotidien RTT Travail à domicile occasionnel Lieu du poste : Télétravail hybride (75009 Paris)

Elle a pour missions principales de contribuer à la prise de décision du gouvernement de la Banque en matière de politique monétaire et financière, d'exploiter, analyser et diffuser des statistiques dans un grand nombre de domaines tels que les statistiques monétaires et financières, les enquêtes de conjoncture, la balance des paiements. La DGSEI est composée de 8 directions, d'une cellule dédiée aux relations IA avec les métiers, ainsi que d'une cellule dédiée à l'économie du climat et d'un pôle scientifique. Au sein de la Direction de l’Informatique métiers et des Moyens (DIM) en charge des fonctions support (RH, formation, communication, budget, maîtrise d’ouvrage informatique, appui aux réunions internationales), le Service de Maîtrise d’Ouvrage pour les Études, l’International et les Statistiques (SMEIS) de la DGSEI assure la déclinaison opérationnelle de la stratégie d’évolution du système d’information de la Direction Générale en liaison étroite avec les métiers de la Banque de France. Pour ce faire, nos principales missions sont de : Décliner la Stratégie DGSEI en une trajectoire d’évolution du système d’information par paliers de création de valeur en cohérence avec les orientations DGSI (Direction Générale du Système d’Information) Piloter le portefeuille des actions d’évolution du SI : suivi des instances de gouvernance, du planning, des risques et des budgets associés. Conduire des activités projets et maintenance : recueil des besoins, rédaction des spécifications fonctionnelles, travaux de qualification et d’acceptation de logiciel, conduite du changement Description de la mission confiée dans le cadre du stage Au sein de l’équipe chargée de la refonte des systèmes de gestion des référentiels des entités légales, vous contribuerez aux travaux liés à la reprise des données : Extraction des données présentes dans les bases Oracle et Hive des systèmes actuels, essentiellement via des requêtes SQL ; Analyse de la qualité de ces données, notamment par des contrôles fonctionnels et métiers et la comparaison avec des données de référence présentes dans d’autres gisements de données, via des scripts Python ou R et des requêtes sur les données, avec des outils IA si applicables ; Propositions de remédiation des anomalies de qualité détectées, via des scripts Python et R ou des injections de données ; Préparation des fichiers d’import vers le nouveau système, en Python et R ; Exécution des tests et des recettes des procédures développées ; Mise en place de tableaux de bord et d’indicateurs pour le suivi des actions ; Participation aux ateliers et points de suivi avec les acteurs impliqués ; Rédaction de la documentation ; Le poste est à pourvoir à partir de novembre 2026 pour 4 à 6 mois ‎ Profil recherché: ‎ Apports du stage Préparation à la prise d’un poste d’analyste de données / data engineer : Participation aux phases de qualification d’un logiciel produit dans le cadre d’un projet informatique dans une perspective maîtrise d’ouvrage ; Approfondissement de la démarche de tests d’application en vue d’accroître la qualité du logiciel ; Participation aux phases opérationnelles d’initialisation et de reprise de données en prévision de la mise en production d’un projet informatique ; Profil Diplôme préparé : école d’ingénieur ou Master liés à la donnée et au développement informatique Compétences : bases de données relationnelles et requêtes SQL, Python et R Qualités : appétence pour la donnée, capacité d’analyse, rigueur, autonomie, goût pour le travail en équipe, aisance à l’oral et à l’écrit Lieu du contrat : Paris, 37 rue du Louvre, 75002 PARIS ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ La Banque de France est une institution socialement responsable , attachée au respect de la diversité sous toutes ses formes, à la lutte contre les discriminations, à favoriser la parité Femme/Homme et à garantir un environnement de travail de qualité. items.desc: #StormYourCareer ? Rejoins STORM GROUP et construis ta carrière avec nous ! Pilote la conformité et la donnéeNous recherchons un(e) Business Analyst pour renforcer nos équipes transverses en charge de la collecte, du stockage et de la distribution des données. Référent(e) fonctionnel(le) au c?ur d?un écosystème Datalake, ton rôle sera de sécuriser les jalons des projets de construction des dispositifs de solvabilité et de liquidité, tout en pilotant les évolutions techniques du socle certifié de données. Ton futur environnementTu intégreras une entité stratégique responsable de l?alimentation de la chaîne Risques et Finance. Dans un environnement Big Data complexe, tu travailleras sur la création de composants transverses et d?accès mutualisés aux données au sein d?un Datalake. C?est un cadre idéal pour relever des défis de modélisation à grande échelle, participer à l?instruction d?enjeux métiers majeurs et évoluer au sein d?une organisation agile orientée vers l?excellence technologique. Tes missions clésCadrage SI & Analyse Stratégique : Instruire les enjeux et les bénéfices des évolutions définies pour le socle technique. Réaliser les analyses de l?existant et les études d?impacts sur le SI Risques et Finance. Élaborer la StoryMap des besoins, proposer les chiffrages associés et définir le planning des travaux. Contribuer activement aux comités de projet et assurer le reporting de l?activité. Modélisation & Conception de l?Assiette : Concevoir les modèles de données sous forme de diagrammes (UML ou MERISE) et maintenir le dictionnaire de données. Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles générales et détaillées pour les données implémentées. Organiser et animer les ateliers de travail, puis produire les notes de synthèse et comptes-rendus associés. Homologation & Qualité : Définir la stratégie d?homologation et concevoir les scénarios de tests. Piloter les phases de validation et formaliser les procès-verbaux (PV) de d?homologation. Assurer le support transverse auprès des différentes entités projets. Ton profilFormation : Diplôme d?Ingénieur ou Bac+5 spécialisé en informatique, data engineering ou finance. Expérience : Tu justifies d?une expérience significative dans le domaine de l?IT, avec une forte composante data. Compétences Techniques Impératives : Maîtrise des environnements Big Data (Hadoop) et des bases de données NoSQL. Excellente pratique de la modélisation objet (UML). Maîtrise de la méthodologie Agile Scrum. Utilisation experte de la suite Office 365 (Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint). Langues : Anglais professionnel opérationnel. Tes atoutsEsprit d?Analyse et de Synthèse : Capacité à modéliser des flux de données complexes et à en extraire des spécifications claires. Rigueur Méthodologique : Précision indispensable dans la tenue du dictionnaire de données et le suivi des jalons projets. Aisance Relationnelle : Capacité à fédérer les parties prenantes lors d?ateliers de travail et à porter les chiffrages en comité. Nos avantagesRemboursement des titres de transport à hauteur de 75%. Tickets restaurant pris en charge par STORM GROUP à hauteur de 50% (10,5? / jour). Accès Gymlib / Wellpass (sport et bien-être). Contrat Santé / Prévoyance mis en place auprès de la compagnie Alan. Formation continue : Accès à Udemy Business. Prime de cooptation, prime d?intéressement et de participation. Excellence Continue : Développe tes compétences au quotidien au sein d?un écosystème exigeant. Performance Durable : Évolue dans un cadre où l?exigence métier respecte ton équilibre de vie. items.desc: Location Paris Job Description About L.E.K. Consulting L.E.K. Consulting is a global strategy consulting firm that addresses the most critical commercial issues for the leaders of some of the world's most successful businesses. Clients come to us time and again because we are proven to act as an insightful expert and a trusted partner. We are uncompromising in our approach to help clients make better decisions at crucial moments, changing the trajectory of their enterprise, delivering improved business performance and creating greater shareholder returns. Our teams combine our core capabilities of research, benchmarking, modelling, data & analytics and strategy development to create game-changing insights and practical solutions that seize competitive advantage and unlock new growth opportunities. We enable clients to make critical decisions with greater certainty and empower them to master their moments of truth. With more than 2,300 professionals located across five continents, L.E.K. specialises in Strategy and Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) support with clients across the full range of corporates and private equity. We are expert in a wide range of industries, including Life Sciences and healthcare, retail and consumer, financial services, industrials, energy and transportation. The Life Sciences Specialist position Joining the European L.E.K. Life Sciences team will enable you to develop a world-class foundation in commercial problem-solving as you address the issues that face today’s business leaders. A wide variety of projects will give you experience of all aspects of commercial activity. The nature and pace of L.E.K.’s strategic work facilitates the rapid development of a highly analytical skill set in a collaborative and rewarding team-based environment. As you progress you will take on a significant level of responsibility and build your leadership skills. With their technical backgrounds, Life Sciences Specialists form a vital part of our team. This dedicated pathway: recognises the scientific, medical and technical expertise that you bring to projects from day one allows you to dedicate yourself to an industry with which you are already familiar and for which you have a passion is a platform for you to build on your technical skills while learning new commercial capabilities provides you with an opportunity to follow an accelerated career path As a Life Sciences Specialist, you will contribute to projects in many ways: Research: conduct critical primary and secondary research to influence client recommendations, e.g. interview scientific experts and key opinion leaders, review medical literature Analyse: conduct quantitative analysis, undertake database manipulation, build sophisticated financial models and interpret complex data Communicate: translate scientific and medical data and concepts to advise business strategy Solve: build on medical and scientific findings of the team to contribute to the overall case-solving process and to answer the client’s key questions Manage: from early on, get first-hand experience of managing Associate team members Who we are looking for We are currently seeking exceptional and committed individuals with the ability to solve complex problems in a creative way. Along with previous experience, studies or a strong interest into economics and business strategy related to the Life Sciences sector , you will have achieved a PhD or MD/MBBS . Successful candidates typically possess outstanding academic achievements, are comfortable with quantitative analysis, have excellent verbal and written communication skills in French and English, relevant professional experience, and notable extracurricular interests. Fluency in another European language is considered an asset. We are looking for a sense of intellectual curiosity that will inspire you to develop a deep understanding of any client situation, and to generate innovative answers to complex questions. We want people with the ability to think in logical, structured ways, together with the creativity to look beyond the obvious. Our team-oriented approach requires individuals who can collaborate and communicate well. We seek proactive, energetic, and enthusiastic candidates who take ownership of their work and make a meaningful impact. Doing that takes some of the rarest talent there is: robotics engineers, ML engineers, data platform specialists, and the technical leaders who build and guide those teams. These people aren’t browsing job boards. You’ll be our dedicated internal headhunter. You will map the market, find the people others miss, and get them excited enough to take the first conversation. items.desc: Job Description About Cognex Cognex Corporation is the world’s leading provider of industrial machine vision systems, sensors, and enterprise barcode readers. Our technology infuses artificial intelligence and advanced optics into manufacturing and logistics processes, helping global automation leaders eliminate defects and track parts seamlessly. We operate in a highly dynamic, fast-paced environment where innovation, persistence, and teamwork drive our unmatched industry success. Role Overview As an Account Development Representative, you will own the localized execution of our Account-Based Marketing (ABM) outbound strategy . Operating within your assigned geographic region (e.g., Americas, EMEA, or Greater China), you will partner intensely with regional sales teams to break into high-priority enterprise accounts. In addition to traditional high-value outbound prospecting, you will act as a modern revenue technologist. You will monitor, manage, and optimize automated digital agents executing front-line sequences, scaling our reach while maintaining brand and conversion quality. Essential Functions & Responsibilities ABM Outbound Strategy Execution: Execute highly tailored multi-channel outbound campaigns (phone, personalized email, social selling) targeting tier-one accounts within your assigned geographic region. AI & Automation Agent Management: Supervise, review, and optimize automated outbound and inbound digital agents. Tweak sequences, manage intent-trigger responses, and continuously refine performance data. Tight Sales & Marketing Alignment: Maintain a high cadence of collaboration with Field Sales Directors and Account Engineers to align on active campaigns, account priorities, and target buying centers. On-Site Seminar Management: Drive attendance for on-site seminars at top-tier corporate accounts. Partner with local Field Sales and Technical Application Engineers who deliver the content. Intent-Driven Prospecting: Utilize intent intelligence platforms to identify accounts showing active buying signals and deploy rapid-response outreach. Account Mapping: Research and navigate highly complex industrial organizations to pinpoint key decision-makers—such as Plant Managers, Automation Engineers, Maintenance and Quality Directors. Data & Tooling Integrity: Rigorously track and log all prospect interactions, account hierarchies, and pipeline metrics within our modern sales technology stack. Technical Product Expertise : Develop and maintain knowledge of Cognex machine vision systems, AI software, industrial sensors, and barcode reading solutions to effectively qualify customer applications. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Your performance and impact will be measured across the following core metrics: Target Account Engagement: Number of net-new relevant contacts and qualified meetings secured within designated target ABM accounts. New Target Account Acquisition: Success rate in penetrating and opening up previously unengaged priority target accounts. Pipeline Contribution: Total dollar value of qualified sales pipelines generated through outbound efforts and optimized automation sequences. Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Language Proficiency: Must be fluent in English and German. High Technology Fluency: Advanced proficiency in navigating enterprise-grade revenue tech stacks. You must be comfortable managing workflows across systems like Salesforce CRM, 6sense, Qualified, ZoomInfo, and Gong. Automation Familiarity: Comfort or direct experience monitoring automated sales sequences, marketing automation tools, or AI-driven outreach platforms. ABM Methodology Mastery: Deep understanding of Account-Based Marketing concepts, including multi-threaded prospecting, persona-based messaging, and identifying buying committees. Analytical Mindset: Ability to read data dashboards, spot drop-offs in sequence performance, and proactively pivot messaging to optimize open and conversion rates. Technical Solution Knowledge : Ability to understand and articulate complex technical products and qualify customer applications. Minimum Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related industrial discipline. Fluency in English (C1 or C2) Fluency in German (C1 or C2) 1–3 years of experience in an outbound B2B tech BDR/SDR role, with a documented track record of executing ABM frameworks. Experience selling into industrial manufacturing, logistics, automation, or enterprise hardware sectors is highly desirable. Office location: An der RaumFabrik 33 B. 76227 Karlsruhe

Solid knowledge of gas turbine operation and the design principles of turbine blades and vanes. Skills or experience in damage analysis, including mechanical integrity assessments, oxidation behavior, and crack propagation in high-temperature superalloys. items.desc: About the role At Agile Robots, we build intelligent robotic systems that learn from high-quality human demonstrations. As we scale our data collection site, we are looking for a Project Coordinator (m/f/d) to organize daily operations and make sure the site delivers the right data, on time and at the right quality. In this role, you will plan and supervise daily work on site, coordinate teleoperators and engineers, track KPIs, and keep tasks, materials, equipment and robots ready for production. Depending on your strengths, you will take ownership of one focus area: site operations & KPIs, new task setup & quality control, site administration, or production & resource planning. This position is ideal for an organized, proactive person who enjoys working with people and numbers, and who wants to help build a new kind of operation at the intersection of robotics and AI. Your Responsibilities New Task Setup & Quality Control (Main Focus) Own the end-to-end setup of new data collection tasks together with R&D: requirements, task instructions, scene and object setup, and pilot runs. Translate research requirements into clear, step-by-step SOPs and success criteria that operators can follow consistently. Train and onboard teleoperators on new tasks, and verify they reach the required quality before production starts. Define quality standards and run regular QC on collected data (sampling, reviews, labeling checks); document defects and root causes. Give structured feedback to operators and R&D, track quality metrics, and follow up until issues are resolved. Continuously improve task procedures and QC workflows to raise data quality and collection efficiency. Site Operations & KPI Tracking Support daily site planning and shift coordination for teleoperators. Contribute to KPI tracking and reporting (e.g., output volume, success rate, robot uptime). Site Administration Support materials and equipment inventory, site logistics and staff administration. Production & Resource Planning Support robot deployment planning and spare part coordination with service engineers. Essential Skills Degree in business, engineering, industrial engineering or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 1+ years of experience in project coordination, operations, production planning or team supervision. Strong organizational skills; able to manage several priorities in a fast-moving environment. Confident with Excel / Google Sheets and data-driven KPI reporting. Good communication skills in English. Beneficial Skills Experience in data labeling / data collection operations, manufacturing or lab environments. Knowledge of quality management, lean or process improvement methods. Interest in robotics, AI or technical products. Experience with project management or ticketing tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Notion). What we offer A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors. Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment. Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow. Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth. Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month. Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment About us Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly. This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us! We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

SUPO, where required) Why this role matters: The SAR Training Specialist within ICEYE’s Data line of business will support the development, customization, and global delivery of technical training programs to customers across the world. This role enables customers, particularly in the Defence and Intelligence (D&I) sector, to effectively understand and apply ICEYE’s SAR capabilities, products, and services to support mission-critical objectives. Who We Are ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Your day-to-day responsibilities Develop, maintain and tailor training programs covering remote sensing principles, SAR fundamentals, and the practical application of ICEYE’s technology across operational use cases. Deliver both in-person and virtual training sessions to a global customer base, adapting materials and delivery approaches to suit varying levels of technical proficiency and requirements. Align training content with evolving product features and customer needs, ensuring materials reflect the latest advancements in ICEYE’s portfolio of offerings. Support customer adoption and operational readiness through hands-on instruction, live demonstrations, and scenario-based learning that emphasizes real-world use. Collaborate with internal teams, including Product and Engineering, to ensure training materials are accurate, current, and aligned with broader customer engagement strategies Represent ICEYE at customer workshops, briefings, and industry events, acting as a trusted technical educator and advocate for the effective use of SAR data What we’re looking for Must haves: Experience in technical training and curriculum development Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences. Experience of D&I sector use of satellite imagery/SAR e.g. IMINT analyst Proficiency with satellite imagery/SAR processing tools and GIS platforms desirable Willingness to travel internationally regularly Ability to work effectively across diverse cultural and operational environments - prior experience engaging with international customers is strongly preferred Bachelor's degree (or higher level) or equivalent in Remote Sensing, Geography, Engineering or a related technical field. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way. Be curious : Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions. See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others. Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions. Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift. Have fun : What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins. items.desc: Kleinanzeigen reaches 36M+ monthly users and is Germany’s leading online classifieds market. We are a sustainability-focused platform where you won't just write code; you will power the services that bridge our high-traffic backend with seamless user experiences. Joining the Edge team means working on the bedrock of Kleinanzeigen, dealing with high-throughput, low-latency and highly-efficient services that require a 'you build it, you run it' mindset, offering you deep exposure to modern infrastructure and platform architecture. What You’ll Own As a Backend-Heavy Full Stack Engineer, you’ll be a central driver for the services that power user privacy and media delivery at scale. You will own the full development lifecycle: from design and implementation to deployment and maintenance. Your impact will include: Core Systems Architecture: Designing and scaling critical microservices using mostly Java and Spring Boot that support 36M+ monthly users. Full Lifecycle Responsibility: Applying "build it, run it" mentality—you aren't just writing code; you’re ensuring robustness, scalability, and observability in production. End-to-End Delivery: Crafting seamless user experiences by integrating our robust backend APIs with high-quality, maintainable frontends in TypeScript and React. Strategic Engineering: Driving improvements in our development practices, testing standards, and CI/CD pipelines to keep our team velocity high and our systems healthy. For frontend components, you will maintain high standards using tools like Vitest and Playwright. Our Tech Toolbox We believe in picking the right tool for the job. Our core environment is built on modern technologies, including: Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Golang, python Frontend: NextJs, React, TypeScript Infrastructure & Messaging: AWS, Kafka, CloudFormation, Kubernetes We value technology-agnostic engineers who are comfortable navigating this stack and are open to learning new technologies as our systems evolve. How We Work Autonomy: We operate in a highly autonomous, cross-functional environment where teams own their services end-to-end. Methodology: We follow Agile methodologies with a focus on code quality, pair programming, and CI/CD best practices. Balance: We work in a hybrid configuration that values flexibility, deep focus time, and collaborative problem-solving. Who You Are Architectural Mindset: You have proven experience building systems at scale (load balancing, service discovery, dynamic routing, circuit breakers). You understand not just how to build features, but how they perform under load. Owner’s Mentality: You seek out challenges, take the lead on troubleshooting complex production issues, and are proactive in proposing long-term technical solutions. Technical Mentor: You elevate the engineers around you through thoughtful code reviews, collaborative pair programming, and a commitment to sharing best practices. Effective Communicator: You can navigate trade-offs between speed and technical debt and explain your decisions clearly to the wider team. Tech Stack: You have strong experience in Java/Go, and you are comfortable balancing that deep backend work with frontend execution using React/TypeScript. At Kleinanzeigen, we care about our people — their wellbeing, growth, and life beyond work. Our benefits are designed to support you holistically, giving you flexibility and opportunities to thrive. ✨ Flexibility 26 business days of paid annual holidays 20 days “work from anywhere” Flexible working time (hybrid) Paid additional parental leave for both parents Extra paid days off for special occasions (e.g. your wedding or a move) ❤️‍ Wellbeing & Support Private health insurance Gym Pass (may cover up to 70% of gym membership fees) 40€ per month as a remote working allowance. Growth & Development Personal development budget Learning opportunities to grow your skills and career A unique position in an international and dynamic environment A flat, collaborative culture where your feedback actively shapes our processes ️ Perks & Everyday Benefits Competitive compensation package (Base salary + annual bonus) Flexible Remuneration Program (tax-efficient options for transport, restaurant vouchers and childcare) Corporate benefits and exclusive discounts An attractive referral program Kleinanzeigen is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome people of all backgrounds, races, religions, colours, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientation, ages, marital status, or disability status. If this role sparks your interest but you’re not sure you meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you anyway!

As part of Reflex Aerospace, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the trajectory of the space industry's future. This is an opportunity to contribute your expertise and enthusiasm to a team
items.desc: Your Mission: Join the Pinnacle of Satellite Technology Advancement in Germany! Reflex Aerospace is at the forefront of propelling high-performance satellite technology to new heights within the German aerospace landscape. As part of Reflex Aerospace, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the trajectory of the space industry's future. This is an opportunity to contribute your expertise and enthusiasm to a team that stands for innovation and excellence. As Structural Analyst – Satellite Missions, you will ensure the structural integrity and mechanical performance of our satellite platforms. You will work closely with mechanical design, systems, and test engineering teams to develop and validate structural models, perform dynamic loads analyses, define and support mechanical testing, and optimize spacecraft structures for minimum mass and maximum performance. Your Background: You hold a university degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. You bring at least 3 years of experience in structural analysis, particularly static, modal, sine, and random vibration analyses. You are proficient with HyperMesh and OptiStruct for FEM modeling, meshing, simulation, model validation, and post-processing. You have experience with Craig-Bampton reduction, superelements, and coupled-load analyses . You have a strong foundation in analytical methods and hand calculations , covering structural mechanics, dynamics, vibrations, and verification of simulation results. You have strong Python skills for analysis automation, data processing, and engineering tool development. You have experience defining mechanical test specifications , deriving qualification environments, and supporting vibration testing and test-analysis correlation. You are familiar with ECSS and NASA structural standards , load paths, failure mechanisms, and bolted joint assessments. You work independently, communicate effectively in English, and collaborate well across engineering teams. A strong plus is hands-on experience in structural optimization , including sizing, shape, and topology optimization, preferably using OptiStruct. What We Offer: Work directly on complete satellite systems and products, with significant technical ownership from early design through qualification and operations. Help establish engineering capabilities used across multiple Reflex satellite missions and product lines. Work closely with specialists across Systems Engineering, AIT, software, electronics, structures, thermal, AOCS and power. Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation and a special company holiday on April 12th, celebrating the International Day of Human Space Flight and the spirit of exploration. We provide a hybrid work model along with flexible working hours, empowering you as the owner of your time management. An annual training budget of 1.500€. A contribution to your Urban Sports membership as well as a discount on public transportation. A 20% contribution to your private pension plan. Access to Corporate Benefits - a website with many discounts for various brands. We exclusively offer permanent employment contracts, reflecting our commitment to building long-term relationships and supporting sustainable career growth within our organization. About us Reflex Aerospace, a NewSpace startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Munich and Berlin, has been leading the charge to provide advanced dual-use satellite technology at unparalleled speed. The company is leveraging the latest techniques to modernize payload-centric satellite development and production, achieving significantly faster delivery times and enhanced reliability. By applying algorithmic engineering and streamlined system design processes, Reflex accelerates the delivery of satellites enabling lightning-fast innovation for our customers.

items.desc: The End User Computing (EUC) department is dedicated to providing employees with the best possible IT experience. Whether it is laptops, desktops, mobile devices, or virtual workplaces, the team ensures that employees across the organization have the technology and services they need to work securely, efficiently, and productively. To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced Citrix Architect (m/f/d).In this role, you will provide the architectural foundation for a secure, resilient, and standardized Citrix platform supporting business-critical workloads. You will directly influence the platform’s transformation, operational stability, security, and future delivery model. Your responsibilities: Design secure, scalable, and highly available cloud, on-premises, and hybrid Citrix solutions. Define the architecture of core platform components, including Citrix DaaS, Virtual Apps and Desktops, VDAs, PVS, WEM, StoreFront, Cloud Connectors, NetScaler/ADC, Delivery Controllers, FAS, profiles, images, policies, Machine Catalogs, and Delivery Groups. Define reusable architecture standards, patterns, and governance principles that can be applied across Helios and other Fresenius business segments. Drive platform harmonization, standardization, cloud migration, license consolidation, and the retirement of legacy components. Translate business, clinical, security, and operational requirements into reliable and supportable Citrix solutions, considering availability, performance, latency, data residency, sensitive-data protection, and service continuity. Define identity and access requirements, including Active Directory and Entra dependencies, MFA, privileged access, service accounts, session recording, and role-based authorization. Coordinate dependencies across network, cloud, hosting, identity, security, monitoring, and application teams, and provide architectural governance and technical direction to internal delivery teams and external service providers. Plan and support platform implementations, pilots, migrations, testing, capacity planning, cutovers, rollback scenarios, decommissioning, business continuity, disaster recovery, and high-availability concepts. Provide technical leadership for complex incidents and problems, maintain architecture and handover documentation, and contribute to capacity, license, and cost planning as the technical basis for commercial decisions. Your qualifications: Academic qualification in information technology or comparable professional experience. Extensive experience with large, distributed, and business-critical Citrix environments. Strong knowledge of Citrix DaaS/Cloud, Virtual Apps and Desktops, PVS, WEM, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, FAS, Citrix Workspace, and Azure integration. Proven experience in hybrid cloud and on-premises architecture, including HLD and LLD creation, capacity planning, lifecycle management, migrations, security, and identity integration. Ability to translate complex business and technical requirements into sustainable, secure, and supportable solutions. Strong analytical, risk-management, and problem-solving capabilities, as well as clear, structured, and audience-appropriate communication. Experience with healthcare IT, clinical applications, regulated environments, or similarly business-critical infrastructure is an advantage. Fluent German skills and good English skills, both spoken and written; relevant Citrix, Microsoft Azure, ITIL, or architecture certifications are an advantage. Why join our team: A key architecture role within a business-critical technology environment. The opportunity to shape the future Citrix platform and transformation roadmap. Collaboration with international infrastructure, security, cloud, application, and service-management teams. Work across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud-based delivery models. A high level of technical responsibility and visibility. Drive the future of our End User Services — join #futurefresenius and apply now through our online portal to make an impact!

items.desc: Über uns CALIMA ist ein Berliner B2B-SaaS-Startup mit der Mission, Arbeitssicherheit durch digitale und innovative Lösungen einfacher, verlässlicher und wirksamer zu machen. Unsere Software unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, dass Alleinarbeitende im Notfall schnell Hilfe erhalten. CALIMA wird von über tausend Unternehmen genutzt und schützt täglich tausende Mitarbeitende. Wir sind ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, produktnah und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Dabei suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und unsere Prozesse aktiv verbessern. Deine Rolle Als Product Owner wirst du unsere erste fest angestellte Person im Produktmanagement und übernimmst die operative Produktverantwortung für unsere Entwicklungsteams: Cloud, Mobile Apps für iOS und Android sowie Platform. Aktuell liegen Backlog, Tickets und Planung direkt beim Head of Tech. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Teams verlässlich an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten: ein gut sortiertes Backlog, klar definierte Tickets, ein funktionierendes Refinement und realistisch abgestimmte Deadlines. Du wirst das Bindeglied zwischen dem Head of Tech, den kleinen, remote arbeitenden Entwicklungsteams, QA, Sales und Customer Success. Wir entwickeln ein sicherheitsrelevantes Produkt. Zuverlässigkeit und Qualität stehen bei uns vor Feature-Menge. Perspektivisch kannst du deine Rolle in Richtung strategisches Product Management weiterentwickeln und Themen wie Roadmap, Markt und Produktstrategie aktiv mitgestalten. Deine Aufgaben Backlog und Tickets Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Customer Success, Sales und Support in Epics und Tickets und klärst offene Fragen. Du pflegst ein priorisiertes Backlog je Team und stellst sicher, dass nur klar definierte Tickets in die Entwicklung gehen. Du formulierst Tickets mit Ziel, Akzeptanzkriterien und Abgrenzung so, dass Entwicklung und QA ohne Rückfragen starten können. Konzeption Du leitest aus Kundenfeedback und Anfragen von Sales und Customer Success ab, welches Problem dahintersteht und welche Verbesserung den größten Nutzen bringt. Du arbeitest Features konzeptionell aus, mit Zielbild, Abläufen und Edge Cases, bevor daraus Tickets werden. Du bewertest Lösungsvarianten gemeinsam mit den Entwickler:innen nach Nutzen, Aufwand und Risiko. Du sprichst gemeinsam mit Customer Success und Sales mit Kund:innen und prüfst Konzepte mit ihnen, bevor wir sie umsetzen. Planung und Steuerung Du bereitest die Quartalsplanung mit dem Head of Tech vor und findest die Balance zwischen Kapazitäten und Deadlines. Du moderierst Refinements, übernimmst nach der Einarbeitung die Moderation unserer Team-Weeklies, behältst Action Items im Blick und entwickelst die Produktkoordination und die zugehörigen Abläufe weiter. Du hältst die Boards aktuell, erkennst Blocker früh und eskalierst sie an die richtige Person. Schnittstellen Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Sales, CS und QA bei Fragen zu Status und Priorität. Du hältst Sales und Customer Success proaktiv auf dem Laufenden, wo ein Release steht und was sich verschiebt. Du steuerst, was in Benutzerhandbuch und Kundendokumentation landet. Du koordinierst unsere externen App-Entwickler:innen auf Ticketebene. Du lieferst die Inhalte für Release Notes und Team Testing. Deine ersten Monate In den ersten Wochen lernst du Team, Produkt und Kunden kennen und übernimmst Backlog und Tickets der Teams Schritt für Schritt. Danach moderierst du Refinements und Weeklies und baust mit uns einen Planungsrhythmus auf, der Fortschritt messbar macht. Nach etwa drei Monaten läuft die operative Produktarbeit über dich, und Sales und Customer Success wissen jederzeit, wo ein Release steht. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager:in oder technische:r Projektmanager:in in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS- oder Startup-Umfeld. Sicherer Umgang mit agilen Methoden sowie Erfahrung in Backlog-Management, Priorisierung, Sprint- und Releaseplanung und der Moderation agiler Meetings. Du schreibst Tickets, die Entwickler:innen gerne umsetzen: klar, vollständig, mit sauberen Akzeptanzkriterien. Genug technisches Verständnis, um Aufwände und Lösungsvorschläge zu hinterfragen, gerne mit Erfahrung in Web- und Mobile-Produkten. Erfahrung mit Ticketingsystemen wie GitHub Projects, Jira oder vergleichbaren Tools. Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise in einem Remote-Team und klare Kommunikation zwischen Tech und Business. Qualitätsanspruch: Du nimmst lieber früh Scope raus, als kurzfristig ein Release verschieben zu müssen. Aktive Nutzung von AI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag, zum Beispiel für Ticket-Entwürfe, Analysen und Dokumentation. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse, unsere technische Dokumentation ist auf Englisch. items.desc: About the Role At Agile Robots, we build intelligent robotic systems that learn from high-quality real-world data. To keep our data collection site running at full capacity, we are looking for a Robot Service Engineer (m/f/d) who keeps our robots, teleoperation devices and recording systems operational every day. In this role, you will be the first technical contact on site. You will diagnose and fix hardware and software issues, maintain the robot fleet, and work closely with our R&D teams to resolve deeper technical problems quickly. Your work directly determines how much usable data the site can produce. This position is ideal for someone with a hands-on technical mindset who enjoys troubleshooting, works systematically, and wants to grow with cutting-edge robotics and AI technology. Your Responsibilities On-site Technical Support Provide daily first-line technical support for robots, teleoperation devices, cameras and data recording systems on site. Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network and calibration issues to minimize downtime. Support teleoperators and project coordinators with technical questions during data collection. Maintenance & System Setup Install, set up and calibrate robots and teleoperation workstations for new tasks. Perform preventive maintenance, replace parts and keep the robot fleet in working condition. Maintain records of faults, repairs and spare parts usage. R&D Collaboration & Issue Resolution Escalate complex issues to R&D with clear reproduction steps, logs and data. Test and deploy software updates, fixes and new features on site, and give feedback on results. Identify recurring problems and propose improvements to hardware, software and workflows. Safety & Documentation Ensure robots and equipment are operated in line with safety and operational guidelines. Write and update troubleshooting guides, SOPs and setup instructions for the site team. Essential Skills Degree or vocational training in mechatronics, electrical engineering, robotics, computer science or a related field. Hands-on experience troubleshooting electromechanical systems, robots or industrial equipment. Basic knowledge of Linux, command line tools and reading system logs. Structured, independent way of working with strong attention to detail. Good communication skills in English; able to explain technical issues clearly to engineers and non-technical colleagues. Beneficial Skills Experience with robotic arms, ROS/ROS 2, or teleoperation systems. Scripting skills in Python or Bash. Knowledge of cameras, sensors, networking or data pipelines. Experience in field service, technical support or a production / lab environment. What we offer A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors. Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment. Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow. Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth. Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month. Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment About us Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly. This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us! We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

Our goal is to provide our employees with an exciting, supportive and motivating environment for personal growth and career development while ensuring that our team maintains a healthy work-life balance. We strive to achieve this by offering: An exciting and impactful job in a fast-growing Swiss cyber tech company expanding across Europe with manifold opportunities to shape your professional profile. Working in close collaboration with our interdisciplinary team and learning from our Security Experts, Data Scientists, and Business Professionals. Taking over responsibilities quickly and help shape and promote a cutting-edge security software. A high degree of trust, independence and flexibility, also in terms of working hours and place of work (remote or in the office). A competitive salary and appealing benefits package. What you bring along: We are looking for a proactive, self-motivated and enthusiastic cyber security professional who is comfortable in a high-paced start-up environment and who shares our values. You should be confident with solving problems independently and communicating easily with both internal teams and directly with customers. You should also: 3-5 years of experience in systems engineering, data engineering, platform/infrastructure engineering, or a similar role Working knowledge of network and application security and the telemetry relevant to detection UNIX/Linux experience, including networking, troubleshooting, and performance tuning in containerized deployments (Docker and/or Kubernetes) Strong programming skills in Python and Bash (or comparable languages), with a focus on automation and maintainable, production-quality code Hands-on experience designing and operating data ingestion pipelines (e.g. syslog, Logstash/Fluentd/Vector, Elastic stack, or similar), including handling heterogeneous formats and high volumes Comfortable with working in a largely remote team where clear communication is key to successful collaboration and impact. We are an English-speaking team but German fluency is appreciated when communicating to some customers Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience Nice to have: Solid understanding of network and application security fundamentals, common attack patterns, and the log and telemetry sources that matter for detection Experience with SIEM, SOAR, or detection platforms (e.g. Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Security), or as a detection engineer or security analyst Familiarity with network telemetry such as NetFlow/IPFIX, Zeek, or Suricata, and frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK Prior customer-facing or professional services experience.

items.desc: What You'll Do Amazon is a global technology powerhouse renowned for its relentless innovation, operational scale, and customer-centric approach. What began as an online bookstore has evolved into one of the world’s largest hyperscalers, with leadership across e-commerce, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, logistics, and advanced infrastructure technologies. Amazon’s expansive ecosystem spans fulfillment centers, corporate campuses, cloud regions, edge environments, research facilities, and global technology hubs that support millions of customers and businesses worldwide. Amazon continues to invest in next-generation networking, AI infrastructure, cloud platforms, security architectures, edge computing, and advanced connectivity solutions that enable seamless integration between cloud regions, edge locations, operational facilities, and end users worldwide. Technologies commonly deployed in large-scale service provider, cloud, and connectivity environments—including high-performance routing, resilient WAN architectures, automation, programmability, optical transport, and network visibility—play a critical role in supporting the scale, reliability, and performance requirements of these initiatives. As the Solutions Engineer (SE) for Amazon, you will own the Cisco technical relationship with the customer and our partners. You will bring deep expertise across Cisco's portfolio, with a focus on Networking (wired and wireless), Unified Computing System (UCS), Security, and Observability. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to Amazon IT leaders and decision makers, translate business needs into prioritized technical requirements, and prove Cisco's value through demonstrations and technical validation. You will engage across multiple Amazon organizations such as Corp IT, Project Kuiper, etc. This gives you the chance to influence some of Amazon's most critical infrastructure investments. Key responsibilities: Lead the technical sales process: design, present, and consult on solutions that fit customer and business requirements. Act as the primary technical influencer in the account, with specialization in core secure networking (switching, wired, wireless, routing, firewall), UCS, security, and observability. Capable of engaging in in-depth technical discussions and proficient in illustrating packet flows through whiteboarding. Work with architecture specialist teams in non-core areas to position Cisco competitively. Lead strategic planning and technical validation with the extended sales team, taking opportunities through technical close. Feed customer feature/product requests, market opportunities, and competitive insights back to Cisco business units and sales teams. Use AI-powered tools to streamline coordination and deal execution. Maintain deep knowledge of Amazon's environment and market to stay ahead of competitors. Success measures: growing revenue through closed deals, displacing competitors to gain market share, expanding Cisco's footprint within Amazon, building critical Customer relationships, driving complex escalations to resolution, present at industry events, and positive influence and impact on the Solutions Engineering community at Cisco. Additional Responsibilities Technical Strategy Develop a deep understanding of Amazon's current and future architecture across transport networks, edge computing, and hybrid cloud. Co-create strategic engineering initiatives with Amazon that improve global connectivity, resiliency, scalability, efficiency, and security. Take an automation- and programmability-first approach, using advanced routing, telemetry, AI-driven operations, and security technologies. As a trusted advisor, help shape Amazon's next-generation connectivity platforms by aligning technology strategy with business outcomes. Cross-Functional Collaboration Translate Amazon's evolving business and operational needs into scalable engineering solutions. Build strong partnerships with Amazon Engineering Leadership, Principal Architects, operations teams, and decision makers, while staying closely aligned with Cisco Business Units, engineering, and executive stakeholders. Continuous Improvement Drive improvements in performance, reliability, automation, and operational processes across Amazon's infrastructure. Bring solutions-oriented thinking, take calculated risks, and adapt quickly to emerging technologies. Act as a change agent who challenges conventional approaches and drives innovation at a scale. Lead by Example Foster curiosity, accountability, customer obsession, and operational excellence. Build trust through active listening, candid communication, collaboration, and respect for diverse perspectives, with a steady focus on execution. Who You'll Work With You will join a world-class Technical Sales and Engineering organization supporting one of Cisco's most strategic customers. You will collaborate with Amazon Client Directors, Client Executives, Solutions Engineers, …

Collaborating closely with Production, your role will ensure seamless support throughout manufacturing and testing phases, guaranteeing top-tier quality and on-time delivery. Responsibilities: Develop design solutions that surpass customer expectations in terms of cost, quality, and schedule adherence. Meet designated schedules and budgets for all assigned work. Thoroughly research and comprehend internal and external specifications and regulatory requirements. Generate 3D designs (using SolidWorks) and manufacturing drawings to bolster the company's product range. Create detailed on-site installation drawings and develop comprehensive procedures for subcontracted teams involved in the installation process. Provide engineering and technical support to Production, Sales, and After-Sales Departments. Support product testing both at the factory and on-site, offering technical assistance.
