Who We Are: Catalyx is a machine vision and automation company that integrates technology and people to help global manufacturers and logistics companies achieve next-generation levels of quality and throughput. For over thirty years, the minds behind Catalyx have been at work maximizing operational processes across highly regulated industries by inventing new technology applications and supporting companies with technical experts. With 9 global offices, over 550 team members, and 3,000 projects under our belt (and counting), we have the capabilities and reach to solve unique process problems at scale – and the vision to keep doing what’s never been done before. For more information visit www.catalyx.ai. The Role: Catalyx is seeking a CSV Engineer to join a major pharmaceutical project supporting laboratory systems and quality control operations in a GMP-regulated environment. This role will support both ongoing and new laboratory projects, with a strong focus on laboratory IT systems, system validation, documentation, and cross-functional project support. The successful candidate will work closely with QC, IT, engineering, and project teams to ensure laboratory systems remain compliant, reliable, and aligned with regulatory and data integrity requirements. This is a hybrid position with involvement in a range of laboratory systems and digital transformation activities across the site. Responsibilities: Support the delivery of laboratory systems projects within a GMP-regulated QC environment. Work closely with site teams on system requirements gathering, configuration specifications, and IOQ protocol generation. Author, review, and approve validation and lifecycle documentation for laboratory systems. Support risk assessments related to laboratory systems and associated processes. Assist with deployment activities, system configuration, and end-user support/training. Support troubleshooting and ongoing reliability of QC laboratory IT systems. Collaborate cross-functionally with QC, IT, engineering, validation, and project stakeholders. Ensure compliance with GMP, data integrity, and regulatory requirements including 21 CFR Part 11 principles. Support ongoing continuous improvement activities within the laboratory systems environment. Maintain strong documentation practices and ensure work is completed to a high compliance standard. Requirements: Degree qualification in IT, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, Chemistry, Biology, or a related discipline. Experience supporting laboratory or GMP systems within a pharmaceutical or regulated environment is advantageous. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows operating systems including Windows 10/11 and server-based environments. Experience with CSV, system lifecycle documentation, or qualification activities would be beneficial. Understanding of GMP environments, data integrity, and regulatory compliance principles. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work both independently and within cross-functional project teams. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Experience supporting QC laboratory operations or laboratory applications is desirable. Why Join Catalyx? items.desc: About Taighde Eireann - Research Ireland Taighde Eireann - Research Ireland is the national research and innovation funding agency which was established on 1 August 2024; it amalgamates the activities of the Irish Research Council and Science Foundation Ireland. Research Ireland will drive world class research and innovation in Ireland, funding research and innovation excellence in all disciplines across the spectrum of Arts, Engineering, Humanities, Mathematics, Science, Social Sciences, Technology and others. Role Purpose To deliver high-quality operations across the full programme lifecycle, from call development and proposal review to post-award management, reporting and close-out. The role manages the day-to-day delivery of allocated calls and grants, ensuring timely, accurate, well-governed activity supported by effective engagement with research experts and stakeholders. It enables Programme teams to operate effectively at scale while maintaining consistent standards and a strong stakeholder experience. This represents an exciting opportunity for a suitably qualified individual to join the Research Ireland Centres team and help shape one of Ireland's most significant research and innovation investments. The team leads the strategic oversight, performance management and development of Research Ireland's portfolio of large-scale, multi-institutional research centres, supporting excellence in research, talent development, industry collaboration and societal impact. The team also leads the stewardship of the recently launched Rinn Network, a €460 million national investment comprising seven large-scale research centres across areas including AI, energy, advanced therapies, medical devices, quantum science, semiconductors and pharma/biopharma. Designed as a new model of radical collaboration, the Rinn Network aims to strengthen Ireland's ability to mobilise research capability at scale and address major societal and economic challenges. Reporting to a Programme Manager, the Programme Officer will take ownership of varied operational activities as part of a team delivering key aspects of Research Ireland's strategy. The role offers the opportunity to coordinate complex programme processes, turn evidence and stakeholder input into effective delivery and contribute practical ideas that improve how the team works. It will suit a highly organised and collaborative individual who is motivated by supporting ambitious research, strengthening partnerships and helping Ireland's Research Centres and the Rinn Network deliver meaningful economic and societal impact. Core Accountabilities The role holder will: Manage and deliver day-to-day operational activity for allocated calls, awards or programme processes, ensuring work is completed to agreed timelines, quality standards and governance requirements. Responsible for the running of peer review processes, including planning, documentation, reviewer or panel logistics, query management and quality control. Manage post-award administration, including monitoring schedules, deliverables, reporting requirements, compliance checks and maintain records. Maintain programme data quality and integrity and documentation within grant management systems, trackers and reporting tools, ensuring a clear audit trail and reliable operational reporting. Draft, update and quality-check programme documentation, including guidance notes, templates, briefing material, operational memos and communications. Identify operational risks, issues and process gaps early, escalating material matters and proposing practical mitigations. Support clear and professional stakeholder communications, ensuring consistent messaging and a positive experience for applicants, reviewers, awardees and partners. Provide continuous improvement by identifying ways to simplify processes, reduce administrative burden and improve consistency across programme delivery. Operate in line with Research Ireland policies, governance standards, compliance requirements and agreed service expectations. Desirable Experience Hold a PhD in a relevant discipline, ideally aligned with one of the strategic areas within the Research Centres/Rinn Network portfolio. At least three years' relevant experience in research, innovation, research funding, programme management or a related field. Demonstrated research track record and knowledge of good research practice and research assessment. Experience managing multiple competing priorities, deadlines and operational processes while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and delivery. Demonstrated ability to produce accurate documentation, manage records and identify errors, inconsistencies or compliance risks. Experience identifying operational challenges and implementing practical improvements to processes, systems or ways of working. Experience communicating effectively through written, verbal and presentation-based formats, adapting messages for different audiences and purposes. …

Who We Are: Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. Job Description: Software Engineer - Backend Location: Galway, Ireland Build the technology that powers great customer experiences Are you passionate about building scalable cloud services, solving complex engineering challenges, and delivering software that makes a real impact? We're looking for a Software Engineer - Backend to join our growing engineering team in Galway. In this role, you'll work on modern cloud-native platforms, designing and building secure, reliable, and high-performing backend services. You'll collaborate with talented engineers across multiple disciplines, contribute to architectural decisions, and help deliver solutions that support customers around the globe. If you enjoy working in an Agile environment, thrive on continuous learning, and want to be part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence, we'd love to hear from you. What You'll Do As a Backend Software Engineer, you will: Design, develop, test, deploy, and support backend features and services from concept through to production. Build and maintain secure, scalable cloud-based applications and integrations. Develop clean, maintainable, and well-tested software using modern engineering practices. Contribute to technical design discussions and influence implementation decisions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions and resolve technical challenges. Support and improve services operating in a 24/7 production environment through monitoring, troubleshooting, and deployment activities. Work with CI/CD pipelines and containerized environments, leveraging technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Participate in code reviews, share knowledge, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and learning. Help drive operational excellence, reliability, and security across the platform. What You'll Bring Software Engineering Expertise Commercial experience developing backend applications using Go, Python, Java , or a similar programming language. Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, clean code principles, and testing methodologies. Experience designing maintainable services and components with clear interfaces. Familiarity with Agile development practices and the full software development lifecycle. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of software design patterns, test-driven development (TDD), and maintainable coding practices. Cloud & Distributed Systems Experience building microservices and RESTful APIs. Understanding of distributed systems concepts including scalability, resilience, availability, and fault tolerance. Experience with public cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform . Exposure to asynchronous messaging, event-driven architectures, and integration patterns. Platform & Operations Experience developing and supporting applications in Linux environments. Knowledge of CI/CD practices and tools. Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes, along with infrastructure-as-code approaches. Understanding of modern security principles including secure API design, authentication, authorization, and secrets management. Experience operating and supporting cloud-hosted production services. Collaboration & Innovation Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly. An eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt in a rapidly evolving environment. Experience using AI-assisted development tools responsibly and effectively. A collaborative mindset and a passion for sharing knowledge with others. Nice to Have While not essential, the following experience would be beneficial: Reactive systems, concurrent programming, or stream processing. Messaging platforms such as Kafka, NATS, or similar technologies. Distributed messaging and transaction patterns. Kubernetes deployment strategies and GitOps practices. Experience with Terraform, Helm, Ansible, or related automation tools. Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field …

items.desc: DESCRIPTION We are the Display Protocols team behind Amazon WorkSpaces Personal and Applications, the cloud desktop platform that lets millions of users provision secure Windows or Linux desktops and access them from any device or browser. If you like working on problems where latency, security, reliability, and scale all collide at once, this is your kind of role. You'll be joining the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, where our mission is to build intuitive, differentiated business applications — powered by Amazon's real-world experience — that millions of companies use to run their day-to-day operations. We build opinionated, turnkey solutions that customers choose to buy over build, and we aim to be the trusted partner they don't have to think twice about. The End User Computing market is growing at an incredible pace right now, which means you'll be solving some of the most interesting problems in providing secure, fast, highly scalable streaming infrastructure — while working across industry-leading AWS services. Our team is innovating across multiple areas to deliver the best-in-class interactive streaming platform, and as an SDE you'll own features end-to-end, ship to real enterprise and ISV customers, and have a direct hand in shaping what world-class application streaming looks like next. We are looking for passionate SDEs who want to build their career in End User Computing. If this sounds interesting to you, talk to us! Key job responsibilities As an SDE on the Display Protocols team, you'll design and build features for our cloud desktop and interactive streaming platform — end to end, from scoping through production. You'll write clean, maintainable code that runs at scale, optimize real-time streaming paths for latency and reliability, and operate what you ship (including on-call). You'll work across multiple AWS services to deliver secure, highly available infrastructure that enterprise and ISV customers depend on daily. Expect to dive deep into performance — profiling, benchmarking, identifying bottlenecks — and collaborate with senior engineers on system design and architecture decisions. You'll participate in code reviews, raise the bar on engineering standards, and contribute to operational excellence across the team. When something's broken or could be better, you take initiative and fix it. You'll also help us figure out how to scale — both technically (millions of concurrent desktops) and as a team (mentoring, improving processes, writing useful documentation). The End User Computing space is evolving fast, so you'll frequently evaluate new approaches and help decide where we invest next to keep our streaming platform best-in-class. A day in the life On a typical day, you'll balance executing on our long-term roadmap with responding to emerging customer issues and finding inventive ways to satisfy new customer needs. You'll work closely with engineers, product managers, and partner teams across AWS like networking and security. Your customers are enterprise IT organizations and ISV partners who need desktops that are reliable, secure, and fast — so the feedback loop is tight and the problems are real. Beyond regular engineering work, there's always room to stretch into areas like mentoring or shaping team direction. About the team As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to …

items.desc: At Scalapay, we're shaping a culture with high standards, independent and critical thought, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning . We operate in a fast-moving, tech-driven environment , and we're looking for people who thrive in change, think boldly, and take initiative. If you're ready to put your potential to the test in a hiring process designed to spotlight exceptional talent, this is your chance to stand out and grow with one of Europe's most ambitious fintech teams . #MakeItHappen #PlayAsATeam #StayCurious #FocusOnCustomer. THE MISSION As part of their duties, the Data Analyst - Financial & Payments Controller shall assume full responsibility for the end-to-end management of projects, covering the entire payments and financial data lifecycle from analysis through to execution. In performing these duties, the Employee shall operate at the intersection of people, processes, and data, and shall be specifically required to: Ensure operational accuracy; Safeguard payment integrity; Secure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs); Mitigate risks within a regulated environment. Key Responsibilities Reconciliation oversight: Ensure timely and accurate reconciliations across multiple workflows, maintaining data integrity and collaborating closely with the finance team; SLA monitoring of third-party providers: Track and validate the performance of external providers (e.g., processors, acquirers, banking partners) against contractual SLAs. Ensure service levels are met, escalate deviations, and contribute to reporting for internal stakeholders and audits; Stakeholder collaboration: Work cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners (banks, acquirers, processors) to address inquiries, optimize processes, and identify improvement opportunities; Continuous process improvement: Collect and refine business and technical requirements to improve accuracy and streamline operations; Risk control and issue resolution: Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks. Conduct checks on bank and acquirer integrations, manage incidents, and troubleshoot processing errors using internal tools; Invoice reconciliation: Validate invoices from acquirers, processors, and card schemes, ensuring accuracy in charges and proper revenue attribution. Why you should join Scalapay Attractive packages based on skills and experience, the salary band we have for this position is of EUR 40'000 - 47'000 (Gross Annual Salary); International environment with significant challenges to be met every day; Lots of opportunities to work with a team of industry tech leaders who are focused on delivering products that offer exceptional user experiences; Personalised support to accelerate your professional growth and take ownership of the products you deliver: we want to help you grow! Latest technologies and being encouraged to bring your flair to the role. Recruitment Process: A quick chat with one of our Talent Acquisition team members; The first interview with Head of Financial Operations and the Data Team to deep dive into your experiences and better understand your motivation; A case study to test your hard skills; A final chat with Simone (our CEO) where he will share and assess the Scalapay Values Want to learn more? Don't hesitate to explore our Careers website, our LinkedIn and Glassdoor pages. Pro tip: send your CV in English Super Pro tip: we know that application processes can be scary and frustrating but… we look for talent, not people that tick all our boxes.

Support the deployment of the Cooling Services Playbook across EMEA. Bring experience and market insights to drive continuous improvement of the Cooling Service value proposition. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Cooling Line of Business functions, including R&D, Manufacturing, Sustaining, and L4 organizations. Work closely with the Service Line of Business to identify service and software solutions that create added value for customers. Coordinate with Schneider Electric Front Offices, FSVPs, Strategic Account Executives, Service Account Managers, Service LoB, and Service Operations across EMEA and globally. If so, we would love to welcome you to our global community! We are seeking two Program Assistants to join our Rome team. In this role, you will be responsible for logistical, operational, and cultural integration tasks (confirming activities and bookings, accompanying field trips and site visits, communicating with students and faculty) ensuring that all programme activities are well-organized and that students receive the necessary support during their stay in Rome. All programmes include day trips and overnight excursions that take place at varying times (including evenings and weekends), which the Custom Program Assistant is required to support. IFSA (Institute for Study Abroad), a US-based nonprofit organization, creates global learning environments to help students gather the critical perspectives, knowledge, and skills essential for future success. With innovative programming and world-class support, IFSA delivers future-focused study abroad options in 19 countries and 48 cities around the globe. Our commitments to inclusive excellence, intercultural agility, individualized learning and enduring impact are present in every aspect of our programs. Inclusion is a driving passion of our organization. We are committed to building a community where the thoughts and opinions of all team members are valued and contribute to our collective success, just as we build programs with the same focus. If you share our unwavering commitment to Inclusive Excellence and want to join a community that actively strives to improve in all that we do, IFSA is the place for you. Learn more about IFSA at https://www.ifsa-butler.org/ In this position, the standard duties include, but are not limited to: Cultural and Social Integration: Act as an ambassador for IFSA and the country and share enthusiasm for local culture. Help students feel welcome and assist with understanding the local culture and environment. Support students with practical tasks such as navigating public transport and getting a phone plan if necessary. Ongoing Program Support: Accompany students to activities, events, and excursions, including activities outside of Rome. Ensure classroom spaces are properly equipped. Incident Management and Reporting: Manage student incidents through IFSA’s CRM, SalesForce, and liaising with the Custom Program lead and Site Director. Ensure students have downloaded and registered on the Alert Media App. Financial Management and Post-Program Review: Document all spending, save receipts, and prepare a spending report. Create a post-program document outlining what went well (WWW) and what could be even better if (EBI). Emergency Response and Student Welfare: Attend and review relevant training materials - including Health and Safety 101, Prevent, and Emergency Response. Contribute to emergency response and student incident management based on established protocols. Requirements One - two years of work experience. Success in engaging with and supporting students with diverse lived experiences including students of color, students with mental and physical disabilities, first-generation college students, and LGBTQIA+ students. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. Design Evaluation Engineer Sustainable Automation The Industrial and Healthcare Backend organization is seeking a motivated and creative Design Evaluation Engineer to join our team in Milan. The team, as part of the Sustainable Automation (SAU) business unit, is at the forefront of the Intelligent Edge, developing innovative silicon and system level solutions that drive growth in our global industrial business. Our diverse portfolio of active projects includes Industrial Communications (e.g. IO-Link, Binary Sensors), Industrial digital I/O (High voltage, Mixed Signal), and Motor Drivers (Stepper, BLDC, FOC, and Gate Drivers) products which operate in harsh high-voltage/large-current industrial environments and end-user applications. The Design Evaluation role provides an exciting opportunity to work in a technically challenging and highly rewarding environment. You will work hands-on with a broad range of analogue and digital electronics, and develop significant expertise at circuit, component, and system level. This role offers a wide variety of development opportunities and exposes you to multiple technologies and end applications. You will work as part of a multidisciplinary team, developing cutting edge silicon solutions to solve our customers’ biggest problems and helping ADI to win at the Intelligent Edge. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected. We are currently seeking a Mechanical Engineer to join our dynamic team in Piove di Sacco (PD), Italy! We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Mechanical CAD Design Engineer to join our Thermal Management Engineering team in Piove di Sacco (PD) - Italy. He/She will be focused on Direct Expansion products for Data Center cooling. He/She will play a crucial role in the design of mechanical components and systems for our innovative products. items.desc: Jij bouwt wat mensen rust geeft op het moment dat het ertoe doet. Een dochter belt de zorgorganisatie omdat haar vader niet meer opneemt. Iemand die vastloopt, zoekt midden in de nacht contact met een hulplijn. Een productielijn ligt stil en de storingsdienst moet direct worden bereikt. Of dat via de telefoon, chat, een portaal of een app gaat, maakt op zo’n moment niet uit. Wat telt, is dat er iemand bereikbaar is. Pegamento ontwikkelt en beheert de eigen producten die dat mogelijk maken, voor onder meer zorginstellingen, gemeenten, onderwijsorganisaties, industrie en hulplijnen. Steeds vaker zetten we daarbij AI in: om vragen sneller bij de juiste persoon te krijgen, medewerkers te ondersteunen en klantcontact menselijk te houden, ook als het druk is. Wie dat bouwt? Dat ben jij. Waar je terechtkomt Je komt in het Research & Development-team, dat onze eigen producten ontwikkelt en beheert. Die producten draaien bij veel klanten tegelijk, in omgevingen met hoge eisen aan privacy, security, performance en continuïteit. We draaien op eigen infrastructuur en maken technische keuzes niet voor de volgende sprint, maar voor de komende jaren. Wat we vandaag ontwerpen, moet morgen nog beheersbaar, veilig en uitbreidbaar zijn. De implementatie bij klanten ligt bij een ander team. Jij bouwt aan het product zelf en gebruikt wat er in de praktijk gebeurt om het beter te maken. Wat de functie is Je krijgt zelfstandig eigenaarschap over een deel van ons landschap. Je denkt na voordat je bouwt, maakt technische keuzes inzichtelijk en zorgt dat kwaliteit geen toevallige uitkomst is. Naast code lever je overzicht, onderbouwing en oplossingen die collega’s kunnen begrijpen, beheren en verder ontwikkelen. Waar je aan meebouwt Je werkt met Python en React. Je bent in een van beide het sterkst en voelt je in de andere voldoende thuis om zelfstandig een volledige feature te bouwen. Je komt in een team dat: eigen neurale netwerken traint op onze on-premise GPU-infrastructuur; private LLM’s en open-weight modellen inzet, in het datacenter en op-device; SIP en andere real-time communicatieprotocollen integreert; multisiteplatformen bouwt die duizenden gebruikers ondersteunen. AI-tooling zoals Cursor en Claude Code gebruiken we dagelijks. Je zet die hulpmiddelen kritisch en efficiënt in, en blijft zelf verantwoordelijk voor ontwerp, codekwaliteit, security en het resultaat in productie. Wat we in het eerste jaar verwachten De eerste 90 dagen Je levert zelfstandig werkende functionaliteit op in een bestaande codebase en brengt die, in afstemming met design en backend, naar productie. Je neemt volwaardig deel aan reviews, refinements en architectuursessies en geeft onderbouwde feedback op het werk van anderen én op je eigen werk. Je werkt je in een domein in en maakt vroeg zichtbaar wat technisch, in de samenwerking of in onze werkwijze beter kan. Binnen 12 maanden Je hebt eigenaarschap over een component, service of domein en legt architectuurkeuzes helder uit aan collega’s en, via het implementatieteam, aan klanten. Je draagt bij aan herbruikbare componenten, patterns, CI/CD en security-by-design en helpt ad-hocoplossingen terug te dringen. Je begeleidt minder ervaren collega’s en vertaalt mogelijkheden in AI, LLM’s, SIP en real-time events naar bruikbare oplossingen. Wat je meebrengt Ervaring als software engineer in een productieomgeving waar echte gebruikers afhankelijk zijn van jouw code, en waarin je zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid droeg voor het resultaat. Je bent sterk in Python of in JavaScript/TypeScript met React, en hebt genoeg ervaring met de andere kant om een feature van database tot gebruikersinterface te bouwen. Je werkt dagelijks met relationele databases en API’s en begrijpt schemaontwerp, migraties en schaalbaarheid. Je weegt alternatieven en technische schuld af en schrijft onderhoudbare, testbare software. Je gebruikt AI-ontwikkeltools kritisch: je werkt er sneller mee, maar controleert aannames, veiligheid en kwaliteit. Je werkt constructief samen met engineers, designers, consultants en projectverantwoordelijken. Je maakt risico’s en afhankelijkheden vroeg zichtbaar en kunt professioneel “nee” zeggen zonder de relatie te verliezen. Je communiceert vloeiend in het Nederlands en redt je professioneel in het Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk. Mooi meegenomen We maken onderscheid tussen wat je nodig hebt om in deze rol te slagen en kennis die je bij ons kunt ontwikkelen. Ervaring met een of meer van deze onderwerpen maakt ons extra nieuwsgierig: SIP, WebRTC of media-streams; LLM’s, RAG, vector search of on-device AI; mobiele performance; klantcontact, CX, telefonie of CRM; publieke sector of zorg; containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD en observability; of PHP voor bestaande onderdelen. Geen ervaring met AI of SIP? Dat is te leren als je technische basis stevig is. Wat wij bieden Een contract voor onbepaalde tijd, vanaf 32 uur per week. Een passend salaris. items.desc: ProQR Therapeutics is a NASDAQ-listed biotechnology company headquartered in Leiden, the Netherlands with an office in and Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA. At ProQR, we are on a mission to edit RNA, treat disease and change lives. A team of 180+ enthusiastic ProQRians from all walks of life and more than 30 different nationalities is committed to pioneering transformative RNA therapies to make a difference in the lives of the communities we serve. Our proprietary Axiomer RNA editing technology platform enables the editing of specific single nucleotides in RNA using the cells own editing machinery. Axiomer RNA editing technology harnesses ADAR (Adenosine Deaminase Acting on RNA), a protein which is present in all human cells, to repair G-to-A mutations, modulate protein, and enable protective mutation functions. Axiomer could potentially yield a new class of innovative medicines and treat currently untreatable diseases. By harnessing the power of RNA editing, we aim to create a world where genetics inform your health - but never limit it. Our Research department is currently looking for an Associate Research Technician (Full-time) to join our team. Location: Leiden, Netherlands (On-site). The role: As an Associate Research Technician, you will be responsible for performing routine bioanalysis experiments to support our ongoing research projects. You will work closely with other (Senior) Researchers and Scientists and contribute to the reliable and timely generation of experimental data. We are looking for candidates with hands-on experience in one or more of the following: Bioanalysis using HPLC Routine laboratory analyses and sample preparation Laboratory automation equipment Experience working with animal tissues is an advantage We expect our Associate Research Technician: To have an MLO degree, level 4, with 0–2 years of working experience, preferably in an industrial or biotech environment; To have hands-on experience with HPLC; To be solution- and result-driven; To work accurately and with focus within a dedicated team; To execute routine experiments according to protocols and SOPs; To document experimental work accurately in a laboratory journal; To analyze and report experimental results; To take care of laboratory organization and related administrative tasks; To work safely and in accordance with applicable procedures; To be based in the Netherlands, within a commutable distance to our Leiden office; To have an existing, unrestricted right to work in the Netherlands, as Visa sponsorship and relocation support are not available for this position. Competencies that are required to make the difference Accurate and detail-oriented Proactive and flexible attitude Hands-on mentality Team player Autonomous and coachable Accountable Good knowledge of spoken and written English Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines Experience in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry is preferred Creative and solution-oriented thinker A nice person ProQR as an employer As an employer, we value a diverse workforce in which people are encouraged to develop themselves both personally and professionally. We believe that when people are happy, energized and supported by an environment in which they can thrive, they can achieve extraordinary things. We are committed to ensuring that no employee, candidate, or job applicant receives less favorable treatment on the grounds of race, age, disability, pregnancy, religion, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership status. items.desc: About Marex Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world's major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 3,000 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Deliver both in-person and virtual training sessions to a global customer base, adapting materials and delivery approaches to suit varying levels of technical proficiency and requirements. Align training content with evolving product features and customer needs, ensuring materials reflect the latest advancements in ICEYE’s portfolio of offerings. Support customer adoption and operational readiness through hands-on instruction, live demonstrations, and scenario-based learning that emphasizes real-world use. Collaborate with internal teams, including Product and Engineering, to ensure training materials are accurate, current, and aligned with broader customer engagement strategies Represent ICEYE at customer workshops, briefings, and industry events, acting as a trusted technical educator and advocate for the effective use of SAR data What we’re looking for Must haves: Experience in technical training and curriculum development Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences. Experience of D&I sector use of satellite imagery/SAR e.g. IMINT analyst Proficiency with satellite imagery/SAR processing tools and GIS platforms desirable Willingness to travel internationally regularly Ability to work effectively across diverse cultural and operational environments - prior experience engaging with international customers is strongly preferred Bachelor's degree (or higher level) or equivalent in Remote Sensing, Geography, Engineering or a related technical field. items.desc: CategorieAndere functies ExpertisegebiedICT StandplaatsNoord- en Midden-Limburg Type contractBepaalde tijd Minimaal aantal uur32 SalarisFWG 55 Vind jij een goede analyse spannender dan een gemiddelde Netflix-serie? Ben je na vakantie altijd blij om gewoon weer SQL te kunnen ‘spreken’? Help de zorg om slimmer te werken met behulp van data. Maak impact en sluit je aan bij Raf! Wat ga je doen? In Noord- en Midden-Limburg werken zorg- en welzijnsorganisaties, gemeenten en zorgverzekeraars samen binnen Regionaal Anders Focussen (Raf) . Raf is geen afzonderlijke organisatie of los project, maar een regionale samenwerking met één gezamenlijk doel: mensen helpen om zo gezond en zelfstandig mogelijk te leven. De partners bieden zorg en ondersteuning waar dat nodig is en proberen problemen te voorkomen waar dat kan. Dat begint natuurlijk met inzicht in de cijfers, en daar ga jij mee aan de slag! Binnen de pijler Raf digitaliseert werken we aan een datawerkplaats: een regionale voorziening voor gezamenlijke analyses, waarbij brongegevens waar mogelijk bij de eigen organisatie blijven. Zo creëren we betrouwbare inzichten die bijdragen aan betere zorg en ondersteuning in de regio. Als data analist haal je informatie op bij zorg- en welzijnsorganisaties, gemeenten, zorgverzekeraars en collega-data-analisten. Je vertaalt zorg- en beleidsvraagstukken naar datagedreven analyses en maakt inzichtelijk wat deze betekenen voor professionals, beleidsmakers en bestuurders. Daarbij herken je verschillen tussen databronnen, onderzoek je de impact daarvan op analyses en zorg je voor een zorgvuldige interpretatie van resultaten. Je ontwikkelt, test, documenteert en onderhoudt reproduceerbare analyses, zodat resultaten herhaalbaar, transparant en betrouwbaar zijn voor alle deelnemende organisaties. Je signaleert trends, patronen en afwijkingen in data en vertaalt deze naar heldere inzichten en handelingsperspectieven. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met de Data Steward bij het toepassen en verbeteren van definities, kwaliteitsafspraken en governancekaders. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat analyses aansluiten op de afgesproken standaarden en datakwaliteit binnen de regionale samenwerking. Samen met je collega’s binnen dit project werk je aan een logische structuur. Er is nog veel op te bouwen, wordt jouw nieuwsgierigheid al aangewakkerd? Heb je nog vragen? Neem contact op met... Sharon Lubbers sharon.lubbers@dezorggroep.nl Hoe zorgen wij voor jou? Je werkt in het hart van een van de grotere regionale digitaliseringsprogramma's in de zorg, met directe invloed op hoe cijfermatige inzichten regionaal worden vormgegeven. Natuurlijk doe je dit niet alleen, samen met de data analisten van verschillende organisaties en de data steward van Raf zorgen jullie voor waardevolle inzichten waarmee de organisaties vooruit kunnen. Jouw werkplek? Daar waar je nodig bent! Je komt geregeld bij verschillende organisaties over de vloer, maar kunt voor een data deep dive ook lekker thuis aan de slag. Ben je productiever in de avond? Rondom de overleggen kun je jouw werktijden flexibel indelen. Voor deze functie bieden we een contract voor de duur van in eerste instantie 1 jaar, met zicht op verlenging van zeker nog een jaar. Als data analist ga je binnen Raf aan de slag voor 32-36 uur per week. Voor dit aantal uren kom je in loondienst bij De Zorggroep en word je conform de cao VVT ingeschaald in FWG 55 met een maximumsalaris van € 5.413,38 bruto per maand bij een fulltime dienstverband van gemiddeld 36 uur per week. Naast je salaris bieden we arbeidsvoorwaarden die aansluiten bij jouw ontwikkeling, vitaliteit en persoonlijke situatie. Altijd goed voor je geregeld Een jaarlijkse periodieke verhoging binnen je functieschaal, totdat je het maximum van de schaal hebt bereikt Speciaal voor jou bij De Zorggroep PAK – Persoonlijk Arbeidsvoorwaarden Keuzebudget: je vakantiegeld van 8% en eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% worden maandelijks gereserveerd in je PAK-budget. Je liefde voor cijfers en expertise om deze te vertalen naar inzichten! Altijd nieuwsgierig en met oog voor detail, ontdek je snel patronen en afwijkingen in data. Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor kwaliteit en kunt resultaten helder visualiseren en presenteren aan verschillende doelgroepen. Daarnaast vind je het leuk om samen te werken met uiteenlopende organisaties binnen een regionale …

items.title: Junior Software Developer
items.card: Your mission Hartwig is working to unlock the value of patient data for better care through interactive analytics and database services. One such product is CNXT, a platform that gives researchers and clinicians intuitive access to insights derived from the Hartwig Medical Database. As Junior Software Developer you combine hands-on software development and collaboration with our INFRA team with product ownership of
items.desc: Your mission Hartwig is working to unlock the value of patient data for better care through interactive analytics and database services. One such product is CNXT, a platform that gives researchers and clinicians intuitive access to insights derived from the Hartwig Medical Database. As Junior Software Developer you combine hands-on software development and collaboration with our INFRA team with product ownership of Database services: translating the needs of researchers, clinicians and other stakeholders into a clear product roadmap towards a federated infrastructure. You report to the Data Lead and work closely with colleagues from data, bioinformatics, governance and infrastructure, as well as with clinicians and pathology experts. You participate in relevant planning and discussion meetings. Your profile What you’ll do Contribute directly to the design, development and maintenance of our Database products as a software developer. Grow into a Product Owner role for our Database products (like CNXT): define, prioritize and maintain the product backlog, translating research and clinical decision support needs into user stories, requirements and acceptance criteria. Gather and incorporate feedback from researchers, clinicians and other stakeholders (biotech, federation partners) to continuously improve usability and analytical value. Plan and coordinate releases and improvements of CNXT, balancing feasibility, timelines and stakeholder priorities. Collaborate with colleagues across technical and data teams to ensure CNXT accurately, reliably and securely surfaces Hartwig Medical Database data, in line with Hartwig’s quality, security and data governance standards. Document product decisions, functionality and known issues Support the onboarding and training of CNXT users. Who you are You hold an MSc or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics or another relevant computational discipline. You have demonstrable experience in software development, preferably using Java and/or Kotlin. You have affinity with, or are willing to grow into, a Product Owner role. You work in an analytical and structured way and can translate complex data and stakeholder needs into a clear product vision. You have strong communication skills and can bridge technical, scientific and clinical audiences. You are proficient in English (spoken and written); Dutch is a plus. You are curious, proactive and eager to learn. You feel comfortable working in a small, fast-moving team with a high degree of ownership. Experience with genomics and/or (cancer) clinical data is preferred but not required. Why us? A meaningful position (32–40 hours per week) within a mission-driven, non-profit organization. The opportunity to work at the intersection of life sciences, data and technology in a rapidly evolving field. A collaborative, open and informal working environment where knowledge sharing and initiative are encouraged. A monthly salary between € 3,500 and € 4,500 gross, based on experience and skills. 26 vacation days (based on full-time employment). A pension plan to which Hartwig Medical Foundation contributes two-thirds of the premium. Complimentary office lunches on Tuesdays and Thursdays, Friday afternoon drinks, and annual team events. About us At Hartwig Medical Foundation, every day we work with one clear goal: to ensure that every patient with cancer receives the treatment best suited to their unique situation. We achieve this by developing comprehensive DNA testing that helps hospitals analyze tumors with precision and supports clinicians in making informed treatment decisions. At the same time, we are building a rich knowledge base on patients, tumors, and treatment outcomes, so that the care delivered today contributes to the breakthroughs of tomorrow. Our organization is driven by both data and people. We collaborate closely with hospitals, researchers, and partners across the Netherlands to lower the barriers to personalized cancer care. Join our multidisciplinary team of experts — including medical professionals, analysts, bioinformaticians, and software developers — and help us make a real impact on patient care. Learn more about our organization at hartwigmedicalfoundation.nl . Location: Science Park 408, 1098 XH, Amsterdam, Netherlands We do not consider collaborations with agencies or freelancers for this position.

items.desc: Locatie: Pijnacker | Fulltime (32 of 40 uur) | Niveau: MBO Over de functie Bij Inlux Robotics komen dagelijks cobots, componenten en complete robotoplossingen binnen en gaan ze de hele wereld over. Maar voordat een cobot bij een klant terechtkomt, moet er meer gebeuren dan alleen een doos verplaatsen. Daarom zoeken we een Robotica Technician die technisch handig is, graag met zijn handen werkt en het leuk vindt om steeds meer over robotica te leren. Je programmeert en configureert cobots, test systemen, maakt orders technisch gereed voor verzending en ondersteunt onze engineers waar nodig. Kortom: geen traditionele magazijnfunctie, maar een praktische technische functie midden tussen de robots. Vandaag configureer je een cobot voor verzending. Morgen help je een engineer bij het testen van een nieuwe grijper. En daarna bouw je misschien mee aan een demo die naar een internationale beurs gaat. Wat ga je doen? Cobots aansluiten, configureren en programmeren; Robots en componenten technisch controleren en testen; Software, instellingen en configuraties voorbereiden; Klantorders technisch compleet maken; Cobots en bijbehorende apparatuur verzendklaar maken; Eenvoudige storingen analyseren en oplossen; Ondersteunen bij demo-opstellingen en tests; Samenwerken met onze engineers bij projecten en prototypes; Apparatuur voorbereiden voor beurzen, demonstraties en trainingen; Zorgen dat onze technische voorraad en werkplek netjes en overzichtelijk blijven. Wie zoeken we? We zoeken geen traditionele magazijnmedewerker. We zoeken iemand die graag praktisch bezig is, maar óók wil begrijpen hoe techniek werkt. Iemand die nieuwsgierig wordt als er een nieuwe robot binnenkomt en hem het liefst meteen aansluit om te kijken wat hij kan. Het helpt als je: Affiniteit hebt met robotica, automatisering of industriële techniek; Handig bent met computers en technische software; Praktisch bent ingesteld en graag met je handen werkt; Nauwkeurig werkt; Zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid kunt nemen; Het leuk vindt om nieuwe dingen te leren; Graag samenwerkt met engineers en andere collega's. Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt geen baan waarbij je de hele dag dezelfde handeling uitvoert. Je krijgt: Dagelijks werken met moderne cobots en robottechnologie; Een functie waarin techniek en praktisch werken samenkomen; Veel ruimte om robotica in de praktijk te leren; Afwisselend werk; De mogelijkheid om door te groeien en steeds meer technische verantwoordelijkheid te krijgen; Korte lijnen met onze engineers en andere collega's; Een goed salaris passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring; Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden; 25 vakantiedagen; Vrijdagmiddagborrels en regelmatig een BBQ; En vooral een werkplek waar robots gewoon onderdeel zijn van je werkdag. Over Inlux Robotics Inlux Robotics is een snelgroeiend internationaal robotica- en automatiseringsbedrijf van Nederlandse bodem. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Pijnacker en onze kantoren in Europa, Australië en Nieuw-Zeeland werken we aan één doel: robotautomatisering toegankelijker maken voor bedrijven wereldwijd. Als officieel distributeur van FAIRINO zijn we uitgegroeid tot een van de grotere internationale spelers op het gebied van cobots. We leveren robots, componenten en complete oplossingen aan machinebouwers, integratoren en grote internationale eindklanten. Daarnaast zijn we wereldwijd actief op toonaangevende vakbeurzen en robotica-events. Maar we leveren niet alleen robots. Met ons eigen engineeringteam ontwikkelen we complete automatiseringsoplossingen, van machinebelading en palletiseren tot vision-systemen en maatwerk robotapplicaties. Ook AI en Physical AI spelen een steeds grotere rol in onze ontwikkeling. Inlux Robotics is onderdeel van een groter concern met verschillende bedrijven en activiteiten. Dat geeft ons de slagkracht van een grotere organisatie, gecombineerd met de snelheid, vrijheid en korte lijnen van een groeiend technologiebedrijf. Salaris: €2.900,00 - €4.200,00 per maand Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Bedrijfsfeesten Budget voor professionele ontwikkeling Extra vakantiedagen Kerstpakket Mogelijkheid tot promotie Pensioen Reiskostenvergoeding Vrijdagmiddagborrel Werk vanuit huis Werklocatie: Fysiek

items.desc: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! As our Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician at QuantWare, you are the hands that turn a quantum chip into a working, measurable product. You package our chips into their housing and onto a PCB, and you will assemble and mount the new devices into their cryo fridge in the test facility. Your precision, discipline and reliability directly keep our production and measurement pipelines moving, and ensure our quantum hardware meets the highest quality standards. This is a hands-on execution role . You carry out chip assembly and fridge loading according to technical drawings and documented work instructions (SOPs), to a consistent quality standard and pace, and you record your work in our production systems. You report to the Production Manager , who holds formal line-management responsibility (1:1s, performance reviews, absence and leave). You take your daily and weekly priorities from the Assembly Tech Lead , who sets the assembly schedule and is the technical authority on the floor; fridge loading is planned in close coordination with the measurement team. What you'll be doing Core Responsibilities Assemble quantum chips into their packaging , working from technical drawings and work instructions to place and mount the chip in its housing and mount the chip in its housing with the PCB. Make the electrical connections , wirebonding (manual and automatic) will be a significant part of the daily activities, as well as manual soldering. Measure and test your work , performing the defined electrical and mechanical checks and recording the results, so issues are caught before a device moves on. Finish and close the package , including sealing, inspection, laser engraving and preparing for transportation to the measurement location. Load our cryogenic fridges with new chips to be measured , mounting packaged samples and QPUs, making the wiring, thermal and mechanical connections, and closing up the system with magnetic shields. Safeguard quality , handling fragile, high-value parts with care and following handling and ESD procedures, because a single scratch, particle or ESD event can ruin a chip. Supporting Responsibilities Flag deviations early , stopping and raising it with the Assembly Tech Lead when something does not match the instruction or does not look right, rather than improvising a fix. Help improve how we work , giving practical feedback on work instructions, fixtures and tools while our processes are still maturing. Keep a safe, clean and organised workplace , applying 5S and HSE rules every day and making sure your bench, tooling and consumables are ready. Your Profile MBO-level technical education (level 3 or 4) or equivalent, for example in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electronics, fine-mechanical or precision engineering, or lab or instrument technology. 4+ years of hands-on experience assembling mechanical, electrical or mechatronic systems; relevant internships count. Able to read work instructions with photos and technical drawings, and comfortable with basic digital tools and production systems. Good with your hands at two scales: precision in assembly, handling of fine devices and connectors, and mechanical assembly such as bolting, cabling and fitting larger parts together. Precise and patient, with a genuine liking for detailed hands-on work done well, every time, and a practical approach to solving problems. Comfortable with structured, repeatable work, and disciplined about following instructions step by step and recording what you did. Comfortable in an environment that is still being built, where not every process is finished yet and priorities can shift. A team player in a young, driven team who communicates openly and speaks up when something isn't right. Good command of technical English. Bonus if you also bring: Experience with wirebonding, die attach or other chip-packaging / microelectronics assembly. Experience with measurements, diagnostics or troubleshooting. Experience in a lab, ESD-controlled or 5S production environment. Experience assembling, servicing or setting up complex equipment, instruments or machines. Familiarity with cryogenics or vacuum systems. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, …

items.desc: Introductie Keeping the Netherlands powered, that is our mission. As a Grid Planning and Analysing Specialist, you help ensure that the electricity system remains secure, stable and future-proof. You provide specialised knowledge and skills in a specific area of expertise to drive innovation and support successful execution of projects, initiatives, innovations and/or daily operations. Furthermore you identify the frameworks and guidelines that apply to their specific area of expertise, translate them into a business context to enable business results, and provide guidance to ensure efficiency and compliancy. By doing this you contribute to a stable, future-proof and affordable energy system. Jouw rol The energy transition demands smart and decisive professionals. Within the Data Tools & Models Team, we work every day on ensuring that TenneT's grid models remain accurate, reliable and future-ready, enabling sound planning and operation of the Dutch electricity system. Do you want to contribute directly to a reliable, affordable and sustainable energy system as a Grid Planning and Analysing Specialist – Grid Model Management (GMM)? At TenneT, the grid model is at the heart of almost every planning and design activity. It is used for everything from load flow calculations and network planning studies to harmonic and EMT analyses. As the electricity system becomes increasingly complex, maintaining a high-quality and centrally managed grid model is more important than ever. As a Grid Planning and Analysing Specialist, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality, governance and further development of these models. Your Contribution to TenneT How do you help keep the Netherlands powered? As a Systems & Markets Specialist – Grid Model Management, you are responsible for the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of TenneT's grid models and associated data sets, enabling high-quality analyses and decision-making across the organisation. You will become part of the Grid Model Management (GMM) team, a team of approximately 6 specialists within the Data Tools & Models Team in the Design division. Tasks & Responsibilities Maintain and develop TenneT’s core high-voltage grid model and derived network models for national and European power system analyses. Manage model changes, data quality, and information requests to ensure accurate and reliable modelling data. Continuously improve network models and underlying datasets through analysis, research, and innovation initiatives. Collaborate with operational teams and stakeholders to ensure alignment, consistency, and quality across network models. Represent TenneT in national and European modelling and data management activities, including ENTSO-E working groups. Share expertise, support colleagues with modelling and software-related challenges, and contribute to the development of a centrally managed, company-wide grid model. Waar kom je terecht Design translates TenneT’s strategy into a future-proof vision of the energy system. Colleagues within this division have a front-row view of today’s energy system and especially of tomorrow’s. Design provides direction for system choices, designs the foundation of the energy system of the future, and creates room for faster implementation. In close alignment with our customers and public stakeholders, Design determines what is needed in the long term to ensure security of supply and system integrity. Ubiq Aerospace is a Trondheim-based deep tech company on an ambitious growth journey. We develop next-generation ice protection systems, smart aerostructures and sensing systems for aircraft operating in the world's harshest environments. We are looking for a creative, open-minded and technically strong Electronics Design Engineer to join our team. Electronic hardware for power and signals is a crucial part of our solutions, and in this role you will take ownership of electronics development from early concepts and requirements through to working, tested hardware. This posting is for an experienced candidate, but we also have an open position for an early career candidate on our website. You will work hands-on across the entire electronics design process, including system and circuit design, component selection, schematic capture, PCB layout, prototyping, bring-up, debugging and validation. We are looking for someone who is comfortable designing a PCB from scratch and taking it all the way through to functioning hardware. You'll combine individual technical ownership with close collaboration across Ubiq's multidisciplinary engineering teams. You'll contribute to decisions about future hardware needs and architectures and work alongside colleagues across different engineering disciplines to develop robust solutions to challenging problems. We're open to what your background specifically might look like. What matters to us is that you're comfortable taking responsibility, are self-motivated and have a learning mindset. We're a small team, so we also value people who are adaptable, pragmatic and enjoy working closely with others. What you'll do End-to-end electronics design: Take ownership of electronic hardware from requirements and architecture through circuit design, component selection, schematic capture and complete PCB layout. Prototyping and bring-up: Take new hardware from design files to physical prototypes, including board bring-up, debugging and iteration. Design for manufacturing: Consider manufacturability, assembly and test from the outset, and work with manufacturing partners and colleagues to take designs smoothly from prototypes towards reliable production. Assembly and integration: Assemble and integrate electronics & wiring into higher-level subsystems. Testing and validation: Develop and perform testing to verify that designs meet their requirements and perform reliably in their intended environment. Hardware architecture: Analyse future hardware needs and contribute to system architecture and technical trade-offs. Cross-disciplinary development: Work closely with other engineering disciplines to ensure electronics are well integrated into the overall system. Documentation: Document hardware designs, design choices, test procedures and results to support effective collaboration and future development. Your background, knowledge and skills Relevant education within electronics, power electronics, electrical engineering or a related field. Practical experience and demonstrated ability are just as important to us as the specific educational path you have taken. Hands-on experience designing electronic hardware and taking PCB designs from an initial idea through to working hardware. Experience with schematic capture and complete PCB layout, including component placement and routing. Strong understanding of electronic design principles and good knowledge of analogue and digital circuits. Ability to select components and make sound engineering trade-offs based on electrical performance, reliability, availability and other design constraints. Comfortable bringing up and debugging newly manufactured PCBs and systematically finding and solving hardware problems. Experience using standard electronics lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies and signal generators. Understanding of design for manufacturing (DFM) principles and how PCB design choices influence fabrication, assembly, testability and production reliability. Proficient in fine-pitch SMD soldering, wire crimping, and PCB modification to support rapid iteration. Strong analytical problem-solving skills combined with a pragmatic and solution-oriented approach. Enjoy taking technical ownership while collaborating closely with others. Why join Ubiq Aerospace? At Ubiq, you'll be trusted with real engineering responsibility from day one. You'll join us at a particularly exciting stage: our technologies are moving from R&D and low-rate production towards products that need to be manufactured reliably at greater scale. items.desc: LoopMe is an AI company solving one of advertising’s hardest problems: making brand advertising actually measurable, and making it perform. Our platform runs patented machine learning models across billions of consumer signals in real time, optimising campaigns toward outcomes like purchase intent, brand lift, and foot traffic rather than proxy metrics like clicks. The result is 2–5x better performance than industry benchmarks, at scale. We operate a high-load programmatic infrastructure, processing millions of ad requests per second with sub-200ms response times globally. This isn’t a layer on top of someone else’s stack; it’s built from the ground up, in-house, by the team you’d be joining. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in London, we now have 400+ people across 19 cities and have sustained 40% revenue CAGR since 2018. The engineering problems here are real, the ownership is genuine, and the scale is significant. The opportunity You own the build and ongoing maintenance of our internal data lakehouse, giving our users the data they need to make better-informed, data-driven decisions. Today our data lives across BigQuery, Clickhouse, Postgres, and Elastic Search, and internal users rely on product reporting or ad hoc extracts in Rill, Tableau, and Looker. What you’ll do Own the build and maintenance of our internal data lakehouse. Partner with our Product team to identify the core platform data that Finance and Business Development need. Analyse and organise raw data from our different sources. Build and maintain the data pipeline architecture that exposes data from our databases into our visualisation tools. Develop data systems and pipelines that keep data efficiently updated. Improve data quality and reliability. Partner with other engineers to maintain our tooling and pipelines. What you’ll bring Essential You bring 3+ years of experience in a data engineering role. You bring experience with database technologies including BigQuery, Clickhouse, and Postgres. You bring technical expertise with data models, data mining, and segmentation techniques. You bring experience with Airflow and/or dbt. You bring experience with cloud-based technologies running on GCS and/or AWS. Nice to have Experience with Snowflake Analytical skills for working with unstructured datasets What we offer Hybrid working — flexible schedule · 1 month work-from-anywhere · Annual performance bonus · Multikafeteria (sport/culture card) · LoopMe Gives Back · Learning & development support

Potrafisz efektywnie współpracować z wieloma interesariuszami biznesowymi, technologicznymi i regulacyjnymi. Oferujemy Ci: Premię uzależnioną od wyników i zaangażowania. W naszym zespole będziesz odpowiadać za: Identyfikację i rozwój zmiennych wykorzystywanych do personalizacji: wyszukiwanie nowych źródeł danych mogących poprawić trafność rekomendacji, definiowanie cech klienta (features) opisujących zachowania, potrzeby i potencjał zakupowy, budowanie zmiennych behawioralnych, transakcyjnych, produktowych i cyfrowych, ocenę jakości, kompletności i stabilności danych. Walidację wartości biznesowej zmiennych. Budowę modeli predykcyjnych i propensity, w tym modeli określających prawdopodobieństwo realizacji konkretnego zachowania. Optymalizację mechanizmów personalizacji. Monitorowanie i ocenę jakości modeli. Współpracę z zespołami biznesowymi, definiowanie potrzeb danych dla nowych przypadków użycia oraz udział w rozwoju Customer Data Platform. Przekładanie potrzeb biznesowych na rozwiązania analityczne i modele. Ta praca jest dla Ciebie, jeśli: Masz doświadczenie w budowie i wdrażaniu modeli predykcyjnych wspierających personalizację, rekomendację ofert i zarządzanie relacjami z klientami. Bardzo dobrze znasz metody Machine Learning, statystykę oraz nowoczesne rozwiązania AI, w tym Generative AI i LLM. Praktycznie znasz język Python i SQL oraz masz doświadczenie w pracy na dużych zbiorach danych klientów. Posiadasz doświadczenie w pozyskiwaniu, integracji, eksploracji i transformacji danych z wielu źródeł, tworzeniu zmiennych (feature engineering) oraz ocenie jakości danych na potrzeby budowy modeli analitycznych. Potrafisz tworzyć modele Next Best Offer, Next Best Action, Churn, Customer Lifetime Value oraz modele propensity. Wykorzystujesz dane Customer 360° do personalizacji komunikacji i ofert. Potrafisz walidować, monitorować i optymalizować modele pod kątem skuteczności biznesowej oraz jakości predykcji. Umiesz przekładać cele CRM, sprzedaży i retencji na rozwiązania analityczne i rekomendacje biznesowe. Rozumiesz znaczenie jakości danych, Data Governance oraz współpracy z zespołami CRM, Customer Data Platform i raportowania. Oferujemy Ci: Premię uzależnioną od wyników i zaangażowania. Prywatną opiekę medyczną dla Ciebie i Twojej rodziny na preferencyjnych warunkach. Kartę MultiSport i Ubezpieczenie Grupowe na korzystnych warunkach. System szkoleń i programów rozwojowych. The Central Demand Planning will provide the statistical forecast to our European operating companies. We will do that using a variety of Demand Planning tools (Blue Yonder and FuturMaster). In the coming 2 years the central team will grow to around 13 people. During that same period, we will onboard European operating companies one by one and start working closely with their local planning teams. As a demand planner you will be responsible for 1-3 European operating companies and provide them every week with the stastical forecast from our planning models. Together with the local team, this statistical base will be enriched to create the Demand Plan. You will support the generation of a reliable Machine Learning (ML) or statistical forecast by collecting and preparing demand causal factors, assisting in forecast stability checks, and performing outlier cleansing where needed. The role enables operating companies to enrich and align the demand plan through standardized processes by maintaining data quality, executing routine analyses, and providing support for the Business Building & Demand Review meeting. Your responsibilities would include: validating master and transactional data, update & refresh demand causal factors, and support maintenance of DFUs/NPI lifecycle reviewing and validating generated ML or statistical forecast by assisting in stability checks, applying cleansing strategy, and escalating intervention cases to operating companies documenting and clarifying demand for causal factors included in the ML forecast to support enrichment activities providing support to operating companies in preparation for Business Building (BB) and Demand Review (DR) meetings and attend meetings to answer ML forecast questions sharing observed causal factor trends, market insights, and input on scenarios and risk & opportunity (R&O;) discussions with Data Science and operating companies tracking forecast performance by preparing KPI and PPI reports; support weekly/monthly performance meetings with operating companies ensuring adherence to Hub cadence; escalate data issues and risks to the Demand Planning Manager You are a good candidate if you have: Bachelor's degree or equivalent, preferably in Management, Business, Supply Chain, or related field at least 2 years work experience in demand planning, Machine Learning forecasting, supply chain management some experience working for a multinational organization; FMCG / Beverage industry experience functional skills: supply chain planning, Microsoft Office, experience working with Blue Yonder or FuturMaster (preferred) advanced English skills; second language (nice to have) At HEINEKEN Kraków, we take integrity and ethical conduct seriously. If someone has concerns about a possible violation of legal regulations indicated in Polish Whistleblowing Act or our Code of Business Conduct, we encourage them to speak up. Cases can be reported to global team or locally (in line with the local HGSS Whistleblowing procedure) by selecting proper option in this tool or by communicating it on hotline. LI-HYBRID

items.desc: The Opportunity We’re building the future of embodied AI: robots that learn, adapt and work alongside people in the real world. Doing that takes some of the rarest talent there is: robotics engineers, ML engineers, data platform specialists, and the technical leaders who build and guide those teams. These people aren’t browsing job boards. We need someone who knows how to find them, wherever they are, and give them a reason to talk to us, especially since we are currently operating in stealth mode. You’ll be our dedicated internal headhunter. You will map the market, find the people others miss, and get them excited enough to take the first conversation. This position can be based in Munich (onsite) or Poland/UK (remote). Your Responsibilities Lead searches for senior technical, leadership and other tough-to-fill roles Map the talent landscape: which companies, labs and research groups have the people we need, and who’s worth approaching Find candidates beyond LinkedIn, through GitHub, research papers, conference speakers, open-source communities and personal networks Run first conversations with candidates to qualify interest and fit Work closely with hiring managers and founders to understand what “great” looks like for each role Share market insights with the team: compensation trends, talent availability, and where the competition is hiring Requirements 4+ years in headhunting or executive search at an agency or search firm A proven track record of placing senior technical & hard-to-find profiles Enough technical understanding to have a credible conversation with a robotics or ML engineer and tell a strong profile from a good-looking CV Experience sourcing internationally, across markets and time zones Creative, persistent sourcing skills: Boolean search, X-ray search, and using sources well beyond the usual platforms Strong written and spoken English An existing network in the European or US robotics and AI communities would be a definite plus! Recruiting Process Your recruiting partner for this role is Madhulika (she/her). You can expect a screening interview, and two additional interviews, including potentially an onsite visit to our office in Munich to meet the team. Benefits Competitive compensation package A role with real impact. Every hire you bring in shapes what we build next. Work with a world-class team in a flat hierarchy, with direct collaboration alongside the founders and engineering team Fast growth potential in a rapidly evolving company and industry International office environment with English as the official working language We hire across backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we are committed to a workplace where everyone belongs. Discrimination has no place here. If you need any accommodations during the recruiting process, just reach out to your recruiting partner.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night.
