items.desc: Do you enjoy turning customer insights, manufacturing knowledge, and technical product understanding into clear direction and innovation for a global product portfolio? Here’s an opportunity to work close to both the market and technology, shaping solutions that support customers and influence the future of our Turning offering. About the job You play a key part in strengthening the Grades product portfolio within the Turning offering. Your technical understanding, business mindset, and customer perspective come together as you connect market needs with product development and business priorities. Working closely with customers, manufacturing, sales application specialists, product developers, R&D and other key stakeholders, you also collaborate with product project teams and project owners to support successful product development and delivery. Job responsibilities Contribute to the Grades portfolio strategy and help shape the future offer direction. Develop and share application and product knowledge through training, demonstrations and communication for internal and external stakeholders. Monitor competitors and analyze the competitive landscape for products within the portfolio. Ensure product specifications meet customer demands, with options and pricing remaining aligned. Develop and communicate clear customer value propositions. Contribute to new product development, from initiating and defining requirements to managing field testing, and support new grade introductions with technical application material and sales strategy. Location and flexibility The position offers flexibility within Europe, preferably close to one of our sites. We support a hybrid way of working, combining office presence with remote work. Your profile You have a strong understanding of technical applications and know how to translate insights into structured product development work. Experience in product management, technical sales, product development, or international business strategy helps you succeed, and you’re comfortable collaborating across a broad stakeholder network. Your background includes: Deep understanding of turning applications, concepts, customer component processes, machining strategies, and customer manufacturing challenges. Good knowledge of customer needs, manufacturing components, and materials. Experience in product portfolio work, manufacturing, lifecycle management, or product development. Understanding of project models and structured product project work, combined with the ability to translate insights into clear requirements. Good communication skills in English, both spoken and written; presentation skills are preferable. Experience within metal cutting, particularly turning applications and grades, is highly valued. You’re structured, collaborative, and motivated by working close to both people and products. Building relationships across countries and functions comes naturally, and you represent the area of turning grades with curiosity, ownership and a customer-focused mindset. By connecting technical details with the bigger picture, you help move ideas forward and turn knowledge into value for customers. Our culture Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career opportunities in an inspiring global environment. Meet some of your future colleagues at our career page or visit our website , LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further. items.desc: Acne Studios is a progressive luxury house and through collaboration and curiosity, we set high aspirations and strive for excellence. We value everyone’s contribution and embrace feedback to develop ourselves and others. We aim to minimise our environmental impact across all our operations and to address societal challenges in the way we conduct our business. As Analytics Engineer at our Stockholm Head Office, you will transform clean, validated data into well-documented, trusted datasets that teams across Acne Studios rely on. items.desc: The Royal Marsden has a vital role in championing change and improvement in cancer care through research and innovation, education and leading-edge practice. We are incredibly proud of our international reputation for pushing the boundaries and for our ground breaking work ensuring our patients receive the very best and latest in cancer treatment and care. As part of the department expansion, an opportunity has arisen for a Genetic Technologist Analyst to join the Clinical Genomics department. The Clinical Genomics laboratory at the Royal Marsden is part of the North Thames Genomic Laboratory Hub (NT GLH), one of seven national Genomic Laboratory Hubs offering Cancer Genomic testing in England. The department is located in the Centre for Molecular Pathology in Sutton. The Centre for Molecular Pathology is a state-of-the-art facility bringing together translational science and molecular diagnostics. It is one of the few specialised laboratories in molecular diagnostics of cancer in Europe. The department provides a reference Molecular Diagnostics and Cytogenetics Service for solid tumours and haematological malignancies, as well as participating in clinical trials and collaborating with the industry (https://www.royalmarsden.nhs.uk/royal-marsden-partnership-create-state-art-house-liquid-biopsy-testing-facility) to provide cutting-edge genomic technologies to support personalised cancer treatment. The post holder will undertake technical, analytical and administrative duties required to support the scientific teams in the provision of an effective and high quality molecular diagnostics service to patients. This will require detailed theoretical and practical knowledge. They will be responsible for carrying out analytical molecular diagnostics investigations. There will be occasions when the post holder takes sole responsibility for their work. The range of tests available will be in continuous development and the post-holder will be responsible for the validation and verification of new techniques and tests, including the provision of NGS and ddPCR for molecular diagnostics in haematological and solid tumours. They will collaborate and plan complex activities with other members of the team to achieve an effective and reliable service. The post holder will be expected to assist in training of new staff members and visitors as well as to contribute to IT development and data management relating to the technical aspects of the molecular service In addition the post holder will be required to support activities such as quality, including compliance with laboratory accreditation standards, equipment maintenance and participate in the departments training programme. Bel-sar represents an entirely novel approach to treating ocular cancers via its dual mechanisms of action of acute tumor necrosis and secondary anti-tumor immune activation. The Phase 3 registration study of Bel-sar in early choroidal melanoma, the largest patient segment of uveal melanoma, is fully enrolled, and earlier stage studies in metastases to the choroid and cancers of the ocular surface are ongoing. Aura's mission is to improve outcomes for patients living with ocular cancers by delivering a therapy that not only arrests tumor growth but also preserves vision and quality of life. Through its Dx CRO and Sponsor Delegation services, ARC supports the planning, delivery and oversight of global CDx clinical trials, acting as an extension of the Sponsor team and providing clear ownership and accountability across delegated activities. ARC Laboratories, based in Belfast, Northern Ireland, provides in-house assay and clinical trial sample testing capabilities across IHC, qPCR, ELISA and NGS-based testing. ARC’s Health Institution status, under the IVDR Article 5(5), provides a practical route for early-phase clinical trial sample testing in the EU and UK, helping reduce regulatory burden and enable faster sample testing for eligible studies. Collaborate with Reporting Engineers to define, develop and enhance the Common Data Model. Team Roles & Responsibilities: Work within the overall data architecture, ensuring that it aligns with the business's data strategy, scalability and future requirements. Continuously optimise for improved data flow, accessibility and security. Design and develop data ingestion processes, integrating multiple data sources. Maintain the Common Data Model to ensure organisation‑wide consistency. Apply Agile principles for iterative and collaborative development. Ensure data pipeline quality, reliability and performance. Develop, test and implement monitoring to ensure effective operation. Experience & Skills Required: Proven experience in Data Engineering, with strong hands‑on experience in Python, Data Modelling, Data Warehousing . Strong background in incident resolution, requests, changes and problem‑solving within SLAs. Hands‑on experience with Spark, Data Architecture, SQL and Delta Lake. Cloud development experience (AWS, GCP or Azure). Working knowledge of Medallion Architecture. Demonstrated capability in implementing and supporting pipelines in demanding environments. Strong communication skills and confidence presenting ideas and technical approaches. Ability to work effectively in complex, high‑pressure environments using both legacy and modern technologies. Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail. Desirable Experience with Fabric, Azure, JIRA, Confluence, CI/CD, GitHub and Git Actions. Certifications in Data Engineering, Cloud, Data Modelling or Data Architecture. Experience with development lifecycle processes for data pipelines. STEM degree (Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics) or equivalent practical experience. items.desc: Description White Swan Data is a small but rapidly growing team of mathematicians, data scientists and software engineers who are constantly striving to refine world class probability models while also researching and deploying new ones. Our work bridges three domains, each challenging in its own right - iGaming, quantitative research and software development. As a Football Trader, you will monitor and manage betting markets, analyse live football data, and make decisions to optimize trading outcomes. This role combines a strong mathematical aptitude with a deep understanding of football dynamics. Prior trading experience is not required but will be considered a plus. You will be expected to work over the weekend during football season and at least 2 evening shifts (finish past 10:30 pm). This role will reward individuals who are curious, hungry for learning and value attention to detail. Key Responsibilities Monitor football betting markets, track odds movements, and identify trading opportunities. Analyse live and historical football data to inform trading strategies. Adjust prices in response to market trends and real-time events (e.g., goals, injuries, substitutions). Collaborate with analysts to refine trading models and improve market predictions. Maintain focus and accuracy in high-pressure, fast-paced environments, particularly during live matches. Stay informed about football leagues, teams, players, and trends to gain a competitive edge. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Essential: Strong mathematical background (degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or a related field preferred). Comprehensive knowledge of football, including leagues, teams, and strategies. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Ability to make quick decisions under pressure. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or basic data analysis tools. Desirable: Experience with statistical programming languages (e.g., Python, R). Knowledge of betting markets or prior experience in a trading environment. Understanding of predictive modeling and probability theory. Passion for football analytics and/or sports betting. Benefits Salary depending on experience. Annual discretionary performance bonus. Comprehensive training in trading strategies, market dynamics, and tools. Opportunities for career growth in a dynamic and exciting industry. A collaborative work environment surrounded by football enthusiasts and data experts. Flexible working hours, particularly during the football calendar. 25 days holiday per annum, plus UK bank holidays. Private health & dental insurance. Optical cover through Aviva. Pension plan. Gympass membership to over 1900 gyms and wellness businesses. Breakfast bought in everyday and lunch bought in twice a week Free coffee & snacks at the office. Regular team events & socials. About White Swan Data Technology is at the heart of our business and has produced consistent and significant results. We are a small but rapidly growing team of mathematicians, data scientists and software engineers constantly striving to refine our world class statistical models while also researching and deploying new ones. Our work bridges three domains, each challenging in its own right - iGaming, quantitative research and software development. This convergence demands a rare blend of skills and creativity to identify and capitalise on inefficiencies across the iGaming landscape. The opportunities are vast, but we are only as good as the people we bring on board. As a startup, we offer a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment where you’ll work on impactful projects and have the autonomy to explore new ideas. In-person collaboration and innovation are at the heart of what we do, and we are always looking for individuals who can contribute their unique perspectives and talents to help us stay ahead in a constantly evolving industry. At White Swan Data, we recognise that building a diverse and inclusive workforce within a highly technical field presents both opportunities and challenges. We recognise the value that a variety of perspectives can bring to innovation, problem-solving, and business success. A team composed of individuals from different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking fosters creativity, enhances decision-making, and ultimately strengthens our ability to tackle complex challenges.

Are you our next Quality Engineer? We're looking for an experienced Quality Engineer who combines strong technical testing skills with the confidence to take ownership of projects and work directly with clients. You'll join our team of software testing specialists, working across a variety of technologies, industries and delivery environments. You could be embedded within a client's development team, leading testing on a project or helping a client improve their approach to quality. We're looking for someone who can get to grips with complex systems, investigate technical issues and make informed decisions about what needs testing and how. Investigate complex technical issues using APIs, databases, browser developer tools, application logs and other diagnostic resources. Apply test automation where it adds value, working with existing frameworks or contributing to automated testing activities. The ability to write SQL queries to investigate issues, validate data and understand how applications interact with databases. Experience using browser developer tools, application logs and other diagnostic resources to investigate defects. A good technical understanding of software architecture, system integrations and data flows. Experience working directly with developers, product owners and other stakeholders in Agile delivery environments. The confidence to work independently, make decisions and provide direction to other testers when required. Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues, challenge assumptions and discuss risks directly with clients. A practical, analytical approach to problem-solving and a willingness to learn new technologies. It would also be great if you have: Experience with test automation tools or frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress or Selenium. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git or cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud. Experience testing complex integrations, data migrations or enterprise systems. Experience improving testing practices or introducing new tools and approaches. ISTQB certification or other relevant technical qualifications. items.desc: Group Overview The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure. items.desc: Guildford Ward is looking for motivated, adaptable, forward thinking and enthusiastic Band 6 Sisters/Charge Nurses with excellent communication skills and the motivation to develop and progress their management skills in our purpose built, bright and modern environment Our enhanced care unit is an intermediate level of care between that provided within HDU and the ward, where enhanced advice and support from the critical care team can be accessed. We provide care to those patients whose care needs are greater than those that are provided on a general ward and ensures a seamless escalation of care should that be required. Each cubicle is fitted out with cardiac monitors and medical devices to allow holistic care to be provided to both low acuity and high dependency patients who may require supported breathing interventions and work closely with our critical care outreach and respiratory teams to ensure the best possible outcomes for our patients We are dedicated to training and developing our staff in their chosen field and take pride in supporting our nurses to become nurse specialists and nurse leaders of the future. We encourage close working with all members of the multi-disciplinary teams and support our band 6 nurses in their roles as practice supervisors and assessors to develop our junior staff and encourage and promote professional learning and development We are recruiting nurses who are passionate about providing and supporting the delivery of high quality, safe and evidenced based care in our 20 bedded unit . This band 6 role provides a real opportunity to develop your clinical skills and knowledge base while working closely alongside our well established infection control team in our negative pressure environment. Royal Surrey is a compassionate and collaborative acute and community Trust. Recognising that our 5,000 colleagues are our greatest strength, we offer a comprehensive health and wellbeing programme alongside a strong commitment to developing your career. Our diverse and welcoming Royal Surrey family ensures you feel valued from your initial interview and throughout your time with us. We are clinically led and provide joined-up care by bridging hospital and community services, alongside delivering regional specialist cancer care. Our main acute hospital site is in Guildford, with community sites at Milford, Haslemere and Cranleigh, and services delivered in patients’ homes across Guildford and Waverley. We work in partnership with Ashford & St Peter’s Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust through a collaborative Group Model, supporting joined-up services, workforce flexibility and development opportunities. The Care Quality Commission (CQC) has rated us as Outstanding. We are proud of our achievements and continue to invest in our people and infrastructure. To learn more about life at Royal Surrey, please watch our short video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R96pMboIYdo Adverts may close early, so you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. As nurse in charge they have overall responsibility for day-to-day management of their clinical area and for ensuring all care is delivered according to Trust policies and procedures maintaining associated records. They will manage, support and lead a team of nurses in the delivery of evidence based patient centred care, which is of a high standard. They will assist the senior sister in the management of staff including appraisal, rotas, recruitment and selection and the supervision of learners. They will provide advice and support to patients, relatives and members of the multi-disciplinary team. Utilising clinical audit, research, supervision of practice and teaching, they will monitor and improve standards of care by efficient and effective use of resources and liaise with the senior sister at all times. items.desc: An exciting opportunity has arisen for an enthusiastic and highly motivated midwife to join the Inpatient Maternity Team at Frimley Park Hospital as a Band 7 Antenatal Ward Sister, working 15 hours per week as part of a job-share arrangement. In this role, you will provide visible clinical and operational leadership within the Antenatal Ward, ensuring the delivery of safe, effective, and compassionate care for women and their families. You will lead on all aspects of antenatal care, supporting and developing the multidisciplinary team to deliver high standards of care and an excellent patient experience. This post offers a valuable opportunity for personal and professional development, as well as the chance to contribute to ongoing service improvement. You will work collaboratively with colleagues across both hospital and community maternity services to promote seamless care and positive outcomes for women and their families. Provide clinical, professional, and operational leadership within the Antenatal Ward, ensuring the delivery of safe, effective, evidence-based, and woman-centred care. Act as a role model and senior clinical resource for the multidisciplinary team, supporting staff development, professional practice, and service improvement initiatives. Work autonomously within established policies, protocols, and guidelines, demonstrating sound clinical judgement and decision-making in accordance with the NMC Code and Midwives Rules and Standards. Coordinate the day-to-day management of the Antenatal Ward, promoting effective patient flow, positive patient experiences, and high standards of care. Support the education, supervision, and development of midwifery staff, students, and support workers, fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement. Maintain and develop specialist knowledge through ongoing professional development and post-registration education, ensuring clinical practice remains current and evidence based. Collaborate closely with colleagues across inpatient, community, and wider multidisciplinary services to ensure seamless care pathways and excellent outcomes for women and their families. Participate in the senior midwife/hands-on-help on-call rota, providing leadership and clinical support to the wider maternity service as required. items.desc: An exciting opportunity has arisen for an enthusiastic and motivated Activity Coordinator to join the multidisciplinary team at Butler Green Enhanced Intermediate Care Unit. The post holder will play a key role in supporting the delivery of a holistic rehabilitation model by developing, coordinating and facilitating a varied programme of meaningful therapeutic, cognitive, social and recreational activities for patients. Working alongside nursing, therapy and wider multidisciplinary colleagues, the Activity Coordinator will support patients to maintain independence, improve wellbeing, enhance social engagement and maximise their rehabilitation potential during their stay. The post holder will assess individual interests, abilities and needs to ensure activities are person-centred, inclusive and aligned with rehabilitation goals. They will promote patient participation, record engagement and outcomes, and contribute to improving the overall patient experience within the unit. The role will also support the development of relationships with community organisations, volunteers, charities and external partners to enhance opportunities available to patients and support community integration where appropriate. Unfortunately, this role does not meet the criteria required to qualify for sponsorship. With support from the Ward Leadership Team/Multidisciplinary team, contribute to providing a range of social interaction and well-being activities, e.g., activity groups, and on an individual basis, with minimal supervision. In collaboration with the client group and Ward Manager, maintain and develop the activities timetable for the ward and for each client on an individual recovery focussed basis. Work alongside colleagues e.g., Occupational Health, Physiotherapy and Nursing staff to deliver a range of activities that are recovery focussed and suit the individual needs of each client. Contribute to the regular updating of individual activity timetables for clients which offer a range of activities on an individual and group basis dependent on the client’s needs. This can be subject to regular change. Document all engagement with clients in their case notes to ensure the clinical team is kept up to date with client’s participation in activities. Verbally hand over this information to the Therapeutic and nursing team on a shift-by-shift basis as appropriate. The post holder will support learners in the workplace by providing an opportunity for shadowing with the activity co-ordinator to observe activities being planned and delivered. Ensure the provision of timely fundamental patient care by working alongside the ward team to support patients with activities of daily living. The Northern Care Alliance NHS Foundation Trust (NCA) provides hospital and integrated health and social care services to over one million people living across Greater Manchester. Our 20,000 colleagues care for people in hospital and in the community, working across Bury, Rochdale, Oldham and Salford, to save and improve lives. As a large NHS trust we are committed to enhancing the health of our local population by delivering consistently high standards of care and working closely with local authorities and key partners. We believe in our power and potential to make a difference and we’re always looking for people who demonstrate our three core values - care, appreciate and inspire – to join our team. items.card: The King’s Haematology service satisfies all the level 4 BCSH criteria including bed numbers, isolation facilities, equipment, hospital infra-structure, laboratory services, radiotherapy, medical and nursing staffing, pharmacy facilities and support services. The department has dedicated Haemato-oncology consultants, in addition to medical and nurse transplant co-ordinators, specialist junior medical and nursing
items.desc: The King’s Haematology service satisfies all the level 4 BCSH criteria including bed numbers, isolation facilities, equipment, hospital infra-structure, laboratory services, radiotherapy, medical and nursing staffing, pharmacy facilities and support services. The department has dedicated Haemato-oncology consultants, in addition to medical and nurse transplant co-ordinators, specialist junior medical and nursing staff. The multidisciplinary team extends to all clinical specialties that are represented in the established weekly regional MDT meetings. The Department, which is the largest in South East of the UK, has an extensive referral base within the SE London, Kent, Sussex and Surrey area with more than 75% of regional referrals coming to Kings. This hub and spoke network is a model for the sharing of patient care between centre and unit. Applications are invited to work in the Department of Haematological Medicine at King’s College Hospital, for an initial period of 6 months. This is an exciting opportunity to join a centre of excellence specialising in haemato-oncology, bone marrow transplantation, haemoglobinopathy, coagulation and transfusion medicine. Our integrated haemato-oncology and transplant service has 4 dedicated wards treating all forms of haematological malignancy as well as marrow failure disorders. It carries out all forms of autologous and allogeneic transplantation and has an active cell and gene therapy program. The Department looks after approximately 1200 adults and children with Sickle Cell disease. King’s is an NHS Exemplar Centre for prevention and management of venous thromboembolism (VTE), and has a large multi-disciplinary Anticoagulation and Clinical Thrombosis Team. The Haematology medical team comprises 30 Consultant Haematologists, 1 Clinical Lecturer, 14 Specialist Registrars, 5 Senior Clinical Fellows and 11 SHOs. King’s College Hospital NHS Foundation Trust is one of the UK’s largest and busiest teaching Trusts with a turnover of c£2.1billion, 1.5 million patient contacts a year and around 14,000 staff based across 5 main sites in South East London. The Trust provides a full range of local hospital services across its different sites, and specialist services from King’s College Hospital (KCH) sites at Denmark Hill in Camberwell and at the Princess Royal University Hospital (PRUH) site in Bromley. King’s is committed to delivering Sustainable Healthcare for All via our Green Plan. In line with national Greener NHS ambitions, we have set net zero carbon targets of 2040 for our NHS Carbon Footprint and 2045 for our NHS Carbon Footprint Plus . In June 2026, we launched our new strategy for 2026-31. Our vision is to transform healthcare, and we have agreed six strategic ambitions to help us improve care for patients, and the working lives of our staff. Our six strategic ambitions are delivering high-quality patient care ; creating a great place to work ; leading pioneering research, innovation and education ; building strong and successful partnerships ; providing timely and efficient care ; and ensuring long-term financial sustainability . This post is for a full time clinical fellow (ST3+) within the Department of Haematological Medicine at King’s College Hospital Foundation Trust. This post will join the haematology specialist trainees rota. This will provide broad experience in haemato-oncology, laboratory and general haematology, haemoglobinopathy, paediatric haematology and thrombosis. This position will be an ideal opportunity to develop supervised experience in haematology, and for more experience candidates to explore an area of interest. Appointees will be expected to undertake both undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, and research is encouraged. The appointee must have (or be eligible for) GMC registration. A medical degree or diploma and MRCP (or equivalent) from a recognised UK or overseas University or Institution is required. The appointment will be initially for a period of 6 months with the potential for renewal. Any candidate who is unable for personal reasons to work full-time will be eligible to be considered for this post; if such a person is appointed, modification of the job will be discussed on a personal basis with the Trust.

items.desc: Applications are invited from suitably qualified candidates for the above post in Urology at Northampton General Hospital. This post is to join the Registrar tier of the Urology Rota, with elective activity primarily in Urology. Prior NHS experience is an essential requirement. The department has had excellent recent success in Trust Grade doctors obtaining Urology ST3 training numbers. This job does not include any regular night or weekend on calls, nor any general surgical on calls. The successful candidate will be on a one in three rota, (see template below) with on-calls covering Urology referrals/admissions 8am to 8pm Monday to Friday. The remaining time will be spent in elective Urology, with ward cover but also excellent exposure to theatres and the One Stop Urology clinic. **Please submit your application as soon as possible as we reserve the right to close any adverts before the closing date once we have received sufficient applications** Northampton General Hospital NHS Trust is one of the largest employers in the area and we are on an exciting journey. All our divisions are committed to doing things better, with more efficiency as we update, modernise, and advance. We have also entered a Group Model with neighbouring Kettering General Hospital NHS Foundation Trust and become University Hospitals of Northamptonshire. Our Excellence Values Compassion Accountability Respect Integrity Courage We want to recruit the best people to deliver our services across the University Hospitals of Northamptonshire and help to unleash everyone's full potential. The Hospital Group encourages applications from people who identify from all protected groups. We understand that we need to work with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and make sure the environment they work in is inclusive and collaborative. We recognise the valuable contribution that the Armed Forces community make to our organisation. We have signed the Armed Forces Covenant and achieved Silver Award under the Armed Forces Employer Recognition Scheme. We have active Networks that promote and support colleagues from all backgrounds. This ensures everyone feels supported and has a sense of belonging working for Kettering and Northampton General Hospitals. We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Urology Registrar to join our supportive and forward-thinking Urology Department. This is an excellent opportunity for a doctor looking to strengthen their clinical experience, develop their surgical skills and build a portfolio for future career progression. Previous NHS experience is essential. The department has an established track record of supporting Trust Grade Registrars to successfully progress through national Urology ST3 selection. We also welcome more senior candidates, with experience of supporting doctors pursuing the FRCS (Urol) examination and CESR pathway. The successful candidate will contribute to the delivery of high-quality elective and emergency urological services, gaining experience across outpatient clinics, diagnostic services and core urological procedures. The department offers exposure to a broad range of specialist procedures and techniques, including percutaneous nephrolithotomy (PCNL), robotic prostatectomy, brachytherapy, laparoscopic nephrectomy, UroLift, holmium laser enucleation of the prostate (HoLEP), and flexible ureterorenoscopy with laser treatment. There are also opportunities to participate in clinical research, quality improvement initiatives and clinical audit, alongside involvement in departmental and undergraduate medical education. The department actively encourages registrars to contribute to teaching and the continued development of the service. The department has strengthened its emergency urology provision through the development of a dedicated 1 in 7 non-resident middle-grade on-call rota, supported by a Urology SHO-equivalent doctor during working hours. This provides an opportunity to develop experience in the assessment and management of emergency urological presentations within a supportive clinical team. items.desc: Job overview Nursing Associates (NA) and assistant practitioners (AP) work as part of the wider health and social care team and have direct contact with patients, services users or clients providing high quality and compassionate care. They will work within both the surgical admissions and pre operative assessment environments developing the additional skills and knowledge required. In the pre operative assessment clinic the NA or the AP will undertake pre-operative assessment on suitable patients that are waiting for elective surgery. The pre-assessment covers the physical, social, emotional and spiritual needs of the patient. They will be supported by the registered pre assessment nurse and expected to work within their determined scope of practice. They also support band 3 healthcare assistants in the testing clinic. When working in the surgical admissions area, the NA or the AP will support the patient on the day of their surgical journey, working with the surgeon and anaesthetist, ensuring they are safe and ready for theatre. They will escort the patient to the anaesthetic room where they will ensure correct monitoring is placed and to be present whilst the anaesthetic is administered by the team. They will advocate for the patient and ensure patient safety. The NA/AP will have responsibility for actively participating as part of the Multi-disciplinary team within the department, to provide a seamless service to patients with proximal supervision from a registered nurse /practitioner Act with professionalism and integrity- being a role model for those around you, ensuring that everyone has equal opportunity Find solutions to problems and be able to demonstrate a positive approach to new challenges, encouraging others to do the same Understand what people need and be adaptable and responsive to help provide a individualised service Help to create an environment where differences are valued, encouraged and supported To provide a high-quality person-centred service which complies with the relevant Legislation and standards Be honest and learn from mistakes. Help to create a ‘no blame culture’ where people feel able to share and learn experiences together · Work collaboratively with colleagues at all levels, both within and outside the department Be mindful of how your role impacts the wider organisation and the people we serve Build a working relationship and trust with those you work with, and provide support when required Actively listen Look at new ideas and ways of working – identify what works well Help to uphold a learning environment where feedback is welcomed and valued Why Work With Us The department comprises of two areas that you will work across; surgical admissions and pre operative assessment clinic. We are a small, friendly team that manage our own daily workload to deliver high standards of care. items.desc: Are you an enthusiastic IT Service Desk Analyst ready to take your next step with the NHS? If you enjoy untangling complex IT challenges, this could be your chance to make a difference. We’re looking for IT Service Desk Analysts to join our committed team and support the busy hospital services in Guildford and surrounding areas. As a Digital Service Desk Analyst, you’ll be the first point of contact for Trust users seeking help from the IT Department, providing first-line technical support. You’ll record and prioritise calls, then progress them through to resolution, keeping customer expectations at the heart of your work. Could this be the opportunity you’ve been looking for? Experience with NHS environments and systems would be valuable, but the successful candidate will receive thorough on-the-job training. Based in Guildford, Surrey, this flexible role follows a shift pattern, with core hours between 8.00am and 5.00pm, Monday to Friday, and up to 37.5 working hours per week. To provide a high quality, comprehensive IT helpdesk service to the users of the IT network at all Trust sites Royal Surrey is a compassionate and collaborative acute and community Trust. Recognising that our 5,000 colleagues are our greatest strength, we offer a comprehensive health and wellbeing programme alongside a strong commitment to developing your career. Our diverse and welcoming Royal Surrey family ensures you feel valued from your initial interview and throughout your time with us. We are clinically led and provide joined-up care by bridging hospital and community services, alongside delivering regional specialist cancer care. Our main acute hospital site is in Guildford, with community sites at Milford, Haslemere and Cranleigh, and services delivered in patients’ homes across Guildford and Waverley. We work in partnership with Ashford & St Peter’s Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust through a collaborative Group Model, supporting joined-up services, workforce flexibility and development opportunities. The Care Quality Commission (CQC) has rated us as Outstanding. We are proud of our achievements and continue to invest in our people and infrastructure. To learn more about life at Royal Surrey, please watch our short video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R96pMboIYdo Adverts may close early, so you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. The Digital Service Desk Analyst is the first point of contact between end users and the IT organisation. The analyst is responsible for recording the details of reported IT service issues and service requests, and working to either restore service as quickly as possible or alerting / escalating them to the appropriate specialist support groups. The position requires technical troubleshooting abilities and excellent customer service skills

items.desc: Job number MED06046 Faculties Faculty of Medicine Departments National Heart & Lung Institute Salary or Salary range £50,733 - £67,351 per annum Location/campus White City Campus - On site only Contract type work pattern Full time - Fixed term Posting End Date 6 Dec 2026 About the role The British Heart Foundation Centre of Research Excellence (BHF CRE) at Imperial College London invites applications to its Transitional Fellowship Programme open to exceptional postdoctoral candidates with a basic science background. A proven track record of excellent academic research An ability to raise research funding from external sources, commensurate with your career stage. A strong interest in interdisciplinary working and translational research. Interest in widening participation and outreach activities. Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey ideas and concepts clearly and effectively to a range of audiences. "A proven track record of contributing to the wider academic and institutional community". What we can offer you Support for the Career Development Award applications to external funders, such as BHF, Wellcome Trust, MRC, BBSRC, UKRI Future Leader Fellowship. This includes extensive academic and administrative support throughout the application process and interview preparation. Networking opportunities with UK-based and international leaders in the cardiovascular fields. Access to sector-leading career development and mentoring programmes offered by Imperial College London as well as opportunities for promotion and progression. Access to cutting edge facilities at Imperial College London. Opportunities to attract students from undergraduate and postgraduate programmes at Imperial College London. Opportunities to develop teaching skills. Sector-leading remuneration package (including 41 days off a year and generous pension schemes) and access to local and national discounts through Imperial Perks at Work. Be part of a diverse, inclusive and collaborative work culture with various staff networks and resources to support your personal and professional wellbeing. Further information How to apply: Please upload the following documents with your application: CV Research plan statement on career intention A letter of support from a BHF CRE Principal Investigator confirming agreement to act as sponsor. For available sponsors, please refer to the investigator lists under each research theme: https://www.imperial.ac.uk/bhf-research-excellence/. Application deadline 06.12.2026 . Interviews will be held in January. The role is full‑time and fixed‑term for up to 24 months (12 months contract will be also considered). Appointment will be offered at either the Research Associate (£50,773 - £59,484) or Research Fellow (£57,075 - £64,619) level, depending on candidate’s experience. We also offer research consumable support depending on the specific requirements of the project. If you require any further details about the role, please contact: Dr. Magdalena Zak (m.zak1@imperial.ac.uk), manager of Imperial BHF CRE. Every resident and customer we deal with has a unique set of circumstances - our team challenge those who can pay and don’t pay – applying a range of legal remedies to compel people to pay what they owe. But the team also listen to and support those who can’t pay and help some of our most vulnerable residents find a way out of debt. What is the job role? This is an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated individual to join our Revenues & Benefits Systems Support Team. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting and developing the systems used across the Revenues & Benefits Service, with a particular focus on Housing Benefits. Working closely with operational teams, system suppliers and stakeholders, you will help ensure our systems remain effective, accurate and resilient in supporting service delivery. You will be responsible for investigating system and process issues, analysing data and reports, testing new functionality, supporting business processes and helping to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Main duties will include, but are not limited to: Providing specialist support for the IT systems used within the Revenues & Benefits Service. Running and monitoring critical business processes to ensure systems remain operational and service objectives are met. Investigating system and process failures, identifying root causes and taking appropriate action to resolve or escalate issues. Analysing system data, reports and outputs to identify issues, trends and opportunities for service improvement. Testing new functionality, system upgrades and legislative changes to ensure changes meet business requirements before implementation. Working with operational teams, ICT colleagues and software suppliers to diagnose, track and resolve system-related issues. Conducting audit checks on batch processing, system outputs and financial reconciliations to ensure data integrity and accuracy. This post is exempted under the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 and as such appointment to this post will be conditional upon the receipt of a satisfactory response to a check of police records via Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS). All candidates must have the Right to Work in the UK. We are currently not offering sponsorship for this role. Who are we looking for? We are looking for an individual with recent experience working within a Revenues and Benefits service and a strong understanding of Housing Benefit legislation and administration. The successful candidate will have excellent analytical and problem-solving skills and be confident using systems, reports, spreadsheets and data analysis techniques to investigate issues and support service improvement. You will be able to work independently and as part of a team, prioritising workloads effectively while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. You should be able to communicate effectively with a wide range of audiences, explaining technical information clearly and managing stakeholder expectations …

In this role, you will design, implement, and test digitally controlled power electronic systems, such as power factor
items.desc: Power Electronics Engineer - KTP Associate Location Cambridge, England, United Kingdom Date posted October 23, 2026 Job ID 23558 Our Opening and Your Responsibilities We have an exciting opportunity for a Power Electronics Engineer to work with the University of Sheffield and METTLER TOLEDO Safeline X-ray (SLXR) on a Knowledge Transfer Partnership (KTP) to develop next generation high voltage generators for X-ray inspection machines. In this role, you will design, implement, and test digitally controlled power electronic systems, such as power factor correctors and high voltage inverters, to enhance X-ray generator performance. You will lead the project and work closely with METTLER TOLEDO engineers to support product development and commercialization efforts. Although you will be employed by the University of Sheffield, you will be predominantly based at METTLER TOLEDO Safeline X-ray’s office in Royston, Hertfordshire and may be required to work from Sheffield occasionally. You will need to apply via the University website: Power Electronics Engineer Job Details | University of Sheffield Main Responsibilities Develop a power supply subsystem for an X-ray inspection machine. Explore and analyse existing solutions, determining areas for improvement. Develop, simulate, implement and test power electronic conversion circuits. Assist in the development of closed-loop controller for power electronics circuits. Develop suitable and safe testing methods for effective testing of various high voltage subsystems. Lead the project, monitor milestones and produce technical documents as required. Work with SLXR and the university to identify and protect intellectual property and work with commercial partners. Work within an existing agile scrum project management framework. Participate in regular project meetings with Mettler Toledo Safeline X-ray and the university. Plan your own workload to ensure the overall project milestones and objectives are met on time. Engage fully with the requirements of the knowledge transfer partnership scheme, including personal development and reporting. Work across multiple sites, including at Mettler Toledo Safeline X-ray and the University of Sheffield. Carry out other duties, commensurate with the grade and remit of the post. What You Need to Succeed Have at least a Master's degree (PhD is desirable) or have equivalent experience in electronic, electrical or control engineering (assessed at application) Experience in designing, constructing and experimental testing of power electronic systems (assessed at application/interview) Experience with analogue/digital control for power electronics systems (assessed at application/interview) Experience of using computer-aided engineering including PCB design, schematic capture, embedded programming and circuit simulation (assessed at application/interview) Evidence of working effectively in a team and presenting findings to a wide range of audiences (assessed at application/interview) Ability to plan own workload and prioritise conflicting deadlines. (assessed at application/interview) Ability to make decisions and apply creative approaches to solving complex technical problems (assessed at application/interview) Appreciation of the commercial implications of decisions, particularly for costs (assessed at application/interview) Willingness to be based in Royston, Hertfordshire but regularly visit Sheffield (assessed at application) Have not previously worked on and completed an Innovate UK-funded KTP project (assessed at application) The University is offering: Salary: £42,000 - £55,000 depending on experience. Duration: 15 months, start date 4th Jan 2027 Hours of work: 37.5 hours per week For informal enquiries about this job contact Dr Jack Forrester, Knowledge Base Supervisor at jack.forrester@sheffield.ac.uk Please apply via this link where more details can be found: Power Electronics Engineer Job Details | University of Sheffield Our Offer to You Professional Growth : Work alongside industry experts, providing opportunities for mentorship and professional development in a leading company. Impactful Contributions : Play a key role in improving the performance of X-ray equipment, contributing to advancements in safety and efficiency in various applications. Career Advancement : Gain valuable experience that could lead to further career opportunities within METTLER TOLEDO or in the broader field of power electronics and engineering. Collaborative Culture : Experience a teamwork-focused environment where collaboration with engineers and researchers is encouraged, fostering creativity and innovation. items.desc: Lanes Group is a leading nationwide utility services provider with c.5000 dedicated employees. Manipulate (including loading and unloading to / from tanker pipe storage trays) flexible pipework in a safe manner utilising correct manual handling techniques Work unsupervised in all weather conditions, wearing correct PPE or utilising the lone worker system Dynamically risk assess site access and working conditions depending on specific circumstances on arrival Liaising with the client regarding process and any updates Provide support to your colleagues Conduct thorough inspections of tools, equipment and plant before and after use Report any defects or malfunctions Carry out risk assessments and have a mature approach to risk perception Be aware of all Lanes Group policies and your responsibilities towards them Any other reasonable ad-hoc tasks, duties or projects as requested by management Please note: full training will be provided Living the Company Values By embedding our companies core values and purpose into each role, ensures that every employee, regardless of their role or level, understands how their individual development and contributions align with our purpose of ‘improving today for a better tomorrow’. Each role and value has an alignment to set proficiency levels and expectations; this role holder is expected to: Leading : Acts as a role model, shaping the learning agenda and influencing change. Engaging : Inspires and motivates learners, builds trust and credibility Safe & Secure: Ensures all learning is aligned to safety and compliance standards. Your Contribution to the company: Strive to be always positive and constructive Adhere to all company policies Straight talking about the facts of the situation – open discussions are the best way to find solutions Help others through communicating clearly Deliver on commitments Ensure that any ideas that may enhance the productivity or systems of the company are brought to the attention of Senior Management, or your colleagues Deliver our Company Values understanding that by working together in unity we are ‘Stronger Together’ Equality, Diversion & Inclusion At Lanes Group, we are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. Iščemo osebo, ki verjame v moč timskega dela, čuti odgovornost za ustvarjanje dodane vrednosti za vse deležnike in želi prispevati k prijetnemu delovnemu okolju, mi pa vam ponujamo številne priložnosti za strokovno in osebnostno rast naših zaposlenih. 
 Kaj boste počeli
 Glavne naloge in odgovornosti bodo: 
 svetovanje, informiranje ter prodaja bančnih storitev in produktov,
 vzpostavljanje in ohranjanje poslovnih odnosov s strankami,
 opravljanje gotovinskih in negotovinskih poslov,
 vodenje računov strank ter skrb za nemoten potek njihovega prometa,
 svetovanje pri reševanju reklamacij.

 K prijavi vabimo kandidate, ki: 
 imate najmanj VI/1 stopnjo izobrazbe ekonomske ali druge primerljive smeri in 2 leti primerljivih delovnih izkušenj ali V. stopnjo izobrazbe z vsaj 5 leti primerljivih delovnih izkušenj,

 ste samostojni, natančni, zanesljivi in urejeni,

 V naši mednarodni skupini boste našli veliko priložnosti za strokovno in osebnostno rast. Delovno mesto je v Kopru. Delovno razmerje bo sklenjeno za nedoločen čas s 6-mesečno poskusno dobo. Prijave z življenjepisom in s spremnim pismom sprejemamo do vključno 01.11.2026.

Dabei orientieren wir uns an den sich wandelnden Bedürfnissen unserer Kund:innen: Persönliche Beratung bildet den Kern unseres Angebots und geht Hand in Hand mit leistungsstarken, kontinuierlich weiterentwickelten digitalen Services.  Mehr als Beratung: Bei uns bist Du die erste Anlaufstelle für vermögende Privatkund:innen und ihre Familien – bis zu einem Vermögen von 1 Mio. Euro.

 Regulatorik: Sachkunde und Zuverlässigkeit gem. §87 WpHG bringst Du mit. 
 Marktverständnis & Analyse: Du erkennst Chancen, denkst strategisch und stärkst das regionale Image der Bank. 
 Souveränes Auftreten: Hohe Serviceorientierung und verbindliche Kommunikation sind Deine Stärke.

items.desc:
The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents
 The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You’ll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead
 The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real
 Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins
 Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view
 Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks
 In your first six months you’ll own the evals for our agent pipelines, propose where we invest next, and ship measurable improvements to both the agents and the prediction models
 You’ll join our Data & AI team of six and report to Renan, our AI Lead who’s been building production models for >10 years. Our engineering team runs the infrastructure, and you shape what runs on it
 The stack:
 Core: Python (async, fully typed with Pydantic) and FastAPI
 LLMs: multiple providers behind our own provider-agnostic layer, with Pydantic AI for typed agents
 Evals and observability: Pydantic Evals and Logfire
 Data: PostgreSQL with pgvector
 Cloud: GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks), Docker, GitHub Actions
 Benefits
 High-growth fintech scale-up with an international footprint
 Flexibility to leeway around exam periods or deadlines
 Hybrid working model, with flexible access to our Warsaw office
 Clear development path supported by lots of coaching and a feedback-driven approach
 Unmatched learning and career preparation opportunities for private equity, investment banking or consulting
 Culture of trust, ownership and standard of excellence
 Fun working atmosphere with company-wide outings and events
 Private medical care and sport card

You’ve dealt with leakage, distribution shift and calibration on real dataYou’ve built and owned ML systems in production for years, typically 6+ in ML or software engineeringYou measure before you claim.  Hilf uns dabei, die spannendsten Herausforderungen gemeinsam anzugehen und umzusetzen, worauf es ankommt. Was wir Dir bieten ist die Chance, wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Also worauf warten? Mach mit uns den nächsten Schritt in Deiner Karriere.
 Was wir dir bieten: 
 Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket
 Zugang zu Aktienplänen für Mitarbeitende
 30 Tage Urlaub sowie vielfältige, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, die eine Auszeit für dich und deine Familie ermöglichen
 2 bis 3 Tage pro Woche mobiles Arbeiten als globaler Standard
 Flexible Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowohl für deine berufliche, als auch persönliche Entwicklung, die du auf deine Interessen abstimmen kannst
Da jeder von uns 300.000 Mitarbeitenden andere Benefits als besonders wichtig empfindet und wir an dieser Stelle nicht unser ganzes Benefit-Portfolio auflisten können, findest du hier weitere Informationen. 
 Die einzelnen Benefits unterliegen gesetzlichen, tarif-/vertraglichen oder betrieblichen Bedingungen. 
 Verändere die Welt von morgen: In deiner neuen Rolle führst du Typtests für digitale Schutz- und Feldgeräte durch wie EMV-Prüfungen, Produktsicherheitsprüfungen, klimatische und mechanische Prüfungen sowie UL-Zertifizierung.
 Zudem definierst und führst du Prüfungen aus und dokumentierst diese, die dazugehörigen Testdokumentationen erstellst und pflegst du zuverlässig.
 Du planst die Testumgebung, beschaffst die dazu benötigte Hard- und Software und nimmst sie in Betrieb sowie du verantwortest den Aufbau, die Inbetriebnahme sowie die Betreuung der Testplätze.
 Die Entwicklung und das Produktmanagement werden von dir bei Design-Reviews, Risikoanalysen und der Bewertung neuer Marktanforderungen unterstützt.
 Du arbeitest intensiv mit dem Component Engineering zusammen und betreust die Prüfung von Einzelkomponenten. Darüber hinaus kooperierst du intensiv mit externen Prüf- und Zulassungsstellen.
 Du koordinierst Audits durch Kunden und der Akkreditierungsstelle gemäß ISO 17025 für unsere R&D Prüflabore in Berlin.
 Diese Erfahrung bringst du mit: 
 Du hast ein Masterstudium in Elektrotechnik oder Energietechnik und langjährige Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Typtests.
 Du verfügst über gute Fachkenntnisse der einschlägigen Normen zu EMV, Umweltsimulationen, Produktsicherheit und Umweltprüfungen (DIN EN 61010-1 , DIN EN 62368-1 / DIN EN 60950-1 , UL508).
 Du besitzt gute Fachkenntnisse im Bereich Hardware-Entwicklung und Messtechnik.
 Du zeichnest dich durch eine zuverlässige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise aus, auf die sich das Team jederzeit verlassen kann.
 Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab
 Du bist viel mehr als deine Qualifikationen und wir glauben an das Potential jeder einzelnen Person. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!
 Bei Siemens sind wir überzeugt: Wer sich wertgeschätzt und zugehörig fühlt, kann das eigene Potenzial voll entwickeln. Deshalb schaffen wir ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Person ein Gefühl der Zugehörigkeit erfährt und in dem individuelle Perspektiven und Erfahrungen geschätzt werden. Unser Engagement für Fairness und Respekt gilt für alle Bewerbenden. 
 Wir legen Wert auf Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, ausdrücklich auch von Menschen mit Behinderung.
 Über uns 
 Bei Smart Infrastructure Electrification & Automation ist es unsere Mission, innovative und nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln, die sowohl Energieeinsparungen ermöglichen als auch den CO2-Fußabdruck von Gebäuden, Infrastrukturen und der Industrie reduzieren. Wir gestalten den Übergang zu einem nachhaltigen Energiesystem und stellen gleichzeitig eine zuverlässige und erschwingliche Energieversorgung sicher. Deshalb setzen wir alles daran, eine grünere Zukunft zu gestalten und unsere Lebens- und Arbeitsweise zu transformieren.

 Junior Product Development Engineer (Electronics) 
 Location: Congleton, Cheshire. This role is hybrid, typically allowing you to split your time between home and the office. Depending on project requirements, there may be occasions where additional on-site presence is required.
 Help Shape the Next Generation of Industrial Drive Technology 
 Join Siemens' award-winning R&D centre in Congleton and help develop innovative industrial electronics products used across manufacturing and automation industries worldwide.
 As a Product Development Engineer, you'll work within a multidisciplinary engineering team, contributing to the design, development and testing of Siemens SINAMICS drive products from concept through to launch. You'll gain hands-on experience across the full product lifecycle, working alongside experienced engineers while developing your expertise in product development, power electronics and industrial automation.
 With access to state-of-the-art laboratories, manufacturing facilities and UKAS-accredited test environments, this is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early-career engineer looking to accelerate their development in a world-class engineering environment.
 Please note: this role requires candidates to have current and permanent right to work in the UK. We are unable to support visa applications for this position. 
 What You'll Be Doing 
 As part of a cross-functional product development team, you will:
 Contribute to the design and development of industrial electronics products and associated options.
 Support the full product development lifecycle, from concept generation through to product launch and future enhancements.
 Collaborate with mechanical, software, test and manufacturing engineers to deliver innovative product solutions.
 Design electronic circuits and support PCB schematic capture and layout activities.
 Participate in simulation, integration, validation and testing activities.
 Build, evaluate and troubleshoot prototypes.
 Support product approvals and compliance activities, including UL certification.
 Assist with the introduction of new products into manufacturing.
 Support existing products through continuous improvement and cost-reduction initiatives.
 Research emerging technologies and engineering techniques that could enhance future products.
 Work with suppliers and global manufacturing teams to implement product improvements successfully.
 What We're Looking For 
 We are looking for engineers who are naturally curious, enjoy solving problems and are excited by developing real-world products.
 Essential 
 Degree in Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical & Electronic Engineering or a related discipline.
 Understanding of the product development lifecycle, from concept through to launch.
 Knowledge of analogue and digital circuit design, including exposure to PCB schematic capture and layout tools.
 Experience using simulation, analysis, prototyping and testing tools to support product development.
 Awareness of EMC considerations within electronic design.
 Ability to work independently, manage priorities and meet project deadlines.
 Strong communication, collaboration and problem-solving skills.
 Desirable 
 Exposure to power electronics, motor drives, inverters or industrial electronics products.
 Experience gained through industry placements, internships or commercial engineering environments.
 Understanding of product approvals, certification requirements and relevant industry standards.
 Knowledge of design for manufacture (DFM) and cost optimisation principles.
 Experience using Siemens Teamcenter PLM or similar product lifecycle management systems.
 Why Join Siemens? 
 This is an opportunity to work on innovative products used around the world, gaining exposure to the full product development lifecycle in a state-of-the-art R&D environment. You'll learn from experienced engineers, develop expertise in industrial electronics and power electronics, and benefit from flexible hybrid working and excellent long-term career opportunities.

With over 300.000 of the world’s most forward-thinking minds and the power of a presence in more than 190 countries, we make a truly global impact.

You will be responsible for the approval of initial test setups and significant equipment or software modifications, while driving automation, traceability, and data integrity . Working closely with R&D, industrialization, production teams, suppliers, and external partners, you will optimize test performance, improve first-pass yield, and enhance product testability throughout the industrialization process . Through the deployment of advanced testing technologies and automation solutions, you will contribute directly to higher product quality, increased production efficiency, and operational excellence on a global scale.

 Approve initial EOL setups and significant modifications to test equipment, software, and related investments across SCM factories.
 Integrate measurement equipment, sensors, communication interfaces, control systems, and data acquisition solutions to ensure robust traceability and reporting.
 Lead commissioning, validation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities to enhance test performance, reliability, first-pass yield, and cost efficiency.
 Drive test automation initiatives and scalable testing solutions to support new product introductions and product variants.
 Act as the global SCM testing expert, partnering with R&D, PLM, industrialization, production teams, suppliers, and external partners to define testing requirements and ensure product testability.
 Support design reviews, FMEA activities, industrialization projects, and the deployment of best practices across all manufacturing sites.
 Define, monitor, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) for EOL testing effectiveness and continuous improvement.

 Master’s degree in Electrical and Computer Engineering or a comparable field

 Understanding of hardware design and debugging

items.card: vos missions principales sont les suivantes : Concevoir et implémenter des solutions IA innovantes pour optimiser et sécuriser les systèmes d'information, incluant le développement d'outils d'aide à la rétro-ingénierie de code assistée par IA. Préparer, structurer et analyser des jeux de données pour développer et évaluer nos solutions IA. Concevoir et implémenter des agents intelligents utilisant des techniques
items.desc: Descriptif de l'organisation Vous souhaitez donner du sens à votre métier ? Vous avez à cœur de contribuer au développement de l’IA au sein du ministère des Armées et de participer au renforcement de la souveraineté technologique de la France au service des forces armées ? Vous désirez développer des solutions IA appliquées à la Cybersécurité au sein d'une équipe projet dynamique et agile, animée par un esprit start-up et tournée vers l’excellence opérationnelle ? Rejoignez l’AMIAD. Rattachée au Ministre des armées, l’AMIAD est une entité en en forte croissance qui développe et déploie des solutions d’IA au profit des armées. En lien étroit avec l’ensemble des entités du ministère, elle pilote des projets stratégiques et innovants dans des domaines variés tels que les systèmes d’armes, les opérations, le renseignement, le commandement, le soutien et l’administration. Descriptif des missions Au sein de l’équipe « Systèmes d’Informations et Données Relationnelles », composée d’ingénieurs en IA, en qualité d’Ingénieur en IA & cybersécurité, vos missions principales sont les suivantes : Concevoir et implémenter des solutions IA innovantes pour optimiser et sécuriser les systèmes d'information, incluant le développement d'outils d'aide à la rétro-ingénierie de code assistée par IA. Préparer, structurer et analyser des jeux de données pour développer et évaluer nos solutions IA. Concevoir et implémenter des agents intelligents utilisant des techniques d'IA agentique afin de renforcer la supervision des systèmes d'information. Évaluer les performances des méthodes et modèles développés pour garantir leur efficacité. Collaborer avec les équipes métier pour co-construire des solutions IA adaptées aux besoins opérationnels. Assurer une veille technologique proactive dans le domaine de l’IA et de la Cybersécurité afin d’identifier les innovations les plus pertinentes. Participer à la rédaction de documentations techniques et de rapports d’analyses afin de faciliter la prise de décision et le partage des connaissances. Pour les profils les plus expérimentés, vous serez également responsable de conduire des projets stratégiques, en pilotant des équipes pluridisciplinaires et en prenant des décisions éclairées pour répondre aux défis complexes de cybersécurité. Profil recherché Titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau bac + 5 en intelligence artificielle, informatique, data science ou domaine connexe, vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant qu'ingénieur IA, data scientist ou doctorant, dont une expérience notable dans le domaine de l'IA appliquée à la cybersécurité. Ainsi, vous maîtrisez : Python et ses principales bibliothèques d’IA agentique Les Frameworks d’IA agentique Les évolutions récentes de l'écosystème IA, notamment concernant les LLM (Large Language Models) et les approches d'IA générative GitLab pour la gestion de versions de code et le travail collaboratif Vous avez des notions en réseaux, systèmes d'exploitation, génie logiciel, bases de données et de l'environnement Linux. Une appétence en cybersécurité et une expérience en CTF (Capture The Flag) seraient un plus. Doté d'un fort esprit d'équipe, autonome, proactif, curieux et bon communicant, vous savez expliquer des concepts techniques complexes à des interlocuteurs variés. Process de recrutement Échange téléphonique pour vérifier l’adéquation du profil et des aspirations par rapport au poste. Entretiens sur site : entretien avec les collaborateurs techniques et le management, entretien RH (prévoir ½ journée). Le poste nécessitant d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, vous ferez l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI n°1300 du 09 août 2021. NB : Le poste est à pourvoir en CDD ou en CDI selon profil et expérience

Vous contribuez à la conception, à l'implémentation et à l'optimisation de fonctions algorithmiques temps réel embarquées, depuis les phases d'étude et de prototypage jusqu'à leur intégration et leur validation sur système opérationnel. Vous intervenez sur des problématiques de traitement du signal , d'imagerie acoustique, de micronavigation , de compensation de mouvement et d'optimisation des performances dans des environnements contraints. Vos Missions Principales Concevoir et développer les algorithmes de traitement du signal et d'imagerie acoustique pour les sonars à ouverture synthétique (SAS). Imagerie SAS et SAS interférométrique (souhaité) Formation de voies (beamforming). Compression d'impulsion. Détection et classification (souhaité) Micronavigation et compensation de mouvement. items.desc: Description QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements. We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question. This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join QuantumDiamonds? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Build the checks, from raw quantum sensor signal to field map, that tell a trustworthy measurement from a measurement or reconstruction artifact, on lab and customer data alike. Trace a failed check to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Keep the catalogue of known artifacts and the set of reference measurements that make every new verdict faster and more defensible. Validate the team's evaluation methods against simulation and reference measurements before they go into daily use. Give our Applications Engineers and the team a clear verdict on each measurement, and feed what breaks back into the next generation of the QDm. What is expected of you 3+ years of professional experience outside academia applying data science to measurement or imaging data from physical instruments. A degree in physics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics or a related discipline; a PhD is welcome, not required. Solid statistics and signal or image processing: you ask where a signal comes from, tell it from noise and systematics, and show it with numbers. Fluency in Python and the scientific stack, with version control and tests as a habit. AI coding agents are part of how you work, and you check their output the way you check your own. Comfortable operating our systems in the lab when your analysis needs data. Fluent English; German is an advantage, not a requirement. On-site in Munich. Experience with magnetic or electromagnetic measurements or semiconductor failure analysis is a plus. What we cannot teach on the job is rigor …
