items.title: Distinguished Scientist, AI for Physical Systems
items.card: THE ROLE The Fundamental Research team at The Alan Turing Institute is advancing AI for Physical Systems, developing foundational theory, methods and tools to improve how AI can model, predict and control physical systems. Working across the Institute’s Science and Innovation portfolio, this research aims to advance state-of-the-art AI techniques and translate them into trusted deployment and real-world impact. We
items.desc: THE ROLE The Fundamental Research team at The Alan Turing Institute is advancing AI for Physical Systems, developing foundational theory, methods and tools to improve how AI can model, predict and control physical systems. Working across the Institute’s Science and Innovation portfolio, this research aims to advance state-of-the-art AI techniques and translate them into trusted deployment and real-world impact. We are looking for a Distinguished Scientist, AI for Physical Systems to provide scientific and strategic leadership for this high-priority research area. You will shape and lead an ambitious research portfolio spanning probabilistic modelling, uncertainty quantification, efficient architectures and embedding physical knowledge into machine learning models. Leading a multidisciplinary team of researchers and research engineers, you will take research from foundational methods through to deployment on real-world resilience challenges, while building collaborations across academia, government and industry. ABOUT YOU You will be an internationally recognised research leader in machine learning for physical systems, with deep, hands-on expertise across areas such as probabilistic and generative modelling, neural operators, surrogate modelling, physics-informed machine learning and uncertainty quantification. You will bring an outstanding and sustained record of research contributions, alongside experience setting strategic research direction, leading complex collaborations and translating research into real-world impact. The successful candidate will have proven experience engaging with stakeholders and securing funding, while also leading a team through the developing and delivering of research software. You will combine hands-on scientific expertise with strong leadership, strategic judgement and the ability to build effective partnerships across academia, government and industry. HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT Set the scientific direction for AI for Physical Systems, defining and developing an ambitious research agenda aligned with Fundamental Research priorities. Build and lead a high-quality research portfolio, taking programmes from foundational research questions through to demonstrators and deployment. Build, lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams of researchers and research engineers, developing technical capability as priorities evolve. Provide hands-on scientific leadership, working alongside technical teams and partners to address challenging methodologies, maintain scientific quality and model excellent research practice. Translate research into real-world impact, applying AI for Physical Systems methods to operational problems, data and constraints, including secure or sensitive environments where required. Develop strategic partnerships and secure resources, building collaborations across academia, government and industry and helping to secure the funding, data, compute and facilities required to deliver the portfolio. Represent the Institute as a senior scientific authority for AI for Physical Systems, communicating scientific evidence to partners, boards and research audiences while monitoring emerging developments in the field. Please see our portal for a full breakdown of the role. Closing date for applications: Friday 20 November 2026 at 23:59 (London, UK BST/GMT) We reserve the right to close this vacancy early or to interview suitable candidates before the closing date if enough applications are received. Term and Conditions This full-time post is offered on a permanent basis with an annual salary range of £96,000 - £115,000. Our offers include excellent benefits including flexible working and family friendly policies, which can be seen here . Applications on a secondment basis (0.8 FTE) can also be considered. The annual salary will be matched and pro-rated to the FTE commitment. The secondment will be subject to agreement between the Turing and the relevant organisation. Application Procedure If you are interested in this opportunity, please click the apply button below. It will redirect you to The Alan Turing Institute jobs portal, where you can find more information and a full job description for this role. You will need to register on the applicant portal and complete the application form including your CV and covering letter. Equality, Diversity and Inclusion The Alan Turing Institute is committed to creating an environment where diversity is valued and everyone is treated fairly. We value diversity of background, experience, and perspective, and are proud to be an inclusive employer. We warmly encourage applications from all backgrounds, particularly from groups currently under-represented in our sector. If you feel passionate about this role but don’t meet every single requirement, please apply - we recognise that great candidates may bring strengths beyond the criteria listed

items.desc: Job Number: R0249693 All-Source Intelligence Data Scientist The Opportunity: Massive volumes of multi-INT data including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured, demand disciplined analysis to drive timely, mission-relevant insight. As a Data Scientist supporting All-Source Intelligence, you will fuse information across SIGINT, HUMINT, GEOINT, OSINT, and related sources to build analytical models, automate pipelines, and surface decision-quality assessments for senior leaders and operators. You’ll partner closely with intelligence professionals to translate collection requirements into repeatable, data-driven workflows, design and implement algorithms that uncover patterns of life, and deliver intuitive visualizations that accelerate sense-making and operational advantage. Work with us as we apply data science to advance national security missions. What You’ll Do Engage stakeholders to elicit analytic questions and transform them into technical requirements and prioritized backlogs, and drive transparency through agile practices and frequent updates. Design end-to-end data solutions: ingestion from collection systems and APIs, schema design and data storage, transformation/ETL, model training and evaluation, and operational delivery. Develop statistical and machine learning models for entity resolution, anomaly detection, classification, clustering, and pattern-of-life analysis across multi-INT datasets. Build dashboards and lightweight applications that communicate key insights, assessments, and confidence levels to audiences with varied technical backgrounds. Guide teammates, set technical standards, and lead the evolution of analytic tradecraft leveraging modern data ecosystems. Join us. The world can’t wait. You Have: 5+ years of experience in data science, including exploration, cleaning, analysis, visualization, or data mining, with demonstrated work across structured and unstructured sources Experience in Python and SQL or R, and with Pandas or NumPy, scikit-learn, and model evaluation or tuning Experience building ETL pipelines and querying APIs using tools such as Airflow or dbt, and Git-based version control Experience developing predictive models and quantitative analyses that support intelligence assessments and operational decision-making Experience applying NLP or text mining to reporting and open-source content Experience integrating multi-INT data such as SIGINT, HUMINT, GEOINT, OSINT, or MASINT, and performing pattern-of-life analysis Ability to synthesize narrative and quantitative findings Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or Data Analytics Nice If You Have: Experience with Palantir Foundry, such as Pipeline Builder or AIP, or similar platforms for application development and data integration Experience with distributed data and compute, such as Spark or Databricks, Hadoop or Hive, Kafka, or AWS EMR, and cloud environments used by the IC Experience with geospatial analysis tools, such as ArcGIS or ArcPro, and GEOINT collection systems, and with Grafana, Power BI, or Tableau Experience with deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, and modern AI patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for analytic workflows Experience supporting CCMDs, service components, or special operations Master’s degree in a related technical field DoD 8140 baseline Level II certification such as Security+, CySA+, or CISSP Clearance: Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required. items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As Signal Processing Engineer, you own the algorithmic core of our drone-to-ground radio link — the system that keeps drones connected, controllable, and streaming in contested environments. You design the waveform, the anti-jam logic, and the signal intelligence that turn radio waves into a reliable link under hostile conditions, working hand-in-hand with RF hardware, FPGA, and software engineers to bring your algorithms from theory to flight. Responsibilities Waveform Design: Design modulation, coding, and equalization schemes for a robust, low-latency radio link. Anti-Jamming (ECCM): Build algorithms that keep the radio link alive under active jamming. Signal Intelligence (SIGINT): Detect and characterize other radio emitters in the operating environment. Mesh Networking: Optimize protocols so multiple radio units share the airwaves without collision. AI-Assisted Processing: Apply machine learning to jamming detection and channel prediction where it improves field robustness. Field Validation: Take algorithms from simulation to lab bench to real flight test. Radio System Integration: Work daily with RF hardware and FPGA engineers to bring designs into a fielded radio. Candidate Requirements Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, or Applied Mathematics. 8-12 years designing radio or communication systems, from algorithms to deployed products. Hands-on experience with modem or waveform design: modulation, coding, synchronization, equalization. Solid grounding in probability, DSP, and information theory; comfortable deriving solutions from first principles. Practical awareness of RF hardware and FPGA constraints (latency, precision, real-time processing). Exposure to ECCM, SIGINT, or mesh networking is a strong plus. Clear communicator across RF, FPGA, and software disciplines. Fluency in English required; French is a plus. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

The position supports the Business Intelligence & Analytics (BI&A) function in shaping strategic decisions across the business and across multiple categories and geographies. This
items.desc: About the Role: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Global Data Science & AI team and solving complex business challenges through innovative analytics and AI-driven approaches, with a strong focus on production and scalability. The position supports the Business Intelligence & Analytics (BI&A) function in shaping strategic decisions across the business and across multiple categories and geographies. This role offers the opportunity to work on high-value projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies and methodologies, transforming data into actionable insights that guide Ferrero’s growth. Based at the Alba offices , the role offers the possibility to work remotely up to two days per week. Main Responsibilities: In this role, you will analyze diverse datasets , including sales, marketing and media, promotions, pricing, macroeconomic indicators, and build advanced statistical and AI-driven models to address business challenges across categories and geographies. Leveraging both traditional Machine Learning approaches and emerging technologies such as Generative AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), you will develop, test, and deploy analytical solutions that deliver contextual insights and support data-driven decision-making. You will design robust data cleansing and classification processes for sources such as retail sell-out, eCommerce sales, digital shelf metrics, shopper behavior, consumer surveys, and third-party datasets, ensuring data quality and integrity across modeling and reporting activities. To drive efficiency and scalability, you will develop automation scripts for analytical pipelines while exploring AI-powered solutions for data preparation, processing, and model validation. You will also create interactive Power BI dashboards and, where relevant, develop self-service tools that enable stakeholders to independently access insights and run models. Working closely with a team of data scientists and cross-functional partners, you will contribute to a culture of innovation by sharing knowledge, experimenting with new approaches, and integrating emerging technologies to continuously strengthen organizational capabilities. About You: You hold a master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field and bring experience in applied data science roles , ideally within an FMCG manufacturing environment. You are proficient in programming languages and have hands-on experience with platforms such as Power BI, Azure, Spark, Scala, and Google Analytics , while familiarity with Databricks would be advantageous. You combine analytical skills with creativity and a test-and-learn mindset, enabling you to turn data into actionable insights. You are fluent in English and bring strong communication skills, enabling you to interact effectively with business stakeholders and interpret analytical results from a business perspective. Ready to turn data into impact? Apply now and join Ferrero’s global analytics journey. What We Offer: The role is classified at Level 1° under the National Collective Agreement for the Food Industry (CCNL Industria Alimentare). The guaranteed minimum base annual gross salary established by the CCNL for the applicable level is €43.249. The compensation package also includes an annual variable component with a target of up to 5% of base salary. The overall compensation will be determined based on the experience, skills, and qualifications of the selected candidate. Careers with caring built in - discover our benefits here. About Ferrero: Ferrero began its journey in the small town of Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946. Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet-packaged food companies, with many iconic brands sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com. DE&I at Ferrero: Ferrero is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which all employees feel welcomed and appreciated and have the same opportunities. We believe all our people are equally talented in their own way. In nurturing the curiosity and natural abilities of our employees, we provide them, generation after generation, the means to succeed personally and professionally, enabling them to craft their journey at Ferrero. The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative, and highly rewarding. Find out more here.

items.desc: Love what you do – we make employment happen! Are you a passionate Machine Learning Engineer eager to take on a new challenge that has the potential to revolutionize the European Job Ads Market? Then keep reading! We're seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our cross-departmental Data Science unit. In this high-impact role, you'll work across multiple teams and projects throughout the organization, leading the development and deployment of production ML systems that serve diverse business needs. As a senior member of our team, you'll be responsible for architecting scalable ML infrastructure, mentoring team members, and driving technical excellence as we transform data science prototypes into robust production services that deliver value across the enterprise. WHAT IS JOBCLOUD HR TECH? JobCloud HR Tech is the Porto, Portugal based company of JobCloud, Switzerland’s number 1 job ads brand and the company behind jobs.ch and jobup.ch. We build software that helps companies spend their hiring budget efficiently and get their job ads in front of the right candidates. Millions of job seekers and thousands of companies use our platform to find each other. WHAT IS IT LIKE TO WORK AT JOBCLOUD? We work as one team of experts in our field. Our culture is inclusive and respectful, and it is built on openness and collaboration. Your skills and motivation count. Your skin colour, gender and beliefs do not matter to us. Come as you are. Our purpose is “Love what you do.” WHAT WILL YOU DO IN THIS ROLE? Partnering with Data Science to translate experimental models into scalable, production-grade ML systemsDesigning and build high-performance, low-latency model-serving architectures and infrastructure Defining and enforce best practices for ML productionization, including coding standards, testing, and deployment strategies Leading cross-functional collaboration between Data Science, Engineering, and Operations as the primary technical interfaceDefining and implementing model performance monitoring (e.g., drift detection, data quality, inference metrics) to ensure reliability in production Driving innovation by evaluating new tools, frameworks, and methodologies, and promoting their adoption across the organization Developing and maintain technical documentation, system designs, and operational runbooks. WHAT SKILLS & EXPERIENCE WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED? 2-3 years of experience in ML Engineering, MLOps, or closely related roles Proven experience deploying and maintaining machine learning models in production at scale Strong Python skills, including experience with data and ML ecosystems Familiarity with LLMs, RAG, and emerging AI paradigms (e.g., agent-based systems) Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) for building and operating ML systems Experience with containerization (Docker) and building production-ready services Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and make architectural decisions Full professional proficiency in English WHAT DO WE OFFER? 1 day per month to tackle challenges inside the project, or test new ideasTech training and human skills training and, budget for conferences Opportunity to travel and collaborate in our various office locations for workshops or team-building events (Zurich, Geneva, Belgrade or Vienna) A dynamic work environment that highly fosters a sense of fun while maintaining a productive atmosphere Our Hiring Process Video Call with People & Culture (30 mins) Video Call with hiring manager (1 hour) Technical challenge (at your best convenience) Challenge presentation by video call (1h-1.5 hour) Offer WHAT ARE OUR BENEFITS? 10 days fully paid sick leave per year 25 days of annual vacation leave Full private health coverage (employee + up to 2 children to age 20) Gym allowance Learning & Development Workation Hybrid & flexible working (team-based arrangement)

items.desc: Job Type Permanent Build a brilliant future with Hiscox As a Data Scientist at Hiscox, you will take on a high-impact role, acting as a critical thinker and problem solver for the business. You'll apply your core technical skills and innovative thinking to tackle complex challenges, identify opportunities, and help shape data-driven decision-making across the London Market. You'll operate across a wide variety of business functions, managing multiple priorities and delivering both ad hoc analysis and predictive/prescriptive models. Your work will contribute directly to building Hiscox's data culture and enabling evidence-based decisions in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Communicating the business value of your analytical solutions to stakeholders will be a key part of your role. You'll be part of an award-winning team, recognised for its pioneering collaboration with Google to deliver the market's first AI-enhanced lead underwriting solution. This achievement reflects the team's commitment to innovation, impact, and excellence in applying data science to real-world insurance challenges. As a Data Scientist, you'll work within a wider technical team whose efforts span multiple business functions, bringing a multi-disciplinary approach to problem solving and analysis. This is an ideal role for someone who is passionate about using analytics to influence decisions and is keen to continue learning and delivering value through data. You'll be expected to conceptualise new approaches, communicate your vision to stakeholders, and see ideas through to implementation. Key Responsibilities Leveraging industry standards, emerging methodologies and empirical research to develop critical inputs to business information and helping business leaders develop innovative approaches to driving their business. Working on the end-to-end data solution including understanding complex business challenges, designing solutions, working with large and small data sets (including 3rd party and internal data of a wide variety), using cutting-edge machine learning or Generative AI techniques. Work collaboratively with data scientists and other technical disciplines including product and business teams. Work closely with other members of the data and analytics community at Hiscox, contributing to delivering value through the use of a range of analytics techniques. Person Specification Degree in a STEM or closely related field or equivalent experience. A further degree is a plus. Practical data science experience, applying analytical techniques to solve business problems and deliver valuable insights. Experience of data science in finance or insurance is advantageous but not required. Experience conducting data analysis, experimentation, and model development to address business challenges. Comfortable using generative AI technologies, including AI-assisted coding tools, to accelerate research, development, and problem-solving, while maintaining a thorough understanding of the methods, code, and outputs produced. items.desc: Python Backend Developer – AI, MCP & systeemintegratie Heb jij passie voor technologie, niet alleen voor wat er gebeurt op de achtergrond, maar ook voor fysieke technieken, zoals een toffe audio-installatie? Dan is dit de perfecte baan voor jou. Wij hebben een platform waar systeemintegratoren hun complete project kunnen kwijt, v an systeemontwerp en engineering tot productbeheer en projectinformatie. Nu zijn we druk bezig met de volgende stap. Klanten moeten met Artura kunnen praten, het platform kunnen bedienen op meerdere manieren op locatie en achter het bureau. Daar hebben we jouw hulp bij nodig. Over Artura Bij Artura geloven we dat system integrators beter verdienen dan versnipperde tools en eindeloos zoeken naar de juiste informatie. Daarom bouwen we één platform waarin systeemontwerp, engineering, productbeheer en projectinformatie samenkomen. Ons product werkt en onze klanten merken het verschil. Alle kennis over hoe een systeem in elkaar zit, welke componenten waar zijn aangesloten en welke producten erin gaan, staat al in Artura. De volgende stap is om die kennis direct bruikbaar te maken via AI. Waarom deze rol bijzonder is Je stapt niet in een team dat AI als losse feature aan een product hangt. Jij bouwt de AI-laag die door het hele platform loopt. Je bent architect en bouwer tegelijk: je ontwerpt hoe AI veilig en betrouwbaar met onze data en functionaliteit samenwerkt, en je schrijft de code die het waarmaakt. AI is bij ons geen hype maar de kern van waar het product naartoe gaat. Je krijgt de ruimte om te experimenteren, maar bouwt uiteindelijk systemen die klanten dagelijks in productie gebruiken. Waar je mee aan de slag gaat Onze agenda is levendig, jong en flexibel. Er is een stip op de horizon, maar aan de route ernaartoe werk jij mee. Dit gaat over allerlei soorten integraties en interacties, waarbij, indien de behoefte er is, ook onsite met onze klanten mee gewandeld kan worden. Je hoeft niet alle context op dag één te beheersen, sterker nog, dat lijkt mij onmogelijk. Belangrijker is dat je de mogelijkheden ziet, graag bouwt en ideeën echt in productie krijgt. Onze stack Backend: Python, Django, GraphQL Frontend: React Infrastructuur: AWS AI: LLM API's, MCP, tool calling, retrieval en agent-workflows. Welke modellen en frameworks we verder inzetten, bepaal je mee. Herken je jezelf? Je hebt stevige ervaring met Python backend development en voelt je thuis in Django en GraphQL. Je hebt LLM-toepassingen in productie gebracht, niet alleen prototypes. Je weet wat er nodig is om ze betrouwbaar, meetbaar en betaalbaar te houden. Je kent het Model Context Protocol (MCP) en tool calling, en ziet hoe je een bestaand platform veilig opent voor AI-agents. Je hebt ervaring met systeemintegratie: API's, koppelingen, datamodellen en de puzzel om informatie uit verschillende bronnen consistent samen te brengen. Je werkt comfortabel met AWS en denkt na over schaalbaarheid, security en kosten. Je denkt in systemen en datamodellen, en vindt het leuk om complexe technische domeinen te doorgronden. Je bent ondernemend, neemt initiatief en voelt je thuis als nog niet alles vastligt. Je gebruikt AI ook zelf dagelijks in je werk en volgt nieuwe ontwikkelingen op de voet. Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met graph-datamodellen of netwerk- en systeemtopologie, kennis van de wereld van system integrators (AV, security, ICT of installatietechniek), ervaring met RAG, vector search of agent-frameworks, en ervaring met offerte- of configuratie-engines (CPQ). Nieuwsgierigheid, initiatief en de drive om iets neer te zetten wegen voor ons zwaarder dan een perfect cv. Wat je van ons mag verwachten Echt eigenaarschap: jij bepaalt mee hoe AI in Artura wordt gebouwd. Impact die je ziet: wat jij bouwt, gebruiken klanten direct in hun projecten. Ruimte om te experimenteren: nieuwe modellen, tools en ideeën zijn welkom. Afwisseling: van architectuur en integraties tot AI-evaluatie en productdenken. Korte lijnen: je werkt direct samen met het team en ziet snel resultaat. Groeiperspectief: groeit Artura, dan groei jij mee. De concrete arbeidsvoorwaarden en werkvorm bespreken we graag in een persoonlijk gesprek. Zin om mee te bouwen? We maken graag kennis! Geen kant-en-klaar antwoord nodig. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar hoe jij denkt.

items.desc: Vill du utveckla AI-lösningar som används på riktigt och skapar konkret nytta i verksamheten? Har du en stark bakgrund inom fullstackutveckling och vill arbeta i framkant med AI, interna agenter och moderna plattformslösningar? Då kan det här vara nästa steg i din karriär! OM ROLLEN Som AI-utvecklare hos Martin & Servera blir du en viktig del av ett mindre AI-team som befinner sig i en spännande uppbyggnadsfas. Tillsammans utvecklar ni AI-drivna verktyg, interna agenter och affärsnära lösningar som frigör tid, höjer kvaliteten och effektiviserar verksamhetens processer. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från analys och design till utveckling, test, release, drift och kontinuerlig förbättring. Rollen har ett tydligt fullstackfokus där du bygger användarvänliga lösningar i React och TypeScript samt robusta API:er och integrationer i Node och TypeScript. Martin & Servera bygger en egen AI-plattform med flera interna lösningar som redan används inom bland annat HR, utvecklingsstöd, kundservice, artikeldata, e-handel samt kategori och inköp. Här får du möjlighet att vidareutveckla befintliga lösningar och vara med och forma plattformens fortsatta utveckling. I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att Utveckla och vidareutveckla Martin & Serveras AI-plattform, interna AI-agenter och affärsnära lösningar. Bygga tillgängliga och snabba användarflöden i React och TypeScript. Utveckla API:er och integrationer i Node och TypeScript. Arbeta med AI-relaterade områden som RAG, agentiska lösningar, minne, verktyg, guardrails och felhantering. Säkerställa kvalitet, datasäkerhet, spårbarhet och hantering av personuppgifter. Bidra till testautomation, CI/CD, observability och stabila releaseflöden. Samarbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå behov, testa idéer och skapa mätbar användarnytta. Delta i code reviews, dokumentation, kunskapsdelning samt incident- och problemhantering. Du blir en del av ett produktteam med ansvar enligt principen ”you build it, you run it”. Det innebär att du får vara med och påverka hela vägen från idé till en långsiktigt hållbar lösning i produktion. DIN PROFIL Vi Söker Dig Som Har Flerårig erfarenhet av systemutveckling. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av React och TypeScript. Erfarenhet av React med SSR. Erfarenhet av API-utveckling och integrationer, gärna i Node och TypeScript. Erfarenhet av hela utvecklingslivscykeln, från design och utveckling till driftsättning och förvaltning. Erfarenhet av Azure och CI/CD-flöden. God förståelse för datasäkerhet och hantering av personuppgifter. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska. Eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT eller motsvarande kompetens genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Meriterande Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av AI-SDK:er, agentiska ramverk, RAG eller LLMOps/MLOps. Vi ser även positivt på erfarenhet av observability, testautomation och kvalitetssäkring av AI-lösningar. Tidigare yrkeserfarenhet inom AI är meriterande, men inget krav. Det viktigaste är att du har en stark fullstackbakgrund, ett stort teknikintresse och en vilja att utvecklas vidare inom AI. För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är initiativtagande och van att driva ditt arbete framåt. Du samarbetar väl med andra, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och har ett tydligt fokus på användar- och verksamhetsnytta. Eftersom AI-området utvecklas snabbt behöver du också vara nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och bekväm med att arbeta i en miljö där alla svar inte finns från början. OM ORGANISATIONEN Tillsammans gör vi på Martin & Servera skillnad för alla som älskar mat och dryck. Med omtanke om varandra, våra kunder och planeten driver vi varje dag restaurangbranschen framåt. Och som medarbetare hos oss är du en viktig del av helheten. Här tas dina erfarenheter, idéer och kunskaper tillvara. Stabilt och långsiktigt Vi har en stark och långsiktig ägare i form av familjeägda Axel Johnson, vilket skapar både trygghet och stora utvecklingsmöjligheter inom koncernen. Vi erbjuder dig Hos oss får du ett spännande jobb med goda förmåner som till exempel ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag, sjukvårdande bidrag och lunchsubvention. Vi utmanar oss själva och värdesätter prestationer på samma sätt som vi värnar om en bra balans mellan jobb och privatliv. Vi erbjuder möjlighet till distansarbete två dagar i veckan. En trygg och säker arbetsmiljö är grundläggande för oss. Därför följer vi upp vår alkohol- och drogpolicy genom test under den inledande anställningsperioden och därefter genom kontinuerliga slumpmässiga tester på samtliga arbetsplatser. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Placeringen är på Martin & Serveras kontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! Ansök här. Kontakt I denna rekrytering samarbetar Martin&Servera med Wise. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail, utan du söker enkelt med ditt CV eller din LinkedIn-profil på wise.se. Vi använder kompetensbaserad rekrytering som metod. Det gör vi i vår strävan efter en mer …

Vous transformerez des besoins métier en solutions IA avec des agents de code et des modèles de pointe, puis vous mènerez en production celles qui ont fait leurs preuves avec le niveau de sécurité et de fiabilité qu’exigent les grandes entreprises. Il ne s’agit pas d’entraîner des modèles. Vous construirez des workflows agentiques et des applications LLM pour les connecter aux systèmes des clients et les rendre sûrs. De plus en tant que consultant vous porterez la relation client. Le build vous revient, avec de vraies décisions d’ingénierie et une large autonomie. Concrètement : Prototyper rapidement des solutions IA pour valider leur valeur avant un développement complet. Déployer et maintenir des applications et agents LLM conformes aux standards d’architecture des clients, avec évaluation, monitoring et suivi des tokens dès le départ. Configurer les connecteurs MCP et leurs permissions avec rigueur sur les données, les accès et le périmètre de chaque agent. Garantir la conformité des solutions aux exigences de sécurité des clients, à la nLPD et, si nécessaire, au RGPD. Créer des actifs réutilisables (skills, plugins, serveurs MCP) pour accélérer les prochains mandats. Diffuser les bonnes pratiques de développement assisté par l’IA et accompagner les profils moins expérimentés. Documenter vos livrables pour que SQLI et ses clients puissent les reprendre après passation. Qualifications Vous avez déjà livré un projet réel avec Claude ou une autre plateforme d’agents. Vous maîtrisez TypeScript et/ou Python et avez construit des applications RAG. Vous savez créer plugins, skills et serveurs MCP, et concevoir prompts et contexte pour des agents autonomes en toute sécurité. Vous maîtrisez les enjeux de sécurité, de contrôle d’accès et de protection des données (nLPD et RGPD). Vous savez mettre en place des pipelines CI/CD et passer d’un prototype à un build de production. Vous avez l’esprit d’équipe et le sens de l’initiative, idéalement acquis en agence ou en société de conseil. Vous parlez français couramment et anglais à un niveau professionnel. Vous êtes suisse, ressortissant UE/AELE ou titulaire d’un permis de travail valable en Suisse. Les plus : la maîtrise de l’allemand, Azure (notamment Azure AI), l’infrastructure d’agents managés d’Anthropic, l’évaluation des sorties de LLM, une expérience e-commerce ou en automatisation, et l’aisance à présenter devant un public non technique. Informations supplémentaires Rattaché à la direction de la service line Data & AI, vous travaillez principalement sur des mandats clients facturables. Une évolution vers un parcours AI Architect est possible à mesure que la practice grandit. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Une agence à taille humaine proche de ses clients Des projets stimulants avec des clients prestigieux et internationaux Un environnement propice à l’apprentissage continu, avec des formations internes et des certifications pour accompagner votre développement Un suivi de carrière avec des standards RH : entretien annuel, suivi de mission, formations, certifications Rituels réguliers : communications internes sur des sujets liés à la tech et à l’IA, événements internes et rencontres (meet-ups) Une flexibilité de travail (télétravail partiel possible) Vous pensez que ce poste est fait pour vous ? Transmettez-nous votre candidature avec un court message précisant : Une réalisation récente effectuée à l’aide de Claude Code ou d’un agent basé sur Claude (incluez un lien, si possible). La démarche que vous adopteriez pour faire passer un agent — interagissant avec des systèmes clients réels — du stade de prototype rapide à une solution sûre pour une mise en production. Votre délai de congé et votre date de disponibilité au plus tôt. Des questions sur vos données personnelles ? items.desc: Make your mark for patients We are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer who is curious, pragmatic and innovative to join us in our Technology Strategy & Solutions team, based in our HQ office in Brussels, Belgium. items.desc: Telematica Informatica , società di consulenza informatica, è attiva da oltre 40 anni nella ricerca e nella selezione dei migliori profili da inserire nei progetti dei propri clienti. Siamo alla ricerca, per opportunità in consulenza, di un AI Engineer . La persona individuata avrà la possibilità di occuparsi della progettazione, sviluppo e integrazione di soluzioni basate su intelligenza artificiale, lavorando sia sulla componente applicativa sia su quella di interfaccia, utilizzando i principali modelli, strumenti e servizi a supporto dell’intero stack applicativo. 🔧 Di cosa ti occuperai? Progettare e sviluppare applicativi e servizi, dalla logica applicativa alle interfacce utente; Realizzare soluzioni basate su intelligenza artificiale per automatizzare e semplificare i processi; Integrare funzionalità di AI in applicazioni e sistemi esistenti, garantendone affidabilità e prestazioni; Curare il rilascio e l’esecuzione delle applicazioni, assicurandone stabilità e continuità di servizio; Utilizzare strumenti di AI a supporto del ciclo di sviluppo, per migliorare qualità e produttività; Collaborare con team multidisciplinari, condividendo competenze e buone pratiche. 🧑💻 Chi cerchiamo? Il profilo ideale ha: Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o formazione equivalente e affine; Esperienza di almeno due anni nello sviluppo software con Python; Buona conoscenza e utilizzo dei sistemi Linux; Conoscenza di Docker per la containerizzazione delle applicazioni; Conoscenza di React per lo sviluppo di interfacce web; Esperienza nell’utilizzo di strumenti di AI a supporto dello sviluppo, come Codex, Skills e Plugin; Esperienza nell’integrazione di modelli OpenAI in soluzioni RAG e OCR; Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese (almeno B2); Ottime capacità organizzative, comunicative e di lavoro in team. 📍 Sede: Torino – Possibilità di lavoro in modalità ibrida settimanale. 💸 Proponiamo un iniziale contratto con RAL compresa tra 26.000 - 29.000 euro, oltre a: Buoni pasto; Piattaforma fringe benefit; Accesso alla piattaforma E-Learning per la tua formazione continua. 🔮 Cosa succede dopo aver inviato la tua candidatura: Il primo step prevede un colloquio conoscitivo/motivazionale con il Team HR e un successivo incontro tecnico, dedicato ad approfondire gli aspetti progettuali e le competenze tecniche richieste dalla posizione. Se ti riconosci nel profilo e vuoi lavorare nel mondo dell’ AI e dello Sviluppo Software , candidati e parliamone! 🚀 La ricerca è rivolta a candidati appartenenti ad entrambi i sessi (L. 903/77). Si richiede di includere l'autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali ai sensi del Regolamento UE n. 679/2016 (GDPR).

items.desc: Was wir machen: DECAID bringt Unternehmen von KI-Piloten in den echten Alltag. Wir befähigen Teams auf Tools wie Langdock, ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude und Microsoft Copilot, und mit DECAID Builders bauen wir KI-Agenten, die beim Kunden produktiv laufen: vom Mittelstand bis zu Konzernen. Wie groß wir sind: Ein Kernteam von rund zehn Leuten plus ein Netzwerk aus Trainern und Engineers. Über 300 Unternehmen arbeiten mit uns, darunter Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen und die Telekom, und wir haben mehr als 30 Langdock-Rollouts begleitet. Was wir vorhaben: Wir wachsen schnell und bauen jetzt unser festes Engineering-Team bei DECAID Builders auf. Du gehörst zu den ersten Engineers und prägst mit, wie wir bauen. Parallel gehen wir in erste Märkte außerhalb des DACH-Raums. Deine Rolle Du verantwortest kleinere und mittlere KI-Projekte im Mittelstand, oft mehrere parallel und meist in wenigen Wochen umgesetzt. Du gehst zum Kunden, verstehst seinen Prozess, legst fest, wann ein Agent »fertig« ist, und steuerst ihn mit unseren Agents und Werkzeugen bis zur Abnahme. Deine Aufgaben Anforderungen beim Kunden aufnehmen und mit dem Fachbereich klären, was der Prozess wirklich tut Prozesse in baubare Skills zerlegen und für jeden eine klare Definition of Done festlegen Agenten agentisch bauen (Claude Code o. ä.): Tool-Calling, RAG, strukturierte Outputs, Context Engineering Dokumente in Daten verwandeln, mit Konfidenz-Scoring statt Bauchgefühl Qualität messen: Ground-Truth-Sets, Evals, Regressionstests Quellsysteme anbinden (APIs, Datenbanken, Mail, SharePoint) und bis zur Abnahme begleiten Wer du bist Du baust schnell und pragmatisch: 80 Prozent, die produktiv laufen, schlagen 100 Prozent im Konzept. Du besitzt das Ergebnis: Dein Standard ist »vom Kunden abgenommen«. Du arbeitest schon heute agentisch und prüfst, was die Agents bauen. Du gehst gern zum Kunden und redest mit Menschen, die keine Entwickler sind. Du organisierst dich selbst und behältst mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig im Griff. Was du mitbringen solltest Solides Fundament in Python und/oder TypeScript, APIs, Git, Testing LLM-Systeme, die du produktiv gebaut hast: Agenten, Tool-Calling, RAG Routine mit agentischen Coding-Werkzeugen (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) Integrations-Handwerk: REST, SQL, Datenmodellierung Ein Portfolio, GitHub oder Projekte, die echte Menschen nutzen Deutsch fließend (C1+) Von Vorteil Erfahrung mit Langdock, Make oder n8n Dokumenten-KI: OCR, PDF-Parsing EU-Cloud (Azure, Hetzner, StackIT), Docker Erfahrung aus Kundenprojekten, Beratung oder Agentur

Nous mobilisons notre expertise, notre excellence scientifique et technologique pour vous permettre d’anticiper les phénomènes météorologiques et climatiques à enjeux, et de vous y adapter. Retrouvez-nous en ligne : https://meteofrance.com/carte-didentite-de-meteo-france Rejoindre Météo France, C'est Intégrer Une Organisation Multi-sites, Situés En Hexagone, En Outre-mer, Etc. L'organisation De Météo-France S'appuie Sur Des Directions Centrales Et Des Directions Interrégionales. Ci-dessous, La Présentation De La Direction Que Vous Pourriez Rejoindre La DESR (Direction de l'Enseignement Supérieur et de la Recherche) rassemble les entités de recherche de Météo-France (principalement CNRM, SAFIRE, LACy), l'Ecole Nationale de la Météorologie, et les services partagés de soutien administratif et informatique (PGA). Le CNRM est une Unité Mixte de Recherche (UMR 3589) avec la double tutelle Météo-France et CNRS. Le CNRM conduit des recherches dans le domaine de la météorologie et du climat, de l'observation, la compréhension et la modélisation des processus jusqu'à la mise au point de systèmes de prévision météorologique et de projection climatique pouvant être transférés aux services opérationnels de Météo-France. Le GMAP (Groupe de Modélisation et d'Assimilation pour la Prévision), basé à Toulouse, est l'un des 6 groupes ou centres de recherche du CNRM. Sa mission est de maintenir et développer les systèmes de prévision numérique du temps (PNT) opérationnels de Météo-France et de conduire des recherches qui préparent les futures versions. L’équipe OBS fait partie du groupe GMAP, et est en charge de l’utilisation de tous les types d’observations pour améliorer les prévisions des modèles de Prévision Numérique du Temps (PNT). La personne sera recrutée au sein de l’équipe OBS, et travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes PROCESSUS et PREVISIBILITE du GMAP, ainsi que l’équipe PHYNH du GMME Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Embarquez pour une aventure stimulante et au service de tous aux côtés d’hommes et de femmes engagés quotidiennement face aux défis posés à notre société par la météo et le climat. Et ainsi bénéficiez des avantages suivants : horaires flexibles, RTT, télétravail, restaurant administratif ou ticket restaurant, participation à hauteur de 75% pour les transports en commun, participation pour la mutuelle, associations sportives et culturelles en fonction du site concerné, (escalade, gym, poterie, théâtre etc..). D'autres avantages vous attendent, venez les découvrir ! L’objectif est d’évaluer l’apport de nouvelles observations (radiosondages dans l’UTLS, mesures aéroportées, données des satellites Européen de nouvelle génération IASI-NG et/ou IRS), actuellement peu ou pas assimilées, pour améliorer la prévision des champs d’humidité, en particulier dans les zones sursaturées. Ces observations seront assimilées séparément dans le système 4DVar d’ARPEGE (Bouyssel et al. 2002). Si les résultats ne sont pas concluants, un ajustement des paramètres d’assimilation (erreurs d’observation et d’ébauche, débiaisage, etc.) sera effectué. Cette étape pourrait également conduire à des modifications des critères d’assimilation dans la chaîne opérationnelle de Météo-France. Une fois cette première étape de tuning des paramètres d’assimilation des observations d’humidité finalisée, la deuxième partie du projet portera sur l’évaluation de l’apport d’une flotte d’avions embarquant des capteurs d’humidité. L’objectif sera d’évaluer si équiper une flotte d’avions de capteurs d’humidité pourrait permettre d’améliorer les prévisions, et en particulier la prévision des zones propices à la formation de traînés de condensation. Pour cela, une méthode ensembliste, appelée « Ensemble of Data Assimilation » (EDA), sera employée (voir par exemple Sasso et al. 2025). Dans cette méthode, des observations synthétiques d’avions seront assimilées avec les observations opérationnellement assimilées dans le système d’assimilation ensembliste d’ARPEGE (AEARP). L’apport de ces nouvelles observations sera évalué par leurs capacités à réduire les incertitudes sur les prévisions à courte échéance. items.desc: About Us We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence. As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations. About The Role Group Research and Development (GRD) performs strategic and applied research to develop the knowledge, methods and technologies required for DNV’s future assurance services. The Energy Security and Resilience research programme focuses on assurance of critical energy infrastructure by developing practical and transparent methods for assessing security risk, vulnerabilities, system dependencies and resilience. The programme combines energy-system knowledge with security research, risk analysis, data science and societal perspectives, and validates new approaches through case studies, prototypes and collaboration with industry, authorities and academia. Are you interested in how geopolitical developments, threat actors and vulnerabilities may affect critical energy infrastructure, and in developing practical methods and tools for threat-informed risk assessment? A central part of the role is to use AI-supported methods to collect, evaluate and synthesise open-source information from multiple sources into descriptions of threat actors, capabilities, intent, possible targets and attack vectors . The resulting threat picture shall provide a documented basis for assessing risk and for identifying proportionate protective security and resilience measures. The research will contribute to future DNV assurance services for energy security and resilience. Ci-dessous, La Présentation De La Direction Que Vous Pourriez Rejoindre GMAP is a research group at CNRM (National Centre for Meteorological Research) affiliated with Météo-France and CNRS (National Centre for Scientific Research). GMAP develops numerical forecasting software packages for Météo-France. The OBS team is in charge of the assimilation of observations in the global and regional NWP models of Météo-France. The position offered is part of the European CICONIA‑MET project, which aims to support and contribute to the European Union’s ambition of achieving climate neutrality by 2050. In this perspective, and in line with the aviation sector’s commitment to reduce the climate impact of air transport, new services are required to help air traffic optimise flight paths and reduce the formation of contrails. To this end, it is necessary to improve the forecasting of ice‑supersaturated regions (ISSRs) in Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) models. Within the previous CICONIA project (Arriolabengoa et al., 2025), recent advances in the cloud scheme of Météo‑France’s global NWP model ARPEGE have enabled better prediction of these ice‑supersaturated regions. However, further improvements are still needed to refine their forecasts, particularly by working on the initial conditions (called analyses). Indeed, at present very few humidity‑sensitive observations are assimilated in the Upper Troposphere–Lower Stratosphere (UTLS). Consequently, the first objective of this project is to advance the assimilation of humidity‑sensitive data (both in‑situ and satellite) in the UTLS within ARPEGE. The second objective is to assess how a fleet of aircraft equipped with humidity sensors could contribute to improving ARPEGE analyses and forecasts in ice‑supersaturated regions. This work will also help inform decisions regarding future deployment scenarios for onboard humidity sensors on aircraft. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Embarquez pour une aventure stimulante et au service de tous aux côtés d’hommes et de femmes engagés quotidiennement face aux défis posés à notre société par la météo et le climat. D'autres avantages vous attendent, venez les découvrir ! The Proposed Work Is Organized Around Two Main Phases Improving the assimilation of humidity observations in ARPEGE The aim is to assess the contribution of new observations—UTLS radiosondes, airborne measurements, and data from the next‑generation of European satellites IASI‑NG and/or IRS—which are currently little or not assimilated at all in the UTLS. These observations will be assimilated in the ARPEGE 4‑D‑Var system (Bouyssel et al. 2002). If the results are not satisfactory, the assimilation parameters (observation and background error statistics, bias correction, etc.) will be adjusted. This step may also lead to changes in the assimilation criteria used in Météo‑France’s operational chain for the assimilation of humidity observations in the UTLS. Evaluating the contribution of a fleet of aircraft equipped with humidity sensors Once the first phase—tuning the humidity‑observation assimilation parameters—is completed, the second part of the project will focus on assessing whether equipping a fleet of aircraft with humidity sensors could improve forecasts, especially in regions prone to contrail formation. For this purpose an ensemble‑based method, called Ensemble of Data Assimilation (EDA), will be used (see, for example, Sasso et al. 2025). In this approach, synthetic aircraft observations are assimilated together with the operational observations already ingested by the ARPEGE Ensemble Assimilation system (AEARP). L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Techniques de l'Informatique et de la Microélectronique pour l'Architecture des systèmes intégrés Type de Contrat CDD Doctorant Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 38031 GRENOBLE Durée du contrat 36 mois Date d'Embauche 01/01/2027 Rémuneration La rémunération est d'un minimum de 2300,00 € mensuel Postuler Date limite de candidature : vendredi 13 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Sujet De Thèse La caractérisation de la sécurité des systèmes embarqués en 'boite noire' ou 'boite grise' face aux attaques Side-Channel requiert fréquemment une phase préparatoire de Reverse-Engineering, qui peut être particulièrement chronophage, notamment sur un Sytem-on-Chip (SoC) complexe que l’on peut retrouver sur smartphone ou dans l’automobile. Cette phase peut, par exemple, consister en la détection d’une primitive cryptographique au sein de mesures Side-Channel pour une future attaque par observation, ou d’une routine cible pour une attaque par perturbation. L’objectif de cette thèse est de développer une méthodologie et des outils non-profilés permettant l’automatisation de cette phase de détection, tout en permettant d’exploiter la connaissance a priori d’un potentiel attaquant. La thématique du Reverse-Engineering non-profilé via Side-Channel gravite autour de problèmes bien connus en traitement de 'timeseries' comme la découverte de motifs, découverte d’anomalies, ou la segmentation sémantique. Un des objectifs de cette thèse sera ainsi de traiter ces problématiques en prenant en compte les particularités des attaques par Side-Channel sur SoC, comme le bruit et le jitter dans les mesures, et l’a priori d’un attaquant sur le code exécuté et les données manipulées. De ce fait, l’investigation d’une méthodologie alliant machine learning, modèles probabilistes et métriques exactes sur les 'timeseries', constitue une des pierres angulaires de cette thèse. Les scenarii couverts par les problématiques de recherche posés par cette thèse sont multiples. Quelques exemples significatifs, en plus de la préparation à des attaques physiques classiques, sont le reverse-engineering de bootloader ou la découverte d’architecture de réseaux de neurones. Il est situé à Grenoble, sur le site Viallet de Grenoble INP-UGA (46 avenue Félix Viallet). TIMA est une équipe cosmopolite de 150 personnes environ, avec des chercheurs du monde entier (chercheurs permanents, enseignants-chercheurs, doctorants, post-doctorants, CDD ingénieurs, collaborateurs scientifiques, invités et stagiaires). Les sujets de recherches couvrent la spécification, la conception, la vérification, le test, les outils CAO et méthodes d’aide à la conception pour les systèmes intégrés. Une grande partie de la recherche s’effectue dans le contexte de projets coopératifs, avec des partenaires industriels et académiques, financés par des contrats régionaux, nationaux et européens. Le laboratoire entretient ainsi de forts contacts avec le milieu industriel et académique qui réclament une implication professionnelle tant sur le plan logistique que relationnel. L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Techniques de l'Informatique et de la Microélectronique pour l'Architecture des systèmes intégrés Type de Contrat CDD Doctorant Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 38031 GRENOBLE Durée du contrat 36 mois Date d'Embauche 01/01/2027 Rémuneration La rémunération est d'un minimum de 2300,00 € mensuel Postuler Date limite de candidature : vendredi 13 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Sujet De Thèse La caractérisation de la sécurité des systèmes embarqués en 'boite noire' ou 'boite grise' face aux attaques Side-Channel requiert fréquemment une phase préparatoire de Reverse-Engineering, qui peut être particulièrement chronophage, notamment sur un Sytem-on-Chip (SoC) complexe que l’on peut retrouver sur smartphone ou dans l’automobile. Cette phase peut, par exemple, consister en la détection d’une primitive cryptographique au sein de mesures Side-Channel pour une future attaque par observation, ou d’une routine cible pour une attaque par perturbation. L’objectif de cette thèse est de développer une méthodologie et des outils non-profilés permettant l’automatisation de cette phase de détection, tout en permettant d’exploiter la connaissance a priori d’un potentiel attaquant. La thématique du Reverse-Engineering non-profilé via Side-Channel gravite autour de problèmes bien connus en traitement de 'timeseries' comme la découverte de motifs, découverte d’anomalies, ou la segmentation sémantique. Un des objectifs de cette thèse sera ainsi de traiter ces problématiques en prenant en compte les particularités des attaques par Side-Channel sur SoC, comme le bruit et le jitter dans les mesures, et l’a priori d’un attaquant sur le code exécuté et les données manipulées. De ce fait, l’investigation d’une méthodologie alliant machine learning, modèles probabilistes et métriques exactes sur les 'timeseries', constitue une des pierres angulaires de cette thèse. Les scenarii couverts par les problématiques de recherche posés par cette thèse sont multiples. Quelques exemples significatifs, en plus de la préparation à des attaques physiques classiques, sont le reverse-engineering de bootloader ou la découverte d’architecture de réseaux de neurones. Votre Environnement de Travail Le laboratoire TIMA est un laboratoire public de recherche sous la tutelle du CNRS, de Grenoble INP et de l’UGA. Il est situé à Grenoble, sur le site Viallet de Grenoble INP-UGA (46 avenue Félix Viallet). TIMA est une équipe cosmopolite de 150 personnes environ, avec des chercheurs du monde entier (chercheurs permanents, enseignants-chercheurs, doctorants, post-doctorants, CDD ingénieurs, collaborateurs scientifiques, invités et stagiaires). Les sujets de recherches couvrent la spécification, la conception, la vérification, le test, les outils CAO et méthodes d’aide à la conception pour les systèmes intégrés. Une grande partie de la recherche s’effectue dans le contexte de projets coopératifs, avec des partenaires industriels et académiques, financés par des contrats régionaux, nationaux et européens. Le laboratoire entretient ainsi de forts contacts avec le milieu industriel et académique qui réclament une implication professionnelle tant sur le plan logistique que relationnel. Contraintes et risques Le poste est localisé en Zone à Régime Restrictif (ZRR), ce qui implique une procédure administrative préalable d’autorisation d’accès. Le CNRS est le seul organisme français actif dans tous les domaines scientifiques. Sa position unique de multi-spécialiste lui permet d’associer les différentes disciplines pour affronter les défis les plus importants du monde contemporain, en lien avec les acteurs du changement. items.desc:
Job Title
Data and AI Engineer 
 Job Description
 Enterprise Informatics is Philips' software business. Decisions about where to invest, which opportunities and accounts to prioritize, and how the business will perform depend on data from CRM, ERP, service, contracts and other enterprise systems. The Data and AI Engineer works at the intersection of business analysis, data analysis, data engineering and agentic AI. The role turns ambiguous business needs into well-defined analytical problems and scalable solutions, from data discovery and rapid prototyping through deployment and adoption. It is a hands-on technical role requiring direct work in Python and SQL, alongside the ability to explain methods, data quality and business implications to senior stakeholders. 
 Your role: 
 Partner with Services, Sales Operations, Marketing, Business Operations and other stakeholders to translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined analytical problems, challenge assumptions where needed, and communicate clear conclusions.
 Find, acquire, explore, integrate and prepare data from enterprise systems such as Salesforce, SAP and ServiceNow, ensuring appropriate data quality, lineage, security and governance.
 Analyze commercial, financial and operational data to explain performance and support recurring business cycles, including revenue and order-intake bridges, pipeline, backlog, installed base and variance analysis.
 Build and maintain curated datasets, Python/SQL data solutions, and semantic and metric layers on the Databricks Lakehouse and cloud platforms, with Azure preferred and AWS experience valued.
 Rapidly prototype and productionize agentic AI solutions that put trusted insights into business users' hands. Design agent tools and skills, curate semantic metadata, create evaluation suites, and use modern AI development harnesses and coding agents while maintaining sound Git, testing and CI/CD practices.
 Coordinate cross-functional data, analytics and AI initiatives from requirements through deployment, testing, validation and adoption, working effectively across business and technical teams.
 Proactively contribute to data and AI strategy and roadmap definition, evaluate emerging technologies, and share reusable methods and best practices across the team.
 You’re a right fit if: 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Management, Data Science, Econometrics, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics or an equivalent field. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 3 years with a Master's degree, in data handling, analytics, data engineering, AI solution development or equivalent.
 Strong hands-on Python and SQL skills, including experience with Spark or PySpark, Delta Lake and practical software development practices.
 Practical Databricks experience spanning notebooks, Lakehouse/Delta, jobs or workflows, applications or agents, and deployment pipelines.
 Demonstrated hands-on experience building agentic AI solutions beyond a proof of concept, including evaluation, testing and production-readiness considerations.
 Strong data analysis capability, including statistical methods, data processing, reconciliation, and the ability to explain why data sources or metrics disagree.
 Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure; AWS experience is also relevant.
 Ability to coordinate cross-functional work, gather requirements, and communicate clearly in English with business leaders and technical stakeholders.
 Practical analytics-engineering experience with commercial and financial data, including revenue, subscription or licence models, pipeline, backlog and installed base, and related enterprise systems such as Salesforce, SAP and ServiceNow, ideally within a B2B software or technology business
 Modern agent frameworks and protocols, LLM evaluation practices, semantic modelling, dbt or Databricks metric views, and Power BI.
 Healthcare, medtech or another regulated industry is preferred
 Compensation & benefits 
 Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €78.187 –€130.312. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations.
We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.
 How we work together 
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

About the Team

The OpenAI for Government AI Architect team partners with public sector organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with government agencies, public institutions, and partner organizations serving the government to identify where AI can advance critical missions, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Global Affairs, and specialist delivery teams to help public sector customers adopt advanced AI responsibly and effectively.

About the Role

As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will shape each customer's AI strategy and guide their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable mission impact.

You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate mission priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value. The Account Director leads the overall account strategy and relationship, while you lead the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production impact.

You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong public sector fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.

This role is based in Munich or London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of public sector customers and pre-sales prospects.

 - Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.

 - Lead discovery with agency leaders, mission owners, executives, and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful mission and operational outcomes.

 - Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.

 - Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, building confidence in both the solution and its path to production.

 - Help customers navigate the security, compliance, governance, and deployment requirements that shape AI adoption in the public sector.

 - Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.

 - Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, Chief Data and AI Officers, program leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.

 - Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, security, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.

 - Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.

 - Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable mission impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.

 - Apply public sector and mission expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.

 - Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.

 - Have guided complex organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable impact.

 - Have experience working with government agencies, public institutions, or government contractors and understand how mission priorities, security, compliance, governance, and procurement considerations shape technology adoption.

 - Build credibility with senior technical and government leaders while communicating equally well with …

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our Data team. You will build and scale our data pipelines, establish best practices, ensure data quality, and enable self-service data access across teams.

 - Own and streamline data pipelines from ingestion to delivery, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, and efficient.

 - Implement and maintain dbt best practices, data standards, and quality controls.

 - Build self-service tooling and write clear documentation to empower cross-functional teams (Engineering, Revenue Operations, Growth, and others) to independently meet their data needs.

 - Create AI agents to serve data questions for others




REQUIREMENTS

Demonstrated experience formalising and scaling data pipelines, ideally as one of the first or early data engineers on a growing team.

 - Expert knowledge of dbt (required).

 - Proficiency with tools across the modern data stack (Python, SQL, BI tools).

 - Strong infra fundamentals (Terraform or other infrastructure as code, GCP or other cloud providers)

 - Structured thinking; ability to simplify complex, messy data into clear structures.

 - Strong ability to understand varied stakeholder requirements and build generalised solutions.




LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, New York.

 Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 
 YOUR ROLE 
 Located in Diegem/Zaventem, we are a Software Design Center and cryptography center of excellence, specialized in developing innovative secure software solutions for authentication solutions used in everyday life, from satellite based and IoT networks to printers and smartphones.
 We are looking for a talented mid-level embedded software engineer with a versatile skillset to contribute to the design of state-of-the-art secure embedded software products:
 Build, improve, and maintain CI pipelines for all secure software developments
 Prototype and integrate AI agents to assist code generation, review, test creation, and documentation
 Develop and optimize secure bare-metal embedded software for resource-constrained devices
 Work closely with cryptographers, security experts, architects, and validation teams across the full product lifecycle
 YOUR SKILLS & EXPERIENCES

 Languages: C, assembly (RISC-V and ARM), Python
 Version control & collaboration: Git, GitHub Enterprise
 CI/CD & automation: Jenkins
 Virtualization & environments: Docker, Ansible, WSL, VMware
 AI tooling: GitHub Copilot, local LLMs.
 Profile 
 You have a degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field, with around 5 years of relevant professional experience.
 You have experience with or interest in multiple of the following topics:
 Embedded systems architecture, development, or test
 AI agents, AI coding tools and AI workflows
 DevOps/DevSecOps, CI pipelines
 Embedded security and cryptography
 System architecture
 Note that we are not looking for an expert in all these areas, but rather someone with exposure to some of them, with an ability to proactively adapt and learn.
 You are autonomous, curious, proactive, and passionate about innovation and emerging technologies.
 You have a continuous improvement and learning mindset.
 You are a team player with good communication skills.
 ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.

items.desc: Vous serez principalement chargé de : Contribuer à des projets d'appui aux politiques publiques ou internationaux sur la gestion et la protection quantitative et qualitative des ressources en eau souterraine en lien notamment avec les eaux de surface, l'eau de mer et les changements globaux ; Modéliser des écoulements souterrains en lien avec les eaux de surfaces (échange nappe-rivière et réseau urbain) et modéliser le transport de solutés/chaleur/masse associés (intrusion saline/pollutions ponctuelles, diffuses/impacts du changement climatique... ; Contribuer à l'intégration d'approches innovantes sur la modélisation hydrogéologique à l'aide de l'intelligence artificielle et/ou de méthodes d'assimilation de données et d'optimisation multi-objectifs de gestion sous incertitudes ; Valoriser les résultats sous forme de rapports techniques, publications ; Présenter les résultats scientifiques et savoir les vulgariser pour tout type d'acteurs et pouvoir dialoguer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires Profil Titulaire d'un master, d'un diplôme d'ingénieur ou d'un doctorat en hydrogéologie, vous avez idéalement une première expérience en post-doctorat ou en entreprise ; une expérience à l'étranger serait un atout. Vous mobiliserez par ailleurs les compétences et qualités suivantes : Savoir-faire scientifique et technique Solides connaissances en hydrogéologie et expertise en modélisation des écoulements et des processus de transfert et transport ; Maîtrise des codes de calcul maillés (MODFLOW-6, Marthe) et des approches scriptées en Python, idéalement avec FloPy ; Expérience de la calibration algorithmique et de l'analyse d'incertitudes, notamment avec la suite PEST/PEST++/PyEMU ; Connaissance des contextes d'intrusion saline et de la modélisation des écoulements à densité variable. Rigueur, sens de l'organisation et respect des engagements contractuels ; Esprit d'initiative et créativité scientifique ; Aptitudes relationnelles et goût du travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire ; Excellentes capacités de communication, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, pour publier, présenter en congrès et animer des formations ; Anglais courant, écrit et oral. Dans un environnement favorable à l'équilibre vie professionnelle/vie privée, notamment grâce au télétravail, le BRGM se distingue par son climat de bienveillance et de convivialité. Nous mettons à votre disposition de nombreux dispositifs pour développer vos compétences et votre expertise, avec des possibilités d'évolutions et de mobilités géographiques.
