items.desc: Stellenbeschreibung Intelligent Operations | CIS FDE Technology & Operations "We support and guardrail AI forward deployed engineering engagements across SAP industries — ensuring quality, security and lasting impact." What you’ll bring You know what it takes to keep AI-native solutions running in production — not in a lab, but in customer environments where uptime, data boundaries, and contractual SLAs are non-negotiable. You’ve worked hands-on with LLM-based systems, agentic workflows, and distributed architectures, and you understand that building something is only half the job — the other half is making sure it stays healthy after go-live. You bring deep experience in observability, incident management, and production reliability across cloud environments. You can spot drift in agentic application behavior before it becomes a customer escalation. You’ve operated in regulated or enterprise-grade settings where compliance, security posture, and operational governance aren’t optional. And you can translate that experience into standards, playbooks, and repeatable processes that a growing team can follow. You’re comfortable working across organizational boundaries — with delivery squads, engineering/ platform teams, and customers/ external partners — and you can hold your ground in a room full of architects who built the thing you now need to run. What you’ll build You’re building Intelligent Operations from the ground up. This capability doesn’t exist at scale yet — you’ll define how it works. Concretely, that means: Handover model: Take care of what “production-ready” looks like when an FDE engagement transitions from Value Delivery to Value Operation. You own the handover framework — what needs to be in place before your team takes over. Run-team operations: Build the monitoring, alerting, and incident response capability for deployed AI solutions. Ensure contractual SLA commitments are met — not by heroics, but by design. AI quality in production: Drift detection, performance benchmarking, guardrails validation, retraining triggers. The solutions we deploy use LLMs and agents — production quality assurance looks fundamentally different here than in classical software. Operational governance: Establish best practices for production security, data boundaries, and compliance across customer engagements. Work with other engineers to ensure the enterprise bar holds post-deployment and establish self-healing capabilities. Scalable operations: What works for one customer engagement needs to work for fifty. You’ll design the operational model to scale — tooling, automation, partner integration — so that every new go-live doesn’t require reinventing the wheel. You’ll work closely with the Knowledge & IP team to capture operational learnings and feed them back into the delivery lifecycle, so the next engagement starts stronger. Where you belong T&O is the engineering backbone of CIS Forward Deployed Engineering. Our mission: ensure quality, security, and lasting impact across AI engagements for SAP’s industry customers. You’ll sit in the Intelligent Operations pillar — the part of T&O that owns what happens after go-live. Deployed solutions stay healthy and improve. That’s the mandate. This is a leadership role without a management title. You’ll mentor engineers, set operational standards, and build the technical capabilities of a team that’s being assembled now. You’ll work globally, across FDE squads and hubs, with external delivery partners, and directly with customers when production demands it. If you’ve spent your career at the intersection of SRE, AI systems, and enterprise operations — and you want to build something new rather than maintain something existing — this is the role. We value the skills you bring and support you to build on them through our learning and development opportunities. These are the skills associated with this role: Agentic AI Day-to-Day Practice, AI Adoption Capability, AI Output Quality Assurance, Context Engineering, AI-Assisted Automation and Prototyping, Learning Agility, Collaboration, Complex Problem Solving, Creative Thinking, Effective Communication, Agentic orchestration, Agentic engineering, Application security, Cloud architecture, Evaluations and benchmarking engineering #SAPAICAreers Zusätzliche Informationen Über SAP Mithilfe eines weltweiten Netzwerks aus Kunden, Partnern, Mitarbeitern und Vordenkern verbessert SAP die Abläufe in der weltweiten Wirtschaft und das Leben von Menschen. Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Anwendungen und KI für Unternehmen sitzt SAP an der Schnittstelle zwischen Wirtschaft und Technologie. items.desc: Stellenbeschreibung Intelligent Operations | CIS FDE Technology & Operations "We support and guardrail AI forward deployed engineering engagements across SAP industries — ensuring quality, security and lasting impact." In this role, you belong to the Intelligent Operations pillar of T&O — the operational backbone of CIS Forward Deployed Engineering. Your job is to build and maintain the data infrastructure that keeps deployed AI solutions reliable, governed, and continuously improving. What you’ll bring You’ve built and operated the data infrastructure that AI systems depend on — not experimental notebooks, but production data pipelines that feed agents, models, and customer-facing applications at scale. You have deep expertise in data pipeline development, data governance, and data infrastructure management across cloud-native environments. You understand that data quality in AI-native operations is fundamentally different from traditional data engineering. The data flowing through agentic systems needs to be validated, governed, and traceable — not just available. Experience with knowledge graph integration, master data management and customer data handling in enterprise environments gives you a head start. What’s non-negotiable is that you know how to build data infrastructure that’s production-grade and scales without manual intervention. You can work across organizational boundaries — with application engineers, platform teams, delivery squads, and data science teams — and you’re comfortable defining data standards and governance practices that others will follow. You’ve done this before: not just built pipelines, but built the data layer that production systems trust. What you’ll build You’re building the data backbone for Intelligent Operations. Every AI solution CIS deploys depends on data — for inference, for evaluation, for drift detection, for continuous improvement. That data layer is your domain. Concretely: Production data pipelines: Design, build, and maintain the data pipelines that feed our own systems based on deployed AI agents and applications. This includes ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and delivery — all automated, monitored, and resilient. Data governance and compliance: Establish and enforce data governance practices across customer engagements. Data privacy, data boundary enforcement, lineage tracking, and audit trails — baked into the infrastructure, not managed in spreadsheets. Regulated industries are a significant part of our customer base. Knowledge graph and semantic data: Build and maintain knowledge graph infrastructure that powers our internal agent context and retrieval. As IAI solutions grow more agentic, the quality of structured knowledge becomes a differentiator in our own production processes — not just in demos. Data quality and validation: Automated validation frameworks for production data. Drift in data quality is the silent killer of AI system performance. You’ll build the checks that catch degradation before it impacts our agentic solutions or customer SLAs. Data product lifecycle: Treat data assets as products with versioning, documentation, ownership, and lifecycle management. Work with the Knowledge & IP team to ensure data assets are reusable across engagements — so the next customer project doesn’t start from zero. You’ll work closely with the Application Engineering and Platform Engineering teams. They operate the solutions and the infrastructure — you ensure the data underneath is solid, governed, and continuously improving. Where you belong T&O’s mission: ensure quality, security, and lasting impact across AI engagements for SAP’s industry customers. The CTO Office defines how we build. T&O manages what CIS has built — ensuring every engagement is production-grade and reusable. Within Intelligent Operations, you own the data layer that everything else depends on. Without reliable, governed data infrastructure, there’s no trustworthy AI in production — just models running on hope. This is a technical leadership role. You’ll define data engineering standards, mentor engineers, and shape the data strategy for a capability that’s being stood up now. You’ll work globally, across FDE squads and hubs, with external delivery partners, and with the SAP data and analytics ecosystem when integration questions need answers. If you’ve spent your career making data infrastructure production-grade — and you want to define what data engineering looks like for enterprise AI operations — this is the role. We value the skills you bring and support you to build on them through our learning and development opportunities. These are the skills associated with this role: Agentic AI Day-to-Day Practice, AI Adoption Capability, AI Output Quality Assurance, Context Engineering, AI-Assisted Automation and Prototyping, Learning Agility, Collaboration, Complex Problem Solving, Creative Thinking, Effective Communication, Data Governance, Data Pipeline Development, Knowledge …

Security and governance tooling: Automated compliance checks, access management, data boundary enforcement — baked into the platform, not bolted on. Work with Engineering Excellence to ensure the enterprise bar holds in every production environment. You’ll work closely with the Application Engineering team who operates the solutions day-to-day. You’ll mentor engineers, define platform standards, and shape the tooling strategy for a capability that’s being stood up now. You’ll work globally, across FDE squads and hubs, with external delivery partners, and with the BAIP platform teams when infrastructure questions need answers. If you’ve spent your career making platforms that other teams depend on — and you want to define what operational platform engineering looks like for enterprise AI — this is the role. items.desc: Chi siamo Delegi Srl è un’agenzia di marketing, comunicazione e sviluppo digitale con sede a Saronno. Lavoriamo con aziende B2B e B2C su progetti di Digital Marketing, advertising, gestione social, creazioni contenuti foto e video, sviluppo siti web, SEO, GEO, CRM, automazioni e Intelligenza Artificiale . Il nostro obiettivo è aiutare le aziende a migliorare il posizionamento, acquisire nuovi clienti, ottimizzare i processi commerciali e crescere in modo più strutturato. Per ampliare il team stiamo cercando un Commerciale B2B che si occupi dello sviluppo di nuovi clienti e della gestione delle opportunità generate dalle nostre attività di marketing. Cosa farai Entrerai nell’area commerciale e ti occuperai di: ricerca e contatto di nuovi potenziali clienti; gestione e qualificazione dei lead generati dall’agenzia; fissaggio e gestione di appuntamenti con aziende e imprenditori; analisi delle esigenze del cliente; presentazione delle soluzioni Delegi; preparazione delle proposte commerciali con il supporto del team; gestione di follow-up e trattative; chiusura delle opportunità commerciali; aggiornamento delle attività all’interno del CRM. L’attività comprende quindi sia sviluppo commerciale outbound sia la gestione di opportunità inbound . Cosa venderai Non avrai un unico prodotto da proporre. Lavorerai su soluzioni costruite in base alle esigenze del cliente, tra cui: Social Media Marketing; Meta Ads; Google Ads; Lead Generation; SEO; GEO; sviluppo siti web ed e-commerce; produzione di contenuti; CRM; automazioni; Intelligenza Artificiale applicata ai processi aziendali; AI Agent; formazione marketing, commerciale e digitale. Cerchiamo quindi una persona capace di capire il problema del cliente prima di proporre una soluzione . Chi cerchiamo Cerchiamo una persona con una forte attitudine commerciale, a cui piaccia parlare con imprenditori e aziende e che abbia voglia di costruire relazioni e sviluppare nuovi clienti. L’esperienza nella vendita B2B è preferenziale, soprattutto in ambiti come: marketing; comunicazione; digitale; software; SaaS; consulenza; servizi alle imprese; Intelligenza Artificiale. Per noi sono importanti soprattutto: capacità comunicative e relazionali; attitudine alla vendita; capacità di ascolto; iniziativa; organizzazione; costanza; orientamento ai risultati; capacità di lavorare in team; dimestichezza con CRM e strumenti digitali; curiosità verso marketing, tecnologia e AI. Cosa troverai in Delegi Metteremo a disposizione: lead generati direttamente dalle nostre campagne; CRM; strumenti di prospecting; materiali commerciali; case study; affiancamento; formazione continua; supporto del team marketing e tecnico. L’obiettivo è costruire una collaborazione stabile, con possibilità concrete di crescita economica, professionale e di responsabilità. La sede di riferimento è Saronno (VA) , con modalità di lavoro ibrida. Il piano economico prevede: commissioni sulle vendite; bonus; incentivi legati ai risultati; possibilità di crescita del compenso in base alle performance. Benefit formazione professionale; affiancamento commerciale; orario flessibile; lavoro ibrido; strumenti digitali e CRM; possibilità di crescita interna. You understand that a great casual game economy is not just “generous” or “tight”: it paces progression, makes every reward feel earned, gives every purchase a clear purpose, and stays healthy for years. About CoolGames At CoolGames, we’re proud to be a leading international HTML5 game studio, working with some of the world’s biggest ‘Big Tech’ game platforms, such as Netflix, Discord, Facebook and Microsoft Play. We also work with famous games IP such as Battleship, Angry Birds and Monopoly. CoolGames is part of Keesing, the world’s largest Braintainment company. Keesing is a financially strong publisher of engaging sudokus, crosswords and many other puzzles & games with a presence in over 20 countries headquartered in The Netherlands. With the CoolGames HQ in Amsterdam, supported by our global remote teams, we offer market-competitive salaries, the chance to contribute to successful casual games that are played by millions and work directly with some of the biggest brands in the world. We believe in creativity, collaboration and delivering world-class gaming experiences, while giving you the choice to either join our Amsterdam studio or become part of our remote teams. If you want to grow your career in a profitable, internationally recognized company, work closely with world-famous partners and be part of a highly professional international team, CoolGames is the right place for you. About the role As an Economy & Balancing Game Designer at CoolGames, you take ownership of the economies inside our casual games: the sources, sinks, progression, and reward systems that decide how players earn, spend, and advance. You will design systems that are fun, fair, understandable, and commercially effective. And you own the outcome: not just the analysis behind the numbers, but the retention and revenue they produce. You will be part of a multidisciplinary agile team. Together, you will work on new titles, improve existing live games, and help shape the models, tools, and processes that make good economy design scalable across our portfolio. Because our games run on a range of platforms with different monetization models, you know how to make an economy work whether it is driven by in-app purchases, ads, or a subscription platform. On new games you are involved from the very first design sessions, so that the economy, its sinks, and its progression are designed in from the start rather than balanced after the game has been built. On live games you take the economy apart per title, in enough depth to say what a change will do before it ships, and you model and simulate that change rather than shipping it and reading the result afterwards. You are comfortable working both creatively and analytically. You can feel when a progression curve or a reward loop is right, but you also know how to validate that instinct through models, simulations, A/B tests, and player data. About You You are proactive and thrive on taking ownership and responsibility. You care deeply about how players feel when they play, and you know that a healthy economy and a great player experience are the same goal, not a trade-off. You know how to design systems that motivate without manipulating, monetize without frustrating, and reward without devaluing progress. If you are: An experienced Economy, Systems or Balancing Game Designer Ready to work on long-lasting casual titles, and to move between them when needed A strong believer in teamwork Are not afraid of innovation and learning new tools on the go Then you are on the right track to be a great match with Coolgames. Responsibilities Design and balance the economy, progression, and reward systems of our casual games, from the first design sessions of a new title through live operations Own the revenue outcome of the economies you design Build and maintain the economy models, balancing sheets, and simulations for each title, in enough depth to say what a change will do before it ships. Use player data and A/B tests to find friction points, progression bottlenecks, and monetization opportunities, and to show, with data, where balancing proposals from game and level designers will take retention and revenue. Design motivation loops and a cohesive ecosystem of LiveOps events that work together rather than compete for player attention Communicate design rationale, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to the team and the studio, and take ownership of a title’s economy when moving between projects. items.desc: Who we are Software Improvement Group (SIG) helpt organisaties grip te houden op de software waar hun business op draait. Ons platform Sigrid® bestaat uit twee delen. Sigrid Core geeft organisaties continu inzicht in de kwaliteit, security en risico’s van hun volledige softwareportfolio, en borgt kwaliteitsstandaarden tot in de ontwikkelstraat. Sigrid Axis, gelanceerd in oktober 2026, brengt diezelfde standaarden naar AI coding agents: het controleert elke wijziging die een agent maakt in real time en verbetert bestaande code, zodat organisaties agentic engineering kunnen opschalen zonder grip te verliezen op kwaliteit, kosten en risico. Beide zijn gebouwd op ’s werelds grootste benchmark voor softwarekwaliteit, met meer dan 40.000 systemen en ruim 600 miljard regels code, en op ruim 25 jaar ervaring in het enige ISO/IEC 17025-geaccrediteerde lab voor softwarekwaliteit ter wereld. Samen met onze consultants vertalen we die inzichten naar strategisch en praktisch advies, zodat technologie een aanjager van succes is in plaats van een bron van risico. Onze klanten zijn grote (internationale) ondernemingen, financiële instellingen en overheidsorganisaties. Zij vertrouwen op SIG om softwarekwaliteit structureel onderdeel te maken van de manier waarop ze hun IT-landschap besturen. Where you come in Als Senior Delivery Consultant zorg je ervoor dat onze grootste klanten Sigrid succesvol inbedden in hun organisatie. Sigrid is geen tool die je even installeert: het is complexe software voor kwaliteitsmanagement die raakt aan de ontwikkelstraat, de architectuur, de securityprocessen en de besluitvorming van een organisatie. Jij leidt die implementaties van begin tot eind: van kick-off en technische onboarding tot training, rapportage en de borging van softwarekwaliteit in de werkwijze van de klant. Of Sigrid nu als SaaS-oplossing wordt afgenomen of on-premise in de eigen infrastructuur van de klant draait, jij zorgt dat het project slaagt. Dat maakt het werk uitdagend en cutting edge. Je werkt met technologie die vooroploopt, op het snijvlak van softwarekwaliteit en AI, bij organisaties die nu de stap zetten naar softwareontwikkeling met AI coding agents. Wat je bij hen implementeert, bepaalt mede hoe zij die stap veilig en beheerst kunnen maken. Je werkt voor grote corporate organisaties en overheidsinstellingen, vaak met honderden ontwikkelteams en duizenden applicaties. Dat betekent complexe trajecten met veel belanghebbenden: van CIO en CISO tot architecten, IT-beheer, inkoop en ontwikkelteams. Je brengt structuur aan in die complexiteit, houdt planning en scope in de hand, en houdt de vaart erin zonder mensen kwijt te raken. Je vertaalt de inzichten uit Sigrid naar rapportages en adviezen die passen bij je publiek. Een bestuurder wil weten waar de risico’s zitten, een architect wil technische schuld gericht aanpakken en een ontwikkelteam wil het dagelijkse werk verbeteren. Dezelfde data vertelt voor ieder van hen een ander verhaal, en jij weet die vertaalslag te maken. Intern noemen we deze rol Senior Guidance Consultant. Je maakt deel uit van ons Guidance-team: een klein, hands-on team van consultants dat nauw samenwerkt met onze Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, technische consultants en het productteam. Na de implementatie draag je de klant over aan de Customer Success Manager, die de langetermijnrelatie voortzet. Wat ga je doen Je leidt complete implementatietrajecten waarin Sigrid wordt ingebed in grote organisaties, zowel SaaS als on-premise: van projectplan en kick-off tot technische onboarding, training en overdracht. Je bent de projectleider: je bewaakt planning, scope en budget, managet risico’s en afhankelijkheden, en sluit aan op de governance van de klant, zoals stuurgroepen, security- en compliance-eisen en beheerprocessen. Bij on-premise implementaties werk je samen met de infrastructuur- en securityteams van de klant en met onze technische consultants, zodat installatie, configuratie en integratie soepel verlopen. Je begeleidt ontwikkelaars, architecten, managers en bestuurders bij het adopteren van Sigrid en het verankeren ervan in hun processen. Je levert heldere rapportages en presentaties aan zowel management als technische doelgroepen, afgestemd op de doelen van de organisatie. Je helpt klanten bij de inzet van Sigrid Axis, zodat hun AI coding agents werken volgens dezelfde kwaliteitsstandaarden als hun ontwikkelteams. Je adviseert klanten over sturen op softwarekwaliteit, het beheersen van technische schuld en de verantwoorde inzet van AI in softwareontwikkeling. Je managet meerdere trajecten tegelijk, gestructureerd en pragmatisch, inclusief een nauwkeurige projectadministratie in ons CRM. Je ondersteunt salestrajecten met overtuigende productdemo’s en met je inbreng over implementatieaanpak en planning. Je draagt bij aan de doorontwikkeling van onze implementatiemethodiek, onze Academy-content en de ondersteuning van partners die zelf Sigrid-implementaties uitvoeren. What's …

items.desc: Job Description What you'll bring You bring curiosity, a genuine interest in people and workplace topics, and at least 1 year of experience in HR or a related people-focused environment. You have a foundational understanding of HR processes and the employee lifecycle, along with experience working with ticketing or case management systems to support employee inquiries and HR operations. Awareness of how onboarding, employment documentation, and basic labor law requirements fit together is a useful starting point, as is comfort working within structured processes and following established guidelines carefully. Familiarity with HR systems or common productivity tools is helpful, and a willingness to learn the specifics of local regulatory environments is more important than arriving with all the answers. Fluency in Polish and English is required to effectively support employees and stakeholders. What you'll build You'll support the delivery of in-person HR services, helping employees navigate onboarding, policy queries, and day-to-day HR processes with the guidance of more senior colleagues in our office from Warsaw, Poland. Assisting with the documentation and maintenance of local HR processes, supporting knowledge management activities, and helping prepare materials for employee communications and HR initiatives are regular parts of the work at this level. You'll develop your understanding of how global HR programs and policies are localized, building practical knowledge of the country-specific compliance requirements and operational practices that make local HR delivery effective. Where you belong You'll be learning the practice of HR service delivery in a structured, team-based environment with regular guidance from more experienced colleagues. The expectation at this level is that you follow established processes carefully, ask when something is unclear, and approach the local compliance and employee relations aspects of the role with discretion and attention to detail. This isn't a role where independent advisory work is expected from day one: the contribution at entry level is dependable support, careful documentation, and a genuine commitment to getting the basics right. If you're building your HR foundation and want early exposure to country-specific employment practices, in-person employee support, and the operational side of a global people and culture function, this is a genuine starting point. We value the skills you bring and support you to build on them through our learning and development opportunities. These are the skills associated with this role: HR service delivery · employee onboarding · human resource management · employment and labor laws · stakeholder management · business acumen · business presentations · consulting · human resources information system · establishing trust · results orientation · content engineering · process mining & optimization · AI data analytics · context engineering · AI output quality assurance · agentic AI day-to-day practice · AI-Assisted Automation and Prototyping · AI adoption capability Additional Information About SAP With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives. items.desc: Location London or remote within the UK Employment Type Full time Location Type Remote Department Engineering About Griffin Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences. We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more. We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies. Learn more about what we do Our culture We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible. We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life. We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified. Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers. Learn more about our culture. The team Infrastructure sits within the Craft function. We’re a small team of three - two engineers and an engineering manager - who work closely with our CTO and Founder, Allen Rohner. It’s our job to build the foundations that everything else at Griffin runs on: the systems, the tooling, the automation that helps us run a highly resilient and reliable platform and lets other teams ship fast. We're a software engineering team as much as an infrastructure team: we write the code that runs our platform, not just the configuration around it. When we start work, we explore multiple solutions before picking one. We write RFCs, build proof-of-concepts, and run experiments to validate approaches. Once we commit to building something, we care about maintainability more than cleverness, observability more than hoping it works, and scalability over premature optimisation. We take the necessary time to ship quality solutions rather than hitting arbitrary deadlines. Once something goes live, we refactor the rough edges rather than polish what's already working. The opportunity Day to day, you'll built and manage the infrastructure the bank runs on - both in the cloud and on our own hardware in third party data centres. This means running FoundationDB clusters and writing the software and tooling for hitless upgrades, managing Kubernetes, writing infrastructure as code in Pulumi and CDK, running the Bazel build farm, and owning the deployment pipeline from CI to production. Operational resilience is a big part of the job: replica clusters, multi-region failover, and chaos engineering to test how systems handle failures. Security access, CircleCI pipelines, DataDog integration, and cloud spend all fall under infrastructure too. On our roadmap currently is: building out our self-hosted infrastructure to support a hybrid-cloud setup and remove single-vendor reliance, improving how Kubernetes scales, improving the build farm, and building out our PKI infrastructure. We also have plans for a global HTTP routing layer to allow seamless failover between sites. Much of this is software we built ourselves, and you'll shape it from the first design through to production. Our infrastructure as code is written in TypeScript. Where it makes sense, tooling gets written in Clojure. There's some Rust too. What success looks like Infrastructure problems become production problems fast. Success here means thinking ahead - identifying issues with scale, security, or compliance before they affect services. You've eliminated an entire class of incidents by fixing the underlying architectural issue. You've proven the database and compute platform can handle 10x current traffic volumes by working with backend teams to stress-test it. You've cut deploy times in half by rethinking how the pipeline works. You've tested multi-region failover under realistic failure scenarios and it worked. You've shipped well-tested software that turns risky manual operations, like database upgrades, into routine, hitless ones that the whole team maintains with confidence. You've redesigned service discovery to …

items.desc: Founding Engineer, Vertical AI Shipio Location: London or UK remote, with regular days together in London Package: Competitive salary plus meaningful share options from day one Why Shipio How do you price moving a hospital's MRI scanner, a wind farm's gearbox, a lab full of delicate instruments or a high-value sculpture? Twenty-five years ago, getting an instant price for a parcel was hard. Now it barely registers at checkout. Shipio is building the infrastructure that does the same for complex goods, so including the logistics price in the sale of a turbine blade becomes as simple as adding postage to a T-shirt. Today every one of those prices rests on dozens of judgement calls about handling, equipment, packing, routing, customs and timing. A specialist operator with years of experience pieces each quote together in spreadsheets and email, and a complex quote can take days. Shipio handles all of that variety inside one system: a vertical AI that reasons through each job, a deterministic pricing engine that produces the price, and a payments rail that settles the transaction. Pricing appears wherever customers want to buy, and for logistics companies quoting stops being the bottleneck and starts driving growth. It's already in customers' hands. Design partners have been using the product for around six months, and we're backed by Fuel Ventures. Our customers are specialist logistics companies, usually between 20 and 200 people, in a market worth around £1.2 trillion that still runs largely on email and spreadsheets. Shipio earns a fee on the transactions that run through it. Our founder, Hugo, is an engineer by background and designed both the pricing algorithm and the vertical AI. Before Shipio he founded a tech-enabled specialist freight forwarder in fine art, which is where he saw the problem first-hand. You'd be one of the first two engineers, building the core team alongside him, with real ownership from your first week, share options in what you build, and work that goes straight into live quotes for customers. The role You make Shipio's vertical AI sharper with every supplier that joins. It already reasons like a senior specialist operator: it understands why each decision on a job is made and makes those calls itself, including on jobs it has never seen. You own it end to end, from the data it learns from through to its architecture, training, calibration and evaluation, working on some of the hardest data in any industry: large, unreliable and endlessly varied. You take features from idea to release yourself, generating the idea, planning the product, designing it, building it and shipping it, and you're accountable for the value it creates for customers. It's a role for an engineer who wants full ownership of complex delivery and wants to push an agentic way of building further. What you'll do Work with Hugo to learn the domain and turn the product strategy into a roadmap for the vertical AI. Improve how the system models cause and consequence in complex, real-world physical operations: why an operator chose one strategy over another, so it reasons its way to the right answer on unfamiliar jobs. Run the model lifecycle as one continuous process: data curation, anomaly detection, training and calibration, evaluation, generalisation and feedback loops. Own the architecture of the vertical AI and how it works with the deterministic pricing engine. Maintain the tests and evaluation that prove the output is right, because prices and payments depend on it. Shape the agentic pipeline the whole team builds with: new agents, sharper checks and faster loops. What you'll bring Models you have built and shipped on highly variable, messy real-world data. A strong engineering mindset and a good head for numbers. End-to-end ownership of model architecture and calibration, rather than one stage of it. An agentic way of building. You read code closely and understand architecture properly, while much of the day-to-day build runs through AI agents. Product sense: you generate the ideas and plan the product as well as build it. Based in the UK and able to spend regular days in London. Nice to have Specialist logistics experience from the inside; logistics tech, freight or pricing systems; anomaly detection on operational data; working across models from more than one provider; early-stage start-up experience. What we offer Share options: Meaningful share options from day one Working pattern: London office or UK remote, with regular days together in London Influence: A seat at the table, shaping the product, the architecture and how the next engineers are hired Start date: We're happy to work around notice periods for the right person How we hire We keep it short, every step shows you how we work, and we'll tell you where you stand at each one. A 30-minute conversation with our talent partner. It's recorded, so you only tell your story once. A conversation with Hugo, our founder: hear where Shipio is going and …

items.card: Responsabilità principali Progettare e sviluppare modelli di machine learning per l'analisi di dati da sensori (serie temporali, anomaly detection, forecasting di criticità); Esporre i modelli tramite API REST, garantendo qualità, documentazione e manutenibilità; Collaborare con il Python Developer per l'integrazione dei moduli AI nell'architettura complessiva; Nelle fasi successive, sviluppare componenti NLP/Voice
items.desc: Chi siamo intelligo è una start-up innovativa che opera nel campo dell'intelligenza artificiale e del machine learning, con una specializzazione distintiva nell'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale per la lingua italiana. Il cuore della nostra tecnologia è un motore NLP proprietario, sviluppato interamente da noi e basato su un lessico di nostra proprietà, che esegue analisi morfosintattica, lemmatizzazione e classificazione dei testi con un livello di precision pensato specificamente per le complessità dell'italiano. Accanto allo sviluppo del nostro motore linguistico, realizziamo progetti di AI applicata in ambiti diversi, dall'analisi di dati provenienti da sensori, ai sistemi RAG e alle tecnologie vocali. Il ruolo Cerchiamo un AI/ML Engineer (con esperienza) che supporti lo sviluppo dei nostri moduli di intelligenza artificiale, dall'ideazione al deployment in produzione tramite API. La risorsa lavorerà in autonomia su un orizzonte di progetto pluriennale, con la possibilità di crescere insieme al prodotto e al team. Responsabilità principali Progettare e sviluppare modelli di machine learning per l'analisi di dati da sensori (serie temporali, anomaly detection, forecasting di criticità); Esporre i modelli tramite API REST, garantendo qualità, documentazione e manutenibilità; Collaborare con il Python Developer per l'integrazione dei moduli AI nell'architettura complessiva; Nelle fasi successive, sviluppare componenti NLP/Voice con librerie pre-addestrate (Whisper, HuggingFace); Contribuire allo sviluppo di applicazioni RAG; Supportare e migliorare gli algoritmi di classificazione esistenti; Partecipare alla definizione delle scelte tecniche in ambito AI. Requisiti tecnici Solida esperienza in machine learning con Python (scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch o TensorFlow); Esperienza con serie temporali e modelli predittivi (LSTM, Prophet, modelli statistici); Capacità di sviluppare e documentare API REST (FastAPI o equivalenti); Familiarità con Docker e workflow di deployment di modelli; Conoscenza di librerie NLP (HuggingFace Transformers, spaCy) e paradigmi LLM; Esperienza con strumenti MLOps di base (experiment tracking, versioning modelli); 2-3 anni di esperienza in ruoli analoghi. Nice to have Esperienza con pipeline ASR/TTS (Whisper, ElevenLabs o equivalenti); Conoscenza di architetture RAG (LangChain, LlamaIndex); Familiarità con Kubernetes per il deployment in produzione; Esperienza in ambito IoT o industrial data; Conoscenza di strumenti cloud (AWS, GCP o Azure); Laurea in Informatica, Matematica, Ingegneria o discipline affini. Soft skill Autonomia su progetti a lungo termine; Comunicazione chiara con figure non tecniche; Curiosità verso l'evoluzione del settore AI; Orientamento alla qualità del codice e alla riproducibilità degli esperimenti. Cosa offriamo Contratto di lavoro con assunzione diretta in Azienda; Possibilità di lavorare su progetti innovativi nel campo AI e data science; Retribuzione, livello e inquadramento commisurato in base all'esperienza; Benefit e welfare aziendale; Orario: full time; Prestazione di lavoro ibrida; Ambiente dinamico, inclusivo e orientato alla crescita continua.

items.desc: ACERCA DE LYNX En Lynx Financial Crime Tech S.A., somos una empresa de software basado en IA especializada en detectar y predecir patrones de comportamiento. Dirigida por un equipo experto del sector financiero y académico , desarrollamos e implementamos tecnologías de IA de vanguardia y autoaprendizaje. Nuestra plataforma destaca en tecnologías de procesamiento de transacciones de baja latencia y está disponible tanto in situ como en la nube. Desarrollamos tecnología avanzada para la prevención del fraude y la lucha contra el blanqueo de capitales (AML), ayudando a organizaciones globales a tomar decisiones en tiempo real mediante analítica avanzada e inteligencia artificial. POR QUÉ UNIRTE A NUESTRO EQUIPO Ofrecemos un entorno internacional y especializado donde podrás crecer, innovar y desarrollarte con propósito, contribuyendo a un sistema financiero más seguro y transparente. Damos prioridad a la visión , la agilidad y la velocidad para ofrecer experiencias de cliente excepcionales y hemos establecido relaciones duraderas y de confianza con algunas de las principales instituciones financieras, fintechs y empresas comerciales de todo el mundo. LO QUE HARÁS EN ESTE ROL Como AI/ML Engineer tu objetivo será participar en el desarrollo de soluciones de inteligencia artificial y machine learning orientadas a la generación de modelos avanzados para la toma de decisiones y la resolución de problemas de negocio. Estas podrán ser algunas de las actividades clave en tu día a día: Análisis de requerimientos y participación en el diseño de componentes de IA para mejorar funcionalidades existentes en nuestras soluciones, o crear otras nuevas. Desarrollo, entrenamiento y validación de modelos de Machine Learning e Inteligencia Artificial. Análisis exploratorio de datos y selección de variables relevantes para la creación de modelos de Machine Learning. Diseño y configuración de sistemas de agentes de IA. Ajuste fino, especialización y optimización de LLM. Testing, evaluación y mejora continua del rendimiento, robustez y precisión de las soluciones. Diagnosis de incidencias, análisis de resultados y optimización de modelos existentes. Mejoras y adopción de buenas prácticas relacionadas con Data Science, Machine Learning y MLOps. LO QUE BUSCAMOS EN TI Estamos en búsqueda de un/una AI/ML Engineer para unirse a nuestro equipo en Madrid , con los siguientes requisitos y experiencia: Experiencia profesional +5 años desarrollando modelos de Machine Learning y soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial (Obligatorio) Formación académica Doble grado en Ingeniería Informática + Matemáticas, con especialización en inteligencia artificial (máster o experiencia demostrable). Graduados en Ciencia de Datos. Graduados en otras ingenierías, Matemáticas, Estadística, Física o carreras similares, complementados con conocimientos sólidos de programación. Idiomas Nivel de inglés fluido, al menos B2 (Deseable) Habilidades técnicas Obligatorias: Conocimiento de tecnologías de IA Generativa y Agéntica: LLM, RAG, MCP, tools sistemas multiagente Experiencia de desarrollo en algún framework de agentes de IA, como pudiera ser LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK o similares Conocimiento consolidado de técnicas de Machine Learning supervisado y no supervisado Experiencia desarrollando modelos con Python y librerías como Scikit-learn, Pandas y NumPy Experiencia en técnicas y estrategias de desarrollo de software: git, implementación de pipelines de CI/CD (ej. GitHub Actions), desarrollo por ramas. Conocimientos sólidos de estadística aplicada y evaluación de modelos Experiencia trabajando con SQL y tratamiento de datos Experiencia en técnicas de análisis de datos y visualización Conocimientos de librería de Deep Learning como TensorFlow, PyTorch o Keras Deseables: Experiencia en herramientas para el empaquetado y servicio de modelos: API REST, Docker Conocimientos y certificaciones en AWS Conocimiento de técnicas de especialización de modelos generativos: SFT, cuantización, destilación Experiencia o familiaridad con prácticas de MLOps Lynx Tech se enorgullece de ser una organización que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades sin importar edad, género, discapacidad, estado civil, raza, religión u orientación sexual. Estamos comprometidos en ofrecer un proceso de selección inclusivo y accesible para todas las personas. NUESTRA OFERTA Y BENEFICIOS Al unirte a nuestro equipo, disfrutarás de múltiples beneficios, tales como: Cuidamos de tu bienestar por lo que contarás con seguro médico, seguro de vida, y acceso a Wellhub. Impulsamos la flexibilidad con un modelo híbrido y colaborativo. Potenciamos tu crecimiento con formación especializada y oportunidades de carrera en un ecosistema tecnológico global centrado en datos e IA aplicada a fraude y AML. Buscamos hacer tus días laborales más accesibles, por lo que contarás con tickets de restaurant y medidas de apoyo familiar. items.desc: About the job: Are you a seasoned Data Scientist ready to make a significant impact on one of the world's largest eCommerce platforms? Here, we implement projects based on a practical application of artificial intelligence and Data Science (e.g. search engine and recommendations, customer service automation, fraud detection) on a scale unprecedented in Poland. In order to effectively implement ML solutions and automate existing processes, we need the support of inquisitive, experienced and data driven individuals. The ones willing to be up to date on newest SoTA algorithms and advancements in AI, from new deep learning architectures, explainable AI and GenAI but still grounded and aware of statistics and predictive modelling. In Allegro you will work with solutions from prototypes to create stable, high-performance solutions (e.g. support for millions of RPS in the search engine) and combine these services with batch and stream processing analyzing real BigData (also in the public cloud). If you thrive on diverse challenges, continuous development, and multidisciplinary knowledge, this is the place for you! Important things for you: The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost): PLN 14 600 - 20 825 Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results. Our team is based in Warsaw. What You'll Do: Lead impactful projects: From concept to productization, to deliver insights and models solving business problems from different areas. Master diverse techniques: Work with diverse modeling techniques and paradigms, spanning gradient boosting, Bayesian frameworks, causal inference, optimization, deep learning, and Generative AI solutions such as LLMs and Agentic workflows. Handle massive datasets: Process terabytes of data using Google Cloud Platform solutions, working with tabular, natural language, image, and time-series data. Drive model implementation: Take part in implementing both off-line and on-line models. Collaborate across teams: Partner with business stakeholders, analytics, and data engineering teams. Grow together: Brainstorm creative solutions with colleagues, contribute to peer mentorship, and cultivate open knowledge sharing. We are looking for people with: Proven production ML & SQL experience: Track record in data analysis with SQL and designing, deploying, and maintaining end-to-end machine learning models in production environments. A business-first problem-solving drive : Natural inclination to deconstruct ambiguous business challenges and translate them into well-defined ML problems. Exceptional communication skills: Ability to bridge the gap with business units—from framing analytical questions to presenting findings in a clear, intuitive, and compelling manner. Strong coding & software engineering foundations: Proficiency in Python and familiarity with standard development workflows and tooling. Solid mathematical grounding: Deep understanding of statistical concepts and core machine learning algorithms. Enthusiasm for modern AI tooling: Practical and theoretical grasp of Generative AI and Agentic AI workflows (prompting, validation), paired with a genuine drive to leverage AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Copilot) to automate and accelerate everyday work. A quantitative background: A degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Economics (or a related discipline), or equivalent hands-on experience in Data Science and ML roles. Language proficiency: Fluency in Polish and English (minimum B2 level). What's in it for you: Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work. Long term discretionary incentive plan based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units). Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results. Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms). A 16" or 14" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories. A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers). English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job. A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings. An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal. Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy. And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here. #goodtobehere means that: You will join a team you can count on - …

items.desc: 5 Degrés Toulouse est une agence de conseil à taille humaine spécialisée dans le produit digital. Basés à Toulouse depuis trois ans, nous accompagnons nos clients de divers secteurs d'activités (santé, aéronautique, automobile, grande distribution) à la fois en BtoB et BtoC. Organisés en cinq practices, nous couvrons intégralement la chaîne de création d'un produit digital : Product Management, Product Design, Product Development, Product Quality et Product Data. Notre ambition : devenir un acteur incontournable du Produit en Occitanie et au-delà, en aidant nos clients à transformer leurs organisations et à gagner en maturité produit 🚀. Pour ce faire, nous recherchons un.e AI Engineer pour rejoindre notre practice Product Data et intervenir chez l'un de nos clients. Descriptif du poste : Nous recrutons un.e AI Engineer (5 ans d’expérience minimum) pour accompagner l’un de nos clients toulousains du secteur public sur des projets data à fort enjeu technique. En tant que AI Engineer, vous savez : Concevoir et développer des solutions d’IA générative et des applications basées sur des LLM, du POC à la mise en production. Participer aux choix d’architecture et contribuer aux décisions techniques structurantes. Industrialiser les modèles et pipelines data en garantissant qualité, robustesse et maintenabilité (MLOps apprécié). Collaborer avec le Product Owner et des équipes pluridisciplinaires pour traduire les besoins métier en solutions techniques pertinentes. Évoluer dans des environnements cloud AWS ou Azure, en tirant parti des services IA/ML disponibles. Documenter rigoureusement les travaux et communiquer clairement sur l’avancement et les enjeux techniques. Opérer dans des contextes critiques, en maintenant un haut niveau d’exigence sur la qualité, la sécurité et la performance. Profil recherché Vous avez 5 ans d'expérience dans la Data et notamment en industrialisation de modèle IA Maîtrise des méthodes MLOps et LLMOps (LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama, KServe, Kubeflow, MLflow, Jupyter, Onyxia ) Vous maîtrisez les bases vectorielles (Qdrant, pgvector ) Bonne connaissance des environnements d'infrastructures (Kubernetes, Rancher RKE2, GPU NVIDIA, S3, Prometheus, Grafana ) La maîtrise de au moins un framework de développement est demandée (Python, Haystack, LangChain, LangGraph, Transformers, TensorFlow, PyTorch,Keras) Basé.e à Toulouse ou sur la région Savoir-être Forte capacité d'analyse et de compréhension des enjeux métier, au-delà de la technique pure. Autonome dans votre travail tout en étant un vrai partenaire pour les équipes. Rigoureux sur la documentation, la qualité du code et le reporting. Anglais professionnel requis pour évoluer dans un contexte international. Ce que nous offrons Des locaux en plein cœur de Toulouse 🧱 (avec briques roses, café, thé et bonne humeur illimités). Une organisation en Practices favorisant la montée en compétence, le partage d'expérience et l'innovation. Un système qui récompense votre implication avec la possibilité d'évoluer sur différents rôles en interne (Practice Leader, Squad Leader, rédaction d'articles…). Un management de proximité et un suivi de carrière personnalisé grâce à notre accompagnement tripartite (RH, Business Manager, Practice Leader) aux formats variés : déjeuners, points formels, cafés… Des formations individualisées et adaptées à chaque parcours ainsi que l'accès en illimité à la plateforme Udemy (e-learning). Un environnement de travail dynamique et accueillant (soirées annuelles, afterworks, meet-ups, activités sportives) mais aussi responsable et engagé (actions en faveur de la RSE). Des avantages salariaux : tickets restaurants, mutuelle d'entreprise/prévoyance, accès au Comité d'Entreprise, forfait mobilité verte, accès à la plateforme solidaire Solikend et tarifs préférentiels Wellpass. Déroulement des entretiens Un entretien avec un(e) RH pour en apprendre plus sur 5 Degrés (1h). Un entretien avec un(e) Business Manager pour en apprendre plus sur les projets clients (45 min). Un entretien avec le Practice Leader ou un membre de la practice pour parler métier et se projeter dans la Practice (1h). Un entretien avec le Directeur Associé pour un échange global autour de 5 Degrés et de ses valeurs (30 min).

items.desc: Data Scientist – Generative AI / Chatbot Utrecht, Netherlands | Hybrid | 36 hours per week | Contract until May 2027 Help shape the future of conversational AI at one of the Netherlands’ leading financial institutions. We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist specialising in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs) and chatbot optimisation for an exciting assignment within a major Dutch financial institution. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of applied AI, improving how intelligent assistants understand context, retrieve information, reason and deliver accurate, relevant responses. Rather than developing foundation models from scratch, you will focus on making existing AI systems perform better — understanding why they behave as they do, identifying weaknesses and developing practical, measurable improvements. The Role Working alongside Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Product Managers and business stakeholders, you will evaluate and optimise GenAI-powered chatbot solutions. Your work will cover retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), contextual data, prompt optimisation, agent reasoning, tool calling and performance evaluation. Key responsibilities include: Analyse chatbot responses to identify weaknesses, inconsistencies and improvement opportunities. Investigate context gaps and improve how AI agents access and use information. Optimise RAG pipelines, retrieval strategies and contextual data structures. Develop evaluation frameworks to measure chatbot accuracy, relevance, reliability and effectiveness. Work closely with engineering teams to troubleshoot data ingestion, API integrations and information flows. Assess emerging GenAI capabilities and identify opportunities for practical implementation. Collaborate with product teams and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical improvements. Support continuous experimentation and improvements to AI assistant performance. What We're Looking For We are particularly interested in professionals with a strong analytical mindset who enjoy understanding and improving the behaviour of AI-powered applications. Essential experience: Medior to senior-level experience in Data Science, Applied AI or a closely related field. Practical experience working with LLM-based applications and Generative AI. Strong understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Knowledge of prompt engineering, context windows, grounding and retrieval techniques. Experience evaluating LLM outputs and identifying causes of poor performance. Familiarity with APIs, structured and unstructured data, and data integration

Backend engineers who moved into AI at a lab, an applied-AI company or a Big Tech applied team and have shipped an LLM or agent system to real users, measured it in production and changed it when the numbers said so. You will be tasked with building one production AI system at a time for a Fortune 500 client inside a $1.8B applied-AI company (ex-Palantir founders, $202M raised) opening its London office: scope it with the client’s senior stakeholders, build it on the company’s internal LLM application platform, prove it with evals, run it, and feed what you learn back into the platform. Own the system: one production AI system live at the London client in six months, with evals, observability and a client lead who trusts it. Own the measure: an eval set built from real traffic, a published accuracy and cost baseline, and every change gated on it. Own the room: scope the next two builds directly with the client’s senior stakeholders, and ship reusable components back into the platform. THE ROLE: Production AI systems: agents, tool use, retrieval, prompting and the full-stack product around them; from prototype to a system a Fortune 500 runs Evaluation infrastructure: eval sets built from production traffic, segmentation by case type, LLM-as-judge with independent scoring, confidence intervals, regression gates before any prompt, model or routing change ships Autonomous loops: the shift from deterministic workflows to agentic systems that self-improve from transcripts, tickets and NPS; versioning of every component so configurations can be compared Enterprise estates: integration with client CRMs, EMRs, telco back ends and data platforms; security reviews, SOC 2, data residency; cost and latency ceilings Platform contribution: reusable infrastructure, tools and workflows returned to the internal LLM application platform for use across deployments Voice and real-time: streaming pipelines, speech models, model fallback and routing under rate limits Client ownership: 60% building, 40% with the client; scoping with C-level stakeholders, pushing back when the brief is wrong, reframing the problem AI-native workflow: coding agents (Claude Code) used daily, with judgement about what they produce Languages and tools: Python first; TypeScript for product surfaces; AWS, GCP or Azure; evals, observability and CI/CD as standard Delivery: one 3-month build at a time, two or three concurrent across a long client relationship; works with AI strategists, architects, a Founding Data Scientist and the Head of Engineering Seniority: Senior / Staff (IC) Industry: Applied AI, Enterprise Software, AI Transformation Employment Type: Full-time, permanent Skills: Python, LLM systems, AI agents, Tool use, RAG and retrieval, Evaluation frameworks, LLM-as-judge, Observability, Prompt engineering, System architecture, Enterprise integration, Streaming and voice, Claude Code, AWS/GCP/Azure, Client-facing delivery

Das erwartet Dich Deine Benefits: Moderne Büros in Toplage in München und Frankfurt Flexibles Hybrid Working mit der Möglichkeit Deine Arbeitszeiten individuell auf Deine Bedürfnisse anzupassen Unsere Devoteam Academy bietet Dir ein großes Angebot an zertifizierten Trainings und Sprachkursen Internationale Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für Deinen Karriereboost bei Devoteam Get-Together Partys und Teamevents für den regelmäßigen Austausch und Spaß mit Deinen Kollleg:innen Mitarbeiter:innen-Prämien beim Werben von neuen Mitarbeiter:innen Moderne IT-Ausstattung - Wähle aus einer Vielzahl von Möglichkeiten das für Dich passende Produkt Corporate Benefits mit großer Auswahl an zahlreichen Angeboten für nahezu jeden Bereich Stellenbeschreibung Darauf richtest du deinen Fokus: End-to-End KI-Entwicklung: Du entwirfst, baust und überführst LLM-Anwendungen, RAG-Systeme und Agenten (z. B. mit Amazon Bedrock und SageMaker) vom Prototyp in den produktiven Betrieb. KI-Integration & Architektur: Du bettest die KI-Komponenten passgenau in die Systemlandschaft der Kunden ein und klärst Aspekte wie Datenzugriff, Anbindung und den späteren Betrieb. MLOps & Pipeline-Aufbau: Du entwickelst automatisierte Deployments, Modellversionierung, Rollback-Strategien und überwachst kontinuierlich Latenz, Kosten sowie Modellqualität. Beratung & Use-Case-Evaluierung: Du bewertest KI-Vorhaben gemeinsam mit IT und Fachbereichen und berätst ehrlich zur technischen und wirtschaftlichen Machbarkeit. KI-Compliance & Qualitätssicherung: Du machst die Modell-Qualität messbar und sorgst für Nachvollziehbarkeit, die aktuellen Richtlinien (wie EU AI Act und ISO 42001) standhält. Teamwork & Wissenstransfer: Du arbeitest eng im Team sowie mit den Kunden zusammen und teilst dein Wissen aktiv in Code Reviews und internen Sessions. Qualifikationen Das bringst Du mit: Praxiserfahrung: 1 bis 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung. Entscheidend ist, dass du bereits KI-Lösungen gebaut hast, die über ein reines Notebook hinausgingen und produktiv von anderen genutzt wurden. Tech-Stack: Du programmierst sicher in Python und bist in mindestens einem relevanten Framework (z. B. PyTorch, Hugging Face oder LangChain) wirklich zu Hause. Cloud-Kenntnisse: Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit AWS, idealerweise speziell mit Amazon Bedrock oder SageMaker. Sprachen: Deutsch auf mindestens C1-Niveau für die Kundenprojekte sowie gutes Englisch für die Dokumentation und den internationalen Austausch. Wünschenswert: Erfahrung im Fine-Tuning oder dem Betrieb eigener KI-Modelle. Kenntnisse im Data Engineering sowie im Umgang mit Containern und CI/CD. Ein fachlicher Schwerpunkt in Bereichen wie Computer Vision, NLP oder Zeitreihenanalyse. Praktische Erfahrung in regulierten Branchen mit strengen Vorgaben zur Nachvollziehbarkeit. AWS-Zertifizierungen im AI/ML-Umfeld. Beiträge in der Tech-Community durch Open Source, Publikationen oder Vorträge. Zusätzliche Informationen Melde Dich bei unserem Recruiting Team! Concevoir et optimiser les prompts (few-shot prompting, prompting structuré, stratégies de raisonnement...). Développer une bibliothèque de composants TypeScript réutilisables qui alimentera le SDK IA de l'entreprise. Accompagner les équipes produit et développement dans la conception et la livraison de cas d'usage IA en production. Participer à la diffusion des bonnes pratiques afin de rendre progressivement les équipes autonomes sur les sujets IA. 🧠 Le profil que nous recherchons 🧠 Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans le développement de systèmes basés sur les LLM et avez déjà participé à leur mise en production. Une capacité à collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires (Produit, Développement, Architecture, Data...). Une expérience avec Claude, Anthropic ou AWS Bedrock constitue un véritable atout. items.desc: Why we’re opening this position Claims handling has been the biggest pain point in insurance for decades. For insurers, the direct and indirect cost runs to 800B every year. For customers, it's the #1 driver of dissatisfaction. Insurers and brokers alike all agree AI will solve this, but they can't scale it. Nor are the generic AI workflow vendors any match for the messy reality of claims handling. As Warren Buffett put it himself: "insurance always looks easier than it is". Ellis was founded by insurtech veterans who have built and scaled fully automated AI claims handling. We're now building the leading vertical AI solution for it - designed from the ground up to integrate with systems no API can touch, and to reach human-grade accuracy in weeks instead of years . Doing this requires building one of the most sophisticated back-office automation products anywhere, where AI autonomy meets the complex reality of insurance claims. It requires redefining what AI engineering can actually do. Ellis is supported by top tier investors and successful business angels such as the founders of french unicorn Qonto and belgian unicorn Aikido. The position itself As a Founding AI Engineer, you own the thing our entire business is built on: a product that does in weeks what the rest of the industry needs quarters - or years - to deliver. Most companies in our space are still fighting to hit human-grade accuracy and reliability at all. We've cracked that. Your job is to make it repeatable, scalable, and fast to deploy - turning a hard technical edge into a durable business advantage. On the one hand, this means building the engine that powers every deployment: Shipping new features to our core AI engine - the models, pipelines, and logic that turn raw client processes into working solutions. Designing and building the agent s that do the heavy lifting: extracting data, making decisions, taking action, and catching their own mistakes. Owning the data layer - ingestion, storage, schema design, and the databases everything else reads and writes to. Building the infrastructure an agentic system needs to run reliably in production: orchestration, monitoring, evals, and the tooling to debug when something goes wrong. Every step of the way, you're: Working closely with the business team to translate what clients need into concrete product requirements. In the trenches, working side by side with the founders. Using AI to speed up your own process - We expect you to harness that power to speed up delivery. But on the other hand - and more importantly - you're the one making the calls that a senior/staff engineer would make at any other company, on day one: Architecture : you're not implementing someone else's design - you're deciding how the system is structured, what gets built vs. bought, and what the stack looks like a year from now. Security : as owner of the data layer and infra, you're responsible for how client data is handled, stored, and protected - there's no separate security team to hand this off to. Infrastructure & scale : the production, monitoring, and deployment decisions you make now are the difference between a system that scales 10x and one that falls over at 2x. Shaping the company vision: to your left and to your right, the business and delivery teams will rely on your technical judgment to set their roadmaps. Who we’re looking for: If you're excited by now, it's already a good sign. When it comes to your competencies: Deep technical fluency and genuine engineering craft - you don't just ship code, you understand why it works. This should be evidenced by a master's degree or above in a technical field (CS, Mathematics, or related), or equivalent hands-on experience. Experience building complex platforms - systems with real architectural depth, not just CRUD apps or thin wrappers around APIs, including experience building LLM-powered systems based on agent frameworks (LangGraph, ADK, or similar). Strong software engineering fundamentals, with deep proficiency in Python and solid grasp of API design (REST/gRPC), Git, and CI/CD. Experience with cloud infrastructure and production systems - deploying, monitoring, and debugging services at scale (GCP, Docker, and Terraform are all pluses). Bonus points if you've had exposure to the financial services industry, fast-paced start-ups, or if you've founded your own business before. When it comes to your approach to the job: A strong sense of ownership , work ethic, and a low-ego mindset: at Ellis, the best idea always wins, not the loudest voice. Excitement for open-ended problems without predetermined solutions. You've got all the support you need, but you're the one who makes the magic happen. Comfortable owning ambiguity: fast-moving priorities, evolving requirements, and problems with no textbook answer. You take your job seriously but not yourself - what's the point of all this if we're not having fun? What we offer in exchange Beyond working on one of the most …

items.desc: Suntem la începutul unei inițiative de AI Analytics într-unul dintre cele mai mari grupuri farmaceutice din România și construim capabilități AI care vor fi folosite pe date reale, la scară enterprise, pentru decizii reale de business. Vei avea ocazia să contribui pe întregul traseu, de la problemă la producție: date → AI → evaluare → API-uri → deployment → monitorizare → impact , folosind și extinzând arhitectura și componentele deja existente, cu suport și review tehnic senior. Ce vei construi: AI Assistants & Natural Language Analytics Soluții care permit utilizatorilor să pună întrebări despre vânzări, profit, stocuri și indicatori operaționali și să primească răspunsuri bazate pe datele companiei. RAG & Enterprise AI Pipeline-uri de retrieval, vector search, grounding și mecanisme prin care răspunsurile AI sunt ancorate în surse verificabile. AI Agents & Automation Workflow-uri AI care pot utiliza tool-uri, accesa sisteme interne și automatiza procese care astăzi necesită intervenție manuală. Data Integration, Reconciliation & Automation Fluxuri pentru integrarea, reconcilierea și validarea datelor din surse multiple, precum și automatizarea proceselor care susțin rapoartele și aplicațiile AI. Predictive & Data Analytics Vei contribui, cu suport și review tehnic senior, la dezvoltarea unor soluții de forecasting, detectarea anomaliilor, optimizarea stocurilor și alte probleme cu impact direct asupra businessului. AI Evaluation & Reliability Nu ne interesează doar dacă „răspunde”. Ne interesează cât de corect răspunde . Vei construi test sets, guardrails, evaluări automate și umane, validări cu sursa de adevăr și mecanisme de monitorizare. Production AI Engineering Vei transforma prototipurile în servicii robuste, scalabile și monitorizabile, cu atenție la latență, cost, securitate, observability și data quality . Tech stack Python · SQL · REST APIs · OpenAI / Azure OpenAI · RAG · Vector Databases · ETL/ELT · Relational Databases · Git În funcție de proiect, vei lucra și cu Azure/AWS/GCP, Docker, BI platforms, ML, agentic workflows și document AI/OCR . Ce căutăm: Căutăm un AI Engineer cu experiență reală de software engineering , nu doar experiență de prototyping. Dacă ești confortabil cu: Python și SQL; API-uri și integrarea serviciilor AI; date reale, inconsistente și volume mari; integrarea, reconcilierea și validarea datelor provenite din surse multiple; RAG, embeddings și vector search; testing, evaluation și monitoring; debugging și optimizarea aplicațiilor; transformarea unei probleme de business într-o soluție tehnică. 3+ ani experiență în Software Engineering, Data Engineering, BI sau AI reprezintă baza de la care pornim. Nu este obligatoriu să fii expert în toate tehnologiile de mai sus. Ne interesează mai mult profunzimea tehnică, capacitatea de a învăța și ce ai construit efectiv . Este binevenit sa fi lucrat in Claude Code / Codex. De ce merită? Pentru că nu vei intra într-un proiect în care primești o componentă bine definită și atât. Vei intra într-o echipă care construiește o nouă capabilitate AI de la început . Vei avea acces la: volume mari de date operaționale și comerciale; probleme reale de business; infrastructură și componente AI deja existente; suport și review tehnic senior; libertatea de a propune soluții și îmbunătățiri tehnice, în cadrul arhitecturii și componentelor existente; contact direct cu echipele BI, IT și business; posibilitatea de a vedea soluțiile pe care le construiești ajungând efectiv în producție. Succesul nu îl măsurăm în numărul de modele sau linii de cod. Îl măsurăm în cât de mult timp economisim, cât de bune devin analizele și cât de mult se schimbă modul în care oamenii iau decizii. Dacă te atrage ideea de a construi AI systems, nu doar AI demos, hai să vorbim!

Presente in 14 paesi europei con oltre 8.500 dipendenti, abbiamo aperto, da sei anni, la prima sede italiana a Milano e, vista la continua crescita, stiamo rafforzando e ampliando il nostro team con persone che condividano gli stessi valori della nostra società: AMBIZIONE, SORRISO, DINAMISMO, VOGLIA DI METTERSI IN GIOCO, il tutto in una realtà in continua evoluzione, nella quale le relazioni umane sono sempre al primo posto. IL TUO RUOLO Stiamo cercando un/una AI Software Engineer per un’importante azienda partner, leader internazionale nella produzione di sistemi HVAC, che sta costruendo e sviluppando un nuovo dipartimento dedicato all’ Artificial Intelligence . Entrerai quindi in un contesto in forte evoluzione, nel quale avrai la possibilità di contribuire attivamente alla definizione e allo sviluppo di nuove soluzioni AI applicate a esigenze concrete di business. Cerchiamo una persona con una forte predisposizione verso il mondo AI e Generative AI , curiosa, intraprendente e capace di muoversi con autonomia nell’esplorazione di nuove tecnologie e approcci. Nel ruolo di AI Software Engineer lavorerai su soluzioni basate su Large Language Models (LLM), Generative AI e Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) , contribuendo sia alla sperimentazione di nuovi use case sia alla loro trasformazione in applicazioni concrete, affidabili e integrate nell’ecosistema tecnologico aziendale. Opererai a stretto contatto con figure Data, IT e con le diverse funzioni di business, con l’opportunità di proporre idee, individuare nuove opportunità di applicazione dell’AI e contribuire alle scelte tecnologiche del nuovo dipartimento. Sviluppare applicazioni basate su architetture Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) . Lavorare con embeddings, semantic search e vector database per la realizzazione di sistemi AI evoluti. Individuare e proporre in autonomia nuovi use case, approcci e soluzioni , contribuendo attivamente alla crescita delle competenze AI interne. Mantenersi costantemente aggiornato sull’evoluzione di LLM, Generative AI e relativi strumenti e framework , valutandone concretamente le possibili applicazioni in azienda. Conoscenza delle architetture RAG , delle tecniche di embeddings, semantic search e vector database. items.desc: Vill du arbeta i teknikens absoluta framkant och skapa AI-lösningar som gör verklig skillnad? Som AI Engineer hos oss på Länsförsäkringar får du vara med och utveckla robusta, skalbara och användarvänliga AI-system som stöttar både våra kunder och medarbetare. Hos oss blir du en del av ett innovativt team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och teknisk nyfikenhet står i centrum. Inom avdelningen Data & AI skapar vi nya möjligheter till proaktiva kundmöten och sömlösa helhetslösningar. Här kan du växa, utvecklas och vara med och bygga framtiden, på riktigt. Om jobbet Som AI Engineer med fokus på generativ AI blir du en nyckelperson i vårt tvärfunktionella spjutspetsteam inom Data & AI. Vi bygger lösningar från ax till limpa och arbetar med hela livscykeln – från idé och arkitektur till utveckling, driftsättning och vidareutveckling. En av våra mest centrala plattformar är vår interna GPT-lösning, som används av över 6000 medarbetare för att effektivisera arbetsflöden, beslutsfattande och kunskapsdelning. Du kommer framför allt att arbeta inom tre områden: Generativ AI och språkmodeller Utveckla lösningar baserade på språkmodeller, RAG och agentteknik. Du arbetar bland annat med prompt engineering, tool calling och agentramverk och gör tekniska avvägningar kring kvalitet, kostnad, prestanda och säkerhet. Data och backend Bygga robusta backend- och datalösningar som gör AI-applikationerna skalbara och användbara. Det innefattar bland annat API, datapipelines, databaser och integrationer mot andra system. Operationalisering Säkerställa att våra AI-lösningar fungerar stabilt och säkert i produktion. Du arbetar med deployment, CI/CD, observability, monitorering, prestanda och åtkomsthantering samt krav på säkerhet och dataskydd. Vår teknikstack Språk: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript Databaser: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis Frontend: React.js, Tailwind, DaisyUI API Gateway: Nginx Plattform: Azure Container Apps – planeras för Kubernetes Backend: FastAPI, Celery Lokal utvecklingsmiljö: Docker Compose, WSL, VS Code med GitHub Copilot CI/CD: Azure DevOps IaC: Bicep Teknikstacken utvecklas kontinuerligt och vi förväntar oss inte att du kan allt. Det viktiga är en stark teknisk grund och förmågan att snabbt sätta dig in i nya tekniker. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har: flera års erfarenhet av mjukvaru- och backendutveckling, gärna med Python praktisk erfarenhet av generativ AI och LLM-baserade lösningar, exempelvis RAG eller agentlösningar erfarenhet av att designa tekniska lösningar och fatta arkitekturella beslut erfarenhet av molnplattformar, containerisering och CI/CD god förståelse för API, databaser och distribuerade system erfarenhet av att bygga och driftsätta lösningar i produktion förståelse för säkerhet, skalbarhet och observability förmåga att självständigt driva tekniska initiativ från problem till färdig lösning. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av: vector search, embeddings och vektordatabaser agentramverk och avancerade LLM-arkitekturer Kubernetes och IaC, exempelvis Bicep MLOps/LLMOps AI-säkerhet och guardrails asynkron programmering, exempelvis Celery att coacha andra utvecklare eller etablera tekniska arbetssätt Även frontendkunskaper är meriterande, men inget krav. Som person är du nyfiken, självgående och trygg i din tekniska kompetens. Du trivs med komplexa problem där lösningen inte alltid är given och kan göra kvalificerade tekniska avvägningar. Som senior ingenjör tar du ansvar för helheten, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och kan kommunicera tekniska frågeställningar med både tekniska och icke-tekniska målgrupper. Om oss Vi står inför en omfattande utveckling inom data och AI – ett initiativ som kommer att påverka både vår organisation och vår bransch under lång tid framöver. Just nu bygger vi ett AI center of excellence, där vi tar fram gemensamma plattformar och riktlinjer för hela Länsförsäkringsgruppen, driver på användningen av nya AI-lösningar och säkerställer återanvändbarhet. Genom detta center stärker vi både lokal innovation och gemensamt lärande, samtidigt som vi ökar kunskap och kompetens i hela organisationen. Som AI-arkitekt tillhör du vår avdelning Data & AI, men får också breda kontaktytor över hela Länsförsäkringar. Vi är ett av Sveriges ledande företag inom bank, försäkring och fondliv, och vi satsar stort på digitalisering och innovation. Här får du möjlighet att växa och utvecklas tillsammans med engagerade kollegor, samtidigt som du bidrar till att stärka hela vår affär. Experiencia en soluciones de Generative AI, RAG, copilotos o agentes inteligentes. Dominio de Python y librerías de datos/IA como Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain o similares. Shape the architecture: Influence technical decisions across application design, workflow orchestration, APIs, data structures, security and technology selection.
