items.desc: Job ID: 5556 We are seeking a technically driven and motivated AI & Data Engineer Trainee to join our AI and Data Innovation team. This role is central to building and evolving our internal data platform, with a focus on data engineering tooling, pipeline automation and platform enablement. The trainee will be hands-on from day one, contributing to the infrastructure that powers both our data and AI capabilities across the organization. At Nordea, we see that the world is changing fast – and we want to be one step ahead of the curve. That's why we're deeply committed to providing the financial solutions of tomorrow to our customers. We're creating an agile environment where we experiment and grow together - and we need your ideas and personal background. With us, you'll be in good company with a chance to make your mark on something bigger. Nordea Asset Management (NAM) is the asset management arm of the Nordea Group, the leading financial services group in the Nordics with the vision of being a leading European Asset Manager. We want to do this by delivering returns with responsibility. The group has more than 30,000 employees. NAM has around 900 employees and manages more than EUR 325 billion of assets for institutional, wholesale, and retail clients across the Nordic region and the globe. About this opportunity: You will join our AI and Data Innovation team based in Oeiras, embedded in a cross-functional environment where engineering and innovation meet. Your primary focus will be on building and maintaining the data platform tooling that underpins our data and AI initiatives. You will contribute to driving platform adoption across the organization and act as a technical bridge between the data platform and our AI Lab. This is a hands-on role — expect to write code, build pipelines, and ship real solutions. The role is based in Oeiras (Quinta da Fonte). It’s expected you to work 100% on-site. Internship duration: 12 months. Salary offer: 1.400 € gross/monthly + meal allowance. Key responsibilities: Design, build and maintain data platform tooling and infrastructure, leveraging technologies such as Snowflake, dbt, dlt and Airflow. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support reliable and automated data workflows. Contribute to infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and containerisation with Docker. Support the adoption and enablement of the data platform across business and technical teams, producing documentation and reusable components. Act as a technical bridge between the data platform and the AI Lab, ensuring data infrastructure is ready to support AI and LLM-driven use cases. Collaborate with engineers and data practitioners to identify improvements and new capabilities within the platform. Your profile Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. To succeed in this role, we believe that you: Are eager to learn and get things done — you enjoy building things and are not afraid to get your hands dirty. Have a foundational understanding of data engineering concepts and curiosity about how modern data platforms work. Can write Python code and are comfortable picking up new libraries and tools as needed. Have had some exposure to workflow orchestration concepts — familiarity with Airflow or similar tools is a plus, not a requirement. Have a basic awareness of CI/CD practices and what good software delivery looks like. Are curious about AI and LLM tooling (RAG, agentic workflows, etc.) — no hands-on experience needed, just genuine interest. The following soft skills: Curious and self-driven with strong interest in data science and AI technologies. Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment. Efficient and delivery oriented. Persistent and determined. Innovative and like to sick new ways to solve issues. Your experience and background: Fluent in English. (Other European language are considered an asset). Master in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Maths or other numerate subject. Familiarity with one or more of the following is a plus: Snowflake, dbt, dlt, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes. Prior experience with data pipelines or platform engineering projects — academic or professional — will be valued. If this sounds like you, get in touch! Next steps If this opportunity is the challenge you are seeking, please send us your cover letter and CV in English latest on 31/10/2026. At Nordea, we recruit from the widest possible pool and hire the best person for the job. Because diversity makes us stronger. And once you are on board, you will find that we offer equal opportunities to everyone. #NAM #NAM-Portugal

items.desc: xHeron is building the Service-as-Software company for short-term rental operators. We take responsibility for guest communication, team coordination and issue resolution, so customers can hand over the work without handing over their business. Today, we deliver that service through people, software and AI. We’re turning the expertise behind it into autonomous systems that understand situations, take action and follow through. Not another tool to supervise. A service that gets the job done. We’re looking for an AI Engineer to build the agentic capabilities at the heart of xHeron. You’ll help shape how our agents reason, act and learn, and build a company where AI doesn’t just support the work, but increasingly delivers it. Tasks We are looking for an AI Harness Engineer to build the software layer that turns language models into dependable operational systems. You will work on orchestration, context assembly, tool execution, state, permissions, evaluations, observability, failure recovery, and human handoffs. The goal is not merely to generate a good response. What You’ll Own Agent harness architecture: Build the control layer around models: task decomposition, state management, model and tool selection, execution loops, checkpoints, retries, stopping conditions, and human handoffs. Decision and execution behavior: Design how agents interpret situations, choose actions, manage uncertainty, and complete bounded operational tasks—not only how they generate text. Context and memory: Determine what an agent needs to know at each step. Build context assembly, retrieval, memory, evidence selection, and knowledge-maintenance strategies while managing relevance, latency, and cost. Tools and real-world effects: Connect agents to APIs and operational systems through explicit tool contracts, permissions, validation, idempotency, and confirmation that the intended effect actually occurred. Evaluation and regression testing: Build representative evaluation suites and automated tests for decision quality, tool use, task completion, safety, escalation behavior, and recurring failure patterns. Observability and failure analysis: Make agent behavior inspectable through structured traces, state, outcomes, and error classification. Diagnose failures across models, prompts, context, tools, and surrounding software. Continuous improvement: Use evaluations, production traces, operator feedback, and controlled experiments to improve prompts, context, tools, model choices, and agent architecture. Production ownership: Ship and operate production Python software alongside our CTO and engineering team. Work closely with systems engineering on integrations, authorization, durable state, recovery, and safe execution. Requirements What Makes You a Great Fit You are a strong software engineer who can design, build, test, and operate reliable production systems in Python. You have built a substantial LLM-powered, automation, workflow, or decision system: not only notebooks, chat interfaces, prompt experiments, or a basic retrieval pipeline. You understand the engineering layer around a model: orchestration, state, context, tools, structured outputs, permissions, retries, fallbacks, observability, and evaluations. You can connect intelligence to real work: selecting relevant evidence, making a bounded decision, invoking tools or APIs, and verifying that the intended result occurred. You design for partial failure and uncertainty. You think deliberately about when an agent should act, retry, wait, stop, ask for help, or escalate. You evaluate behavior systematically. You use representative cases, traces, outcome checks, comparisons, and regression tests rather than treating a plausible response as proof of success. You have shipped software that people or operational processes depend on and have worked through debugging, timeouts, inconsistent data, changing APIs, and production incidents. You can investigate ambiguous problems independently, define a useful system boundary, explain trade-offs clearly, and turn decisions into working software. You care about simplicity and control. You know when a deterministic workflow is better than an agent and when additional autonomy is justified by evidence. You bring useful expertise and an independent perspective. Strong adjacent experience in workflow engines, developer tooling, distributed systems, automation platforms, or integration-heavy backend software can be highly relevant when paired with credible LLM-system understanding. Around 2+ years of professional software-engineering experience is a useful guide, not a hard requirement. What matters is the technical depth of what you built, the decisions and production outcomes you owned, and your ability to learn unfamiliar systems. You May Not Be a Great Fit If Your LLM experience is mainly prompt engineering, chatbots, basic RAG, or connecting a model API to a user interface. items.desc: We are looking for a Software Developer to become the first engineer at RedTrack hired specifically for a spec-driven, AI-first development model. This is a new approach for us. Rather than focusing primarily on writing code, the role puts strong emphasis on turning requirements into precise technical specifications, identifying ambiguity and hidden assumptions before implementation, and defining how the solution should behave under real-world conditions. As the first developer joining RedTrack in this model , you will also help us learn, refine, and establish how spec-driven, AI-assisted engineering should work in practice. Tasks Turn product and technical requirements into clear, implementation-ready specifications. Identify ambiguity, hidden assumptions, constraints, failure scenarios, and technical risks before implementation begins. Use AI agents to implement solutions by providing specifications, context, constraints, and acceptance criteria, and guiding implementation iterations. Review and verify AI-generated and unfamiliar code for correctness, architectural fit, performance, scalability, and maintainability. Design reliable backend components and data access patterns for production-scale systems. Validate solutions through testing, benchmarking, profiling, runtime metrics, and other relevant evidence. Investigate failures and continuously improve engineering guardrails, tooling, specifications, and AI-agent instructions. Requirements Strong backend software engineering experience. Strong ability to translate ambiguous requirements into precise technical specifications. Solid understanding of backend architecture, databases, concurrency, performance, scalability, and failure handling. Ability to critically review and reason about code, including code you did not write yourself. Strong testing, debugging, and problem-solving skills. Experience with CI/CD, observability, and production engineering practices. Hands-on experience with AI coding tools or a strong interest in AI-assisted development. High level of ownership and ability to work independently in a new and evolving engineering model. Russian proficiency at a native or C2 level is mandatory, as Russian is the primary language of day-to-day Engineering team communication. English sufficient for technical communication and documentation. EU residence. Benefits Competitive compensation and stock option program Fully remote setup with flexible working hours (REMOTE FROM EU) 21 paid vacation days plus 10 paid personal holidays Paid sick leave and maternity/paternity leave A collaborative team culture built on ownership, clarity, and trust Opportunities for professional growth, experimentation, and real impact Team offsites and conference trips - we love connecting offline too If you’re excited about building software in a new way and want to help shape how spec-driven, AI-first engineering works in practice, we’d love to hear from you. Join RedTrack and help us build what comes next!

items.desc: If you think product management means writing tickets for engineers to execute, this role isn't for you. If you think AI is a feature you bolt onto a roadmap after the fact, this role isn't for you either. - We believe AI doesn't create talent. It amplifies it. Used poorly, it generates an exponential amount of technical debt. Used well, it becomes a team of eager junior engineers capable of executing at machine speed. The quality of the outcome depends on how well you organize them, guide them, and review their work. - We're building Lonio, an AI-native backoffice outsourcing service for finance & HR. Most companies see AI as a product opportunity. We do too. But we believe the bigger opportunity lies in execution. The companies that master AI-native engineering and product development will build faster, learn faster, and out-execute competitors still operating with traditional processes. That's the company we're building. This is not an AI product company. This is an AI-native service company. Want to know how to build it? Watch this. This is not a classical start-up, we are a spin-off out of BLP Digital, the fastest-growing AI scale-up in Europe. Tasks You should be excited by Turning complex Swiss HR and payroll compliance logic into specs engineers can build from without gaps. Owning the product roadmap for our compliance AI automation workflows Working daily with engineering to scope work, sequence what ships next, and catch edge cases before they become technical debt. Joining customer conversations when it sharpens the roadmap. This isn't a GTM role, but you'll sit in on discovery and demo calls often enough to know our customers' problems firsthand. You'll work directly with Nick (CEO) to translate deep domain knowledge into a product Lauriane (CTO) can execute against. Requirements We're less interested in your credentials than your trajectory. We don't have a predefined model of what a great product person looks like. What matters to us is that you: Understand what AI agents can and can't reliably do today Write specs precise enough that an engineer builds from them without guessing at edge cases ;) Have strong product fundamentals: prioritization, and turning ambiguity into a plan. Learn fast in a regulated domain you likely don't know yet. Take ownership, including the parts of the job nobody has defined yet. Care about outcomes more than titles. Are comfortable working shoulder to shoulder with engineers daily. This role doesn't stop at strategy and hand off execution. Bonus: German fluency and comfort with Swiss B2B customers (CFOs, Treuhand firms, and payroll specialists), since you'll visit them from time to time. Benefits We're flexible on titles, backgrounds, and compensation structures. If you're unsure whether you qualify, we'd still encourage you to apply. A final note from the CTO. Nick knows this domain cold. Swiss payroll compliance, the Treuhand ecosystem, what customers actually need. All of that is in his head. The hard part is turning that knowledge into specs I can build from without guessing at the edge cases. That gap is exactly what this role closes. If you like being the translation layer between deep domain expertise and a small, fast-moving engineering team, you'll enjoy this.

items.desc: Almawave Labs Srl è una società italiana attiva in ambito Data & Artificial Intelligence, la quale dispone di tecnologie proprietarie, soluzioni e servizi che concretizzano il potenziale dell’AI e dei dati nell’evoluzione digitale di aziende e pubbliche amministrazioni. Può contare su oltre 450 clienti nazionali ed internazionali, in settori quali Government, Finance, Energy & Utilities, Turismo, Healthcare, operando direttamente e tramite partner. Posizione: Entrerai a far parte dei Laboratori di Ricerca e Sviluppo Cognitive & AI di Almawave , all’interno della Direzione Technology & Innovation, in un ambiente fortemente stimolante ed eterogeneo, costantemente impegnato nello sviluppo di prodotti innovativi di AI. Nel ruolo di AI Software Engineer sarai responsabile dell'intero ciclo di vita di sviluppo, dalla formalizzazione di concetti astratti alla messa in produzione di sistemi complessi. Sfruttando Coding Agents di ultima generazione, agirai come un vero e proprio "moltiplicatore tecnologico", garantendo l'eccellenza architetturale e l'integrità del sistema in ambienti Cloud-Native. Avrai le seguenti responsabilità: Architectural Orchestration: Progettazione E2E di sistemi distribuiti, definendo i pattern di comunicazione e i modelli di dati necessari per soluzioni scalabili. AI Agent Steering: Guida e supervisione di agenti autonomi per l'implementazione del codice (Java, Python, TypeScript), assicurando il rispetto di standard qualitativi elevati. Requirement Engineering: Traduzione di ipotesi di ricerca avanzata in specifiche tecniche dettagliate, testabili e pronte per l'industrializzazione. Security & Validation: Esecuzione di audit critici sul codice generato dall'IA per garantire i massimi livelli di sicurezza, performance e manutenibilità a lungo termine. Requisiti: Consolidata esperienza nello sviluppo software con un approccio end-to-end e responsabilità completa sulla soluzione. Forte attitudine al problem solving, autonomia operativa e spiccata mentalità analitica. Competenza tecnica di alto livello che permetta di supervisionare o intervenire manualmente su qualsiasi layer dello stack tecnologico. Sviluppo GenAI: Comprovata esperienza nella comprensione, progettazione e sviluppo di sistemi di Generative AI (ad esempio architetture RAG, chatbot avanzati, integrazione LLM, ecc.). Conoscenza approfondita dei linguaggi di programmazione Java, Python e Modern JS/TS. Padronanza di architetture a microservizi, event-driven e metodologie Domain-Driven Design. Padronanza di architetture cloud native: K8s, Docker, Helm e progettazione di pipeline CI/CD automatizzate. Esperienza nell'uso di Agentic Workflows e strumenti di AI Tooling per lo sviluppo software assistito. Altre informazioni: Sede di lavoro: Roma, con possibilità di lavoro in modalità ibrida Orario di lavoro: full time, dal lunedì al venerdì Contratto: tempo indeterminato, CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria Profilo: AI Software Engineer equiparato a AI-ML Software Engineer Inquadramento: livello B2 Retribuzione: RAL compresa da 32.263,92€ a 40.000€, commisurata all'esperienza e alle competenze maturate Benefit aziendali: buono pasto del valore di €8,26 per ogni giornata lavorata. Perché scegliere il Gruppo Almaviva? In AlmavivA troverai un modello organizzativo in cui la persona e le sue competenze sono al centro. Ci contraddistingue un ambiente di lavoro fondato su fiducia, collaborazione, autonomia e responsabilità, orientato all'efficienza e al raggiungimento dei risultati. Il nostro impegno verso le persone si traduce nella promozione di un contesto inclusivo e attento alle pari opportunità, supportato dalla conformità agli standard ISO 30415 per la Diversity & Inclusion, UNI/PdR 125 per la parità di genere e SA8000 per la responsabilità sociale. La tua opportunità è ora! Se l’innovazione è la tua passione, se esplorare il mondo dell’Information e Communication Technologies è un tuo desiderio, se la tua aspirazione è lavorare in un team con forte volontà di condivisione e focalizzato su obiettivi sempre più sfidanti, incontriamoci ora! Ai sensi della normativa vigente, la presente offerta di lavoro è rivolta a tutte le persone candidate, senza distinzione di genere, in conformità alla normativa applicabile. Le persone interessate possono inviare il proprio CV aggiornato e dettagliato, corredato dell'autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali ai sensi del D.Lgs. 196/2003 e dell'art. 13 del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679 (GDPR).

items.title: Data Scientist
items.card: You will work closely with software engineers, SREs, product managers, platform teams and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, build predictive models, evaluate AI solutions and take products from concept through to production. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with commercial awareness and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and measurable business value.
items.desc: ABOUT US: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity. LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG. OUR PEOPLE: People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential. We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers. ROLE SUMMARY: We are seeking an experienced Data Scientist to help develop and deploy enterprise-scale AI and machine learning solutions that improve operational efficiency, service resilience and customer outcomes. You will work closely with software engineers, SREs, product managers, platform teams and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, build predictive models, evaluate AI solutions and take products from concept through to production. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with commercial awareness and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and measurable business value. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: AI & Machine Learning Solutions Design, build and deploy machine learning models to solve operational and business challenges. Develop predictive analytics capabilities focused on incident prevention, service health, operational risk and customer experience. Support the development of Generative AI applications leveraging LLMs, retrieval systems and agentic workflows. Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend practical applications across the organisation. Data Science & Analytics Perform advanced statistical analysis and modelling across large-scale operational and engineering datasets. Develop feature engineering, experimentation and model evaluation frameworks. Create insights and recommendations that drive decision making for senior stakeholders. Build and maintain reproducible data science workflows and pipelines. Product Delivery Partner with engineering and product teams to transition solutions from proof-of-concept into production. Define success metrics and measurement frameworks for AI products. Support model monitoring, governance and continuous improvement activities. Contribute to AI product roadmaps and prioritisation discussions. Collaboration & Innovation Work with subject matter experts from Engineering, Operations, Service Management and Product organisations. items.desc: APOLLO3® est un code de transport neutronique déterministe multi-échelle, multi-filière, de nouvelle génération utilisé pour réaliser des simulations avancées 3D de cœurs des réacteurs nucléaires actuels ou du futur (REP, EPR, SMR, RNR, MSR, Propulsion Navale, Réacteurs Expérimentaux, …). Il permet de réaliser des calculs à l’échelle de l’assemblage (dit réseau) et à l’échelle du cœur (en exploitant des bibliothèques multi-paramétrées assemblages). APOLLO3 est développé au sein du SERMA/LLPR par une équipe dynamique et motivée 🚀 comportant une vingtaine d’ingénieur.e.s-chercheurs.ses et doctorant.e.s. Les langages de programmation utilisés sont le C++ et le Python. Cette mission a lieu dans le contexte de l’industrialisation du code APOLLO3® en vue de son utilisation pour la simulation du parc nucléaire existant et futur jusqu'aux études du prototypes pour la fermeture du cyle. Vous intègrerez l’équipe de développement de ce code au SERMA/LLPR et interagirez avec les utilisateurs du code. 🤝 Vous participez au développement du code APOLLO3 ® pour consolider les versions actuelles et préparer l'indiustrialisation des prochaines versions permettant de mieux répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs du code au CEA et chez les partenaires industriels (EDF, Framatome, ORANO) pour la modélisation du parc nucléaire existant et futur y compris les prototypes envisagés pour la fermeture du cycle (réacteurs RNR de 4ème génération). Vous contribuez au développement et à la vérification de certains composants du code et leurs interfaces utilisateur en vue de la construction de schémas de calculs plus précis et performants Les points valorisants sont la contribution à un nouveau logiciel ainsi que la participation à des présentations, comme des conférences ou des publications dans des revues scientifiques 📚. Profil du candidat PARLONS DE VOUS ! Vous êtes un.e ingénieur.e de niveau Bac+5 , issu.e d’une école d’ingénieurs en informatique scientifique et/ou en physique des réacteurs. Expérience professionnelle de 3 à 5 ans dans le développement de composants logiciels et programmation orientée objet. Vous possédez de solides compétences dans les outils C++, Python, Linux, OpenMP et MPI. Le poste requiert une bonne aptitude au travail en équipe 🤝, de l'autonomie ainsi que des bonnes compétences en informatique 💻 scientifique, en particulier une bonne connaissance des méthodologies, outils et langages de développement logiciel en programmation parallèle : Linux, programmation orientée objet C++/Python, OpenMP, MPI, etc. Des connaissances en physique des réacteurs seront nécessaires. items.desc: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. The Customer Experience Engineering Team builds the internal and external technologies that scale Snowflake’s global support and sales organizations. We empower our technical experts by providing the advanced tools they need to resolve complex issues and drive customer success. Our team specializes in software engineering, data-driven decisions, ML, and LLM-based solutions . We build production-grade systems to automate manual processes and augment the capabilities of our technical staff. Our current focus includes: LLMs: Developing and deploying LLM and agent-based architectures for streamlining troubleshooting Scalable Evaluations: Implementing large-scale evaluations to ensure the quality and reliability of our internal and external tools Process Automation: Designing intelligent workflows that eliminate bottlenecks and allow our experts to focus on the most technical aspects of the Snowflake platform Incident discovery: using embeddings, LLMs, clustering, and agents to detect potential widespread issues more quickly Now, the team is growing, and we are looking for a Software Engineer to join us. In this role, you will work closely with the state of the art LLM models, fine-tune them, develop agents, apply various clusterings, summarizations, embeddings, and so on. Even though we usually use high-level libraries (e.g., scikit or Snowflake’s Cortex) rather than perform matrix multiplications ourselves, some prior ML experience is definitely useful. As a Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development of ML and LLM-based solutions, propose new ideas, and keep improving the existing models. You will: Develop and refine ML models that are critical to Snowflake’s business Design metrics and experiments to validate your insights Help to implement projects that span our stack, including Java and Python services hosted in Snowflake and Kubernetes Collaborate with a cross-functional team, including product management and design Deliver features requiring close coordination with several partner teams Be a participant in defining the product vision and team planning Pinpoint problems, instrument relevant components as needed, and ultimately implement solutions Our ideal Software Engineer will have: B.S. or M.S. degree in CS, or equivalent discipline 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience 1+ years of working ML experience Interest in the State of the Art LLM-based solutions Great communication skills, both verbal and written and an interest in working with a diverse set of peers and external developers Genuine enjoyment of the art of building great software, and a love of learning new things Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? items.desc: Requisition Number: 19461 Contract Type: Permanent Location(s): Betzdorf, LU (Senior) Engineer, DSP Systems Engineering, meoSphere Programme Description meoSphere is SES’s next-generation Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) satellite constellation, designed to deliver secure connectivity services to government agencies, enterprises, and commercial customers. It will also provide high-speed broadband internet to eliminate global connectivity dead zones. To accelerate development timelines, reduce costs, and ensure quality, SES is internalizing a critical segment of the satellite supply chain: the final integration of partner satellite platforms with SES’s software-defined payloads, all within a cutting-edge manufacturing and test facility. Role Description As a DSP System Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, analysis, modelling and validation of multiple signal processing blocks implemented in ASIC and FPGA technology in in our satellite payloads. Embedded in an agile software/firmware and hardware development team, you will ensure optimized algorithms and accurate modelling are implemented along the signal processing chain. In your first six months, you will model and propose algorithms for state-of-the-art Digital Beamforming ASICs and 5G NTN waveform digital processing blocks. Within two years, your algorithms and modelled systems will have flown in space, demonstrating cutting-edge digital signal processing technologies. Develop DUC/DDC blocks using multi-rate DSP techniques and ensure optimized implementation for low-power fixed point hardware (FPGA/ASIC). Create system-level MATLAB/Python/C++ models representing end-to-end RF and baseband processing, including beamforming algorithms, channelization, quantization effects, and channel impairments. Translate high-level system requirements into implementable DSP blocks for ASIC design, collaborating with RTL and physical design teams to define fixed-point accuracy, throughput, and latency targets. Evaluate fixed-point vs. floating-point architecture trade-offs for ASIC efficiency and precision across multiple channels. Develop hardware/software co-design models to partition algorithms between firmware, digital logic, and analog front end. Prototype and validate system performance via FPGA or simulation platforms; assist with pre-silicon and post-silicon validation workflows. Optimize DSP algorithms for low power and high throughput suitable for space or high-reliability communication ASICs. Support beamforming calibration strategies, including array calibration, gain/phase mismatch correction, and RF impairment compensation. Generate technical reports, design documentation, and test plans to validate DSP architecture performance. Required Qualifications COMPETENCIES, QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, or related field with 5 years of relevant DSP algorithm design experience. Proven background in digital beamforming, MIMO signal processing, and calibration algorithms for phased arrays. Strong experience with system-level modelling in MATLAB/Simulink and Python, including model-based design. Proficiency in DSP algorithm simulation in C/C++ or SystemC, especially fixed-point modelling for ASIC implementation. Deep understanding of OFDM, modulation schemes, adaptive filtering, channel estimation, and RF impairment modelling. Familiarity with ASIC flow integration of DSP algorithms — RTL handoff, verification, and bit-accurate modelling. Experience in lab-based silicon bring-up, calibration, and verification of beamforming performance. Understanding of FPGA prototyping, hardware emulation, and verification flows used for DSP system validation. Nice to have Strong grasp of digital communications theory and antenna array processing. Capability to bridge system, algorithm, and implementation levels in custom beamforming ASICs. Excellent communication skills for cross-functional coordination (DSP, RTL, RF, firmware, system integration). Analytical mindset for trade-off evaluations: precision vs. power, latency vs. accuracy, hardware cost vs. performance. Working Experience of radiation and thermal constraints relevant to satellite ASIC system design. items.desc:
Salary Range: 
€69,000.00 - €128,100.00 
 Job Description Summary 
Dir. DDIT ISC Functional Security Architect role provides enterprise-level architectural leadership and specialist security expertise for Identity and Access Management (IAM). The role partners closely with Functional Security Architects, Enterprise Architects, Platform Architects, business stakeholders and IAM capability teams to ensure that solutions implement secure, scalable and reusable identity patterns aligned with enterprise security standards.
It also contributes to the strategic development and maturity of enterprise IAM capabilities, including Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), authentication, authorization, federation, Privileged Access Management (PAM), machine/workload identities and emerging identity requirements associated with AI and autonomous agents.
A key focus of the role is developing IAM architecture for AI-enabled applications and Agentic AI, including identities for AI agents, delegated authority, agent-to-agent and agent-to-application access, human-to-agent delegation, workload identities, least-privilege authorization, JIT access, credential and secret management, lifecycle governance, auditability and accountability. 
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Review, approve and govern IAM technology variants and architecture patterns against agreed enterprise security and architecture standards. 
 Drive IAM technology and architecture standards in close collaboration with Enterprise Architecture, Security Architecture, IAM capability teams and Architecture Governance. 
 Act as the IAM subject-matter expert for Functional Security Architects, providing IAM-specific architecture guidance, design reviews, reusable patterns and risk advice for projects and programmes. 
 Support development and evolution of enterprise IAM capabilities and their associated target architectures, roadmaps and reference architectures. 
 Advance the maturity of IAM architecture and governance processes, ensuring IAM architectural decisions and standards remain relevant as business, security and technology requirements evolve. 
 Drive relevant architecture KPIs and metrics to assess adoption, architectural compliance, exceptions and maturity of IAM capabilities. 
 Identify opportunities for consolidation, standardisation and retirement of overlapping IAM technologies and patterns. Proactively communicate IAM risks and architectural considerations to business, security and technology stakeholders. 
 Participate in evaluation of new IAM and security technologies, providing a holistic assessment of security, architecture, interoperability, lifecycle and operational considerations. 
 Engage early in solution and demand governance to ensure IAM requirements are identified before detailed solution design and implementation. 
 Promote reuse of approved enterprise IAM capabilities and patterns rather than creation of application-specific identity solutions. Build and maintain an IAM architecture Community of Practice, facilitating knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. 
 Essential Requirement: 
 Strong experience in Identity and Access Management architecture, security architecture or enterprise security architecture. 
 Deep understanding of identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorisation, federation, access governance and privileged access. 
 Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML 2.0, SCIM and modern identity-federation patterns. 
 Experience architecting enterprise SSO, MFA and passwordless authentication solutions. 
 Strong understanding of RBAC, ABAC, policy-based access control, least privilege and separation of duties. 
 Experience with identity governance and administration and privileged access management. Understanding of cloud-native identity, workload identity, APIs, service accounts and other non-human identities. 
 Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and identity-centric security.Ability to translate security requirements into practical, reusable architecture patterns. 
 Strong stakeholder-management skills and ability to provide specialist IAM guidance to Solution Security Architects, engineering teams and enterprise architects. 
 Desirable Requirement: 
 Understanding of security architecture for Generative AI and AI-enabled applications. 
 Knowledge of IAM challenges associated with autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents. Understanding of agent identity, workload identity, delegated authorisation and machine-to-machine trust.

items.desc: About our client Our client is a London-headquartered company that designs, builds and operates infrastructure for an emerging area of transport. It has grown into an international business, with projects across Europe, the Middle East, Asia and North America, and it is now putting AI agents at the heart of how the business runs. About the role AIQoach is recruiting on behalf of our client for an Applied AI Engineer. This is a central role reporting directly to the CTO. You will build production-ready AI agents with LangGraph that support teams across the whole business. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building agents, not a data science or machine learning research role. It is hybrid from London, and fully remote working will be considered for exceptional candidates. What you will do Design, build and ship production-ready AI agents in Python with LangGraph Work with teams across the business to find where agents add the most value, and shape what each agent should do Connect agents to the data, systems and APIs they need through well-defined tools Build evaluations and tests so agent outputs can be trusted, with human review where it matters Deploy, monitor and improve agents in production, with attention to reliability, security and cost Work directly with the CTO to set the standards for how the company builds with AI Essential Three to six years of commercial Python engineering experience, including shipping and maintaining production software Hands-on experience building AI agents with LangGraph Hands-on experience building or integrating tools with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) A public GitHub portfolio of AI agents you have built, which we will review One of these certifications: Claude Certified Developer: Foundations (Anthropic) or AWS Certified Generative AI Developer, Professional Nice to have Experience deploying and running agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Experience building internal tools or automation for business teams How to apply Apply through Indeed with your CV and a link to your GitHub portfolio. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to walk us through one of their agents. There is no cost to apply. Pay: From £80,000.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in London

items.desc: Make a difference in the financial life of millions of people: At Erste Digital you are co-creating the digital future, in which better financial health is possible. #believeinyourself We are part of Erste Group – the largest banking group in Central and Eastern Europe with more than 2,500 branches and over 45,000 employees. Our more than 2,000 IT experts and enthusiasts are the bank's Digital Muscle. Within our Daily Banking Experience department, you contribute to digital products that customers rely on for their everyday banking. Depending on the product and team, we work with technologies such as Java, .NET, React/LUNA, Angular, Camunda, Kafka and cloud technologies, while increasingly using AI and agentic engineering as part of everyday product development. What to do: As a Digital Product Engineer, you take technical ownership of digital banking products throughout their lifecycle – from understanding a need to running the solution in production. You combine software engineering (around 3 years of Java/React experience), technical analysis and product-level coordination. Instead of working within traditional role boundaries, you connect business needs with technology, turn requirements into solutions, contribute hands-on to their implementation and help ensure that the product works reliably in production. You work closely with Product Owners, Business, UX, Architecture and Engineering and become a key technical contact for your product. Understand & Shape Understand customer and business needs and translate them into clear technical requirements and solutions . Analyze processes, APIs, data flows, system interactions and dependencies. Turn requirements into features, stories and technical specifications that teams can implement. Challenge requirements and solution approaches to find simple, sustainable and technically sound solutions . Build & Engineer Design and develop software hands-on across frontend, backend or full-stack, depending on your expertise and the needs of the product. Take responsibility for engineering quality through automated testing, CI/CD, observability and secure coding. Contribute to architectural evolution, modernization and the reduction of technical debt. Leverage AI-assisted and agentic engineering across analysis, specification, development and testing. Connect & Coordinate Be a technical anchor for your product and connect Business, Product and Engineering. Coordinate technical dependencies and align with other products, teams and stakeholders. Drive technical topics, decisions and follow-ups instead of simply handing them over. Support product and delivery planning with technical expertise. Coordinate technical aspects of releases and product changes and maintain transparency around relevant product knowledge. Run & Improve Take ownership beyond go-live and contribute to the stable and reliable operation of your product. Support incident resolution and root-cause analysis and turn learnings into sustainable improvements. Continuously improve security, resilience, performance and maintainability. Identify opportunities to simplify the product, automate work and improve engineering efficiency. What makes this role different A Digital Product Engineer does not stop where another role traditionally starts. You can understand a requirement, analyze its technical implications, shape a solution, implement it and help run it in production. We do not expect everyone to be equally strong in every discipline from day one. You might come from Software Engineering or Technical Analysis and bring deep expertise in one area. What matters is the ambition to broaden your capabilities and develop into a T-shaped Digital Product Engineer with end-to-end product ownership. Why you will like us: Young, talented and motivated team which is respected & valued across the whole group. Possibility to benefit and learn from our international, talented and passionate community at Erste. Interest groups and clubs: Take part in discussions and get involved in projects. Numerous interest groups invite you to engage with a topic. Health Center: The Erste Campus operates a fully equipped health center that offers all employees a high standard of medical services during working hours. Employee benefits: Benefit from special conditions for financial services and insurances, supermarkets, clothing stores and many more. Employee Referral Program: Become a talent scout for career opportunities in IT. We are rewarding every successful referral for Erste Digital with 3000€. A competitive and performance-related salary dependent on your professional and personal qualifications is granted - the minimum wage for this position in accordance with the respective collective agreement is EUR 64.554, - gross per year. items.desc: Curious about how technology and AI can improve the way we work with data? Join Saxo and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now. Join us in building a new data capability in Markets About the job At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets. We are a newly established team and still very much in the build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve. As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets. This is an opportunity to join early, learn quickly and have a real influence on how we work. What you will do Technology will be an important part of your role. Together with colleagues in the team, you will help strengthen our technical foundation. This could mean building AI supported workflows, contributing to Azure projects, automating manual processes or exploring new tools and platforms. As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will work across our four domain areas together with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams. Your focus will be on improving how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled. Depending on the domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market and price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data. You will learn about Markets from experienced colleagues and gradually take ownership of your own areas and tasks. You will be part of one Markets Data Office, working with shared standards, tooling and governance practices. You will sit close to the business and help turn business needs into practical technical solutions. We want you to experiment, test ideas and find better ways of working. Your responsibilities will include Exploring and testing new technology, including AI, and helping the team choose and use the right tools Setting up reporting and dashboards for data owners and data stewards, for example in Power BI Automating manual parts of our governance work, including data quality checks, documentation and metadata Building and maintaining AI supported workflows and data workflows together with colleagues and technology teams, for example in Azure or Databricks Testing and validating automated workflows, including AI outputs, before they are used in day to day governance work Helping define and maintain data definitions, rules, thresholds and supporting documentation Monitoring data quality outputs, following up on remediation and raising issues when they are not being resolved Working with data owners, stewards and stakeholders across business and technology, and helping translate between business needs and technical solutions Contributing to the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office A key part of the role is making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain. This helps create transparency and consistency across the organisation. Who you are You have recently completed a master’s degree or have around one to two years of professional experience. A relevant degree in areas such as information systems, data science, computer science, business analytics or a similar field An interest in data and how it supports business processes, combined with an interest in connecting business and technology Experience with SQL, Python or similar tools from your studies, a student job or personal projects Hands on experience using AI or other technology to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working Good communication skills in English and the ability to write clear and structured documentation You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters most is that you are curious, willing to learn and motivated to build your technical skills. An advantage if you have Familiarity with Azure, Databricks, Power BI, Great Expectations, data catalogue tools such as OpenMetadata or similar technologies Experience building with AI beyond everyday use, for example agents, LiteLLM based workflows, prompt engineering or automation using tools such as Power Automate Experience from banking or financial services, for example through a student job Knowledge of, or an interest in, Markets functions such as trading, risk, investment products or operations, including how a trade moves from front to back Exposure to data governance or data quality work such as data profiling, data controls or data lineage, ideally within financial services We are looking for someone who: Takes ownership. items.card: About the Role You'll own the AI agents that run Gorgias's GTM workflows, taking them from manual process to reviewed agent. The goal is to optimize as much GTM work as possible without losing quality. A strong fit ships working agents quickly, debugs a broken workflow in Cargo, HubSpot, or another GTM tool without waiting for help, and cares whether the business actually uses what gets built. What You'll Do
items.desc: We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop. At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift. Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before. To win, we focus relentlessly on: Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand. Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout. Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing. The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood. Join us to make Conversational Commerce real. About the Team GTM Engineers builds the AI product layer for Gorgias's go-to-market teams: AI agents, internal cockpits, and the automations underneath them, all running on one shared context layer (Cortex). We work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partnerships. We build and maintain the agents, the business teams own the outputs, and humans review exceptions. About the Role You'll own the AI agents that run Gorgias's GTM workflows, taking them from manual process to reviewed agent. The goal is to optimize as much GTM work as possible without losing quality. A strong fit ships working agents quickly, debugs a broken workflow in Cargo, HubSpot, or another GTM tool without waiting for help, and cares whether the business actually uses what gets built. What You'll Do Navigate between our context layer, our app and service repositories, MCPs, and our automation tools to build and improve end-to-end GTM workflows. Build custom agents and reusable agent skills on our agent stack (Cortex) , and on custom builds when the stack can't do the job. Build and maintain agents for lead and account work: outbound reply handling, audience and call-list building, enrichment, event follow-up, and referral routing. Map the Sales and Marketing workflow backlog, decide Agent vs. Automation vs. Manual for each workflow, and deliver the chosen option with a reviewable output for the business owner. Improve live agents: tune prompts and skills, read conversation and performance data, fix regressions, and document edge cases. Debug broken workflows fast across Cargo, HubSpot, Customer.io, and other GTM tools, and fix the root cause. Connect agents to our systems through APIs and workflows (n8n, Clay, custom code), with credentials managed centrally rather than on personal accounts. Help Sales (BDRs and AEs) and CS adopt agents: learn their daily work, design flows with them, and train them to supervise outputs. Work with the other GTM Engineers (cockpit, data, systems) so agents run on clean CRM data. Who You Are You need to be passionate about AI. Claude Code, Conductor, or another AI coding harness is where you spend most of your time building—not something you only experiment with occasionally. 3+ years in a technical GTM, RevOps, or growth engineering role, with production automations you can point to. Hands-on with LLM applications: prompt design, tool or function calling, and reviewing output quality. Experience building custom agents is a plus. Familiarity with a modern data stack (BigQuery, dbt, Segment, Airbyte, Hightouch) is a plus. Solid SQL and Python or JavaScript, and comfortable working with REST APIs. Working knowledge on outbound or engagement tool (Cargo, Dust, Apollo, Lemlist, Instantly, Customer.io, or similar). Experience with n8n, Clay, or a similar automation tool is a plus. Good business judgment: you know when an agent should draft and when it should act. Ownership: you take a workflow from idea to live agent and flag breakages early. Fluent English. French is a plus for the Paris team. Perks & Benefits 5-week vacation plus 2 weeks RTT (We follow each country's appropriate PTO Laws) Paid sick leave Paid parental leave (16 weeks) MacBook Pro Personal credit card to buy lunches (we use Swile) We provide private health insurance (we use GAN) Get up to €700 to set up your workstation at home (working from home should feel breezy) Get up to €2000 of learning material and wellness support per year! This includes €1500 for learning material (such as books, courses, and individual coaching sessions) directly linked to your job scope, as well as a €500 wellness budget. Take advantage of these resources to grow in your role and prioritize your personal development and wellness. Every quarter, we organize an online company-wide summit to discuss where we’re going and strengthen social bonds. Once per year we organize offsite team retreats and company retreats! Translate business questions into well-defined
items.desc: Ready for a job where you look forward to Monday? Let's Go! Expert Data Scientist - Customer & Decision Intelligence (m/f/d) 1 For us „Let’s Go!“ is not just a slogan, it is an attitude. We love technology and we want to excite. We have fun and want to inspire. Our customers and our teams. That’s why we are looking for people who share this spirit. People who are passionate about creating the shopping experience of the future together with 50.000 colleagues across Europe. Your tasks Deliver measurable commercial and operational impact through operations intelligence, customer intelligence, and personalization. Contribute to the development of the Decision Science roadmap for operations intelligence and customer intelligence by applying scientifically sound statistical modeling, mathematical optimization, and machine learning. Translate business questions into well-defined mathematical and statistical problems, critically assess the available data, and select and justify the most appropriate modeling approach. Operations Intelligence: develop models for demand forecasting, inventory and replenishment optimization, assortment and allocation, supply chain and logistics optimization, workforce and store capacity planning, and pricing and markdown optimization. Customer Intelligence: develop recommendation systems and models for personalization, customer segmentation, customer lifetime value, churn, propensity, marketing effectiveness, and uplift. Choose methods based on assumptions, interpretability, robustness, computational efficiency, and empirical performance: use a simple linear model when sufficient, and advanced ML or AI only when it adds demonstrable value. Build predictive, prescriptive, and optimization models (e.g., linear/integer programming, simulation, causal inference, experimentation) to improve business performance and operational efficiency. Collaborate with Data Engineers and ML Engineers to build scalable data pipelines, feature stores, and production-ready ML solutions using Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Vertex AI). Evaluate, monitor, and continuously improve model performance through baseline comparisons and the validation of assumptions, uncertainty estimates, and generalization, while ensuring business value. Your profile Master’s degree (MSc) or PhD from an established, internationally recognized university in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, Data Science, Operations Research, or a closely related quantitative field. Approximately 4–5 years of relevant professional experience after graduation in data science, statistical modeling, applied mathematics, or machine learning. A strong foundation in probability theory, statistical inference, linear algebra, numerical methods, and mathematical optimization, with the ability to explain the assumptions and limitations of different models. Proven ability to compare classical statistical models, optimization methods, and machine learning approaches and justify the choice using scientific reasoning and evidence. Practical experience in developing and validating predictive and optimization models; experience in operations intelligence (forecasting, inventory, supply chain, and pricing) or customer intelligence (recommendation systems, personalization, and CRM analytics) is an advantage. Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, digital products, media, retail technology, or customer-facing systems is an advantage. Excellent programming skills in Python and SQL, with experience processing large-scale structured and unstructured datasets. Experience with scientific Python libraries (e.g., NumPy, SciPy, statsmodels, and scikit-learn) and ML frameworks such as XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Vertex AI, and modern MLOps practices, is an advantage. Understanding of modern AI methods, including deep learning and Generative AI / LLMs, and the judgment to identify when these approaches are—or are not—appropriate. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business needs into sound mathematical and statistical solutions. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to both technical and business audiences. A collaborative mindset, scientific curiosity, intellectual independence, and a pragmatic approach to delivering measurable business impact. What's in it for you? International teams & exciting tasks 30 days vacation & company pension plan Employees discount & Fitness Collaborations Training & Education Open corporate culture & Teamwork Mobile work (50/50) About us We are looking for a scientifically grounded Data Scientist to join our Decision Science team, which focuses on two pillars: Operations Intelligence and Customer Intelligence. You will develop robust statistical, mathematical, and machine learning solutions across one of Europe’s largest omnichannel retailers …

items.desc: Short Description SPREAD builds engineering intelligence for the world's most complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes, and industrial manufacturers a single source of product truth so engineering teams can make confident product decisions, fast. We work with companies like Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes, Bosch, and Rheinmetall. Backed by HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia, and Salesforce. You'll own SPREAD's information security and compliance program, from ISO 27001, SOC 2, and TISAX audit cycles through to the risk register, policies, and vendor assessments that back them. You set the security requirements across the company and check that day-to-day operations meet them. You work closely with the GTM team on customer security questionnaires and with leadership on ISMS reporting each cycle, and you'll grow the scope of what you own as the program matures. Your Mission Own audit cycles end-to-end for ISO 27001, SOC 2, and TISAX, expanding scope as certifications mature. Answer security questionnaires for customers and OEMs alongside the GTM team, turning fast and accurate answers into a real edge in deals. Present ISMS status, risk posture, and audit results to leadership every cycle. Maintain and evolve risk registers, security policies, and vendor security assessments as the company grows. Run security awareness training and phishing simulations across the organization. Set the security requirements for identity, device, and endpoint management, and audit that IT operations meet them. Build and maintain the evidence base behind every control, closing gaps before an auditor finds them. Automate repetitive compliance and evidence-collection work with platforms like Vanta. Your Experience 3 to 5 years in information security, GRC, or compliance operations, with direct experience supporting a complete ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit cycle. Current or recent experience in a small, close-knit security or compliance function, not a large corporate GRC team where your scope was narrowly defined. Working knowledge of identity, endpoint, and M365-style device management, strong enough to set requirements and judge whether IT operations meets them. Comfort owning a risk register, a policy set, and vendor security assessments end-to-end. Fluent German, and willingness/eligibility to undergo a German Ü2 security clearance (SÜG). Bonus: Direct exposure to TISAX or the automotive OEM security ecosystem. Bonus: Scripting or automation skills and the instinct to remove repetitive work. Bonus: Vanta or similar compliance platform experience. Why SPREAD? You're joining a security program that's already protecting deals with some of the biggest names in automotive, with a clear path to owning it fully. High ownership and measurable impact. You connect your work directly to the success of the organization. A senior team that values craft, speed, and accountability over process and hierarchy. Strong overall package including attractive compensation, VSO and an annual learning budget. Mobility and wellbeing support through a Deutschlandticket mobility budget, bike-leasing and an Urban Sports partnership. Time off and flexibility with 30 vacation days, and one paid volunteering day per year. Contact Dmytro İefymenko recruiting@spread.ai SPREAD AI Köpenicker Str. 40c | 10179 Berlin Stay connected—follow us on LinkedIn for the latest insights and updates About us SPREAD is pioneering Agentic Engineering Intelligence . Our low-code platform transforms fragmented hardware and software product data into dynamic Product Twins , creating an AI-ready knowledge base that powers smarter decisions and automation across the entire product lifecycle. At the heart of our technology lies the world’s first Universal Engineering Information Model (EIN) — a semantic framework that connects domain-specific and lifecycle data into a federated Engineering Intelligence Graph , continuously evolving over time. This foundation enables specialized AI agents to execute tasks like compliance checks, dependency analysis, and specification generation — seamlessly integrated into the tools engineers already use. The impact is tangible: companies using SPREAD achieve up to 10x faster time-to-market , 50% lower lifecycle costs , and significantly higher product quality . Industry leaders such as Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Rheinmetall , and others rely on SPREAD to build the next generation of software-defined products. Headquartered in Berlin, SPREAD delivers enterprise-grade security (ISO 27001 & TISAX), full GDPR compliance , and flexible deployment options — in the cloud or on-premises. Our Vision The future of engineering is data-driven and agentic . We make product data the most accessible, intuitive, and impactful resource in engineering — so that engineers can unleash their full creativity and drive innovation at scale.

Our system identifies, links and standardizes critical enterprise data in compliance with global standards such as ISO IDMP. We help global life-science companies launch products faster, more safely and with better patient outcomes. At Accurids, you'll join a collaborative, growth-driven environment where your work makes a real impact from day one. As a member of our Product Development team, you will work with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating closely with backend and frontend engineers, QA, DevOps and product owners. You will work directly with cross-functional engineering stakeholders, and the features and fixes you deliver reach our customers. Our CTO is directly available to you as a mentor and technical sparring partner. A Computer Science degree, Fachinformatiker training or strong hands-on experience as a career changer are all welcome. Eye for good UI: You have a feel for good UI principles and are happy to own the frontend part of a feature. Experience with React and TypeScript is a plus. Architectural thinking: You think in modules, boundaries and trade-offs, and you enjoy building what you design. AI-native mindset: AI tools like Cursor, Claude and Gemini are part of your daily workflow. You treat AI as an output amplifier and combine curiosity with sound judgment about what ships. Quality & delivery: Experience with testing at all levels (unit, integration, E2E) and GitLab CI/CD. Location & work permit: You are based in Germany within a reasonable commuting distance to our Cologne office (NRW) and hold a valid German work permit. Languages: Business-fluent English is required, and German skills are a strong plus. Bonus: DevOps experience (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS), semantic web (RDF, SPARQL, Apache Jena), Elasticsearch, LLM or MCP integration, Material UI, or pharma/life-sciences domains (FHIR, IDMP). Why you’ll love working here: Grow your expertise: Deepen your specialization in semantic data platforms, AI features or platform architecture as we scale. Epic Office & Hybrid Work: Work from our brand-new office in the KölnTurm, featuring breathtaking views over the city (even higher than the view from the Cologne Cathedral!). Enjoy flexible hybrid options. (Note: On-site presence in Cologne/NRW is required, and fully remote work is not offered.) Community & Industry Events: Connect and grow your network through exclusive industry events hosted regularly right in our scenic office space. Competitive Compensation: Fixed salary package of €60,000 to €100,000 per year, depending on experience, for a full-time, permanent position. Work-Life Balance & Perks: 30 days of paid vacation, a personal learning budget, hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux, Windows), and your choice between a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a €50/month City Plus Card. Empowered Culture: High trust, flat hierarchies and an environment where your decisions directly shape the product. Not ticking every box? We encourage you to apply anyway! We know great talent doesn't always follow a checklist, and we care more about your potential, curiosity and motivation to learn. The people using them run airspace, counter-drone and defence operations, working alongside the AI agents our network connects. You turn the product strategy into reality: you
items.desc: Product Engineer Neuron Innovations Location: UK, hybrid, with time in London Package: £90,000–£100,000 plus share options Why Neuron Neuron is building the machine internet. Sensors, drones, robots and software are becoming autonomous, but they can't yet find, trust or work with each other across organisations. Neuron is the coordination layer that changes that: the DNS and routing for agentic physical systems. Each organisation runs its own Neuron console and registers its systems as agents with a verifiable identity. Other organisations can then discover those agents, trust them and work with them through shared protocols, across organisational and national boundaries, without anyone giving up control of their systems or data. Everything on the network is ready to work with AI agents. It is already live and paid for. There are 470+ agents on our network, and we have won £4.3M in grants and sales since 2019, £1.7M of it since June 2026, from the UK CAA, Innovate UK and the European Space Agency. We are also part of NATO's multinational test and evaluation for counter-drone systems. We started in lower airspace, where we know the domain best: 4DSKY, our community sensor network for aircraft tracking, with hundreds of active receivers across the UK and Europe. Funded programmes with the CAA, Innovate UK and the European Space Agency: federated surveillance for airspace modernisation, ground-based detect-and-avoid for drones, counter-drone sensing at a regional airport, and distributed acoustic drone detection. Deployments of airspace surveillance networks for defence and UAS operators. Neuron is expanding rapidly. We are a team of 7 in London today, growing across product, engineering and delivery, and we are hiring exceptional people who want to build the infrastructure autonomous systems will run on. You would join early, with real ownership from your first week, share options in what you build, and work that goes straight into live operations at airports, along coastlines and in defence exercises. The role You make our products something customers love to use. You look after all of them: C2OS, our command-and-control platform; 4DSKY, our community sensor network; and the Neuron console, which each customer runs to connect their systems. The people using them run airspace, counter-drone and defence operations, working alongside the AI agents our network connects. You turn the product strategy into reality: you define how each feature should work, design and build the interface customers use every day, write the requirements our engineers build from, and make sure everything we ship is high quality. It's a hands-on role for an engineer who cares as much about the people using the product as about the code behind it. What you'll do Work with the Head of Engineering (our CEO until they join) to turn the product strategy into a roadmap of features, and define the detail of each: user journeys, workflows, edge cases and how it should behave. Design and build the user interface and experience yourself: the console's screens and onboarding, C2OS's operator displays and real-time maps, and the 4DSKY app. Write the requirements and acceptance criteria our engineers, including our outsourced development partner, build the back end from. Own product quality: test what's built against the requirements, run acceptance before each release, and decide with the Head of Engineering when it's ready for customers. Talk to customers and operators, watch how they use the product, and feed what you learn back into the design. Prototype new ideas quickly, including AI agents that work with the systems customers register, and line up programme needs with our Systems and Assurance Engineer. What you'll bring Front-end and full-stack engineering you have shipped, in TypeScript and a modern framework such as React, with real users relying on it. UX design: you design interfaces and workflows that customers love, not only implement someone else's designs. Product requirements and specifications that other engineers built from. Owning the quality of a shipped product: acceptance testing, release readiness and triaging what users hit. AI, IoT, robotics or connected-device products. UK-based and eligible for SC clearance. Nice to have Real-time maps and data visualisation; operator or mission-control interfaces; counter-UAS or defence systems; building with AI agents or large language models; drones, sensors or airspace; geospatial or aviation data such as ADSB; early-stage start-up experience. What we offer Holiday: 25 days plus UK public holidays; one extra day for each year of service, up to five; your birthday off Pension: Neuron pays 3% of your full basic salary Share options: EMI options, vesting over four years with a one-year cliff Sick pay: Up to 10 days at full pay a year once probation is complete Working pattern : Remote until our London office opens, then one to three days a week there; flexible hours around a 10:00–16:00 …

items.desc: Hungry for a challenge? That’s good, because at Just Eat Takeaway.com (JET) we believe everything is possible, or, as we say, everything is on the table. We are a leading global online food delivery marketplace. Our tech ecosystem connects millions of active customers with hundreds of thousands of connected partners in countries across the globe. Our mission? To empower every food moment around the world, whether it’s through customer service, coding or couriers. All about the role As a Site Reliability Engineer, part of our global Platform Assurance team, you will be seen as a partner to the wider tech community. Our platform is in a constant state of change, as we grow we want to continue to increase our velocity in harmony with our platform stability. We're in a unique position, our ultimate goal is making change that benefits all of our engineering teams. You will seek to continuously improve the reliability of our platforms & tooling, while navigating the complexity of our global platforms. You will be helping teams to understand availability, increase observability and resiliency. We have an established, north star vision and want a proactive contributor to help us turn it into reality. This will rarely be a linear path, we’re looking to continually validate the effectiveness of what we ship and steer our efforts to the best experience we can deliver. You will contribute across multiple projects and not a single day will be the same. These are some of the key ingredients to the role: Own engineering projects, their implementation and delivering against the Reliability & Observability Engineering roadmap Be a part of global agile delivery team Support the implementation and adoption of various initiatives (Load testing, Chaos Engineering, production assurance) Work closely with multiple engineering teams Share your knowledge and promote best practices on how we reliably operate our global platform Troubleshoot, reproduce and mitigate issues in our production environments Identify improvements, highlighting risks vs benefits, and translating them into technical requirements What will you bring to the table? Eagerness to learn Previous exposure to large-scale cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) Experience in DevOps, SRE or similar role Experience with containers and Kubernetes (EKS) Experience with developing AI agent would be an advantage Development/engineering background would be an advantage (e.g. Python, .NET, Java…) At JET, this is on the menu: Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth and about celebrating every aspect of our JETers. Thanks to them we stay one step ahead of the competition. Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging: No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day. What else are we delivering? Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels. Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now! #LI-CB2
