 We are Siemens 
 Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 
 We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience in software testing and test automation to join our growing Quality Center of Excellence. 
 In this role, you will design, develop, and execute automated tests across Siemens software products in a multiplatform environment. You will combine strong software testing fundamentals with programming and automation skills to improve product quality, test coverage, and release confidence. 
 You will work closely with Product Management, Software Development, Applications Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, while also collaborating with other QA specialists across Siemens in areas such as automation, performance testing, and security testing. 
 The ideal candidate is a logical thinker and strong problem solver who enjoys understanding how software works, identifying defects, automating repetitive activities, and continuously improving the way software is tested. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop test automation: Design, implement, maintain, and execute automated tests for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end scenarios using appropriate frameworks and programming languages. 
 Drive test coverage: Work with Product Managers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to understand requirements, identify risks, define test cases, and develop effective automation strategies for new features and product releases. 
 Enable continuous testing: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid feedback, detect defects early, and improve the efficiency and reliability of software delivery. 
 Test APIs and data: Perform API testing using RESTful services and tools such as Postman or Swagger, and validate application data using SQL queries and SPARQL where applicable. 
 Investigate and resolve quality issues: Execute automated and functional tests, analyze failures and results, identify defects, perform structured troubleshooting, and collaborate with development teams to drive resolution. 
 Improve automation frameworks: Continuously enhance existing test frameworks, scripts, and utilities to improve maintainability, efficiency, reliability, and test coverage. 
 Collaborate and contribute to quality excellence: Maintain clear test documentation, share knowledge, and collaborate with the Siemens Quality Center of Excellence to adopt effective quality engineering practices and emerging testing technologies. 
 Qualifications 
 3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Software Testing, with hands-on experience in test automation. 
 Strong programming or scripting skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable language, with the ability to develop maintainable automation solutions. 
 Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Katalon Studio, PyTest, TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent. 
 Experience with API testing and database validation, including RESTful APIs, SQL queries, and tools such as Postman or Swagger. 
 Familiarity with SPARQL and RDF/knowledge graph concepts, including the ability to write or assess SPARQL queries for data retrieval and validation. 
 Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, GitLab CI, or equivalent, with an understanding of integrating automated tests into pipelines. 
 Strong understanding of software testing methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, TDD, and BDD, combined with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 
 Preferred Skills 
 Exposure to AI agents, LLM-driven applications, or AI-assisted automation, including technologies such as Anthropic Claude or equivalent. 
 Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies. 
 Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner. 
 Familiarity with security testing practices such as DAST and penetration testing concepts. 
 Experience testing browser-based applications, including functionality, performance, and cross-browser compatibility. 
 Experience or interest in Data Science, Data Visualization, Data Analytics, RDF, or …

Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. items.desc: Almawave Labs Srl è una società italiana attiva in ambito Data & Artificial Intelligence, la quale dispone di tecnologie proprietarie, soluzioni e servizi che concretizzano il potenziale dell’AI e dei dati nell’evoluzione digitale di aziende e pubbliche amministrazioni. Può contare su oltre 450 clienti nazionali ed internazionali, in settori quali Government, Finance, Energy & Utilities, Turismo, Healthcare, operando direttamente e tramite partner. Posizione: Posizione Entrerai a far parte dei Laboratori di Ricerca e Sviluppo Cognitive & AI di Almawave , all’interno della Direzione Technology & Innovation, in un ambiente fortemente stimolante ed eterogeneo, costantemente impegnato nello sviluppo di prodotti innovativi di AI. Nel ruolo di Junior AI Software Engineer sarai responsabile dell'intero ciclo di vita di sviluppo, dalla formalizzazione di concetti astratti alla messa in produzione di sistemi complessi. Sfruttando Coding Agents di ultima generazione, agirai come un vero e proprio "moltiplicatore tecnologico", garantendo l'eccellenza architetturale e l'integrità del sistema in ambienti Cloud-Native. Avrai le seguenti responsabilità: Collaborare alla progettazione di sistemi distribuiti, contribuendo alla definizione dei flussi applicativi e dei modelli dati sotto la supervisione di figure senior. Utilizzare strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale a supporto dello sviluppo del codice (Java, Python, TypeScript), applicando gli standard qualitativi e le best practice del team. Contribuire alla raccolta e all'analisi dei requisiti funzionali e tecnici, traducendoli in specifiche chiare e documentate. Partecipare alle attività di test, validazione e revisione del codice, assicurando attenzione agli aspetti di qualità, sicurezza e manutenibilità. Requisiti: Buona conoscenza dei principi di sviluppo software maturata in 1-2 anni di esperienza in contesti aziendali analoghi; esperienza di almeno 1 anno nella progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni tecnologiche end-to-end. Buona Conoscenza dei principali concetti di Generative AI (es. architetture RAG, chatbot, integrazione LLM) e interesse nello sviluppo di soluzioni basate su Intelligenza Artificiale. Conoscenza dei linguaggi di programmazione Java, Python e Modern JS/TS, con capacità di applicarli in contesti progettuali. Familiarità con architetture a microservizi, sistemi event-driven, metodologie Domain-Driven Design e principi di sviluppo cloud native. Interesse nell’utilizzo di strumenti di AI Tooling, Agentic Workflows e tecnologie come Docker, Kubernetes, Helm e pipeline CI/CD. Altre informazioni: Sede di lavoro: Roma, con possibilità di lavoro in modalità ibrida Orario di lavoro: full time, dal lunedì al venerdì Contratto: tempo indeterminato, CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria Profilo: AI Software Engineer equiparato a AI-ML Software Engineer Inquadramento: livello B1 Retribuzione: RAL compresa dada 30.073,42€ a 35.000€, commisurata all'esperienza e alle competenze maturate Benefit aziendali: buono pasto del valore di €8,26 per ogni giornata lavorata. Perché scegliere il Gruppo Almaviva? In AlmavivA troverai un modello organizzativo in cui la persona e le sue competenze sono al centro. Ci contraddistingue un ambiente di lavoro fondato su fiducia, collaborazione, autonomia e responsabilità, orientato all'efficienza e al raggiungimento dei risultati. Il nostro impegno verso le persone si traduce nella promozione di un contesto inclusivo e attento alle pari opportunità, supportato dalla conformità agli standard ISO 30415 per la Diversity & Inclusion, UNI/PdR 125 per la parità di genere e SA8000 per la responsabilità sociale. La tua opportunità è ora! Se l’innovazione è la tua passione, se esplorare il mondo dell’Information e Communication Technologies è un tuo desiderio, se la tua aspirazione è lavorare in un team con forte volontà di condivisione e focalizzato su obiettivi sempre più sfidanti, incontriamoci ora! Ai sensi della normativa vigente, la presente offerta di lavoro è rivolta a tutte le persone candidate, senza distinzione di genere, in conformità alla normativa applicabile. Le persone interessate possono inviare il proprio CV aggiornato e dettagliato, corredato dell'autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali ai sensi del D.Lgs. 196/2003 e dell'art. 13 del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679 (GDPR).

Through the Launch Program and on-the-job learning, you will develop the technical, analytical, and business skills needed to turn data into trusted insights and support better decisions. As analytics professional, you will operate at the intersection of analytics, AI, and business judgement, validating analytical outputs, challenging assumptions, and translating analysis into business value. Within our graduate programme there will be a number of roles in two tracks: Engineering Track Software Engineer - Develops client and internal applications Data Engineer - Builds and maintains data pipelines and platforms Analyst Track Data Analyst - Turns data into insight through analysis and visualisation Business Analyst - Translates business needs into requirements and process change Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organisation, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Data and Analytics Aon delivers data and analytics solutions across two primary pillars: Risk Capital and Human Capital, helping organizations manage uncertainty, optimize capital, and support their workforces. Based in Dublin, together with partner hubs in Krakow, Singapore and Bangalore, develops innovative data solutions for colleagues, clients, and Aon partners. The D&A team works across the entire analytics lifecycle, leveraging both Aon proprietary and external data sources to provide new insights within our AI enabled products and services. The Launch Development Program Launch Is a Structured 10-month Early Career Development Program That Combines Meaningful Work, Business Learning, Professional Development, And Relationship-building Across Aon. The Program Helps You Build a Strong Foundation For a Long-term Career Through On-the-job learning with analysts, engineers, product teams, business partners, and specialists. Business and professional development in communication, collaboration, problem-solving, commercial awareness, and client service. Exposure to AI, data and technology through meaningful work, practical learning, and technology-enabled delivery. Networking, mentorship, and coaching opportunities to build relationships across Aon and develop your career path. What Will Help You Succeed and Grow Skills We are looking for candidates who are curious, motivated, and excited to learn. Through the Launch Program, you will continue developing the skills and capabilities that support a successful career, including: An interest in analytics, AI, technology, data-driven decision-making, and problem-solving. A relevant third-level qualification, or transferable skills and demonstrated aptitude to work in data and analytics. Foundational understanding of AI-enabled technologies, with an interest in prompt engineering and evaluating AI outputs. Critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical ability, including the confidence to challenge assumptions. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to present complex ideas clearly. Curiosity, learning agility and the ability to investigate challenges independently. items.desc: Digitale Leute ist die Plattform für Produktmanagement, UX-Design und Engineering. Über Konferenzen, Bootcamps und unsere Community vernetzen wir Fach- und Führungskräfte der Digitalbranche. Gemeinsam mit Partnern wie Airbnb, Porsche Digital, Atlassian oder Rewe Digital gestalten wir die Software-Entwicklung von morgen. (Weiterbildung) Mit der Digitale Leute School bieten wir praxisnahe Weiterbildungen für die Tech-Branche an. Ein Highlight ist unser AI Software Engineering Bootcamp – die ideale Chance für Softwareentwickler:innen, den nächsten Karriereschritt zu machen. Unsere Trainer kommen aus führenden Tech-Unternehmen und vermitteln dir topaktuelles AI-Know-how kombiniert mit Produktmanagement-Methoden für Entwickler:innen. Nach dem Bootcamp unterstützen wir dich aktiv bei der Jobsuche über unser starkes Hiring-Network. Für Arbeitssuchende mit Bildungsgutschein ist die Teilnahme sogar komplett kostenlos. Der nächste Kurs startet bald – und es gibt noch freie Plätze! Diese Inhalte erwarten dich: Aufgaben Vom Entwickler zum Mitgestalter: Während AI repetitive Coding-Aufgaben übernimmt, wächst dein strategischer Einfluss in der Produktentwicklung. Du lernst, Geschäftsmodelle und Nutzerbedürfnisse zu analysieren, Hypothesen zu formulieren und deine Erkenntnisse in Roadmaps und produktnahe Backlogs zu überführen. Architektur & Verantwortung im AI-Zeitalter: Du entwickelst Software, die nicht nur funktioniert, sondern strukturiert und langfristig tragfähig ist – auf Basis bewährter Architekturprinzipien und moderner Patterns. Dabei identifizierst du Risiken beim Einsatz von AI, überwachst deren Entscheidungen und behältst Kosten, API-Limits und System-Performance im Blick. AI-gestützte Entwicklung & Deployment: Du nutzt moderne AI-Tools, um stabile Prototypen oder komplette MVPs zu entwickeln, automatisiert zu testen und sicher zu deployen. Dabei behältst du die AI-Entscheidungen im Blick – von der Qualität und Einhaltung deiner Anforderungen bis hin zur Observability im Livebetrieb. Orchestriere AI als Teammitglied: Du setzt AI gezielt im Team ein, entwickelst Agenten für verschiedene Aufgaben und orchestrierst deren Zusammenarbeit. Dabei automatisierst du Workflows und bindest Unternehmensdaten über etablierte Frameworks wie LangChain oder MCP ein – für echte AI-Features mit Mehrwert. Qualifikation Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Technologie und entwickelst gern Produkte, die Nutzer begeistern. Du bringst solide Kenntnisse in moderner Softwareentwicklung mit Du bist neugierig, ambitioniert und suchst aktiv nach Wegen, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln. Du hast Spaß an agilen Methoden (Scrum, Kanban) und arbeitest gerne im Team. Du kannst dich gut in Nutzer und Stakeholder hineinversetzen und verstehst, wie man technische Lösungen aus Produktperspektive denkt. Du bist bereit, dich in komplexe, schnell wachsende Themen wie AI-Entwicklung und Agentic Workflows einzuarbeiten. Du bleibst nicht stehen: Veränderungen im Tech-Stack und neue Tools motivieren dich, statt dich zu verunsichern. Du hast Freude daran, über den Tellerrand hinaus zu denken und technische wie auch produktstrategische Verantwortung zu übernehmen. items.desc: Role Overview So arbeiten wir – bitte aufmerksam lesen Diese Stelle passt nicht zu jedem, und das ist Absicht. Damit du einschätzen kannst, ob sie zu dir passt: Es gibt keine fertige Use-Case-Liste. Du baust dir deine Pipeline selbst auf – durch Gespräche, Beobachtung und Neugier auf die Arbeit anderer. Was du findest, bewertest und priorisierst du eigenverantwortlich. Du wirst öfter "nein" sagen als "ja". Viele Use-Case-Wünsche sind bei genauem Hinsehen zu teuer, zu riskant oder schlicht ein Prozessproblem, das keine KI braucht. Du musst das erkennen, begründen und freundlich vertreten können – ohne die Beziehung zur Abteilung zu beschädigen. Beratung ist die Hälfte des Jobs. Du führst Gespräche, moderierst Workshops, siehst Kollegen bei der Arbeit über die Schulter und dokumentierst Prozesse, die noch nie jemand aufgeschrieben hat. Erst danach wird gebaut. Wer diesen Teil als lästige Vorstufe zum Coden empfindet, wird hier nicht glücklich. Nicht alle freuen sich über dein Kommen. Manche Kollegen sehen in KI eine Bedrohung für ihre Arbeit, andere haben schlicht keine Zeit für dich, und in manchen Prozessen ist die Ineffizienz jemandes lieb gewordene Routine. Du nimmst diese Vorbehalte ernst statt sie wegzuargumentieren – und arbeitest bei sensiblen Themen früh und offen mit Datenschutz, IT-Security und Vorgesetzten zusammen, statt an ihnen vorbei. Jedes Teammitglied handelt sehr autonom. Du setzt dir deinen eigenen Maßstab und prüfst deine eigenen Ergebnisse kritisch, bevor jemand anderes es tut. Austausch und Feedback gibt es selbstverständlich – aber die Qualitätssicherung deiner Arbeit beginnt bei dir. Du bist der Spezialist für dein Gebiet. Unser Innovationsteam ist bewusst interdisziplinär aufgestellt, mit kaum Überlappungen zwischen den Disziplinen. Du hast Spezialisten für Frontend, Backend und UX an deiner Seite, wenn aus einem Use-Case mehr wird – aber die KI-Transformation ist dein Feld, und du verantwortest es fachlich selbst. Wir arbeiten selbst AI-gestützt – konsequent. Tools wie Claude Code oder Cursor sind bei uns Alltag, nicht Experiment. Wer anderen Abteilungen KI-gestütztes Arbeiten näherbringt, sollte es selbst vorleben – und wissen, wo die Grenzen liegen. Das verschiebt den Schwerpunkt der Arbeit: weniger selbst tippen, mehr Probleme präzise formulieren und Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen, bevor sie jemand anderes nutzt. Wöchentliche Freiräume sind fest eingeplant – rund 10 % deiner Arbeitszeit. Zeit für fachliche Weiterentwicklung, eigene Ideen und kreativen Austausch ist bei uns Teil der Arbeitswoche – kein Nice-to-have, das im Tagesgeschäft verdampft. Ergebnisgetrieben und prozessual schlank. Wir brauchen schnelle, pragmatische Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren – keine über Monate ausgefeilten 100%-Systeme. Wächst ein Use-Case Richtung Produkt, übergibst du ihn an unser Innovationsteam oder R&D. Diese Rolle lebt von Präsenz. Use-Cases findet man häufig nicht per Videocall, sondern beim Zusehen, im Flurgespräch, am Schreibtisch der Kollegen. Plane regelmäßige Zeit in Landau ein (ca. 10–20 % der Arbeitszeit, gerade in der Anfangsphase eher mehr). Wenn du darauf wartest, dass dir jemand sagt, wo es klemmt, wirst du bei uns nicht glücklich. Den Kolleginnen und Kollegen ist oft selbst nicht bewusst, dass ein Problem existiert oder sich eine Effizienzchance bietet – genau das zu erkennen, ist der Kern dieser Rolle. Wenn dich das reizt: lies weiter. Your Tasks Use-Cases für KI im Unternehmen aktiv identifizieren: Abteilungen und ihre Prozesse kennenlernen, Ineffizienzen und Potenziale aufdecken, Ideen gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen ausarbeiten Use-Cases ehrlich bewerten: Nutzen, Aufwand, Machbarkeit, Datenschutz- und Ethik-Risiken – und auf dieser Basis priorisieren, was umgesetzt wird und was nicht Lösungen pragmatisch umsetzen: Workflow-Automatisierungen, interne Tools, LLM-basierte Anwendungen, Integration von KI-APIs – mit dem Werkzeug, das zum Problem passt Lösungen in den Alltag bringen: Einführung begleiten, Kollegen befähigen, Feedback einsammeln und nachschärfen Gespräche und Workshops mit den Fachbereichen vorbereiten, moderieren und nachhalten – inklusive der Prozessaufnahme, die es vorher nicht gab (Shadowing, einfache Prozessdokumentation) Erwartungen managen: klären, was eine Lösung leisten wird und was nicht, bevor sie gebaut wird Kollegen befähigen: Schulungen und Hilfestellungen, Multiplikatoren in den Abteilungen gewinnen, internen Erfahrungsaustausch zu KI aufbauen Größere oder produktnahe Use-Cases strukturiert an Innovationsteam oder R&D übergeben Ergebnisse und Empfehlungen gegenüber Fachbereichen und Geschäftsführung präsentieren – auf dem jeweiligen technischen Niveau deines Gegenübers Your Profile Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Softwarelösungen – du bist und bleibst jemand, der selbst baut Praktische Erfahrung im Bau von GenAI-Anwendungen: LLM-APIs, Prompt Engineering, RAG – idealerweise in Lösungen, die echte Nutzer im Alltag verwenden …

items.desc: Want to design the architecture that lets AI agents safely refactor, test and ship production code? Then let's talk. Our client acquires enterprise software companies and turns them into AI-native, profitable, scalable businesses. They are a remote-first, AI-forward team spread across the globe, offering high ownership, flexibility and impact, work across multiple products and technologies, and growth pathways across engineering, product and leadership. The job: transform a 10+ year legacy codebase into a high-velocity, agent-operable architecture, at the intersection of software architecture, AI-agent orchestration and engineering governance. Contract Type: Contract, full-time Location: Fully remote from Eastern Europe, working US morning hours (Scrum). items.desc: Position Purpose: We are seeking a passionate and motivated AI Data Engineer to join our international team as part of a strategic expansion of our AI and Data capabilities. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the data foundations that power foundational applications, advanced analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Model (LLM) applications across the organization. You will work at the intersection of data engineering, AI platform development, and data governance, ensuring that high-quality, trusted, and scalable data is available to support AI-driven innovation. Your work will play a critical role in enabling next-generation AI solutions by building robust data pipelines, optimizing large-scale data architectures, and creating AI-ready datasets that support model training, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, and intelligent automation initiatives. As an AI Data Engineer, you will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Architects, Product teams, and business stakeholders to ensure that data assets are reliable, accessible, secure, and aligned with both business and technical requirements. What You Will Be Doing Design, develop, and maintain scalable data ingestion, transformation, and enrichment pipelines supporting AI and analytics initiatives. Assess, modernize, and migrate legacy data platforms, tools, and operational processes to scalable, governed, and AI-ready data infrastructures. Lead initiatives to replace manual, siloed, or obsolete data workflows with automated, cloud-enabled, and data-driven solutions. Design and execute migration strategies for data assets stored in legacy applications, databases, file systems, and on-premise environments while ensuring data quality and business continuity. Refactor and optimize existing ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, and integration processes to align with modern architectural standards and AI platform requirements. Develop data processing solutions using Python, Spark, SQL, and distributed computing frameworks. Design and implement data architectures supporting LLM-based applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, and knowledge management platforms. Develop and manage metadata, lineage, and cataloging solutions to improve data discoverability and governance. Collaborate with Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists to provide high-quality feature stores, training datasets, and inference data pipelines. Support the creation and maintenance of Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) platforms and reusable data products. Implement automated data quality checks, validation frameworks, and monitoring solutions to ensure data integrity and reliability. Contribute to AI platform engineering initiatives, including model-serving infrastructure, feature management, and AI data lifecycle management. Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations, security standards, and organizational governance policies. Define and implement best practices to ensure migrated systems comply with enterprise standards for data governance, security, lineage, observability, and documentation. Participate in the design of AI governance processes related to data sourcing, quality management, access control, and responsible AI. Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for process automation, technical debt reduction, and platform modernization. Stay informed on emerging technologies in data engineering, Generative AI, knowledge graphs, vector search, and AI platform architectures. Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, solution design reviews, architecture discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives. What You Need For This Position Fluency in Czech/Slovak. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. Proven at least 5 years of working experience as a Big Data Engineer or similar. Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Scala, Python, or Java. Familiarity with APIs, data integration frameworks, and event-driven architectures. At least 5 years of experience in migrating legacy data platforms, repositories, and operational workflows to modern data architectures while ensuring business continuity and data integrity. Building data solutions using Python, SQL, Spark, and distributed computing frameworks experience. Knowledge of data security, encryption, access controls, and compliance requirements. Understanding of modern data architectures, including data lakes, lakehouses, and data mesh concepts. Familiarity with AI and ML workflows, including training data preparation, feature engineering, and model-serving data pipelines Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to navigate complex and ambiguous challenges. Passion for AI, data …

items.desc: The Role We are seeking a Junior Full-Stack Engineer, Generative AI to join our technology organization and contribute to the development of enterprise-grade, AI-enabled applications. This role is designed for early-career engineers who are eager to grow their full-stack skills while gaining hands-on experience with applied generative AI in real-world systems. You will work as part of a collaborative engineering team, contributing to the design, development, and operation of AI-enabled web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies, Large Language Models (LLMs), and cloud infrastructure. You will be supported by more experienced engineers and will grow your skills through hands-on delivery, feedback, and mentorship. In this role, you will learn how enterprise software is built, deployed, and maintained, while applying generative AI responsibly within established engineering standards and practices. This role will be based in Cluj and has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office. What We Will Rely On You To Do Contribute to the development and maintenance of full-stack web applications under the guidance of more experienced engineers. Implement frontend features using React with TypeScript (or similar frameworks). Support the development of backend services and APIs using NodeJS / NestJS or Python (FastAPI / Django). Assist with integrating LLM-based capabilities into applications using established patterns and guidance. Help evolve proofs of concept into stable, production-ready features within defined scope. Write clean, readable, and well-tested code following established engineering standards. Participate in code reviews, learning from feedback and improving code quality over time. Support deployment and operation of applications on cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS) with guidance. Work with SQL and NoSQL data stores under direction. Collaborate with teammates in an Agile delivery environment, participating in stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives. Demonstrate curiosity, a willingness to learn, and openness to feedback. What you need to have: 1 - 2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience through internships, placements, or relevant projects. Foundational knowledge of JavaScript / TypeScript and at least one modern frontend framework (React preferred). Basic experience with backend development using NodeJS or Python. Familiarity with RESTful APIs and client-server concepts. Exposure to cloud-based systems or interest in learning cloud technologies. Basic understanding of Agile development practices. Interest in generative AI and how LLMs can be applied in software systems. Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. What makes you stand out: These are not mandatory, but strong candidates typically show interest or early exposure in some of the following areas: Hands-on experimentation with LLMs through APIs or tooling. Familiarity with concepts such as prompting, basic evaluation, or simple RAG patterns. Academic, personal, or early professional projects involving AI-enabled applications. Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) through coursework or projects. Curiosity about software quality, security, and reliability, even if experience is still developing. What can you expect: A supportive environment focused on learning, growth, and mentorship Hands-on experience building real enterprise AI solutions Clear progression paths to mid-level and senior engineering roles A collaborative and inclusive engineering culture Access to modern technologies and best practices Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with local market practices Why join our team: We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work, and supportive leaders. We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have an impact for colleagues, clients, and communities. Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being. A yearly budget and the opportunity to build your flexible benefits package (up to 20 percent of your annual salary). 30+ days off, including legal days, birthday, public holiday replacements, and benefits options. Performance bonus scheme. Matching charity contributions, charity days off, and the Pay it Forward charity challenge. Core benefits: Pension, Life and Medical Insurance, Meal Vouchers, Travel Insurance. items.desc: Et si ton prochain projet tech te permettait d'industrialiser l'IA au service du Craft ? Chez Zenika, on ne te propose pas juste une mission. On te challenge sur des projets à fort impact : modernisation d'architecture, développement de produits from scratch, refonte de legacy, mission de consulting. 🧭 Ton quotidien en mission ? Tu interviens là où ton expertise a un vrai impact : Démultiplier la vélocité de delivery : tu utilises les assistants IA de manière chirurgicale à chaque étape du SDLC, pour aller plus vite sans jamais sacrifier la qualité. Garantir l'excellence logicielle : tu conserves une parfaite maîtrise technique sur le code généré. Tu as une maîtrise totale de la chaîne de test pour valider chaque incrément. Améliorer les pratiques de développement : tu expérimentes, testes et industrialises l'usage de l'IA générative dans le quotidien de l'équipe technique pour l'aider à monter en compétences. Travailler de manière itérative : tu livres régulièrement de la valeur, avec une boucle de feedback courte pour coller parfaitement au besoin métier. 🛠️ Tu codes (et tu promptes) avec : Assistants IA de dev : Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, GPT, Gemini... Frameworks & Ingénierie classique : Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.JS, Angular, React, Vitest. Cadre maîtrisé & Craft : Gitlab CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, DDD. 💡 Et tu ne fais pas "que coder" : Gouvernance IA (Prompting avancé) : Tu configures et rédiges des règles (custom instructions, .cursorrules) pour tes assistants afin de garantir que le code généré respecte nos standards de sécurité, de clean code et d'architecture. Garant du Craft (Human in the loop) : Tu as une posture extrêmement rigoureuse de relecture critique. Tu gardes la responsabilité finale du code face à la machine, tu mènes des revues de code augmentées et tu insuffles les pratiques TDD (Red, Green, Refactor) et DDD (ateliers métiers, contextes bornés). 🧑‍💻 Des projets qui parlent Plateforme de Maintenance Intelligente : Développement d’une application de remontée d'anomalies sur des équipements et d'analyse de données terrain pour optimiser la fiabilité opérationnelle, création d'agents IA aidant à la résolution de défauts sur des équipements. 🌱 Ce qui rend l’aventure Zenika différente Tu n’es jamais seul·e : guildes internes, binômage, partages entre pairs. Tu grandis à ton rythme : lead dev, archi, speaker, formateur… Tu codes, tu questionnes, tu comprends le “pourquoi” métier derrière le “comment” technique. 🌍 Un cadre qui fait du bien Stack moderne et outillage IA de pointe. Agile pragmatique (Scrum ou Kanban), équipes mixtes client/Zenika Des talks, formations, projets open source : tu choisis ton terrain de jeu Télétravail flexible, vrai respect du temps perso, rémunération transparente Et en plus : Un modèle d’entreprise responsable : inclusion, égalité pro, sobriété numérique. Un environnement où tu peux être toi-même, avec écoute et équité 🎯 Un process clair, humain et rapide 3 étapes en 3 semaines maximum Échange pour comprendre ton parcours et tes envies Entretien tech (live coding ou archi, avec 1 dev Zenika) Discussion conseil & culture avec un·e manager Nous parlerons de ta rémunération et de notre fonctionnement interne dès le premier échange. ✉️ Et maintenant ? Tu te reconnais dans notre approche du développement orientée qualité et produit ? Tu as déjà pu te construire une expérience sur plusieurs écosystèmes techniques et fonctionnels ? Tu cherches de la montée en compétence sans bullshit et tu veux bosser dans une équipe où ton avis compte vraiment ? Alors viens voir ce qu’on construit ensemble. À bientôt ? Chez Zenika, la RSE a une place centrale dans toutes nos décisions, c’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à garantir l’égalité de traitement pour chaque candidature. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité apporte de la valeur, et l’expérience candidat est au cœur de nos préoccupations. Si tu as des besoins spécifiques, nous adapterons ton processus de recrutement et ton intégration en conséquence. Propulsez votre carrière au sein d'une communauté qui vous ressemble. Chez Zenika, nous réinventons le modèle de l'ESN. Notre ambition est simple : offrir à nos 550 consultantes et consultants un terrain de jeu idéal où excellence technique et équilibre de vie ne font qu’un. Zenika est présente dans 11 villes en France et à l’international, nous grandissons ensemble sans jamais perdre notre esprit de proximité. Notre ambition ? Mettre l'expertise de nos talents et notre culture de l'excellence technique au service des enjeux métiers et produits de nos clients. De la modernisation de systèmes à l'innovation pure, rejoindre Zenika, c'est choisir d'apporter une vraie valeur ajoutée aux projets tout en évoluant au sein d'une communauté où veille et partage résonnent dans le quotidien de toutes et tous.

items.desc:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.
 The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery. 
 Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.
 The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you. 
 About Iso 
 Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.
 Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.
 We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.
 Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.

Operating with a proactive, service-minded approach and a strong bias for AI and automation, you will safeguard our workforce, identity systems, and sensitive data.
 In this unique and polyvalent role, you will implement and maintain pragmatic corporate security controls across a wide range of domains such as IAM, DLP, corporate/external applications, and data governance. You will participate in detection and incident response and develop long-lasting measures to improve our corporate security posture. Beyond technical controls, you will also build scalable and secure operational processes across a wide range of domains such as data transfer or systems integration that will materially impact IsoLabs’ mission. You will directly support AI/medical researchers on security topics and will ensure our cross-functional teams can innovate rapidly, securely, and with total confidence.

 Security Awareness: Promote corporate security rules, support security awareness training and run social engineering exercises.
 Workplace Security: Collaborate with Workplace and Tech teams to ensure the security of physical systems (badges, lab workstations) and offices.
 Security of Operations & Processes: Translate key user needs and security compliance requirements into clear operational processes—such as establishing workflows for onboarding new tools, setting up data transfers and external system integrations.

Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société.
 En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui.
 Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.
 Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.
 Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation. 
 Notre technologie commence avec vous.
 Version française 
 En tant que V.I.E. Ingénieur en déploiement de solutions GenAI, vous rejoindrez l’équipe Imaging SW et contribuerez à l’Imaging AI Core Team, une initiative transversale visant à accélérer l’adoption de l’intelligence artificielle dans l’ensemble des activités Imaging.
 Votre mission principale sera de concevoir, développer et déployer des projets pilotes de GenAI, définis collectivement comme des priorités stratégiques pour l’organisation.
 Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la transformation d’idées à fort potentiel en prototypes d’IA fonctionnels, leur validation auprès des équipes d’ingénierie, leur préparation à une utilisation opérationnelle et le soutien à leur déploiement à grande échelle dans Imaging.
 Ce poste est concret, très visible et au cœur de la feuille de route IA d’Imaging.
 A propos de vos missions 
 1. Développer des projets pilotes de GenAI basés sur les LLM 
 Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions pilotes utilisant des Large Language Models (LLMs), le Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), le prompt engineering et des techniques de fine-tuning léger, selon les contraintes de la politique en vigueur.
 Transformer les cas d’usage IA prioritaires en prototypes fonctionnels, avec des résultats mesurables.
 Créer des dispositifs d’évaluation pour mesurer la qualité, la sécurité, la latence et le coût des composants GenAI.
 2. Contribuer au passage à l’échelle et au déploiement 
 Faire évoluer les solutions pilotes pour en faire des outils internes déployables et faciles à maintenir.
 Collaborer avec les équipes concernées pour valider la faisabilité des solutions, intégrer leurs retours et préparer leur déploiement à plus grande échelle.
 Documenter les modes d’utilisation, les points d’intégration et les contraintes opérationnelles.

 Travailler avec les représentants des différents groupes Imaging pour clarifier leurs besoins, recueillir les données nécessaires et s’aligner sur les priorités.
 Présenter les résultats, les démonstrations et l’avancement des travaux lors des réunions de l’AI Core Team.
 Contribuer à la feuille de route IA d’Imaging en assurant le suivi des expérimentations, en partageant les enseignements tirés et en proposant les prochaines étapes.
 4. Garantir un usage responsable et conforme de l’IA 
 Appliquer les directives de ST et les règles de gouvernance de l’IA, notamment en tenant compte de l’EU AI Act, des cadres de safe use et des contraintes de sécurité.
 Contribuer à définir des garde-fous et de bonnes pratiques pour l’utilisation des LLM dans les activités d’ingénierie.

 Une expérience pratique dans la création de solutions d’IA concrètes destinées à des centaines d’ingénieurs, au sein d’un environnement industriel complexe.
 Une compréhension des contraintes de déploiement des LLM en entreprise : sécurité, confidentialité, performance et reproductibilité.

items.desc: Krijg jij energie van AI-oplossingen die niet in slides blijven hangen, maar echt werken bij klanten? Ben je zowel sterk in analyseren en adviseren als in bouwen en integreren? Wil je mee de kar trekken om AI concreet te laten landen, bij klanten en intern bij Flexso? Dan ben jij misschien de AI Agentic Engineer die we zoeken! Profiel Professional Brand Flexso Digital Locaties waar je kan werken Ontdek ons kantoor in Kontich, Gent, Lummen Wie is Flexso? Flexso, da’s één team met véél expertises. Als SAP Gold partner bouwen we mee aan de bedrijfsprocessen van morgen en willen we een pionier zijn in digitale innovatie ; dat is waar we elke ochtend met volle goesting voor opstaan. En dat doen we al sinds 2004. We zijn een enthousiaste en gepassioneerde bende, gedreven door ondernemingszin en teamspirit. De blik vooruit en de voeten op de grond. Onze waarden en mensen, dat is onze kracht! Hier is iedereen helemaal zichzelf en krijg je de kans om initiatief te nemen en het verschil te maken in je rol. Bij Flexso zit je goed én op de eerste rij. Zin om mee te schrijven aan ons groeiverhaal? SAP...say what? SAP is dé marktleider wereldwijd in bedrijfssoftware , a.k.a. ‘Enterprise Application Software’, en biedt een onovertroffen portfolio aan apps die bedrijven ondersteunen in alle aspecten en dimensies van hun processen: logistiek, finance, HR, e-commerce, analytics,… you name it! Daarnaast biedt SAP ook een uiterst krachtig technologie platform – SAP Business Technology Platform – volledig gebaseerd op open standaarden en het ‘Bring Your Own Language’ principe (BYOL), zowel in de cloud als on-premise. Als Agentic AI Engineer bij Flexso … Sta je op het kruispunt van analyseren en bouwen . Waar veel AI-verhalen blijven steken in een demo, ben jij net diegene die de brug slaat: je begrijpt de nood van de klant, weet die te vertalen naar een concrete oplossing, én bouwt die zelf mee uit tot iets dat écht werkt in productie, end-to-end geïntegreerd met SAP. Die combinatie van functioneel inzicht en technische diepgang is precies waar jouw meerwaarde zit. Het is wat het verschil maakt tussen een AI-idee en een AI-oplossing die klanten ook effectief gebruiken . Deze rol is een pioniersrol . Agentic AI bij Flexso staat nog volop in ontwikkeling, en jij gaat mee bepalen hoe we het aanpakken: welke tools we inzetten (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, N8N, Claude, Copilot Studio,…), hoe we oplossingen laten landen bij klanten, en hoe we onze eigen aanpak en interne tools zoals Flexso Cortex verder uitbouwen. Het draaiboek ligt zeker niet vast. Je krijgt de ruimte en vrijheid om zelf mee vorm te geven aan wat goed werkt. Daarmee speel je ook een sleutelrol in onze toekomst . Wat jij vandaag mee opbouwt, de aanpak, de keuzes, de kennis, legt de basis voor hoe AI en agentic development hier de komende jaren verder groeien . Je deelt actief wat je leert met collega's en klanten, en je ownership reikt verder dan je eigen project: je helpt mee de richting bepalen. Kortom, als analytische bouwer met een pioniersmindset krijg je hier niet zomaar een rol, maar de kans om mee te schrijven aan het AI-verhaal van Flexso. Wat verwachten we? Je hebt een sterke interesse in (generatieve) AI en agentic development , en durft daar zelf mee te experimenteren en in te investeren. Je hebt ervaring met agentic frameworks zoals LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, N8N, AgentForce, Zapier of gelijkaardige platformen. Kennis van en ervaring met SAP, BTP, ABAP, ... is een sterke plus , maar geen absolute vereiste: we leren je graag die kant van het verhaal, als jij de AI/Agentic-expertise meebrengt. Je geeft advies en neemt ownership : van idee tot werkende oplossing. Je hebt zin om mee te bouwen aan iets nieuws binnen Flexso , en schrikt niet terug van een rol die nog volop in ontwikkeling is. Wat bieden wij jou? Boeiende en gevarieerde projecten , waarbij AI niet blijft hangen bij een idee of een demo, maar je zelf mee bepaalt hoe het écht landt bij klanten — volgens jouw interesses en expertise. Je maakt deel uit van een team dat mee de agentic AI-koers van Flexso uittekent , in een professionele organisatie met SAP-diepgang. Een job met impact : je katapulteert klanten én Flexso zelf naar een AI-gedreven toekomst. Coaching , opleidingen via de Flexso Academy en massa’s ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, in een cultuur van kennisdeling waar iedereen elkaar uitdaagt en helpt groeien. Duidelijke focus op innovatie: we investeren graag in de nieuwste tools en volgen de evoluties in AI, agentic frameworks en de SAP-roadmap op de voet. De dynamiek van een klein bedrijf en de mogelijkheden van een groot bedrijf. Een open organisatie met toffe collega's en véél feestjes . Een barbecue, hackathon of een weekendje weg zijn eerder regel dan uitzondering. Voor zover we met regels werken, dan. items.desc: #StormYourCareer Rejoins STORM GROUP et construis ta carrière avec nous ! Révèle la puissance sémantique des modèles de langage et adapte l?IA générative aux cas d?usage métierDans le cadre du développement stratégique de ses solutions avancées de traitement automatique du langage naturel, un grand compte recherche un(e) NLP / LLM Scientist. Ton rôle sera central et à forte valeur scientifique : tu concevras, adapteras et évalueras des modèles de langage de pointe (LLMs propriétaires et modèles ouverts) pour répondre aux défis métiers spécifiques du groupe avec un niveau d?exigence maximal sur la performance, la fiabilité et la reproductibilité. Ton futur environnementTu évolueras au sein d?une équipe de recherche appliquée et d?ingénierie IA de premier plan, en collaboration étroite avec les data scientists, les ingénieurs MLOps et les directions métiers. Dans un environnement équipé d?infrastructures de calcul accéléré (GPU), tu travailleras sur des corpus textuels d?entreprise riches et volumineux. C?est le cadre parfait pour mener une veille scientifique de pointe, expérimenter des techniques d?adaptation paramétrique avancées (LoRA, QLoRA) et déployer des architectures RAG robustes. Tes missions clésModélisation, Fine-Tuning & Architectures Génératives (Mode R&D & BUILD) : Analyser, benchmarker et sélectionner les architectures de modèles de langage les plus adaptées aux cas d?usage (arbitrage modèles propriétaires vs modèles open-weight comme Llama ou Mistral). Réaliser le fine-tuning et l?alignement de modèles ouverts sur des corpus métiers spécialisés en appliquant des techniques d?adaptation efficaces (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA). Concevoir et optimiser des stratégies de prompting avancées et des chaînes d?augmentation par récupération (RAG) connectées à des bases vectorielles. Résoudre des problématiques de NLP classiques et génératives : extraction d?entités nommées (NER), classification sémantique, résumé automatique et recherche de similarité textuelle (spaCy, Hugging Face Transformers). Évaluation Scientifique, Benchmarking & Restitution (Mode LAB & ÉVALUATION) : Concevoir des jeux de données d?évaluation dédiés (benchmarks sur mesure) et formaliser des métriques quantitatives et qualitatives par tâche (précision, fidélité, consistance, BLEU/ROUGE, LLM-as-a-judge). Analyser rigoureusement les erreurs, quantifier les phénomènes d?hallucination et calibrer les scores de confiance des modèles. Assurer le suivi des expérimentations, le versioning des poids et des métriques via MLflow sur grappes GPU. Rédiger la documentation méthodologique et restituer avec clarté les conclusions scientifiques auprès d?interlocuteurs techniques et de sponsors métiers. Ton profilFormation : Diplôme d?Ingénieur, Bac+5 universitaire (Master 2) ou Doctorat (PhD) en NLP, Machine Learning, informatique ou linguistique computationnelle. Expérience : Tu justifies d?une expérience confirmée de 3 à 5 ans en NLP et Deep Learning appliqué au texte (ou doctorat avec travaux appliqués). Expertise NLP & LLM Impérative : Maîtrise approfondie de la programmation en Python et du framework PyTorch. Excellente pratique de l?écosystème Hugging Face (Transformers, Datasets, PEFT, TRL). Expérience concrète du fine-tuning de modèles de langage open-weight (LoRA, QLoRA, Mistral, Llama). Solide compréhension des architectures RAG, des bases vectorielles et des bibliothèques NLP traditionnelles (spaCy). items.desc: Nordic Knots is looking for a mid-level to senior Member of Technical Staff with 5+ years of experience to join our team in Stockholm. This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing interior design company that strives for perfection and is willing to invest in developing great tools that deliver excellent customer experiences. We are looking for someone who has fully embraced agentic development. You don’t just use AI to write code faster – you design the harnesses, tools and flows that let agents do real work reliably, and you have the engineering judgment to know when the output is right. You thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and love solving problems and improving business operations with technical solutions. The Role AI has changed how software gets built, and we have changed with it. Our tech team works agentic-first: agents handle much of the implementation, and our engineers spend their time on architecture, context, review and making sure that what ships is fast, correct and maintainable. You will be an integral part of a team responsible for everything from development and testing to architecture, ensuring that we continue to scale up in the most technically efficient way possible. You will also help shape how the whole company works with AI – from our eCommerce platform to the internal tools and automations used across buying, logistics, finance and customer experience. You’re both encouraged and expected to take the initiative and solve problems, as you will have the opportunity to influence the way the tech team works. You need an explorative mindset and the ability to pick up new models, tools and techniques as fast as the landscape moves. What you’ll do Build and maintain our eCommerce frontend in Next.js and TypeScript, along with the integrations to Centra, our headless eCommerce platform, and Sanity, our CMS – working agentic-first with Claude Code as your daily driver. Design and own our agentic development setup: project context and CLAUDE.md files, custom commands and skills, hooks, subagents, MCP servers and the guardrails that keep agents on track. Build AI pipelines and internal agents that streamline processes throughout the organization, connecting models to our business systems through well-designed tools. Write the specs, tests and evals that make agent output verifiable, and review AI-generated code for correctness, security and performance before it ships. Set up agentic flows in our CI/CD, such as automated code review, test generation and background agents working on well-scoped tasks. Be part of optimizing the performance of the application to ensure an exceptional user experience. Raise the bar for how the rest of the tech team, and the wider company, works with AI. Be part of developing the roadmap to make sure that we stay ahead of technological developments in our market space, aligned with the company’s long-term strategy and vision. Who you are You are a mid-level to senior engineer with 5+ years of experience building production software, ideally high-performing eCommerce applications. You work agentic-first by default. Agents are part of how you plan, build, test and review – not an add-on. You’ve been working with Claude Code since its research preview in early 2025 and have evolved your workflow alongside it. You have hands-on experience setting up harnesses, tools and flows for agents: context engineering, tool and MCP server design, subagent and multi-agent orchestration, evals and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. You understand the underlying systems well enough to catch an agent that is confidently wrong, and you hold AI-generated code to the same standard as your own. You know how to break a problem down and describe it precisely enough for an agent to act on. You are well versed in TypeScript, React, Next.js, RESTful API and GraphQL integrations, and comfortable working directly with LLM APIs. You adjust easily and are able to change course as new requirements – and new models – arise. You’re curious and enjoy technical discussions, especially about what the latest models can and can’t do. You have excellent English communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with a team. We’re a Swedish company with multinational coworkers. (Plus) You’ve shipped AI features that run in production, not just AI-assisted workflows for yourself. (Plus) You have a good eye for UX and UI design. (Plus) You’re business oriented and understand true customer value. How to stand out In your application, tell us about a harness, agent workflow or AI pipeline you’ve built: the problem it solved, how you set it up and what you learned along the way. items.desc: Data Engineer Context & Impact As Lansweeper scales its SaaS business across new products and markets, trusted data has become critical to how we make executive and board-level decisions. Two questions sit at the center: how is our revenue performing and how are customers using our products? We’re hiring two Data Engineers to bring structure, trust, and clarity to both. You’ll join the Data & Analytics team and work in one of two focus areas: Revenue Analytics : Build the foundation for how Lansweeper measures growth: ARR, retention, expansion, and forecasting. Your work will shape how C-level leaders, the board, sales, and finance understand performance and planning. Product Insights : Build the pipelines and models that show how customers adopt and use our products. Your work will help product teams decide what to build next and help customer success spot risk and opportunity early. Both roles share one goal: connecting commercial performance with product behavior, so the business can see not just what is happening, but why. In the near term, you’ll help establish a single source of truth for your domain’s KPIs, build reliable, board- and leadership-ready reporting, and enable the forecasting and insight models that drive go-to-market and product decisions. You don’t need to know our products or industry already. Curiosity, strong engineering fundamentals, and an interest in the business side of data matter more. 6-12 Month Goals Develop a strong understanding of the data platform, architecture, and key data flows supporting business reporting and analytics. Become a trusted partner for internal stakeholders by delivering reliable, well-structured, and scalable data solutions that support decision-making. Improve the quality, consistency, and availability of data by strengthening pipelines, models, and data management practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions. Support the company’s data maturity by enabling better access to trusted data and contributing to a scalable analytics foundation. Challenges The main challenges you'll face are: Working within a growing organization where data sources, systems, and business processes have evolved over time and may have been customized to meet specific needs. Designing scalable and maintainable data solutions in an environment where requirements may change frequently as the business grows. Ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability across multiple systems and pipelines, while managing dependencies and complexity. Translating business needs into technical implementations that are both practical and aligned with long-term platform standards. Key Responsibilities For both roles: Build, maintain, and improve data pipelines and models that power executive-level reporting and board-ready metrics in your focus area Establish a single, trusted source of truth for your domain’s KPIs, reconciling data across systems of record Build the curated data models and semantic layer that power dashboards and reporting, in partnership with analysts Partner with business stakeholders (sales operations, finance, product, customer success) to understand evolving processes and reflect them accurately in our data models Investigate data anomalies and trace them back to their source (pipeline issue, upstream system change, or genuine business shift), then work with stakeholders to resolve them Proactively improve data quality and integrity across your pipelines to ensure consistent, reliable reporting Month-end close support: Reporting is time-critical at month-end. When the end of the month falls on a weekend, you’ll be part of a rotation to monitor the pipelines and make sure the numbers are ready for finance and leadership on the next business day. This is occasional and planned in advance, and the load is shared across the team. Global food production is expected to increase by 60% by 2050 to meet the needs of a growing population. Our mission is to help food and agricultural companies worldwide meet this demand without compromising sustainability. To support this exciting journey, we are looking for a Group Controller to join our Group Control team within the Finance function. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping financial strategy and ensuring robust control processes that enable FOSS to deliver on purpose. You will work onsite at our head office in Hillerød Denmark. It is part of our DNA to always strive to become even better at what we do. Being FIRST is one of our core values, because it is both rewarding and fun. What you will be doing As a Group Controller, you will be an integral part of our Group Control team, working alongside four dedicated colleagues. You will play a pivotal role in supporting the growth ambitions of the business by creating standardized financial processes in a global setting and a high level of financial insight by developing and aligning the transactional accounting, controlling, statutory and tax reporting processes. The team is responsible for consolidation of reporting entities, maintaining the control framework, regional control of sales entities, transfer pricing, and overall accounting policies. In this role, you will contribute to ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting and help drive continuous improvements in processes and controls. items.desc: b> : Pratiquer l’innovation, choisir un tremplin professionnel, inventer des technologies qui ont du sens, contribuer à des projets de recherche qui n’existent nulle part ailleurs, travailler avec plus d’autonomie, plus de responsabilités, bénéficier d’une diversité sous toutes ses formes, intégrer une communauté de personnalités bienveillantes, curieuses, expertes et enthousiastes : b<>com est, selon les mots de ses collaborateurs, une entreprise où il fait bon innover. Alors n’attendez plus, soyez là où les autres ne sont pas encore ! Quel sera votre environnement ? Dans un contexte où les organisations sont confrontées à de nombreuses crises, la capacité à identifier rapidement des tendances émergentes ou des signaux faibles constitue un enjeu majeur pour l'aide à la décision. Une part importante de ces informations est aujourd'hui accessible en ligne, à travers des sources variées telles que les articles de presse, les publications scientifiques, les réseaux sociaux ou encore les documents institutionnels. Cependant, la dispersion et le volume de ces données rendent leur exploitation manuelle complexe, voire irréaliste. Les avancées récentes en traitement de langage naturel (NLP), portées notamment par les grands modèles de langage (LLM), ouvrent de nouvelles perspectives pour l'analyse automatisée de données textuelles massives. Ces modèles apparaissent comme des outils prometteurs pour les analyser à grande échelle et mettre en évidence des éléments d'intérêt. Ils ouvrent en outre la voie à une « prospective augmentée », dans laquelle ils assistent les experts sans s'y substituer, en challengeant des hypothèses ou en identifiant des scénarios de futur possibles, par exemple. Leur exploration constitue ainsi une opportunité de développer de nouvelles approches pour la détection précoce de tendances et de signaux pertinents au sein de flux massifs de données, ainsi que pour l’assistance à la prospective. Quelle sera votre mission ? Au sein d'un projet interdisciplinaire intégrant des recherches sur les liens entre numérique et vulnérabilités, ce stage vise à explorer et à développer des pipelines de traitement automatisé de données textuelles massives, dans le but de détecter des tendances ou des signaux faibles. Les objectifs seront notamment de : Réaliser une étude sur le traitement de grands corpus textuels pour la détection de tendances, de signaux faibles et pour la prospective augmentée ; Évaluer différentes approches sur des jeux de données de référence ; Implémenter l’approche la plus adaptée dans un pipeline complet ;19/10/2026 Diffusion : interne RH/M&C Documenter les études, évaluations et implémentations réalisées. Quel profil ? Étudiant•e en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou en master 2 informatique, avec une spécialisation en intelligence artificielle, en traitement du langage naturel ou en traitement de données massives. > Les indispensables Développement en Python, gestion de versions via Git Connaissances en IA, en NLP et/ou en big data Aptitude à travailler en autonomie tout en sachant évoluer en équipe > Les plus Connaissance de modèles d’apprentissage machine (classification, prédiction, clustering) Connaissance des bibliothèques Python de traitement de données (pandas, matplotlib, spaCy, LangChain) Connaissance de technologies de traitement de données massives (Spark, data lakes) Connaissance de représentations formelles de données (p. ex. graphes de connaissances) Aisance dans la lecture d’articles de recherche récents Quelles modalités ? items.desc: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. Customer experience Customer experience at Nebius AI Cloud involves tackling customers' challenges and directly impacting their success by solving real-world AI and ML problems at massive GPU cloud scale. You'll not only resolve issues, but play a key role in shaping clients' business success by optimizing their AI solutions. Working with advanced GPUs such as H200, B200 and GB200, as well as modern ML frameworks, you'll influence the development of the Nebius AI Cloud and gain experience at the intersection of infrastructure and AI. With minimal bureaucracy, you'll have the freedom to innovate, take ownership and drive change. Opportunities for growth are abundant in this vibrant and supportive professional community. The role We are looking for an experienced Partner Solutions Architect with a proven track record of enabling both value-added resellers (VARs) and technology partners. You will help partners build differentiated offerings on Nebius, enable Channel joint value propositions and take those solutions to market. You will own the technical partner relationship, connecting partner sales, presales, product and engineering teams with their counterparts at Nebius. items.desc: About Serinyx Serinyx builds AI for high-stakes decisions on confidential data. On our decision-intelligence platform, AI agents break a hard question down, research it with checked citations and debate the findings under human review. The result is a verified, cited and signed report. Our second product gives universities and research institutes an always-current, AI-built view of their research. We were founded in Saarbrücken in 2026 and are now building our engineering team. The role You build what people use on our decision-intelligence platform, end to end. Users set up a research question, watch AI agents work on it live, review the findings and read the final report. You make each step clear, fast and accessible, from the component to the API behind it. Why this role You own the whole product surface, design system included, not one corner of it. Interesting interface problems: live AI runs, long-running jobs and human review in one flow. Your design system becomes the foundation every future screen is built on. What you will do in your first year Own the design system: a versioned design-token contract, several switchable visual themes and a library of atomic components that every screen uses. Ship the core flows end to end, screen and API: setting up a question, a live monitor for long-running AI research runs, the human review steps and the report view. Build the console where people approve which sources the platform may use, plus account, admin and sign-in flows. Keep every theme accessible, with colour contrast checked automatically in CI. Work with the engineer who builds our simulation and forecasting layer on how reports and forecasts are shown. What you bring Several years designing and owning production web products end to end. Show us one. React and TypeScript on the frontend; Python (FastAPI or similar) with Postgres on the backend. Design-system work: tokens, theming, and a component library others build on (Storybook or similar). Interfaces for complex workflows: forms, long-running jobs, review and approval steps. Tests across the stack (Vitest, Testing Library, Playwright, pytest). You turn a vague goal into a precise work order an AI coding agent can build from, and you can show us a time you caught an agent’s code or tests being wrong. Nice to have Temporal; single sign-on (OIDC, Keycloak or Entra ID); data visualisation (ECharts, D3); forms driven by JSON Schema; accessibility audits. How we work One team, one backlog. Everyone builds from day one and works directly with our CTO, Dr Raja Naeem Akram. Owners, not ticket-takers. Each engineer owns parts of the codebase and leads the AI coding agents working in them: writing their work orders, reviewing every pull request and deciding what merges. A typical week. Much of your time goes into specifying and reviewing work done by AI coding agents; the hardest parts you write yourself. AI agents take the routine platform work. Infrastructure, deployment and monitoring are done by AI agents under engineering review, so your time goes into design and the hard problems. You still own what you build once it is live. Quality is part of the job. You write the tests for your own work and keep CI green. Done means tests pass, security scans are clean, docs are updated and container images are signed. Two-week cycles. Planning on day one, a demo on day ten and a short written retro. English first. English is our working language; German is welcome but not required. What we offer Real ownership. An early role in a small team: you shape the product, the code and how we work, not a ticket queue. A modern stack. Python, FastAPI, Temporal, Kubernetes, React with TypeScript, and the best AI models for each task. Saarbrücken, hybrid. We are based in one of Europe’s leading centres for computer science, and we work hybrid. 30 days of holidays per year. International applicants welcome. If you come from outside the EU, we support you through the work-permit process, usually the EU Blue Card. How to apply Send your CV and one link that shows your work (code, a paper or a project you built) to contact@serinyx.com with the job title in the subject line. English or German is fine. The process has three steps: a call with our CTO, a technical interview on a problem typical of the role, with your usual AI tools, and a conversation with the founders. Equal opportunity We welcome applications from everyone, whatever their ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age or sexual identity. You don’t need to include a photo or your date of birth. Job Type: Full-time Pay: 55.000,00€ - 65.000,00€ per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in 66111 Saarbrücken

items.desc: Kleinanzeigen reaches 36M+ monthly users and is Germany’s leading online classifieds market. We are a sustainability-focused platform where you won't just write code; you will power the services that bridge our high-traffic backend with seamless user experiences. As a Data Engineer (Analytics & Products) at Kleinanzeigen, you start where the data need begins — not where the code does. You will work directly with product managers, analysts, and domain stakeholders to understand what decisions the data needs to support, how it will be consumed, and what already exists in the platform before writing a single line. From there, you design and build data assets that are homogeneous with the existing stack, cost-effective at scale, maintainable by the next engineer, and self-discoverable, so consumers can find, understand, and trust what you built without asking you. You will own the full lifecycle: ingestion through Airflow DAGs, transformation across dbt stage, core, and report layers on Databricks, and the quality, documentation, and observability that make those assets production-grade. You stay current with Airflow and design DAG topology deliberately, knowing when to use dynamic task mapping, data-aware scheduling, the TaskFlow API, or a Cosmos dbt task group with Watcher mode for performance-critical pipelines. You understand Spark well enough to know why a dbt incremental model running in Databricks produces a full table scan instead of a partition filter push-down, how a poorly configured merge operation compounds into file fragmentation over time, and what to do about it, whether that means adjusting the incremental strategy, adding liquid clustering, running OPTIMIZE, or rethinking the model grain entirely. You write Python and shell scripts as naturally as SQL and follow engineering core principles: modularity, idempotency, testability, not because they are rules, but because they make your work last. You operate in an AI-First engineering model: AI handles execution; you own intent, precision, and correctness. You use it to automate, to accelerate best practices, and to raise the quality bar across the team, not to ship faster with less judgment. items.desc: Data Engineer Context & Impact As Lansweeper scales its SaaS business across new products and markets, trusted data has become critical to how we make executive and board-level decisions. Two questions sit at the center: how is our revenue performing and how are customers using our products? We’re hiring two Data Engineers to bring structure, trust, and clarity to both. You’ll join the Data & Analytics team and work in one of two focus areas: Revenue Analytics : Build the foundation for how Lansweeper measures growth: ARR, retention, expansion, and forecasting. Your work will shape how C-level leaders, the board, sales, and finance understand performance and planning. Product Insights : Build the pipelines and models that show how customers adopt and use our products. Your work will help product teams decide what to build next and help customer success spot risk and opportunity early. Both roles share one goal: connecting commercial performance with product behavior, so the business can see not just what is happening, but why. In the near term, you’ll help establish a single source of truth for your domain’s KPIs, build reliable, board- and leadership-ready reporting, and enable the forecasting and insight models that drive go-to-market and product decisions. You don’t need to know our products or industry already. Curiosity, strong engineering fundamentals, and an interest in the business side of data matter more. 6-12 Month Goals Develop a strong understanding of the data platform, architecture, and key data flows supporting business reporting and analytics. Become a trusted partner for internal stakeholders by delivering reliable, well-structured, and scalable data solutions that support decision-making. Improve the quality, consistency, and availability of data by strengthening pipelines, models, and data management practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions. Support the company’s data maturity by enabling better access to trusted data and contributing to a scalable analytics foundation. Challenges The main challenges you'll face are: Working within a growing organization where data sources, systems, and business processes have evolved over time and may have been customized to meet specific needs. Designing scalable and maintainable data solutions in an environment where requirements may change frequently as the business grows. Ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability across multiple systems and pipelines, while managing dependencies and complexity. Translating business needs into technical implementations that are both practical and aligned with long-term platform standards. Key Responsibilities For both roles: Build, maintain, and improve data pipelines and models that power executive-level reporting and board-ready metrics in your focus area Establish a single, trusted source of truth for your domain’s KPIs, reconciling data across systems of record Build the curated data models and semantic layer that power dashboards and reporting, in partnership with analysts Partner with business stakeholders (sales operations, finance, product, customer success) to understand evolving processes and reflect them accurately in our data models Investigate data anomalies and trace them back to their source (pipeline issue, upstream system change, or genuine business shift), then work with stakeholders to resolve them Proactively improve data quality and integrity across your pipelines to ensure consistent, reliable reporting Month-end close support: Reporting is time-critical at month-end. When the end of the month falls on a weekend, you’ll be part of a rotation to monitor the pipelines and make sure the numbers are ready for finance and leadership on the next business day. This is occasional and planned in advance, and the load is shared across the team. Revenue Analytics track: Own revenue data models covering ARR, MRR, churn, expansion, contraction, and renewal cycles Reconcile revenue data across CRM, billing, and ERP to produce one consistent view of financial KPIs Build and maintain the data foundation for forecasting models, working with analysts to support go-to-market planning Work closely with sales and finance operations to keep revenue models aligned with how the business actually sells and bills Product Insights track: Own product usage and adoption data models covering active usage, feature adoption, engagement, and customer health Integrate product telemetry with commercial data (accounts, subscriptions, renewals) so usage can be tied to retention and expansion Define and maintain product KPIs together with product management and customer success Build the foundations of the self-serve dashboards and insight models that help product teams prioritize and help customer success spot risk and opportunity early Key Requirements For both roles: Hard skills: Strong SQL: you can write, optimize, and …
