items.desc: About Boomi and What Makes Us Special Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity. Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you'll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more. How You'll Make an Impact You're the technical engine behind Boomi's biggest customer engagements. You take extreme technical complexity and turn it into a strategic solution, which positions Boomi as the leader in data activation. Then you convert each high-tier engagement into a reusable asset, so the rest of the organization moves with speed and precision. The ideal candidate knows the Boomi ecosystem cold and has a track record of clearing architectural hurdles to drive revenue attainment. You bridge field requirements and product innovation. You have the executive presence to engage C-suite personas, and the discipline to productize complex solutions into workshops and blueprints. You'll manage role ambiguity and stay focused on strategic architecture, while building a culture of curiosity and a resilient community. Key Qualifications Elite Technical Proficiency: Hands-on command of the Boomi portfolio (iPaaS, Data Management, API Management). You write code in Java, Groovy, JavaScript, or Python to extend the platform and build custom solutions. Cloud-Native Infrastructure: Advanced knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP, plus Docker and Kubernetes. You're comfortable navigating clusters with K9s, managing data streaming, and troubleshooting runtime frameworks. Data Management: Deep expertise in the modern data stack. You understand the nuances of data governance, lifecycle management, and synchronization. You're proficient in cloud data warehouses (Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake) and ETL/ELT tools (dbt, Fivetran, Informatica). Master Data Management and Governance: You've architected enterprise-grade MDM systems with tools like Reltio, Informatica, Ataccama, or Stibo, built around data integrity and a unified record strategy. You know metadata management and data lineage, and you design solutions that meet GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA. Agentic AI: You've built and deployed Agentic AI solutions. You know how to connect to model providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google, and how to run local Agent Gardens for data sovereignty. Content and Enablement: You've created high-visibility expert content, such as blog posts, technical blueprints, and hands-on workshops, that eliminated manual effort and spread knowledge globally. What You'll Do Lead Strategic Engagements: Partner with Sales and Solution Engineering as the go-to resource on high-value opportunities. Work through complex architectural hurdles to drive revenue. Productize Technical Wins: Run high-impact POCs, then turn them into reusable assets like industry blueprints and solution starter kits for the global solution engineering community. Scale Technical Excellence: Distill complex innovations into training and blueprints that regional teams can run on their own. Drive Thought Leadership: Write regularly for the Boomi Community on digital transformation trends, and solve difficult technical problems in public forums. Bridge Product and PSO: Bring customer requirements to Product Management to influence roadmaps. Work with Professional Services (PSO) to move blueprints into successful Paid Pilots. Modernize Technical Validation: Replace costly, repetitive POCs with workshops and custom demonstrations. Maintain Operational Excellence: Track your impact in Jira and homerun. Manage the "Request an Expert" workflow and meet your SLAs. #LI-RS1 Be Bold. Be You. Be Boomi. We take pride in our culture and core values and are committed to being a place where everyone can be their true, authentic self. Our team members are our most valuable resources, and we look for and encourage diversity in backgrounds, thoughts, life experiences, knowledge, and capabilities. Boomi strives to create an inclusive and accessible environment for candidates and employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

items.title: Software Engineer at SF Studios and SF Anytime
items.card: Job Description Do you love film, tech and building innovative solutions? Are you driven by building stable, modern systems, and would you like to join a team where film quotes fly and the next big premiere is always up for discussion? This is your chance to combine your passion for tech with the magic of film! SF Studios is looking for a Software Engineer to help shape the future of streaming and film experiences.
items.desc: I'm interested Industry Entertainment Category Software Development Experience Experienced Location: Stockholm Workspace type: On-site Visit website Follow SF Studios Enable "functional cookies" to watch the video Job Description Do you love film, tech and building innovative solutions? Are you driven by building stable, modern systems, and would you like to join a team where film quotes fly and the next big premiere is always up for discussion? This is your chance to combine your passion for tech with the magic of film! SF Studios is looking for a Software Engineer to help shape the future of streaming and film experiences. Whether you prefer action, drama or sci-fi, this is a role where you can make a real difference. So, are you ready for the next chapter in your career? The role covers both SF Studios and SF Anytime. You’ll join a tight-knit, highly skilled team with many years of experience. What we all share is a strong interest in tech, film and series. The team has an open, non-hierarchical culture, which gives you plenty of room to influence where development goes next and to contribute to the company’s continued success. It’s a dynamic environment where you can help create magic, both at home and on the global stage. The role You’ll be part of a central development team that works across both SF Studios and SF Anytime and owns the full lifecycle of our services, from code to infrastructure and operations. You’ll work with a wide range of technologies, such as .NET, MongoDB, SQL Server, Docker, AWS, Terraform, GitHub and GitHub Actions, and Splunk. We also use AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code in our day-to-day work. Your responsibilities include: Designing and building robust, scalable and highly available APIs Building, maintaining and operating our cloud infrastructure on AWS using infrastructure as code Improving our CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and alerting to keep our services reliable in production Developing and maintaining internal and external-facing applications, including back-office systems for the business Building agentic workflows and integrations, such as MCP servers Working with other developers, product owners and stakeholders to deliver the best possible customer experience We have an office-first policy, which means the role is based at our office in Hagastaden five days a week. Requirements To be successful in this role, we believe you: Have at least a couple of years’ experience with .NET and feel at home in that environment Have solid experience with AWS (experience with Azure or GCP is also a plus) Have experience with both relational and document databases Speak Swedish – you don’t need to be fluent, but it’s a must – and have strong spoken and written English, as both languages are used every day It’s a plus if you have experience with streaming services experience building large-scale, distributed systems experience with data warehouse solutions and system integration knowledge of React As a person, you’re highly committed to your work and enjoy being part of a team. You are comfortable taking ownership and independently driving initiatives through to completion. At the same time, you actively engage with stakeholders across the business to gather input, discuss solutions and ensure that what we build meets real business needs. Furthermore, you work efficiently and have good business sense. You can argue the case for your own solution, while also being quick to acknowledge when someone else’s idea works better. You have a structured approach, take initiative and see problem-solving as something fun and challenging. Application Does this sound like a job for you? Apply today. We look forward to your application. For questions, please turn to SF Studios’ CTO Roger Levy, roger.levy@sfstudios.se. Kindly note that we do not accept applications sent through email. About the company SF Studios, founded in 1919, is one of the world’s oldest film companies and the leading film studio in the Nordic region. Its business includes production and distribution of feature films and TV series and the streaming platform SF Anytime. SF Studios has its head office in Stockholm, Sweden and subsidiaries in Oslo, Copenhagen and Helsinki, and is part of the leading Nordic media company Bonnier AB.

Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks. Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets. As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking. If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you. Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics. 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows. 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput. Core Responsibilities1. Storytelling That Converts Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy. Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth. Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion. Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct. 2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers. Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel. Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle. 3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale. Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment. Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices. Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency. 4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties. Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments. Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases …

Job Specific Context UNOPS Geneva Office is providing support to a wide range of portfolios, including UNEP, UNICEF, UNHCR, and other partners. This position is a Partner Personnel role. UNOPS is supporting UNICEF-DI as a UN Partner and acting on its behalf to provide recruitment and administrative support for this position. About UNICEF Digital Inclusion UNICEF works in some of the world’s toughest places, to reach the world’s most disadvantaged children. To save their lives. To defend their rights. To help them fulfill their potential. UNICEF’s Digital Inclusion team accelerates access to affordable, sustainable, safe and resilient digital infrastructure for every child. We do so by supporting governments and partners to expand equitable and affordable connectivity across child-facing service locations such as schools, health facilities, and social protection locations, and addressing related infrastructure such as electricity and computer. Our work empowers children and their communities through information, opportunity, choice and dignity. The Digital Inclusion team includes functions that support Giga, the joint partnership between UNICEF and ITU to connect every school to the internet. The Giga team is based at the Giga Connectivity Centre in Geneva and the Giga Technology Centre in Barcelona. Digital Inclusion team is part of the Digital Impact Division (DID), which is at the heart of reshaping how UNICEF delivers lasting results for all children everywhere, and is committed to harnessing the full potential of emerging digital technologies to advance UNICEF’s mission. DID works in close collaboration with a network of colleagues in more than 190 countries and territories at country, region and headquarters levels to leverage technologies and capabilities that accelerate progress on UNICEF’s goals, strengthen community resilience, and expand access to essential digital services and information. items.card: About the role Meridial is seeking an experienced experimental neuroscientist to join our team as Scientist – In Vivo Neurophysiology . This is a hands-on scientific role focused on developing and performing advanced in vivo experiments in mice that combine intracellular electrophysiology, two-photon imaging and optogenetic stimulation. You will develop new approaches as part of Meridial’s programme to create
items.desc: About Meridial Meridial is a Focused Research Organisation (FRO) with a mission to bring connectomics into the living brain. We are building a platform for longitudinal, synapse-resolution mapping of functional neural circuitry in preclinical models. Our aim is to deploy this platform for translational projects and improve drug development outcomes for disorders of the central nervous system. Meridial is a new not-for-profit FRO in the Convergent Research Ecosystem and funded by the Advanced Research and Invention Agency (ARIA). About the role Meridial is seeking an experienced experimental neuroscientist to join our team as Scientist – In Vivo Neurophysiology . This is a hands-on scientific role focused on developing and performing advanced in vivo experiments in mice that combine intracellular electrophysiology, two-photon imaging and optogenetic stimulation. You will develop new approaches as part of Meridial’s programme to create advanced 3D imaging and photostimulation technologies for functional mapping of neural circuits. Your initial focus will be to establish electrophysiological ground-truth measurements for Meridial’s optical approaches to mapping functional neural connectivity. You will combine targeted intracellular recordings with optical imaging and stimulation to understand how synaptic activity and neuronal spiking are reflected in fluorescence signals. Your results will help guide experimental strategy and serve as a crucial foundation for interpreting our optical data. You will also contribute more broadly to Meridial’s experimental programme. That will include performing longitudinal two-photon imaging and optogenetic experiments and developing new approaches that extend the capabilities of our platform. We are looking for an exceptional experimentalist who combines strong electrophysiological and imaging expertise with scientific independence. You will join a growing Experimental Team and report to the Director of Experimental Research. You will work closely with engineers and computational researchers across Meridial and help train and mentor experimental team members. Key Responsibilities In vivo experimentation Develop and perform high-quality in vivo whole-cell patch-clamp recordings in current and voltage clamp, including two-photon-guided targeted patching combined with optical imaging and optogenetic stimulation. Contribute to analysis of electrophysiological and imaging data. Design and run in vivo experiments combining two-photon imaging and optogenetic stimulation, including longitudinal imaging of the same animals. Perform neurosurgical procedures required for in vivo electrophysiology and imaging experiments. Monitor recording and imaging quality, physiological stability and animal welfare throughout acute and longitudinal studies and identify and resolve sources of noise, artefacts and variability. Method and platform development Set up Meridial’s in vivo electrophysiology rig together with in-house experts, integrating acquisition with two-photon imaging and optogenetic stimulation. Lead the development, optimisation and validation of targeted patching methods. Optimise experimental configurations to improve recording stability, signal quality, reproducibility and throughput, and establish quantitative quality-control criteria and reproducible workflows for electrophysiological, imaging and multimodal experiments. Work with the Computational Team to develop analysis workflows, and to make sure data and metadata meet the standards needed for open sharing. Evaluate emerging technologies and experimental approaches relevant to Meridial's platform. Scientific contribution and team development Contribute to experimental design and interpretation across Meridial's research programmes, particularly the validation of optical measurements of neural activity and connectivity. Train and mentor other team members in electrophysiological, imaging, surgical and related experimental techniques. Maintain thorough experimental documentation and promote high standards of rigour, reproducibility and animal welfare. Communicate findings, technical challenges and recommendations clearly to colleagues across disciplines. Essential Qualifications and Experience PhD in neuroscience, neurophysiology, biophysics or a related discipline, or equivalent research experience. Substantial (3+ years’) hands-on experience with whole-cell patch-clamp electrophysiology, including high-quality current-clamp recordings. Strong practical expertise in electrophysiological troubleshooting, including obtaining and maintaining stable recordings, optimising recording quality and distinguishing physiological signals from technical artefacts. Experience with the surgical preparations required for in vivo electrophysiology, such as craniotomy and headplate implantation. Substantial hands-on experience with in vivo two-photon microscopy. Excellent understanding of neuronal physiology and biophysics, including synaptic …

items.desc: Liaise is looking for an intelligent, ambitious and commercially minded individual to join our Property Team. This is an exciting opportunity for a graduate or early-career professional to build a career in property, development and investment within a growing specialist residential care organisation. The role offers broad exposure to property acquisitions, construction, development projects and commercial transactions, alongside a particular focus on using Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation and digital technology to improve how we work. We are looking for someone who is organised, curious and enthusiastic about technology, with the initiative to identify opportunities to make processes more efficient and develop practical digital solutions. Key Responsibilities Coordinate property administration, records, project documentation and reporting. Maintain property pipeline trackers, monitor deadlines and support acquisitions and transactions. Assist with construction and development projects, including budgets, programmes and milestones. Liaise with solicitors, property agents, developers, contractors and internal teams. Support legal due diligence, contractual documentation and transaction approvals. AI and Automation: Identify opportunities to use AI tools, develop AI agents and automated workflows, and explore simple applications that reduce manual work and improve efficiency. Use AI and digital tools to support research, document preparation, reporting, information analysis and project monitoring. Test and improve new processes, ensuring information is handled securely and responsibly. Essential requirements: Degree-level education or equivalent capability. Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. An interest in property, development, construction and commercial transactions. A genuine interest in AI, automation and emerging technologies, with the initiative to explore how they can improve business processes. Desirable experience: A degree in Property, Real Estate, Construction, Law, Business, Economics or a related discipline. Experience using AI tools, creating automated workflows, developing simple applications or improving digital processes. Previous experience in property, construction, project management or a commercial environment. Previous property experience is not essential. We welcome applications from graduates and candidates with strong potential, including those who have independently developed their AI and technology skills. Career Development This role offers the opportunity to develop technical and commercial property expertise while gaining practical experience in AI and business process automation. As your skills develop, you will take on increasing responsibility for property transactions, development projects and digital improvement initiatives. Why Join Liaise? Liaise provides specialist residential care for adults with learning disabilities, autism and complex needs. Our Property Team supports the organisation's growth by delivering safe, high-quality living environments. Join us to build a varied career combining property, commercial development and technology, while making a meaningful difference to people's lives.

items.desc: Quel sera votre rôle dans la #TeamDeloitte ? Description de l'emploi L'univers de la Data et de l'Intelligence Artificielle (IA) est à l'aube d'une révolution sans précédent, marquée par des avancées technologiques fulgurantes et une intégration toujours plus poussée dans tous les secteurs d'activité. L'ère de l'IA générative, avec son potentiel de transformer radicalement la stratégie de données des entreprises, s'annonce comme un tournant majeur pour les organisations. Rejoindre Deloitte France en tant qu' AI Engineer / Scientist confirmé vous offre une opportunité unique de jouer un rôle essentiel dans la conduite et la croissance de nos activités en Intelligence Artificielle au sein d'un cabinet de conseil de renommée mondiale. Vous travaillerez au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires, en étroite collaboration avec des experts métiers et des cadres dirigeants, pour transformer les défis de nos clients dans divers secteurs tels que les services financiers, le secteur de l'énergie, la santé ou encore la technologie, les médias et les télécommunications. Vous contribuerez à établir les meilleures pratiques en matière d'ingénierie IA (MLOps), de choix d'architecture technique et de delivery de produits IA en travaillant main dans la main, lorsque le contexte le permet, avec nos partenaires stratégiques (AWS, GCP, Microsoft, Databricks, Snowflake, Nvidia) . Vous aurez également l'opportunité de travailler et apprendre auprès d'une équipe d’experts de l'IA . Contribuer au delivery des projets et produits IA (Machine Learning, GenAI, NLP, Classification, Computer Vision, modélisation) pour des clients de divers secteurs Encadrer de jeunes Data Scientists et Ingénieurs ML en les coachant et assurant leur montée en compétences. Mettre en place et promouvoir les bonnes pratiques MLOps et LLMOps pour optimiser la livraison des modèles IA en production (scalabilité, fiabilité, coûts). Être un prescripteur sur les outils communs Data & IA et assurer l'identification et le déploiement d'assets techniques réutilisables (internes, groupe, marché). Contribuer activement à la veille technologique pour amplifier l'innovation et identifier les synergies entre technologies, méthodes et pratiques. Assurer la qualité des solutions, le respect des bonnes pratiques de développement et de sécurité, et intégrer les principes d'architecture de Deloitte. Capitaliser et diffuser auprès des équipes internes et externes sur les avancées et les résultats des projets IA. Participer à des initiatives d'innovation et effectuer une veille technologique sur les pratiques LLMOps. Et si c’était vous ? Au moins 3 années d'expérience significative dans le domaine du ML et de l’IA, et plus globalement de la data science, idéalement acquise dans un environnement de conseil ou en lien avec divers secteurs d'activité. Une formation scientifique et/ou informatique de niveau Bac+5 minimum, de préférence avec une spécialisation en mathématiques appliquées, machine learning ou domaines connexes. Une solide compréhension des technologies et outils d'IA, incluant notamment Python, PyTorch, ScikitLearn, services Clouds IA (Azure, GCP, AWS). La maîtrise de frameworks et outils liés aux LLM (ex?: LangChain, LangGraph, FAISS) est également un atout. Une maîtrise des concepts core du Machine Learning (Réseaux neuronaux, apprentissage non/semi/supervisé, Deep Learning, classification, modélisation). Une expérience significative dans les techniques de NLP/GenAI incluant LLM, RAG, VectorStores, Agents LLM. Une expertise avérée en gestion de projets techniques et une excellente capacité de collaboration interfonctionnelle. Une familiarité avec les processus et outils de développement modernes (DataOps, DevOps, CI/CD, Git, Docker, Kubernetes) et le déploiement de micro-services ou API (Flask, Django). Un esprit de synthèse et une capacité à travailler en équipes pluridisciplinaires. D'excellentes capacités de communication et de présentation, vous permettant d'interagir efficacement avec des profils techniques et non techniques. Une curiosité intellectuelle et d'excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes. La maîtrise des outils, méthodologies et concepts de suivi et gestion de projet est un plus.

items.desc: About At Uniplay, our vision is simple: Make Corporate Learning Fun. We're building something different — an AI-native company where games, data, and hyper-personalisation redefine how people learn and grow at work. Our product blends games, behavioral data, and AI agents into a living learning experience that adapts to employees and evolves with every organisation. We care less about titles and more about people who create, collaborate, and push limits. The role AI isn't a feature we bolted on — it's the product. Agent workflows, source grounding, RAG, structured generation, and learning science are how we turn real company material into adaptive, game-based learning. We're looking for an AI Engineer to join the team building that machinery: researching what's possible, building it, evaluating it honestly, and shipping it to customers. It's a hands-on role for someone who moves from paper to prototype to production without needing three planning meetings first. What you'll do Build AI learning pipelines end to end. From ingestion of source material to generated, adaptive learning content — research, build, ship, measure, improve, together with the rest of the engineering team. Work with messy, real knowledge sources. Documents, links, videos, internal company material. Turning that into something useful is the hard part, and it's what the team spends its days on. Build our evaluation infrastructure. Quality in generated learning content is not a vibe. Help us define how we measure it and make the numbers move. Improve the AI production system. Prompts, templates, orchestration, model selection, latency, cost, internal tooling. Find the bottlenecks and remove them. Add a strong voice to the roadmap. You'll have real influence over what we build next — and a direct line to the people making those calls. Work closely with the rest of the team. Engineers, product, design, and learning experts. You'll review each other's work, pair on hard problems, and share what you learn. What we're looking for Real experience shipping AI systems. You've built LLM-powered products that ran in production, with real users and real failure modes — not just notebooks and demos. Depth in the modern stack. RAG, agentic workflows, structured generation, evals, vector databases, knowledge graphs. You know where each one earns its keep and where it doesn't. Your own projects. You build things because you can't help it. Show us at least one — repo, demo, write-up, product. What you learned matters more than how polished it is. Extreme drive. You don't wait for permission. You make things happen and bring people along. Fast iteration. You prototype quickly, kill your own ideas when the data says so, and are comfortable with messy early-stage exploration. Strong engineering. TypeScript and/or Python. You write code others can build on. Curiosity about how people learn. The bottleneck to AI value isn't technology — it's human learning and behaviour change. If that thesis interests you, we'll get along. A team player. You share context, ask for help early, give useful feedback, and would rather the team ship something good than be right on your own. Clear communication in English. Swedish a plus. Why Uniplay Work on AI that turns company knowledge into learning experiences people voluntarily come back to. Global from day one — Sweden, Brazil, UK, DACH. A small team where your work reaches production in days, not quarters. Direct collaboration with engineers, AI specialists, HR experts, and product designers. Stockholm-base Goodbye boring. Hello fun. Apply https://careers.uniplay.io/jobs/8223234-ai-engineer

Être un prescripteur sur les outils communs Data & IA et assurer l'identification et le déploiement d'assets techniques réutilisables (internes, groupe, marché). Contribuer activement à la veille technologique pour amplifier l'innovation et identifier les synergies entre technologies, méthodes et pratiques. Capitaliser et diffuser auprès des équipes internes et externes sur les avancées et les résultats des projets IA. Participer à des initiatives d'innovation et effectuer une veille technologique sur les pratiques LLMOps. Et si c’était vous ? Au moins 3 années d'expérience significative dans le domaine du ML et de l’IA, et plus globalement de la data science, idéalement acquise dans un environnement de conseil ou en lien avec divers secteurs d'activité. Une expérience significative dans les techniques de NLP/GenAI incluant LLM, RAG, VectorStores, Agents LLM. Une expertise avérée en gestion de projets techniques et une excellente capacité de collaboration interfonctionnelle. Une familiarité avec les processus et outils de développement modernes (DataOps, DevOps, CI/CD, Git, Docker, Kubernetes) et le déploiement de micro-services ou API (Flask, Django). Un esprit de synthèse et une capacité à travailler en équipes pluridisciplinaires. D'excellentes capacités de communication et de présentation, vous permettant d'interagir efficacement avec des profils techniques et non techniques. Une curiosité intellectuelle et d'excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes. La maîtrise des outils, méthodologies et concepts de suivi et gestion de projet est un plus

items.desc: At Daiichi Sankyo, we are united by a single purpose, to improve lives around the world through innovative medicines. With a legacy of innovation since 1899, a presence in more than 30 countries, and more than 19,000 employees, we are advancing breakthrough therapies in oncology, cardiovascular disease, rare diseases, and immune disorders. Guided by our 2030 vision to "be an innovative global healthcare company contributing to the sustainable development of society", we are shaping a healthier, more hopeful future for patients, their families, and society. Purpose of the function Join our interdisciplinary Technology Intelligence team to drive digital transformation across (bio-)pharmaceutical development and manufacturing. We are looking for a passionate Data Scientist (m/f/x) who can build scalable, production-grade Modeling, Simulation (M&S) solutions using data-driven methods, machine learning, and generative AI. You will work directly with multi-disciplinary teams including scientists, engineers, and corresponding global partners to solve high-impact challenges that accelerate product development and manufacturing excellence. Roles and Responsibilities Data-Driven Insights: Analyze and interpret development and manufacturing datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies, and translate them into actionable insights for pharmaceutical scientists Modeling & Simulation: Develop and implement digital models and digital twins through mathematical models and generative AI to simulate pharmaceutical (bio-)processes, predict outcomes, and optimize workflows across early development, scale-up, and manufacturing.- Collaborative Innovation: Communicate effectively with scientific and business stakeholders from diverse backgrounds to translate complex requirements into end-user-tailored, technology-driven solutions with intuitive, advanced visualizations Data Management: Design and maintain high-quality Python-based data and model pipelines, ensuring robust data management practices for structured and unstructured data (e.g., Excel, SQL, SAP, process historians, batch records, simulation results) Innovate & Scale: Listen to operational needs, translate them into technology-driven opportunities with clear business value, and lead the delivery of scalable digital solutions across development labs, manufacturing sites, and supply chain organizations keeping Daiichi Sankyo at the cutting edge of Industry 4.0 Continuous Improvement: Continuously learn and apply state-of-the-art technologies and approaches in data science, machine learning, and generative AI. Act as a driver of continuous improvement for M&S capabilities within the function Mentorship: Guide and mentor junior team members, fostering a culture of learning, collaboration, and innovation Personal Skills And Professional Experience Modeling and Simulation Expertise: Strong background in statistics and mathematical modeling including Bayesian optimization (BoTorch, Optuna), uncertainty quantification, machine learning (scikit-learn, Pyro, Stan), and scientific computing Expert knowledge of Python and Git, with optional familiarity with R or Julia. Experience working with cloud and data platforms (Azure, GCP, AWS, Snowflake), SQL, and developing dashboards or lightweight applications using Power BI, Tableau, Python frameworks (e.g., Dash, Streamlit), or JavaScript Proactive problem-solver with strong analytical skills and a passion for science and technology, supported by a track record of working effectively in international and cross-functional global teams Fluent in English (German is a plus), with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-experts Advanced Methods (Bonus): In-depth experience with physics-based modeling (CFD, molecular modeling/dynamics), mechanistic modeling and/or generative-AI-based solutions Experience with tools such as OpenFOAM, gProms, Modelica, GROMACS, AMBER, LBM solvers, Schrödinger, or MoE is highly valued Open-minded and communicative team player Independent and results-oriented approach to work High degree of customer and service orientation Master (e.g. chartered) Master’s or PhD in Data Science, (Bio/Chemical) Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline relevant to (bio-)pharmaceutical development Several years of experience in an industrial environment in the areas of responsibility described above required Why work with us? Working at Daiichi Sankyo is more than just a job – it is your chance to make a difference and change patients’ lives for the better. We can only achieve this ambitious goal together. That is why we foster a culture of mutual respect and continuous learning, with a strong commitment to inclusion and diversity. Here, you will have the opportunity to grow, think boldly, and contribute your ideas. If you have a proactive mindset and passion for addressing the needs of patients, we eagerly await your application.

Seit 25 Jahren entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Anwendungen, die strategisch durchdacht, technologisch exzellent und langfristig tragfähig sind. Ob Business Applications, AI-Driven Development, SAP oder moderne Cloudlösungen: Unser Fokus liegt auf individueller Softwareentwicklung. Innovativ, effizient, wirksam und jenseits von Standards. Mit KI schreiben wir das nächste Kapitel: Wir verbinden 25 Jahre Engineering-Erfahrung mit agentischen Systemen, die in Produktion laufen. BE PART OF THE SOLUTION. Werde auch du Teil der Lösung! Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine:n: AI Engineer (m/w/d) – Softwareentwicklung & Agentic AI Standort: Darmstadt | Hybrid Aufgaben Du denkst in Architekturen statt in Prompts und weißt trotzdem genau, was ein guter Agent leisten kann? Dann bring deine Erfahrung zu uns. Du integrierst KI in bestehende Systeme und entwickelst auf unserer eigenen offenen KI-Plattform orchideo | coreAI agentische Workflows. Du begleitest sie vom ersten Use Case bis zum produktiven Betrieb, wie z.B. in diesem Projekt: Für einen Hersteller von Elastomer und Kunststoffteilen nimmt KI dem Einkauf und der Buchhaltung Routinearbeit ab. Eingangsrechnungen landen automatisch im ERP, und fremdsprachige Mails lassen sich direkt im Postfach verstehen und beantworten. Unsere Kunden kommen aus allen Branchen und haben jede Größe, ein Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem Mittelstand. Du entwickelst KI-Lösungen, die in Produktion laufen, von der Architektur bis zum Deployment. Das kann ein neues System sein oder eine Erweiterung der bestehenden Software unserer Kunden. Du baust agentische Systeme: Bots mit klaren Aufgaben, automatisierte Workflows über mehrere Systeme und agentische Teams, in denen spezialisierte Agents und Menschen zusammenarbeiten, abgesichert mit Guardrails und Human-in-the-loop. Du entwickelst unsere Open-Source-basierte KI-Plattform orchideo | coreAI weiter: LLM-Gateway, MCP-Anbindung an Kundensysteme, Workflow-Engines, z.B. n8n und Temporal. Betrieben wird sie on-premise, in der Cloud oder hybrid. Du sorgst dafür, dass KI im Alltag zuverlässig funktioniert. Dazu gehören Evaluierung, Monitoring, Kostenkontrolle und Wartbarkeit, und du machst aus Prototypen belastbare, produktive Lösungen. Du machst die Daten und das Wissen unserer Kunden nutzbar, mit RAG und NLP oder, wo es passt, mit klassischem ML wie Prognosen, Computer Vision und Predictive Analytics. Du baust selbst und Beratung gehört ebenso dazu. In unseren AI-Shift-Workshops bringst du die technische Perspektive ein, findest mit Kunden Use Cases, prüfst die Machbarkeit und machst daraus Umsetzungspläne. Du teilst Wissen, intern in unserer KI-Gilde und extern, zum Beispiel in Fachbeiträgen oder auf Konferenzen. Warum jetzt zu uns? Unser AI-Team besteht aktuell aus 7 Kollegen und unserer Head of AI. Unterstützt wird es von der KI-Gilde mit neun Mitgliedern, die unser KI-Wissen bündelt und das ganze Unternehmen im Wandel mitnimmt. Gerade weil das Team noch wächst, hast du großen Einfluss darauf, welche Technologien wir einsetzen und wie wir Lösungen bauen. Du arbeitest nicht in einem Innovationslabor, sondern an Lösungen für echte Kunden. Profil Du kommst aus der professionellen Softwareentwicklung und bist nun tief in KI eingetaucht. Du weißt, was es heißt, Software zu bauen, die wartbar, sicher und im Betrieb stabil ist, und genau das willst du jetzt mit KI machen. Abgeschlossenes Master-Studium der Informatik, Mathematik, Naturwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Mindestens 3-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung nach dem Studium in der professionellen Entwicklung anspruchsvoller Softwarelösungen in einem Unternehmen, egal ob mit Java, Python, TypeScript, .NET oder einem anderen Enterprise-Stack Ein solides Verständnis von Softwarearchitektur und der Integration in bestehende Systemlandschaften, z. B. APIs, Datenbanken, Cloud und CI/CD Praktische Erfahrung mit KI in echten Projekten, z. B. mit LLMs, RAG, NLP oder klassischem ML Erste Erfahrung mit Agentenarchitekturen, MCP oder Workflow-Engines wie n8n Kommunikationsstärke, ein sicheres Auftreten bei Kunden und Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) Du hast Software gebaut, die läuft und willst jetzt KI bauen, die läuft? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Wir bieten Marktgerechte Vergütung: Ein konkurrenzfähiges Gehaltspaket, das wir jährlich gemeinsam besprechen und anpassen. Die Gehaltsspanne zum Einstieg liegt je nach Erfahrung bei 65.000–85.000 € Jahresbrutto. Unternehmenskultur: Unsere Werte sind mehr als Worte. Dafür wurden wir mehrfach ausgezeichnet. way we work: Hybrid und flexibel. Du entscheidest mit deinem Team, wann und wo ihr arbeitet. Weil wir nah an unseren Kunden in der Region Ulm sind, arbeiten wir nicht zu 100 % remote. Familie & Leben: Teilzeit ist in allen Modellen möglich. Spontan mittags vom Office ins Homeoffice, weil zu Hause etwas ist? Kein Problem. …

items.desc: Love what you do – we make employment happen! Are you a passionate AI Engineer eager to build AI solutions that will reshape the European job market? We’re looking for an AI Engineer to join our cross-functional AI Hub , working across teams and products to turn the latest advances in AI into solutions used by our customers and internal teams. In this high-impact role, you’ll design, build and deploy AI-powered applications and services , working with technologies such as LLMs, Generative AI, RAG and intelligent agents . You’ll experiment with new approaches, rapidly turn ideas into prototypes, and take the most promising solutions all the way into production. WHAT IS JOBCLOUD HR TECH? JobCloud HR Tech is the Porto, Portugal based company of JobCloud, Switzerland’s number 1 job ads brand and the company behind jobs.ch and jobup.ch. We build software that helps companies spend their hiring budget efficiently and get their job ads in front of the right candidates. Millions of job seekers and thousands of companies use our platform to find each other. WHAT IS IT LIKE TO WORK AT JOBCLOUD? We work as one team of experts in our field. Our culture is inclusive and respectful, and it is built on openness and collaboration. Your skills and motivation count. Your skin colour, gender and beliefs do not matter to us. Come as you are. Our purpose is “Love what you do.” WHAT WILL YOU DO IN THIS ROLE? Design, build, and operate production AI applications that connect language models with enterprise data, APIs, and business workflows. Develop conversational and AI-assisted experiences using tool calling, structured outputs, orchestration, state management, and appropriate combinations of deterministic workflows, RAG, and agentic behavior. Integrate and prepare data from APIs, databases, document repositories, and event-driven systems, ensuring it remains secure, current, and suitable for AI use. Establish automated evaluation, testing, monitoring, tracing, feedback, and safe fallback mechanisms covering quality, groundedness, reliability, latency, and cost. Collaborate with platform and security teams on deployment, CI/CD, observability, access control, privacy, auditing, and prompt-injection defenses. Own technical designs, communicate trade-offs, review code, mentor colleagues, and turn ambiguous business needs into maintainable solutions. WHAT SKILLS & EXPERIENCE WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED? Om teamet och rollen Du landar i ett mindre team där din personlighet märks direkt. Du jobbar både med den interna organisationen och tillsammans med vår befintliga AI-konsult, så du har en teknisk kollega att bolla med samtidigt som du äger och driver de interna produkterna framåt. Här finns frihet, ansvar och en rejäl möjlighet att sätta avtryck från dag ett. I rollen kommer du att Identifiera flaskhalsar och trögheter i organisationens arbetsflöden. Designa och bygga interna produkter, AI-verktyg och automationer. Utveckla lösningar med LLM:er, AI-agenter och moderna integrationer. Förvandla data till beslutsstöd och smartare processer. Äga dina initiativ hela vägen, från problemformulering till lanserad lösning. Jobba tätt med affären och driva förändring genom teknik. Experimentera snabbt, mäta resultat och iterera kontinuerligt. Vi tror att du Har ett starkt produkttänk och drivs av att lösa riktiga problem. Tar egna initiativ och trivs med stort eget ansvar. Är nyfiken på ny teknik och lär dig snabbt. Har ett systemtänk och förstår snabbt hur saker hänger ihop. Kommunicerar lika bra och gärna med utvecklare som med andra delar av verksamheten. Location: Praha, Czechia 
Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure. 
Thales in the Czech Republic employs over 400 people from 45 different nationalities. A total of 15 teams work on projects for government agencies, banking, mobile services and the Internet Of Things (IoT) technology. At the core of our business is the development of software which we configure and embed in a multitude of different devices and form factors. These include many kinds of payment cards, SIM cards, travel passes, secure eBanking devices, authentication tokens, machine identification modules (MIM), and secure ID documents including ePassports, eID and eHealth cards, as well as eDriving licenses. Because of the international environment surrounding us every day, it comes as no surprise that English is our official corporate language.

 Modern stack, by design : We stay on the newest Java LTS and the newest Spring Framework (security expectations make this non-negotiable - and it’s a great side effect for engineers).
 Pragmatic testing : We value confidence over coverage . Integration-first where it matters. Minimal mocking. Tests that catch real issues.
 Strong CI/CD culture : Automated pipelines, multiple test layers, fast feedback, high signal.
 True ownership : We deploy to production ourselves and own the full lifecycle.
 AI-enabled engineering (for real) : Company-backed initiative with tooling, guidelines, and people driving adoption - great opportunity to level up how you use AI effectively.
 Voice and influence : Engineers are expected to speak up, challenge solutions, and improve the platform, even beyond our team boundaries.

 Design and deliver backend services where security, correctness, and maintainability are first-class requirements.
 Break down ambiguous, high-impact problems into a clear plan and ship iteratively.

items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 As a Specialist Export Control, you will hold a critical position in bridging the gap between regulatory compliance and operational execution. You will act as a high-agency professional, taking full ownership of our daily export control operations—including licensing, releases, screening, and the customs interface. Beyond day-to-day throughput, your work will directly enable our growth by driving the projects that make these operations scalable, such as system rollouts, process automation, and building licensing architectures for new programs and sites. This role requires a hands-on specialist who thrives on operational excellence, complementing our ITAR/EAR regulatory function by owning our process architecture. You will work directly with our Executive Export Control Officer ( Ausfuhrverantwortlicher ) and design the vital controls they rely on, while formal personal liability remains at the management level.
 The day-to-day 
 Operations — Driving Daily Execution 
 End-to-End BAFA Licensing: Manage individual, global, and general licenses (AGG) for exports, transfers, and tech data, including conditions and deadlines.
 Transaction Releases: Clear shipments, services, and software releases (list checks, end-use/end-user verification, catch-all assessments).
 Sanctions Screening: Execute and document EU, UN, OFAC, and UK list screenings, resolving hits and false positives.
 ERP Master Data: Ensure export control classifications (AL-No., ECCN) in the ERP match the reality of our products.
 Customs Interface: Align with logistics and brokers on ATLAS filings, proofs of origin, and Carnets.
 Advisory & Documentation: Guide internal stakeholders (Sales, Engineering, Procurement) and maintain an audit-proof record of all compliance decisions.
 Projects — Scaling for Tomorrow 
 Program Export Concepts: Build licensing architectures for new programs, consortia, and sites right from the proposal phase.
 System Rollouts & Automation: Drive the implementation and optimization of export control tools (e.g., SAP GTS, AEB, Descartes) to automate workflows.
 ICP Evolution: Upgrade internal processes and control mechanisms to meet BAFA ICP requirements.
 Audits & Metrics: Lead internal checks, support external/AEO audits, and establish hard KPIs (lead times, hit rates) over gut feeling.
 Team Enablement: Design and roll out practical, target-group-specific compliance trainings.
 You should apply if you 
 Have deep operational expertise: You bring at least 5 years of hands-on experience in operational export control within an industrial, technology, or defense company—or in a comparably transaction-heavy role
 Drive outcomes through project leadership: You have a proven track record of independently leading projects—such as system rollouts, process digitization, or building export frameworks—while steering stakeholders across departments
 Are a BAFA & EU regulatory specialist: You confidently apply AWG/AWV, the EU Dual-Use Regulation (EU) 2021/821, national control lists ( Ausfuhrliste ), and EU sanctions law in your daily practice, and have extensive experience with BAFA licensing procedures including ELAN-K2
 Understand systems beyond the user interface: You have practical experience with ERP or export control software (e.g., SAP, SAP GTS, AEB) coupled with a strong grasp of underlying master data and screening logic
 Thrive under real time pressure: You maintain a structured, deadline-driven approach and autonomously prioritize when twenty release requests hit your desk at once
 Are a clear communicator: You navigate complex topics with professional fluency in both written and spoken German and English 
 Can obtain security clearance: You are willing and eligible to undergo a national security clearance check (SÜG)
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to Have 
 Knowledge of ITAR/EAR and US (re-)export regulations—while deep regulatory expertise sits with the …

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenCreative brings together leading image and video models alongside our own audio models, so our users can make everything they need in one place. We are looking for someone to own our relationships with the model providers who make that possible, starting with video.

You will be the main point of contact for our model partners, help bring new models to ElevenCreative, and build partnerships that are good for our partners, our users, and our business. You will work closely with product, engineering, finance, marketing, and sales.

This is a green-field role. You will define how we work with model partners as the ecosystem grows.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - Build and manage relationships with image and video model providers.

 - Identify and evaluate new partners and models to bring to ElevenCreative.

 - Own the commercial side of our partnerships, working closely with finance.

 - Drive marketing including joint launches, campaigns, and co-marketing.

 - Work with product and engineering to shape which models we offer and when.

 - Support enterprise sales on partnership needs for large customers.

 - Stay close to the generative video landscape and the models creators and marketers want next.


WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for someone who combines strong partnership skills with sound commercial judgment. You will thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, or commercial roles at a technology company, ideally in AI or infrastructure.

 - Have deep familiarity with the generative AI model landscape.

 - Are comfortable with numbers and can connect partnership decisions to business outcomes.

 - Can manage several partner relationships at once and build trust with senior stakeholders.

 - Have worked cross-functionally with product, engineering, finance, and marketing.

 - Can operate with US and European timezone overlap, with flexibility for partners in Asia.

 - Thrive in fast-moving environments where you define the playbook rather than follow one.


BONUS

 - Experience working with AI model or API providers.

 - Familiarity with usage-based or credit-based pricing.

 - Experience running co-marketing or channel partnerships.

items.desc: Hi, we're glad you're here! We are hiring to our Aviva Services Excellence Centre! Take a look at our job description - maybe it suits you or one of your friends? We are looking for an AI Quality Engineer to join Aviva Services Excellence Centre (ASEC) and help build confidence in the quality, safety and reliability of AI-powered products. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys understanding how AI systems behave, identifying weaknesses before they become customer problems, and creating reliable ways of measuring whether AI solutions are actually delivering the outcomes they were designed for. You will work across conversational AI, autonomous agents and other AI-powered systems, partnering closely with engineers, product teams and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are robust, trustworthy and ready for production use. What will you be doing? Translating business expectations, user outcomes and operational risks into measurable evaluation criteria. Defining what successful, partially successful and unsuccessful system behaviour looks like, including the gradient between clear success and clear failure. Designing evaluation approaches for conversational, multi-turn and non-deterministic AI systems. Building and maintaining representative evaluation datasets covering common, rare, boundary and high-risk scenarios. Assessing dataset quality, including coverage, class balance, duplicates, data leakage, label quality, synthetic-versus-production differences and dataset freshness. Selecting appropriate manual, deterministic, model-based and statistical evaluation methods. Analysing errors by category, user journey, risk level and likely root cause. Distinguishing model failures from failures in retrieval, chunking, ranking, prompts, tools, guardrails, integrations, source data and evaluators. Validating automated evaluators, including LLM-as-a-Judge, against human judgement. Detecting blind spots, noise, bias and misleading aggregation in evaluation results. Creating baselines, controlled comparisons and regression tests that allow meaningful comparison between system versions. Prioritising tests according to the probability and impact of failure rather than coverage alone. Communicating results, uncertainty, limitations and residual risks in a form that supports release and product decisions. Proactively identifying emerging failure modes based on system changes, production observations and research. What we're looking for: Professional experience in quality engineering, software testing, test automation, data science, software engineering or a related field (we can consider different seniority levels) . Experience or strong interest in working with AI-powered solutions, either through developing, testing, evaluating or supporting them. Good Python proficiency and experience writing clean, maintainable code for analysis, automation or testing purposes. Interest in understanding how AI systems behave, how reliable they are, and how their quality can be measured. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues and identify root causes. Ability to translate business objectives, customer outcomes and risks into practical evaluation approaches. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A curious, proactive mindset and a genuine interest in AI, emerging technologies and system robustness. Nice to have: Experience evaluating, testing or monitoring AI-powered systems in production environments. Working with structured data, especially JSON, logs and tabular evaluation results. Understanding of LLM behaviour, tokenisation, context limits, parameters and non-determinism. Understanding of multi-turn context, RAG, grounding, faithfulness, hallucinations, guardrails, attacks (like prompt injection etc.) and tool/function calling. Software engineering practices: Git, modular code, configuration management and automated tests. items.desc: Joining KEYES means giving purpose to your talent. Are you looking for an environment where technology is not an end in itself, but a lever to build a sustainable future? At KEYES , we are not just looking for technical expertise; we are looking for people who share our values. Do you want to continue your career and grow within one of Belgium’s leading IT companies? Join KEYES as a Technical Infrastructure & Network Architect! KEYES supports private and public organizations in Belgium and across Europe in their digital transformation by combining business expertise, technological mastery, and a long-term vision. We support large enterprises, the public sector, healthcare organizations, and SMEs in all their digital challenges : Infrastructure & Cloud Solutions, Cybersecurity Solutions, Business Software Solutions, Mainframe Solutions, Data & AI Solutions, Advisory Solutions, and Staffing Solutions. More information: www.keyes.eu YOUR MISSION Provide technical architecture leadership across infrastructure, network, cloud and hybrid environments, supporting transformation, modernization and operational initiatives across multiple projects and sites, including industrial/OT environments. The role is to define coherent, secure, resilient and operable technical architectures and support their delivery from design through implementation and transition to operations. The architect must be able to reason beyond individual infrastructure components and understand the broader architecture context: applications, data flows, trust zones, integration mechanisms, cloud connectivity, security and operational constraints. Positioning within the Architecture Organization The Technical Infrastructure & Network Architect works closely with Enterprise, Solution, Application, Data, Cloud and Security Architects, as well as Infrastructure, Network, DevOps and project teams. The role is accountable for the technical infrastructure architecture required to host, connect, secure, operate and recover solutions, including network, compute, storage, backup, cloud/hybrid infrastructure, container foundations and observability. End-to-end architecture is developed jointly. The architect must actively contribute to cross-domain architecture decisions and challenge proposed solutions when required. Network and infrastructure architecture are considered part of the overall solution architecture, not isolated technical domains. Key responsibilities Translate business, application and solution requirements into technical architecture requirements covering hosting, connectivity, performance, availability, security, resilience, backup/recovery, monitoring and supportability. Define target and reference architectures, reusable standards and technical patterns across sites. Produce HLDs and architecture documentation, and review LLDs and detailed technical designs. items.desc: Are you a high-caliber finance professional who loves turning data into direction and insight into impact? Join us as Group FP&A Lead and play a central role in shaping performance, guiding strategic decisions, and elevating financial rigor across the organization. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on building robust forecasting frameworks, partnering with leaders, and driving continuous improvement in a dynamic, growth-focused environment. Principal Accountabilities Develop and apply professional expertise; use company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues and recommend process improvements. Determine appropriate courses of action within established guidelines; adapt processes and methods when required. Work on problems of moderate scope, often varied and routine, requiring review of multiple factors and sound judgment within defined procedures. Apply learned techniques; contribute to analysis and investigation to solve problems with limited day-to-day instruction. Build productive internal and external relationships; collaborate to resolve mutual problems and improve procedures or transactions. Provide standard professional advice; create initial reports/analyses for review by senior team members. Partner with leaders across functions (Commercial, Operations, People, Tech) to translate strategy into numbers and numbers into action. Prepare high-impact board and executive materials: dashboards, trend analyses, cash flow outlooks, risks/opportunities, and recommendations. Enhance FP&A processes, calendar discipline, and governance; improve close-to-forecast cycle time and forecast accuracy. Strengthen data and reporting foundations; leverage BI and planning tools to automate recurring reports and elevate analytical depth. Support investment cases, pricing, and unit economics; contribute to capital allocation discipline and performance management. Coach and elevate the broader finance team’s analytical toolkit and stakeholder engagement. What You’ll Bring A strong finance toolkit: advanced Excel/Google Sheets, driver-based modeling, scenario analysis, and executive-ready storytelling. Proven ability to synthesize complex data, challenge constructively, and influence decisions with clear, commercially focused insights. Track record of improving processes, closing gaps in data/controls, and driving scalable reporting solutions. Curiosity, accountability, and a bias for action—comfortable operating with autonomy while collaborating cross-functionally. Preferred Qualifications 5+ years of FP&A or corporate finance experience, ideally in multi-entity/group or fast-paced environments. Professional qualification (e.g., CPA, ACCA, CIMA) or MBA. Experience with planning and BI tools (e.g., Anaplan, Adaptive, NetSuite Planning, Power BI, Tableau, Looker). Exposure to board reporting, consolidation, and cash flow forecasting. items.desc: Pour un grand compte en Île-de-France, nous recherchons un Chef de projet infrastructure sénior pour renforcer, au sein de la DSI, l'équipe en charge de la roadmap et des projets d'infrastructure. Cette équipe pilote les projets techniques de l'entreprise : briques techniques (montées de version de palier OS, SGBD, nouvelles offres de service), reprises d'exploitation (reprise d'infrastructures, définition du modèle d'exploitation) projets autour des nouvelles technologies (cloud, conteneurs, Infrastructure as Code). Vous conduisez ces projets depuis l'étude d'opportunité jusqu'au déploiement et à l'intégration complète en production, dans le respect des engagements de qualité, coûts, délais et sécurité. Démarrage en binôme avec le chef de projet en place pour une reprise progressive du portefeuille. Missions Rédiger et porter les demandes de financement des études et des projets (fiche d'opération, dossier d'opportunité, dossier de décision d'investissement). Piloter la conception générale des projets : cahier des charges, dossier de conception générale. Organiser, planifier, coordonner et piloter l'ensemble des ressources, processus et intervenants internes et externes mobilisés. Contribuer aux phases d'achats : RFI, POC, appel d'offres, dossier de consultation, sélection des fournisseurs. Assurer le suivi financier, le plan de charges, le planning et la gestion des risques ; définir le plan de management et le plan d'assurance qualité du projet. Assurer les activités d'AMOA projet : analyse fonctionnelle du besoin, rédaction des spécifications, réalisation des recettes. Animer les revues et comités de pilotage, produire ordres du jour et comptes rendus. Conduire le changement de bout en bout et assurer le transfert de compétences aux équipes de production ; définir et piloter la mise en ?uvre de la maintenance des nouvelles solutions. Environnement technique Deux datacenters, 550 applications, 1 500 serveurs physiques, 5 300 serveurs virtuels, 3 Po de stockage, plus de 2 000 instances de bases de données. Stockage EMC et NetApp, sauvegarde Commvault, réseau Cisco / Checkpoint / Fortinet / F5, RedHat Linux et Windows, VMware, OpenStack, Docker, Kubernetes, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL Server, WebLogic, Tomcat, Apache, GitLab, Ansible, Terraform, Azure, AWS, ServiceNow, Centreon, Nagios. Pratique des méthodologies agiles (Scrum, JIRA) et de la culture ITIL (transition projet vers RUN, modèle d'exploitation, CAB, recette). Qualités rédactionnelles pour les dossiers d'opportunité, cahiers des charges et comptes rendus. Autonomie, méthode, rigueur, bon relationnel ; capacité d'organisation, d'anticipation, de priorisation, de proposition, de conseil et d'alerte ; goût du travail en équipe. Rapidement opérationnel ; français courant.

items.desc: Qui sommes-nous ? Cybersecura est une équipe de passionnés par la gouvernance en cybersécurité et qui met l'exigence au centre de leur quotidien. Nous sommes persuadés que la sécurisation du numérique ne doit pas être un privilège des grandes entreprises. C’est pourquoi nous avons décidé d’accompagner les TPE et PME avec la même exigence. Être RSSI à temps partagé chez Cybersecura , ce n’est pas juste vendre une offre, c’est être au côté de nos clients avec un accompagnement personnalisé, un service de qualité et une écoute active afin de délivrer des solutions pertinentes avec leurs besoins. Nous nous sommes lancés il y a 10 ans et nous avons conservé l’énergie d’une entreprise qui n’a pas peur d’évoluer chaque jour . Nous recherchons une personne qui a cette envie d'allier exigence et passion et qui se sent prête à co-construire avec nous. Ton rôle et tes missions : En tant que Consultant(e) GRC Cybersécurité, tes missions seront les suivantes : Piloter la sécurité de nos clients de la stratégie à l'exécution. Participer à l’accompagnement de nos clients vers les certifications clés (ISO 27001, SOC 2) en contribuant à la mise en place de leur SMSI. Réaliser des analyses de risques pour identifier les menaces et concevoir des plans d'action adaptés. Rédiger des documents de gouvernance (PSSI, PCA/PRA, PAS). Ton profil : Nous recherchons un profil capable d'allier l'exigence de la sécurité à la réalité métier de nos clients. L'envie d'apprendre et de progresser est primordiale chez Cybersecura ! Tu as 3 ans d’expérience minimum dans le domaine de la GRC ou de l'audit en cybersécurité dans une entreprise similaire à la nôtre ou chez un client final. Tu possèdes un Bac+5 informatique/Sécurité ou une solide expérience professionnelle équivalente. Tes savoir-faire : Cartographie & Architecture : Cartographier un système d’information, analyser des zones de confiance et des flux (TCP/IP, DNS, TLS). Analyse d'architecture : Identifier les données sensibles et les points d’exposition. Analyse de vulnérabilités : Interpréter les rapports de pentest et de scan pour prioriser les actions. Environnements & sécurité technique : Maîtrise des environnements (Active Directory, M365, AWS/Azure, Linux/Windows) et évaluation des mesures de sécurité (MFA, EDR, sauvegardes, pentests). Gestion des risques : Conduite d’analyses de risques et élaboration de plans de traitement adaptés. Normes & Gouvernance : Maîtrise de la norme ISO 27001 et structuration de l'architecture documentaire (PSSI, politiques, procédures). Communication : Capacité à vulgariser des concepts complexes et à interagir avec tous types d'interlocuteurs. Tes savoir-être : Autonomie : Gérer ses missions, anticiper les besoins et proposer des solutions. Rigueur : Adopter une approche méthodique et exigeante pour garantir la qualité. Adaptabilité : Maîtriser rapidement les outils et respecter les procédures internes. Co-construction : Contribuer au développement de l'entreprise. Collaboration : Avoir un esprit d'équipe, faire preuve de bienveillance et d'entraide. Pourquoi rejoindre CyberSecura ? Nous créons la cybersécurité ensemble et en équipe . Un environnement où l'humain, la pédagogie et l'accompagnement sont au centre de nos méthodes. Des possibilités d’évolution tout au long de ton aventure Cybersecura grâce à des feedbacks constructifs et des mobilités internes. Une grande diversité de missions (audit, conseil, rédaction, formation) qui te permet de développer de nouvelles compétences et d’éviter la routine. Des avantages tout au long de l’année : 2 jours de télétravail, ticket restau 7€ avec une prise en charge à 60 % par l’entreprise, des certifications financées après la validation de ta période d’essai. Notre processus de recrutement : Entretien d’une heure avec Sarah (notre Consultant RH) et Soroush (notre Directeur des Opérations) Cas pratique d’une heure maximum Entretien de 40 minutes avec Saghar notre Directrice Générale Tu as envie de relever de nouveaux défis, d’avoir des missions à impact et de participer au développement d’une belle entreprise ? Alors envoie-nous ton CV et explique-nous rapidement ta passion pour la cybersécurité. P.S. Chez CyberSecura, nous privilégions l'authenticité, donc n’hésite pas à nous le montrer à travers ton CV ! La plateforme data du groupe a été construite avec l’appui d’un intégrateur externe. Nextpool internalise aujourd’hui cette compétence et formalise un pôle Data & IA. Le poste est créé pour porter au quotidien l’exploitation et l’évolution de la plateforme, reprendre les développements historiques et fiabiliser l’alimentation des usages métier. Le pôle porte deux volets indissociables. Le premier est la donnée : entrepôt, flux, qualité, restitution. Le second est l’intelligence artificielle appliquée, avec plusieurs cas d’usage : assistant conversationnel de configuration et de chiffrage produit, classification automatique de commandes, exploitation de bases de connaissances internes, automatisation de processus métier. Ce second volet s’appuie directement sur la qualité du socle de données et constitue une part croissante de l’activité du pôle. Le ou la titulaire du poste est le premier profil data à temps plein du groupe. Il ou elle travaille en binôme avec le RSI, qui assure l’architecture et la feuille de route du pôle. Ici, les circuits de décision sont courts, les utilisateurs sont proches, et ce que vous livrez sert très vite sur le terrain, en usine comme dans les équipes commerciales. 2.
