Documenter les flux, leurs dépendances et leurs règles de gestion. 2.2 Faire évoluer l’entrepôt de données Snowflake Développer et maintenir les modèles de transformation sous dbt (versionnés sous Git). Faire évoluer la modélisation Data Vault et les couches de restitution associées. Mettre en place les tests de données et la documentation générée. Suivre les performances et la consommation de la plateforme. 2.3 Alimenter et fiabiliser le socle décisionnel Construire et maintenir les jeux de données exposés à Power BI. Fiabiliser les rapports de direction et rationaliser l’existant. Accompagner les utilisateurs métier dans la compréhension et l’usage des données. 2.4 Qualité et gouvernance de la donnée Formaliser le dictionnaire de données et les règles de gestion du groupe. Mettre en place les contrôles de cohérence et les indicateurs de qualité. Contribuer à la gestion des référentiels partagés entre entités. 2.5 Contribuer aux produits IA et aux automatisations du groupe Exposer et structurer les données nécessaires aux applications d’IA : référentiels produits, tarifaires, historiques de commandes, bases de connaissances internes. Développer et maintenir les automatisations de processus . Contribuer aux développements : assistants conversationnels, classification et enrichissement automatiques de données, extraction documentaire. Mettre en place les mécanismes d’accès aux données pour les agents et assistants internes. Participer à l’évaluation et à la recette des cas d’usage. Assurer une veille technique sur l’écosystème data et IA et proposer des évolutions. 3. Environnement technique Entrepôt et transformation : Snowflake (modélisation Data Vault), dbt, SQL. Intégration : Talend, PowerShell (existant à refondre), flux EDI, API. Restitution : Power BI. Sources : Divalto, Cegid PMI, Cegid Primavera, Salesforce, SQL Server, MariaDB / MySQL. Outillage : Git. Profil recherché : Formation et expérience Formation supérieure en informatique ou en data (Bac+3 à Bac+5). 3 à 5 ans d’expérience sur un poste équivalent, en entreprise ou en société de services. items.desc: Location Cologne, North Rhine-Westphalia Category Engineering, Technology, & Science Job Type Full time Job Id R3000875 Posted Date 10/26/2026 JOB DESCRIPTION Title: Biomedical Engineer At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results. Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact. Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment. About Us KBR GmbH was established in October 2000 to provide human spaceflight medical support services to the European Space Agency’s (ESA) Space Medicine Team (SMT) at the European Astronaut Center (EAC) in Cologne, Germany. KBR GmbH specializes in the provision of biomedical engineering, space medicine projects including Crew Health and Performance (CHP) technology evaluation, health care administration, psychology, nutrition, medical informatics and technology, fitness and rehabilitation, physiotherapy, and medical education. By developing expertise in these core areas whilst supporting capacity building and broader strategy/risk management, KBR GmbH has expanded to provide support services to a range of customers in aerospace, government and space life science/medical research. Thus, KBR GmbH’s employees contribute to a wide range of projects including astronaut selection and training, ongoing medical operations to the International Space Station and other Low Earth Orbit (LEO) missions, whilst supporting the ESA SMT’s endeavors in preparation for space exploration beyond LEO. Benefit highlights with working for KBR GmbH Training and Education support Worker’s Compensation coverage Company pension scheme KVB Job ticket support – (Local Transportation support - Cologne and Bonn Area); Sport Membership Benefit Hybrid/working options WHEN APPLYING, PLEASE INCLUDE A COVER LETTER WITH YOUR RESUME. Purpose of the Job A Biomedical Engineer (BME) is a member of the ESA Space Medicine Team (SMT) within the Engineering & Operations (E&O) unit. The general function of the BME is to ensure astronaut health and well-being by providing medical operational, engineering, and project support to the ESA crew surgeons, the SMT medical project unit, and other ESA human spaceflight mission support disciplines. This includes medical technology development support, document preparation, operational processes development, flight controller training, and console support in the role of EAC Crew Operations Support (ECOS) Flight Controller and/or EUROCOM Flight Controller. As ECOS Flight Controller, the BME ensures the ops preparation and real time implementation of ESA activities assigned to ECOS in the domain of crew support, astronaut training, medical operations and technology testing. As EUROCOM flight controller, the BME is responsible for Crew Communications and Medical Operations. In the EUROCOM role on console, the BME facilitates communication between the ESA Flight Controllers on the ground and the crew on board the ISS and represents the ESA crew’s interest in the ESA Flight Control Team. He/she ensures the implementation of the ESA Flight Program, monitors and annotates biomedical, environmental, and other crew-related data, maintains awareness of ongoing on-orbit operations, and ensures the implementation of the ESA Medical Support Program. A large portion of the job corresponding to flight operations involves responding to new situations as they arise. Job Functions (may include the following and other activities as reasonably assigned): GENERAL functions Implement ESA crew medical activities during pre-flight, in-flight, and post-flight mission phases in coordination with the ESA Crew Surgeon, Health Care Administrator, Fitness, Rehabilitation and Countermeasure expert, Psychologist, and other space medicine experts (as necessary). items.desc: Über thexton armstrong "Wir glauben: Nicht jeder Unternehmer ist ein geborener Entrepreneur. Aber jeder Unternehmer kann einer werden – mit der richtigen Begleitung." thexton armstrong wurde 2011 in den Niederlanden gegründet mit einer klaren Mission: KMU-Inhabern die Unterstützung geben, die sie wirklich brauchen – nicht als externe Berater, die Präsentationen liefern, sondern als Vertrauenspersonen, die langfristig an ihrer Seite bleiben. Heute ist das Netzwerk in 5 Ländern aktiv, zählt über 100 Partner und hat Hunderte von KMU geholfen, profitabler, stabiler und besser managebar zu werden. In Deutschland startete das Franchise Ende 2024 – jetzt kommt Nord- und Ostdeutschland. Als thexton armstrong Partner in Berlin, Hamburg, Hannover, Bremen, Leipzig, Dresden oder einer der anderen Metropolregionen der Region arbeiten Sie mit einem bewährten System, einer anerkannten Marke und einem Netzwerk gleichgesinnter Profis – europaweit. Das Geschäftsmodell Als Franchise Partner gewinnen Sie KMU-Inhaber (5-10 Klienten) als langfristige Mentoring-Mandate. Die Zusammenarbeit läuft über strukturierte KMU-Programme in drei Phasen: Discovery Session – Sie knüpfen eine Verbindung, verstehen die persönliche Motivation des Unternehmers, seine Hoffnungen und Herausforderungen. Profit Leakage Session – Mit dem thexton armstrong Online-Tool identifizieren Sie live, wo und wie viel Profit aus dem Unternehmen fließt. Sofortige, greifbare Erkenntnisse. Proposal Session – Gemeinsam planen Sie die Zusammenarbeit: welches Programm, welche Ziele, welche Schritte. Klienten unterschreiben Verträge mit monatlicher Abrechnung – das schafft planbare, wiederkehrende Einnahmen für Sie und entlastet die Cashflow-Planung des Klienten. Ein typisches Klienten-Portfolio: 5–10 KMU mit Mandatslaufzeiten von 12+ Monaten. Viele Beziehungen dauern mehrere Jahre. Ihre Aufgaben als Franchise Partner Klientenakquisition: Sie identifizieren und gewinnen KMU-Inhaber in Ihrer Region – durch Netzwerkarbeit, Empfehlungen und aktives Outreach. Business Mentoring: Sie begleiten Ihre Klienten langfristig bei Wachstum, Profitabilitätssteigerung, Restrukturierung und Unternehmensnachfolge. Profit Leakage Analysen: Sie führen strukturierte Unternehmensanalysen mit dem thexton armstrong Online-Tool durch und präsentieren klare, umsetzbare Erkenntnisse. Programmbegleitung: Sie steuern aktiv ein Portfolio von 5–10 KMU-Klienten durch maßgeschneiderte KMU-Programme (Wachstum, Stabilisierung, Exit). Netzwerkaufbau: Sie etablieren sich als anerkannter KMU-Experte in Ihrer Region – durch IHK-Engagements, Vorträge, Events und digitale Präsenz. Eigenes Unternehmertum: Sie führen Ihr eigenes Unternehmen – von der Akquisition über die Leistungserbringung bis zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung. Community & Netzwerk: Sie nehmen an regelmäßigen Peer-Exchanges, Trainings und Best-Practice-Sessions mit dem europaweiten thexton armstrong Netzwerk teil. Was Sie bei uns finden Neustart ohne Neuanfang: Ihre Erfahrung ist das Fundament – nicht das Problem. Unternehmerische Freiheit: Kein Chef, keine Konzernpolitik, keine Abstimmungsschleifen. Planbare Einnahmen: Langfristige Verträge und monatliche Abrechnung – keine Projektabhängigkeit. Echte Wirkung: Sie helfen KMU-Inhabern sichtbar und messbar – das motiviert täglich neu. Gemeinschaft: Ein Netzwerk gleichgesinnter Partner – kein einsames Freelancer-Dasein. Unterstützung von Anfang an: 10-15-tägiges Onboarding, laufendes Coaching, fertige Tools und Templates, Unterstützung bei der Leadgenerierung. Was Sie erhalten Exklusive Regionallizenz: Ihr eigenes, geschütztes Territorium in Nord/Ostdeutschland. Bewährte Methodik: Vollständige Toolbox inkl. Profit Leakage Applikation, Klientenprogramme, Playbooks und Templates – ab Tag 1 einsetzbar. 10-15-tägiges Onboarding: Intensive Einarbeitung in Foundation und KMU-Programme über zwei Monate – praxisnah und strukturiert. Laufendes Coaching: Regelmäßige 1-on-1-Begleitung durch den Master Franchise Partner Christian von Volkmann und das internationale Team. Marketing & Vertrieb: Fertige Kampagnen, Klientenmaterialien, Podio CRM, LinkedIn-Templates und digitale Marketingunterstützung. Peer-Netzwerk: Zugang zu 25+ Franchise Partnern und deren Netzwerk in NL, BE, UK und Deutschland – Peer Exchanges, Best Practices, gemeinsame Entwicklung. Wiederkehrende Einnahmen: Jahresverträge mit monatlicher Abrechnung schaffen planbare, stabile Einnahmen – ohne Projektabhängigkeit. Unternehmerische Freiheit: Sie führen Ihr eigenes Unternehmen – unabhängig, flexibel und ohne interne Konzernpolitik. Wir suchen keine Lizenz-Nehmer. Wir suchen erfahrene Unternehmer, Führungskräfte und Berater, die den nächsten großen Schritt machen wollen – mit Rückhalt, Methodik und Gemeinschaft. Erfahrung General Management oder Erfahrung in mind. 2 Funktionsbereichen (Sales, Finance, Operations, Strategy) Oder: Erfahrung als (Mit-)Inhaber oder Investor eines Unternehmens Oder: Aktiv als unabhängiger Business Consultant …

items.desc: Vacancy ID 13045 Download as PDF In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program. TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution. The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, a Doctoral Fellowship for a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027 . The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Cultural Studies . Primary supervision will be provided by Prof. Dr. Orit Halpern, Chair of Digital Cultures. The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of Cultural Studies, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme: AI and Energy Histories/STS studies of Finance, Digitalization, and Energy Energy Infrastructures Environment, Energy, and Design Cybernetics and Energy Cultures Tasks: Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Cultural Studies. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory. Requirements: You hold an excellent university degree in Cultural Studies or a comparable field such as Geography, Anthropology or History. We especially welcome studies with global perspectives, particularly from North America, Asia or Africa. You possess strong teamwork skills and a willingness to collaborate across disciplines, and demonstrably excellent English language skills (C1 level minimum). Knowledge of German is desirable but not a requirement. We offer: The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. Familiarity with Git, DevOps practices, continuous integration, and continuous delivery. Experience optimising applications across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web platforms and ecosystems. items.desc: Job Description Network Engineer Job Location: Stockholm Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country Req Id: 13203 Posting Start Date: 10/26/26 At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age. With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). About the role: We are looking for a highly skilled Network Engineer with 5+ years of experience who thrives on solving complex network issues and wants to help drive our service delivery to the next level. The position is within our Stockholm-based Network team, part of Hybrid IT Services. This role plays a central part within the team and offers the opportunity to become a trusted network expert across the organization. We are looking for someone, who has a strong background in implementing and developing large-scale network solutions, a solid understanding of network infrastructure fundamentals, and a hands-on approach to network architecture and design. Proficiency in Swedish is a plus, while fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required. We are looking for: Extensive experience operating and troubleshooting enterprise firewalls (Palo Alto, Check Point), along with experience in Cisco, Cisco ISE, and HPE/Aruba troubleshooting, and a solid understanding of best-practice configurations. Deep understanding of routing and switching protocols (OSPF, BGP, VLANs, STP). In-depth knowledge of firewall architectures and technologies (Palo Alto, Juniper, Fortinet/FortiGate). Proficient in implementing VPN solutions (Site-to-Site and GlobalProtect). Skilled in performing packet captures, analyzing traffic flows, and interpreting logs. Proactive, analytical mindset with a strong focus on root-cause analysis. Solid understanding of automation, Ansible/Python, and Linux. Strong team player with excellent communication skills, capable of taking a lead role when needed, and able to remain calm under pressure. Bonus if you have: Experience with monitoring and alerting tools (Zabbix, Prometheus, Op5, Cisco Catalyst Center, etc.). Familiarity with Linux networking tools (tcpdump, traceroute, iptables). Network/security certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, PCNSE, or CCSA/CCSE. In this role, you will: Play a key role in a high-availability environment where your expertise has direct impact. Collaborate in a culture centered on teamwork, continuous learning, and technical excellence. Have opportunities to cross-train in automation, security, and advanced routing. Benefit from flexible working conditions and modern tools to support your work. For the consultant/employee selected for the role, checks of public registers and records relating to financial and legal status will be conducted. By submitting an application, the candidate consents to such checks being carried out. Relocation Supported: No Visa Sponsorship Approved: No At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

The organisation is at the heart of the Governments cyber security strategy and has the aim of making the UK the safest place to live and work online. Job description This is an exciting opportunity to join NCSCs multidisciplinary User Centred Research and Design (UCRD) team. Strengthening the UKs ability to protect itself against cyber security threats depends on NCSC guidance, tools and services being accessible, usable and trusted by millions of diverse users. Through mixed-method research, iterative testing and evidence-based design approaches, we help shape end-to-end services based on user insight rather than assumption. By identifying risks and validating ideas early, we inform strategy, support teams to make informed delivery decisions, reduce avoidable cost and technical debt, and improve the UKs cyber resilience. You will plan and conduct user research or user experience activities, generate actionable insights, advocate for diverse users and help teams make informed decisions based on evidence rather than assumptions. Senior User Research or User Experience specialists: will lead the delivery of research and design activities across projects, advising teams on appropriate methods and helping colleagues embed user-centred approaches throughout delivery. They will share insights with stakeholders, provide constructive challenge, support decision-making, and contribute to peer review and continuous improvement within the wider User Research and User Experience community. Lead User Research or User Experience specialists: will provide expert strategic advice to multidisciplinary teams and senior stakeholders, shaping requirements, influencing delivery approaches and ensuring user needs are considered from the earliest stages of work. They will apply their specialist expertise to balance user needs, organisational priorities and technical constraints, provide technical leadership and quality assurance across the UCRD capability, mentor and support senior practitioners, and escalate significant risks or blockers where required. Alongside project delivery, you will provide specialist User Research or User Experience consultancy and support to a variety of NCSC initiatives, including large-scale public-facing campaigns that help individuals and organisations stay secure online. You will also have opportunities to collaborate with user-centred specialists across government, contributing to nationally significant services and sharing best practice across the wider profession. As part of a growing team, you will help shape the future of UCRD within the NCSC. You will contribute to the development of our ways of working, support capability growth, and strengthen professional relationships across the government user-centred research and design community to promote …

items.desc:
À propos du rôle 
 Au sein de la practice AI & Data , nous recherchons un(e) AI Engineer / Agentic AI Engineer – Consultant pour piloter la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions avancées en Intelligence Artificielle, Machine Learning, IA Générative et IA Agentique pour des clients grands comptes.
 Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de certains streams clés des missions clients, du cadrage des problématiques et de la définition de l’architecture jusqu’au déploiement et à l’adoption. Vous jouerez un rôle de passerelle entre le métier et la technologie, en traduisant les enjeux clients en solutions IA scalables et en orientant les choix d’architecture entre ML, GenAI et approches agentiques.
 Vous ne vous limiterez pas à la construction des solutions, mais contribuerez également à leur définition, leur positionnement et leur adoption. Cela inclut l’animation de discussions techniques, la contribution aux propositions commerciales et le conseil aux parties prenantes sur les approches les plus pertinentes — des applications basées sur des LLM (RAG, copilotes, automatisation) aux systèmes agentiques (architectures multi-agents, workflows augmentés par des outils, processus autonomes).
 En collaboration étroite avec des parties prenantes seniors, des architectes et des équipes transverses, vous occuperez un rôle client-facing avec une autonomie croissante, tout en contribuant au développement d’actifs réutilisables et de bonnes pratiques en GenAI et Agentic AI.
 Responsabilités clés 
 • Piloter la conception, le développement et la validation de modèles de machine learning alignés avec les objectifs métiers, en garantissant scalabilité, robustesse et impact mesurable
• Concevoir et délivrer des solutions d’IA Générative de bout en bout : architectures RAG, stratégies de prompt engineering, applications LLM de niveau entreprise
• Concevoir et implémenter des systèmes d’IA agentique : architectures multi-agents, utilisation d’outils, workflows de planification et de raisonnement, raisonnement enrichi par graphes de connaissance lorsque pertinent
• Prendre en charge les décisions d’architecture, en sélectionnant les approches adaptées entre ML, pipelines GenAI et systèmes agentiques selon le contexte métier, les contraintes et les risques
• Évaluer et sélectionner des modèles fondamentaux (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral) et définir des architectures combinant GenAI et systèmes agentiques
• Concevoir et implémenter des bases de données vectorielles et des systèmes de recherche basés sur des graphes, pipelines d’embeddings et mécanismes de retrieval ; concevoir des graphes de connaissance, couches mémoire et gestion d’état pour supporter des workflows avancés

Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents
items.desc: SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Preferred (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. Nos chiffres clés : 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA. 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique. Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network. 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent... +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute. Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes. ▪️ À propos du poste Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise. Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous. Les missions : Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine). Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS). Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée. Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu. Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle. Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord. Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act). S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts. Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR. ▪️ Le profil idéal 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...) Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A) Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites …

items.desc: ¿Quiénes somos? Somos una compañía tecnológica especializada en Inteligencia Artificial , IA Generativa, Analytics, Gobierno del Dato, Cloud y arquitecturas Event Driven, pero sobre todo somos un equipo con conocimiento, criterio y muchas ganas de hacer las cosas bien. Trabajamos con talento altamente especializado, esté donde esté, y apostamos por una forma de crecer basada en la confianza, la autonomía y la participación. Nos mueve la excelencia tecnológica , la orientación a negocio y el sentido común, pero también el entusiasmo, la creatividad y la convicción de que la tecnología necesita alma, propósito y personas capaces de convertir la complejidad en soluciones reales. ¿Qué buscamos? Buscamos a un/a IA Engineer con 3-4 años de experiencia profesional que haya podido trabajar con IA Generativa en proyectos reales durante mínimo 6 meses . Te formarás tanto en la construcción de agentes, como del desarrollo asistido con IA, potenciando tus capacidades y convirtiéndote en un integrante del equipo multidisciplinar de aceleración de IA dentro de Mática. Experiencia sólida en Python para el desarrollo de aplicaciones de IA. Experiencia en integración de LLMs vía API (OpenAI, Azure OpenAi, Gemini…etc.) Conocimiento en LangChain y/o LangGraph. Se valorará diseño de agentes LLM y flujos multiagente. Diseño e implementación de sistemas RAG. Uso de embeddings, vector databases y búsqueda semántica. Experiencia en la evaluación de respuestas de modelos (calidad, precisión, alucinaciones) Buen nivel de inglés , tanto oral como escrito. ¿Cómo será tu día a día? Te encargarás de la creación y optimización de prompts y agentes, así como de la integración de LLMs en aplicaciones reales. Colaborarás con equipo interno y de cliente para construir aplicaciones escalables, seguras y alineadas con las necesidades del negocio. Mejorarás la fiabilidad, escalabilidad y observabilidad de las soluciones en producción, incorporando buenas prácticas de ingeniería de software aplicadas a LLMs. Tendrás autonomía para investigar tecnologías emergentes. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Pertenecer a una empresa a la vanguardia tecnológica y centrado en las Personas , ponemos al trabajador en el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Creemos en una cultura horizontal, sin egos, en un entorno donde se valoran tanto las ideas como las personas. Contrato indefinido y salario de entre 38.000 y 44.000 euros brutos/año de entrada , ajustado según tu experiencia. También tendrás a tu disposición un plan de formación especializado, participación en la propiedad y los beneficios de Mática: Wetaca gratuito en la oficina dos días a la semana, horario flexible con facilidades para trabajar desde donde quieras, seguro de salud, retribución flexible con Cobee, además de las vacaciones habituales, ofrecemos una semana extra en Navidad y tres días adicionales en Semana Santa. También recibirás un divertido Welcome Kit con portátil (podrás escoger entre varios modelos Mac o Windows), móvil, botella personalizada, auriculares bluetooth y golosinas. Cuando estés en nuestra oficina, en el centro de Barcelona o Madrid , la fruta, los cafés y los refrescos corren a cuenta de Mática. ¡Ah! Y si eres amante de los animales, te gustará saber esto: ¡nuestras oficinas son Pet-friendly ! Si te interesa, escríbenos por LinkedIn o envía tu CV a seleccion@maticapartners.com Do you want to be Mática? Be Mática!

Identifying tasks that can be automated or significantly improved with AI, and prioritising those with the greatest value. Designing and building AI agents and automations in Python, using LLMs and agent-based workflows to complete multi-step tasks. Integrating with internal and third-party systems through APIs, and reading from and writing to databases to keep information accurate and connected. Building RAG pipelines that ground LLM responses in our own documents and data, with a focus on accuracy and reliability. Testing your solutions with real users, gathering feedback and improving them quickly. Measuring and reporting the impact of your work, such as time saved, faster turnaround and improved consistency or quality. What Success Looks Like. A good understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering and agent-based workflows. Experience of working with APIs, including REST APIs and JSON. Working knowledge of databases and SQL. Familiarity with RAG, including embeddings and vector search. Confident use of version control with Git and GitHub. Strong problem-solving skills and a practical, delivery-focused mindset, with the ability to work independently and take ownership. Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical ideas simply to colleagues who are not technical. Experience with automation and orchestration tools or agent frameworks, cloud platforms, an awareness of data protection and GDPR, and examples of prototypes or projects you have already shipped are all desirable. We care more about what you have built than your formal experience. All appointments are subject to a satisfactory DBS check, references and evidence of the legal right to work in the UK. Key Skills. AI Agents, LLMs, RAG, Python, APIs, Databases, Automation and Version Control (GitHub). Personal Qualities. You are values-led and role model Truth, Love and Compassion in everything you do. items.desc: Unikie is seeking a Geospatial Data Science Engineer to pioneer the data layer powering our next-generation software-defined electric vehicles. In this senior role, you will be responsible for transforming massive, high-frequency streams of vehicle sensor observations into highly accurate, dynamic map features that the vehicle can use for localization, routing, and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). You will apply advanced computational statistics, machine learning, and spatial analysis to process and model large datasets, drawing actionable insights that translate raw fleet telemetry into live, high-definition maps. We value proactive problem-solvers who thrive in autonomous roles and are passionate about building performant, scalable systems at the intersection of data science and robotics. Responsibilities Geospatial Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that ingest, clean, and segment billions of daily vehicle sensor observations into consumable map features and geometries. Statistical Modeling & Insights: Apply advanced data mining and analytic methods to detect real-world changes (e.g., road closures, new lanes, construction) and design rigorous statistical tests to validate map accuracy. Map Generation & Map Matching: Develop robust algorithms for map matching, trajectory smoothing, and sensor fusion to convert noisy probe data into high-fidelity road geometry and attributes. System Design & Architecture: Lead the technical design of spatial data systems, ensuring low-latency query performance, efficient spatial indexing (e.g., H3, S2), and scalable storage of vector/raster map data. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with embedded software engineers, perception teams, and cloud architects to align onboard vehicle capabilities with cloud-based mapping platforms. Staying Ahead of the Curve: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in big data technologies, computational statistics, machine learning, and automated mapping practices. Skills Required Python SQL SLAM LiDAR Sensor Fusion PostGIS GCP Point Clouds Data Engineering MATLAB Machine Learning Data Science Shell Scripting Big Data QGIS Data Clustering Robotics Statistics System Design Bayesian inference Locations Tallinn Helsinki Szczecin Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: Education: Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Geoinformatics, Robotics, or a related quantitative field with an emphasis or thesis work on computational statistics, data mining, machine learning, or spatial optimization. Experience: 8+ years of related professional experience building and maintaining large-scale data processing and predictive systems. Advanced Analytics & Data Mining: Expert-level knowledge in data mining and analytic methods such as regression, classifiers, clustering, association rules, decision trees, and Bayesian network analysis. Geospatial Expertise: Proven experience working with geospatial data, handling noisy time-series datasets, writing advanced spatial queries in PostGIS, and utilizing spatial libraries/indexing systems (e.g., H3, S2, GeoPandas). Programming & Scripting: Proficiency with statistical analysis packages and programming languages, including Python, SQL, and shell scripting (or familiarity with R/MATLAB). Statistical Testing: Strong statistical foundation with proven expertise in designing, executing, and analyzing complex data tests and validation methodologies. Preferred Qualifications Crowdsourced Mapping: Experience with fleet-based, crowdsourced map generation methodologies, including probe-data aggregation, change detection, and incremental map updates. Cloud Ecosystems: Experience deploying large-scale geospatial pipelines and machine learning workloads within cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Databricks). Open-Source Infrastructure: Experience with standard open-source vector tile formats, tools like Martin, QGIS, and geospatial processing engines (GDAL/OGR, GEOS). Automotive Map Formats: Familiarity with automotive map standards, routing schemas, and data structures such as NDS (Navigation Data Standard), OpenStreetMap (OSM), and Lanelet2/HD Maps. Robotics Algorithms: Familiarity with core robotics concepts, including SLAM (Simultaneous Localization & Mapping), Sensor Fusion, and Point Cloud / Sensor Processing (LiDAR, radar, vision). This is an initial six-month contract, with the possibility of extending the assignment. WHY JOIN UNIKIE? We are dedicated partner for global players in our segments – Unikie supplies technology solutions and services to several global Fortune 500 companies in EMEA and America. As a responsible and competent partner, we have access to some of the most interesting projects. Technology we create enables our clients to become digital leaders in their own industries. items.card: you will be responsible for transforming massive, high-frequency streams of vehicle sensor observations into highly accurate, dynamic map features that the vehicle can use for localization, routing, and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). You will apply advanced computational statistics, machine learning, and spatial analysis to process and model large datasets, drawing actionable insights that translate raw
items.desc: Unikie is seeking a Geospatial Data Science Engineer to pioneer the data layer powering our next-generation software-defined electric vehicles. In this senior role, you will be responsible for transforming massive, high-frequency streams of vehicle sensor observations into highly accurate, dynamic map features that the vehicle can use for localization, routing, and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). You will apply advanced computational statistics, machine learning, and spatial analysis to process and model large datasets, drawing actionable insights that translate raw fleet telemetry into live, high-definition maps. We value proactive problem-solvers who thrive in autonomous roles and are passionate about building performant, scalable systems at the intersection of data science and robotics. Responsibilities Geospatial Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that ingest, clean, and segment billions of daily vehicle sensor observations into consumable map features and geometries. Statistical Modeling & Insights: Apply advanced data mining and analytic methods to detect real-world changes (e.g., road closures, new lanes, construction) and design rigorous statistical tests to validate map accuracy. Map Generation & Map Matching: Develop robust algorithms for map matching, trajectory smoothing, and sensor fusion to convert noisy probe data into high-fidelity road geometry and attributes. System Design & Architecture: Lead the technical design of spatial data systems, ensuring low-latency query performance, efficient spatial indexing (e.g., H3, S2), and scalable storage of vector/raster map data. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with embedded software engineers, perception teams, and cloud architects to align onboard vehicle capabilities with cloud-based mapping platforms. Staying Ahead of the Curve: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in big data technologies, computational statistics, machine learning, and automated mapping practices. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: Education: Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Geoinformatics, Robotics, or a related quantitative field with an emphasis or thesis work on computational statistics, data mining, machine learning, or spatial optimization. Experience: 8+ years of related professional experience building and maintaining large-scale data processing and predictive systems. Advanced Analytics & Data Mining: Expert-level knowledge in data mining and analytic methods such as regression, classifiers, clustering, association rules, decision trees, and Bayesian network analysis. Geospatial Expertise: Proven experience working with geospatial data, handling noisy time-series datasets, writing advanced spatial queries in PostGIS, and utilizing spatial libraries/indexing systems (e.g., H3, S2, GeoPandas). Programming & Scripting: Proficiency with statistical analysis packages and programming languages, including Python, SQL, and shell scripting (or familiarity with R/MATLAB). Statistical Testing: Strong statistical foundation with proven expertise in designing, executing, and analyzing complex data tests and validation methodologies. Preferred Qualifications Crowdsourced Mapping: Experience with fleet-based, crowdsourced map generation methodologies, including probe-data aggregation, change detection, and incremental map updates. Cloud Ecosystems: Experience deploying large-scale geospatial pipelines and machine learning workloads within cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Databricks). Open-Source Infrastructure: Experience with standard open-source vector tile formats, tools like Martin, QGIS, and geospatial processing engines (GDAL/OGR, GEOS). Automotive Map Formats: Familiarity with automotive map standards, routing schemas, and data structures such as NDS (Navigation Data Standard), OpenStreetMap (OSM), and Lanelet2/HD Maps. Robotics Algorithms: Familiarity with core robotics concepts, including SLAM (Simultaneous Localization & Mapping), Sensor Fusion, and Point Cloud / Sensor Processing (LiDAR, radar, vision). This is an initial six-month contract, with the possibility of extending the assignment.

You'll work across the stack with real ownership and autonomy, and see your work hit real users the same week you ship it. What you'll be doing: Design and ship voice AI agents: real-time phone interviews
items.desc: About Us: Asendia AI is rebuilding how the world hires. The global staffing industry is $600B+ and still runs on manual phone calls and gut feelings. We built AI agents that screen, interview, and score candidates 24/7, live, in real time, at a fraction of the cost. We work alongside staffing agencies across the US and Europe who expect speed, accuracy, and scale, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Already running thousands of AI-powered screens, our agents place candidates within days of going live and cut screening costs by 90%.YC-backed. Seed-stage with years of runway. AI penetration in staffing is still under 1%, and there's no dominant platform yet. We're building it, AI-native from day one. Joining Asendia means three things: We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We build with AI: the best tools, in the product, and in how we ship. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you're driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar, this is the place.The roleAs a Product Engineer at Asendia, you'll build the AI agents that are the product, the voice interviewers that talk to thousands of candidates, and the systems that turn those conversations into decisions. You'll work across the stack with real ownership and autonomy, and see your work hit real users the same week you ship it. What you'll be doing: Design and ship voice AI agents: real-time phone interviews with sub-300ms latency (LLM orchestration, WebSockets, FastAPI) Build the prompt and agent architecture: reusable, multi-vertical interviewer systems, each client customizes their own screening logic, voice personality, compliance rules Turn messy voice conversations into structured, reliable candidate scores Run evals and reliability work: audit agents across a live fleet, catch regressions, keep behavior consistent at scale Build the agentic infrastructure that lets every client spin up and tune their own screening workflows Who you are A passionate engineer who's shipped AI agents end-to-end, not demos, things real users hit Fluent with LLMs, prompting, and agent orchestration; you know where models break and how to engineer around it You build with AI tools, not around them. Agentic coding is part of how you ship Strong in Python and comfortable across the stack; you don't wait on anyone to finish a feature High-agency: no docs, no playbook, a client deadline on Friday—you figure it out You think about the product, not just code—you understand why a screening flow matters to a recruiter and build accordingly Bonus: voice/speech systems, real-time streaming, eval frameworks, or prior staffing/recruitment experience. About the interview Complete the application form and attach your CV. An introductory conversation to get to know you, share more about Asendia, and discuss what you’re looking for. A deeper dive into your technical skills, experience, and approach to problem-solving. You’ll receive a case or challenge relevant to the role, followed by a 60-minute presentation and discussion with the team. A final conversation with Rihab (our CEO) to ensure mutual fit and alignment.

items.desc: Seit rund 15 Jahren stehen wir an der Hochschule Rhein-Waal am Niederrhein für eine innovative, inter­disziplinäre und internationale Ausbil­dung junger Menschen aus der ganzen Welt. Wir bieten insgesamt 37 Bachelor- und Master­studien­gänge an den vier inter­disziplinären Fakultäten – Technologie und Bionik, Life Sciences, Gesell­schaft und Ökonomie sowie Kommunikation und Umwelt. Mehr als 90 Partner­hochschulen in 38 Ländern stehen für die internationale Kooperations­stärke der Hochschule Rhein-Waal. So ist die Hochschule in der EUREGIOn verwurzelt und mit der Welt vernetzt. Das Forschungs­projekt „ResistCAM“ konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung innovativer und multifunktionaler Materialien für fortschrittliche Tarnungs­anwendungen. Ziel des Projekts ist es, neue Material- und Beschichtungs­konzepte zu etablieren, die hohe thermische Beständigkeit, Langlebigkeit sowie maßgeschneiderte optische, infrarote und elektromagnetische Eigenschaften vereinen. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Entwicklung nanostrukturierter Fasern, funktioneller Polymer­materialien, Nanomaterialien und fortschrittlicher Oberflächen­beschichtungen sowie auf dem Verständnis ihrer Struktur-Eigenschafts-Beziehungen. Im Rahmen des Projekts bringen wir unser Fach­wissen in den Bereichen funktionelle Materialien, Nanofaser­herstellung, Oberflächen­technik und fortschrittliche Material­charakterisierung ein. Die Forschungs­aktivitäten umfassen die Entwicklung und Optimierung elektrogesponnener Nanofaser­strukturen und multifunktionaler Beschichtungs­systeme sowie die Untersuchung ihrer thermischen, mechanischen, elektrischen und optischen Eigenschaften. Das Projekt bringt Partner aus Wissen­schaft und Industrie in einem inter­disziplinären und internationalen Forschungs­umfeld zusammen, mit dem Ziel, innovative Material­konzepte in leistungsstarke und anwendungs­orientierte Technologien umzusetzen. items.desc: Job Description onsemi is seeking a highly motivated System Validation Engineer to join our growing System Validation team in Limerick. The successful candidate will play a key role in validating next-generation power management solutions, including multiphase digital controllers, Smart Power Stages (SPS), SmartFET, eFuse, Gate Driver devices, and associated power-delivery systems. Working as part of a cross-functional product development team, you will be responsible for developing validation strategies, executing system-level testing, identifying root causes of complex issues, and ensuring products meet all functional, performance, reliability, and customer requirements. This position offers the opportunity to work directly with cutting-edge power solutions used in Automotive, AI, server, cloud computing, CPU, and GPU applications. The role aligns with internal System Validation activities covering validation planning, pre silicon validation execution, board bring-up, characterization, automation, and silicon readiness. Responsibilities Develop and execute comprehensive system validation plans covering functional, electrical, system, reliability, and application-level requirements. Design and implement validation methodologies, measurement techniques, and test systems for new product development. Perform hands-on laboratory validation, characterization, and debug of silicon and system platforms. Develop automated test solutions using Python, LabVIEW, or similar software tools. Create validation hardware, test fixtures, and supporting circuitry as required. Validate product functionality, protection features, telemetry, comms interfaces, power sequencing, fault handling, and system performance. Execute electrical characterization across operating conditions including voltage, load, temperature, and transient scenarios. Analyze validation data, identify root causes, and work closely with Design, Product Engineering, Applications, Firmware, and ATE teams to resolve issues. Support silicon bring-up activities and contribute to release to market readiness. Document validation results, generate technical reports, and present findings to project teams and management. Support continuous improvement of validation methodologies, test automation frameworks, and best practices. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. 8–12 years of relevant industry experience in semiconductor, power electronics, system validation, or hardware development. Strong understanding of analog and digital circuit fundamentals. Experience using laboratory equipment such as: Oscilloscopes, Electronic loads, Logic analyzers, Signal and spectrum analyzers. Experience troubleshooting complex hardware and silicon-related issues. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively within cross-functional global teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience in one or more of the following areas would be highly beneficial: System-level validation of: Multiphase power controllers Digital VR controllers Smart Power Stages (SPS) POL (Point-of-Load) regulators PMIC products Power conversion topologies including Buck, Multiphase Buck, and TLVR architectures. Validation of CPU/GPU power delivery solutions. Functional Safety, ISO 26262, ISO 21780, SiC/GaN. AI-assisted validation experience. Test automation using Python, LabVIEW, C/C++, or similar languages. FPGA-based validation and emulation. Familiarity with Jama, Jira, and Confluence. PCB design and schematic review experience. Validation planning, compliance testing, characterization, and correlation methodologies. About Us onsemi (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world’s most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world. More details about our company benefits can be found here: https://www.onsemi.com/careers/career-benefits About The Team We are committed to sourcing, attracting, and hiring high-performance innovators, while providing all candidates a positive recruitment experience that builds our brand as a great place to work.

items.desc: Role Highlights Smart Manufacturing Engineer, SW & Electronics Location: Espoo, Finland Department: Global Manufacturing Organization Reports to: Smart Manufacturing, Team Leader Employment type: Permanent Workplace model: Hybrid Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required) Why This Role Matters As a Smart Manufacturing Engineer, SW & Electronics, you will help ensure our satellites can be tested reliably and efficiently before they are launched to space. You will design and own Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) and satellite‑level test systems that combine electronics, embedded software and automation. Your work will directly support AIT and Production teams, keeping critical test setups running while building the next generation of EGSEs to scale ICEYE’s manufacturing. Who We Are ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy – day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits. As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring (including oil-spill detection), and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience. ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation. Your Day-to-day Responsibilities Support AIT and Production teams in running and troubleshooting RF, electronics and satellite‑level test setups, especially in your first months. Design, develop and maintain EGSE systems that combine electronics, embedded software and Python-based test automation. Capture requirements and define architectures for new test systems together with AIT Engineering, Production and other Engineering teams. Implement and debug embedded C/C++ code on ARM‑based MCUs (e.g. STM32, TI), including bring‑up, interface control and communication with instruments. Design or adapt electronics for EGSE (schematics, interfaces, power, measurement paths) and work with mechanical engineers on the overall solution. Use Python and tools like PyVISA to automate instruments, collect data and improve test workflows. Write clear, maintainable documentation and user guides so others can operate and maintain the systems you build. Contribute to improving existing legacy test setups, increasing reliability, repeatability and ease of use. Collaborate closely with other Smart Manufacturing engineers (mechanical, electronics, software) and share knowledge within the team. Must Haves What we’re looking for 5+ years of experience in electronics / embedded systems / test development, ideally in complex or high‑reliability products. Hands‑on experience with ARM‑based MCUs (e.g. STM32 or TI), including embedded C/C++ development and debugging. Practical experience designing or modifying electronics for test or control (schematics, interfaces, power, signal integrity basics). Strong Python skills for test automation, scripting and instrument control (e.g. PyVISA or similar). Familiarity with Altium Designer (or similar) for PCB design Comfortable using common lab and RF test equipment such as oscilloscopes, PSUs, multimeters, power loads, VNAs and spectrum analyzers. items.desc:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.



Safety System Engineer



🛠️ About our Engineering Teams



At Wayve, we are developing AV2.0: an end-to-end AI driving system designed to learn and adapt across a wide range of driving environments, with the ambition to scale autonomy globally. Our Safety team tackles one of the most important and complex challenges in that mission - assuring the safety of our Automated Driving System (ADS) as it evolves across vehicle platforms, applications and operating environments. You will help design and orchestrate the safety assurance framework that makes this possible.



🧠 Your day-to-day



You will lead functional safety activities for Wayve's ADS and its integration into current and future vehicle platforms, as well as third-party safety-critical systems. Working closely with internal engineering teams, external partners and other safety experts, you will build a deep understanding of the system, assess risk, shape the safety concept and architecture, define verification and validation, and develop the evidence needed to support a robust safety case.



🧩 What you’ll be working on:



• Build and maintain Item Definition work products for each vehicle platform and safety-critical integration.

• Conduct HARAs, FMEAs and FTAs to identify risk and define safety concepts that reduce risk to an acceptable level.

• Work with design teams on system architectures that satisfy the safety concept, including decomposition decisions and derived software and external requirements.

• Support software teams in implementing safety requirements on target hardware.

• Define test specifications across integration levels, including vehicle-level verification and validation of the safety concept.

• Build structured safety cases using clear claims, arguments and evidence.

• Contribute to production safety work products and evolve safety processes with process and compliance teams for certification activities.



🙌 You should apply if:



• You have at least 5 years of hands-on automotive functional safety experience applying ISO 26262 across different systems, with strong working knowledge of Parts 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 and 9.

• You have conducted vehicle-level testing at proving grounds to verify and validate safety concepts.

• You are experienced in risk analysis and safety engineering techniques such as HARA, FMEA and FTA, and can translate findings into practical safety concepts, architectures and requirements.

• You can work effectively across software, hardware, systems and external partners, and are comfortable debating safety-related trade-offs at different levels of the organisation.

• You are pragmatic in balancing risk and benefit, especially in a fast-moving development environment, while maintaining high safety standards.

• You are a self-starter who can move between long-term, high-level safety thinking and detailed subsystem or application-level problem solving, and you are confident challenging ideas while remaining open to constructive feedback.



✨ Nice to have

• Practical experience with ISO 26262 Part 6, including production software development and software-tool qualification.

• Experience managing suppliers of safety-related hardware or software, including DIA definition, supplier audits and assessments.

• Experience developing safety cases for automated driving systems, including computer-vision-based systems, and enough knowledge of neural networks to discuss safety assurance approaches with scientists and engineers.

• Experience with SOTIF, including identifying triggering conditions and defining testing and validation strategies.

• Operational safety experience, including identifying operational risks and defining training or procedures for safe public-road testing.



🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven …

items.desc:
At Verda, we're building a full-stack AI cloud, covering everything from data centers and hardware to our own cloud platform that the world's leading AI teams use to do serious AI work. 
 We strive to make a positive mark on the world through the infrastructure we build and give leading teams a service they can truly depend on. Headquartered in Helsinki, we operate globally with offices in London and San Francisco. 
 Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished.
 Why Verda
 Cash and equity compensation along with local benefits.
 40+ nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team.
 A real chance to make an impact and work alongside world class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem.
 Practicalities
 Work mode: On-site, 8-hour shift rotation covering 24/7 operations
 Level: Mid/Senior level
 Employment type: Full time and permanent
 About the role
 Our site runs high-density GPU infrastructure around the clock, and we are hiring at both Data Center Technician and Senior Data Center Technician levels. Your level will be determined by your experience, technical capability and the complexity of work you can handle independently.
 This is a hands-on, all-rounder role covering server installation, hardware break/fix, rack builds, copper and fibre cabling, link-level troubleshooting and general site operations. You will work independently within your level of responsibility while collaborating closely with other technicians, network engineers, system administrators and wider infrastructure teams.
 At the senior level, you will take on more complex technical work, lead the technical execution of deployments and build-outs, mentor junior technicians and help improve operating procedures and technical standards.
 Your responsibilities 
 Install, configure, and maintain servers, storage systems, networking equipment, and other data center hardware.
 Monitor data center environmental conditions — temperature, humidity, power — and respond to alerts.
 Ensure uptime and availability of data center infrastructure in a 24/7 environment, including participation in on-call.
 Lead or contribute to data center build-outs, migrations, and refresh projects — including opening new data halls and extensions.
 Plan and schedule machine installations independently, and plan future site upgrades as power capacity grows.
 Collaborate closely with remote hands teams, network engineers, system administrators, the Site Manager, and Head of DC Operations.
 Mentor junior technicians and, as the site grows, take part in hiring and building the on-site team.
 Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, with professional fluency in English — our internal working language and the language of daily contact with colleagues globally.
 Your key competencies 
 We're looking for someone who works independently on routine hardware and cabling tasks and knows when to escalate.
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
 3–5+ years of progressive data center or IT infrastructure experience.
 Direct hands-on experience with enterprise GPU servers (NVIDIA Ampere, Hopper, or Blackwell generations).
 Ability to operate independently and improvise — you don't need check-ins or supervision to know what matters.
 Ability to work on-site full-time in shift rotation.
 Comfortable with ambiguity and a broad scope of work
 Nice to have
 Experience with liquid cooling — DLC loops, and maintenance of liquid cooling solutions.
 Experience leading site build-outs, data hall openings, or large cluster deployments.
 Experience mentoring or leading junior technicians.
 What's next
 We're building fast and this role needs the right person behind it. There's no artificial deadline, but when we find who we're looking for, we move. If this sounds like your next move, apply now.
 If you have a CV in English, you are welcome to submit it. Applications in Spanish are equally accepted. Please apply through our careers page, as we do not accept applications by email.

 En tant qu’Architecte Solution Infrastructure, vous serez le/la chef(fe) d’orchestre technique des projets d’automatisation et d’industrialisation des infrastructures, avec une approche DevOps. Vos responsabilités : Analyser les besoins techniques et métiers pour concevoir des architectures d’infrastructure agiles, scalables et sécurisées. Définir et mettre en œuvre des chaînes CI/CD robustes et automatisées. Industrialiser les déploiements d’infrastructure (Infrastructure as Code) via des outils comme Terraform, Ansible, Puppet ou Chef. Mettre en place des plateformes d'intégration, de supervision et de monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.). Accompagner les équipes projets dans l’adoption des pratiques DevOps et des outils associés. Participer à la standardisation et à la veille technologique, tout en capitalisant les bonnes pratiques. 

Formation supérieure en informatique. Expérience confirmée (5 ans minimum) dans des projets DevOps ou d’industrialisation d’infrastructures. Très bonne maîtrise des outils DevOps : GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Nexus, SonarQube, Terraform, Ansible, etc. Connaissance des environnements Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) et des architectures hybrides. Maîtrise de la conteneurisation et de l’orchestration : Docker, Kubernetes. Compétences en scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell). Bonne culture des environnements systèmes (Linux/Windows), réseaux, sécurité. Certification DevOps ou Cloud (Azure DevOps, CKA, etc.) appréciée. Au-delà de la technicité, votre capacité à vulgariser, convaincre, structurer une vision technique et à travailler en transverse avec des équipes projet variées vous permettront de vous sentir pleinement à votre place dans cette fonction. Communauté d’architectes : intégrez un réseau mondial d’architectes, favorisant le partage d’expertise, le mentorat et les échanges entre pairs, notamment lors du Architect Summit. Projets à fort impact : diversité de missions dans des environnements innovants, interactions avec des dirigeants (CTO, CXO…) et opportunités concrètes de progression. Apprentissage en continu : accédez à des certifications techniques (AWS, Azure, Programme Architecte) et à des plateformes de formation pour rester à la pointe des évolutions technologiques.

items.desc: WE ARE BETCLIC Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here's why you'll love working with us: An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME As a Security Engineer, you will join Betclic's Global Security team as a member of the Cybersecurity Referents team. You will work directly within squads responsible for authentication, identity and payment journeys. You will act as an embedded security partner throughout the product lifecycle, from initial design and architecture discussions through implementation, security validation and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on role combining application security and architecture analysis. When relevant, you will also perform pragmatic offensive security testing. You will help teams identify relevant risks, implement effective security controls and deliver secure, reliable and user-friendly experiences. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC Your role will be to strengthen security across several business and technology domains at Betclic, with a focus on Data and Sports Betting. Working closely with Developers, Architects, Product Managers and Engineering Managers, you will: Conduct secure design reviews and threat modeling for new projects, providing pragmatic and actionable recommendations. Assess existing implementations—including source code, APIs, data flows and security controls—to identify vulnerabilities and opportunities for improvement. Identify realistic attack paths affecting critical business journeys and validate them through controlled security testing or proof-of-concept exercises when useful. Work with teams to implement security improvements, promote secure development practices and share reusable security patterns. Propose, lead and contribute to security initiatives that reduce risks across the Data domain and your assigned business domain. Collaborate with the wider Security organization, including the Blue and Red Teams, as well as Compliance and Fraud teams. Why join this role? Strengthen security across Betclic's Data activities and a strategic business domain. Work directly with teams and influence security from architecture through implementation. Bring your software development experience to practical application security challenges. Help teams implement meaningful security improvements, rather than stopping at recommendations. Develop broad expertise across application security, data security, secure software engineering and business domains. Work collaboratively with the wider Security organization in an international environment. TECHNOLOGY & SECURITY LANDSCAPE Application security: Threat modeling, secure design reviews, source code and API reviews, and controlled security testing. Data security: Data flows, access rights, data exposure risks, and security controls for data processing and sharing. Technologies: You will encounter C#, Rust, Kotlin, Dart and Flutter. Experience with one or more of these technologies is an advantage. Secure delivery: CI/CD security controls, SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC scanning and secrets management. Business context: Experience working with data platforms , online betting or gaming products systems is a plus. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm! This job is for you if you: Have 3–5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on securing applications or digital products. Have experience working directly with Product and Engineering teams in an agile environment. Have a solid understanding of software development practices and the challenges developers face. Are comfortable analyzing both security architecture and implementation details. Understand the security principles behind modern authentication and identity systems. Are proactive and able to identify, propose and drive security improvements. Can communicate effectively with …

Vous assurez le suivi des données, mesurez l’impact des actions digitales et transformez les analyses en recommandations concrètes pour accompagner la croissance de l’activité. Vous contribuez également aux projets stratégiques visant à optimiser l’expérience utilisateur et la performance de la plateforme e-commerce Pour ce faire, vous aurez la charge des missions suivantes : Garantir la qualité et la fiabilité des données trackées. Accompagner l’équipe e-commerce dans le tracking et la mesure de la performance des projets e-commerce. Définir et suivre les KPI e-commerce, acquisition, conversion. Analyser les performances des campagnes marketing et identifier les leviers de croissance. Étudier les comportements clients sur nos plateformes digitales et recommander des actions d'optimisation de l'expérience. Concevoir et animer des tableaux de bord facilitant la prise de décision. Évaluer la performance des outils de recherche, recommandation et personnalisation. Identifier les opportunités de développement du chiffre d'affaires et de fidélisation. Votre Profil Chez Sysco, la diversité n’est pas simplement un mot, c’est la recette de notre succès ! Nous sommes conscients que c’est la multitude des parcours, des profils et des compétences de nos équipes qui nous permet de satisfaire nos clients chaque jour. Issu(e) d'une formation Bac+5 en Data Analytics, Digital Marketing, Statistiques, Data Science ou équivalent, vous justifiez d'une expérience de 3 à 5 ans minimum dans un environnement Digital Analytics ou Web Analytics, idéalement dans le e-commerce. Vous maîtrisez GA4, GTM, Excel et la création de tableaux de bord dans data studio n’a pas de secret pour vous. Vous avez une très bonne compréhension des enjeux d’acquisition, de conversion e-commerce et de fidélisation. Vous possédez une grande capacité de vulgarisation et de compréhension des besoins métiers. Orienté business et résultats, vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et la conception de tableaux de bord et de process. Vous savez travailler en équipe en transverse avec des fonctions supports et commerce. La connaissance d’outils de data visualisation tels que Tableau/Sisense ainsi que la maîtrise de SQL est un plus. Rémunération & Avantages Salaire fixe + variable ou prime selon fonction Intéressement Titres-restaurants ou panier-repas selon fonction Avantages CSE (chèques cadeaux/vacances, billets cinéma, etc.) Mutuelle/Prévoyance adaptée à vos besoins Produits Sysco à tarif préférentiel Perspectives d’évolution en interne Le saviez vous Sysco collabore avec des acteurs spécialisés pour favoriser l’embauche de personnes en situation de handicap et l'inclusion. Enfin Sysco développe une politique active pour garantir la sécurité de l’ensemble de ses collaborateurs. « ET SY VOTRE TALENT ÉTAIT NOTRE MEILLEUR INGREDIENT ? »
