items.desc: At Aristocrat, we are dedicated to bringing happiness to life through the power of play. As a world leader in gaming content and technology, our mission is to build outstanding gaming experiences that entertain millions globally. Our inclusive and collaborative culture fosters innovation and excellence, making Aristocrat an exciting place to grow your career. We are currently seeking a skilled Product Manager to join our team and lead some of our core engagement tools and reporting domains. This role is critical to our success, directly impacting the popularity of our games and our presence in the North American market. Join us and be part of an ambitious team crafting the future of gaming! What You'll Do Own and drive the product vision, strategy, and execution for the company’s Internal and External tools within the SaaS platform, ensuring alignment with company-wide business objectives. Lead complex, high-impact product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and strategy definition through delivery, launch, and post-release optimization. Translate business strategy, market insights, and customer needs into clear, scalable product roadmaps, balancing short-term delivery with long-term growth. Serve as the primary product authority and technical go-to for assigned domains, providing deep product, market, and domain expertise across the organization. Own product definition artifacts at a strategic level, including PRDs, system flows, use cases, business requirements, and product policies, ensuring clarity and alignment across collaborators. Drive prioritization decisions based on business impact, customer value, technical feasibility, and strategic fit; make independent judgments on complex trade-offs. Partner closely with R&D, Delivery, BI, Marketing, Operations, and Executive collaborators to ensure cross-functional alignment and successful execution throughout the product lifecycle. Influence and contribute to the development of product standards, guidelines, and internal processes, helping build how product management is practiced across the company. Coordinate backlog management, release planning, and delivery execution using Agile/SCRUM methodologies, ensuring predictable delivery against commitments. Identify risks, dependencies, and delivery constraints early; proactively define mitigation strategies to protect timelines, budgets, and quality. Use data, analytics, and market intelligence to evaluate product performance, guide decision-making, and continuously improve outcomes. Act as a mentor and role model for other Product Managers, raising the overall product maturity of the organization (without direct people management). What We're Looking For 5+ years of proven Product Management experience, including ownership of complex, customer-facing SaaS products. Strong experience in games, gambling, or highly regulated / flow-intensive platforms – with a deep understanding of industry dynamics and key players. Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives independently, align collaborators, and deliver measurable business outcomes. Strategic problem solver with strong execution capabilities; able to move seamlessly between big-picture vision and detailed product decisions. Excellent analytical skills with the ability to synthesize inputs from BI, customer data, market research, and business insights into clear product direction. Outstanding communication, presentation, and storytelling skills across multiple formats (PRDs, presentations, diagrams, wireframes, and executive reviews). Strong influencing skills and confidence in engaging with senior leadership and cross-functional decision-makers. Proven experience managing multiple products or domains simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. High proficiency with Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence), including advanced or admin-level usage. Dedicated, accountable, and determined, with a strong sense of ownership and bias toward action. This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat. Compensation Philosophy We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location. Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits. Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Pracujemy blisko klienta – od pierwszych rozmów o celach biznesowych, przez wspólne projektowanie rozwiązania, aż po wdrożenie produkcyjne i dalszy rozwój systemu. items.desc: Job Title: Security Architect Location: Belfast, Northern Ireland Work Arrangement: Hybrid Position Overview: We are looking for our first dedicated Security Architect to own Information Security across Biller Genie. Today, security responsibilities are spread across IT and Engineering and handled largely as needed. You will bring that work together under a single, accountable function: setting the strategy, building the governance framework, and partnering with IT and Engineering to raise our security maturity across our production platform, corporate environment, endpoints, and product development lifecycle. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will write policy and present to the executive team, but you will also design controls, tune detection tooling, and sit with engineers to review architecture. Primary Job Responsibilities: Information Security Governance & Risk Management Establish and own the Information Security governance framework, including policies, standards, and procedures, and secure executive approval for them. Develop and maintain a leadership-approved Information Security risk management strategy and risk register. Implement security incident management procedures covering reporting, classification, response, record-keeping, and post-incident review. Deliver regular reporting to senior leadership on security posture, incidents, risks, and program progress. Implement third-party and vendor risk management procedures, including security assessment, approval, and ongoing assurance. Own Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery planning and run regular exercises to validate them. Maintain a threat intelligence process that tracks advisories from government and industry bodies and turns them into action. Define regulatory, contractual, and breach-notification obligations, and keep security controls aligned with compliance frameworks (e.g. PCI DSS, SOC 2) and cyber insurance requirements. Own the Information Security budget and make resourcing and tooling recommendations. Production Environment Security Define and maintain security architecture standards for our cloud production environments, in partnership with Engineering. Implement Cloud Security Posture Management practices and policy. Establish vulnerability and patch management procedures, including software supply-chain and dependency management, with defined remediation SLAs. Design production monitoring, logging, and threat detection capabilities. Develop production incident response, compromise recovery, and ransomware response plans, and run regular tabletop exercises against them. Define production backup, recovery, and resilience standards, including recovery time and recovery point objectives. Oversee the security testing program, including vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and its evolution against emerging threats. Govern production identity, access, and secrets management standards. Corporate Environment Security Define and implement identity and access management standards, including privileged access governance and periodic access reviews. Establish credential and secrets governance procedures, including the full joiner-mover-leaver lifecycle. Implement data classification, handling, retention, and destruction policies across the organization. Define corporate backup, recovery, and compromise response procedures. Establish centralized security logging, monitoring, and alerting (SIEM) capabilities, with clear ownership. Implement corporate vulnerability management and security testing practices. Govern the secure use of AI tools and AI-integrated systems across the business. Device & Endpoint Security Own the endpoint security strategy and the configuration, tuning, and effectiveness review of endpoint protection tooling. Define and implement device security policies, including Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) and mobile device management. Strengthen device authentication and hardening standards. Establish lost and stolen device procedures, and regularly validate remote response capabilities. Secure Product Development Establish a Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) with Engineering, including written secure coding standards and how they are enforced. Embed threat modelling and security-by-design reviews into product planning and architecture. Implement automated security testing (SAST, DAST, dependency and secrets scanning) within CI/CD pipelines. Define data protection standards for the product, including PII identification and mapping, encryption, and multi-tenant isolation. Establish vulnerability disclosure procedures and assess the case for a bug bounty program. Define source code integrity, repository access, and tamper-recovery standards. Security Training & Awareness Design and run an ongoing security awareness program aligned to compliance requirements, covering phishing, social engineering, AI and deepfake threats, and related risks such as financial fraud. Implement role-based security …

items.desc: In OVS SpA non cerchiamo solo "esecutori", ma professionisti con la voglia di trasformare il business attraverso l'intelligenza artificiale. La tecnologia è il motore della nostra strategia e il tuo ruolo sarà fondamentale per integrare l'esperienza fisica dei nostri store con quella digitale, creando un impatto tangibile sul futuro del retail. All'interno del team Digital Transformation & Information Technology , sarai il punto di riferimento per l'evoluzione dei nostri modelli analitici e delle architetture dati. Di cosa ti occuperai? Progettare e implementare soluzioni di Machine Learning (Classico, Deep Learning e Generative AI) per ottimizzare i touchpoint con i clienti Contribuire alla definizione dell'architettura di riferimento per il ciclo di vita dei modelli (MLOps), garantendo scalabilità e performance Collaborare con i business stakeholder per tradurre i requisiti in soluzioni tecniche che ottimizzino costi e risultati Supportare la transizione verso un'architettura dati moderna, integrando logiche di Data Engineering con lo sviluppo di modelli Cosa cerchiamo? Hai maturato esperienza in ambito Data Science e/o Machine Learning Engineering. Ti senti a tuo agio tra codice, algoritmi e architetture cloud Laurea in ingegneria informatica e/o informatica Padronanza di Python: il linguaggio principale per lo sviluppo dei nostri modelli Machine Learning Classico e Deep Learning: solida conoscenza di algoritmi di regressione, classificazione, clustering e serie storiche Data Engineering Fundamentals: ottima conoscenza di basi dati SQL e NoSQL e capacità di manipolare dataset complessi in modo distribuito utilizzando Spark Generative AI & RAG: solida esperienza nell'implementazione di architetture RAG avanzate, con focus sull'integrazione di Vector Databases (es. Milvus) e strumenti di orchestrazione come LangChain o LlamaIndex Metodologia: esperienza in contesti Agile e capacità di gestire progetti end-to-end Costituiscono un plus (Ma non lasciarti bloccare se ti manca qualcosa!): Databricks & Spark: Esperienza nell'utilizzo della piattaforma per lo sviluppo e l'orchestrazione Cloud (Azure): Conoscenza dei servizi Cloud (preferibilmente Microsoft Azure) per il deploy e la gestione delle risorse Model Deployment & MLOps: Esperienza nel portare i modelli in produzione (MLflow, API, containerizzazione con Docker/Kubernetes/Azure ML, monitoraggio) Potrebbe essere l'inizio della tua avventura con noi! Perché scegliere il gruppo OVS? In OVS SpA - all'interno della nostra società OVS Innovazione e Sostenibilità - troverai un'azienda strutturata, un ambiente dinamico e fortemente orientato al risultato. Stiamo innovando la tradizione, con un forte investimento sulle nuove tecnologie, per offrire a clienti e dipendenti un'esperienza sempre più completa e digitale, senza trascurare l'attenzione per l'ambiente, il futuro e la sostenibilità. Si tratta di un'opportunità full time, che prevede una RAL compresa tra i 26.000 e i 36.000 euro. Inoltre, avrai accesso a: Modalità ibrida di lavoro con due giorni di smartworking a settimana Welfare aziendale e percorsi di Wellbeing e Parenting Percorsi di formazione sia tecnico specialistici che manageriali Sconti del 20% su tutti i nostri brand Accesso a vantaggi riservati ai dipendenti del gruppo (viaggi, elettronica...) Flessibilità in entrata Consulenza medica a distanza e 8 ore di permesso integrativo dedicate a visite mediche Assicurazione sanitaria prevista dal nostro contratto Unisciti al team, partecipa alla crescita del nostro business e cogli le opportunità, anche internazionali, che il Gruppo ti può offrire. Ti garantiamo inoltre un percorso di selezione equo ed inclusivo, per offrire pari opportunità di accesso al lavoro. WEAR YOUR CHANCE We are your chance!

items.desc: Descriptif du poste L’IA générative change la donne. Chez eXalt , on accompagne nos clients pour passer du POC excitant au produit en production , robuste, mesurable et utile. On cherche un·e AI Engineer expérimenté·e pour construire avec nous cette pratique GenAI et intervenir sur des cas d’usage concrets chez nos clients : RAG, agents, automatisation intelligente, copilotes métier. Ce que tu vas faire Concevoir et industrialiser des solutions basées sur des LLMs (RAG, agents, fine-tuning selon les cas) Choisir les bons outils : APIs propriétaires (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral) vs modèles open source, vector DBs, orchestrateurs Mettre en prod avec les standards software qui vont bien : tests, évaluation, monitoring, coût, latence, sécurité Challenger les cas d’usage clients (tout ne mérite pas un LLM 😉) Contribuer à la pratique IA d’eXalt : R&D, veille, partage de connaissances, prise de parole La stack Langages : Python (principalement), TypeScript selon les projets Frameworks GenAI : LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, DSPy Modèles : OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, modèles open source (Hugging Face) Vector DBs : Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector Cloud IA : AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI MLOps / LLMOps : MLflow, LangSmith, LangFuse, évaluation (Ragas, DeepEval) Profil recherché Solide expérience en développement (Python idéalement) + appétence forte pour la GenAI Tu as déjà mis en prod des solutions basées sur des LLMs (pas juste des notebooks) Tu comprends les enjeux : hallucinations, évaluation, coût des tokens, latence, sécurité, RAG vs fine-tuning Tu as une approche produit et pragmatique : tu sais dire “un LLM n’est pas la bonne réponse ici” Tu es curieux·se et joueur·se : le domaine bouge chaque semaine, tu aimes ça Bonus : background ML/Data Science, contributions open source, prise de parole (blog, conf) Déroulement des entretiens Échange avec un Digital Sales Manager (~45 min) Entretien technique avec un Tech Lead / expert IA eXalt Rencontre avec un associé pour parler vision, practice et perspectives Qui sont-ils ? En entreprise, comme en musique, tout est une question de tempo. Depuis 2018, nous réunissons des consultant·e·s passionné·e·s, curieux·ses et ambitieux·ses, uni·e·s par une même conviction : mettre leur expertise au service des défis numériques, sectoriels et industriels de nos clients. Notre mission ? Accélérer les transformations en combinant excellence opérationnelle, curiosité et audace. Nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs du luxe, du retail, de l’énergie, du transport, du tourisme, de la banque ou encore de l’assurance — partout où la technologie rencontre l’humain. Nous aimons la tech quand elle connecte et libère les potentiels. Nos consultant·e·s ne se contentent pas de conseiller : ils construisent, testent, mettent en production, mesurent, ajustent et recommencent. Avec nos clients, nous faisons partie du jeu, du début à la fin . Notre organisation repose sur une culture de la confiance, de l’apprentissage et de la collaboration . Nous avons conçu un cadre unique qui accompagne chaque eXalté·e à chaque étape de sa carrière, avec des rôles clairs, des communautés actives et des rituels qui renforcent le collectif. Nos eXaltemps trimestriels, notre eXalt Academy et nos projets internes sont autant d’occasions d’apprendre, de partager et de grandir ensemble. Aujourd’hui présents en France, au Canada, aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni, en Belgique, en Espagne, au Portugal et à Monaco , nous sommes portés par un engagement fort et une énergie contagieuse. Parce qu’apprendre est notre discipline, agir notre obsession et réussir ensemble notre plus belle victoire. Pulse. Make. Learn. Trois mots qui rythment notre quotidien. Et peut-être bientôt le tien?

items.desc: Essen, Dresden, Hamburg, München, Frankfurt am Main, Ludwigsburg, Magdeburg, Berlin ab sofort Deine Aufgaben – das machst du bei uns: Entwickle gemeinsam mit Data Scientists und Software-Entwicklern moderne Chatbot- und Voicebot-Lösungen auf Basis von ML- und GenAI-Technologien für Kunden aus der Gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung. Nutze MLOps- und DevOps-Methoden, um nachhaltige und skalierbare KI-Lösungen zu realisieren. Entwickle intelligente Dialogsysteme unter Einsatz von Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG-Architekturen und Agenten-Technologien. Entwickle und manage Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten zur Integration von KI-Modellen, Conversational Interfaces und Unternehmenssystemen. Arbeite in crossfunktionalen, agilen Teams an leistungsfähigen und innovativen KI-Produkten. Dein Background – das bringst du mit: Erfahrung mit Python und objektorientierter Programmierung (OOP) sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit Backend-Technologien, REST-APIs und Datenbanken gehören zu deinem Handwerkszeug. Know-how im Arbeiten mit Vektor-Datenbanken wie Qdrant oder PGVector und in der Similarity Search hast du bereits gesammelt. Der Umgang mit Large Language Models (LLMs), egal ob Open-Source oder API-basiert, ist dir bestens vertraut. Konzepte wie Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) und Agenten-Technologien sind dir nicht nur bekannt, sondern wendest du gezielt an. Idealerweise hast du bereits Chatbots, Voicebots oder andere Conversational-AI-Anwendungen entwickelt. Open-Source-Tools wie LangChain, LlamaIndex oder Hugging Face nutzt du routiniert für deine Projekte. Erfahrung mit Git, CI/CD und DevOps-Praktiken sowie gute Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten im agilen Umfeld runden dein Profil ab. Unsere Benefits – das bieten wir dir: Branche mit Zukunft Bei uns arbeitest du in zwei Zukunftsmärkten – IT und Gesundheit. Fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung Bleib nicht stehen - wenn du dich entwickeln möchtest. Deshalb fördern wir dich in jeder Hinsicht bei deiner persönlichen und fachlichen Entwicklung. Im Büro, zu Hause oder unterwegs – einfach flexibel arbeiten Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, an bis zu drei Tagen deine Arbeit ganz einfach mobil zu erledigen. Wir statten dich dafür technisch aus. Zusätzlich gibt es sogar noch ein einmaliges Ausstattungs-Budget – für das, was du persönlich zum Arbeiten außerhalb des Büros brauchst! Freiräume und Zeit für Regeneration Wer Leistung bringen will, muss sich wohlfühlen. Wir arbeiten in einer 39-Stunden-Woche, haben flexible Arbeitszeiten und bieten dir 30 Tage Urlaub. Wir legen sogar noch drei weitere betriebsfreie Tage oben drauf. Du möchtest mehr Zeit für dich? Dann hast du die Möglichkeit, ein Teil deines Entgeltes in weitere Urlaubstage umzuwandeln. Deine Gesundheit im Fokus Unsere Gesundheitsprogramme, einschließlich Gesundheitsseminare, Firmenläufe und Achtsamkeitsübungen, sorgen für einen klaren Kopf. Moderne Hard- und Software Heb dich auf das nächste Level – werde Teil unserer agilen Teams und nutze die neusten Technologien. Gutes Betriebsklima und Netzwerk Teamwork wird bei uns großgeschrieben! Wir arbeiten gerne zusammen, egal von welchem Standort aus. Benefits Bei uns ist deine tarifliche Vergütung gesichert. Dazu gibt es Firmentickets, eine Sabbatical-Regelung, JobRad-Leasing, Kindergartenzuschuss und viele weitere Vorteile.

items.desc: Functiebeschrijving (Note: This job posting is only open to native level or near-native level Dutch speakers . If you are not proficient in Dutch, please have a look at our other job postings instead!) Spreek jij native of near-native Nederlands? Lees dan verder! Chatbot? Dat woord zijn we eigenlijk al ontgroeid. Prompts. Flows. Data. Code. En uiteindelijk één goed gesprek. Wil jij AI-conversaties niet alleen ontwerpen, maar ze ook daadwerkelijk bouwen, testen en continu verbeteren? Als Conversational AI Engineer ontwikkel je slimme digitale klantinteracties voor chatbots, virtuele assistenten, AI-agents en digitale selfservice. Jouw rol in ons team Je werkt hands-on met conversational AI-platformen en vertaalt klantvragen en processen naar slimme flows, prompts en AI-logica. Daarbij combineer je conversational design met technologie en data: je bouwt, meet wat er gebeurt en gebruikt die inzichten om de ervaring steeds beter te maken. Van traditionele rule-based flows tot Generative AI en AI-agents: jij zorgt dat de technologie in de praktijk werkt. Wat gaat doen Ontwerpen én bouwen van conversational flows en digitale klantreizen. Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van prompts en agent-logica. Werken met rule-based, NLU-gedreven en Generative AI-conversaties. Bouwen en configureren van AI-agents en selfservice-oplossingen. Optimaliseren van intents, entities, routing en fallback-logica. Aansluiten van API's en andere systemen op conversational flows. Werken met knowledge sources en RAG-oplossingen. Testen en verbeteren van conversational AI-oplossingen. Analyseren van klantvragen, contactredenen en conversational data. Sturen op KPI's zoals containment, completion rate, fallback rate en CSAT. Documenteren van oplossingen zodat deze beheersbaar en schaalbaar blijven. Samenwerken met Customer Care, IT, Data en andere engineers. Wie jij bent Je beschikt over een relevante afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding. Je hebt ervaring m[NP3.1]et het daadwerkelijk bouwen van conversational AI-oplossingen. Je hebt kennis van conversational design en weet hoe je natuurlijke dialogen opbouwt. Je hebt ervaring met NLU, intents, prompts en/of Generative AI. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar LLM's, RAG en AI-agents. Je werkt datagedreven en gebruikt resultaten om oplossingen verder te verbeteren. items.desc: Contexte de la mission : Dans le cadre d’un programme stratégique autour de l’intelligence artificielle générative, nous recherchons un Software Engineer spécialisé en GenAI, capable de concevoir et d’industrialiser des solutions d’IA destinées à améliorer l’ensemble du cycle de développement logiciel (SDLC). Vous intégrerez une équipe d’experts techniques et interviendrez sur des sujets à forte valeur ajoutée, en collaboration avec différentes équipes IT, data et innovation, dans un environnement international et exigeant. L’objectif est de développer et de mettre en production des solutions GenAI permettant d’optimiser les pratiques de développement, d’améliorer la qualité du code et d’automatiser certaines étapes du cycle de vie logiciel. Missions principales : Concevoir et développer des applications intégrant des LLM, des architectures RAG, des embeddings et des agents IA. Développer et industrialiser des solutions GenAI appliquées au développement logiciel, notamment : Génération et complétion de code assistées par IA. Revue de code automatisée et analyse des Pull Requests. Génération de tests unitaires et amélioration de la couverture de tests. Analyse de bugs, de logs et aide au diagnostic. Modernisation, refactoring et documentation de code existant. Développement d’assistants IA et intégration de copilotes dans les IDE. Automatisation des pipelines CI/CD à l’aide d’agents IA. Mesure de l’impact des solutions IA sur la productivité des développeurs et la qualité logicielle. Participer à la définition d’architectures GenAI robustes, sécurisées et scalables. Développer des API, des microservices et des pipelines d’IA dans des environnements cloud industriels. Garantir la qualité, la sécurité, l’observabilité et la conformité des solutions déployées. Contribuer aux choix techniques, aux estimations de charge et à l’amélioration continue des pratiques de développement. Accompagner les équipes techniques dans l’adoption des solutions IA et partager les bonnes pratiques. Profil candidat: Compétences techniques requises : Développement logiciel : solide expérience en développement backend avec Python, Node.js et/ou Java. IA générative : maîtrise des LLM et des frameworks associés, tels que LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face et les API de modèles de langage. -GenAI appliquée au SDLC : expérience concrète de solutions d’assistance au développement logiciel, idéalement déjà déployées en production.- Cloud : bonne connaissance d’au moins un environnement cloud majeur (GCP, AWS ou Azure). Industrialisation : connaissance des API, microservices, pipelines CI/CD et pratiques DevOps. RAG et données : expérience des architectures RAG, des embeddings et des bases de données vectorielles appréciée. MLOps / LLMOps : connaissance des problématiques de déploiement, de supervision et de maintenance des solutions IA. Une expérience de mise en production de solutions GenAI appliquées au cycle de développement logiciel constituera un critère particulièrement important. Compétences fonctionnelles et comportementales : Capacité à intervenir en autonomie sur des sujets techniques complexes. Rigueur, esprit d’analyse et sens de la qualité logicielle. Aptitude à challenger les choix techniques et à proposer des solutions adaptées. Bonnes capacités de communication et de collaboration avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires. Participation active aux rituels Agile, à la planification des sprints et à l’amélioration continue. Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement international. Anglais professionnel indispensable, pour collaborer avec des équipes réparties dans plusieurs zones géographiques. Environnement de travail : Localisation : Clermont-Ferrand. Organisation hybride : jusqu’à 2 jours de télétravail par semaine. Méthodologie : Agile. Environnement technique : GenAI, LLM, Python / Node.js / Java, cloud, CI/CD et outils d’assistance au développement.

You’ll prototype quickly, put things in front of users early, and use what you learn to decide what to build next. items.desc: You sit with the business, not behind it. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you’ll work side by side with our clients’ teams, find the problems worth solving, and ship AI products that solve them in weeks, not quarters. Part of the job is telling clients honestly what makes sense and what doesn’t, and explaining why. You own the whole path: from the first conversation with a business owner, through scoping, estimating, and budgeting the work, to a working prototype and a product in real use. Can’t remember how to derive the backpropagation formula? Last saw a partial derivative in your second year at university? Don’t worry, nobody here will ask you to prove your loss function is differentiable. In this role, success means business impact. You’ll use foundation models, APIs, and modern AI frameworks to build products that solve real problems. You’ll prototype quickly, put things in front of users early, and use what you learn to decide what to build next. The AI landscape changes every few months, so you’ll need to pick up new tools and approaches as fast as they appear and judge which ones matter. You’ll have a lot of autonomy and real influence. We’re looking for someone who spots opportunities, proposes solutions, and drives them forward without waiting to be told what to do. You’ll also help shape the strategy and growth of our AI business unit, so what you learn on projects will directly influence where we go next. What We Offer AI Grant — Stop talking about AI and start building it. Our AI Grant gives you a dedicated budget and resources to turn your wildest AI idea into a working project, backed by two paid weeks to focus on nothing else. AI Center of Excellence — Work alongside specialists in agentic AI, sovereign AI, generative and discriminative AI. This isn’t a siloed team — it’s the people you’ll learn from and build with daily. Your tools, your choice — Full access to AI-powered development tools including Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Pick what works best for you. Real project variety — From generative AI for legal document compliance, through agentic systems in manufacturing environments, to enterprise-scale AI platforms, computer vision, and autonomous driving. You won’t get bored. Conference and speaking support — Want to attend conferences? We’ll back you. Want to speak at them? Even better — we’ll support you with dedicated preparation time and bonuses. Your tasks Work embedded with client business teams to turn their ideas into concrete, buildable product concepts Prototype fast, test with real users, and decide what to scale, pivot, or drop Scope, estimate, and budget projects, including key risks and how to mitigate them, and clearly communicate to clients what’s worth building and what isn’t Build and ship LLM-powered products: assistants, agentic workflows, and integrations with business systems Bring a product perspective: define success metrics, prioritize by business value, and measure real impact Proactively propose solutions and keep up with new models and tools as the landscape evolves Contribute to the strategy and growth of our AI business unit, from service offerings to reusable solutions Requirements At least 4 years in software engineering, including shipping LLM-based applications that real users rely on Pragmatic Python skills and hands-on experience with LLM APIs, RAG, tool calling, and agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent) Daily, practical use of AI software development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor. They’re central to how we build, and you should know how to get real speed out of them A product mindset: you think in MVPs, user feedback, and measurable outcomes Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders Experience scoping and estimating software or AI projects, including effort, cost, and risk A self-starter attitude: you take ownership, work with minimal supervision, and learn new technologies fast Advanced level of Polish and English Residency in Poland Nice to have Frontend skills for quick prototypes and demos (e.g., React, Streamlit, Gradio) Startup, product company, or founder experience Background in a specific business domain (financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, public sector) Working knowledge of a major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) Job no. JOB-7MFKW Sii ensures that all hiring decisions are made solely on the basis of qualifications and competence. We are committed to equal and fair treatment of all, regardless of legally protected characteristics. At Sii, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment, in full compliance with applicable anti-discrimination laws. Benefits For You Great Place to Work Solid financial situation Contracts with the biggest brands Centre of internal trainings Many experts you can learn from Open and accessible management team Profit sharing Passion Sponsorship program Regular …

Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : évaluer la maturité Data & IA des organisations et définir leurs ambitions ; identifier et prioriser les cas d’usage selon leur valeur métier, leur faisabilité et leurs risques ; construire des business cases, trajectoires et roadmaps IA ; repenser les processus métiers à l’aune de l’IA générative et de l’IA agentique ; accompagner les entreprises du POC jusqu’au passage à l’échelle ; définir les modèles de gouvernance et operating models nécessaires à l’industrialisation ; accompagner l’adoption de l’IA par les métiers et la transformation des pratiques ; intégrer les enjeux d’IA responsable, d’AI Act, de souveraineté, de sécurité et de maîtrise des coûts ; conseiller les clients sur leurs choix technologiques et leurs stratégies Make / Buy / Partner ; mesurer la valeur créée, les usages et l’adoption des solutions mises en œuvre. Vous n’avez pas vocation à être le développeur principal du projet, mais vous devez pouvoir dialoguer avec un architecte ou un AI Engineer, challenger une solution et en expliquer les arbitrages à un décideur. Vous contribuerez également à construire les offres IA de demain Notre pôle ne se limite pas au delivery client. Vous participerez directement à nos ambitions autour de : l’industrialisation et du passage à l’échelle des projets IA ; l’IA générative et agentique appliquée aux processus métiers ; la maîtrise des coûts et du FinOps IA ; l’accélération de la migration et de la transformation Data par l’IA ; la Data Governance et le MDM augmentés par l’IA ; l’IA responsable, souveraine et sécurisée ; la conception d’accélérateurs, méthodes et démonstrateurs réutilisables. L’objectif : transformer nos expertises et nos retours d’expérience en actifs démontrables et en offres commercialisables. 🟨 Nous rejoindre ? Parce que ce poste permet de ne pas choisir entre stratégie, innovation et réalité opérationnelle. Vous pourrez : intervenir sur des problématiques IA à fort enjeu auprès de grands comptes ; travailler au croisement des expertises Data, Cloud, Cyber, Digital et IA d’Orange Business ; rester indépendant des choix éditeurs et challenger réellement les architectures et solutions ; travailler aussi bien avec des technologies propriétaires qu’open source ; contribuer à des projets intégrant souveraineté, sécurité et numérique responsable dès leur conception ; créer des offres, accélérateurs et convictions, et pas uniquement les appliquer ; rejoindre un collectif d’experts reconnu, avec une vraie capacité d’influence régionale et nationale ; prendre la parole auprès …

items.desc:
As a Data Engineer at Meta, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Reality Labs, Threads). Your technical skills and analytical mindset will be utilized designing and building large-scale data sets, helping to craft experiences for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses worldwide.
In this role, you will collaborate with software engineering, data science, and product management teams to design/build scalable data solutions across Meta to optimize growth, strategy, and user experience for our 3 billion plus users, as well as our internal employee community.
You will be at the forefront of identifying and solving some of the most interesting data challenges at a scale few companies can match. By joining Meta, you will become part of a data engineering community dedicated to skill development and career growth in data engineering and beyond.
Data Engineering: You will guide teams by building optimal data artifacts (including datasets and visualizations) to address key questions. You will refine our systems, design logging solutions, and create scalable data models. Ensuring data security and quality, and with a focus on efficiency, you will suggest architecture and development approaches and data management standards to address complex analytical problems.
Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, identify new opportunities, and tackle upcoming challenges. You'll ensure our products add value for users and businesses, by prioritizing projects, and driving innovative solutions to respond to challenges or opportunities.
Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence your partners using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.
Conceptualize and own the data architecture for multiple large-scale projects, while evaluating design and operational cost-benefit tradeoffs within systems Create and contribute to frameworks that improve the efficacy of logging data, while working with data infrastructure to triage issues and resolve Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and data scientists to understand data needs, representing key data insights visually in a meaningful way Define and manage Service Level Agreements for all data sets in allocated areas of ownership Determine and implement the security model based on privacy requirements, confirm safeguards are followed, address data quality issues, and evolve governance processes within allocated areas of ownership Design, build, and launch collections of sophisticated data models and visualizations that support multiple use cases across different products or domains Solve our most challenging data integration problems, utilizing optimal Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) patterns, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources Assist in owning existing processes running in production, optimizing complex code through advanced algorithmic concepts Optimize pipelines, dashboards, frameworks, and systems to facilitate easier development of data artifacts Influence product and cross-functional teams to identify data opportunities to drive impact Mentor team members by giving/receiving actionable feedback
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent 7+ years of experience where the primary responsibility involves working with data. This could include roles such as data analyst, data scientist, data engineer, or similar positions 7+ years of experience with SQL, ETL, data modeling, and at least one programming language (e.g., Python, C++, C#, Scala or others.) Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) Master's or Ph.D degree in a STEM field Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Job Description For External Posting
 We are looking for a passionate Junior Aerodynamics Engineer to join our elite Flight Physics team at Airbus Defence & Space in Getafe . In this role, you won't just analyze airflows—you will directly influence the external aerodynamic design, flight performance, and safe operation of next-generation aircraft in a highly collaborative, international environment.
 From complex CFD modeling and high-speed wind tunnel testing to safe separation analysis, you will work at the crossroads of cutting-edge technology and multidisciplinary engineering.
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Aerodynamic Design & Modeling: Shape external air vehicle geometries and build comprehensive aerodynamic databases (steady & unsteady loads, performance, stability, and handling qualities).
 Experimental & Numerical Testing: Drive CFD simulation campaigns and participate directly in experimental wind tunnel testing.
 Store & Cargo Integration: Perform critical safe separation analyses for external stores and complex maneuvers.
 Innovation & Tool Development: Develop, optimize, and maintain state-of-the-art aerodynamic methods, scripts (Python/Matlab), and technological roadmaps aligning with Airbus strategy.
 Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Work closely with international experts across Flight Physics, Structures, Flight Control, Loads, and Mass Properties, as well as leading external aerospace research communities.
 Delivery Excellence: Ensure high-impact aerodynamic solutions meet time, cost, and quality standards (TCQ) across the entire aircraft lifecycle.
 SKILLS 
 Must-Haves: 
 Education: Master’s Degree in Aerospace / Aeronautical Engineering (or equivalent).
 Experience: We are looking for an Aerodynamics pro with 5+ years of hands-on military transport or combat aircraft aerodynamics experience across shape design and characterization, CFD, wind tunnel testing, or safe separation; experience in civil aircraft aerodynamics will also be highly valuable. Mastery in other Flight Physics disciplines (Performance, Loads, Flight Mechanics) is a major plus. 
 Languages: Advanced / C1 level in English (our global working language).
 Core Competencies: Strong foundation in aerodynamics principles, fluid mechanics, and flight mechanics.
 Nice-to-Haves (What will make you stand out): 
 A PhD in Aerospace Engineering focused on Aerodynamics or Fluid Dynamics.
 Proficiency with numerical aerodynamic prediction tools (CFD, high-performance meshing, solver execution).
 Previous experience in aerodynamic shape design and optimization 
 Practical experience building aerodynamic databases combining experimental and CFD data.
 Hands-on skills in Python, Matlab , or CAD tools (CATIA).
 Previous exposure to wind tunnel testing or safe separation analysis .
 Professional working knowledge of German or French.

items.desc:
TL;DR - Search is being rebuilt in real time. People now find products through Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude etc. and nobody has the full playbook yet. You'll write it for Lovable. This is a technical role first: you'll set the strategy, then make the website updates, build the tools, and ship the fixes yourself.
 Why Lovable? 
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
 Why this role? 
 The biggest shift in search in 20 years. Answer engines are changing how people discover software. You'll be one of the people defining what winning looks like there, with real traffic and real signups to prove it.
 Builder, not ticket-filer. You'll work directly with dedicated engineering and ship changes yourself. No long queues between an insight and a live fix.
 Real ownership. Organic search for lovable.dev is yours: the strategy, the roadmap, and the numbers.
 This is a technical role 
 We're looking for someone with an engineer's instincts. You should be as comfortable in a crawl log, a render trace, or a pull request as you are working with a brand team on search optimised creative systems. Day to day, that means:
 6+ years in organic search at tech or SaaS companies, with AEO & SEO results in your existing role
 Deep, hands-on technical SEO. You own structured data, sitemaps, canonicals, hreflang, and internal linking at scale. When rendering, crawling, or indexing breaks, you find out why and fix it in code yourself.
 AI-first workflow . You build your own tools, workflows and pages with AI without engineering support.
 Sharp content judgment and the willingness to cut what isn’t working.
 Strong preferences 
 PLG or self-serve experience at scale
 International SEO
 You’ve built something with Lovable
 What you’ll do 
 Own organic search for lovable.dev across Google, AI Overviews, and AI assistants
 Protect and grow search traffic as the site scales, relaunches, and changes
 Build hub pages that win our highest-intent terms
 Decide what stays, what gets refreshed, and what goes across guides, templates, the blog and more
 Earn citations in AI answers, track them, and tie them to signups
 Partner early with product marketing, design, and engineering so every launch is built to be found
 About your application
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
 We treat all candidates equally. If you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

items.desc: Unikie is seeking a Geospatial Data Science Engineer to pioneer the data layer powering our next-generation software-defined electric vehicles. In this senior role, you will be responsible for transforming massive, high-frequency streams of vehicle sensor observations into highly accurate, dynamic map features that the vehicle can use for localization, routing, and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). You will apply advanced computational statistics, machine learning, and spatial analysis to process and model large datasets, drawing actionable insights that translate raw fleet telemetry into live, high-definition maps. We value proactive problem-solvers who thrive in autonomous roles and are passionate about building performant, scalable systems at the intersection of data science and robotics. Responsibilities Geospatial Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that ingest, clean, and segment billions of daily vehicle sensor observations into consumable map features and geometries. Statistical Modeling & Insights: Apply advanced data mining and analytic methods to detect real-world changes (e.g., road closures, new lanes, construction) and design rigorous statistical tests to validate map accuracy. Map Generation & Map Matching: Develop robust algorithms for map matching, trajectory smoothing, and sensor fusion to convert noisy probe data into high-fidelity road geometry and attributes. System Design & Architecture: Lead the technical design of spatial data systems, ensuring low-latency query performance, efficient spatial indexing (e.g., H3, S2), and scalable storage of vector/raster map data. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with embedded software engineers, perception teams, and cloud architects to align onboard vehicle capabilities with cloud-based mapping platforms. Staying Ahead of the Curve: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in big data technologies, computational statistics, machine learning, and automated mapping practices. Experience: 8+ years of related professional experience building and maintaining large-scale data processing and predictive systems. Advanced Analytics & Data Mining: Expert-level knowledge in data mining and analytic methods such as regression, classifiers, clustering, association rules, decision trees, and Bayesian network analysis. Geospatial Expertise: Proven experience working with geospatial data, handling noisy time-series datasets, writing advanced spatial queries in PostGIS, and utilizing spatial libraries/indexing systems (e.g., H3, S2, GeoPandas). Programming & Scripting: Proficiency with statistical analysis packages and programming languages, including Python, SQL, and shell scripting (or familiarity with R/MATLAB). Statistical Testing: Strong statistical foundation with proven expertise in designing, executing, and analyzing complex data tests and validation methodologies. Preferred Qualifications Crowdsourced Mapping: Experience with fleet-based, crowdsourced map generation methodologies, including probe-data aggregation, change detection, and incremental map updates. Cloud Ecosystems: Experience deploying large-scale geospatial pipelines and machine learning workloads within cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Databricks). Open-Source Infrastructure: Experience with standard open-source vector tile formats, tools like Martin, QGIS, and geospatial processing engines (GDAL/OGR, GEOS). Automotive Map Formats: Familiarity with automotive map standards, routing schemas, and data structures such as NDS (Navigation Data Standard), OpenStreetMap (OSM), and Lanelet2/HD Maps. Robotics Algorithms: Familiarity with core robotics concepts, including SLAM (Simultaneous Localization & Mapping), Sensor Fusion, and Point Cloud / Sensor Processing (LiDAR, radar, vision). items.desc: Good decisions start with good data. But good data does not just happen. At NORDEN, data comes from many places and is used across our business to understand... Place of work: Hellerup Deadline: 20. november 2026 Good decisions start with good data. But good data does not just happen. At NORDEN, data comes from many places and is used across our business to understand markets, automate processes and make better decisions. Your job is to make sure that data is actually ready to be used. As our new Data Engineer, you will build the pipelines and datasets that move data through our organisation and turn raw information into something people can trust and work with. You will not be sitting far away from the business maintaining pipelines no one really talks about. You will work closely with digital and commercial colleagues, understand what they need and build the data foundation that helps them solve real problems. And while shipping knowledge is something you will pick up along the way, curiosity about data and how to make it useful is something we hope you bring from day one. Why this role? Because there is a lot to build, improve and figure out. You will join nine colleagues in our Data Engineering team in Copenhagen, working with large and varied datasets using PySpark, SQL, Azure DevOps and Microsoft Fabric. And our team is growing beyond Copenhagen. We are setting up a Data Engineering team in Singapore, starting with two colleagues, giving you an even broader team to work and share ideas with. Some days will be about building something new. Others will be about improving what already exists, finding a smarter way to structure data or figuring out why something is not working quite as expected. What connects it all is the purpose behind it: making data easier to trust, access and use across NORDEN. You already know your way around data engineering. Now you are looking for a role where you can have more of a say in how things are built, not just build what has already been decided. You will manage your solutions, contribute to technical decisions and collaborate closely with the business to understand what our data needs to do. What you will be doing You will work across the journey from raw data to reliable datasets that colleagues and systems across NORDEN can actually use. You will: Build and maintain scalable data pipelines. Bring internal and external data together and turn it into trusted datasets. Transform raw data into useful features and insights. Improve how we capture, validate and enrich data. Build solutions that are reliable today without making life difficult for whoever needs to work with them tomorrow. Work with digital and commercial colleagues to understand what they need from our data and translate that into technical solutions. What you bring You know that good data solutions are not only about getting things to work, but about making them reliable, scalable and useful to others. Besides this you likely have: Around 5 years of practical experience in data engineering or a similar role. A degree within data, IT, engineering or another analytical field. Eligibility to work in Denmark. Solid experience with Lakehouse architecture, for example in Microsoft Fabric or Azure Databricks. Experience designing and building data pipelines and working with how data is structured, transformed and made available to others. Experience contributing to technical decisions around data architecture and how data should be structured and used. The confidence to be responsible for your solutions, while still enjoying sparring with and learning from others. Good English communication skills, both written and spoken. Application Please upload your motivation letter, resume and relevant diplomas via our website as soon as possible and no later than 20 November 2026. Your motivation letter helps us understand what drives you, why you are interested in the role, and how your skills and experiences could contribute to the team. We are especially interested in your motivation and transferable skills, not a recap of your CV. It is your opportunity to tell us the story behind your application. We review and interview candidates on an ongoing basis. We will do our best to get back to you at least within ten working days after the application deadline, 20 November 2026. In NORDEN we value a range of perspectives, educational backgrounds and professional experience and encourages all qualified candidates to apply. Were you missing anything in this job ad? Please share your feedback with us here. Our company We are a global provider of ocean-based freight services for bulk and project cargo of all sizes. We integrate freight solutions with port logistics, helping our customers optimise and decarbonise supply chains. We provide tailored solutions built on flexibility, reliability, and intelligence. Our agile business model ensures stability by continuously adapting our fleet to market developments and customer needs. …

items.desc: Architecte d’Entreprise F/H Localisation : Paris – La Garenne-Colombes Nous sommes un groupe mondial de référence dans l’énergie bas carbone et les services. Aux côtés de nos collaborateurs, clients, partenaires et parties prenantes, nous nous engageons chaque jour à accélérer la transition vers un monde neutre en carbone grâce à des solutions plus sobres et plus respectueuses de l’environnement. Guidés par notre raison d’être, nous conjuguons performance économique et impact positif sur les personnes et la planète, en nous appuyant sur nos métiers clés (gaz, énergies renouvelables et services) pour proposer des solutions compétitives à nos clients. À propos d’ENGIE et de Supply & Energy Management ENGIE, leader mondial de l’énergie bas carbone et des services, s’appuie sur sa Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management (GBU S&EM) pour fournir une énergie fiable, durable et abordable à l’ensemble de ses clients. Cette entité stratégique optimise les actifs de production du Groupe et de ses clients, tout en concevant des solutions énergétiques sur mesure pour plus de 200 000 clients professionnels et 15 millions de consommateurs. La Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management valorise les actifs d’ENGIE afin de fournir une énergie sûre et durable à ses clients B2B et B2C. Grâce à son expertise en gestion de l’énergie, elle est en mesure de fournir une électricité décarbonée 24h/24 et 7j/7. Rejoindre Supply & Energy Management , c’est intégrer une équipe de plus de 10 000 experts passionnés répartis dans 20 pays, unis autour d’une mission commune : construire un avenir énergétique plus vert et plus performant. Ensemble, nous repoussons les limites de l’innovation pour fournir une énergie décarbonée en continu. Rejoignez-nous et participez à façonner l’énergie de demain. Contexte ENGIE ONE B2B est l’entité commerciale du Groupe ENGIE dédiée aux clients professionnels : entreprises, collectivités publiques et acteurs industriels. Elle couvre la vente et la gestion de solutions énergétiques (gaz, électricité, services d’efficacité énergétique et flexibilité). Dans un contexte d’accélération de la transition énergétique et de pression concurrentielle croissante sur les marchés B2B, ENGIE ONE B2B lance une transformation digitale majeure visant à moderniser ses systèmes d’information, renforcer son orientation data et améliorer sa performance commerciale et opérationnelle. Cette transformation IT s’articule autour de trois programmes stratégiques dont l’Architecte d’Entreprise garantit la cohérence globale : 1. BeeStone – Transformation du cœur de système Gestion des contrats Facturation Opérations énergétiques (back-office et middle-office) 2. Nous rejoindre, c’est être au barycentre d’un triangle entre les intérêts de nos clients, de CGI et de nos équipes. C’est aussi partager entre pairs, développer ses compétences en pilotant des projets de plus en plus complexes, travailler dans des environnements clients et opérationnels variés, collaborer avec des équipes étendues géographiquement, tout en proposant les solutions les plus adaptées. Vous rejoignez CGI, leader mondial du conseil et des services numériques à Bordeaux et accompagnez nos clients A Bordeaux, nos équipes accompagnent nos clients grands comptes et mid market dans la mise en œuvre de leurs projets stratégiques de la région sur l’ensemble des métiers dans les secteurs finance, industrie, retail, énergie et télécommunications. Vous maitrisez les compétences suivantes : Piloter des projets d’infrastructure en garantissant les engagements de qualité, coûts et délais Élaborer et suivre les plannings, jalons et indicateurs de pilotage du projet Coordonner des équipes techniques multidisciplinaires et des parties prenantes métiers Gérer les risques, dépendances et plans d’actions associés Assurer le suivi budgétaire et le contrôle des charges projet Accompagner la conduite du changement auprès des utilisateurs et des équipes concernées Appliquer les méthodologies de gestion de projet et les bonnes pratiques de gouvernance Superviser le déploiement et l’évolution d’environnements systèmes, réseaux ou cloud Produire et présenter les reportings d’avancement aux différentes instances de pilotage Anglais (professionnel) Vous êtes ou avez: : Leadership Organisation Communication Rigueur Autonomie Esprit d’équipe Chez CGI, nous cultivons un environnement de travail respectueux, où chacun peut trouver sa place et développer son potentiel. Nous sommes engagés en faveur d’un recrutement inclusif, fondé sur l’égalité des chances et la non-discrimination. Cet engagement est reconnu par le Label Recrutement Inclusif, décerné par JobinLive. Ensemble, en tant que propriétaires, mettons notre savoir-faire à l’œuvre. La vie chez CGI est ancrée dans l’actionnariat, le travail d’équipe, le respect et un sentiment d’appartenance. Chez nous, vous pourrez exploiter votre plein potentiel parce que… Nous vous invitons à devenir propriétaire dès le jour 1 alors que nous travaillons ensemble à faire de notre rêve une réalité. C’est pourquoi nous nous désignons comme associés de CGI, plutôt que comme employés. Nous tirons profit des retombées de notre succès collectif et contribuons activement à l’orientation et à la stratégie de notre entreprise. Votre travail crée de la valeur. Vous élaborerez des solutions novatrices et développerez des relations durables avec vos collègues et clients, tout en ayant accès à des capacités mondiales pour concrétiser vos idées, saisir de nouvelles opportunités, et bénéficier d’une expertise sectorielle et technologique de pointe. Vous ferez évoluer votre carrière en vous joignant à une entreprise bâtie pour croître et durer. Vous serez soutenus par des leaders qui ont votre santé et bien-être à cœur et qui vous permettront de saisir des occasions afin de parfaire vos compétences et élargir les horizons. Ce même engagement envers l’équité s’étend à notre utilisation des technologies. Afin de soutenir notre équipe de recrutement, des outils d’IA peuvent être utilisés pour aider à l’évaluation des candidatures, sans jamais remplacer le jugement humain. De la conception à l'installation, nous créons des systèmes de contrôle aérien de pointe ! Nous rendons l'accès à l'espace aérien fluide, équitable et durable. Au sein de la Direction des Opérations de l’entité Thales AVS France, DIGIS regroupe les activités IS/IT et digitales. Dans DIGIS, le chapter Architecture & Cybersecurity définit l’architecture du Système d’Information AVS. Le Système d’Information AVS est hybridé avec une empreinte sur nos différents sites, en Data Center et sur différents Clouds. Dans ce contexte, rattaché au Chapter Architecture & Security au sein de DIGIS dans le pôle Architecture Solution et en lien avec le Technology Office du Chapter, vous concevez des solutions résilientes répondant aux enjeux de confiance numérique (identité, chiffrement, ségrégation réseau) tout en satisfaisant les besoins des différentes fonctions. items.desc: Description de l'entreprise Qui sommes-nous ? Rejoindre NEXTON, c'est intégrer une entreprise où convergent l'esprit d'un cabinet de conseil, la créativité d'une Factory et la dynamique d'une ESN ! Grâce à notre expertise, nous accompagnons des clients grands comptes et des pure players tels que SNCF, Orange, et BNP Paribas dans leurs stratégies d'évolution et d'innovation digitale. Fondée en 2011, NEXTON réunit aujourd'hui une équipe de plus de 450 experts spécialisés dans le digital, le design, l'agilité, le produit et le développement. Ensemble, ils créent un écosystème riche en connaissances et en compétences diversifiées. Description du poste NEXTON recrute un Product Owner Fraude Senior H/F , en CDI , à Paris ! Ton futur environnement de travail : Tu rejoindras la direction Sécurité et Sécurisation des Paiements d'un groupe bancaire majeur. Au cœur d'une organisation agile à l'échelle, ton rôle consistera à piloter la vision, le développement et le déploiement des outils de détection, de prévention et de lutte contre la fraude sur l'ensemble des parcours digitaux et des moyens de paiement. Tes missions : Tu définis et portes la vision produit du domaine Fraude en formalisant une feuille de route stratégique visant à contrer les menaces émergentes tout en préservant la fluidité de l'expérience client. Tu maximises la valeur apportée aux équipes de sécurité et métier en traduisant les schémas de fraude et les règles d'authentification en fonctionnalités opérationnelles et performantes. Tu alimentes et priorises le backlog produit en rédigeant des User Stories détaillées accompagnées de leurs critères d'acceptation et des règles de décision en temps réel. Tu orchestres les rituels agiles de la squad en collaborant étroitement au quotidien avec les développeurs, les Data Scientists, les équipes Sécurité et le Scrum Master. Tu garantis la conformité et la sécurité des parcours en intégrant nativement les réglementations bancaires ainsi que les normes d'authentification forte. Tu pilotes les KPI de performance de détection pour mesurer l'efficacité des dispositifs anti-fraude, réduire les faux positifs et ajuster la stratégie produit en continu. Qualifications De formation Bac +5 (École de Commerce, d'Ingénieur ou Master en Management des Systèmes d'Information), tu recherches un poste à fort impact au sein du secteur financier. Tu justifies de 5 à 8 ans d'expérience au moins en tant que Product Owner acquise dans l'écosystème bancaire ou du paiement sur des problématiques de prévention de la fraude. Tu possèdes une excellente connaissance des mécanismes de fraude bancaire qu'il s'agisse de la fraude aux moyens de paiement, de l'usurpation d'identité ou de l'ingénierie sociale. Tu maîtrises parfaitement les méthodologies agiles comme Scrum et Safe ainsi que les outils d'organisation du travail type Jira et Confluence. Tu as une vraie sensibilité pour la Data et le Machine Learning nécessaires pour comprendre les modèles prédictifs et les moteurs de règles d'analyse de risque. Tu disposes d'un fort leadership et de grandes capacités de communication te permettant d'interagir efficacement avec la Conformité, les équipes IT et les risques. Tu fais preuve de rigueur et d'un esprit d'analyse aiguisé indispensable pour réagir rapidement face aux évolutions des typologies de fraude. Informations supplémentaires Pourquoi choisir NEXTON ? Nous te proposons des avantages et des opportunités pour enrichir ton expérience professionnelle et personnelle tout au long de l'année : Des communautés dynamiques pour t'accompagner dans ton parcours. Des Meet Up pour développer tes compétences. Des formations pour te réinventer et progresser. Des événements sportifs et festifs pour t'épanouir. Un forfait mobilité durable pour faciliter ton quotidien et encourager la mobilité douce. Un téléphone de dernière génération pour rester connecté. Prêt à nous rejoindre ? Rencontrons-nous ! NEXTON

items.desc: Au sein d’ALKERA SAS, structure de tête de notre groupe, la Direction des Opérations du Groupe renforce ses équipes et recrute un Data Analyst (H/F). La Direction des Opérations du Groupe composée d’environ 130 personnes gère 3 entités opérationnelles dont 2 liées à Polyexpert France, filiale spécialisée dans l’expertise de Dommages aux biens et 1 équipe de renfort administratif. Outre la gestion de ses entités opérationnelles, les activités de la Direction des Opérations du Groupe reposent sur 5 piliers vis-à-vis des filiales du groupe : le suivi opérationnel, la gestion de la qualité, la gestion des projets métiers en lien avec notre DSI, la gestion de la relation client et l’expérience clients. Le poste est rattaché au Directeur des Opérations du Groupe. Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique et enthousiaste. Vos missions : Au sein de la Direction des Opérations du Groupe, vous serez amené à : Concevoir des outils de pilotage Maintenir et faire évoluer les outils de pilotage existant Editer et mettre en forme les données de pilotage de nos différents clients Préparer les supports de Comité de Pilotage de nos différents clients (plusieurs par mois) Concevoir, implémenter et développer des tableaux de bord, des reportings de performance, d'analyse de données ou de visualisations de données (Power BI, Tableau…) Rencontrer les parties prenantes de l'entreprise pour recenser les besoins Accompagner nos différentes filiales et nos clients sur leurs différents besoins de traitement de données, d’analyses et de mise en place de reporting Comprendre, recueillir et analyser les besoins des clients Echanger avec les clients pour analyser les mesures de performance Vos compétences : Vous avez un niveau avancé sur Excel, vous savez également coder des macros simples en VBA voire en Python Vous maîtrisez le langage de programmation Dax (PowerBI) et éventuellement celui de requête de bases de données : SQL Vous maîtrisez au moins un outil avancé de visualisation de données, de préférence Power BI Vous êtes reconnu pour votre esprit analytique, structuré et rigoureux Vous êtes organisé, curieux, autonome avec une bonne expression écrite et une aisance relationnelle Vous êtes impliqué et dynamique, vous appréciez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique Vous avez le sens du client, le souci du détail et un « sens » de la donnée Profil De formation Bac +5, école d’ingénieur, école de commerce et / ou universitaire (data science, gestion de projets, système d’informations, etc.) Vous justifiez de 4 à 5 ans d'expérience, de préférence dans le secteur de l’assurance ou de l’expertise en assurance, Au moins une expérience prouvée dans l’univers de la Data Analyse, l’utilisation d’outils d’analyse de données et la préparation de supports de comité de pilotage. Localisation du poste Localisation du poste Europe, France, Ile-de-France, Hauts-de-Seine (92) Lieu Clichy la Garenne Zone de déplacement Nationale Critères candidat Niveau d'études min. requis 4- Master ou MBA Diplôme Master / diplôme d'études approfondies / diplôme d'études supérieures spécialisées / diplôme d'ingénieur Spécialisation Informatique / Système Information /Télécommunication Niveau d'expérience min. requis 2-5 ans

items.desc: Great AI doesn’t start with a great model. It starts with a great platform. The success of an AI initiative is rarely determined by the model alone. More often, it depends on the quality of the platform underneath it. As a Platform Engineer in our central Data & AI team, you’ll build the foundations that let engineers develop, deploy and operate AI workloads safely and efficiently. You’ll work on the infrastructure, automation and platform capabilities that allow teams to innovate without compromising reliability, and you’ll bridge the gap between promising technology and production reality. Think Kubernetes platforms, deployment automation, observability, security and developer experience. Think AI workloads built around Large Language Models, retrieval systems, graph technologies and modern data platforms. Think creating an environment where engineers focus on solving problems rather than fighting infrastructure. What you will work on Designing self-service platform capabilities using Kubernetes, Terraform and GitOps principles Operationalizing graph and vector databases, and enabling model serving workloads Improving the observability of AI systems running in production Integrating OpenAI or Anthropic-based services into our platform Operationalizing LangGraph workloads on Kubernetes Enabling GraphRAG architectures powered by Neo4j Designing deployment patterns so AI services meet the same standards as any other production workload You’ll spend less time tuning models and more time making sure AI capabilities can be trusted, operated and continuously improved. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, software engineering and AI. At Schuberg Philis we don’t believe in throwing solutions over the fence. The engineers building systems are responsible for running them too, and that ownership extends to AI just as much as every other technology we work with. Your impact won’t be measured by the number of clusters you manage, but by how much autonomy and confidence other engineers gain from the platform you’ve built. items.desc: Your Mission The Field Engineer owns the technical planning, deployment, execution, and support of assigned pre-clinical and clinical studies involving INBRAIN's neural-interface systems. The role ensures reliable device performance, high-quality data collection, and study readiness across research and clinical environments. Working closely with Clinical, R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and external study-site teams, the Field Engineer II serves as the primary technical lead for assigned studies and translates field experience into continuous product and process improvements. What You'll Do Study Planning & Execution Own the technical execution of assigned pre-clinical and clinical studies from preparation through close-out. Develop study-specific deployment plans, equipment strategies, and technical readiness activities. Identify and mitigate technical risks affecting study execution, data quality, or system performance. Ensure all study equipment, software, and supporting systems are available, calibrated, and compliant with applicable requirements. System Deployment & Technical Support Deploy, configure, and validate implantable-device systems and associated telemetry, stimulation, recording, and data-acquisition platforms. Perform system verification and functional testing prior to study activities. Monitor system performance during study execution and troubleshoot technical issues affecting device operation, connectivity, or data integrity. Coordinate escalation of complex technical issues to appropriate internal or external stakeholders. Stakeholder & User Support Serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned study sites and external partners. Deliver training and technical guidance to clinicians, researchers, technicians, and study personnel. Support users throughout study execution and promote adherence to approved procedures and technical standards. Documentation & Continuous Improvement Maintain accurate records of system configuration, technical activities, deviations, and equipment status. Prepare study reports and communicate technical findings to Clinical, R&D, Quality, and Regulatory teams. Provide field feedback to support product improvements, risk management activities, and usability enhancements. Contribute to the development and refinement of field-engineering procedures, tools, and best practices. Equipment Management Maintain operational readiness of field equipment through appropriate calibration, maintenance, and inventory control. Coordinate equipment repair, replacement, and supplier support activities as needed. Support continuous improvement of study setup, deployment, and technical support processes. What You'll Bring Education Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Neuroscience, Biomedical Sciences, or a related technical discipline. Experience 3–5+ years of experience supporting medical devices, clinical research, biomedical systems, or related technical environments. Experience troubleshooting complex hardware-software systems in laboratory, hospital, or field settings. Experience working within regulated environments such as medical devices, clinical research, or life sciences. Technical Skills Medical device hardware and software troubleshooting. Data acquisition, telemetry, electrophysiology, or neural-interface systems. Technical documentation and root-cause investigation. Familiarity with quality systems, study documentation, and regulated processes. Demonstrated ability to configure, integrate, test and troubleshoot multidisciplinary hardware and software systems used in in vivo studies. Ability to analyse technical problems systematically, distinguish hardware, software and workflow-related causes, and drive issues through resolution. Ability to manage multiple technical workstreams independently in dynamic and time-sensitive study environments. Behavioral Competencies Confidence working as a technical counterpart to colleagues in software, electronics, mechanical engineering, clinical and research disciplines. Clear and effective communication skills, including the ability to train users and present technical findings to diverse audiences. Self-motivated, proactive and results-oriented approach, combined with flexibility, reliability and a strong service mindset. Professional fluency in English. Willingness and ability to travel regularly to pre-clinical and clinical study sites. Preferred Experience with active implantable medical devices or brain-computer interface technologies. Experience supporting clinical studies or operating-room activities. Familiarity with design verification and validation, risk management and controlled technical documentation. Experience working within a medical-device quality management system. Physical and other requirements 30% Domestic/international travel per year .
