items.desc: Company NestAI builds the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. Most AI systems are built once, validated at deployment, and expected to stay sufficient after that. That assumption holds until conditions change, and in defence, they always do. Our team develops adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions, deployed in environments where there is no internet, no GPS, and failure is not an option. NestOS, our open, modular, and interoperable platform, enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI has grown to over 200 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry. We're ambitious about what we're building and honest with each other. The bar is high, and so are the standards we hold ourselves to. But this is also a place built on humility, trust, and looking after each other. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, keep reading. Role Description NestAI builds the software and intelligence layer for autonomous defense systems, deployed in live operational environments where reliability isn't a nice-to-have — it's the whole point. As a Full Stack Engineer, you'll own the technical delivery and integration of that platform for our most critical partners. This is not a traditional implementation or support role. It's a high-stakes, high-ownership full-stack engineering position: you'll build, adapt, and scale modern web applications, decision-support interfaces, and backend integration layers directly against complex customer environments — with the freedom to choose the right tool for the problem rather than inherit a decade of someone else's legacy decisions. We need a versatile engineer who can jump into unfamiliar codebases, connect disparate software ecosystems, and deliver intuitive, high-performance user experiences where software meets the mission. Most of what you encounter here won't have a known answer yet; you'll work it out alongside a small, senior team that has full ownership of the problems in front of it, and a product organization that takes field feedback seriously enough to ship it back into the platform in days, not quarters. Day-to-Day Responsibilities: Mission-specific full stack engineering: Take technical ownership of building, customizing, and deploying client-facing web applications, operational dashboards, and backend services. API & system integration: Design, develop, and deploy robust APIs and backend services that connect NestOS cloud and edge modules with external situational awareness and command systems. Frontend execution: Build responsive, high-performance decision-support UI designed for low-latency, mission-critical operational environments. Engineering craft under pressure: Hold a high bar for code quality, testing, and observability even while moving fast on-site. AI-driven workflows: Use modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate velocity and rapidly prototype client-requested features without sacrificing platform security or reliability. Collaborative problem solving: Work directly with customer technical teams and internal product R&D to translate operational user needs into scalable full-stack features, feeding field feedback back into our core product roadmap. Qualifications: Solid experience (equivalent to 5+ years) as a Full Stack Software Engineer, with a proven track record of shipping complex web applications and backend systems. Strong proficiency across the full web stack, including modern frontend frameworks (React, TypeScript) and server-side ecosystems (Node.js, Python, or Go). Practical experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and WebSockets, database management (SQL/NoSQL), and hands-on familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and deployment pipelines across cloud or on-prem environments. A quick study who adapts rapidly to new technical environments, diverse codebases, and shifting customer priorities — you thrive on changing scenery rather than needing a settled, well-trodden stack. Strong interpersonal skills, with the confidence to interface directly with external partners, understand user workflows, and translate complex operational needs into software realities. Willingness to travel to and work in customer environments as needed. Preferred, not required: Experience in client-facing technical delivery or technical consulting. Prior exposure to mapping/GIS libraries (e.g., Mapbox, Cesium) or data visualization. Experience in defence or aerospace environments. If your background doesn't match every requirement but the work resonates with you, we'd encourage you to apply. How you think, learn, and take ownership matters more to us than ticking every box. This role serves as a technical Subject Matter Expert for Red Teaming and adversary emulation within Hilti's Offensive Security team. Its primary focus is the design and execution of realistic, threat-informed offensive security operations across identity, endpoint, cloud, application, SaaS, OT/manufacturing and hybrid infrastructure environments. The role combines deep hands-on Red Team expertise with ownership of the supporting infrastructure, tooling, automation, operational security and tradecraft required to safely conduct offensive operations at enterprise scale. Working closely with the Blue Team, SOC, detection engineering and relevant technology teams, the role translates offensive operations into measurable improvements in prevention, detection and response. Plan and execute Red Team, Purple Team and adversary emulation exercises based on realistic threat actors, attack paths and business priorities. Design, operate and continuously improve Red Team infrastructure, tooling, automation and operational security controls. Leverage threat intelligence and emerging attacker techniques to develop realistic testing scenarios and attack campaigns. Validate prevention, detection and response capabilities and work with the SOC and detection engineering teams to improve defensive effectiveness. Drive innovation in Offensive Security by identifying, testing and operationalizing AI capabilities that improve the scale, speed and effectiveness of Red Team activities. Define and maintain operational standards, rules of engagement and safety mechanisms for offensive security activities. Provide technical mentoring, knowledge sharing and guidance to Offensive Security colleagues and stakeholders. Support awareness and capability-building activities through workshops, live demonstrations and collaborative security exercises. You will find a stable working environment, exceptional support, learning and development opportunities, and a great team around you. Here is what you will need to bring with you: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or related field; Master’s degree is a plus. 5+ years of hands-on offensive security experience, including at least 2 years focused primarily on Red Team operations. Hands-on experience designing, deploying, securing and/or operating Red Team infrastructure, for example in cloud or hybrid environments. Experience conducting attacks against Entra ID, Active Directory, and/or hybrid identity environments. Strong understanding of operational security principles, authorization boundaries, risk management, cleanup procedures, and/or emergency stop mechanisms. Practical understanding of how AI may augment offensive security activities or workflows. Strong communication skills in English. Some of the benefits of building your career with us include: Diverse global headquarters community of over 2,100 colleagues from 70 nationalities. Long-term career growth supported by transparent development framework and career opportunities across functions, regions, and roles. items.desc: About the job you're considering Role Purpose As an Observability Engineer, you’ll design, build and evolve enterprise observability capabilities across cloud and hybrid environments, with Dynatrace as our platform of choice. You’ll be equal parts engineer and consultant. You’ll implement end-to-end observability and also evangelise its value, influencing engineering, platform, operations and business teams to adopt it. You’ll help organisations move beyond traditional monitoring. You’ll do this by grounding observability in SRE principles and by turning telemetry into insight the business can act on. You’ll be recognised as a source of thought leadership in observability and reliability practice, both within our clients and across the wider profession. Your role Key Responsibilities Observability strategy and thought leadership Act as a trusted adviser, consulting with clients and teams on observability strategy, maturity and roadmaps. Define and drive observability standards, frameworks and best practices, and evangelise their adoption across multiple teams. Provide thought leadership on modern observability, OpenTelemetry and SRE practice, internally and externally. Use influence rather than authority to shift teams from reactive monitoring to proactive, data-driven operations. SRE principles in practice Establish Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and error budget frameworks, and help teams use them to balance reliability against delivery pace. Champion SRE ways of working, including reducing toil, defining error budget policies and running blameless post-incident reviews. Support incident management, root cause analysis and problem management, and feed the lessons back into engineering practice. Partner with development and platform teams to improve reliability, resilience and operational maturity. Getting the most from Dynatrace Maximise the full capability of Dynatrace across applications, infrastructure and cloud services, going well beyond out-of-the-box configuration. Use Dynatrace’s AI-driven analysis, service mapping and SLO capabilities to cut noise and shorten time to resolution. Integrate Dynatrace with OpenTelemetry instrumentation and wider telemetry pipelines to give a single, consistent view of service health. Translating business insight into meaningful dashboards Work with business and product stakeholders to understand what matters to them, and translate it into dashboards, service maps and alerts that tell a clear story. Connect technical signals to customer experience and business outcomes, so that decisions are driven by data rather than instinct. Make observability data accessible and meaningful to audiences from engineers to senior leadership. Engineering and automation Develop and maintain metrics, logs, traces and events strategies. Drive automation of monitoring, alerting and remediation. Governance and adoption Support governance, onboarding and adoption of observability platforms across multiple teams, building communities of practice that last beyond the engagement. items.desc: Unikie is seeking a Geospatial Data Science Engineer to pioneer the data layer powering our next-generation software-defined electric vehicles. In this senior role, you will be responsible for transforming massive, high-frequency streams of vehicle sensor observations into highly accurate, dynamic map features that the vehicle can use for localization, routing, and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). You will apply advanced computational statistics, machine learning, and spatial analysis to process and model large datasets, drawing actionable insights that translate raw fleet telemetry into live, high-definition maps. We value proactive problem-solvers who thrive in autonomous roles and are passionate about building performant, scalable systems at the intersection of data science and robotics. Responsibilities Geospatial Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that ingest, clean, and segment billions of daily vehicle sensor observations into consumable map features and geometries. Statistical Modeling & Insights: Apply advanced data mining and analytic methods to detect real-world changes (e.g., road closures, new lanes, construction) and design rigorous statistical tests to validate map accuracy. Map Generation & Map Matching: Develop robust algorithms for map matching, trajectory smoothing, and sensor fusion to convert noisy probe data into high-fidelity road geometry and attributes. System Design & Architecture: Lead the technical design of spatial data systems, ensuring low-latency query performance, efficient spatial indexing (e.g., H3, S2), and scalable storage of vector/raster map data. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with embedded software engineers, perception teams, and cloud architects to align onboard vehicle capabilities with cloud-based mapping platforms. Staying Ahead of the Curve: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in big data technologies, computational statistics, machine learning, and automated mapping practices. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: Education: Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Geoinformatics, Robotics, or a related quantitative field with an emphasis or thesis work on computational statistics, data mining, machine learning, or spatial optimization. Experience: 8+ years of related professional experience building and maintaining large-scale data processing and predictive systems. Advanced Analytics & Data Mining: Expert-level knowledge in data mining and analytic methods such as regression, classifiers, clustering, association rules, decision trees, and Bayesian network analysis. Geospatial Expertise: Proven experience working with geospatial data, handling noisy time-series datasets, writing advanced spatial queries in PostGIS, and utilizing spatial libraries/indexing systems (e.g., H3, S2, GeoPandas). Programming & Scripting: Proficiency with statistical analysis packages and programming languages, including Python, SQL, and shell scripting (or familiarity with R/MATLAB). Statistical Testing: Strong statistical foundation with proven expertise in designing, executing, and analyzing complex data tests and validation methodologies. Preferred Qualifications Crowdsourced Mapping: Experience with fleet-based, crowdsourced map generation methodologies, including probe-data aggregation, change detection, and incremental map updates. Cloud Ecosystems: Experience deploying large-scale geospatial pipelines and machine learning workloads within cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Databricks). Open-Source Infrastructure: Experience with standard open-source vector tile formats, tools like Martin, QGIS, and geospatial processing engines (GDAL/OGR, GEOS). Automotive Map Formats: Familiarity with automotive map standards, routing schemas, and data structures such as NDS (Navigation Data Standard), OpenStreetMap (OSM), and Lanelet2/HD Maps. Robotics Algorithms: Familiarity with core robotics concepts, including SLAM (Simultaneous Localization & Mapping), Sensor Fusion, and Point Cloud / Sensor Processing (LiDAR, radar, vision).

items.desc: Unikie is seeking a Geospatial Data Science Engineer to pioneer the data layer powering our next-generation software-defined electric vehicles. In this senior role, you will be responsible for transforming massive, high-frequency streams of vehicle sensor observations into highly accurate, dynamic map features that the vehicle can use for localization, routing, and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). You will apply advanced computational statistics, machine learning, and spatial analysis to process and model large datasets, drawing actionable insights that translate raw fleet telemetry into live, high-definition maps. We value proactive problem-solvers who thrive in autonomous roles and are passionate about building performant, scalable systems at the intersection of data science and robotics. Responsibilities Geospatial Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that ingest, clean, and segment billions of daily vehicle sensor observations into consumable map features and geometries. Statistical Modeling & Insights: Apply advanced data mining and analytic methods to detect real-world changes (e.g., road closures, new lanes, construction) and design rigorous statistical tests to validate map accuracy. Map Generation & Map Matching: Develop robust algorithms for map matching, trajectory smoothing, and sensor fusion to convert noisy probe data into high-fidelity road geometry and attributes. System Design & Architecture: Lead the technical design of spatial data systems, ensuring low-latency query performance, efficient spatial indexing (e.g., H3, S2), and scalable storage of vector/raster map data. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with embedded software engineers, perception teams, and cloud architects to align onboard vehicle capabilities with cloud-based mapping platforms. Staying Ahead of the Curve: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in big data technologies, computational statistics, machine learning, and automated mapping practices. items.desc: AI Engineer Consultant Bouw AI. Adviseer klanten. Breng het naar productie. Een goede AI-oplossing bouwen is één ding. Zorgen dat die oplossing aansluit bij wat een organisatie nodig heeft en daadwerkelijk wordt gebruikt, is iets anders. Bij Orange Business combineer je die twee. Als AI Engineer binnen ons Data & AI-team werk je samen met klanten aan AI-vraagstukken van idee tot implementatie. Je onderzoekt wat er werkelijk nodig is, maakt technische keuzes begrijpelijk en bouwt zelf mee aan de oplossing. De ene dag ontwerp je een RAG- of agentic AI-architectuur, de andere dag programmeer je in Python, experimenteer je met modellen of de evaluatie hiervan. Je bent engineer én consultant: hands-on met technologie en een Trusted Advisor voor onze klanten. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van het Data & AI-team van Orange Business Nederland: een hechte groep consultants met een gedeelde passie voor technologie. We praten graag over de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in GenAI, maar willen ze vooral begrijpen door ze zelf te gebruiken en te bouwen. We delen code en kennis, dagen elkaar inhoudelijk uit en helpen elkaar om betere engineers én consultants te worden. Tegelijkertijd kijken we verder dan technologie. Onze klanten hebben niet alleen iemand nodig die een model of agent kan bouwen. Ze zoeken een partner die begrijpt wat ze willen bereiken, kan adviseren over de juiste aanpak en hen helpt om AI daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van hun organisatie. Daar ligt onze kracht: we combineren technische kennis met consultancy. Wat ga je doen? Als AI Engineer Consultant werk je end-to-end aan Data & AI-vraagstukken bij onze klanten. Je helpt bepalen wat er gebouwd moet worden en bent vervolgens zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Je gaat onder andere: samen met klanten bedrijfsproblemen vertalen naar AI use-cases en bepalen wanneer AI wel, en niet, de juiste oplossing is; prototypes ontwerpen en deze doorontwikkelen tot betrouwbare toepassingen die in de prakrijk gebruikt kunnen worden; genAI-applicaties bouwen met onder andere LLMs, RAG, agents, tool calling en moderne AI-workflows; AI-oplossingen integreren met bestaande data, API's, applicaties en bedrijfsprocessen; schaalbare architecturen ontwerpen voor AI-applicaties in de cloud; kennis delen binnen Orange Business en bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Data & AI-propositie. We zoeken iemand met een goede technische basis die graag bouwt, samenwerkt en zich verder wil ontwikkelen als engineer en consultant. We vinden het belangrijk dat je: ervaring hebt met het ontwikkelen van AI-oplossingen, bijvoorbeeld als AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist of een vergelijkbare rol; comfortabel bent met Python en begrijpt wat er nodig is om code betrouwbaar en onderhoudbaar te maken; begrijpt wat er nodig is om AI-oplossingen verder te brengen dan een experiment of notebook richting een productieomgeving; graag samenwerkt met klanten en collega’s waarbij je technische keuzes duidelijk kunt maken aan mensen met verschillende achtergronden en kritische vragen kan stellen; nieuwsgierig bent, graag nieuwe technologie uitprobeert en je kennis deelt met andere; Een bachelor- of masteropleiding in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Wiskunde, Econometrie of een vergelijkbare richting is mooi meegenomen, maar relevante praktijkervaring vinden we minstens zo belangrijk. Technologie waarmee je kunt werken Onze stack verschilt per klant en use case. Je hoeft dus zeker niet alles al te kennen. Belangrijker Denk bijvoorbeeld aan: AI & GenAI OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Hugging Face, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, Semantic Kernel en vergelijkbare frameworks. Modern AI Engineering RAG, embeddings, vector search, agents, MCP, tool/function calling, structured outputs, prompt & context engineering en LLM evaluation. Engineering & Cloud Python, REST APIs, Git, CI/CD, Docker, Azure DevOps, Azure ML, MLflow en cloud-native deployment. Belangrijker dan ervaring met één specifieke tool is dat je begrijpt hoe je een betrouwbaar AI-systeem ontwerpt, bouwt en naar productie brengt. Waarom Orange Business? Omdat je bij ons niet hoeft te kiezen tussen technologie en consultancy. Je krijgt de ruimte om diep de techniek in te gaan én jezelf te ontwikkelen als adviseur. Je werkt aan verschillende klantomgevingen en vraagstukken en ziet daardoor veel meer dan wanneer je jarenlang aan één product of platform werkt. Tegelijkertijd sta je er niet alleen voor. Je werkt samen met een hecht Data & AI-team waarin kennisdeling, nieuwsgierigheid en elkaar beter maken belangrijk zijn. Daarnaast biedt Orange Business je de combinatie van een lokaal consultancyteam en de kennis, klanten en mogelijkheden van een internationale technologieorganisatie. items.desc: 💻 Job Title: Software Engineer (Agentic AI) 💰 Salary: up to ~€100k (flex for strong candidates) + up to 35% bonus (~20% standard, rest based on performance) 📈 Equity: very generous, early stage equity 📍 Location: Madrid (preferred) or Barcelona (1-2 office days) 🚀 Company : autonomous AI agents for enterprise clients 👥 Team : ~35 💸 Funding : ~$25m (Series A) About the company This rapidly scaling start-up is building an AI-native platform that lets enterprise clients run high-volume operations through autonomous, conversational agents — voice, chat and messaging, deployed across dozens of countries in over 60 languages, for some of the largest employers in the world. items.desc: HFM is an internationally acclaimed multi-asset broker, delivering cutting-edge trading tools, platforms, and conditions to traders worldwide. We are committed to innovation, transparency, and excellence in the financial markets. As we continue to expand, we are seeking a driven and strategic Mid AI Engineer to join our team. Responsibilities: Build and ship internal AI services end to end — from the data pipeline through the model to the API other teams call — working within the team's established architecture. Develop asynchronous REST APIs and microservices in FastAPI, deployed on Kubernetes, to serve models and orchestrate agent tool calls. Implement retrieval pipelines over PostgreSQL and pgvector — chunking, embedding, indexing and retrieval tuning — and measure them against a held-out evaluation set. Build and maintain training pipelines covering data preparation, fine-tuning, evaluation and model registration, promoting a new model only when it measurably beats the one in production. Integrate agent tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoints, ensuring each tool enforces its own access controls rather than relying on the model to do so. Write the evaluation sets, structural output checks and drift monitoring that prove a model works before release and keep proving it afterwards. Instrument services with structured logging, Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry tracing, so that failures can be diagnosed rather than guessed at. Review the work of junior engineers and trainees, pair with them on delivery, and contribute to the team's engineering and documentation standards. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of backend software development experience, including hands-on delivery of at least one machine learning or LLM application into production. Strong proficiency in Python and FastAPI, with solid working knowledge of PostgreSQL and SQL. Practical experience with LLM application patterns — retrieval-augmented generation, prompt design, structured outputs, and evaluation of model quality. Experience with Docker, Git and CI/CD pipelines, and comfort working in a containerised environment such as Kubernetes. Working knowledge of a major cloud platform, ideally AWS. A methodical approach to correctness: you write tests, you measure before and after, and you can explain how you know a change is an improvement. Strong communication skills and full professional proficiency in English. A collaborative approach — comfortable learning from senior colleagues and supporting those with less experience. Nice to have: Experience running vector search in production (pgvector, OpenSearch, Qdrant or similar). Exposure to multi-agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex) or to the Model Context Protocol. Experience with model registries and deployment workflows (MLflow or equivalent), or with serving open-weight models (e.g., vLLM). Familiarity with analytical data stores such as ClickHouse, and with observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Langfuse). Familiarity with FinTech platforms, FX trading, or financial services operations. Resumes must be submitted in English. Applicants must be eligible or have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is based. Benefits Hybrid Work Model (2 days working from home) Monthly Food Vouchers Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Summer Short Fridays (August) Additional Paid Annual Leave Birthday Leave Udemy Business access Referral Bonus Program Additional Support Visa Sponsorship and Relocation Assistance Sounds like you? items.desc: Pourquoi rejoindre Keyrus aujourd'hui ? Keyrus est un groupe international de 2 800 consultants et experts présents dans 28 pays , porté par une conviction forte : ce n'est pas l'intelligence artificielle qui transforme les entreprises, mais l'intelligence conçue, structurée et intégrée à leur fonctionnement. Depuis plus de 30 ans, nous construisons les fondations data qui permettent aux systèmes intelligents de créer de la valeur. Nous concevons le système d'exploitation de l'entreprise intelligente, où la donnée, l'IA et l'expertise humaine s'intègrent au cœur des processus métiers pour générer une performance durable. Chez Keyrus, nous donnons vie à l'intelligence opérationnelle. L'intelligence artificielle ne remplace pas l'humain. Elle lui permet de se concentrer sur ce qu'aucun système ne peut reproduire : comprendre, décider, concevoir et innover. Rejoindre Keyrus, c'est construire son jugement, son expertise et sa capacité à résoudre des problématiques complexes. La technologie est un accélérateur. La culture Keyrus fait la différence. L'excellence opérationnelle permet de relier les deux. AI Engineer L'AI Engineer construit, orchestre et déploie l'intelligence artificielle en production : briques d'IA générative (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Google Gemini, etc.), modèles de machine learning, agents multi-étapes intégrés aux systèmes du client. C'est la colonne technique du dispositif Keyrus AI, garant que ce qui est déployé fonctionne, tient à l'échelle et reste maîtrisé en coût : chaque brique construite porte sa propre responsabilité FinOps, du prototype à la production. Il construit avec le Foundations Architect qui en définit l'architecture et le Data Engineer qui prépare la donnée, confie l'intégration applicative au Software Engineer, et travaille main dans la main avec le Forward Deployed Engineer au contact du client et le Business Value Advisor sur la valeur visée ; le Data Trust & AI Governance Manager encadre la gouvernance de ce qu'il déploie et le Service Delivery Manager en assure l'exploitation dans la durée. Vous itérez à partir des retours d'usage réels (pilotes, métriques), plutôt que de considérer un agent comme terminé dès son premier déploiement. Vous accompagnez la montée en compétences des équipes internes sur ces sujets, en posture de champion du changement. Une trajectoire technique orientée vers l'autonomie croissante sur le déploiement de solutions IA, avec l'ambition d'évoluer aux côtés du Forward Deployed Engineer et du Foundations Architect. Job Description:

 Independent End-to-End crypto design, development and verification for new ground segments

 Structured and self-organized conduction of crypto system functional integration and verification tests
 Autonomous definition and implementation of verification documents according to ECSS standards
 Autonomous migration of the current crypto chain to cloud-based architecture 
 Self-organized integration of the newest crypto hardware in the ground segment 
 Required skills: 
 You have the experience and the following skills: 
 Completed university degree in technical computer science or comparable 
 minimum 3 years of professional crypto experience with hardware and software components 
 (IT) security knowledge

 Advanced expertise in: Linux, OSI model and protocols, virtualization, logging, certificate management, security hardening, firewall config, switch config 
 Experience with software development (Agile development, Linux-Environments, DevOps, Kubernetes) 
 Good communication and team skills 
 Fluency in German & English

items.desc: Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond. We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork. Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do. Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay. The Role As Etraveli Group rapidly expands its agentic AI ecosystem, we are looking for a hands-on engineer to serve as the core technical muscle for our AI Optimization team. In this role, you will rapidly build, test, and evaluate agentic MVPs using Python, APIs, and LLM frameworks. You will design rigorous evaluation pipelines to prove accuracy, latency, and ROI, ensuring all agents align with company principles. Once validated, you will act as the key technical stakeholder translating prototypes into clean specifications for our core Technology team to scale. Responsibilities Rapid Prototyping & MVP Engineering Build functional end-to-end agents using Python, LLM frameworks, APIs, and databases. Spin up infrastructure (vector/relational databases, docker containers) for real-world testing. Select architectural patterns (API wrappers, lightweight RAG, function calling). Iterate based on business feedback and discard when concepts prove unviable. Data Rigor & Technical Evaluation Design evaluation pipelines to benchmark accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, and cost. Build ground-truth labeled evaluation sets with business owners to validate production readiness. Analyze discrepancies between agent outputs and human decisions during pilots. Support business stakeholders in taking responsibility for prompts and business logic. Continuously test new AI models and tools against internal benchmarks. Feasibility & Technical Discovery Assess operational workflows with strategy teams to determine agentic feasibility and scope difficulty. Evaluate new agent architectures and AI tooling to recommend core platform adoption. Handoff & Platform Stakeholder Serve as the primary technical stakeholder to the core technology AI platform team. Translate validated MVPs into clear technical specs, architecture diagrams, and data flows. Partner with AI platform team to ensure seamless absorption of MVP logic into internal SDKs. Requirements Must Have 3+ years software engineering experience with strong Python and rapid prototyping skills. Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration (tool use, RAG, structured outputs via LangChain, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM, or APIs). Proficiency in API design, SQL, and relational/vector databases. Experience using evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith) to benchmark performance. Agile, pragmatic mindset for fast experimentation outside traditional sprint cycles. Ability to convert complex business logic into concise specs for engineering teams. Nice to Have Background as a Forward-Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or similar fast-delivery role. Familiarity with modern deployment stacks (FastAPI, Docker, serverless). Domain experience in travel tech, airline distribution, or payments. Basic product management understanding (ROI tracking, KPIs, user validation). Benefits The culture at Etraveli Group embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company. With us you can enjoy: A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you will have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location. Modern office in the heart of the city – A bright and central location with great access to public transport, lunch spots, and parks just around the corner. Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc. Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident. items.desc: **We only consider candidates based out of the Netherlands for this role.** Title: Junior AI Engineer Company: FRISS Location: Utrecht, the Netherlands Workplace type: Hybrid (1 to 2 days per week at the Utrecht office) Employment type: Full-time Seniority level: Entry level About FRISS FRISS builds fraud detection, claims automation, and underwriting risk software for P&C insurers. Our software helps carriers settle honest claims faster and send the suspicious ones to the investigators who need to see them. About the role Fraud hides in the details: a claim description that doesn't add up, or a pattern no single file shows. Our ML team builds the AI that finds those signals and helps investigators act on them: models that detect fraud in claims and unstructured text, AI agents that support fraud investigators, and explanations that show why a claim was flagged. As a Junior AI Engineer, you help build, test, and run these machine learning and generative AI features. Senior engineers in the team mentor you as you take AI features from prototype to production on Azure, and you grow into a fully independent engineer. The team builds with Claude Code as part of its daily engineering work. What you will do Build and improve fraud detection features using ML models, LLMs, and AI Agents (prompting, RAG, tool use) with senior engineers Write clean, tested Python code and contribute to shared agent and LLM components Build evaluation datasets and automated tests for the quality and groundedness of LLM outputs Support the deployment of AI services in Azure (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, containerized APIs) through CI/CD pipelines Help monitor AI services in production (logs, traces, latency, cost) and fix issues Prepare and analyze data, including unstructured text such as claim descriptions, in line with privacy (GDPR) and security practices Document your work and share findings with the team and product stakeholders What you bring An MSc in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field 0 to 2 years of experience with ML or LLM applications; internships, thesis, and personal projects count Good knowledge of Python, Git, writing tests, and REST APIs (for example FastAPI); SQL is a plus A solid understanding of ML fundamentals and of how LLMs work (prompting, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation) Hands-on experience with at least one of: OpenAI or Azure OpenAI APIs, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, or scikit-learn Curiosity, eagerness to learn, and openness to feedback; you take ownership and work well in a team Excellent communication skills in English Nice to have Exposure to Azure: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning Basic experience with Docker and CI/CD (for example Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) Experience evaluating LLM outputs or using observability tooling for AI applications Experience with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code Interest in insurance, fraud detection, or financial crime What we offer €3,000 to €4,000 gross per month Holiday allowance, pension, training budget Hybrid working: 1 to 2 days per week at the office in Utrecht An international team and setting, with English as the working language Mentoring from senior engineers, and AI work that runs in production for insurers

items.desc: A PwC-nél azon dolgozunk, hogy együttműködve segítsük ügyfeleinket a megalapozott döntések meghozatalában, hatékony működésben, és közösen formáljuk a jövőt. Ehhez az izgalmas kihíváshoz élvezetes feladatokat és inspiráló munkakörnyezetet kínálunk. Jól hangzik? Most lehetőség van, hogy Te is csatlakozz generatív MI fejlesztésekre szakosodott tanácsadó csapatunkhoz Medior AI Engineer pozícióba. Technológiai tanácsadó csapatunk jövőbe mutató, innovatív projekteken dolgozik nap mint nap. Munkánkkal a partnercégek életében történő komoly technológiai változásokat kísérjük végig. Olyan projekteken dolgozunk jelenleg, mint pl. nagy nyelvi modellek és generatív MI alkalmazása a pénzügyi és energia szektorban, vagy belső hatékonyság fejlesztése, munkafolyamatok gyorsítása generatív MI eszközökkel. Miért izgalmas ez a lehetőség? A PwC GenAI Lab dinamikusan fejlődő csapatához csatlakozhatsz, ahol Magyarország vezető szakértőitől tanulhatsz; Vállalati működési modelleket, folyamatokat alapjaiban változtathatsz meg a technológia segítségével; Megismerkedhetsz a legkülönbözőbb iparágak szereplőivel; Alkalmad nyílik a gyors fejlődésre, és munkádért versenyképes javadalmazásban részesülhetsz; Kihívást jelentő feladatok és dinamikus munkakörnyezet vár; Változatos feladatokkal és nagyvállalati ügyfelekkel foglalkozhatsz hazai és nemzetközi projektekben; On-prem és felhő alapú technológiákban szélesítheted univerzális vagy mélyítheted speciális tudásodat. Feladataid a következők lesznek: Nagy nyelvi modellekre (LLM) épülő, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) és agentic alapú rendszerek aktív fejlesztése, a koncepciótól a működő prototípusig. Innovatív megoldások kidolgozása, a legújabb generatív AI trendek és kutatási eredmények folyamatos követése és gyakorlati alkalmazása. Szoros együttműködés a vállalat különböző üzletágaival és belső döntéshozóival új felhasználási lehetőségek azonosítása és implementálása céljából. Önálló felelősségvállalás Proof of Concept (PoC) projektekben, a tervezéstől a leszállításig. Munkádat senior szakértőinkkel szoros együttműködésben végzed, biztosítva a magas minőségű eredményeket és a folyamatos szakmai fejlődésedet. A kiválasztási folyamatban sikeres lehetsz, ha rendelkezel az alábbi kompetenciákkal: Szakmai Tapasztalat: Minimum 2-3 év releváns szoftverfejlesztői tapasztalat, amelyből legalább 1 év kimondottan RAG és/vagy ágens alapú (Agentic) AI rendszerek fejlesztésével telt. Programozás: Magabiztos, haladó szintű Python tudás, beleértve az aszinkron programozás és a multiprocessing technológiák gyakorlati ismeretét. AI/LLM Ökoszisztéma: Multi-agent rendszerek, guardrail megoldások és orkesztrációs keretrendszerek (pl. LangGraph) alapvető ismerete és használata. Context Engineering: Haladó szintű kontextusépítési stratégiák ismerete és alkalmazása a modellek teljesítményének maximalizálására. Adatkezelés: Különböző adatbázisok magabiztos használata, különös tekintettel a vektoradatbázisokra. Szoftverfejlesztői Szemlélet: Erős szoftverfejlesztői alapok, CLEAN kód írására való törekvés Személyes Kompetenciák: Kiváló csapatjátékos vagy, de képes vagy önállóan is felelősséget vállalni. Proaktív, megoldásorientált hozzáállás jellemez. Nyelvtudás: Magabiztos, legalább középfokú angol nyelvtudás. A pályázatok elbírálásánál előnyt jelent: Szenvedély a nyelvi modellek és a körülöttük lévő, dinamikusan fejlődő ökoszisztéma iránt; ha a terület vezető kutatóitól és a legfrissebb publikációkból tanulsz. Multi-agent rendszerek architekturális mintáinak (pl. hierarchikus, kollaboratív modellek) ismerete és tervezési tapasztalata. Jártasság az LLM rendszerek monitorozásában és automatizált kiértékelésében. Mélyebb elméleti tudás, például a Transformer architektúra működésének részletes ismerete. Gyakorlati tapasztalat LLM-alapú rendszerek specifikus tesztelési módszertanaiban. Folyamat-automatizációs eszközök ismerete, különösen az n8n platformon, és Copilot Studio-val szerzett tapasztalat. Gyakorlati tapasztalat valamely felhőplatformon (elsősorban Azure), valamint konténerizációs technológiák (Docker, Kubernetes) alapszintű ismerete. Szélesebb körű gépi tanulási algoritmusok és technikák gyakorlati alkalmazásában szerzett jártasság. Miért válassz bennünket? Változatos feladatokkal teli munkakörnyezet és folyamatos szakmai fejlődés: nálunk lehetőséged nyílik arra, hogy tapasztalatot szerezz, miközben fejleszted képességeidet egy ösztönző, támogató közegben. Rugalmas munkarend és home office lehetőség: igény szerint te oszthatod be a munkaidődet, és részben otthonról is dolgozhatsz. Támogatás a tanulás és fejlődés útján: számos üzleti és digitális tréning, valamint egyéb workshopok várnak, hogy folyamatosan fejleszthesd személyes és szakmai képességeidet. Sokszínű juttatási csomag az alapbéren felül: éves bónusz rendszerünkön felül minden kollégánknak SZÉP-kártya, home office támogatás és magán egészségügyi szolgáltatás biztosított. PA’s IT team, internally known as Group Systems, is comprised of a variety of areas that support the wider firm, consisting of four key pillars: Strategy, Architecture and Infrastructure Services; Enterprise Solutions; Technology and Operations ; and Cyber Security and Compliance . The successful candidate will be covered two primary areas: the security of AI (protecting the organisation's own AI systems and use of AI) and AI for security (using AI to strengthen protection, detection and response). This role will sit within Cyber Security and Compliance. Technical ownership of AI security tool selection and deployment Define requirements, run structured evaluations and proofs of concept, and judge vendor claims on evidence rather than marketing. That means measuring detection efficacy, false positive rates, latency and operational overhead. The tool categories to cover include AI security posture management, LLM guardrails and firewalls, model and supply-chain scanning, GenAI data loss prevention, and AI-enabled SOC tooling. They should also own the deployment itself: integration with existing SIEM, SOAR, EDR and identity tooling, architecture decisions, and making sure the tools are tuned and producing value after go-live rather than becoming shelfware. Input to vendor risk assessments fits here too, particularly on how vendors handle your data in their own models. Understanding the AI threat landscape They need a working knowledge of AI-specific attack techniques and should be fluent in the reference frameworks, mainly the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS. Key threats include: Direct and indirect prompt injection Data and model poisoning Sensitive data leakage through prompts and outputs Model theft and extraction Malicious model files in the supply chain The growing set of risks from agentic AI, such as excessive permissions and tool misuse They also need to understand how attackers use AI against the organisation (more convincing phishing, deepfake-enabled fraud, faster reconnaissance and exploit development) and how that changes your threat model. Shadow AI, meaning unsanctioned use of AI tools by staff, is a practical, near-term issue they should be able to discover and manage. Demonstrating AI in protection, detection and response This is where the role earns its keep with stakeholders. In protection, that might mean AI-assisted vulnerability prioritisation, secure code review, or posture analysis. In detection, it covers behavioural anomaly detection, alert triage and enrichment, and LLM-assisted threat hunting. In response, it includes AI copilots for investigation and incident summarisation, automated playbooks, and agentic response actions. A good candidate will be clear-eyed about limits: where human-in-the-loop controls are needed, how to validate AI outputs, and how to avoid automating mistakes at speed. The ability to build or run demonstrators that show value concretely is a strong differentiator. Assurance and testing The role should include adversarial testing and red teaming of the organisation's AI systems, whether done directly or by scoping and overseeing third parties. Examples are testing RAG applications for injection and data exposure, or checking that an agent can't be manipulated into acting outside its intended permissions. Alignment with governance and standards This isn't primarily a governance role, but the engineer should translate frameworks into technical controls and evidence. The relevant reference points are: NCSC's Guidelines for Secure AI System Development The UK government's AI Cyber Security Code of Practice NIST AI RMF ISO/IEC 42001 The EU AI Act, where relevant to clients or operations Qualifications Skills and background The ideal profile is a security engineer (typically from cloud security, security architecture, or SOC engineering) who has built genuine ML and LLM literacy. That means understanding how models, RAG pipelines and agents work, reasonable Python or scripting ability, and cloud platform experience. Communication …

items.desc: Die APT-ONE GmbH in Berlin ist ein auf Cyber Security spezialisiertes Beratungshaus. Wir schützen die IT-, OT-, Cloud- und KI-Systeme unserer Kunden wirksam vor digitalen Bedrohungen. Unser Ansatz ist anders: KI-gestützte Werkzeuge übernehmen Discovery, Routine-Analysen und Mustererkennung – unsere Berater:innen validieren, interpretieren und konzentrieren sich auf Strategie und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen. Das ergibt tiefere Analysen und belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen in kürzerer Zeit, bei 40–60 % weniger Aufwand für Routinearbeit. KI nur mit höchster Sensibilität für Kundendaten: Datenschutz steht über jedem Effizienzgewinn. KI ausschließlich auf vertraglich abgesicherten, datenschutzkonformen Plattformen, minimierte und anonymisierte Daten, niemals Kundendaten im Modelltraining. Diesen Umgang – und die Bereitschaft, unsere Prozesse und Produkte kontinuierlich mit KI weiterzuentwickeln – erwarten wir von allen Berater:innen. Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn: du ein attraktives Fixgehalt plus überdurchschnittliche Gewinnbeteiligung willst. du ortsunabhängig an hochrelevanten Projekten in Security Operations und KI-Sicherheit arbeiten willst. du KI als Hebel siehst und Sicherheitsberatung neu denken willst – ohne Kompromisse beim Datenschutz. du deine Expertise in SOC-Plattformen, Detection Engineering und Automatisierung ausbauen willst. items.desc: Remora Robotics AS Dusavikveien 39, 4007 Stavanger Om jobben Lagre favoritt Type ansettelse Fast, heltid 100% Antall stillinger 1 Arbeidsspråk Engelsk Mulighet for hjemmekontor Delvis hjemmekontor Can you design a robot that works in the sea around the clock, through currents, corrosion, biofouling and the occasional curious salmon? Remora Robotics is looking for a senior mechanical design engineer to strengthen our R&D team and help take our underwater robots to the next level. About the role At Remora Robotics, we build autonomous underwater robots operating at commercial scale in one of the world’s most demanding industries - aquaculture. Our robots continuously clean and inspect fish farm nets, combining robotics, autonomy, AI, computer vision, and real-world operations into one integrated platform. We are now developing the next generation of our robots, and we’re looking for an experienced mechanical engineer who can turn ideas into robust hardware and help the hardware team deliver on its plans. You will join a small R&D team where your experience will be valued and your input will help shape both what we build and how we build it. You’ll work closely with electronics, software and our field operations team, and your designs will be tested at sea, not just in CAD. What you will work on Mechanical design of underwater robots, from early concepts and creative solutions to detailed CAD and complete assemblies. Pressure-rated housings, sealing solutions and structures built to survive long-term operation at sea. Material selection and tolerance analysis for components exposed to seawater, corrosion and continuous operation. Strength and structural analysis, including rotating parts, shafts, bearings and motor integration. Design for manufacturing and assembly, choosing the right production methods and working with suppliers. Technical drawings, documentation and revision control for prototypes and production. Planning and following up prototyping, testing and validation, coordinating priorities across the hardware team, and making sure projects reach their goals on time. Taking designs all the way from prototype to stable production. We are looking for someone who Has several years of experience with mechanical design and product development, ideally including products that went into production. Has strong CAD skills, including assemblies and production-ready drawings, and good habits around documentation and revision control. Knows a range of production methods and designs with manufacturability and cost in mind. Has experience with material selection, tolerance analysis, and structural and strength calculations. Can take a concept to a working prototype within tight timelines, balancing quality, speed and cost. Has experience leading hardware projects, with responsibility for planning, priorities and follow-up across disciplines. Brings structure and overview, and naturally takes responsibility for keeping the team aligned on priorities. Shares knowledge and supports colleagues, and values input from those with field experience. Has a degree in mechanical engineering, product development or a related field. It’s a plus if you have experience with Subsea or marine equipment, especially pressure testing and sealing Underwater or field robotics FEA and simulation tools Electromechanical design, such as motors, thrusters or actuators Additive manufacturing We offer An important role in a small, skilled team where you get to see your designs go from sketch to robots operating at sea. Work on autonomous robots operating in the real world, with all the fun challenges that brings. A company with strong momentum, ambitious goals and global potential. Office in Stavanger with easy access to our workshop and test facilities. Om bedriften At Remora Robotics, we build autonomous underwater robots operating at commercial scale in one of the world’s most demanding industries - aquaculture. Our robots continuously clean and inspect fish farm nets, combining robotics, autonomy, AI, computer vision, and real-world operations into one integrated platform. We develop both the hardware and software powering our systems. From embedded software and cloud infrastructure to AI-driven inspection and real-time operations, we are building the next generation of autonomous subsea robotics. items.desc: The FCU Technology team at PwC Polska includes over 100 IT specialists. The financial services industry operates in a challenging environment due to global economic pressures, increasing regulatory and capital requirements, and significant operational and technological changes. As FCU Technology, we provide innovative technological solutions, data analytics and consulting services for global PwC clients, responding to key challenges in the area of Anti Financial Crime (Anti Money Laundering, Combating Terrorism Financing, Fraud Risk Management, FATCA and implementation of financial sanctions, etc.). We are looking for: Data Scientist Your future role: Be Part of the Data Science (R&D) Team and Take Data Throughout Its Full Lifecycle - Research, Exploration, Preprocessing, Development, Integration and Implementation, Engage in Brainstorming Sessions and Develop Prototypes or Proofs of Concept That Utilize Data Science Methods to Tackle FinCrime-Related Challenges, Collaborate with Other Departments and Clients to Understand Processes and Come Up with Tailored Solutions, Create Automation Solutions Based on AI Agents, Generative AI Models, Machine Learning Techniques, Contribute to the Development of Data Science Products from Technical Perspective (Application Backend, Data Pipelines) and from Sales Perspective (Pricing, Solution Architectures, Visual Representation of the Concepts, Key Value Drivers), Support Junior and Mid-Level Team Members Through Mentoring and Technical Assistance, Participate in Training, Certifications, and Conferences (Also as a Speaker, if You Wish), Work in an Agile Environment Alongside Backend/Frontend/Low-Code Developers, DevOps, and Business Analysts. Apply if you have: Minimum of 1 Year of Experience in Data Science or Research & Development, University Degree (Preferred in Statistics, Econometrics, Mathematics or Computer Science), Proficient Knowledge in Python Programming Language, Familiarity with Several Key Data Science and Machine Learning Packages (e.g., pandas, polars, scikit-learn, Keras, PyTorch, LightGBM), Knowledge of Generative AI Concepts (e.g. Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents), Demonstrated knowledge of new technologies and AI‑powered tools in your daily work (e.g., task automation, information analysis, content creation), Excellent Written & Spoken English, Creative and Critical Thinking Skills, Curiosity and Eagerness to Learn About Multiple Business Processes and Disciplines. Nice to have: Knowledge and Experience in Relational Databases (SQL, Data Warehouse), Ability to Create Simple Proof of Concept Applications in Python (Streamlit, Poetry), Interest in Solving Problems and Addressing Business Challenges with Data and AI, Experience in Generative AI-Based Tools (LangChain, LangGraph, Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, or Similar Technologies), or Experience in MLOps/DevOps Technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, REST API, CI/CD, Linux), or Experience in Cloud Solutions (Azure, AWS or GCP Preferred). By joining us you gain: Work flexibility – hybrid working model (min. 2 days in the office per week), flexible start of the day, workation, sabbatical leave, Development and upskilling - our full support during onboarding process, mentoring from experienced colleagues, training sessions, workshops, certification co/financed by PwC e.g. (...) and conversations with native speaker, Wide medical and well-being program - a medical care package (incl. physiotherapy, discounts on dental care), coaching, mindfulness sessions, psychological support, education through dedicated webinars and workshops, financial and legal advice, Possibility to create your individual benefits package (a.o. lunch pass, insurance packages, concierge, veterinary package for a pet, massages) and access to a cafeteria - vouchers, discounts on IT equipment and car purchase, 3 paid hours for volunteering per month, Additional paid Birthday Day off, And when you start enjoying PwC as much as we do, you may recommend your friend to work with us. Recruitment process: Submit your resume, Have a short phone conversation with our Recruiter, Let's get to know each other better in the interview! Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out to us: pl_ITrecruitment@pwc.com. Please note that this email is not designated for application submissions. items.desc: At 5Plus (part of Pentadoc Group), we build production-grade AI systems that solve real operational problems for our customers. As a AI Engineer (m/f/d), you will take technical responsibility for customer-facing AI solutions — from early design decisions to production deployment and operation. You will design, build, and operate AI applications ranging from LLM-powered workflows (e.g., intelligent document processing, RAG systems) to agentic AI systems that are actively used in customer environments. German language skills at C1 level and above are mandatory for this role. You’ll work closely with customers and internal engineers to translate ambiguous requirements into reliable, scalable systems and guide AI-driven product development within customer projects. This role is hybrid , with predominantly remote work and occasional on-site presence at customer locations across Germany and our office in Würzburg, Bavaria. Your profile Several years (3–6) of hands-on experience building and operating AI/ML systems in real-world projects . Solid experience implementing agents on the LangChain stack ( LangGraph , DeepAgents ) in Python , including FastAPI interfaces. Experience with AWS (e.g. ECS , CDK , …) Strong Python expertise ( app. 5 years) and experience with modern AI/LLM tooling; framework-agnostic mindset. Proven experience with LLM-based systems (e.g., RAG, embeddings, tool usage) and an understanding of trade-offs between quality, cost, latency, and complexity. Ability to work independently in customer-facing environments , taking ownership of technical decisions under uncertainty. Professional communication skills in customer contexts. Residence in Germany . Bonus points to score Deeper experience with agentic architectures (planning, memory, multi-agent coordination). Contributions to open-source projects, technical writing, or applied research. Your daily business Design and ship end-to-end AI systems, from prototype to production. Build LLM-powered applications (incl. RAG, tool usage, validations) with a focus on reliability and cost-efficiency. Develop and operate agentic AI systems (e.g., planning, tool orchestration, multi-step workflows) with clearly defined safety and integrations into customers’ systems. Define evaluation strategies (offline + online), including metrics, benchmarks, and monitoring. Optimize system performance across latency, cost, and quality. Take technical leadership within customer project teams , coordinating architecture, implementation, and iteration cycles. Act as a technical point of contact for customers , explaining trade-offs and guiding solution decisions. Work directly with customers and internal teams to turn ambiguous, real-world problems into concrete AI solutions. Contribute to architectural decisions and support less-experienced engineers through technical guidance (no people management). Some of your benefits at 5Plus Real ownership: Build and own AI solutions that go live quickly! Small, experienced team with fast decision-making . Flexible working hours and freedom to choose your workplace . Learning budget and support for conferences and publications . Pentadoc Group offers additional benefits, feel free to check out everything. To plan an initial conversation quickly, please make sure your application contains all relevant documentation and information, you'd like to share with us. We look forward to meeting you!

items.desc: Beskrivning av tjänsten Vill du vara med och bygga nästa generations mjukvarulösningar med AI som en central komponent? Hos oss får du utveckla moderna mjukvaruprodukter där AI används som en naturlig del av både utvecklingsprocessen och de lösningar vi bygger. Vi utforskar kontinuerligt nya möjligheter inom AI – från intelligenta arbetsflöden och automatisering till AI-agenter och andra tillämpningar. Du blir en del av en etablerad produktorganisation där du får arbeta hands-on med modern mjukvaruutveckling, påverka tekniska vägval och bidra till hur vi utvecklar våra produkter och arbetssätt framåt. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera din erfarenhet som utvecklare med ett växande område inom AI och omsätta idéer till lösningar som används i verkligheten. Du behöver inte redan vara specialist inom AI. Vi söker framför allt dig som har en bra grund inom mjukvaruutveckling, är nyfiken på möjligheterna med AI och vill utvecklas vidare inom området. Det här är inte en roll med fokus på förvaltning. Du får vara med och bygga nytt, testa idéer och bidra till hur vi använder AI och ny teknik i vår produktutveckling. Du arbetar nära verksamhet, kunder och andra specialistroller och får goda möjligheter att påverka både lösningar och arbetssätt. Vad vi erbjuder: ✅Möjlighet att kombinera din erfarenhet inom mjukvaruutveckling med AI och ny teknik ✅Vara med och påverka produkten, tekniska vägval och hur vi arbetar med AI ✅Arbeta med moderna AI-verktyg och AI-drivna lösningar som en del av utvecklingsarbetet ✅Möjlighet att arbeta med hela utvecklingskedjan – från idé och design till produktion ✅ Nära samarbete med verksamhet och kunder där du ser resultatet av det du bygger Placeringsort: Stockholm, Malmö eller Karlstad Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter Som Senior Engineer blir du en viktig del av vår produktutveckling. Du arbetar tillsammans med verksamhet, kunder och andra specialistroller för att förstå behov och omsätta dem till användbara tekniska lösningar. Vi arbetar idag brett med produktivitetsverktyg och AI-relaterade initiativ i flera delar av organisationen. Nu samlar vi dessa satsningar i ett gemensamt team för att accelerera utvecklingen av både interna verktyg, arbetssät och nya funktioner som skapar värde för våra kunder. Du kommer bland annat att: Utveckla moderna mjukvaruprodukter där AI är en viktig del av lösningen Arbeta med integration av AI-tjänster, API, verktyg och affärsprocesser Utforska nya möjligheter inom AI, testa idéer och omsätta dem till praktiska lösningar för kunder och användare Bidra till tekniska vägval, systemdesign och utvecklingen av våra arbetssätt Arbeta med moderna utvecklingsmetoder, automatiserad testning och CI/CD Dela med dig av din erfarenhet och bidra till kunskapsdelning och teknisk utveckling i teamet Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling och ett stort intresse för hur AI kan användas för att utveckla bättre produkter och arbetssätt. Du behöver inte redan vara specialist inom AI – viktigare är att du har en stabil utvecklarbakgrund, är nyfiken på tekniken och vill fortsätta utvecklas inom området. För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har: Erfarenhet av modern mjukvaruutveckling, exempelvis i Python, TypeScript, .NET eller liknande teknologier Förståelse för systemdesign och hur olika delar i en modern mjukvarulösning hänger ihop Erfarenhet av moderna utvecklingsmetoder, CI/CD och automatiserade utvecklingsflöden Intresse för AI och hur tekniken kan användas i mjukvaruutveckling och produkter Du har gärna börjat använda AI-baserade verktyg som exempelvis Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, Codex eller motsvarande i ditt utvecklingsarbete. The role Most robotics simulation still relies on engines built for video games or legacy CPU physics packages never designed for massive parallelisation. This Cambridge-based startup, backed by leading VCs with a long runway and founded by veteran architects who spent over a decade building physics engines at a major semiconductor giant, is rewriting the simulation and learning stack for modern robotics from the ground up. They are a lean, deeply technical team of eleven working alongside live humanoid and quadruped hardware. You will lead the hands-on development of the core simulation and engine infrastructure, coding alongside founders who still commit engine code daily. This is a senior IC anchor seat, not an ivory-tower management track: the on-site engineering team is early-career and needs a senior systems engineer in the room to review, unblock, and mentor. If you want layers of middle management and abstracted ticket-shuffling, this is not it; if you want to write modern C++ close to the hardware and watch your simulation train physical robots in the lab, it is. The work Architect and implement the core GPU-accelerated simulation engine powering massive-scale robot learning pipelines. Write, profile, and tune performance-critical modern C++ where throughput and execution speed directly dictate training viability. Bridge the engine to real-world edge hardware, validating simulation fidelity against in-house humanoid and quadruped robots. Act as the senior technical anchor on site—setting engineering standards, unblocking complex bugs, and mentoring early-career engineers through pairing and rigorous code reviews. What You Bring Deep expertise in modern C++ with a track record of shipping performance-critical, low-level systems where speed and determinism are the product. Direct experience building or working deep inside physics engines, game engines, or comparably complex systems close to the silicon. Demonstrated seniority through mentoring earlier-career engineers, levelling up the room via pairing, rigorous code reviews, and clear technical guidance. Comfort debating technical trade-offs openly and iterating directly alongside highly technical, code-writing founders. Based in or able to relocate to Cambridge, UK, to work fully on site with the lab and robotics hardware every day. Why apply through Dex Exceptional low-level systems roles in robotics simulation are scarce, often masked by generic game-dev or robotics listings, and run by founders with a razor-thin tolerance for superficial code. Applying through Dex cuts out cold outreach and puts your systems depth directly in front of technical decision-makers. We brief you thoroughly on the underlying architecture and the team before you ever enter the room. You are the bridge between a business problem and a working solution. You bring both sides together: business understanding to see what a team really needs, and technical skill to build it. You consult on what's possible, scope it, and build quick, practical automations and proofs-of-concept using existing AI models and tooling. You build on the tools, integrations and platform that the Tool Enablement team provides, and you partner with the Machine Learning team whenever a solution is ready to scale, move into monitored production, or needs deeper engineering. What you can expect Consult and partner with commercial teams: Sit with non-technical departments to understand their processes, surface high-value automation opportunities, and shape solutions together with them. Build practical automations and POCs: Connect existing tools and LLMs into working workflows fast, to prove value before anything scales. Know our systems: Understand which internal systems and data a use case needs, judge what has to be made accessible, and articulate the requirement clearly (via APIs and, ideally, MCP). Enable teams to help themselves: Hand over working first versions and equip teams to run, adjust, and maintain simple solutions themselves. Know when to hand off: Recognize when a use case needs the ML team (scaling, self-hosting, cost or quality optimization, monitored production), Tool Enablement (tools, integrations) or IT (server infrastructure, access and security), and route it cleanly. Work in the open: Collaborate closely with the ML team, Tool Enablement and IT, whose use-case knowledge and infrastructure this role builds on. What sets you apart A blend of business and technical understanding: With a minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience you combine solid business sense with a hands-on technical foundation, for example a information systems or computer science background or a comparable mix of experience. Solid programming fundamentals: You build working MVPs yourself, wiring existing tools, LLMs and integrations into working solutions at a practical, not production-grade, level. Applied AI experience: Hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering in real use cases (Claude, GPT or similar), not just experimenting. Integration awareness: A working understanding of APIs, HTTP/JSON and, ideally, MCP, enough to connect tools and judge what data and access a solution needs. You get up to speed fast on the tools and systems our teams use day to day, so you can advise them credibly and spot where AI fits. Enabling communicator: you explain options clearly to non-technical stakeholders, translate fluently between business and technical worlds, and shape solutions together with the teams. Strong, direct communication is core to the role. Ownership: you spot opportunities, scope them, and bring a first version to life without waiting for tickets. Challenges the status quo: You question how work gets done today and look for where AI can meaningfully change the process. Language: Very good German and English skills. Out of scope (so expectations are clear) Training or fine-tuning models: this role uses existing models in a deployment setup; it does not build them. Building and owning infrastructure, platforms, or self-hosted models: provided by Tool Enablement, IT / ML. Long-term, monitored, scaled production systems: handed to the ML team once a use case grows beyond a POC. What we offer A strategically important role with real room to shape and build. A dynamic, international company with leading Private Equity involvement. A modern work environment with flexible hours and hybrid working options. A benefits app with a monthly allowance of €80 for sports, childcare, or flexible mobility. Free lunch to keep you energized and bring the team together. A permanent employment contract with long-term development opportunities. 30 days of annual leave. Additional paid time off on December 24 and December 31. Option to work up to 20 days per year from abroad. About Us JOIN US NOW! We stand for a dynamic company culture with flat hierarchies and strong team spirit. items.desc: Most AI initiatives stall somewhere between a promising prototype and a system that actually runs in production. We need an architect who closes that gap — someone who can look at a client’s problem, design a solution that makes technical sense, estimate what it will take to build, and then stay involved long enough to make sure it ships. You’ll work across both generative and classical AI pipelines — knowledge-grounded AI systems, agent frameworks, model serving, and data infrastructure on the GenAI side, alongside prediction, recommendation, and optimization models where they’re the right tool for the job. You’ll also be client-facing: leading technical conversations, pulling apart RFPs, scoping projects, and being honest about what’s feasible and what isn’t. This role requires deep fluency in at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and the judgment to know when a simpler solution is the better one. Als AI QA Engineer übernimmst du Verantwortung für eines proaktives Quality Engineering und die Testaktivitäten für entsprechende Lösungen in deinen Projekten. GenAI Qualität ist mehr als „Testfälle grün“: Bei CGI sorgst du dafür, dass Chat- und Voicebots sowie agentische GenAI Workflows verlässlich, sicher und nachvollziehbar funktionieren – auch dann, wenn sie in Workflow Engines und RPA Automationen eingebettet sind. Du definierst Teststrategien, baust Evaluations- und Regressions-Setups, testest Robustheit und stellst Produktionsreife mit klaren Qualitätsmetriken sicher. Dir sind die besonderen Qualitätsanforderungen an KI-basierte Systeme bekannt und du stellst sicher, dass regulatorische Vorgaben von Anfang an in Design, Architektur und Entwicklung mit einfließen. Aufgaben Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Teststrategie für Conversational AI, GenAI und Automationslösungen (Testpyramide, Quality Gates, Releasekriterien) Aufbau eines AI Test Harness inkl. items.desc: SIXT's central Business Intelligence team builds and maintains the SIXT Data Platform and its Data Catalogue, serving thousands of users globally. Our flagship product, the SIXT Data Shop, ingests tens of millions of events daily, processes them to meet diverse consumer needs, and delivers insights through a comprehensive toolbox — from self-service batch processes to real-time ML model endpoints. As part of a hands-on team of 30+ Data and BI Engineers, you will drive operational automation, expand self-service capabilities, and enable innovative use cases for our customers worldwide. At SIXT, we value success, agility, ownership, and intercultural collaboration — if that sounds like you, apply now and become part of the SIXT family. YOUR ROLE AT SIXT You drive innovation by exploring and implementing the latest AWS and big data technologies to uncover hidden opportunities, enable new capabilities, and build integrations for the SIXT Data Shop You collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineers, BI Analysts, and Data Scientists to architect optimal solutions for diverse analytical use cases, including dashboarding, ad hoc analytics, data-as-a-product, and machine learning You shape the Data Platform vision and roadmap by contributing your expertise, innovative ideas, and intellectual curiosity You ensure data integrity by applying exceptional work ethics when handling sensitive customer data, maintaining the highest standards of data protection YOUR SKILLS MATTER Education & Experience You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field and bring at least 3 years of professional experience as a Data Engineer with a strong focus on data modelling Data Modelling You have proven experience designing scalable data models (dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, Kimball-style methodologies) and building end-to-end automation from source systems to analytical dashboards using ELT methodologies Cloud Data Warehousing You bring hands-on expertise with Amazon Redshift, data transformation using dbt (models, tests, macros, documentation), and orchestrating interdependent workflows with Apache Airflow AWS Data Stack You have solid experience with the broader AWS data ecosystem (e.g., S3, Glue, Lambda, IAM) supporting ingestion, storage, and transformation pipelines feeding into Redshift AI Proficiency You have hands-on experience with AI coding assistants and agentic workflow automation, and ideally a solid understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems and how to leverage LLMs with contextual data Engineering Excellence You apply strong engineering best practices across the full development lifecycle — including agile methodologies, code reviews, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins), and testing — with advanced proficiency in Python and SQL and a deep understanding of distributed systems and data storage/compute principles WHAT WE OFFER A Global Tech Hub in Lisbon Join a thriving international tech community and work alongside engineers, product experts, and business teams who turn ideas into real impact. Our hubs at Factory Lisboa in Beato and ARTs Lisboa in Parque das Nações are where great tech gets built Learning & Knowledge Exchange Level up through regular events with internal and external speakers. We value curiosity, continuous learning, and open exchange – across teams, disciplines, and borders Flexible Work Setup Two office days a week, flexible hours, and modern spaces built for both deep focus and team collaboration – work the way that brings out your best Time Off & Wellbeing Enjoy 28 vacation days per year, an additional day off on your birthday, one volunteer day annually, and private health insurance that also covers your spouse and children free of charge Practical Everyday Benefits Get a yearly Coverflex allowance and a daily meal allowance to make everyday life a little easier SIXT Perks Get exclusive rates on all SIXT services, with special discounts extended to your family and friends. Because great perks are even better when you can share them About us: We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.3 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 360,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 100 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!
