items.desc: Most AI initiatives stall somewhere between a promising prototype and a system that actually runs in production. We need an architect who closes that gap — someone who can look at a client’s problem, design a solution that makes technical sense, estimate what it will take to build, and then stay involved long enough to make sure it ships. You’ll work across both generative and classical AI pipelines — knowledge-grounded AI systems, agent frameworks, model serving, and data infrastructure on the GenAI side, alongside prediction, recommendation, and optimization models where they’re the right tool for the job. You’ll also be client-facing: leading technical conversations, pulling apart RFPs, scoping projects, and being honest about what’s feasible and what isn’t. This role requires deep fluency in at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and the judgment to know when a simpler solution is the better one. You will report directly to the Head of AI. Expect a roughly 50/50 split between hands-on technical leadership on active projects and preparing new engagements — scoping, estimating, and shaping proposals. What We Offer AI Grant — Stop talking about AI and start building it. Our AI Grant gives you dedicated budget and resources to turn your wildest AI idea into a working project, backed by two paid weeks to focus on nothing else. AI Center of Excellence — Work alongside specialists in agentic AI, sovereign AI, generative and discriminative AI. This isn’t a siloed team — it’s the people you’ll learn from and build with daily. Your tools, your choice — Full access to AI-powered development tools including Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Pick what works best for you. Real project variety — From generative AI for legal document compliance, through agentic systems in manufacturing environments, to enterprise-scale AI platforms, computer vision, and autonomous driving. You won’t get bored. Conference and speaking support — Want to attend conferences? We’ll back you. Want to speak at them? Even better — we’ll support you with dedicated preparation time and bonuses. Your tasks Lead client-facing engagements — discovery sessions, technical workshops, architecture presentations — and translate business problems into well-defined AI solution specifications Analyze RFP/RFI documents, assess feasibility, and build technical proposals including architecture diagrams, delivery timelines, team composition, and cost breakdowns Scope and estimate AI projects end-to-end — from data readiness and infrastructure needs through cloud costs and ongoing operational expenses Design end-to-end architectures for generative and classical AI systems: knowledge-grounded AI, agentic workflows, multi-model orchestration, and hybrid search solutions Make and defend technology choices — foundation models, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, inference infrastructure — matching each to the problem, not the hype Define MLOps/LLMOps practices and data pipelines: CI/CD for models and prompts, evaluation pipelines, chunking strategies, embedding generation, and drift monitoring Lead technical design reviews, produce architecture decision records, and mentor engineers on AI engineering best practices Requirements At least 10 years in software/data/ML engineering, with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML architecture at scale Deep, production-level fluency in at least one major cloud AI ecosystem: Azure, AWS, or GCP Experience in client-facing roles — comfortable leading technical workshops and presenting to both C-level and engineering audiences Ability to scope and budget AI projects, including cloud cost modeling, team sizing, and delivery planning Strong hands-on skills in Python and practical experience with AI/ML frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent Practical experience building knowledge-grounded AI systems and agent architectures in production — not just prototypes Solid understanding of transformer architectures and how they affect system design decisions (context windows, latency, cost) Fluent English, both written and spoken Fluent Polish required Residing in Poland required Nice to have Experience fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, RLHF/DPO) and understanding when fine-tuning is worth the investment vs. in-context learning Background in consulting, system integration, or services delivery with exposure to enterprise procurement processes Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or published technical writing Experience with graph databases for knowledge graph-augmented search and reasoning Background in classical ML — because not every problem needs an LLM Job no. JOB-9P9KG Sii ensures that all hiring decisions are made solely on the basis of qualifications and competence. items.desc: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. Snowflake is seeking an experienced Partner Sales Manager/Director to join our dynamic France team. This role is focused on developing and managing our relationships with key channel partners and resellers across France. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of building and scaling channel partnerships in the SaaS or data platform space, with a deep understanding of the French reseller ecosystem (SEC, Orange Business Services & Software One). You will be responsible for driving revenue growth through our partners, enabling them on Snowflake's Data Cloud platform, and ensuring our joint success. Key Responsibilities: Partner Strategy & Management: Develop and execute a comprehensive channel strategy for key UK resellers. Build, maintain, and manage relationships with new and existing partners. Revenue Generation: Drive sales pipeline and achieve revenue targets through your assigned partners. Co-sell with partners and the Snowflake direct sales team to close opportunities. Partner Enablement: Lead the enablement and training of resell partners to ensure they are proficient in selling and supporting Snowflake's solutions. This includes technical, sales, and marketing enablement. Go-to-Market (GTM): Collaborate with resell partners to develop joint GTM plans, marketing campaigns, and sales initiatives. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Snowflake's internal teams (including direct sales, marketing, solution architects, and leadership) to align on channel strategy and execution. Required Qualifications: Experience: Minimum 5-7 years of experience in channel sales & partner management, within the enterprise software, cloud, or data industry. UK Reseller Ecosystem: Demonstrable experience and existing relationships with key UK technology resellers and systems integrators (e.g., VARs, SIs, MSPs). Sales Acumen: Proven track record of exceeding sales quotas and driving revenue through a partner-led model. Aptitude: Understanding of data warehousing, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), analytics, and AI/ML is highly preferred. French: Fluency or Native French will be required. Self-Starter: Ability to operate independently and in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

items.desc: Data Engineer Royal Mail Farringdon Permanent, Full time London Farringdon x3 days a week Salary & Benefits Competitive salary Plus: Car allowance Healthcare Up to 18% annual bonus potential 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays rising with service Pension: access to the UK’s only Collective Defined Contribution scheme with industry-leading Royal Mail contributions of over 12%, flexible options to boost your savings, and a guaranteed retirement lump sum* Senior Data Engineer Royal Mail is transforming how it uses data and technology to improve efficiency, support better decision-making and create value for our customers and colleagues. We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to play a pivotal role in delivering our data strategy. Working closely with Data Analytics, Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering and Technology teams, you’ll help design and build scalable data products that solve real business challenges across one of the UK’s largest and most complex organisations. This is a highly visible role offering the opportunity to lead technical delivery, influence engineering standards and support the continued development of our Data Engineering capability. What You’ll Be Doing Leading the design, development and delivery of scalable data pipelines and products that create measurable business value. Designing, optimising and monitoring our cloud data platform, with a particular focus on Google Cloud Platform. Establishing simple, standardised and innovative approaches to ingesting, processing, storing and analysing data. Leading teams responsible for sourcing, transforming and delivering data that supports frontline operations and strategic decision-making. Owning the technical lifecycle of data products, from initial concept and design through to delivery, incident management and BAU support. Working with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to deploy machine learning and AI use cases into production. Building automation across CI/CD pipelines, testing, infrastructure management, release processes and configuration. Overseeing technical priorities, resource allocation and delivery estimates across the data product portfolio. Working with Product Owners, Delivery Managers and business stakeholders to resolve technical challenges and deliver agreed outcomes. Supporting pilot and innovation activity across the organisation. Ensuring data products are documented effectively and handed over smoothly to internal teams and suppliers. Coaching and mentoring Data Engineers while promoting engineering best practice and reducing technical debt. What We’re Looking For You’ll be an experienced Data Engineer with a strong track record of building and delivering production-ready data solutions in complex environments. You’ll bring: Significant Data Engineering experience, with evidence of delivering solutions that have created measurable business value. Strong experience using Python or Scala. Hands-on knowledge of Big Data and streaming technologies such as Spark and Kafka. Experience designing data models, ETL and ELT pipelines, data warehouses and data lakes. Practical experience with Google Cloud tools such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Composer and Dataplex, or comparable services within Azure or AWS. Strong knowledge of SQL, databases, metadata management and data governance. Experience working with CI/CD toolsets, Kubernetes, release management, automated testing and cloud deployments. Knowledge of test-driven or behaviour-driven development practices, including TDD and BDD. Experience using tools such as Jira and Confluence within Agile delivery environments. An understanding of MLOps practices and how data engineering supports scalable machine learning and AI deployment. Experience managing distributed applications across cloud environments, ideally including Google Cloud Platform and Microsoft Azure. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly. A structured and analytical approach to solving problems, with the confidence to challenge constructively. Experience coaching or mentoring engineers and improving technical standards across a team. A relevant degree or recognised Cloud Engineering certifications, ideally relating to Google Cloud, would also be valuable. Why Join Royal Mail? Build data products with impact across a large and complex national organisation. Work with modern cloud, data engineering, machine learning and automation technologies. Influence engineering standards and the future direction of our data platform. Collaborate with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Analysts and Technology specialists. Develop other engineers and help grow Royal Mail’s internal data capability. Take on a visible role within a business investing in data-led transformation. items.desc: Job Purpose This is a development role. You’ll join the integrated solution services team, which focuses on infrastructure, cloud, automation, and security, as we move towards secure, automated, AI enabled services. You’ll work alongside the engineers and architects, and you’ll be encouraged to lean on experienced colleagues as you grow. As your skills develop, you’ll take on more ownership of automation and AI work.the postholder will help build and maintain Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform, assist with development of AI tooling and features, and will turn business and technical requirements into reliable, repeatable automation that reduces manual effort and risk. Role and Key Responsibilities Write, test and maintain Infrastructure as Code, mainly using Terraform, to build and change cloud resources in Azure, following agreed standards and patterns. Support the development of AI enabled tools and services, and help identify where AI can improve how the department works. Automate repetitive operational and administrative tasks using scripting (for example PowerShell and Python) and approved tools. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, using Git, pull requests and peer review for all code, and respond constructively to review feedback. Build security into your work from the start, including careful handling of credentials and secrets, with guidance from the Cloud Security Architect. Document what you build so others can use and support it. Help investigate failed pipelines and deployments, resolving issues or escalating them to senior colleagues. Take an active part in your own development by agreeing a learning plan, working towards relevant certifications, and joining team ceremonies such as stand-ups and retrospectives. Position, goals, and measures Your goals are to become a productive contributor to the team’s automation, Infrastructure as Code and AI work, to deliver secure, well-documented and peer-reviewed code that follows team standards, and to build practical skills through a structured development plan. You’ll take on increasing ownership as your skills grow. Progress is measured through the quality of your peer-reviewed work, the completeness of your documentation, progress against your learning plan (including entry-level certifications such as AZ-900 or HashiCorp Terraform Associate), and feedback from colleagues and stakeholders. Essential Experience and Capabilities A degree in computer science, software engineering, IT or a related technical subject, or equivalent practical experience (for example an apprenticeship or recognised training programme). A genuine interest in cloud, automation and infrastructure, shown through study, personal projects, placements or home labs (for example a GitHub portfolio). Understanding AI fundamentals including large language models (LLMs), inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), natural language processing (NLP) and prompt engineering. Ideally you’ll have completed an AI project, either independently or as part of your degree. Basic programming or scripting ability in at least one language (for example Python, PowerShell or Bash). An understanding of core IT concepts, including security, networking (IP addressing, DNS, firewalls), operating systems (Windows and Linux) and identity (users, groups and permissions). Awareness of cloud computing concepts and at least one major cloud platform, ideally Microsoft Azure. Familiarity with version control using Git. The ability to take a business or technical requirement, ask good questions to clarify it, and break it down into practical steps. A logical, analytical approach to problem-solving, with good attention to detail. Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document work so that others can follow it. A willingness to learn, accept feedback and lean on colleagues for support, and to work collaboratively as part of a team. An awareness of the importance of security when working with systems and data. Desirable Experience and Qualifications Exposure to Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools (for example Bicep or CloudFormation) and secure development practices. Participation in AI development projects converting business processes to repeatable, secure outcomes. Entry-level certifications, for example Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), HashiCorp Terraform Associate or AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner. Exposure to CI/CD tools (for example GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) or DevOps practices. Relevant work experience, such as an industrial placement, internship or apprenticeship in an IT or engineering team. Exposure to containers (for example Docker) or configuration management tools (for example Ansible). items.desc: GenAI Engineer Sobre la posición Buscamos un/a GenAI Engineer (Mid-Level) para acelerar la adopción de la GenAI en nuestro portfolio de productos de software de gestión empresarial. Te incorporarás a la organización de Tecnología (R&D) y trabajarás en estrecha colaboración tanto con el equipo internacional de AI Platform como con múltiples equipos de producto e ingeniería, con un objetivo claro: transformar oportunidades de AI en capacidades reales, listas para producción. No buscamos únicamente una persona que ejecute. Buscamos a alguien con mentalidad de producto, que entienda cómo llevar la GenAI a producción de forma escalable, que construya soluciones reutilizables y agnósticas a la tecnología, y que se sienta cómodo trabajando de forma transversal con varios equipos de ingeniería a la vez. Qué harás Diseñar e implementar funcionalidades de producto basadas en AI en múltiples aplicaciones de negocio. Desarrollar agentes de AI, workflows e integraciones de herramientas, así como estrategias de context engineering. Diseñar e implementar soluciones RAG apoyándote en la AI Platform corporativa. Integrar sistemas empresariales mediante APIs, arquitecturas event-driven y servicios de plataforma compartidos. Construir componentes de AI reutilizables que puedan adoptarse en distintos productos del grupo. Acompañar a los equipos de ingeniería durante la adopción de tecnologías de AI, promoviendo buenas prácticas. Evaluar nuevas tecnologías de AI y proponer mejoras pragmáticas. Optimizar las soluciones de AI en rendimiento, escalabilidad, fiabilidad y eficiencia de costes. Contribuir a las discusiones de arquitectura, la documentación y la compartición de conocimiento, alineado con la gobernanza de AI y los estándares de plataforma. Qué buscamos Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia profesional en ingeniería de software. Experiencia construyendo aplicaciones en producción con tecnologías de GenAI. Experiencia integrando LLMs comerciales u open-source (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini u otros). Experiencia diseñando e implementando soluciones RAG. Experiencia desarrollando servicios backend y APIs REST, con Python y/o Node.js. Experiencia con Docker y con servicios cloud de Azure. Conocimiento de arquitecturas event-driven, data products y plataformas de datos empresariales modernas. Nivel profesional de inglés. Soft skills Mentalidad de producto y orientación al impacto real en el negocio. Sólidas prácticas de ingeniería de software. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación. Curiosidad y aprendizaje continuo en un campo que evoluciona cada semana. Ownership y accountability sobre lo que construyes. Perfil colaborativo, cómodo trabajando de forma transversal con múltiples equipos de ingeniería. Valorable Experiencia con frameworks del ecosistema GenAI: LangChain, LlamaIndex o Semantic Kernel, LiteLLM y MCP (Model Context Protocol). Prompt engineering y context engineering, y desarrollo de agentes de AI. Bases de datos vectoriales (Pinecone o similares). Técnicas de evaluación y observabilidad de soluciones de AI. Kubernetes, CI/CD y familiaridad con el ecosistema .NET. Conocimiento de plataformas enterprise como Databricks, Terraform, Dagster, Liquibase, Witboost, Hermes o Profisee. Qué ofrece el reto Contrato indefinido. Incorporarte a la organización de Tecnología (R&D) de un grupo tecnológico europeo, trabajando codo con codo con el equipo internacional de AI Platform. Un rol con impacto real y visible: los componentes que construyas se adoptarán en múltiples productos del grupo. Modelo de trabajo híbrido.

items.desc: Openjobmetis Spa, ricerca per importante società di consulenza ingegneristica un/a System Engineer da inserire c/o azienda cliente operante nel settore dell’Ingegneria Navale e della Difesa, Ruolo e mansione La risorsa contribuirà in prima persona alla gestione di progetti di trasformazione digitale basati sull’Intelligenza Artificiale, nel contesto dell’ingegneria dei sistemi per la nave militare integrata. Opererà attivamente nella progettazione, nello sviluppo e nell'integrazione di soluzioni AI data-driven per supportare le attività di progettazione, integrazione, monitoraggio e manutenzione di sistemi complessi. In particolare si occuperà di: Definire architetture AI, Data Analytics e Digital Twin applicate a sistemi navali e piattaforme complesse. Analizzare e valorizzare dati provenienti da sensori, sistemi operativi e basi informative aziendali. Sviluppare e integrare soluzioni di Machine Learning, AI predittiva, RAG e sistemi multi-agent. Collaborare alla definizione dei requisiti, alla verifica, validazione e integrazione delle soluzioni sviluppate. Supportare la definizione di strategie di Data Governance, Data Quality e Knowledge Management. Redigere documentazione tecnica e fornire supporto diretto ai responsabili di progetto. Partecipare a iniziative di innovazione, ricerca e sviluppo in ambito Digital Engineering e AI. Requisiti e Competenze Richieste Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria dell'Automazione, Ingegneria Elettronica, Data Science, Systems Engineering o discipline affini, con specializzazione in AI, Digital Engineering o Digital Twin. Esperienza: Almeno 3 anni di esperienza professionale in Systems Engineering, Data Science o AI Engineering, con focus su progetti di trasformazione digitale e analisi dati da sistemi complessi. Conoscenza approfondita di tecniche e pipeline di sviluppo di Machine/Deep Learning, AI predittiva e distribuita; esperienza nella progettazione, industrializzazione e integrazione di soluzioni basate su Generative AI, LLM, RAG, Knowledge Base e Agentic AI. Padronanza di Data Science, Data Mining, Big Data Analytics e logiche di Data Governance/Quality per la valorizzazione di dati complessi. Visione sistemistica e solida conoscenza dei principi di Systems Engineering e MBSE; padronanza di strumenti a supporto del ciclo di vita del prodotto, del Digital Twin e di tool di Requirements Management & System Modelling (es. DOORS, Cameo, Rhapsody). Familiarità con tecnologie Cloud e piattaforme di cloud computing (es. Microsoft Azure). Job Description Forward Deployed Engineer, c'est être l'ingénieur qui transforme les ambitions IA d'un client en systèmes déployés, utilisés et créateurs de valeur. Vous intervenez là où les idées deviennent des produits . Depuis l'identification d'un problème métier jusqu'à la mise en production d'une solution opérationnelle, vous concevez, développez et déployez des systèmes d'IA agentique directement au cœur des organisations. En immersion auprès de nos clients, vous évoluez à la croisée du conseil , de l'ingénierie et de l'innovation . Vous comprenez les enjeux métier, naviguez dans des environnements parfois complexes — données hétérogènes, contraintes d'architecture, enjeux de gouvernance ou d'adoption — et concevez les solutions Data & IA les plus pertinentes pour répondre à ces défis. Ce que vous allez construire Vous développez des applications et produits intelligents qui intègrent LLM, RAG et systèmes multi-agents au sein des écosystèmes technologiques de nos clients. À titre d'exemple, nos équipes déploient aujourd'hui : une plateforme de BI conversationnelle multi-agents pour une grande Maison de luxe, intégrant plusieurs agents spécialisés, une isolation stricte des données par entité et des espaces de connaissance dédiés à chaque marque ; des agents IA et modèles GenAI/prédictifs déployés sur les opérations d'un acteur majeur de l'énergie afin d'optimiser et d'automatiser plusieurs processus critiques de la distribution. Pour rendre ces systèmes possibles, vous concevez les architectures modernes qui les alimentent, développez les pipelines de données nécessaires à leur fonctionnement et assurez leur robustesse dans le temps . Vous ne livrez pas seulement une application : vous construisez un système capable d'évoluer, de monter en charge et de produire un impact durable . La véritable complexité du poste ? Créer un prototype est accessible. Concevoir une IA agentique fiable, gouvernée et exploitable à grande échelle est un tout autre défi. C'est précisément sur cette frontière technique que vous intervenez. Vous serez amené à : concevoir des frameworks d'évaluation et de validation permettant de mesurer la qualité et la non-régression de systèmes non déterministes ; optimiser les compromis entre performance, coût et latence afin de garantir la viabilité opérationnelle des solutions déployées ; construire des architectures RAG robustes capables d'exploiter efficacement des données d'entreprise complexes, fragmentées ou peu structurées ; mettre en place les mécanismes de monitoring, observabilité, sécurité et gouvernance nécessaires à une exploitation pérenne des systèmes IA. Vous évoluerez dans des environnements où les standards restent à inventer et où l'autonomie, l'expérimentation et l'excellence technique font partie du quotidien. Le conseil comme accélérateur d'impact Parce que vous êtes au contact direct des enjeux métiers et des équipes clientes, vous contribuez également aux décisions qui conditionnent le succès des projets. À ce titre, vous participez à : l'évaluation et au benchmark des principales solutions IA, GenAI, Agentic AI et plateformes LLM du marché ( OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral AI, Google, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock , etc.) ; la conception de POC, MVP et démonstrateurs permettant de valider rapidement la pertinence et la valeur d'un cas d'usage ; des missions de cadrage stratégique, d'acculturation et de construction de feuilles de route IA auprès de directions métiers et technologiques. L'objectif reste toujours le même : transformer une intention en solution concrète et déployée . Avec qui vous allez travailler, et où ce poste peut vous mener Vous rejoignez la Practice Data …

items.desc: Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit mit technischem Tiefgang, hohem Qualitätsanspruch und Freude daran, aussergewöhnliche digitale Experiences zu entwickeln. Du verbindest Engineering mit einem ausgeprägten Verständnis für Design und User Experience und übernimmst technische Verantwortung von der Konzeption bis zum laufenden Betrieb. Über uns relyz ist eine inhabergeführte Agentur für Digital Business und Experience Design. Wir verbinden Strategie mit Design, Daten und Technologie und entwickeln digitale Lösungen, die Menschen bewegen und Organisationen voranbringen. Unsere Projekte reichen von digitalen Strategien und Transformationsvorhaben über Websites, Plattformen und Applikationen bis zu KI-Strategien und KI-Lösungen. Wir beraten unabhängig, arbeiten partnerschaftlich und begleiten unsere Kund:innen ganzheitlich – von der ersten Fragestellung über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung. Über den Job Als Digital Experience Engineer entwickelst du digitale Lösungen an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Design, Daten und Technologie. Das beinhaltet die folgenden Tätigkeiten: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Consultants, Designers und Kund:innen zusammen und bringst deine technische Perspektive bereits in Konzeption und Design ein – nicht erst bei der Umsetzung. Du übernimmst technische Verantwortung für unsere Projekte – von Architektur und Technologieentscheidungen über Entwicklung und Integration bis zu Deployment, Launch und Weiterentwicklung. Dabei arbeitest du je nach Projekt eigenständig oder gemeinsam mit externen Spezialist:innen. Du entwickelst moderne Websites und Web-Applikationen mit TypeScript, React und Next.js. Als CMS setzen wir je nach Projekt insbesondere auf Payload CMS oder Craft CMS. Du übersetzt anspruchsvolle Designkonzepte, Prototypen und Interaktionsmodelle präzise in responsive, performante und zugängliche Frontends. Du hast Freude an besonderen digitalen Markenerlebnissen und Interfaces, die sich gestalterisch und technologisch vom Durchschnitt abheben. Du entwickelst und integrierst Backend-Funktionalitäten, APIs und Schnittstellen und verbindest Websites und Applikationen mit CMS, CRM, Analytics, externen Services und weiteren Systemen. Dabei arbeitest du mit REST, GraphQL, Webhooks und zunehmend auch mit modernen Integrationsstandards wie MCP. Du entwickelst KI-gestützte Funktionen und Anwendungen – von LLM-Integrationen und RAG-basierten Wissenssystemen bis zu Assistenten und agentischen Workflows. Dabei verbindest du Modelle, Unternehmensdaten, APIs und Tools zu robusten und sinnvoll integrierten Lösungen. KI ist fester Bestandteil deines Entwicklungsworkflows. Du nutzt KI-gestützte Development Tools gezielt für Konzeption, Implementierung, Refactoring, Testing, Debugging und Dokumentation und entwickelst deinen Workflow kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei behältst du jederzeit die technische Kontrolle über Architektur, Code und Ergebnisqualität. Du deployest und betreibst Anwendungen primär auf unserer Managed-Server-Infrastruktur in Schweizer Rechenzentren. Dabei arbeitest du mit Docker sowie Node.js- und bestehenden PHP/LAMP-Umgebungen und sorgst für stabile, sichere und nachvollziehbare Deployments. Du arbeitest mit Git-basierten Entwicklungsprozessen, Code Reviews, Testing und CI/CD und stellst gemeinsam mit dem Team eine hohe Codequalität und Wartbarkeit sicher. Du berücksichtigst Performance, Accessibility, Security und Privacy von Anfang an und kennst grundlegende Konzepte rund um Authentifizierung, Autorisierung, OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect, SSO sowie Rollen- und Berechtigungsmodelle. Du sorgst mit Monitoring, Logging und sauberer technischer Dokumentation dafür, dass unsere Lösungen auch nach dem Launch zuverlässig betrieben und weiterentwickelt werden können. Über dich Du hast eine Ausbildung und/oder ein Studium im Bereich Software Engineering, Web Development, Informatik, Human Computer Interaction Design oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung abgeschlossen. Du verfügst über mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung in einer Digitalagentur und hast an anspruchsvollen Websites, Plattformen oder Web-Applikationen gearbeitet. Du beherrschst moderne Webtechnologien wie HTML, CSS und JavaScript/TypeScript sowie React und Next.js und verfügst über ein fundiertes Verständnis moderner Frontend-Architekturen. Du hast Erfahrung mit CMS-basierten und API-getriebenen Plattformen. Kenntnisse in Payload CMS, Craft CMS oder vergleichbaren Systemen sind von Vorteil. Du verfügst über ein gutes Full-Stack-Verständnis, kennst Node.js-basierte Anwendungen und kannst auch bestehende PHP-/LAMP-Umgebungen technisch einordnen und integrieren. Du verstehst relationale Datenbanken, Datenmodelle, APIs und Integrationen zwischen unterschiedlichen Systemen. Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit AI-/LLM-basierten Anwendungen und verstehst, wie sich LLMs sinnvoll in digitale Produkte integrieren lassen. Erfahrung mit RAG-Pipelines, Tool Calling, MCP …

 Information Flows up to date with the new data flows developed and deployed 
 Data Integration Platform SLR up to date 
 Configuration Mgt documentation 
 UATs deliverables in alignment with Project Manager 
 Deployment plan and associated acceptance criteria per data flows 
 Data Integration technologies metrics 
 Technical advice on architecture and integrations related to project tasks in his/her perimeter or responsibility 
 Physical data models in corresponding Data Integration platforms for associated data UCs 
 Data Quality checks of the implemented pipelines and automated alerts mechanisms

 University degree in IT related field 
 English and Spanish negotiation level is required 
 Strong collaboration and communication skills 
 Existing Security Clearance or eligibility to obtain one would be mandatory 
 Over 5 years of relevant work experience as a Data Engineer with key focus on Data Integration aspects, including Data Quality checks

 solutions/integrations for large scale data pipelines (on-premises)

 Experience in developing technical and support documentation, translate business requirements and needs into reporting and models

 API based services technologies experience is mandatory

 Knowledge on DevOps methods and tools (at least 2-3 years of experience required) 
 IT project management knowledge

items.desc: Type de contrat : CDD Contrat renouvelable : Oui Niveau de diplôme exigé : Bac + 5 ou équivalent Fonction : Ingénieur scientifique contractuel Niveau d'expérience souhaité : De 3 à 5 ans A propos du centre ou de la direction fonctionnelle The Inria center at the University of Rennes is one of eight Inria centers and has more than thirty research teams. The Inria center is a major and recognized player in the field of digital sciences. It is at the heart of a rich ecosystem of R&D and innovation, including highly innovative SMEs, large industrial groups, competitiveness clusters, research and higher education institutions, centers of excellence, and technological research institutes. Contexte et atouts du poste L’adoption généralisée de l’IA dans de nombreux domaines de la société appelle au développement de techniques rendant l’IA plus sûre et plus digne de confiance. Les systèmes fondés sur l’IA affichent des performances impressionnantes, mais leur opacité les rend peu fiables pour les applications industrielles, car ils n’offrent aucune garantie formelle. À l’inverse, les méthodes formelles excellent dans le raisonnement logique, peuvent prouver des propriétés de programmes ou détecter des erreurs, mais sont souvent limitées en matière de passage à l’échelle. Pour répondre à cette tension, Inria et MERCE (Mitsubishi Electric R&D Centre Europe) on monté un projet commun, appelé Défi FRAIME pour explorer, d’une part, comment les méthodes formelles peuvent fournir des garanties sur les systèmes d’IA et, d’autre part, comment l’IA peut aider les méthodes formelles à devenir plus efficaces et plus faciles à utiliser pour les praticien·nes. La vision de ce projet est d’ entrelacer méthodes formelles et IA afin de concevoir efficacement des systèmes sûrs. Le projet est guidé par des cas d’usage industriels relevant des domaines d’expertise de MERCE. Ce poste s’inscrit dans le projet FRAIME, qui offre un espace de recherche collaboratif stimulant entre 5 équipes Inria et 2 équipes MERCE, et sera l’opportunité pour la personne recrutée d’intéragir avec une vingtaine de chercheurs et chercheuses reconnu·es en méthodes formelles, génie logiciel et IA. Le poste vise à assurer la veille, le déploiement, l’évaluation et le partage des technologies d’IA du projet, tout en accompagnant les chercheurs par une expertise pratique et en capitalisant les connaissances issues des expérimentations. La personne recrutée aura accès aux ressources informatiques suivantes : Ilaas : https://www.ilaas.fr/ Albert : https://ia.numerique.gouv.fr/outils-ia/albert-api/ Abaca : (grille interne inria) Elle sera basée dans les locaux du centre Inria de l’Université de Rennes, et aura des interactions fréquentes avec les équipes de MERCE (localisées à proximité immédiate) et les équipes Inria de Nantes et Paris impliquées dans le Défi FRAIME. Mission confiée Ce poste consiste à identifier, déployer et évaluer les technologies d’IA les plus pertinentes pour les expérimentations du projet, notamment autour des LLM et SLM. La personne recrutée assurera une veille technologique continue et mettra en place les infrastructures nécessaires au bon déroulement des travaux. Elle accompagnera les chercheurs en leur apportant une expertise pratique sur les technologies IA et en contribuant aux choix techniques du projet. Enfin, elle favorisera le partage, la capitalisation et la diffusion des connaissances acquises, notamment via de la documentation, des synthèses d’expérimentation et des présentations en réunions plénières. Principales activités Identification des technologies pertinentes pour les expérimentations. Veille sur les technologies relatives au projet (LLMs, SLM). Déploiement des infrastructures utilisables sur la durée du projet. Mise en place de l’évaluation des expérimentations. Transmission d’une expérience pratique des technologies IA aux chercheurs du projet ; être force de proposition sur les technologies à utiliser. Participation au partage de savoir-faire et connaissances sur les aspects technologies de l’IA au sein du projet. Capitalisation et mutualisation des connaissances acquises au sein du projet. Production de synthèses sur les expérimentations réalisée, et présentation lors des réunions plénières. Compétences Compétences techniques requises Maitrise de RL / LLM / SLM : fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA), RAG, prompt engineering, quantification, optimisation de l’inférence, infrastructures techniques (déploiement local et distant). Capacité à conduire des expérimentations (construction de benchmarks, reproductibilité et suivi des expériences), analyser des résultats et évaluer des systèmes d’IA. Maîtrise des outils de développement collaboratif (Git, intégration continue, gestion de projets logiciels). Niveau Master ou équivalent en informatique, intelligence artificielle, mathématiques appliquées ou domaine connexe. Atouts supplémentaires / compétences complémentaires appréciées Une expérience des méthodes formelles serait un plus. …

items.desc: Are you excited by the move from chatbots to reliable, production-grade AI agents? Do you enjoy turning emerging AI capabilities into customer experiences that are useful, safe, measurable, and genuinely scalable? Join the Generators squad in If’s Oasis tribe and help shape the next generation of digital customer experiences in insurance. Our GenAI-powered assistant is live across Denmark, Sweden, and Norway, serving customers on web and app. Now we are expanding across the Nordics and evolving the assistant from a strong conversational experience into a more personalized, connected, and action-oriented AI product. You will be central to that journey, working on real production systems with a modern stack (LangGraph, Langfuse, Azure): designing, building, evaluating, and operating AI systems that can use internal knowledge and APIs responsibly to help customers get the right guidance at the right moment. About the role This is one open position, and we are open to both junior and senior candidates. As our Generative AI Specialist, you will be a hands-on engineer in the Generators squad, building production AI systems alongside the team, from agent design and retrieval to evaluation and monitoring. Your responsibilities include: Designing and building production-grade agentic workflows with tool and API use, orchestration, guardrails, and safe handover paths. Building the agent harness: the runtime that makes agents dependable in production, including context management, memory, and observability. Scaling our AI assistant across Nordic markets. Integrating AI systems with internal APIs and data to deliver personalized support. Improving retrieval, grounding, and response quality through systematic experimentation. Establishing evaluation practices (test sets, regression testing, human and safety evaluation) and monitoring quality, latency, and cost. Building improvement loops that use evaluations, customer feedback, and production signals. Collaborating with the Product Owner and the team through code reviews and knowledge sharing. We have a hybrid setup with fixed team days onsite. Occasional travel to Nordic markets and our Kuala Lumpur office is part of the role. You will work closely with colleagues across engineering, product, and business to turn ambitious AI opportunities into reliable customer experiences. Junior colleagues are supported by experienced teammates through pairing and code reviews, and seniors help shape the team’s direction. Who are you? You are an engineer, at junior or senior level, who is curious about AI and enjoys building, testing, and improving systems in production. You are a team player who is pragmatic, unafraid to challenge assumptions, and thrives in a cross-Nordic, cross-functional, hybrid environment. With over $1 trillion in client assets under administration, we offer fund administration, banking, payments, fund financing, foreign exchange overlay, corporate and regulatory services, custody, business consulting, and more. This is not a traditional full-stack role. Working closely within our AI Research and Development team, you will operate as an end-to-end owner , from integration through the whole engineering surface, shaping how AI agents are embedded into enterprise-grade systems . AI Feature Development & Enhancement Build and evolve the technical layer of the Workflow and Agent AI Platform, the foundation teams use to design, run, and scale AI workflows and agents. Because it’s how we defy expectations that really defines us. You’ll feel that difference in all kinds of ways. Our vibrant CULTURE. Connected team. Love of innovation, laser client focus, and next-level LEARNING & DEVELOPMENT, we also talk the talk when it comes to HYBRID WORKING. So, why settle for the ordinary? Apply now for a Brilliantly Different career. We thank all candidates for applying; however, only those proceeding to the interview stage will be contacted. MUFG is an equal opportunity employer.

items.desc: As the Researcher you will conduct desktop research into cyber and online threats, to enrich our Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) reporting. This role will primarily involve contributing regular reporting for Control Risks’ clients that subscribe to our intelligence platform, as well as supporting on and eventually leading bespoke engagements. Tasks and Responsibilities Research and Information Gathering Research new sources of information and develop capabilities to collect and analyse information in support of the team. Demonstrate strong investigation skills relating to specific cyber threat incidents, data breaches and other cyber security incidents. Build knowledge of collection tools to support bespoke investigative projects and Cyber Incident Response engagements. Conduct research on topics which support other service lines, notably Intelligence and Analysis and and Response. Develop knowledge of principal cyber and online threat actors through research on open source, social media, deep and dark web sites and Control Risks internal intelligence systems. Contribute continuous research for inclusion in routine CTI reporting and bespoke threat assessments. Support CTI threat monitoring activities with consistent and routing intelligence collection for our bespoke clients. Please note that this role includes some flexible weekend monitoring. General Analytical Responsibilities Support analysis on bespoke projects through data collection across all CTI products, demonstrating an ability to make judgments on the value of research collected. Be technically aware and understand basic cyber security principals e.g. MITRE ATT&CK, the unified kill chain, the intelligence life cycle Be alert to the political implications of developments among cyber threat groups and bring these to the attention of other service lines. Contribute analysis for subscription updates. Marketing and Business Development Support business development by initial research scoping for proposals and other business development and marketing exercises. Requirements Knowledge and Experience Essential Interest in and knowledge of cyber threat and risk issues and the interaction between political and geopolitical developments and the evolving threat landscape. Interest in and knowledge of broader trends and developments in technology, including AI, and associated regulatory landscape. Interest in and knowledge of intelligence and threat assessment principles, understanding of methods used to identify, understand and compare threat actors. Academic or professional training in online investigations or open source collection. Ability to prepare sizable written reports for a senior business audience. Preferred Experience in undertaking operational and tactical level research and investigations relating to cyber threat incidents or using cyber as a means of collecting information. Additional languages to English. Russian, Chinese, Farsi preferred. Qualifications and specialist skills Essential Degree level qualification or equivalent. Demonstrable experience in collecting information from multiple sources in support of complex research projects in the online intelligence or cyber threat and security domains. Preferred High level of Microsoft Excel proficiency (knowledge of pivot tables and macros). Intelligence analysis training or qualifications (e.g. City and Guilds, SANS GIAC, CREST threat intelligence practitioner or researcher, GIAT or DIAM UK government modules). Open source intelligence collection and investigation qualifications. Interest and experience in analysing complex international relations issues. Benefits Control Risks offers a competitively positioned compensation and benefits package that is transparent and summarised in the full job offer. We operate a discretionary global bonus scheme that incentivises, and rewards individuals based on company and individual performance. Control Risks supports hybrid working arrangements, wherever possible, that emphasise the value of in-person time together - in the office and with our clients - while continuing to support flexible and remote working. As an equal opportunities employer, we encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join us and are fully committed to equal treatment, free from discrimination, of all candidates throughout our recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments to be made in order to participate fully in the interview process, please let us know and we will be happy to accommodate your needs.

items.desc: Prêt à transformer la vision en action ? Magellan est un Groupe international de Conseil en management et de Technologies. Notre force réside dans notre capacité à activer à la fois expertise métier et maîtrise technologique pour accompagner les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans toutes leurs transformations. VISION IN ACTION Dans un environnement où les mutations s’accélèrent, les organisations doivent en permanence réinventer leurs modèles pour rester compétitives. Pour y répondre, nous accompagnons nos clients de la définition de leur stratégie à sa mise en œuvre opérationnelle, en combinant expertise métier, maîtrise technologique et capacité d'exécution. Rejoindre Magellan, c’est intégrer un collectif de 6 700 talents engagés, unis par une même exigence : accompagner les enjeux de nos clients dans toute leur complexité pour construire des solutions concrètes et activables au plus près des réalités du terrain. Magellan figure parmi les entreprises où faire accélérer sa carrière (Classement LinkedIn Top Companies 2026). L’opportunité Votre rôle consiste à favoriser la veille technologique, l’adoption et l’innovation au sein de l’unité Interactions omnicanales, avec une attention particulière portée aux chatbots conversationnels, aux callbots et aux systèmes agentiques. Votre temps sera réparti approximativement de la manière suivante : 50 % – Développement : contribution à de nouvelles fonctionnalités pour nos solutions d’IA, ainsi que conception de preuves de concept et de pilotes afin de valider des idées émergentes. 30 % – Évangélisation et vulgarisation : partage des connaissances, animation de communautés internes et sensibilisation à l’IA auprès de publics variés, notamment dans le cadre de démonstrations clients. 20 % – Veille technologique : identification des signaux pertinents parmi le bruit ambiant, qualification des opportunités et accompagnement des Product Managers et des architectes dans leurs choix technologiques. Cette répartition pourra évoluer en fonction de la feuille de route produit et du rythme des évolutions technologiques. Vos responsabilités Innovation et développement (≈ 50 %) Contribuer au développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités pour nos solutions d’IA conversationnelle, de technologies vocales et d’orchestration agentique. Concevoir, développer et documenter des preuves de concept et des pilotes afin de valider des technologies et des cas d’usage émergents : LLM, modèles agentiques, RAG, IA vocale, garde-fous, automatisation, etc. Livrer des preuves de concept accompagnées de recommandations claires de type go/no-go , puis assurer leur transmission aux équipes produit en vue de leur industrialisation. Acquérir une compréhension solide de nos solutions et de leur architecture afin de garantir que les propositions d’innovation soient pragmatiques et intégrables. Travailler principalement avec Java, Kotlin et Python , en fonction de la nature de l’expérimentation ou de la fonctionnalité. Collaborer étroitement avec les Lead Developers, les architectes et les Product Managers des différentes lignes de produits. Évangélisation et vulgarisation (≈ 30 %) Agir comme référent interne sur les sujets liés à l’IA au sein de l’unité Interactions omnicanales et au-delà. Animer des sessions transverses, des démonstrations et des ateliers consacrés aux tendances et aux innovations en matière d’IA. Adapter votre discours à une grande diversité de publics : équipes techniques, produit, commerciales, management et clients. Produire des contenus valorisant les résultats de votre veille et de vos expérimentations : articles de blog internes, newsletters, démonstrations en direct, vidéos courtes ou tout autre format favorisant la diffusion de l’innovation. Développer et entretenir un réseau interne entre les différentes lignes de produits afin de favoriser la collaboration, l’alignement et le partage des idées. Représenter Magellan à l’extérieur lorsque cela est pertinent — conférences, meetups ou publications. Ces opportunités seront définies en fonction de votre profil et de vos aspirations. Veille technologique (≈ 20 %) Maintenir une veille technologique structurée sur l’IA et les sujets connexes pertinents pour les systèmes conversationnels et agentiques. Replacer les nouvelles tendances dans notre réalité métier et technique afin de distinguer les effets de mode des véritables opportunités. Produire des livrables de veille réguliers : rapports de veille, backlog d’opportunités qualifiées et synthèses mensuelles de l’actualité de l’IA. Conseiller les Product Managers et les architectes sur les choix technologiques , la sélection des modèles et les approches émergentes. We invest in your success through comprehensive training, combining internal programs with resources from our technology partners. Join us if you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI technology and making a significant impact in enabling our customers to create GenAI-powered applications with confidence and a fast time to market. Develop applications powered by GenAI models, both self-managed and API-accessible that meet business needs and comply with applicable regulations (GDPR, EU AI Act, Model licenses, etc.) Design effective prompts, continuously balancing simplicity and complexity, to enhance models’. analytical capabilities, refine outputs, improve user experience, and increase control over business users' interactions with the models. Optimize model output accuracy with RAG techniques to retrieve relevant information from pre-determined knowledge sources and gain insights into how the model generates the response (including source attribution). Select and fine-tune the right models to create higher-quality multimodal content (images, text, audio, video, etc.) and raise the value creation opportunity for businesses. items.desc: Are you excited by the move from chatbots to reliable, production-grade AI agents? Do you enjoy turning emerging AI capabilities into customer experiences that are useful, safe, measurable, and genuinely scalable? Join the Generators squad in If’s Oasis tribe and help shape the next generation of digital customer experiences in insurance. Our GenAI-powered assistant is live across Denmark, Sweden, and Norway, serving customers on web and app. Now we are expanding across the Nordics and evolving the assistant from a strong conversational experience into a more personalized, connected, and action-oriented AI product. You will be central to that journey, working on real production systems with a modern stack (LangGraph, Langfuse, Azure): designing, building, evaluating, and operating AI systems that can use internal knowledge and APIs responsibly to help customers get the right guidance at the right moment. About The Role This is one open position, and we are open to both junior and senior candidates. As our Generative AI Specialist, you will be a hands-on engineer in the Generators squad, building production AI systems alongside the team, from agent design and retrieval to evaluation and monitoring. Your Responsibilities Include Designing and building production-grade agentic workflows with tool and API use, orchestration, guardrails, and safe handover paths. Building the agent harness: the runtime that makes agents dependable in production, including context management, memory, and observability. Scaling our AI assistant across Nordic markets. Integrating AI systems with internal APIs and data to deliver personalized support. Improving retrieval, grounding, and response quality through systematic experimentation. Establishing evaluation practices (test sets, regression testing, human and safety evaluation) and monitoring quality, latency, and cost. Building improvement loops that use evaluations, customer feedback, and production signals. Collaborating with the Product Owner and the team through code reviews and knowledge sharing. We have a hybrid setup with fixed team days onsite. Occasional travel to Nordic markets and our Kuala Lumpur office is part of the role. We offer Here are some of the benefits of working at If: An inclusive work environment where everyone is welcome Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics Social activities and a highly skilled professional environment Possibility of a hybrid workplace A health-promoting workplace with e.g., fitness programs and various sports activities Attractive insurance benefits About The Team You will be a hands-on squad member in Generators, an agile team that builds customer-facing solutions driven by real user insights. We work with a clear build, measure, learn mindset and continuously validate what creates the most value for our customers. Collaboration, code quality, and a team-first mindset matter deeply to us. You will work closely with colleagues across engineering, product, and business to turn ambitious AI opportunities into reliable customer experiences. Junior colleagues are supported by experienced teammates through pairing and code reviews, and seniors help shape the team’s direction. Who are you? You are an engineer, at junior or senior level, who is curious about AI and enjoys building, testing, and improving systems in production. You are a team player who is pragmatic, unafraid to challenge assumptions, and thrives in a cross-Nordic, cross-functional, hybrid environment. Must Have (all Levels) A university degree in a technical or quantitative field, such as computer science, engineering, mathematics, mathematical economics, physics, or statistics. Hands-on Python experience, ideally with FastAPI, Pydantic, and pytest. Practical experience building LLM-powered or agentic applications, ideally with LangGraph or LangChain, and sound knowledge of agentic best practices: tool use, orchestration, state management, guardrails, human-in-the-loop, and safe fallbacks. Experience with AI evaluations (test sets, regression testing, LLM-as-judge) and observability of LLM applications (we use Langfuse). Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD (Azure DevOps), Docker, and cloud, ideally Azure. The ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineers and business stakeholders. Senior Level / Nice To Have Proven experience running LLM-powered or agentic systems in production, including cost, latency, and incident management. Knowledge of RAG: embeddings, vector search (we use Qdrant), reranking, and grounding. Experience designing an agent harness or comparable runtime: context management, memory, access control, and safe deployment. Azure (OpenAI or AI Foundry, Key Vault, App Configuration), infrastructure as code with Bicep, and secure API design. items.desc: ¡Hola! Somos OGA Nos ilusiona que estés considerando esta oportunidad de empleo. Somos una compañía pionera en la hibridación de la Inteligencia Artificial y la Investigación Operativa, con sede en Sevilla. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la industria a través de soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto para nuestros clientes, líderes en sectores como el logístico, supply chain, industrial o el químico. Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico. Sobre la posición. Buscamos incorporar un/a Generative AI Engineer a nuestro equipo de IA. Queremos contar con una persona que disfrute construyendo aplicaciones basadas en modelos de lenguaje (LLM) y otras tecnologías de IA generativa, conectando estos modelos con información, herramientas y sistemas reales. Participarás en el desarrollo de asistentes inteligentes, soluciones de búsqueda y consulta documental, automatización de procesos y sistemas capaces de utilizar herramientas para resolver tareas complejas. Nuestro objetivo no es simplemente integrar un LLM, sino desarrollar soluciones útiles, fiables, medibles y mantenibles que puedan funcionar en entornos empresariales reales. ¿Qué harás? Desarrollo de aplicaciones con LLM Diseñar e implementar aplicaciones basadas en modelos de lenguaje, utilizando APIs comerciales, modelos abiertos o modelos desplegados en infraestructura propia, según las necesidades del proyecto. Desarrollar prompts, plantillas y flujos de interacción que permitan obtener resultados consistentes y controlados. Integrar los modelos con APIs, bases de datos, aplicaciones corporativas y otros servicios. Trabajar con salidas estructuradas, validación de respuestas y mecanismos de control de errores. Sistemas RAG y gestión del conocimiento Diseñar e implementar soluciones de generación aumentada por recuperación (RAG) para consultar documentación y fuentes de información empresariales. Desarrollar procesos de ingesta, fragmentación ( chunking ), indexación y recuperación de información. Experimentar con embeddings, búsqueda semántica, recuperación híbrida y técnicas de reranking cuando aporten valor. Evaluar la relevancia de los documentos recuperados, la fidelidad de las respuestas y su trazabilidad hasta las fuentes. Colaborar en la integración de permisos y controles de acceso para proteger la información. Agentes y automatización Desarrollar flujos de trabajo basados en LLM que utilicen herramientas y servicios externos mediante tool calling . Implementar agentes y sistemas de orquestación para automatizar tareas concretas con límites y controles definidos. Utilizar frameworks de orquestación cuando aporten valor, seleccionando la tecnología más adecuada para cada solución. Gestionar estados, errores, reintentos, límites de ejecución y validación de las acciones realizadas. Integrar las soluciones con sistemas empresariales, APIs y procesos de negocio. Evaluación, seguridad y puesta en producción Diseñar pruebas y métricas para evaluar la calidad, fiabilidad, latencia y coste de las aplicaciones. Crear conjuntos de evaluación representativos y utilizar pruebas automatizadas para detectar regresiones. Implementar medidas frente a alucinaciones, inyección de prompts, uso indebido de herramientas y exposición de información sensible. Participar en el despliegue, monitorización y mantenimiento de las soluciones. Trabajar con prácticas de versionado, observabilidad y gestión del ciclo de vida de aplicaciones de IA. Contribuir a evaluar modelos y arquitecturas locales cuando los requisitos de privacidad, seguridad o latencia lo requieran. Timing de primeras semanas en OGA Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. El área de People organizará una serie de reuniones de Onboarding en tres niveles con distintos responsables de OGA: aspectos generales y sistemas internos, el propósito de la compañía y las tecnologías que utilizamos. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación. ¿Qué requerimos? Titulación en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Ciencia de Datos o disciplinas relacionadas, o experiencia profesional equivalente. Experiencia práctica desarrollando aplicaciones en Python. Conocimientos de los modelos de lenguaje y de sus principales capacidades y limitaciones. Experiencia desarrollando aplicaciones con LLM mediante APIs o modelos abiertos. Conocimiento práctico de técnicas de …

items.desc: Are you excited by the move from chatbots to reliable, production-grade AI agents? Do you enjoy turning emerging AI capabilities into customer experiences that are useful, safe, measurable, and genuinely scalable? Join the Generators squad in If’s Oasis tribe and help shape the next generation of digital customer experiences in insurance. Our GenAI-powered assistant is live across Denmark, Sweden, and Norway, serving customers on web and app. Now we are expanding across the Nordics and evolving the assistant from a strong conversational experience into a more personalized, connected, and action-oriented AI product. You will be central to that journey, working on real production systems with a modern stack (LangGraph, Langfuse, Azure): designing, building, evaluating, and operating AI systems that can use internal knowledge and APIs responsibly to help customers get the right guidance at the right moment. About The Role This is one open position, and we are open to both junior and senior candidates. As our Generative AI Specialist, you will be a hands-on engineer in the Generators squad, building production AI systems alongside the team, from agent design and retrieval to evaluation and monitoring. Your Responsibilities Include Designing and building production-grade agentic workflows with tool and API use, orchestration, guardrails, and safe handover paths. Building the agent harness: the runtime that makes agents dependable in production, including context management, memory, and observability. Scaling our AI assistant across Nordic markets. Integrating AI systems with internal APIs and data to deliver personalized support. Improving retrieval, grounding, and response quality through systematic experimentation. Establishing evaluation practices (test sets, regression testing, human and safety evaluation) and monitoring quality, latency, and cost. Building improvement loops that use evaluations, customer feedback, and production signals. Collaborating with the Product Owner and the team through code reviews and knowledge sharing. We have a hybrid setup with fixed team days onsite. Occasional travel to Nordic markets and our Kuala Lumpur office is part of the role. We offer Here are some of the benefits of working at If: An inclusive work environment where everyone is welcome Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics Social activities and a highly skilled professional environment Possibility of a hybrid workplace A health-promoting workplace with e.g., fitness programs and various sports activities Attractive insurance benefits About The Team You will be a hands-on squad member in Generators, an agile team that builds customer-facing solutions driven by real user insights. We work with a clear build, measure, learn mindset and continuously validate what creates the most value for our customers. Collaboration, code quality, and a team-first mindset matter deeply to us. You will work closely with colleagues across engineering, product, and business to turn ambitious AI opportunities into reliable customer experiences. Junior colleagues are supported by experienced teammates through pairing and code reviews, and seniors help shape the team’s direction. Who are you? You are an engineer, at junior or senior level, who is curious about AI and enjoys building, testing, and improving systems in production. You are a team player who is pragmatic, unafraid to challenge assumptions, and thrives in a cross-Nordic, cross-functional, hybrid environment. Must Have (all Levels) A university degree in a technical or quantitative field, such as computer science, engineering, mathematics, mathematical economics, physics, or statistics. Hands-on Python experience, ideally with FastAPI, Pydantic, and pytest. Practical experience building LLM-powered or agentic applications, ideally with LangGraph or LangChain, and sound knowledge of agentic best practices: tool use, orchestration, state management, guardrails, human-in-the-loop, and safe fallbacks. Experience with AI evaluations (test sets, regression testing, LLM-as-judge) and observability of LLM applications (we use Langfuse). Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD (Azure DevOps), Docker, and cloud, ideally Azure. The ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineers and business stakeholders. Senior Level / Nice To Have Proven experience running LLM-powered or agentic systems in production, including cost, latency, and incident management. Knowledge of RAG: embeddings, vector search (we use Qdrant), reranking, and grounding. Experience designing an agent harness or comparable runtime: context management, memory, access control, and safe deployment. Azure (OpenAI or AI Foundry, Key Vault, App Configuration), infrastructure as code with Bicep, and secure API design. Data and platform services such as Redis, MongoDB, and Qdrant, and tracing with Langfuse, LangSmith, or OpenTelemetry. Mentoring colleagues and shaping technical …

items.desc: AI Engineer 📍 Luogo: Full Remote 💰 RAL: 35.000 a 45.000. 📄 Contratto: Assunzione a Tempo Indeterminato – CCNL Commercio 🔎 Parole Chiave: AI Engineer, Generative AI, LLM, Agentic AI, AI Agents, RAG, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Foundry, Python, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, API, Azure, LLM Evaluation 🎯 Esperienza: Seniority 1-4 anni CHI SIAMO Heliont è il brand di consulenza tecnologica del Gruppo Relizont. Lavoriamo con un approccio sincero e orientato alle persone: per noi la tecnologia ha valore solo se crea impatto reale nei sistemi e nei servizi dei nostri clienti. Il nostro modo di lavorare si basa su tre principi semplici — Strive for. Learn. Improve. — che guidano sia i progetti sia la crescita delle persone nel team. Non cerchiamo solo "tecnici", ma professionisti/e che abbiano voglia di costruire con noi: eccellenza, relazione con il Cliente e il futuro dell'azienda. In Heliont troverai un contesto dove la qualità tecnica conta davvero e dove sarai affiancato da un/a Manager dedicato, con cui far evolvere il tuo percorso nel tempo. IL PROGETTO Stiamo selezionando 1-2 figure AI Engineer per un progetto presso un importante cliente enterprise, leader nello sviluppo di soluzioni software per il mercato Energy & Utilities . Il progetto riguarda lo sviluppo della nuova offerta Generative AI e Agentic AI della piattaforma software del Cliente, con l'obiettivo di integrare funzionalità basate su LLM direttamente all'interno di un prodotto enterprise già strutturato. Il focus sarà sulla realizzazione di agenti AI, workflow agentici, soluzioni RAG, integrazione di LLM, API e tool con i sistemi applicativi esistenti. IL RUOLO Come AI Engineer lavorerai all'interno del team di prodotto del Cliente, occupandoti della progettazione e realizzazione di funzionalità AI destinate a essere integrate in un prodotto software enterprise. Il ruolo combina attività di sviluppo, progettazione e analisi , con la possibilità di confrontarti direttamente con Product Manager, Product Owner e team di sviluppo del Cliente. Non lavorerai esclusivamente su proof of concept: l'obiettivo è portare le soluzioni AI oltre la fase sperimentale, integrandole nei prodotti e nei processi reali. Ecco i principali task che andrai a svolgere: Progettare e sviluppare AI Agent e workflow agentici per automatizzare attività e processi all'interno della piattaforma. Integrare Large Language Models (LLM) nei prodotti software esistenti, lavorando con servizi Azure e progettando prompt, contesto e modalità di interazione. Sviluppare soluzioni RAG , occupandoti di ingestion, chunking, embedding, indicizzazione e ricerca semantica. Progettare sistemi in grado di interrogare in modo affidabile documentazione e database relazionali attraverso il linguaggio naturale . Progettare e integrare API e tool utilizzabili dagli agenti, anche attraverso MCP (Model Context Protocol) e tecnologie equivalenti. Valutare la fattibilità dei casi d'uso proposti, identificando effort, rischi, limiti e condizioni necessarie per portarli in produzione . Lavorare sull'ottimizzazione di costi e consumi dei sistemi LLM , considerando scelta del modello, token, caching, latenza e risorse di calcolo. Contribuire alla definizione di guardrail, standard di qualità, osservabilità ed evaluation dei sistemi AI. Collaborare con i team di prodotto e sviluppo per integrare le funzionalità AI all'interno dei moduli applicativi esistenti. Lavorare secondo metodologie Agile, partecipando alle principali cerimonie e interfacciandoti quotidianamente con team distribuiti internazionalmente. CHI CERCHIAMO Cerchiamo una persona con una forte passione per la tecnologia e la sperimentazione, ma allo stesso tempo capace di astrarsi dal singolo tool per ragionare su architettura, casi d'uso, sostenibilità e valore della soluzione . La seniority è aperta: valuteremo profili diversi sulla base delle competenze effettivamente maturate e della capacità di aver portato soluzioni AI oltre la fase di prototipo. Sono richiesti: Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Matematica, Fisica o discipline affini. Esperienza concreta nello sviluppo di applicazioni basate su LLM , preferibilmente già portate in produzione. Buona conoscenza di Python e capacità di progettare e consumare API. Esperienza concreta su Microsoft Azure e sui relativi servizi AI e applicativi. Conoscenza di Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search e Azure AI Foundry . Familiarità con servizi Azure quali Functions, App Service, AKS e API Management . Esperienza con almeno un framework per l'orchestrazione di agenti, tra Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Pydantic AI o equivalenti. Conoscenza dei principi di RAG , tra cui chunking, embedding, ricerca semantica e valutazione della qualità delle risposte. Consapevolezza dei costi di inferenza e delle principali leve di ottimizzazione: scelta del modello, gestione del contesto, caching e monitoraggio dei consumi. items.desc: Who We Are Based in The Romania Excellence Centre, Bucharest - our client is seeking for experienced professionals who value teamwork, pioneering technology, and innovation. People who want to take their careers to the next level of success. You will be part of a global and diverse team, contribute to all stages of software development lifecycle and lead the implementation, deployment and test of multi-agent systems. Also, This Role Will Give You The Chance To Use frameworks like Google Agent Development Kit (Google ADK) and LangGraph to build robust, controllable, and observable agentic architectures Assist in the design of LLM-powered agents and multi-agent workflows (planning, tool use, orchestration, memory, and human-in-the-loop) So if you are an experienced AI Engineer please join our team to create the next big thing in digital banking. What You’ll Be Doing Design and build complex agentic systems with multiple interacting agents Implement robust orchestration logic (state machines / graphs, retries, fallbacks, escalation to humans) Implement RAG pipelines, tool calling, and sophisticated system prompts for optimal reliability, latency, and cost control Apply core ML concepts to evaluate and improve agent performance, including dataset curation and bias/safety checks Lead the development of agents using Google ADK and/or LangGraph, leveraging advanced features for orchestration, memory, evaluation, and observability Integrate with supporting libraries and infrastructure (e.g., LangChain/LlamaIndex, vector databases, message queues, monitoring tools) with minimal supervision Define success metrics, build evaluation suites for agents (automatic + human evaluation), and drive continuous improvement Curate and maintain comprehensive prompt/test datasets; run regression tests for new model versions and prompt changes Deploy and operate AI services in production, establishing CI/CD pipelines, observability, logging, and tracing Debug complex failures end-to-end, identifying and document root causes across models, prompts, APIs, tools, and data Work closely with product managers and stakeholders to shape requirements, translate them into agent capabilities, and manage expectations Document comprehensive designs, decisions, and runbooks for complex systems What We’re Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field At least 3 years of experience as Software Engineer / ML Engineer / AI Engineer, with at least 1-2 years working directly with LLMs in real applications Strong proficiency in Python (core language features, packaging, testing, async, type hints) Very strong software engineering practices: version control (Git), unit/integration testing, code reviews, CI/CD Experience building and consuming REST/gRPC APIs and integrating external tools/services Understanding of core ML concepts: supervised/unsupervised learning, train/validation/test splits, overfitting, regularization, and common metrics (precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, etc.) Good understanding of deep learning basics (neural networks, embeddings) and at least one ML/DL framework (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, scikit-learn) Deep practical knowledge of large language models Tokenization, context windows, temperature, top-p, system vs user prompts Prompt engineering patterns (ReAct, chain-of-thought, tool-calling/tool-use) Fine-tuning / adapters / instruction-tuning, or experience with RAG as an alternative Experience building LLM-powered applications end-to-end: from idea → prototype → production Familiarity with safety and reliability considerations: hallucinations, guardrails, content filtering, privacy Conceptual understanding of modern agentic frameworks and patterns (stateful graphs, multi-agent coordination, human-in-the-loop, memory, and evaluation). Hands-on experience with at least one of: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) – building multi-agent workflows, using its orchestration, tools, and evaluation features or LangGraph – designing graph-based, stateful agent workflows with cycles, branches, and durable execution Candidates must be able to read, reason about, and extend ADK/LangGraph-based codebases Direct production experience with both ADK and LangGraph is a strong plus Experience working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Chroma) for retrieval-augmented generation Comfortable with SQL and basic data modeling Experience deploying on at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, Azure) and using managed services (e.g., serverless runtimes, container orchestration, secrets management) Nice-to-Have Experience With Vertex AI / Gemini or other hosted LLM ecosystems Related frameworks and tools: LangChain, LlamaIndex, semantic search, evaluation frameworks (e.g., RAGAS, custom eval harnesses) Monitoring and observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana/NewRelic, Datadog, etc.)
